examples.cantonese_sentence: 我做兼職，時薪係五十蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zou6 gim1 zik1, si4 san1 hai6 ng5 sap6 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我做兼职，时薪是50元。
examples.english_sentence: I work part-time; my hourly wage is 50 dollars.

mandarin_meaning: 时装；时尚服装（跟随流行趋势的服饰）
english_meaning: fashion; fashionable clothing; trendy garments
explanation_mandarin: 指符合当下流行趋势的服装或时尚设计，可用于泛指时尚界的服饰或服装款式。
explanation_english: Refers to clothing or designs that follow current fashion trends; used to describe fashionable garments or items in the fashion industry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意買時裝雜誌睇最新潮流。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 maai5 si4 zong1 zaap6 zi3 tai2 zeoi3 san1 ciu4 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她喜欢买时装杂志看最新潮流。
examples.english_sentence: He/She likes buying fashion magazines to check out the latest trends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 設計師喺時裝週展示佢哋嘅新系列。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sit3 gai3 si1 hai2 si4 zong1 zau1 zin2 si6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 san1 hai6 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 设计师在时装周展示他们的新系列。
examples.english_sentence: Designers showcase their new collections at fashion week.

mandarin_meaning: 时装剧（现代题材的电视剧，与古装剧相对）
english_meaning: contemporary drama; modern-day TV drama (as opposed to historical/costume drama)
explanation_mandarin: 指以現代（當代）背景、服飾和生活方式為主題拍攝的電視劇，通常與古裝劇或歷史劇相對。
explanation_english: Refers to television dramas set in contemporary times featuring modern costumes, settings, and lifestyles; typically contrasted with historical or costume dramas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近好多台播緊嘅劇都係時裝劇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 hou2 do1 toi4 bo3 gan2 ge3 kek6 dou1 hai6 si4 zong1 kek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近很多台播的剧都是时装剧。
examples.english_sentence: Lately many channels are airing contemporary dramas.

mandarin_meaning: 時裝災難 / 時尚災難（穿著或造型非常不合適、搭配失敗）
english_meaning: fashion disaster (an outfit or styling that is badly mismatched, inappropriate, or unattractive)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容某人的穿著或造型非常不合適、難看或搭配失敗，常帶有批評或戲謔意味。
explanation_english: A phrase used to describe someone's outfit or styling as extremely inappropriate, unattractive, or badly matched; often used critically or jokingly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日出街嗰套衫真係時裝災難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 ceot1 gaai1 go2 tou3 saam1 zan1 hai6 si4 zong1 zoi1 naan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天出門穿的那套衣服真是時裝災難。
examples.english_sentence: The outfit they wore out today was a fashion disaster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 設計師話呢個造型係前衛，但喺我睇嚟係時裝災難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sit3 gai3 si1 waa6 ni1 go3 zou6 jing4 hai6 cin4 wai6, daan6 hai6 ngo5 tai2 loi4 hai6 si4 zong1 zoi1 naan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 設計師說這個造型很前衛，但在我看來是時裝災難。
examples.english_sentence: The designer called the look avant-garde, but to me it's a fashion disaster.

mandarin_meaning: 时辰（时间；古代把一天分为十二个时辰，每个时辰约为两小时）
english_meaning: time; an hour/time period (historically a two-hour period in traditional Chinese timekeeping); an auspicious time
explanation_mandarin: “時辰”指時間，在古代是一個約兩小時的時段。現代漢語中可指具體的時刻，也常用於選擇吉時、婚喪嫁娶等社會文化語境。
explanation_english: “Shi chen” refers to time or a time period; historically it denotes a two-hour segment in traditional Chinese timekeeping. In modern usage it can mean a specific time or an auspicious time chosen for events.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋話要揀好嘅時辰先搬屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waa6 jiu3 gaan2 hou2 ge3 si4 san4 sin1 bun1 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们说要先选个好时辰才搬家。
examples.english_sentence: They said they should pick a good time before moving house.

mandarin_meaning: 生辰八字（出生的年、月、日、時，用於命理和算命）
english_meaning: The birth 'Eight Characters' (year, month, day, hour) used in Chinese astrology/fortune-telling
explanation_mandarin: 指一個人出生的年、月、日、時等信息（即“八字”），常用於命理、算命、風水等場合；口語中也可泛指具體的出生時間或關鍵時間點。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's birth details (year, month, day, hour) — the 'Eight Characters' used in Chinese astrology and fortune-telling. Colloquially it can also mean a specific birth time or crucial time information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以俾我你嘅時辰八字？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bei2 ngo5 nei5 ge3 si4 san4 baat3 zi6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以把你的生辰八字告訴我嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Can you give me your birth date and time (your Eight Characters)?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 風水師要睇你嘅時辰八字先至可以算命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fung1 seoi2 si1 jiu3 tai2 nei5 ge3 si4 san4 baat3 zi6 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 syun3 ming6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 風水師要看你的生辰八字才能算命。
examples.english_sentence: The feng shui master needs to see your birth date and time to do a fortune-telling.

mandarin_meaning: 时辰钟
english_meaning: time bell; a bell or clock that marks traditional Chinese 'shi‑chen' time periods
explanation_mandarin: 時辰鐘指用來敲響或標示時辰（古代每兩小時為一時辰）的鐘，常見於寺廟或古代的報時裝置。
explanation_english: A bell or clock used to sound or indicate the traditional Chinese shi‑chen (two‑hour) periods; commonly found in temples or as an ancient time‑keeping device.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古代嘅時辰鐘用嚟報時。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 doi6 ge3 si4 san4 zung1 jung6 lai4 bou3 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代的时辰钟用来报时。
examples.english_sentence: In ancient times, time bells were used to announce the time.

mandarin_meaning: 时速；每小时的速度（通常以公里/小时为单位）
english_meaning: speed per hour; the distance traveled in one hour (commonly measured in km/h)
explanation_mandarin: 表示每小時行駛或移動的距離，常用於道路限速或交通工具的速度標示，單位一般為公里/小時（km/h）。
explanation_english: Refers to the distance traveled in one hour; commonly used in road speed limits or to indicate the speed of vehicles, usually measured in kilometers per hour (km/h).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢段路限時速五十公里。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dyun6 lou6 haan6 si4 cuk1 ng5 sap6 gong1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这段路限速每小时五十公里。
examples.english_sentence: This stretch of road has a speed limit of 50 km/h.

mandarin_meaning: 时运；运气、际遇
english_meaning: fortune; luck; the state of one's luck or fate during a period
explanation_mandarin: 指一個人在某段時間的運氣或際遇，常用於描述命運、運勢的好壞與起落。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's luck or fortune over a period of time; used to describe the ups and downs of one's fate or luck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近時運唔好，做咩事都唔順利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 si4 wan6 m4 hou2, zou6 me1 si6 dou1 m4 seon6 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近时运不好，做什么事都不顺利。
examples.english_sentence: His luck hasn't been good recently; nothing he does goes smoothly.

jyutping: si4 wan6 gou1 tai2 m4 dou3
mandarin_meaning: 運氣非常好，走運到不可思議的程度
english_meaning: extremely lucky / on an unstoppable lucky streak
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語表達，表示某人最近運氣特別好，凡事順利、屢屢中獎或成功，帶有誇張或幽默成分。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning someone is extraordinarily lucky — everything seems to go their way. Often used humorously or hyperbolically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近佢真係時運高睇唔到，搞乜都中。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 keoi5 zan1 hai6 si4 wan6 gou1 tai2 m4 dou3, gaau2 mat1 dou1 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近他真的是運氣好到不可思議，做什麼都中（成功）。
examples.english_sentence: He's been insanely lucky lately — everything he does works out/wins.

mandarin_meaning: 時針（鐘表上較短的指針，用來指示小時）
english_meaning: hour hand (the shorter hand on a clock that indicates the hour)
explanation_mandarin: 鐘表上較短的一根指針，用來顯示小時，與分針相對。
explanation_english: The shorter hand on a clock or watch that indicates the hour, as opposed to the minute hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇下，時針而家指住幾點？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 haa5, si4 zam1 ji4 gaa1 zi2 zyu6 gei2 dim2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看，时针现在指着几点？
examples.english_sentence: Look, what time is the hour hand pointing to right now?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個鐘嘅時針好似走得慢，可能要換電池。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 zung1 ge3 si4 zam1 hou2 ci5 zau2 dak1 maan6, ho2 nang4 jiu3 wun6 din6 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 钟的时针好像走得慢，可能要换电池。
examples.english_sentence: The clock's hour hand seems to be running slow; it might need a new battery.

mandarin_meaning: 时钟
english_meaning: clock
explanation_mandarin: 表示用來顯示時間的器具，通常指掛在牆上或放在桌上的時鐘。
explanation_english: A device used to display the time; typically refers to a clock hung on a wall or placed on a table.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 牆上掛住一個時鐘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 soeng6 gwaa3 zyu6 jat1 go3 si4 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 墙上挂着一个时钟。
examples.english_sentence: There is a clock hanging on the wall.

mandarin_meaning: 钟点酒店（按小时出租客房的酒店）
english_meaning: hourly hotel; short-stay (or 'love') hotel — a hotel that rents rooms by the hour
explanation_mandarin: 指按小时出租客房的酒店，供短时间休息或约会使用，有时带有隐私或情色的含义。
explanation_english: Refers to hotels that rent rooms by the hour for short stays, often used for resting, dates, or private encounters; can carry euphemistic or sexual connotations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好攰，想喺時鐘酒店訓陣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 gui6, soeng2 hai2 si4 zung1 zau2 dim3 fan3 zan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很累，想在钟点酒店睡一会儿。
examples.english_sentence: I'm really tired and want to sleep for a while in an hourly hotel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間時鐘酒店好乾淨，但通常係用嚟約會嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 si4 zung1 zau2 dim3 hou2 gon1 zeng6, daan6 tung1 soeng4 hai6 jung6 lai4 joek3 wui6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家钟点酒店很干净，但通常是用来约会的。
examples.english_sentence: This hourly hotel is very clean, but it's usually used for dates.

mandarin_meaning: 时间
english_meaning: time
explanation_mandarin: 表示持續的度量或特定的時刻，可指抽象的時間概念或具體的時間段。
explanation_english: Refers to the measure of duration or a specific point/period; can denote an abstract concept of time or a concrete time span.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇時間今晚食飯？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 si4 gaan3 gam1 maan5 sik6 faan6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今晚有时间吃饭吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you have time to have dinner tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我冇太多時間做功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mou5 taai3 do1 si4 gaan3 zou6 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我没有太多时间做作业。
examples.english_sentence: I don't have much time to do homework.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 時間會沖淡傷痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si4 gaan3 wui5 cung1 daam6 soeng1 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 时间会冲淡痛苦。
examples.english_sentence: Time will ease the pain.

mandarin_meaning: 定時開關 / 定時器
english_meaning: timer switch / timer (button)
explanation_mandarin: 指家電或裝置上的定時開關或按鈕，用來設定裝置幾時開或關；也可引申為倒數計時或限期的概念。
explanation_english: Refers to a timer switch/button on appliances or devices used to set when they turn on/off; can also be used metaphorically for a countdown or time limit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部冷氣有時間掣，可以預先設定幾耐先熄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 laang5 hei3 jau5 si4 gaan3 caat3, ho2 ji5 jyu6 sin1 cit3 ding6 gei2 noi6 sin1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部冷氣有定時開關，可以預先設定多久才關掉。
examples.english_sentence: This air conditioner has a timer switch; you can preset how long before it turns off.

mandarin_meaning: 时间线
english_meaning: timeline
explanation_mandarin: 指按時間順序排列的重要事件或節點，可以指歷史脈絡上的時間順序，也常用於社交媒體表示動態資訊流或帖子排列。
explanation_english: Refers to a chronological sequence of important events or points in time. It can mean a historical timeline, or, in social media/technology contexts, the feed or sequence of posts/events.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺Facebook睇返我朋友嘅時間線。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 Facebook tai2 faan1 ngo5 pang4 jau5 ge3 si4 gaan3 sin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在Facebook上查看朋友的时间线。
examples.english_sentence: I was looking through my friend's timeline on Facebook.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 歷史課老師畫咗一條時間線，顯示古代至今嘅重要事件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lik6 si2 fo3 lou5 si1 waa6 zo2 jat1 tiu4 si4 gaan3 sin3, hin2 si6 gu2 doi6 zi3 gam1 ge3 zung6 jiu3 si6 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 历史课老师画了一条时间线，显示古代至今的重要事件。
examples.english_sentence: The history teacher drew a timeline showing major events from ancient times to the present.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要整理項目嘅時間線，確保每個階段有明確截止日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zing2 lei5 hong6 muk6 ge3 si4 gaan3 sin3, kok3 bou2 mui5 go3 gaai1 dyun6 jau5 ming4 kok3 git3 zi2 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要整理项目的时间线，确保每个阶段有明确截止日。
examples.english_sentence: We need to organize the project's timeline to ensure each phase has a clear deadline.

mandarin_meaning: 时间表 / 日程表 / 时刻表
english_meaning: timetable; schedule; timetable/schedule of events or times
explanation_mandarin: 表示列出各項活動或交通工具發出與到達時間的表格或清單，用於安排或參考時間。
explanation_english: A chart or list showing planned times for events or departures/arrivals; a timetable or schedule used for planning and reference.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校已經發咗下學期嘅時間表。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 ji5 ging1 faat3 zo2 haa6 hok6 kei4 ge3 si4 gaan3 biu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學校已經發下學期的時間表了。
examples.english_sentence: The school has already released the timetable for next semester.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以喺車站睇到火車嘅時間表。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 hai2 ce1 zaam6 tai2 dou2 fo2 ce1 ge3 si4 gaan3 biu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以在車站看到火車的時間表。
examples.english_sentence: You can see the train timetable at the station.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要訂一個詳細嘅時間表，咁先可以按時完成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 deng6 jat1 go3 coeng4 sai3 ge3 si4 gaan3 biu2, gam2 sin1 ho2 ji5 on3 si4 jyun4 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們要訂一個詳細的時間表，這樣才能按時完成。
examples.english_sentence: We need to set a detailed schedule so we can finish on time.

mandarin_meaning: 时髦；时尚
english_meaning: fashionable; stylish; trendy
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容某人或某事跟上流行、具有時尚感、看起來很新潮。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something that follows current trends and has a fashionable, stylish appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日著得好時髦，吸引咗好多人睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 dak1 hou2 si4 mou4, kap1 jan5 zo2 hou2 do1 jan4 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天穿得很时髦，吸引了很多人看。
examples.english_sentence: He/she is dressed very fashionably today, attracting a lot of attention.

mandarin_meaning: 摇晃；闪烁；（口）欺骗；一晃（表示时间很快过去）
english_meaning: to sway/shake; to flash/dazzle; (colloquial) to trick; (as 一晃) in a flash/in the blink of an eye
explanation_mandarin: “晃”可以表示物體來回搖動或閃動的動作，也可口語指欺騙某人；作時間副詞用（如“一晃”）則表示時間迅速流逝。
explanation_english: “晃” can mean to swing or shake, or to flash/dazzle. Colloquially it can mean to trick someone. As in the phrase 一晃, it expresses that time passed quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 風咁大，啲樹晃得好勁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fung1 gam2 daai6, di1 syu6 wong6 dak1 hou2 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 風這麼大，樹搖晃得很厲害。
examples.english_sentence: The wind is so strong the trees are swaying violently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一晃五年過咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 wong6 ng5 nin4 gwo3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一晃五年就過去了。
examples.english_sentence: In a flash, five years have passed.

mandarin_meaning: 晃动；摇动
english_meaning: to shake; to sway; to wobble
explanation_mandarin: 表示物體來回擺動或搖晃，通常指因外力或不穩定導致的晃盪。
explanation_english: Describes an object moving back and forth or shaking/swaying, usually caused by an external force or instability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 枱一震，杯子就晃動咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: toi4 jat1 zan3, bui1 zi2 zau6 wong6 dung6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 桌子一震，杯子就晃动了。
examples.english_sentence: When the table shook, the cup started to wobble.

mandarin_meaning: 晋（jìn）：晋升、提升；亦指中国古代的晋国或晋朝；为姓氏。
english_meaning: Jìn: to advance or promote; also refers to the ancient Chinese state/dynasty Jin; a surname.
explanation_mandarin: “晉”可以表示升迁、晋升（如“晉升”）；在历史语境中指晋国或晋朝；同时可作为姓氏使用。
explanation_english: “晉” can mean to promote or advance (as in compounds like '晉升'); historically it refers to the State of Jin or the Jin dynasty; it is also used as a surname.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 晉朝係中國古代嘅一個朝代。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeon3 ciu4 hai6 zung1 gwok3 gu2 doi6 ge3 jat1 go3 ciu4 doi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晋朝是中国古代的一个朝代。
examples.english_sentence: The Jin dynasty was a dynasty in ancient China.

mandarin_meaning: 晋升；升职、提升职务或等级
english_meaning: to promote; promotion (advancement in rank or position)
partOfSpeech_english: verb (can also be used as noun: 'promotion')
explanation_mandarin: 指在職位或等級上獲得提升，通常用於升職或晉級的情況。
explanation_english: To be raised to a higher position or rank; commonly used for being promoted or advancing in status.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為表現突出，已經晉升做部門經理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 biu2 jin6 dat6 ceot1, ji5 ging1 zeon3 sing1 zou6 bou6 mun4 ging1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為表現突出，已經晉升為部門經理。
examples.english_sentence: He was promoted to department manager because of his outstanding performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司有固定嘅晉升制度，表現好嘅員工先有機會晉升。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jau5 gu3 ding6 ge3 zeon3 sing1 zai3 dou6, biu2 jin6 hou2 ge3 jyun4 gung1 sin1 jau5 gei1 wui6 zeon3 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司有固定的晉升制度，表現好的員工才有機會晉升。
examples.english_sentence: The company has a formal promotion system; only employees with good performance have a chance to be promoted.

mandarin_meaning: 晋级
english_meaning: to advance to the next round/level; to be promoted
explanation_mandarin: 表示在比賽、職位或等級上從較低的階段提升到較高的階段或輪次。
explanation_english: To move up a level or round — e.g., advancing to the next stage of a competition, ranking up in a game, or being promoted to a higher position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋贏咗呢場比賽，成功晉級下一輪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jing4 zo2 ni1 coeng4 bei2 coi3, sing4 gung1 zeon3 kap1 haa6 jat1 leon4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們贏了這場比賽，成功晉級下一輪。
examples.english_sentence: They won this match and successfully advanced to the next round.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺遊戲入面成功晉級到金牌段位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 jau4 hei3 jap6 min6 sing4 gung1 zeon3 kap1 dou3 gam1 paai4 dyun6 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在遊戲裡面成功晉級到金牌段位。
examples.english_sentence: I successfully advanced to the Gold rank in the game.

mandarin_meaning: 拜見；向地位較高的人正式會見（多用於對君主或上級）
english_meaning: to pay a formal visit to or present oneself before a superior; to pay one's respects (used in formal contexts)
explanation_mandarin: 表示拜見或向地位較高的人行禮、見面，通常用於正式或官場場合，語氣較為莊重或文言。
explanation_english: Indicates formally meeting or paying respects to someone of higher rank; used in formal or official situations with a solemn tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今日要去晉見董事長，記得準時出席。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 zeon3 gin3 dong2 si6 zoeng2, gei3 dak1 zeon2 si4 ceot1 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們今天要去晉見董事長，記得準時出席。
examples.english_sentence: We are going to pay a formal visit to the chairman today; remember to be on time.

mandarin_meaning: 晋升；进入更高的地位或阶层
english_meaning: to be promoted; to advance to a higher position or rank
explanation_mandarin: 表示從原有的職位或等級提升，進入較高的地位或階層，可用於職場或社會地位的提升。
explanation_english: Indicates moving up from a current position or level into a higher rank, status, or tier; commonly used for job promotions or social advancement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢努力咁做，終於晉身做經理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nou5 lik6 gam2 zou6, zung1 jyu1 zeon3 san1 zou6 ging1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他努力工作，终于晋升为经理。
examples.english_sentence: He worked hard and was finally promoted to manager.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 年紀輕就能晉身高層，真係唔容易。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nin4 gei2 heng1 zau6 nang4 zeon3 san1 gou1 cang4, zan1 hai6 m4 jung4 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 年纪轻就能晋升到高层，真的不容易。
examples.english_sentence: Being able to rise to senior management at a young age is really not easy.

mandarin_meaning: 在（...的時候）；（晌午）中午
english_meaning: at; during; (in compounds like '晌午') noon/midday
explanation_mandarin: 「晌」常用於廣東話，表示在某一時間或某處，相當於普通話的「在」或「在……的時候」。也出現在詞組如「晌午」，表示中午。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "晌" is used to indicate being at a certain time or place (equivalent to Mandarin "在" or "when/at"). It also appears in compounds like "晌午" meaning "noon."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我晌屋企等你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 uk1 kei2 dang2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在家等你。
examples.english_sentence: I'll wait for you at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 晌午我哋去食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng2 ng5 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中午我們去吃飯。
examples.english_sentence: We'll go eat at noon.

mandarin_meaning: 晚、迟；（姓氏）
english_meaning: late; later; (in compounds) to have lunch (colloquial)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞 / 名詞 / 姓
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語中常用「晏(aan3)」表示晚、遲或「稍後」。亦常見於「食晏」表示吃午飯。另在文言或作姓氏時有不同讀音或用法。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, 晏 (aan3) is commonly used colloquially to mean 'late' or 'later' and appears in compounds like '食晏' (to have lunch). It can also appear as a surname or in literary contexts with different usages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中午我要同朋友去食晏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 ng5 ngo5 jiu3 tung4 pang4 jau5 heoi3 sik6 aan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中午我要和朋友去吃午饭。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to have lunch with friends at noon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嚟得太晏啦，會議已經開始咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 lai4 dak1 taai3 aan3 laa3, wui6 ji5 ji5 ging1 hoi1 ci2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你来得太晚了，会议已经开始了。
examples.english_sentence: You're too late; the meeting has already started.

mandarin_meaning: 下午
english_meaning: afternoon
explanation_mandarin: 粵語用詞，指中午之後到傍晚之前的時段，常見於香港廣東話口語中。
explanation_english: A Cantonese term meaning 'afternoon', used in Hong Kong Cantonese to refer to the time period after noon and before evening.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋晏晝見面得唔得？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ngaan6 zau3 gin3 min6 dak1 m4 dak1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们下午见面可以吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can we meet this afternoon?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日晏晝我有個會議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 ngaan6 zau3 ngo5 jau5 go3 wui6 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天下午我有个会议。
examples.english_sentence: I have a meeting this afternoon.

mandarin_meaning: 午饭 / 午餐
english_meaning: lunch
explanation_mandarin: 粤语常用口语，指中午吃的饭或餐，即午饭。与普通话的“午饭/午餐”相对应。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term referring to the midday meal (lunch). Equivalent to Mandarin '午饭/午餐'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日晏晝飯食咗魚蛋粉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 ngaan6 zau3 faan6 sik6 zo2 jyu4 daan6 fan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天午饭吃了鱼蛋粉。
examples.english_sentence: I had fishball noodles for lunch today.

mandarin_meaning: 睡懶覺；睡得很晚或睡到很晚才起來
english_meaning: to sleep in; to oversleep (have a lie-in); sleep late
explanation_mandarin: 「晏覺」是廣東話口語，指睡得較晚或早上睡懶覺、賴床不早起。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to sleep late or sleep in (have a lie-in/oversleep).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日唔使返工，我想訓晏覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 m4 sai2 faan1 gung1, ngo5 soeng2 fan3 aan3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天不用上班，我想睡懶覺。
examples.english_sentence: I don't have to work tomorrow; I want to sleep in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都晏覺，朝早起唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 aan3 gaau3, ziu1 zou2 hei2 m4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是睡懶覺，早上起不來。
examples.english_sentence: He always sleeps in and can't wake up in the morning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友唔好訓晏覺，會影響上學成績。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 m4 hou2 fan3 aan3 gaau3, wui5 jing2 hoeng2 soeng5 hok6 sing4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩不要睡懶覺，會影響上學成績。
examples.english_sentence: Kids shouldn't sleep in; it can affect their school performance.

mandarin_meaning: 晒 / 晾（晒太阳、晾乾）；炫耀；（口語）表示完全、全部
english_meaning: to sun/to dry; to show off; (colloquial) to finish/complete (eat/use up)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞；口語助詞/語氣詞（依語境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 「晒」在粵語有幾個常見用法：一是指把東西放在陽光下晾乾或曬太陽；二是指炫耀、賣弄；三是在口語中用作程度或完成標記（如「食晒」表示吃完）。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "晒" (saai3) has several uses: (1) to put something in the sun to dry or to bask; (2) to show off; (3) colloquially used as a marker to indicate completion or entirety (e.g. "sik6 saai3" = eaten up).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啲衫而家喺天台度晒緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 di1 saam1 ji4 gaa1 hai2 tin1 toi4 dou6 saai3 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的衣服現在在天台上晾著。
examples.english_sentence: My clothes are drying on the rooftop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺Facebook度晒佢部車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 Facebook dou6 saai3 keoi5 bou6 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是在 Facebook 上炫耀他的車。
examples.english_sentence: He is always showing off his car on Facebook.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲餅我哋已經食晒喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 beng2 ngo5 dei6 ji5 ging1 sik6 saai3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些餅我們已經吃完了。
examples.english_sentence: We've already eaten all the cakes.

mandarin_meaning: 冷落/冷淡（故意不理睬）
english_meaning: to give someone the cold shoulder; to snub or treat someone coldly
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語俚語，表示故意冷落、冷淡對待別人，用不理睬或冷漠的態度對人。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang phrase meaning to deliberately snub or treat someone coldly—i.e., to give the cold shoulder or act aloof.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日對我晒冷，好似唔想見到我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 deoi3 ngo5 saai3 laang5, hou2 ci5 m4 soeng2 gin3 dou3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常對我冷落，好像不想見到我。
examples.english_sentence: They often give me the cold shoulder, as if they don't want to see me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再晒冷，講返你嘅問題出嚟，我哋幫你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 saai3 laang5, gong2 faan1 nei5 ge3 man6 tai4 ceot1 lai4, ngo5 dei6 bong1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再冷淡了，把你的問題說出來，我們幫你。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep giving the cold shoulder; tell us your problem and we'll help you.

mandarin_meaning: 炫耀；卖弄（口语，俚语）
english_meaning: to show off; to brag; to flaunt (colloquial/slang)
explanation_mandarin: 粤语俚语，指通过言行夸耀自己或显摆自己拥有的东西、能力，有时带有贬义或“卖弄”的意思。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang verb meaning to show off or brag — to flaunt one's possessions, abilities, or achievements. Often carries a negative nuance of ostentation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺度晒命，講自己有幾多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 saai3 ming6, gong2 zi6 gei2 jau5 gei2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在那儿炫耀，说自己有多少钱。
examples.english_sentence: He is always showing off, saying how much money he has.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好晒命，低調啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 saai3 ming6, dai1 diu6 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别炫耀，低调一点吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't show off — be more low-key.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺面試度晒命，自以為好犀利，結果冇得工做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 min6 si3 dou6 saai3 ming6, zi6 ji5 wai4 hou2 sai1 lei6, git3 gwo2 mou5 dak1 gung1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在面试时炫耀，自以为很厉害，结果没得到工作。
examples.english_sentence: He showed off during the interview, thinking he was great, but ended up not getting the job.

mandarin_meaning: 炫耀；卖弄
english_meaning: to show off; to flaunt
explanation_mandarin: 香港粵語俚語，前字「晒」有展示、炫耀之意，「士」為俏皮或口語化後綴。用來形容在人前或在社交媒體上誇耀自己、炫耀財力或生活狀態。屬非正式用語。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang term: 晒 (to show) plus 士 as a playful suffix. It describes showing off or flaunting oneself—often used for bragging on social media. Informal usage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺IG晒士，好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 IG saai3 si6, hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是在IG上炫耀，真烦。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps showing off on Instagram; so annoying.

mandarin_meaning: 把當月的錢花光；成為「月光族」
english_meaning: to spend all of one's monthly income; to be broke by the end of the month (monthly spender)
explanation_mandarin: 「晒月光」是廣東話俗語，指在一個月份內把薪水或當月的錢全部花光，成為所謂的「月光族」。通常帶有輕微自嘲或批評意味。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang phrase meaning to spend all of one's money for the month (to be a 'month-light' person). It implies being broke by the end of the pay period and often carries a slightly self-mocking or critical tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今個月又晒月光，唔夠錢去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 go3 jyut6 jau6 saai3 jyut6 gwong1，m4 gau3 cin2 heoi3 leoi5 hang4。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我這個月又把錢花光了，沒錢去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I spent all my money again this month; I don't have enough to go on a trip.

mandarin_meaning: 晒照片；（在社交媒体上）炫耀自己的照片
english_meaning: to post/show off photos (usually on social media)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語，原意為把照片晾曬或沖曬，現多指在社交媒體上張貼照片，常帶有炫耀或分享近況的含義。
explanation_english: Cantonese colloquial term. Originally meant to dry or develop photos; now commonly used to mean posting photos on social media, often with a sense of showing off or sharing updates.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺Instagram晒相，成日都係想炫耀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 Instagram saai3 soeng2, sing4 jat6 dou1 hai6 soeng2 hyun6 jiu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他成天在 Instagram 晒照片，就是想炫耀。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps posting photos on Instagram; he's just trying to show off.

mandarin_meaning: 炫耀錢財的時刻；顯擺有錢的時候
english_meaning: a time to flaunt money; showing off one's wealth
explanation_mandarin: 「晒銀時」是廣東話俚語，用來形容某人有錢或剛獲得錢財，開始在別人面前展示或炫耀財力的時刻。
explanation_english: “晒銀時” is Cantonese slang referring to the moment when someone has money (or just came into money) and starts to display or flaunt their wealth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱中咗六合彩，今日就係晒銀時，一路買名牌一路炫耀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aam1 aam1 zung1 zo2 luk6 ho2 coi2, gam1 jat6 zau6 hai6 saai3 ngan4 si4, jat1 lou6 maai5 ming4 paai4 jat1 lou6 hyun3 jiu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他剛中六合彩，今天就是他炫富的時候，一邊買名牌一邊炫耀。
examples.english_sentence: He just won the lottery; today is his time to flaunt his wealth, buying designer brands and showing off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去到朋友嘅生日派對，見到啲人喺度晒銀時，覺得幾虛榮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 dou3 pang4 jau5 ge3 saang1 jat6 paai3 deoi6, gin3 dou3 di1 jan4 hai2 dou6 saai3 ngan4 si4, gok3 dak1 gei2 heoi1 wing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 到朋友的生日派對，看到有人在那裡炫富，覺得挺虛榮的。
examples.english_sentence: At a friend's birthday party, seeing people flaunting wealth felt quite vain.

mandarin_meaning: 炫耀；賣弄
english_meaning: to show off; to flaunt; to gloat
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，指刻意展示自己的財物、成就或優勢以引起他人注意或羨慕，帶有炫耀或賣弄的語氣。
explanation_english: A colloquial/slang verb meaning to deliberately display one's possessions, achievements, or advantages to attract attention or make others envious; to show off or flaunt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺社交媒體晒馬，話自己啲生意好掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 se5 gaau1 mui4 tai2 saai3 maa5, waa6 zi6 gei2 di1 saang1 ji3 hou2 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常在社交媒體上炫耀，說自己的生意很成功。
examples.english_sentence: He often shows off on social media, saying his business is doing great.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日喺我面前晒馬，真係煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 hai2 ngo5 min6 cin4 saai3 maa5, zan1 hai6 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別總是在我面前炫耀，真的很煩。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always show off in front of me — it's really annoying.

mandarin_meaning: 露馬腳；露餡兒
english_meaning: to give oneself away; to reveal one's true colors or secret (unintentionally)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，表示不小心或不經意把真相、缺點或底細暴露出來，相當於普通話的「露馬腳」或「露餡」。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to unintentionally reveal a secret, flaw, or true situation — equivalent to Mandarin '露馬腳' or English 'to give oneself away / let the cat out of the bag'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一開口就晒馬檻，等大家知佢唔識做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 hoi1 hau2 zau6 saai3 maa5 haam4, dang2 daai6 gaa1 zi1 keoi5 m4 sik1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一開口就露出馬腳，讓大家知道他不會做那件事。
examples.english_sentence: He opened his mouth and immediately gave himself away, letting everyone know he couldn't do it.

mandarin_meaning: 知道；天亮（曉）
english_meaning: to know; (literary) to dawn, become daylight
explanation_mandarin: 「晓」在廣東話中可表示「知道、懂得」，在較書面或文言語境下亦可指天亮、拂曉。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "晓" (hiu2) commonly means "to know/understand"; in more literary contexts it can also mean "to dawn" or "daybreak."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔晓佢講緊咩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 hiu2 keoi5 gong2 gan2 me1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不曉得他在說什麼。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know what he is saying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝天光晓咗，街上好多人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 tin1 gwong1 hiu2 zo2, gaai1 soeng6 hou2 do1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今早天亮了，街上很多人。
examples.english_sentence: This morning it dawned; there are many people on the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你晓唔晓點做？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hiu2 m4 hiu2 dim2 zou6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你知道怎麼做嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Do you know how to do it?

mandarin_meaning: 晚；晚上；遲
english_meaning: late; evening
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞 / 形容詞 / 副詞
explanation_mandarin: 表示時間接近夜間（晚上）或時間上遲，既可作名詞指「晚上」，亦可作形容詞或副詞表示「晚、遲」。
explanation_english: Refers to the evening or being late. Can be used as a noun (the evening) or as an adjective/adverb to indicate lateness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚見，唔好太晚嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 gin3, m4 hou2 taai3 maan5 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚见，别太晚来。
examples.english_sentence: See you tonight; don't come too late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以晚啲再打俾我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 maan5 di1 zoi3 daa2 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以晚一点再打给我。
examples.english_sentence: You can call me later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嚟得太晚，門已經關咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lai4 dak1 taai3 maan5, mun4 ji5 ging1 gwaan1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他来得太晚，门已经关了。
examples.english_sentence: He arrived too late; the door was already closed.

mandarin_meaning: 晚上（夜晚）
english_meaning: evening; night
explanation_mandarin: 指從傍晚到夜裏的一段時間，通常包含天黑之後的時段。
explanation_english: Refers to the period from evening into night, typically the time after dusk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚有空，晚上可以出嚟食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 jau5 hung1, maan5 soeng6 ho2 ji5 ceot1 lai4 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚有空，晚上可以出来吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: I'm free tonight; I can come out to eat in the evening.

mandarin_meaning: 晚报
english_meaning: evening newspaper; evening edition (or evening news)
explanation_mandarin: 指在傍晚或晚上出版或發行的報紙，也可泛指晚間發布的新聞或晚間版的報導。
explanation_english: Refers to a newspaper published in the evening (an evening edition); can also loosely mean evening news or reports released at night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今晚會唔會買晚報睇？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 maan5 wui5 m4 wui5 maai5 maan5 bou3 tai2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今晚会不会买晚报看？
examples.english_sentence: Will you buy the evening paper tonight to read?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚嘅晚報報道咗啲關於股市波動嘅消息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ge3 maan5 bou3 bou3 dou6 zo2 di1 gwaan1 jyu1 gu2 si5 bo1 dung6 ge3 siu1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚的晚报报道了关于股市波动的消息。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight's evening paper reported news about fluctuations in the stock market.

mandarin_meaning: 晚安
english_meaning: Good night
explanation_mandarin: 用於晚上道別或睡前向他人致意，表示祝對方有個好覺或道別的禮貌用語。
explanation_english: Used to say goodbye or to wish someone a good sleep in the evening; a polite nighttime greeting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我依家洗完澡，準備訓覺，晚安！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji1 gaa1 sai2 jyun4 zou2, zeon2 bei6 fan3 gaau3, maan5 on1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在洗完澡，準備睡覺，晚安！
examples.english_sentence: I've just finished showering and am about to sleep — good night!

mandarin_meaning: 晚宴 (wǎnyàn)，正式或隆重的夜間宴會或宴席
english_meaning: a formal evening banquet or dinner
explanation_mandarin: 指在晚上舉行的正式或隆重宴會，通常有主持、宴席或致辭等環節，場合較為正式。
explanation_english: A formal or grand evening banquet or dinner, usually held at night with hosts, seated meals, speeches, and a more formal atmosphere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司今晚會舉辦一個晚宴，記得帶名片。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1si1 gam1maan5 wui5 geoi2baan6 jat1go3 maan5jin6, gei3dak1 daai3 ming4pin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司今晚會舉辦晚宴，請記得帶名片。
examples.english_sentence: The company is hosting a banquet tonight; remember to bring your business cards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校舉行咗盛大嘅畢業晚宴，師生都好感動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6haau6 geoi2hang4 zo2 sing4daai6 ge3 bat1jip6 maan5jin6, si1saang1 dou1 hou2 gam2dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學校舉行了盛大的畢業晚宴，師生都很感動。
examples.english_sentence: The school held a grand graduation banquet; teachers and students were very moved.

mandarin_meaning: 晚市（晚上營業的市集或餐廳的晚間營業時段，類似夜市或晚餐時段）
english_meaning: evening market; night market; dinner service (restaurant's evening service)
explanation_mandarin: 指晚上營業的市集（類似夜市）或餐廳的晚間營業時段（晚餐時段）。在香港語境中常用來區分午市與晚市。
explanation_english: Refers to markets open in the evening (night markets) or a restaurant's dinner service (the evening dining period). In Hong Kong usage it commonly contrasts with the lunch service (午市).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚去晚市食嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 heoi3 maan5 si5 sik6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚去晚市吃東西。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to the night market to eat tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅午市同晚市都好忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 ng5 si5 tung4 maan5 si5 dou1 hou2 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间餐厅的午市和晚市都很忙。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is busy during both the lunch and dinner services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 晚市嘅價錢通常會貴啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maan5 si5 ge3 gaa3 cin2 tung1 soeng4 wui5 gwai3 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚市的價格通常會貴一些。
examples.english_sentence: Prices at the night market are usually a bit higher.

mandarin_meaning: 晚年（指人生的晚年階段，老年時期）
english_meaning: later years; one's old age; the twilight years
explanation_mandarin: 指人生的晚年階段，通常指人年老的時期，也可用來形容事物的晚期階段（如事業或生命的最後階段）。
explanation_english: Refers to the later period of a person's life, typically old age; can also describe the final stage of something (e.g., a career or an era).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢希望喺晚年有個安定嘅生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hei1mong6 hai2 maan5 nin4 jau5 go3 on1ding6 ge3 saang1wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他希望在晚年有一個安定的生活。
examples.english_sentence: He hopes to have a stable life in his later years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老人家喺晚年要注意健康同社交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5jan4 gaa1 hai2 maan5 nin4 jiu3 zyu3ji3 gin6hong1 tung4 se5gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老人家在晚年要注意健康和社交。
examples.english_sentence: Elderly people should pay attention to health and social interaction in their later years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺晚年專心寫回憶錄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 maan5 nin4 zyun1sam1 se2 wui4jik1luk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在晚年專心寫回憶錄。
examples.english_sentence: He devoted himself to writing his memoirs in his later years.

mandarin_meaning: 每晚 / 每個晚上
english_meaning: every night; night after night
explanation_mandarin: 「晚晚」是廣東話口語，意思是每晚、每個晚上，表示習慣性或持續地在每晚發生的事。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term meaning 'every night' or 'night after night', indicating a habitual action that occurs each night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢晚晚都熬夜做功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maan5 maan5 dou1 ngou4 je6 zou6 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每晚都熬夜做作業。
examples.english_sentence: He stays up late doing homework every night.

mandarin_meaning: 晚会
english_meaning: evening party; gala; soirée; evening event
explanation_mandarin: 指在晚上舉行的聚會或節目活動，例如慶祝活動、聯歡會或晚宴等。
explanation_english: An event or gathering held in the evening, such as a party, gala, concert, or banquet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚公司有晚會，我要早啲返工準備。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 gung1 si1 jau5 maan5 wui6, ngo5 jiu3 zou2 di1 faan1 gung1 zeon2 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚公司有晚會，我得早點回公司準備。
examples.english_sentence: There's a company evening party tonight; I need to return to work early to prepare.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校下星期會舉行一個晚會，大家可以表演。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 haa6 sing1 kei4 wui5 geoi2 hang4 jat1 go3 maan5 wui6, daai6 gaa1 ho2 ji5 biu2 jin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學校下星期會舉行一個晚會，大家可以表演。
examples.english_sentence: The school will hold an evening event next week; everyone can perform.

mandarin_meaning: 晚期（处于某个过程或时期的后段，常指发展到最后或接近结束的阶段）
english_meaning: late stage; the final or advanced stage of a process (often used medically, e.g. late-stage cancer)
explanation_mandarin: 表示处于某个过程或时期的后段，强调进入末期或末段的状态；常用于医学（如“晚期癌症”）或描述事物进入最终阶段。
explanation_english: Indicates being in the later or final stage of a process or period; often used in medical contexts (e.g., 'late-stage cancer') or to describe something that has reached its final phase.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢被診斷出晚期肺癌，已經唔適合做手術。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei6 zan2 dyun6 ceot1 maan5 kei4 fai3 ngaam4, ji5 ging1 m4 sik1 hap6 zou6 sau2 seot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被診斷出晚期肺癌，已經不適合做手術。
examples.english_sentence: He was diagnosed with late-stage lung cancer and is no longer a candidate for surgery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套劇係佢演藝生涯嘅晚期作品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 kek6 hai6 keoi5 jin2 ngai6 saang1 ngaai4 ge3 maan5 kei4 zok3 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這套劇是他演藝生涯的晚期作品。
examples.english_sentence: This drama is one of the late-period works in his acting career.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個程式已經係晚期版本，開發團隊已停止支援。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 cing4 sik1 ji5 ging1 hai6 maan5 kei4 baan2 bun2, hoi1 faat3 tyun4 deoi2 ji5 ting4 zi2 zi1 wun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個程式已經是晚期版本，開發團隊已停止支援。
examples.english_sentence: This program is a late-stage version and the development team has stopped support.

mandarin_meaning: 晚禮服
english_meaning: evening dress / evening gown / formal evening wear
explanation_mandarin: 指在正式晚間場合穿著的正裝，女性通常為長禮服或晚禮裙，男性則為晚宴西裝或燕尾服，適合宴會、舞會、頒獎典禮等場合。
explanation_english: A formal outfit worn for evening events; for women typically a gown or formal dress and for men a formal dinner suit or tuxedo. Worn to galas, dinners, balls, award ceremonies, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今晚要著晚禮服去出席慈善晚宴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 maan5 jiu3 zoek3 maan5 lai5 fuk6 heoi3 ceot1 zik6 ci4 sin6 maan5 jin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今晚要穿晚禮服出席慈善晚宴。
examples.english_sentence: She will wear an evening gown to attend the charity dinner tonight.

mandarin_meaning: （罕用）字面：晚熟的禾苗；引申：比喻晚熟、行事或成就較遲的人
english_meaning: (rare) Literal: late-maturing grain; Figurative: a late bloomer — someone who develops, ripens, or succeeds later than others
explanation_mandarin: 「晚禾」並非常用詞，多見於方言或口語創作。字面上指生長晚、成熟較遲的禾苗；引申可用來形容人成長或成功較晚，類似「晚熟」的意思。
explanation_english: Not a common standard term; appears in dialectal or colloquial use. Literally refers to grain that matures late; figuratively used to describe a person who matures or achieves success later than others (i.e., a late bloomer).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好嘲佢，佢只係個晚禾，遲啲先成熟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 cau2 keoi5, keoi5 zi2 hai6 go3 maan5 wo4, ci4 di1 sin1 sing4 suk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要嘲笑他，他只是個晚熟的人，遲一些才成熟。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mock him; he's just a late bloomer — he'll mature later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺農村，晚禾指晚熟嘅稻子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 nung4 cyun1, maan5 wo4 zi2 maan5 suk6 ge3 dou6 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在農村，『晚禾』指晚熟的稻子。
examples.english_sentence: In rural areas, '晚禾' refers to late-maturing rice.

mandarin_meaning: 深秋，秋季的晚期
english_meaning: late autumn; late fall
explanation_mandarin: 指秋季後期，天氣轉涼、樹葉開始變色的時節。可用於描述季節或景象。
explanation_english: Refers to the late part of autumn when the weather cools and leaves begin to change color. Used to describe the season or scenery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 晚秋嘅天氣開始轉涼，樹葉慢慢變黃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maan5 cau1 ge3 tin1 hei3 hoi1 ci2 zyun2 loeng4, syu6 jip6 maan6 maan6 bin3 wong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚秋的天气开始转凉，树叶慢慢变黄。
examples.english_sentence: In late autumn the weather begins to cool and the leaves slowly turn yellow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋約咗喺晚秋去郊外睇紅葉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 joek3 zo2 hai2 maan5 cau1 heoi3 gaau1 ngoi6 tai2 hung4 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们约在晚秋去郊外看红叶。
examples.english_sentence: We planned to go to the countryside in late autumn to see the red leaves.

mandarin_meaning: 晚節不保（指晚年或晚期名譽、品行受損、維持不住當初節操）
english_meaning: Failing to maintain one's moral integrity or reputation in later life; one's later conduct tarnishes earlier honor.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語（用於描述品行或名譽）
partOfSpeech_english: idiom (descriptive; used to describe conduct or reputation)
explanation_mandarin: 形容一個人在晚年或事業後期，行為或名譽出現問題，無法保住原本的節操或聲望。
explanation_english: Describes someone who, in their later years or late career, behaves in a way that damages their reputation or fails to uphold previously held moral standards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以前係好有聲望嘅學者，點知晚節不保，捲入賄賂醜聞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5cin4 hai6 hou2 jau5 sing1mong6 ge3 hok6ze2, dim2 zi1 maan5-zit3-bat1-bou2, gyun2-jap6 wai6-lou6 cau2-man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以前是很有聲望的學者，沒想到晚節不保，捲入賄賂醜聞。
examples.english_sentence: He used to be a highly respected scholar; unexpectedly he didn't preserve his reputation in later years and was implicated in a bribery scandal.

mandarin_meaning: 晚装 / 晚礼服
english_meaning: evening dress; evening wear; formal evening gown
explanation_mandarin: 指在晚间正式場合穿着的服装，通常為晚礼服或晚裝裙，风格較為隆重、正式。
explanation_english: Refers to clothing worn for formal evening occasions, typically evening gowns or formal evening wear; usually dressy and formal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚要出席晚宴，我要著晚裝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 jiu3 ceot1 zik6 maan5 jin6, ngo5 jiu3 zoek3 maan5 zong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚要出席晚宴，我要穿晚装。
examples.english_sentence: I have to attend an evening banquet tonight; I'm going to wear an evening dress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 婚禮嘅著裝要求係正式晚裝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan1 lai5 ge3 zoek3 zong1 jiu1 kau4 hai6 zing3 sik1 maan5 zong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 婚礼的着装要求是正式的晚装。
examples.english_sentence: The dress code for the wedding is formal evening wear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺商場買咗件晚裝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 soeng1 coeng4 maai5 zo2 gin6 maan5 zong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她在商场买了一件晚装。
examples.english_sentence: She bought an evening dress at the mall.

mandarin_meaning: 晚辈 (wǎnbèi)：年纪或辈分较低的人
english_meaning: junior; a person of a younger generation or lower seniority
explanation_mandarin: 指年龄或辈份较低的人，常用於家庭、组织或社交场合，表示地位或年纪在后的一方。
explanation_english: Refers to someone of a younger generation or lower rank/seniority, used in family, organizational, or social contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司入面係我嘅晚輩，我要教佢啲工作流程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1si1 jap6 min6 hai6 ngo5 ge3 maan5 bui3, ngo5 jiu3 gaau3 keoi5 di1 gung1 zok3 lau4 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司裡是我的晚辈，我要教他工作流程。
examples.english_sentence: He is my junior at the company; I need to teach him the work procedures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你對晚輩要有耐性，慢慢教佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 deoi3 maan5 bui3 jiu3 jau5 noi6 sing3, maan6 maan6 gaau3 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你對晚輩要有耐心，慢慢教他們。
examples.english_sentence: You should be patient with juniors and teach them gradually.

mandarin_meaning: 晚间；夜间；晚上（较书面）
english_meaning: evening; nighttime (formal/literary)
explanation_mandarin: 指傍晚到夜晚的時段，與「晚上」「夜間」意思相近，語體較書面或正式。
explanation_english: Refers to the period from evening into the night; similar in meaning to 'evening' or 'nighttime', used in a more formal or literary register.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 晚間嘅燈光好柔和，適合讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maan5 gaan1 ge3 dang1 gwong1 hou2 jau4 wo4, sik1 hap6 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚间的灯光很柔和，适合读书。
examples.english_sentence: The lighting in the evening is soft, suitable for studying.

mandarin_meaning: 晚季节出现的霜；比喻年老时的白发或晚年遭遇的不幸
english_meaning: late frost (literal); figuratively, white hair of old age or misfortune occurring in later life
explanation_mandarin: 1) 指季节较晚时出现的霜。2) 引申为形容鬢角或头发苍白如霜（即白发），有时也比喻晚年遭遇的苦难或不幸。
explanation_english: 1) A frost that occurs late in the season. 2) Figuratively, it describes white hair (as if frosted) in old age, and can also metaphorically refer to misfortunes occurring in later life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝有晚霜，農夫要小心啲，唔好畀凍害影響收成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 jau5 maan5 soeng1, nung4 fu1 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 bei2 dung3 hoi6 jing2 hoeng2 sau1 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上出现了晚霜，农民要多加小心，别让霜冻影响收成。
examples.english_sentence: There was a late frost this morning; farmers should be careful so the frost doesn't damage the harvest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鬢上已經有晚霜，睇得出經歷咗好多事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ban3 soeng5 ji5 ging1 jau5 maan5 soeng1, tai2 dak1 ceot1 ging1 lik6 zo2 hou2 do1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他鬓上已经有了晚霜，可以看出经历了很多事情。
examples.english_sentence: He already has grey at his temples; you can tell he's been through a lot.

mandarin_meaning: 晚霞（夕陽或日落時天空呈現的彩霞、餘暉）
english_meaning: evening glow; the colorful afterglow or rosy clouds at sunset
explanation_mandarin: 指夕陽或日落時分，天空被陽光映照而呈現的彩霞或餘暉，常用來形容晚間天空的美麗景色。
explanation_english: Refers to the colorful glow or rosy clouds in the sky during or just after sunset; commonly used to describe the beautiful evening sky.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚嘅晚霞好靚，我哋去海邊影相啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ge3 maan5 haa4 hou2 leng3, ngo5 dei6 heoi3 hoi2 bin1 jing2 soeng2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚的晚霞很漂亮，我們去海邊拍照吧。
examples.english_sentence: The evening glow tonight is beautiful; let's go to the beach to take photos.

mandarin_meaning: 晚點/等會兒/之後
english_meaning: later; a little later; afterwards
explanation_mandarin: 口語廣東話用語，表示不久之後或稍後發生，常用於香港日常對話中。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese expression meaning 'later' or 'a little while after'; commonly used in Hong Kong spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我晚頭再打俾你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maan5 tau4 zoi3 daa2 bei2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我等會再打給你。
examples.english_sentence: I'll call you later.

mandarin_meaning: 深夜；夜深時分（口語）
english_meaning: late at night; the dead of night (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「晚頭夜」是香港粵語的口語用語，用來表示夜深、很晚的時候，常用於描述活動延伸到深夜或勸人不要等到太晚才做某事。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase meaning 'late at night' or 'in the dead of night'. It is used to describe very late hours or to warn against waiting until it is too late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好等到晚頭夜先食晚飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 dang2 dou3 maan5 tau4 je6 sin1 sik6 maan5 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要等到深夜才吃晚飯。
examples.english_sentence: Don't wait until late at night to eat dinner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日都做到晚頭夜，唔好咁唔健康。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sing4 jat6 dou1 zou6 dou3 maan5 tau4 je6, m4 hou2 gam2 m4 gin6 hong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你經常工作到深夜，不要這麼不健康。
examples.english_sentence: You always work until late at night; don't be so unhealthy.

mandarin_meaning: 到时候会糟糕/吃亏；将来会有不好的后果
english_meaning: It'll turn out badly later; you'll get into trouble or suffer consequences later
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語說法，表示某件事現在看似可以，但遲早會出事或有不良後果，帶有警告或負面預測的語感。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang expression meaning that something will turn out badly later or lead to trouble; often used as a warning or negative prediction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣亂借人錢，晚頭黑㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng6 lyun6 ze3 jan4 cin2, maan5 tau4 hak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样随便借钱给别人，到时候会吃亏的。
examples.english_sentence: If you lend money to people like that, it'll end badly for you later.

mandarin_meaning: 晚饭 (wǎnfàn)
english_meaning: dinner; evening meal
explanation_mandarin: 指傍晚或晚上吃的正餐，與“晚餐”意思相同，常用於口語中。
explanation_english: Refers to the main meal eaten in the evening; synonymous with 'dinner'. Commonly used in spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今晚有冇食晚飯？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 maan5 jau5 mou5 sik6 maan5 faan6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今晚有没有吃晚饭？
examples.english_sentence: Have you eaten dinner tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一齊去食晚飯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 heoi3 sik6 maan5 faan6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一起去吃晚饭吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go have dinner together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚嘅晚飯好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ge3 maan5 faan6 hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚的晚饭很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight's dinner is delicious.

mandarin_meaning: 晚餐 / 晚飯
english_meaning: dinner; supper
explanation_mandarin: 表示一天中晚上吃的正餐，等同於「晚飯」，可用於口語或書面語。
explanation_english: Refers to the main meal eaten in the evening; equivalent to 'dinner' or 'supper'. Used in both everyday and formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋一齊食晚餐，去邊間餐廳好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 sik6 maan5 caan1, heoi3 bin1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们一起吃晚餐，去哪间餐厅好？
examples.english_sentence: Shall we have dinner together tonight? Which restaurant should we go to?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你通常幾點食晚餐？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tung1 soeng4 gei2 dim2 sik6 maan5 caan1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你通常几点吃晚餐？
examples.english_sentence: What time do you usually have dinner?

mandarin_meaning: 晚上；天黑的時候
english_meaning: night; in the evening; when it gets dark
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞 / 時間副詞短語
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，表示天黑、晚上或在天黑時的時段或時間點。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning nighttime or the time when it gets dark; used as a time word or adverbial phrase.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋等到晚黑先出發啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dang2 dou3 maan5 hak1 sin1 ceot1 faat3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們等到天黑才出發。
examples.english_sentence: We'll wait until it's dark before setting off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意喺晚黑行山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 hai2 maan5 hak1 haang4 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜歡在晚上爬山。
examples.english_sentence: He likes hiking at night.

mandarin_meaning: 白天；日間（昼）
english_meaning: day; daytime
explanation_mandarin: 「晝」指太陽出來的時間，即白天、日間。常用於口語或與夜相對的語境中。
explanation_english: “晝” means daytime or the period when the sun is up (day). It is used to contrast with night and frequently appears in colloquial expressions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 晝日你有冇時間？
examples.jyutping_sentence: zau3 jat6 nei5 jau5 mou5 si4 gaan3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 白天你有沒有時間？
examples.english_sentence: Do you have time during the day?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我成日晝夜都工作，冇乜休息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sing4 jat6 zau3 je6 dou1 gung1 zok3, mou5 mat1 jau1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我經常白天黑夜都工作，沒有什麼休息。
examples.english_sentence: I often work day and night and don't get much rest.

mandarin_meaning: 昼夜（白天和黑夜；持续不断）
english_meaning: day and night; around the clock; continuously
explanation_mandarin: 表示白天和黑夜，常用來形容時間的持續或某事不停地發生（如晝夜工作）。
explanation_english: Refers to day and night; often used to describe continuous time or that something happens without stopping (e.g., working day and night).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫護人員晝夜都喺醫院照顧病人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 wu6 jan4 jyun4 zau3 je6 dou1 hai2 ji1 jyun2 ziu3 gu3 beng6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医护人员昼夜都在医院照顾病人。
examples.english_sentence: Medical staff care for patients in the hospital day and night.

mandarin_meaning: 清晰 (qīngxī)
english_meaning: clear; distinct; lucid
explanation_mandarin: 表示清楚、明晰，指事物或影像等能被清楚辨認。此字較少見，現代漢語常用「清晰」或「明晰」。
explanation_english: Denotes clarity or distinctness, e.g. of an image or expression. The character is relatively rare/archaic; modern Chinese typically uses '清晰'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張相片唔夠晢，睇唔清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 soeng2 pin3 m4 gau3 sik1, tai2 m4 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這張照片不夠清晰，看不清楚。
examples.english_sentence: This photo isn't clear enough; you can't see it clearly.

mandarin_meaning: 不（表示否定，為粵語「唔」的書面寫法）；（古漢語）晤 = 見面、會見
english_meaning: not (Cantonese negative particle equivalent to '唔'); (classical) to meet
explanation_mandarin: 在粵語書寫中，『晤』常作口語否定詞『唔』的書面寫法，用來表示否定（相當於普通話的「不/不是」）。另在古漢語或現代漢語字義中，『晤』也有「晤面／會見」之意。
explanation_english: In Cantonese writing, '晤' (jyutping m4) is often used as the written form of the colloquial negation '唔', meaning 'not' or 'don't' (equivalent to Mandarin '不/不是'). In Classical Chinese, '晤' can also mean 'to meet'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我晤知佢去唔去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zi1 keoi5 heoi3 m4 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不知道他去不去。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know whether he will go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢晤係我嘅朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 hai6 ngo5 ge3 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不是我的朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He is not my friend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我晤想去派對，今晚想瞓覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 heoi3 paai3 deoi6, gam1 maan5 soeng2 fan3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想去派对，今晚想睡觉。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to go to the party; I want to sleep tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 昏暗、陰鬱；晦澀（難懂）；（合成詞）如「晦氣」指不順利、不吉利
english_meaning: gloomy/dark; obscure or abstruse (hard to understand); in compounds (e.g., '晦氣') meaning unlucky or ill‑fortune
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞 / 名詞（視語境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 「晦」常用來形容天色或氛圍昏暗、陰沉，也可指文字或語句晦澀難懂；與其他字合用時（如「晦氣」）可表示不順、不吉利。
explanation_english: Used to describe gloominess or darkness (e.g., weather or atmosphere); can describe writing or speech that is obscure or hard to understand; in compounds like '晦氣' it conveys bad luck or misfortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日天色陰晦，好似快落雨喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 tin1 sik1 jam1 wui6, hou2 ci5 faai3 lok6 jyu5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天天色陰晦，好像快要下雨了。
examples.english_sentence: The sky is gloomy today; it looks like it's going to rain soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇文章寫得好晦澀，讀起身好難明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 man4 zoeng1 se2 dak1 hou2 wui6 sik1, duk6 hei2 san1 hou2 naan4 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這篇文章寫得很晦澀，讀起來很難懂。
examples.english_sentence: This article is written very obscurely; it's hard to understand when reading.

mandarin_meaning: 不吉利；倒霉
english_meaning: unlucky; ill-fated; jinxed
explanation_mandarin: 表示運氣不好、遇到不順利或連串不幸的情況，常用於口語表示倒霉。
explanation_english: Describes having bad luck or being jinxed; commonly used colloquially to say someone is having a run of bad luck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日真係好晦氣，做嘢成日出錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 zan1 hai6 hou2 fui3 hei3, zou6 je5 sing4 jat6 ceot1 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天真倒霉，做事一直出錯。
examples.english_sentence: I'm really unlucky today; I'm making mistakes all the time.

mandarin_meaning: 倒霉鬼；帶來晦氣、運氣差的人
english_meaning: an unlucky person; a jinx; someone believed to bring bad luck
explanation_mandarin: 口語用語，指經常倒霉或被認為會帶來晦氣、不幸的人，有時帶有戲謔或迷信色彩。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term for someone who is often unlucky or thought to bring bad luck. Often used jokingly or superstitiously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日倒楣，大家都話佢係個晦氣星。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 dou2 mui4, daai6 gaa1 dou1 waa6 keoi5 hai6 go3 fui3 hei3 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是倒霉，大家都說他是個晦氣星（帶來晦氣的人）。
examples.english_sentence: He's always unlucky; everyone says he's a jinx.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好帶佢去賭場，佢係個晦氣星，成日輸錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 daai3 keoi5 heoi3 dou2 coeng4, keoi5 hai6 go3 fui3 hei3 sing1, seng4 jat6 syu1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要帶他去賭場，他是個晦氣星，總是輸錢。
examples.english_sentence: Don't bring him to the casino—he's a jinx; he always loses money.

mandarin_meaning: 晨（chén）：早晨、清晨、黎明
english_meaning: morning; dawn; early morning
explanation_mandarin: 表示早晨或清晨的時間，常見於『早晨』『清晨』『晨光』等詞語中，用於描述一天開始時的時間或景象。
explanation_english: Refers to the morning or early dawn. Commonly appears in compounds like 'zaau2 san4' (good morning), 'cing1 san4' (early morning), or 'san4 gwong1' (morning light), used to describe the start of the day or related scenes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 早晨！你食咗早餐未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou2 san4! nei5 sik6 zo2 zou2 caan1 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 早上好！你吃早餐了嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Good morning! Have you had breakfast?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意喺清晨跑步，感覺特別清新。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 hai2 cing1 san4 paau2 bou6, gam2 gok3 dak6 bit6 cing1 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜歡在清晨跑步，感覺特別清新。
examples.english_sentence: I like to run in the early morning; it feels especially refreshing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 晨光照進嚟，房間感覺好溫暖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san4 gwong1 ziu3 zeon3 lai4, fong4 gaan1 gam2 gok3 hou2 wan1 nyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晨光照進來，房間感覺很溫暖。
examples.english_sentence: Morning light shines in, and the room feels very warm.

mandarin_meaning: 晨光；早晨的光线，曙光
english_meaning: morning light; dawn; first light
explanation_mandarin: 指清晨出現的光線或曙光，常用來描繪早晨的景象或象徵新的開始。
explanation_english: Refers to the light of early morning or dawn; often used to describe morning scenery or to symbolize a new beginning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺晨光下散步，覺得好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 san4 gwong1 haa6 saan3 bou6, gok3 dak1 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在晨光下散步，覺得很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: Walking in the morning light feels very comfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 晨光喺山頭升起，景色好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san4 gwong1 hai2 saan1 tau4 sing1 hei2, ging2 sik1 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晨光在山头升起，景色很美。
examples.english_sentence: The morning light rises over the hill; the scenery is beautiful.

mandarin_meaning: 这么早 / 一大早
english_meaning: so early (in the morning) / this early
explanation_mandarin: 口語用語，表示在時間上比預期或正常時間更早，常用來表示驚訝或不滿。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase meaning 'so early' or 'this early (in the morning)', often used to express surprise or mild annoyance at the early time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你晨咁早就起身做乜嘢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 san4 gam2 zou2 zau6 hei2 san1 zou6 mat1 je5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么早就起床做什么？
examples.english_sentence: What are you doing getting up so early?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 晨咁早就有人打電話嚟，發生咩事？
examples.jyutping_sentence: san4 gam2 zou2 zau6 jau5 jan4 daa2 din6 waa2 lei4, faat3 sang1 me1 si6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这么早就有人打电话来，发生了什么事？
examples.english_sentence: Someone's calling this early — what happened?

mandarin_meaning: 晨操（早晨集體做的體育鍛鍊）
english_meaning: morning exercises; morning calisthenics
explanation_mandarin: 指學校、部隊或單位在早晨集體進行的體育鍛鍊，通常包括做操、跑步等活動。
explanation_english: Refers to collective physical exercises performed in the morning at schools, workplaces, or military units, typically including calisthenics, running, and similar activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋每日七點喺學校操場集合做晨操。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 mui5 jat6 cat1 dim2 hai2 hok6 haau6 cou1 coeng4 zaap6 hap6 zou6 san4 cou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们每天七点在学校操场集合做晨操。
examples.english_sentence: We gather at the school playground at 7 every day to do morning exercises.

mandarin_meaning: 清晨；一大早
english_meaning: early morning; bright and early
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 副詞（時間副詞，也可作口語問候）
explanation_mandarin: 「晨早」表示在清晨或很早的時候，常用作時間副詞描述起床或出門的時間，亦可在口語中作為問候語使用（類似「早晨」）。
explanation_english: “晨早” denotes the early morning (very early in the day). It is commonly used as a time adverb to describe getting up or leaving early, and can also function as a colloquial greeting similar to “good morning.”

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我晨早六點就起身跑步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 san4 zou2 luk6 dim2 zau6 hei2 san1 paau2 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一大早六點就起床去跑步。
examples.english_sentence: I get up at six early in the morning to go for a run.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢晨早成日要趕地鐵，幾辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 san4 zou2 sing4 jat6 jiu3 gon2 dei6 tit3, gei2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天一大早都要趕地鐵，挺辛苦的。
examples.english_sentence: He has to rush to catch the subway early every morning; it's quite tiring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 晨早好！我哋去飲杯咖啡啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san4 zou2 hou2! ngo5 dei6 heoi3 jam2 bui1 gaa3 fe1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 早安！我們去喝杯咖啡吧。
examples.english_sentence: Good morning! Let's go have a cup of coffee.

mandarin_meaning: 清晨出去闲逛／清晨溜达
english_meaning: to go out for a casual stroll or wander early in the morning
explanation_mandarin: 口語用語，表示在清晨隨意外出閒逛、溜達，通常沒有固定目的或行程。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase meaning to casually go out and wander or stroll in the early morning, usually without a specific purpose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意晨早流流，去公園行下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 san4 zou2 lau4 lau4, heoi3 gung1 jyun4 hang4 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢一大早出去闲逛，去公园走走。
examples.english_sentence: I like to go out for a stroll early in the morning and walk in the park.

mandarin_meaning: 晨曦；清晨的阳光，黎明时的微光
english_meaning: morning light; dawn; the first rays of the morning
explanation_mandarin: 指清晨或黎明時分出現的光線，常用於描寫清晨的微光或象徵新的開始。
explanation_english: Refers to the light at dawn—the pale rays that appear in the early morning; often used poetically to describe the break of day or a symbolic beginning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺晨曦時分出門散步，空氣好清新。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 san4 hei1 si4 fan6 ceot1 mun4 saan3 bou6, hung1 hei3 hou2 cing1 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在晨曦时分出门散步，空气很清新。
examples.english_sentence: I went out for a walk at dawn; the air was very fresh.

mandarin_meaning: 晨褸／早晨穿的薄外套（粤语用词）
english_meaning: a light jacket or windbreaker (typically worn in the morning)
explanation_mandarin: 指早上穿的薄外套或風褸，為香港粵語常用說法，通常比厚大衣輕便，適合微涼天氣。
explanation_english: Refers to a light jacket or windbreaker worn in the morning. A common Cantonese term in Hong Kong for a lightweight outer layer suited to cool mornings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝好凍，記得著返你件晨褸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 hou2 dung3, gei3 dak1 zoek3 faan1 nei5 gin6 san4 lau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上很冷，記得穿上你的晨褸（薄外套）。
examples.english_sentence: It's chilly this morning; remember to put on your light jacket.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢朝早成日著件舊晨褸返工，睇落好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ziu1 zou2 sing4 jat6 zoek3 gin6 gau6 san4 lau1 faan1 gung1, tai2 lok6 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天早上都穿著那件舊晨褸去上班，看起來很舒適。
examples.english_sentence: He wears that old light jacket to work every morning; it looks very cozy.

mandarin_meaning: 晨运（早晨做的體育鍛鍊或體操）
english_meaning: morning exercise
explanation_mandarin: 指早上進行的體操或運動，通常用來喚醒身體、促進血液循環和保持健康。
explanation_english: Refers to physical exercises or calisthenics done in the morning, usually to wake the body up, improve circulation, and promote health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我每日朝早都去公園做晨運。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mui5 jat6 ziu1 zou2 dou1 heoi3 gung1 jyun2 zou6 san4 wan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每天早上都去公園做晨運。
examples.english_sentence: I go to the park every morning to do morning exercise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做晨運可以幫助改善血液循環，精神都會好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 san4 wan6 ho2 ji5 bong1 zo6 goi2 sin3 hyut3 jik6 seon4 waan4, zing1 san4 dou1 wui5 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做晨運可以幫助改善血液循環，精神也會更好。
examples.english_sentence: Doing morning exercise can help improve blood circulation and make you feel more energetic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司有個晨運小組，每星期一、三、五朝早集合。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jau5 go3 san4 wan6 siu2 zou2, mui5 sing1 kei4 jat1, saam1, ng5 ziu1 zou2 zaap6 hap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司有個晨運小組，每星期一、三、五早上集合。
examples.english_sentence: The company has a morning exercise group that meets Monday, Wednesday and Friday mornings.

mandarin_meaning: 晚（wǎn）：傍晚、晚上；晚、遲）
english_meaning: late; evening
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞 / 形容詞 / 副詞
explanation_mandarin: 表示傍晚或晚上這段時間，也可表示時間上遲（不早、延遲）。在口語中常用來說「很晚」「太晚」等。
explanation_english: Refers to the evening time or to being late (not early). Commonly used in speech to say 'very late' or 'too late'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晩會好晩先返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 wui5 hou2 maan5 sin1 faan1 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚會很晚才回家。
examples.english_sentence: I'll come home very late tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁晩嚟，等我開門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 maan5 lei4, dang2 ngo5 hoi1 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那麼晚來，等我開門。
examples.english_sentence: Don't come so late; wait for me to open the door.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晩我哋去嗰間新餐廳食晩飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 go2 gaan1 san1 caan1 teng1 sik6 maan5faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我們去那間新餐廳吃晚飯。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight we're going to that new restaurant for dinner.

mandarin_meaning: 普（表示普遍、一般、广泛，用作词素或形容词）
english_meaning: universal; general; widespread (used as a morpheme or adjective)
explanation_mandarin: 「普」常用來表示普遍、一般、廣泛的意思，常出現在合成詞中，如普通、普遍、普及、普選等。
explanation_english: “普” conveys generality or universality and commonly appears as a morpheme in compounds (e.g., 普通 'general', 普及 'widespread', 普選 'universal suffrage').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港人一直爭取普選。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jan4 jat1 zik6 zang1 ceoi2 pou2 syun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港人一直在争取普选。
examples.english_sentence: People in Hong Kong have been striving for universal suffrage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種疫苗已經喺社區普及。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 jik6 miu4 ji5 ging1 hai2 se5 keoi1 pou2 kap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种疫苗已经在社区普及。
examples.english_sentence: This vaccine has already become widespread in the community.

mandarin_meaning: 普遍的、全世界通用或被接受的
english_meaning: universal; widely accepted or applicable across the world or many groups
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事物在多數文化或地區中普遍存在或被接受，常用作定語（如「普世價值」）。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is universal or widely accepted/applicable across different cultures or regions; often used attributively (e.g. “universal values”).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 普世價值喺唔同文化入面都會有共鳴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: pou2 sai3 gaa3 zik6 hai2 m4 tung4 man4 faa3 jap6 min6 dou1 wui5 jau5 gung6 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 普世價值在不同文化裡面都會有共鳴。
examples.english_sentence: Universal values resonate across different cultures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套規則唔係普世適用，應該按地區調整。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 gwai1 zak1 m4 hai6 pou2 sai3 sik1 jung6, jing1 goi1 on3 dei6 keoi1 diu6 zing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這套規則並非普世適用，應該根據地區調整。
examples.english_sentence: These rules are not universally applicable; they should be adjusted by region.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 普世呢個概念有時會畀人過度泛化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: pou2 sai3 ni1 go3 goi3 nim6 jau5 si4 wui5 bei2 jan4 gwo3 dou6 faan6 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 「普世」這個概念有時會被過度泛化。
examples.english_sentence: The concept of 'universal' is sometimes overgeneralized.

mandarin_meaning: 普世主义（pǔshì zhǔyì）— 指相信某些原则或价值对所有人普遍适用；在宗教语境中可指普遍救赎论。
english_meaning: Universalism — the belief that certain principles or values apply universally; in religion, the doctrine that all souls will ultimately be saved.
explanation_mandarin: 指一種主張普遍適用的價值或原則的思想，在神學上有時指相信所有人最終會得救的觀點。
explanation_english: Refers to an ideology that asserts universal applicability of certain values or principles; in theology it can mean the belief that everyone will eventually be saved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢信普世主義，覺得人人應該享有平等同自由。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seon3 pou2 sai3 zyu2 ji6, gok3 dak1 jan4 jan4 jing1 goi1 hoeng2 jau5 ping4 dang2 tung4 zi6 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他信奉普世主义，认为人人应该享有平等和自由。
examples.english_sentence: He believes in universalism, thinking that everyone should enjoy equality and freedom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺神學入面，普世主義通常指相信最終所有人都會得救。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 san4 hok6 jap6 min6, pou2 sai3 zyu2 ji6 tung1 soeng4 zi2 seon3 zeoi3 zung1 so2 jau5 jan4 dou1 wui5 dak1 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在神学里，普世主义通常指相信最终所有人都会得救。
examples.english_sentence: In theology, universalism usually refers to the belief that ultimately all people will be saved.

mandarin_meaning: 普世价值
english_meaning: universal values
explanation_mandarin: 指被普遍接受、跨文化的基本價值，例如人權、民主、法治等，常在政治與倫理討論中出現的概念。
explanation_english: Refers to values considered universal and widely accepted across cultures—such as human rights, democracy, and the rule of law—often invoked in political and ethical discussions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 討論會上大家都提到普世價值，例如人權同民主。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou2 leon6 wui2 soeng6 daai6 gaa1 dou1 tai4 dou3 pou2 sai3 gaa3 zik6, lai6 jyu4 jan4 kyun4 tung4 man4 zyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在討論會上大家都提到普世價值，例如人權和民主。
examples.english_sentence: At the discussion meeting everyone mentioned universal values, such as human rights and democracy.

mandarin_meaning: 普及（推广、使广泛存在或为大众所用/所知）
english_meaning: to popularize; to spread; to become widespread; to make something common or accessible to the general public
explanation_mandarin: 表示使某種事物、知識或技術在社會上廣泛普遍或推廣開來，也可表示某事物變得普遍。
explanation_english: Indicates making something widely available or known (e.g., knowledge, technology), or that something has become widespread.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 智能手機已經好普及，幾乎人人都有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 nang4 sau2 gei1 ji5 ging1 hou2 pou2 kap6, gei2 fu1 jan4 jan4 dou1 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 智能手机已经很普及，几乎人人都有。
examples.english_sentence: Smartphones are already widespread; almost everyone has one.

mandarin_meaning: 普天同庆（普遍歡慶、舉國同慶）
english_meaning: universal celebration; the whole country/world celebrating together
explanation_mandarin: 表示普遍慶祝、天下同享歡慶的景象，常用於重大節日或喜慶時刻。
explanation_english: Denotes a widespread celebration where everyone (or the whole country/world) celebrates together; often used for major festivals or joyous occasions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農曆新年，普天同慶，街道上處處都充滿歡樂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 lik6 san1 nin4, pou2 tin1 tung4 hing3, gaai1 dou6 soeng6 cyu3 cyu3 dou1 cung1 mun5 fun1 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 農曆新年，普天同慶，街道上處處充滿歡樂。
examples.english_sentence: During the Lunar New Year everyone celebrates; the streets are filled with joy everywhere.

mandarin_meaning: 普渡（超度亡靈、救渡眾生）
english_meaning: to perform rituals to deliver/save souls; to universally save or help sentient beings
explanation_mandarin: 多用於佛教或道教語境，指舉行儀式以超度亡靈、救渡眾生；引申為廣泛救助或普遍施恩。
explanation_english: Commonly used in Buddhist or Daoist contexts to refer to conducting rituals to deliver or save the deceased's souls; figuratively, it can mean to help or benefit people broadly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農曆七月，村裏會搞普度，大家會擺供品同燒紙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 lik6 cat1 jyut6, cyun1 leoi5 wui5 gaau2 pou2 dou6, daai6 gaa1 wui5 baai2 gung1 ban2 tung4 siu1 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 農曆七月，村裡會舉行普渡，大家會擺供品和燒紙。
examples.english_sentence: In the seventh lunar month the village holds a pou dou ceremony; everyone sets out offerings and burns paper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 寺廟每年都會舉行普度，念經超度亡靈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 miu6 mui5 nin4 dou1 wui5 geoi2 hang4 pou2 dou6, nim6 ging1 ciu1 dou6 mong4 ling4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 寺廟每年都會舉行普渡，誦經超度亡靈。
examples.english_sentence: The temple holds a pou dou ceremony every year, chanting sutras to deliver the departed spirits.

mandarin_meaning: 到處說教／到處教訓（俚語）
english_meaning: preaching/lecturing everywhere; being preachy (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「普教中」為香港粵語俚語，形容某人經常向他人說教或無端教訓，帶有諷刺或不耐煩的語氣。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term used to describe someone who constantly preaches or gives unsolicited lectures to others; often used sarcastically or with annoyance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺社交媒體度普教中，大家都唔鍾意聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 se5 gaau1 mui4 tai2 dou6 pou2 gaau3 zung1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 zung1 ji3 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他成天在社交媒體上到處說教，大家都不喜歡聽。
examples.english_sentence: He is always preaching on social media; nobody likes to listen.

mandarin_meaning: 普查（对某一地区或全体人口、事物进行全面调查与统计）
english_meaning: census; general survey (a comprehensive survey or census of a population or items)
explanation_mandarin: 指對某一地區或整體對象進行全面性的調查和統計，常用於人口、經濟或資產等方面的普遍性清查。
explanation_english: Refers to a comprehensive survey or census carried out across a region or for an entire population or set of items; commonly used for population, economic data, or inventories.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府會喺下個月進行人口普查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 wui5 hai6 haa6 go3 jyut6 zeon3 hang4 jan4 hau2 pou2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府會在下個月進行人口普查。
examples.english_sentence: The government will carry out a population census next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要做一次庫存普查，確保數量正確。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu3 zou6 jat1 ci3 fu3 cyun4 pou2 caa4, kok3 bou2 sou3 loeng6 zing3 kok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要做一次庫存普查，確保數量正確。
examples.english_sentence: The company needs to do an inventory survey to ensure counts are accurate.

mandarin_meaning: 普洱（茶），指雲南普洱地區出產的一種發酵茶
english_meaning: Pu'er (tea) — a type of fermented tea from Pu'er, Yunnan
explanation_mandarin: 指雲南普洱產的發酵茶，通常稱為普洱茶，分生茶（生普）與熟茶（熟普），且常以陳年越久越醇厚為特色。
explanation_english: Refers to a type of fermented tea from Pu'er in Yunnan, commonly called Pu'er tea. It is typically categorized as raw (sheng) or ripe (shou) and is prized for how aging can deepen its flavor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意飲普洱茶，尤其係陳年普洱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 jam2 pou2 ji5 caa4, jau4 kei4 hai6 can4 nin4 pou2 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜歡喝普洱茶，尤其是陳年普洱。
examples.english_sentence: I like drinking Pu'er tea, especially aged Pu'er.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗一餅普洱，準備收藏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 jat1 beng2 pou2 ji5, zeon2 bei6 sou1 cong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他買了一餅普洱，準備收藏。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a cake of Pu'er tea to collect.

mandarin_meaning: 普渡（普遍救渡/盂蘭、普渡祭祀）
english_meaning: to universally save or deliver; (noun) the Pudu ritual/offering during the Ghost Festival
explanation_mandarin: 佛教術語，指普遍救渡眾生；在民間也指盂蘭、普渡等祭祀活動，為孤魂野鬼準備供品以超渡。
explanation_english: A Buddhist term meaning to universally save or deliver sentient beings. In folk practice it refers to Pudu rituals (often during the Ghost Festival) where offerings are made to appease or deliver hungry spirits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日係普渡，要準備祭品畀孤魂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 hai6 pou2 dou6, jiu3 zeon2 bei6 zai3 ban2 bei2 gu1 wan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天是普渡，要准备祭品给孤魂。
examples.english_sentence: Today is Pudu; we need to prepare offerings for the wandering spirits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佛教係講普渡眾生，重視修行同慈悲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fat6 gaau3 hai6 gong2 pou2 dou6 zung3 saang1, cung4 si6 sau1 hang4 tung4 ci4 bei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 佛教讲求普渡众生，重视修行和慈悲。
examples.english_sentence: Buddhism emphasizes saving all sentient beings and values cultivation and compassion.

mandarin_meaning: 普羅（大眾）；普通人
english_meaning: the masses; ordinary people; the general public
explanation_mandarin: 「普羅」是粵語口語，常作「普羅大眾」的簡稱，用以指代一般民眾或普通人，有時帶稍微口語化或輕蔑色彩。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese abbreviation of "普羅大眾" (the general public). Refers to ordinary people or the masses; can be neutral or slightly colloquial in tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家普羅都會用手機買嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 pou2 lo4 dou1 wui5 jung6 sau2 gei1 maai5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在普羅大眾都會用手機購物。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays the general public all use their phones to shop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔係記者，只係一個普羅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 hai6 gei3 ze2, zi2 hai6 jat1 go3 pou2 lo4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不是記者，只是一個普通人。
examples.english_sentence: He's not a reporter, just an ordinary person.

mandarin_meaning: 普罗大众 / 普通大众 / 广大民众
english_meaning: the general public; the masses
explanation_mandarin: 指一般普通的大多数人群，沒有特定身份或專業背景的群眾，常用於討論政策、服務或活動的受眾範圍。
explanation_english: Refers to ordinary people or the majority of the public without special status or professional background; commonly used when talking about the audience or beneficiaries of policies, services, or events.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府話會推出新措施去照顧普羅大眾嘅需要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 waa6 wui5 teoi1 ceot1 san1 cou3 si3 heoi3 ziu3 gu3 pou2 lo4 daai6 zung3 ge3 seoi1 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府說會推出新措施來照顧普羅大眾的需要。
