examples.english_sentence: The government said it will introduce new measures to address the needs of the general public.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲活動唔係淨係畀專家，而係畀普羅大眾參加嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 wut6 dung6 m4 hai6 zing6 hai6 bei2 zyun1 gaa1, ji4 hai6 bei2 pou2 lo4 daai6 zung3 caam1 gaa1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些活動不是只給專家，而是讓普羅大眾參加的。
examples.english_sentence: These events are not only for experts, but are open for the general public to participate.

mandarin_meaning: 普羅大眾（一般民眾、廣大群衆）
english_meaning: the general public; the masses; ordinary people
explanation_mandarin: 指一般的民眾或大多數人，通常用來描述面向或關係到普羅大眾利益、看法或感受的事物或政策。
explanation_english: Refers to the general public or the masses; commonly used to describe matters, policies, or opinions that affect ordinary people's interests or viewpoints.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃要顧及普羅大眾嘅利益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 jiu3 gu3 kap6 pou2 lo4 daai6 zung3 ge3 lei6 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個計劃要顧及普羅大眾的利益。
examples.english_sentence: This plan needs to take into account the interests of the general public.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 普羅大眾對呢件事嘅睇法好唔同。
examples.jyutping_sentence: pou2 lo4 daai6 zung3 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 tai2 faat3 hou2 m4 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 普羅大眾對這件事的看法很不同。
examples.english_sentence: The general public have very different views on this matter.

mandarin_meaning: 普通 (pǔtōng)
english_meaning: ordinary; common; general; average
explanation_mandarin: 表示平常、一般、沒有特別或突出的特性，用來形容事物或人的一般性質。
explanation_english: Indicates something ordinary, common, or not special; used to describe average or typical qualities of things or people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個好普通嘅人，冇乜特別。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 pou2tung1 ge3 jan4, mou5 mat1 dak6 bit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一个很普通的人，没有什么特别。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very ordinary person, nothing special.

mandarin_meaning: 普通法（基於判例和司法先例的法律體系）
english_meaning: common law (a legal system based on judicial decisions and precedents)
explanation_mandarin: 以判例與司法先例為主要法律來源的法律體系，與以成文法為主的民法體系相對。常見於英美及其司法傳統延伸的地區，如香港。
explanation_english: A legal system that relies primarily on judicial decisions and precedents rather than solely on statutes. It contrasts with codified civil law and is common in the UK, the US, and jurisdictions influenced by them (e.g., Hong Kong).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港係採用普通法嘅司法制度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 hai6 coi2 jung6 pou2 tung1 faat3 ge3 si1 faat3 zai3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港採用普通法的司法制度。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong uses a common law judicial system.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 普通法同大陸嘅成文法有啲唔同，主要係來源同解釋方法唔一樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: pou2 tung1 faat3 tung4 daai6 luk6 ge3 sing4 man4 faat3 jau5 di1 m4 tung4, zyu2 jiu3 hai6 loi4 jyun4 tung4 gaai2 sik1 fong1 faat3 m4 jat1 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 普通法和大陸的成文法有些不同，主要是來源和解釋方法不一樣。
examples.english_sentence: Common law is somewhat different from the mainland's codified law, mainly in its sources and methods of interpretation.

mandarin_meaning: 普通科 (一般科、普通門診或學校的普通組別)
english_meaning: general department/stream (e.g., general outpatient department or the general academic stream)
explanation_mandarin: 「普通科」可指醫院或診所的普通門診/內科部門，也可指學校或教育體系中的普通組別或一般科目，與專科或分科相對。
explanation_english: “普通科” refers to a general department or stream — for example, the general outpatient department (as opposed to a specialist department) or the general academic stream in school (as opposed to specialized streams).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係普通科嘅學生，主修通識同英文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 pou2 tung1 fo1 ge3 hok6 saang1, zyu2 sau1 tung1 sik1 tung4 jing1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她是普通科的學生，主修通識和英文。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is a student in the general stream, majoring in Liberal Studies and English.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我去普通科睇醫生，唔係專科。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 heoi3 pou2 tung1 fo1 tai2 ji1 sang1, m4 hai6 zyun1 fo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我去普通科看醫生，不是專科醫生。
examples.english_sentence: I went to the general (outpatient) department to see a doctor, not a specialist.

mandarin_meaning: 普通話（指以北京語音為基礎的標準漢語）
english_meaning: Putonghua / Standard Mandarin (the standard form of Mandarin Chinese)
explanation_mandarin: 指以北京語音為基礎並由國家推行的標準漢語，常作為教學與官方語言使用。
explanation_english: The standardized form of Mandarin Chinese (Putonghua), based mainly on the Beijing dialect and used as the official and instructional language in Mainland China.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你識唔識講普通話？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sik1 m4 sik1 gong2 pou2 tung1 waa6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你會說普通話嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Can you speak Mandarin?

mandarin_meaning: 普遍（pǔbiàn）：广泛存在的、常见的
english_meaning: widespread; common; prevalent; general
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事物在一定範圍、人口或情況中廣泛存在或常見。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is widespread, common, or prevalent across a given range, population, or situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個現象好普遍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jin6 zoeng6 hou2 pou2 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个现象很普遍。
examples.english_sentence: This phenomenon is very common.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺香港，使用智能手機已經變得好普遍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 hoeng1 gong2, si6 jung6 zi6 nang4 sau2 gei1 ji5 ging1 bin3 dak1 hou2 pou2 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在香港，使用智能手机已经变得很普遍。
examples.english_sentence: In Hong Kong, using smartphones has already become very common.

mandarin_meaning: 普选（普遍选举、普遍投票）——指所有合资格公民均有投票权以选举公职人员的制度，常指选择行政首长或立法机构的权利
english_meaning: universal suffrage — the system in which all eligible citizens have the right to vote to elect public officials
explanation_mandarin: 普選指所有符合资格的公民拥有投票权，以选出政府首脑或立法代表等公职人员的制度。该词在香港语境中常用于讨论是否可普选行政长官或立法会成员。
explanation_english: Universal suffrage refers to a voting system in which all eligible citizens have the right to vote to elect public officials. In the Hong Kong context it is often used when discussing the right to elect the Chief Executive or legislative representatives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港市民一直爭取普選行政長官。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 si5 man4 jat1 zik6 zang1 ceoi2 pou2 syun2 hang4 zing3 coeng4 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港市民一直争取普选行政长官。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong citizens have long been fighting for universal suffrage for the Chief Executive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 普選係公民權利嘅重要體現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: pou2 syun2 hai6 gung1 man4 kyun4 lei6 ge3 zung6 jiu3 tai2 jin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 普选是公民权利的重要体现。
examples.english_sentence: Universal suffrage is an important expression of citizens' rights.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果要落實普選，政府需要修改選舉制度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 jiu3 lok6 sat6 pou2 syun2, zing3 fu2 seoi1 jiu3 sau1 goi2 syun2 geoi2 zai3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果要落实普选，政府需要修改选举制度。
examples.english_sentence: If universal suffrage is to be implemented, the government would need to reform the electoral system.

mandarin_meaning: 普鲁士（歷史上位於德國及周邊地區的國家/王國）
english_meaning: Prussia (historical state/kingdom in what is now Germany and neighboring areas)
explanation_mandarin: 普鲁士是歐洲歷史上的一個重要國家，起源於勃蘭登堡-普魯士，19世紀在德意志統一過程中扮演關鍵角色，二戰後於1947年被正式廢止。
explanation_english: Prussia was a significant historical state in Europe, originating from Brandenburg–Prussia. It played a key role in 19th-century German unification and was formally abolished in 1947 after World War II.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 普魯士以前係一個強大嘅國家，喺十九世紀喺統一德國嘅過程中扮演重要角色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: pou2 lou5 si6 ji5 cin4 hai6 jat1 go3 koeng4 daai6 ge3 gwok3 gaa1 , hai2 sap6 gau2 sai3 gei2 hai2 tung2 jat1 dak1 gwok3 ge3 gwo3 cing4 zung1 baan6 jin2 zung6 jiu3 gok3 sik1 .
examples.mandarin_sentence: 普鲁士以前是一个强大的国家，在十九世纪的德意志统一过程中扮演重要角色。
examples.english_sentence: Prussia used to be a powerful state that played an important role in the 19th-century unification of Germany.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 普魯士喺第二次世界大戰之後被解散，喺一九四七年正式廢止。
examples.jyutping_sentence: pou2 lou5 si6 hai2 dai6 ji6 ci3 sai3 gaai3 daai6 zin3 zi1 hau6 bei6 gaai2 saan3 , hai2 jat1 gau2 sei3 cat1 nin4 zing3 sik1 fai3 zi2 .
examples.mandarin_sentence: 普鲁士在第二次世界大战之后被解散，1947年正式废除。
examples.english_sentence: Prussia was dissolved after World War II and officially abolished in 1947.

mandarin_meaning: 景；風景；情況；前景
english_meaning: scenery; view; situation; outlook/prospect
explanation_mandarin: 表示風景、景象或情況，也可用於表示前景、繁榮等含義，常見於複合詞如「景色」「前景」「景氣」。
explanation_english: Refers to scenery or a scene, and can also mean a situation or outlook (e.g., prospects, economic climate). Commonly appears in compounds like "景色" (scenery) and "前景" (prospect).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度景色好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ging2 sik1 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這裡景色很美。
examples.english_sentence: The scenery here is beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個城市嘅前景好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sing4 si5 ge3 cin4 ging2 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個城市的前景很好。
examples.english_sentence: The city's prospects are good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 山上嘅景色好壯觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saan1 soeng6 ge3 ging2 sik1 hou2 zong6 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 山上的景色很壯觀。
examples.english_sentence: The scenery on the mountain is spectacular.

mandarin_meaning: 敬仰、仰慕
english_meaning: to admire; to revere; to look up to
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某人或某种品质抱有敬重与仰慕的情感，语气较庄重正式，常用于书面或较正式的场合。
explanation_english: Expresses respect and admiration for someone or some quality. The term is relatively formal and often used in written or dignified contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好景仰佢，因為佢對工作好認真。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 ging2 joeng5 keoi5, jan1wai6 keoi5 deoi3 gung1 zok3 hou2 jing6zan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很敬仰他，因為他對工作很認真。
examples.english_sentence: I greatly admire him because he is very serious about his work.

mandarin_meaning: （經濟）景氣；繁榮、興旺或不景氣的經濟狀況
english_meaning: economic well-being; prosperity; boom (or lack thereof) in business/activity
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞 / 名詞（經濟學）
explanation_mandarin: 指經濟活動活躍或低迷的狀態，用來描述市場或行業的好壞與繁榮程度。
explanation_english: Refers to the state of economic activity—whether the market or industry is flourishing or sluggish; used to describe business conditions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年經濟景氣唔錯，生意好轉咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ging1 zai3 ging2 hei3 m4 co3, saang1 ji3 hou2 zyun2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年經濟景氣不錯，生意好轉了。
examples.english_sentence: The economy has been doing well this year; business has improved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家樓市景氣唔太好，樓價開始下跌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 lau4 si5 ging2 hei3 m4 taai3 hou2, lau4 gaa3 hoi1 ci2 haa6 dit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在樓市景氣不太好，房價開始下跌。
examples.english_sentence: The property market isn't very strong right now; housing prices have started to fall.

mandarin_meaning: 景深（攝影術語，指在一張照片中從最近到最遠仍然清晰的距離範圍）
english_meaning: Depth of field (the range in a photo within which objects appear acceptably sharp)
explanation_mandarin: 攝影專業術語，指在影像中由最近到最遠仍能保持清晰的距離範圍，受光圈、焦距和拍攝距離影響。
explanation_english: A photography term describing the distance range in an image—from the nearest to the farthest point—that appears acceptably sharp; affected by aperture, focal length, and shooting distance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張相嘅景深好淺，背景模糊晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 soeng2 ge3 ging2 sam1 hou2 cin2, bui3 ging2 mo4 wu4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這張照片的景深很淺，背景模糊了。
examples.english_sentence: The depth of field in this photo is very shallow; the background is blurred.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 拍人像時，想製造模糊背景，就要縮小景深。
examples.jyutping_sentence: paak3 jan4 zoeng6 si4, soeng2 zai3 zou6 mo4 wu4 bui3 ging2, zau6 jiu3 suk1 siu2 ging2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拍人像時，想製造模糊的背景，就要縮小景深。
examples.english_sentence: When shooting portraits, to create a blurred background you need to reduce the depth of field.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 光圈越大，景深越淺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwong1 hyun1 jyut6 daai6, ging2 sam1 jyut6 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 光圈越大，景深越淺。
examples.english_sentence: The larger the aperture, the shallower the depth of field.

mandarin_meaning: 风景；景象；环境中的事物
english_meaning: scenery; scene; sights; objects in a landscape
explanation_mandarin: 指風景或環境中可見的事物和景象，常用來描述自然或人造的景致。
explanation_english: Refers to the scenery or visible objects and scenes in an environment, often used to describe natural or man-made vistas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行山嗰陣，我望住周圍嘅景物，好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 saan1 go2 zan6, ngo5 mong6 zyu6 zau1 wai4 ge3 ging2 mat6, hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爬山的時候，我看着周围的景物，很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: When hiking, looking at the surrounding scenery felt very relaxing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 畫家用畫筆記錄咗城市嘅景物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waak6 gaa1 jung6 waak6 bat1 gei3 luk6 zo2 sing4 si5 ge3 ging2 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 畫家用畫筆記錄了城市的景物。
examples.english_sentence: The artist used a brush to record the city's scenes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本相簿入面收錄咗好多旅行嘅景物相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 soeng2 bou2 jap6 min6 sau1 luk6 zo2 hou2 do1 leoi5 hang4 ge3 ging2 mat6 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這本相冊裡收錄了很多旅行的景物照片。
examples.english_sentence: This photo album contains many photos of scenery from trips.

mandarin_meaning: 景致 (jǐngzhì)：风景、景观
english_meaning: scenery; landscape; the appearance or scenic appeal of a place
explanation_mandarin: 指自然或人文的风景、景观，常用来形容景色的美观或特色。
explanation_english: Refers to the scenery or landscape of a place, often used to describe the attractiveness or distinctive features of a view.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度嘅景致真係好靚，好適合影相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ge3 ging2 zi3 zan1 hai6 hou2 leng3, hou2 sik1 hap6 jing2 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的景致真漂亮，很适合拍照。
examples.english_sentence: The scenery here is really beautiful, perfect for taking photos.

mandarin_meaning: 景色（jǐngsè）
english_meaning: scenery; view; landscape
explanation_mandarin: 指風景、景致，常用來描寫自然或城市的景觀，也可比喻某種情景或場面。
explanation_english: Refers to scenery or a view, commonly used to describe natural or urban landscapes; can also be used metaphorically for a scene or spectacle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度嘅景色好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ge3 ging2-sik1 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的景色很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: The scenery here is very beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 山上嘅景色四季各有特色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saan1 soeng5 ge3 ging2-sik1 sei3 gwai3 gok3 jau5 dak6-sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 山上的景色四季各有特色。
examples.english_sentence: The scenery on the mountain has its own charms in every season.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一齊享受眼前嘅景色啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 hoeng2-sau6 ngaan5-cin4 ge3 ging2-sik1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一起享受眼前的景色吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's enjoy the view in front of us together.

mandarin_meaning: 景观 (指可供觀賞或觀察的風景、場景或視野)
english_meaning: landscape; scenery; view; vista
explanation_mandarin: 指可見的風景或場景的總稱，可以是自然景致或人工景觀，常用於描述視覺上的整體印象。
explanation_english: Refers to the visible scenery or vista of a place, whether natural or man-made; used to describe the overall visual appearance or view.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 維多利亞港嘅景觀喺夜晚特別靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai4 do1 lei6 aa3 gong2 ge3 ging2 gwaan3 hai2 je6 maan5 dak6 bit6 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 維多利亞港的景觀在夜晚特別漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: The scenery of Victoria Harbour is especially beautiful at night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 城市規劃好注重景觀同綠化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 si5 kwai1 waak6 hou2 zyu3 zung6 ging2 gwaan3 tung4 luk6 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 城市規劃非常重視景觀與綠化。
examples.english_sentence: Urban planning places great emphasis on landscape and greening.

mandarin_meaning: 景象 (jǐngxiàng)：景色、場面或某種情況的情形
english_meaning: scene; sight; spectacle; the visual appearance of a place or the state of affairs
explanation_mandarin: 指眼前看到的場面、景致，或描述某種社會／事態的狀況與樣貌。
explanation_english: Refers to a scene or sight — the visible appearance of a place or the state/condition of a situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 山頂嘅日出景象好壯觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saan1 ding2 ge3 jat6 ceot1 ging2 zoeng6 hou2 zong6 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 山頂的日出景象很壯觀。
examples.english_sentence: The sunrise scene at the summit is spectacular.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 疫情下嘅社會景象令人擔憂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jik6 cing4 haa6 ge3 se5 wui6 ging2 zoeng6 ling6 jan4 daam1 jau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 疫情下的社會景象令人擔憂。
examples.english_sentence: The social situation under the pandemic is worrisome.

mandarin_meaning: 大肆渲染；製造誇張場面以吸引注意（香港粵語俚語）
english_meaning: to make a big scene or spectacle; to sensationalize something to attract attention (Hong Kong Cantonese slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「景轟」為香港粵語俚語，指為了吸引注意、增加話題或收視而故意渲染、製造誇張或聒噪的場面。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang term meaning to deliberately create a noisy or exaggerated spectacle—sensationalize events or behaviour—to attract attention or boost interest/ratings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺度景轟，淨係識做戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 ging2 hung1, zing6 hai6 sik1 zou6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是在那裡大肆渲染，只會做戲。
examples.english_sentence: He's always making a fuss there, only putting on a show.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新聞台為咗吸引觀眾成日景轟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 man4 toi4 wai6 zo2 kap1 jan5 gun1 zung3 sing4 jat6 ging2 hung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新聞台為了吸引觀眾總是大肆渲染。
examples.english_sentence: The news channel is constantly sensationalizing things to attract viewers.

mandarin_meaning: 旅遊景點；有觀光、遊覽價值的地方
english_meaning: tourist attraction; scenic spot; place of interest for sightseeing
explanation_mandarin: 指具有觀光或遊覽價值的地方，如風景區、名勝古跡或城市中的旅遊景點；也可指旅遊行程中的停留點。
explanation_english: Refers to a place of interest for sightseeing or tourism, such as scenic areas, landmarks, or attractions; can also mean a stop on a travel itinerary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下個星期去嗰度旅行，想去啲著名嘅景點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 sing1 kei4 heoi3 go2 dou6 leoi5 hang4, soeng2 heoi3 di1 zoek3 ming4 ge3 ging2 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們下個星期去那裡旅行，想去一些著名的景點。
examples.english_sentence: We're going on a trip there next week and want to visit some famous attractions.

mandarin_meaning: 清晰、明白（如聲音、影像或表達）
english_meaning: clear; distinct; easy to perceive or understand
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事物（例如聲音、影像、說話的表達等）清楚、易於辨別或理解。
explanation_english: Indicates that something (for example sound, image, or spoken expression) is clear, distinct, and easy to perceive or understand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張相好清晰，可以睇到每個細節。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 soeng2 hou2 cing1 sik1, ho2 ji5 tai2 dou3 mui5 go3 sai3 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這張照片很清晰，可以看到每個細節。
examples.english_sentence: This photo is very clear; you can see every detail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講得好清晰，我而家明白晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 dak1 hou2 cing1 sik1, ngo5 ji4 gaa1 ming4 baak6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你說得很清楚，我現在都明白了。
examples.english_sentence: You explained it very clearly; I understand now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個聲音唔太清晰，錄音有雜音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 seng1 jam1 m4 taai3 cing1 sik1, luk6 jam1 jau5 zaap6 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的聲音不太清晰，錄音有雜音。
examples.english_sentence: His voice isn't very clear; the recording has background noise.

mandarin_meaning: 晴（qíng），表示天氣晴朗
english_meaning: sunny; clear (weather)
explanation_mandarin: 表示天空無雲或陽光充足，天氣晴朗。常見於「晴天」、「放晴」等詞語。
explanation_english: Describes weather that is clear or sunny (no clouds or plenty of sunshine). Commonly used in compounds like "晴天" or "turns sunny".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日好晴，我哋去海邊啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 hou2 cing4, ngo5 dei6 heoi3 hoi2 bin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天天氣很晴朗，我們去海邊吧。
examples.english_sentence: It's very sunny today; let's go to the beach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣預報話聽日會轉晴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 jyu6 bou3 waa6 ting1 jat6 wui5 zyun2 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天氣預報說明天會轉晴。
examples.english_sentence: The weather forecast says it will clear up tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果想影相，最好揀晴天。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 soeng2 jing2 soeng2, zeoi3 hou2 gaan2 cing4 tin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果想拍照，最好選晴天。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to take photos, it's best to choose a sunny day.

mandarin_meaning: 晴天 (qíng tiān)
english_meaning: sunny day
explanation_mandarin: 指天空晴朗、没有下雨的日子，也可用来描述天气状态。
explanation_english: Refers to a day with clear skies and no rain; a description of weather conditions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日係晴天，我哋可以去海邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 hai6 cing4 tin1, ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 heoi3 hoi2 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天是晴天，我們可以去海邊。
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow will be a sunny day; we can go to the beach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日係晴天，晒衫啱啱好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 hai6 cing4 tin1, saai3 saam1 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天是晴天，晒衣服正好。
examples.english_sentence: It's sunny today, perfect for drying clothes.

mandarin_meaning: 晴天霹靂（qíng tiān pī lì）：比喻意外且令人震驚的事情
english_meaning: A bolt from the blue; a sudden, unexpected and shocking event
explanation_mandarin: 原指晴朗的天忽然打雷，後用來比喻突如其來、令人非常震驚的事情或消息。
explanation_english: Originally refers to thunder striking on a clear day; figuratively used for an unforeseen event or piece of news that shocks people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢突然辭職，對我嚟講真係晴天霹靂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dat6 jin4 ci4 zik1, deoi3 ngo5 lai4 gong2 zan1 hai6 cing4 tin1 pik1 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他突然辭職，對我來說真是晴天霹靂。
examples.english_sentence: His sudden resignation was truly a bolt out of the blue for me.

mandarin_meaning: 晴朗（天气晴朗、阳光充足）
english_meaning: clear and sunny; bright (of weather)
explanation_mandarin: 形容天气晴朗、天空明亮、云量少或无云，也可引申形容心情明朗。
explanation_english: Describes weather that is clear and sunny with little or no cloud; can also be used figuratively to describe a bright or cheerful mood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日天氣好晴朗，啱晒出去郊遊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 hou2 cing4 long5, aam1 saai3 ceot1 heoi3 gaau1 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天天气很晴朗，适合出去郊游。
examples.english_sentence: The weather is very clear and sunny today, perfect for going on an outing.

mandarin_meaning: 晴空万里
english_meaning: clear sky; cloudless expanse; bright, fine weather
explanation_mandarin: 形容天空晴朗，沒有雲層，常用來描述天氣非常好。
explanation_english: Describes a sky that is clear and cloudless; commonly used to indicate very good, sunny weather.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日晴空萬里，啱晒出去郊遊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 cing4 hung1 maan6 lei5, aap3 saai3 ceot1 heoi3 gaau1 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天晴空万里，正适合出去郊游。
examples.english_sentence: Today's sky is clear and cloudless — perfect for going on an outing.

mandarin_meaning: 水晶；晶莹；明亮、闪耀的状态
english_meaning: crystal; bright/sparkling; (also used in compounds like 'chip' in electronics)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞 / 作形容詞語素
explanation_mandarin: 表示晶体或透明且能反光、闪亮的状态，常见于复合词如“水晶”、“晶莹”，在科技语境中也可见于“晶片”。
explanation_english: Denotes a crystal or a bright, sparkling/transparent quality. Commonly appears in compounds such as '水晶' (crystal) and '晶莹' (sparkling); in technical contexts it appears in terms like '晶片' (chip).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊水晶好靚，晶瑩剔透。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 seoi2 zing1 hou2 leng3, zing1 jing4 tik1 tau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这块水晶很漂亮，晶莹剔透。
examples.english_sentence: This crystal is very beautiful, sparkling and translucent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢隻眼晶晶㗎，好有神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zek3 ngaan5 zing1 zing1 gaa3, hou2 jau5 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她的眼睛晶晶的，很有神采。
examples.english_sentence: His/her eyes are sparkling and lively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家嘅手機入面有好多晶片。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ge3 sau2 gei1 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 zing1 pin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的手机里面有很多晶片。
examples.english_sentence: Modern phones contain many chips.

mandarin_meaning: 晶片 (jīngpiàn)：半导体芯片或集成电路芯片，用于儲存和處理資訊
english_meaning: semiconductor chip; microchip; integrated circuit chip
explanation_mandarin: 指用半导体材料製作的電子元件，如微處理器或記憶體等，也可泛指智慧卡或電子裝置內的芯片。
explanation_english: Refers to semiconductor components made from crystalline materials used in electronic circuits (e.g., microprocessors, memory chips); can also generically mean the chip inside smart cards or electronic devices.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近晶片短缺，唔少廠商都要減產。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 zing1 pin3 dyun2 kyut3, m4 siu2 cong2 soeng1 dou1 jiu3 gaam2 caan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近晶片短缺，不少廠商都要減產。
examples.english_sentence: There has been a recent chip shortage, and many manufacturers have had to cut production.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你張八達通裏面有晶片，用嚟儲值同過閘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoeng1 baat3 daat6 tung1 leoi5 min6 jau5 zing1 pin3, jung6 lai4 cou5 zik6 tung4 gwo3 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的八達通卡裡面有晶片，用來儲值和過閘。
examples.english_sentence: Your Octopus card has a chip inside, used for storing value and tapping through gates.

mandarin_meaning: 晶莹（形容透明清澈、光亮如晶體）
english_meaning: sparkling; crystal-clear; lustrous; translucent
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容透明、光亮、像晶體般閃爍清澈，常用於描述露水、寶石、眼淚等帶有光澤和通透感的事物。
explanation_english: Describes something that is clear, sparkling, or lustrous like crystal; often used for dew, gems, eyes/tears, or other objects with a glistening, translucent quality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 早晨嘅露水令草葉晶瑩剔透。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou2 san4 ge3 lou6 seoi2 ling6 cou2 jip6 zing1 jing4 tek3 tau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 早晨的露水讓草葉晶莹剔透。
examples.english_sentence: The morning dew made the grass blades sparkle and look crystal-clear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊玉石晶瑩剔透，好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 juk6 sek6 zing1 jing4 tek3 tau3, hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這塊玉石晶莹剔透，很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of jade is crystal-clear and very beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喊完之後，眼淚未乾，眼睛仲晶瑩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haam3 jyun4 zi1 hau6, ngaan5 leoi6 mei6 gon1, ngaan5 zing1 zung6 zing1 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他哭完之後，眼淚還沒乾，眼睛依然晶莹。
examples.english_sentence: After crying, her tears hadn't dried and her eyes were still glistening.

mandarin_meaning: 晶莹剔透（jīng yíng tī tòu）：形容光亮透明、纯净
english_meaning: crystal-clear; sparkling and translucent; bright and transparent
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容物體晶亮、透明、純淨，常用於描述寶石、冰雪或清澈的液體，也可比喻人的眼睛或表情清澈純真。
explanation_english: Describes something that is sparkling, bright and translucent. Often used for gemstones, ice, or clear liquids; can also metaphorically describe clear, innocent eyes or expressions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊水晶晶瑩剔透，閃閃發光，好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 seoi2 zing1 zing1 jing4 tik1 tau3, sim2 sim2 faat3 gwong1, hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這塊水晶晶莹剔透，閃閃發光，很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: This crystal is crystal-clear and translucent, sparkling beautifully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友嘅眼睛晶瑩剔透，望落好純真。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 ge3 ngaan5 zing1 zing1 jing4 tik1 tau3, mong6 lok6 hou2 seon4 zan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友的眼睛晶莹剔透，看起來很純真。
examples.english_sentence: The child's eyes are bright and clear, looking very innocent.

mandarin_meaning: 晶体（固体中原子、分子或离子按规则排列形成的结构）
english_meaning: crystal (a solid whose atoms, molecules, or ions are arranged in an ordered, repeating pattern)
explanation_mandarin: 指固体物质中具有规则排列的原子、分子或离子形成的结构，例如鹽、石英、鑽石等，被称为晶体。
explanation_english: A solid material whose constituent particles (atoms, molecules, or ions) are arranged in an ordered, repeating pattern; examples include salt, quartz, and diamond.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個物質嘅晶體結構好複雜，要用X射線先睇到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 mat6 zat1 ge3 zing1 tai2 git3 gau3 hou2 fuk1 zaap6, jiu3 jung6 X se6 sin3 sin1 tai2 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个物质的晶体结构很复杂，要用X射线才能看清楚。
examples.english_sentence: The crystal structure of this substance is very complex; you need X-rays to see it.

mandarin_meaning: 晷（古代用來計時的日影或日晷）
english_meaning: sundial; the sun's shadow used to tell time (archaic/technical)
explanation_mandarin: 指日晷或日影，古代用來根據太陽影子判斷時刻的器具或其所形成的影子。
explanation_english: Refers to a sundial or the sun's shadow used to indicate time; an archaic/technical term for time measured by sunlight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公園入面有個古老嘅日晷，係用嚟展示古代計時方法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jyun4 jap6 min6 jau5 go3 gu2 lou5 ge3 jat6 gwai2, hai6 jung6 lai4 zin2 si6 gu2 doi6 gai3 si4 fong1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公园里面有一个古老的日晷，是用来展示古代计时方法。
examples.english_sentence: There is an old sundial in the park, used to demonstrate ancient timekeeping methods.

mandarin_meaning: 智 (zhì) — 智慧、智力；表示『聰明、智慧』，常見於複合詞如「智慧」「智能」「智障」
english_meaning: wisdom; intelligence; wise (used as a morpheme in compounds)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞 / 形容詞（作為構詞成分）
explanation_mandarin: 「智」字表示智慧、聰明或智力，常見於各類複合詞中（例如：智慧、智能、智障），單獨使用時多作語素出現。
explanation_english: The character 智 denotes wisdom, intelligence, or being wise. It commonly appears as a morpheme in compounds such as 智慧 (wisdom), 智能 (intelligent/smart), and 智障 (intellectual disability).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢幾有智慧㗎，諗法好成熟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gei2 jau5 zi3 wai6 gaa3, nam2faat3 hou2 sing4suk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很有智慧，想法很成熟。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is quite wise; their thinking is very mature.

mandarin_meaning: 智人（指現生的人類，學名 Homo sapiens）
english_meaning: Homo sapiens; modern human (literally 'wise person')
explanation_mandarin: 指現生的人類，學名 Homo sapiens。常見於人類學、考古學與古生物學的專業語境；字面上亦可理解為「有智慧的人」。
explanation_english: Refers to modern humans (scientific name Homo sapiens). Commonly used in anthropology, archaeology, and paleontology contexts. Literally translates as 'wise person'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 科學家話智人大約喺二十萬年前出現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fo1 hok6 gaa1 waa6 zi3 jan4 daai6 joek3 hai2 ji6 sap6 maan6 nin4 cin4 ceot1 jin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 科学家说智人大约在二十万年前出现。
examples.english_sentence: Scientists say Homo sapiens appeared around 200,000 years ago.

mandarin_meaning: 智利（南美洲國家，正式國名為智利共和國）
english_meaning: Chile (country in South America; officially the Republic of Chile)
explanation_mandarin: 智利是位於南美洲西南部的國家，西臨太平洋，首都為聖地亞哥（Santiago）。
explanation_english: Chile is a country in southwestern South America, bordering the Pacific Ocean to the west; its capital is Santiago.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個禮拜會去智利旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 wui5 heoi3 zi3 lei6 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下個禮拜會去智利旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'll travel to Chile next week.

mandarin_meaning: 智力 (zhìlì)
english_meaning: intelligence; intellectual ability
explanation_mandarin: 智力指一個人理解、學習、推理和解決問題的能力，常用於教育和心理測試與發展評估中。
explanation_english: The capacity for understanding, learning, reasoning, and solving problems; often used in education and psychological assessment contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅智力好高，學嘢快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zi3lik6 hou2 gou1, hok6 je5 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的智力很高，學東西很快。
examples.english_sentence: He has high intelligence and learns things quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友嘅智力發展需要玩遊戲同刺激。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 ge3 zi3lik6 faat3 zin2 seoi1 jiu3 waan2 jau4 hei3 tung4 ci3 gik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友的智力發展需要透過遊戲和刺激來促進。
examples.english_sentence: Children's intellectual development needs play and stimulation to promote it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做智力測驗之前唔好太緊張，要休息好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 zi3lik6 cak1 jim6 zi1 cin4 m4 hou2 taai3 gan2 zoeng1, jiu3 jau1 sik1 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在做智力測驗之前不要太緊張，要好好休息。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be too nervous before an intelligence test; make sure to rest well.

mandarin_meaning: 既有智慧又有勇氣（的人或特質）；智勇雙全
english_meaning: possessing both intelligence and courage; both wise and brave
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人既有智謀又有勇氣，常用來稱讚領袖、英雄或能幹的人。
explanation_english: An idiom used to describe someone who combines wisdom/intelligence with bravery/courage; often used to praise leaders, heroes, or capable people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係智勇雙全，唔論係策劃抑或執行都做得好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 zi3 jung5 soeng1 cyun4, m4 leon6 hai6 caak3 waak6 jik1 wo6 zap1 hang4 dou1 zou6 dak1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是智勇雙全，無論是策劃還是執行都做得很好。
examples.english_sentence: He truly has both wisdom and courage; whether planning or executing, he does everything very well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做領袖要既有計劃又有膽識，先可以話係智勇雙全。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 ling5 zau6 jiu3 gei3 jau5 gai3 waa6 jau6 jau5 daam2 sik1, sin1 ho2 ji5 waa6 hai6 zi3 jung5 soeng1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做領袖要既有計劃又有膽識，才能說是智勇雙全。
examples.english_sentence: To be a leader you need both planning ability and courage; only then can one be called both wise and brave.

mandarin_meaning: 智取
english_meaning: to seize/obtain by strategy; to outwit and capture
explanation_mandarin: 用智慧或計謀取得勝利或佔領，強調以策略取勝而非以蠻力。
explanation_english: To achieve victory or secure something by intelligence or stratagem; emphasizes using tactics rather than force.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃要用智取，唔好硬碰硬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 jiu3 jung6 zi3 ceoi2, m4 hou2 ngaang6 pung3 ngaang6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划要用智取，不要硬碰硬。
examples.english_sentence: This plan needs to rely on strategy; don't confront directly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢靠智取贏咗場比賽，大家都好佩服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kaau3 zi3 ceoi2 jing4 zo2 coeng4 bei2 coi3, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 pui3 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他靠智取赢了场比赛，大家都很佩服。
examples.english_sentence: He relied on strategy to win the match; everyone admired him.

mandarin_meaning: 智商（zhìshāng），智力商数（IQ）。
english_meaning: Intelligence quotient (IQ); a measure of a person's cognitive ability.
explanation_mandarin: 表示智力水平的指标，全称为智力商数（IQ），常用于评估和比较個體的認知能力或學習能力。
explanation_english: A metric that represents intellectual ability—intelligence quotient (IQ). Commonly used to evaluate and compare individuals' cognitive or learning abilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅智商好高，學嘢好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zi3 soeng1 hou2 gou1, hok6 je5 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的智商很高，学东西很快。
examples.english_sentence: He has a high IQ and learns things quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做呢份工可能智商唔夠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 ni1 fan6 gung1 ho2 nang4 zi3 soeng1 m4 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做这份工作可能智商不够。
examples.english_sentence: He may not have a high enough IQ for this job.

mandarin_meaning: 智商稅（网络用语）指因判断失误、轻信或缺乏信息而付出的金钱损失，类似“愚蠢的代价”
english_meaning: “IQ tax” (slang) — the money or loss one pays because of poor judgment, gullibility, or lack of information
explanation_mandarin: 網路流行語，用來形容因為判斷錯誤、輕信廣告或詐騙、購買劣質商品等而造成的金錢損失，好像是為自己的“智商”繳的一種稅。
explanation_english: An internet slang term describing money lost or a penalty paid due to bad judgment, naivety, or being gullible — as if one is paying a 'tax' on their intelligence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰件衫質素咁差，我買完真係畀咗智商稅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gin6 saam1 zat1 sou3 gam2 caa1, ngo5 maai5 jyun4 zan1 hai6 bei2 zo2 zi3 soeng1 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那件衣服質量那麼差，我買完真的交了智商稅。
examples.english_sentence: That piece of clothing was so poor in quality — after buying it I really paid the 'IQ tax'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到有高回報就即刻投資，最後發現係騙局，當時真係交咗智商稅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teng1 dou3 jau5 gou1 wui4 bou3 zau6 zik1 hak1 tau4 zi1, zeoi6 hau6 faat3 jin6 hai6 pin3 guk6, dong1 si4 zan1 hai6 gaau1 zo2 zi3 soeng1 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一聽到高回報就立刻投資，最後發現是騙局，當時真的交了智商稅。
examples.english_sentence: He invested as soon as he heard about high returns; in the end it turned out to be a scam — he really paid the IQ tax.

mandarin_meaning: 網絡流行語，字面意思為「智商被徵稅」，引申指因判斷失誤、缺乏常識或輕信他人而付出的金錢或代價。
english_meaning: Internet slang literally meaning "IQ tax" — the money or cost someone pays because of poor judgment, lack of common sense, or gullibility.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容因為不夠聰明、判斷錯誤或貪便宜而要付出的損失或代價，通常帶有調侃或諷刺意味。
explanation_english: Used to describe the loss or cost one pays due to being not smart enough, making bad decisions, or falling for a bargain; often used mockingly or sarcastically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買啲冇用嘅電子產品就係交智商稅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 di1 mou5 jung6 ge3 din6 zi2 caan2 ban2 zau6 hai6 gaau1 zi3 soeng1 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 買那些沒用的電子產品就是交智商稅。
examples.english_sentence: Buying those useless electronic gadgets is paying the "IQ tax."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俾人騙去買假貨，其實係交智商稅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 jan4 pin3 heoi3 maai5 gaa2 fo3, kei4 sat1 hai6 gaau1 zi3 soeng1 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 被人騙去買假貨，其實是在交智商稅。
examples.english_sentence: Getting scammed into buying a fake product is basically paying the IQ tax.

mandarin_meaning: 智囊；提供智力或策略建議的人或團體
english_meaning: braintrust; a person or group that provides intellectual support, strategic advice, or consultancy
explanation_mandarin: 指为决策或行动提供智力支持、策略建议或咨询的个人或团队，常用于描述顾问团或智库性质的角色。
explanation_english: Refers to an individual or team that provides intellectual support, strategic advice, or consultancy for decision-making or actions; similar to a braintrust or think tank.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司請咗一個前政府高官做智囊，幫手策劃政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1si1 ceng2 zo2 jat1 go3 cin4 zing3fu2 gou1gun1 zou6 zi3nong4, bong1sau2 caak3waak6 zing3cai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司请了一个前政府高官做智囊，帮忙策划政策。
examples.english_sentence: The company hired a former senior government official as a braintrust to help plan policies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我哋智囊團入面嘅主要成員，負責提供策略建議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5dei6 zi3nong4 tyun4 jap6min6 ge3 zyu2jo6 sing4jyun4, fu6zaak3 tai4gung1 caak3loek6 gin3ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在我们的智囊团里是主要成员，负责提供策略建议。
examples.english_sentence: He is a key member of our braintrust and is responsible for providing strategic recommendations.

mandarin_meaning: 智囊團 / 智囊（團）——由專家或顧問組成的諮詢或研究團隊
english_meaning: an advisory group or think tank; a panel of experts who provide strategies, research, or advice
explanation_mandarin: 指由專家、學者或顧問組成，為決策提供建議、研究或策略支持的團隊或機構。
explanation_english: A group of experts or advisers who provide intellectual support, research, strategies, or recommendations to assist decision-making.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司請咗一個智囊團幫手設計新策略。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 cing2 zo2 jat1 go3 zi3 nong4 tyun4 bong1 sau2 cit3 gai3 san1 caak3 loek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司請了一個智囊團幫忙設計新策略。
examples.english_sentence: The company hired a think tank to help design the new strategy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府成立咗一個智囊團，專門應付經濟危機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 sing4 laap6 zo2 jat1 go3 zi3 nong4 tyun4, zyun1 mun4 jing3 fu6 ging1 zai3 ngai4 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府成立了一個智囊團，專門應對經濟危機。
examples.english_sentence: The government established an advisory panel specifically to deal with the economic crisis.

mandarin_meaning: 智庫（研究政策並提供諮詢與建議的機構）
english_meaning: think tank (an organization that researches policies and provides advice and recommendations)
explanation_mandarin: 指專門從事公共政策、社會議題或專業領域研究，並向政府、企業或公眾提供分析與建議的機構。
explanation_english: An organization dedicated to researching public policy, social issues, or specialized fields and providing analysis and recommendations to governments, businesses, or the public.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府搵咗幾間智庫嚟分析新政策嘅影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 wan2 zo2 gei2 gaan1 zi3 fu3 lai4 fan1 sik1 san1 zing3 caak3 ge3 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府找了幾家智庫來分析新政策的影響。
examples.english_sentence: The government hired several think tanks to analyze the impact of the new policy.

mandarin_meaning: 智慧 (zhìhuì)：明智、深刻的理解與判斷力
english_meaning: wisdom; the ability to make sound judgments and show deep understanding
explanation_mandarin: 指一種來自經驗、沉思或深刻洞見的能力，能做出合宜的判斷與決策，偏重於長遠與周全的考量。
explanation_english: Refers to the ability, often developed through experience and reflection, to understand complex situations and make appropriate, well-considered decisions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅智慧幫到我哋解決咗好多問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zi3 wai6 bong1 dou3 ngo5 dei6 gaai2 kyut3 zo2 hou2 do1 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的智慧幫助我們解決了很多問題。
examples.english_sentence: His wisdom helped us solve many problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要應付呢個複雜嘅情況，你要有智慧同耐性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 jing3 fu6 ni1 go3 fuk1 zaap6 ge3 cing4 fong3, nei5 jiu3 jau5 zi3 wai6 tung4 noi6 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要應付這個複雜的情況，你要有智慧和耐性。
examples.english_sentence: To handle this complicated situation, you need wisdom and patience.

mandarin_meaning: 智能手機 / 智慧型手機
english_meaning: smartphone
explanation_mandarin: 指具有先進計算能力和多種應用功能的手機，例如可以上網、安裝應用程式、拍照和導航等。
explanation_english: A mobile phone with advanced computing capabilities and a variety of applications and features, such as internet access, apps, camera, and navigation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我部智慧型手機冇電，要快啲去充電。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bou6 zi3 wai6 jing4 sau2 gei1 mou5 din6, jiu3 faai3 di1 heoi3 cung1 din6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的智慧型手機沒電了，要快點去充電。
examples.english_sentence: My smartphone is out of battery; I need to go charge it soon.

mandarin_meaning: 智齒（第三磨牙）
english_meaning: wisdom tooth (third molar)
explanation_mandarin: 智慧齒，即智齒或第三磨牙，通常在青少年末期或成年早期長出；有時會阻生或長歪，導致疼痛或發炎，需要由牙醫評估是否拔除。
explanation_english: Wisdom tooth — the third molar that usually emerges in late adolescence or early adulthood. It can become impacted, misaligned, or cause pain/infection and may need extraction by a dentist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最近啲智慧齒痛，要去睇牙醫拔牙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 di1 zi3 wai6 ci2 tung3, jiu3 heoi3 tai2 ngaa4 ji1 baat6 ngaa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近智齒痛，要去看牙醫拔牙。
examples.english_sentence: My wisdom tooth has been hurting recently; I need to see a dentist to have it extracted.

mandarin_meaning: 智者；有智慧的人
english_meaning: wise person; sage
explanation_mandarin: 指具有智慧、判斷力和遠見的人，常用來稱讚有見識或能給出良好建議的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person of wisdom, good judgment, and insight; often used to praise someone who offers wise advice or guidance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我哋班嘅智者，大家有難題都會問佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 baan1 ge3 zi3 ze2, daai6 gaa1 jau5 naan4 tai4 dou1 wui5 man6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我們班的智者，大家有難題都會問他。
examples.english_sentence: He is the wise person in our class; everyone asks him when they have difficult problems.

jyutping: zi3 ze2 cin1 leoi6, bit1 jau5 jat1 sat1
mandarin_meaning: 智者千虑，必有一失（即使再有智慧的人，也难免会犯错）
english_meaning: Even the wise make mistakes; no one is infallible.
explanation_mandarin: 意思是即使最聰明、最謹慎的人，也有可能犯錯或出差錯，用來提醒人們謙遜和容錯。
explanation_english: Says that even the most thoughtful or wise people can make errors; a reminder that nobody is perfect and errors are possible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢雖然係專家，但智者千慮，必有一失，今次都出咗少少錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seoi1 jin4 hai6 zyun1 gaa1, daan6 zi3 ze2 cin1 leoi6, bit1 jau5 jat1 sat1, gam1 ci3 dou1 ceot1 zo2 siu2 siu2 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他雖然是專家，但智者千慮，必有一失，這次也出了一些錯誤。
examples.english_sentence: Although he's an expert, even the wise make mistakes; this time he made a few errors.

mandarin_meaning: 智能 (zhìnéng)：有智慧或具備自動判斷、處理能力；常指電子或系統的智慧能力
english_meaning: intelligent; smart; intelligence (often referring to electronic or system capabilities)
explanation_mandarin: 「智能」可作名詞或形容詞使用，常用於描述設備、系統或技術具有類似人類思考、判斷或自動處理的能力（例如智能手機、智能家居、人工智能）。
explanation_english: “智能” can be used as a noun or adjective to describe devices, systems, or technologies that have the ability to perform tasks requiring judgment, learning, or automatic processing (e.g., smartphones, smart homes, artificial intelligence).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部手機有好多智能功能，好方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 sau2 gei1 jau5 hou2 do1 zi6 nang4 gung1 nang4, hou2 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部手机有很多智能功能，很方便。
examples.english_sentence: This phone has many smart features; it's very convenient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋屋企啲智能家居系統可以用手機控制燈同窗簾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei5 di1 zi6 nang4 gaa1 geoi1 hai6 tung2 ho2 ji5 jung6 sau2 gei1 hung3 zai3 dang1 tung4 cong1 lim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们家的智能家居系统可以用手机控制灯和窗帘。
examples.english_sentence: Our home's smart home system can control the lights and curtains with a phone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人工智能已經改變咗好多行業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 gung1 zi6 nang4 ji5 ging1 goi2 bin3 zo2 hou2 do1 hong4 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人工智能已经改变了很多行业。
examples.english_sentence: Artificial intelligence has already changed many industries.

mandarin_meaning: 智能手机 (zhìnéng shǒujī)
english_meaning: smartphone
explanation_mandarin: 一种具备上网、运行应用程序和多媒体功能的手机，能够进行通话、上网、拍照、播放视频等功能。
explanation_english: A mobile phone with advanced computing and internet connectivity that can run apps and multimedia functions (i.e., a smartphone).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱買咗部新嘅智能手機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 maai5 zo2 bou6 san1 ge3 zi6 nang4 sau2 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我剛買了一部新的智能手機。
examples.english_sentence: I just bought a new smartphone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以用智能手機上網、睇片同影相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 jung6 zi6 nang4 sau2 gei1 soeng5 mong5, tai2 pin2 tung4 jing2 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以用智能手機上網、看影片和拍照。
examples.english_sentence: You can use a smartphone to go online, watch videos, and take photos.

mandarin_meaning: 智能手机 / 智能电话 (zhìnéng shǒujī / zhìnéng diànhuà)
english_meaning: smartphone
explanation_mandarin: 指具有智能操作系統、可上網並允許安裝應用程式的行動電話。
explanation_english: A mobile phone with a smart operating system, internet capabilities, and support for installing apps.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱買咗部智能電話，拍相好清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 maai5 zo2 bou6 zi6 nang4 din6 waa2, paak3 soeng2 hou2 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我剛買了一部智能手機，拍照很清楚。
examples.english_sentence: I just bought a smartphone; the photos are very clear.

synonyms: 智能手機 (zi6 nang4 sau2 gei1)

mandarin_meaning: 智谋（聰明的計謀與策略，機智與謀略）
english_meaning: clever plans and strategies; strategic acumen, resourcefulness
explanation_mandarin: 指聰明的計謀和策略，強調在應對局面或解決問題時所運用的智略與機變。
explanation_english: Refers to clever plans and strategies; the intelligence and resourcefulness someone uses to handle situations or solve problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅智謀幫公司避過一場大危機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zi3 mau4 bong1 gung1 si1 bei6 gwo3 jat1 coeng4 daai6 ngai4 gei1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的智谋帮助公司避免了一场大危机。
examples.english_sentence: His strategic acumen helped the company avoid a major crisis.

mandarin_meaning: 智识；智慧與知識（類似「知識」或「見識」）
english_meaning: knowledge; intellect; insight (similar to 'knowledge' or 'insight')
explanation_mandarin: 「智識」指一個人的知識和見識，有時強調智慧或判斷力，與「知識」「見識」「學識」相近但可帶有較多判斷、智慧的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's knowledge and insight, sometimes emphasizing wisdom or judgment. It is similar to 'knowledge', 'learning', or 'insight' but can carry a stronger sense of intelligent judgment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 讀書可以增加你嘅智識同見識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: duk6 syu1 ho2 ji5 zang1 gaa1 nei5 ge3 zi3 sik1 tung4 gin3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 读书可以增加你的智识和见识。
examples.english_sentence: Reading can increase your knowledge and insight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅專業智識令公司受益良多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zyun1 jip6 zi3 sik1 ling6 gung1 si1 sau6 jik1 loeng4 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的專業智識讓公司受益良多。
examples.english_sentence: His professional knowledge has greatly benefited the company.

mandarin_meaning: 智力障礙
english_meaning: intellectual disability; (slang/derogatory) 'retard'
explanation_mandarin: 原指「智力障礙」（智力發展或功能有顯著限制）的醫學/社會用語，但在口語中常被濫用作貶低他人的罵詞，具有冒犯性。
explanation_english: Originally refers to 'intellectual disability' (a clinical/social term). In colloquial Cantonese it is often used as a derogatory slang insult ('retard'), which is offensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有智障，喺學校要特別支援。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 zi3-zoeng3, hai2 hok6-haau6 jiu3 dak6-bit6 zi1-zyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有智力障礙，在學校需要特別支援。
examples.english_sentence: He has an intellectual disability and needs special support at school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂講人智障，咁樣好傷人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gong2 jan4 zi3-zoeng3, gam2 joeng6 hou2 soeng1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要亂說別人智障，這樣很傷人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't casually call someone 'retard'; it's very hurtful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一唔順就鬧人智障。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 m4 seon6 zau6 nau6 jan4 zi3-zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一不順就罵人智障。
examples.english_sentence: Whenever things don't go his way he insults others as 'retards'.

mandarin_meaning: 晾 (liàng)：把衣物等放在通風或陽光下使其乾燥
english_meaning: to hang out (clothes) to air or dry; to expose to air/sun
explanation_mandarin: 指把衣服、被褥等放在通風處或陽光下，使其水分蒸發變乾。也可用於把東西暫時放置、讓空氣流通的情況。
explanation_english: Refers to hanging clothes or other items out in the open air or sun so they dry. Can also mean leaving something exposed or airing it out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我將衫晾喺陽台，等佢乾晒先收返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zoeng1 saam1 loeng6 hai2 joeng4 toi4, dang2 keoi5 gon1 saai3 sin1 sau1 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我把衣服晾在陽台，等它完全乾了再收回來。
examples.english_sentence: I hung the clothes out on the balcony; I'll take them in once they're completely dry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好將呢啲貴重嘅衫晾喺太陽底下，會褪色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng1 ni1 di1 gwai3 zung6 ge3 saam1 loeng6 hai2 taai3 joeng4 dai2 haa6, wui5 teoi3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把這些貴重的衣服晾在太陽底下，會褪色。
examples.english_sentence: Don't hang these expensive clothes in the sun; they'll fade.

mandarin_meaning: 晾干 / 晒干 (把濕的物品放在通風或陽光下使其變乾)
english_meaning: to air-dry; to dry (by airing or in the sun)
explanation_mandarin: 把濕的衣物或其他物品放在通風或有陽光的地方，讓水分蒸發變乾。
explanation_english: To leave wet clothes or items exposed to air or sunlight so the moisture evaporates and they become dry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啲衫洗完之後要晾乾先好收返入櫃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 di1 saam1 sai2 jyun4 zi1 hau6 jiu3 loeng6 gon1 sin1 hou2 sau1 faan1 jap6 gwai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的衣服洗完之後要晾乾才能收進櫃子。
examples.english_sentence: I need to air-dry my clothes after washing before putting them back in the closet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放喺窗邊晾乾會快啲，記得翻一翻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 hai2 coeng1 bin1 loeng6 gon1 wui5 faai3 di1, gei3 dak1 faan1 jat1 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 放在窗邊晾乾會比較快，記得翻一翻。
examples.english_sentence: Putting them by the window will dry faster; remember to turn them over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝落雨，衫未晾乾，今晚唔好著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 lok6 jyu5, saam1 mei6 loeng6 gon1, gam1 maan5 m4 hou2 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上下雨，衣服還沒晾乾，今晚不要穿。
examples.english_sentence: It rained this morning; the clothes haven't dried yet. Don't wear them tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 先暫時放着不管，等候時機再出手或處理
english_meaning: To leave something/someone alone for the time being (to 'leave hanging') and wait for the right moment to act or handle it.
explanation_mandarin: 口語俗語，常用於表示先把事情放置一邊觀望或暫不處理，等待更合適的時機再行動。
explanation_english: A colloquial/slang expression meaning to put something aside temporarily and wait/watch for a better opportunity before taking action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我先唔好理佢，晾住揼睇下佢會唔會主動道歉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sin1 m4 hou2 lei5 keoi5, loeng6 zyu6 dam2 tai2 haa5 keoi5 wui5 m4 wui5 zyu2 dung6 dou6 hip3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我先不理他，先放着看看他会不会主动道歉。
examples.english_sentence: I'll ignore him for now—leave him hanging—to see if he'll apologize on his own.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單買賣唔使急，晾住揼先觀察市場反應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 maai5 maai6 m4 sai2 gap1, loeng6 zyu6 dam2 sin1 gun1 caat3 si5 coeng4 faan2 jing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这笔买卖不用急，先放着观察市场反应。
examples.english_sentence: This deal isn't urgent; we'll hold off and observe the market response first.

mandarin_meaning: 在议价时故意拖延或不回应对方出价（以争取更好条件或让对方让步）
english_meaning: to stall or leave an offer hanging during bargaining; deliberately delay or ignore a price offer to gain an advantage
explanation_mandarin: 「晾價」是香港粵語俚語，指在買賣或議價時故意拖延、不回應或冷淡對待對方的出價，目的是爭取更好條件或讓對方降低要求。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang term meaning to deliberately delay, ignore, or give the cold shoulder to an offered price during bargaining, usually to gain a better deal or force the other party to concede.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個賣家成日晾價，講完價就唔覆我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 maai6 gaa1 sing4 jat6 loeng6 gaa3, gong2 jyun4 gaa3 zau6 m4 fuk1 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个卖家总是晾價，讲完价就不回复我（拖延或不回应我的出价）。
examples.english_sentence: That seller always 'loeng gaa' — after I state a price they don't reply (they stall or ignore my offer).

mandarin_meaning: 把（人）晾著、不理會；放鴿子、冷落某人
english_meaning: to leave someone hanging; to ignore someone; to stand someone up
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，源自「晾衣服」的意象，指把人晾在一邊不理會、令對方等候或放鴿子。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese expression (slang). Literally from 'hanging clothes'; it means to leave someone hanging by ignoring them, making them wait, or standing them up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣晾線我，我都唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng6 loeng6 sin3 ngo5, ngo5 dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣把我晾著，我也不知道該怎麼辦。
examples.english_sentence: Don't leave me hanging like this; I don't know what to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話今晚會出嚟，最後又唔來，完全畀我晾線。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 gam1 maan5 wui5 ceot1 lai4, zeoi6 hau6 jau6 m4 loi4, jyun4 cyun4 bei2 ngo5 loeng6 sin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說今晚會出來，最後又不來，完全把我晾著。
examples.english_sentence: He said he'd come tonight but didn't show up; he totally stood me up.

mandarin_meaning: 被放鴿子（尤指約吃飯時被放鴿子），被晾著、白等一場
english_meaning: to be stood up or left waiting (especially for a meal); to be left hanging and possibly hungry
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，指被人放鴿子、被約好見面或吃飯卻對方沒來，導致被晾著等候，有時強調因而肚子餓。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang verb meaning to be stood up or left waiting (often in the context of a meal), emphasizing being left hanging and sometimes getting hungry as a result.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我約咗佢食晏，結果俾佢晾肚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 joek3 zo2 keoi5 sik6 ngaan3, git3 gwo2 bei2 keoi5 loeng6 tou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我約了他吃午飯，結果被他放鴿子。
examples.english_sentence: I arranged to have lunch with him, but he stood me up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日晾人肚，約就要準時。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 loeng6 jan4 tou5, joek3 zau6 jiu3 zeon2 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要總是放別人鴿子，約好了就要準時。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep standing people up; if you make plans, be punctual.

mandarin_meaning: （被）放鴿子、被約會放鳥
english_meaning: to be stood up; to be left waiting (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，指約好見面或安排好活動時，對方未出現或故意讓你等，等於被放鴿子或被放鳥。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang verb meaning someone is left waiting or 'stood up' — e.g., an arranged meeting where the other person doesn't show up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚畀佢晾腳，等咗成個鐘佢都冇嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 bei2 keoi5 loeng6 goek3, dang2 zo2 seng4 go3 zung1 keoi5 dou1 mou5 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我被他放鴿子，等了整整一個小時他都沒來。
examples.english_sentence: He stood me up tonight; I waited a whole hour and he never came.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想畀人晾腳，出門前打個電話確認一下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 bei2 jan4 loeng6 goek3, ceot1 mun4 cin4 daa2 go3 din6 waa2 kok3 jing6 jat1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想被人放鴿子，出門前打個電話確認一下。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to be stood up; I'll call to confirm before going out.

mandarin_meaning: 晾衣服 / 晒衣服
english_meaning: to hang clothes out to dry
explanation_mandarin: 把洗净的衣服挂起来让风和阳光晾干。
explanation_english: To hang washed clothes up so they dry by air or sunlight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱洗完衫，依家出去晾衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 sai2 jyun4 saam1, ji1 gaa1 ceot1 heoi3 loeng3 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我剛剛洗完衣服，現在出去晾衣服。
examples.english_sentence: I just finished washing my clothes; I'm going out to hang them to dry now.

mandarin_meaning: 晾衣夾 / 衣夾
english_meaning: clothes peg; clothespin
explanation_mandarin: 指用來把衣物夾在晾衣繩或晾衣架上以便晾乾的小夾子，家居常見的生活用具。
explanation_english: A small clip used to fasten clothes to a clothesline or drying rack for drying; a common household clothes peg (clothespin).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我發現啲晾衫夾唔見咗，啲襪成日會畀風吹走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 faat3 jin6 di1 loeng3 saam1 gaap3 m4 gin3 zo2, di1 mat6 sing4 jat6 wui5 bei6 fung1 ceoi1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我發現衣夾不見了，襪子常常會被風吹走。
examples.english_sentence: I found the clothespins missing; the socks keep getting blown away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以幫我拎幾個晾衫夾落去曬啲衫？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 ling1 gei2 go3 loeng3 saam1 gaap3 lok6 heoi3 saai3 di1 saam1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可不可以幫我拿幾個衣夾去曬衣服？
examples.english_sentence: Can you help me bring a few clothespins to hang the clothes?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新買嗰啲晾衫夾好堅固，用幾年都冇問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 maai5 go2 di1 loeng3 saam1 gaap3 hou2 gin1 gu3, jung6 gei2 nin4 dou1 mou5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新買的衣夾很結實，用幾年都沒問題。
examples.english_sentence: The new clothespins are very sturdy; they can last for years without problems.

mandarin_meaning: 晾衣架；晒衣服用的架子
english_meaning: clothes drying rack; a rack used to hang and dry laundry
explanation_mandarin: 指用來晾晒衣物的架子，通常放在陽台或戶外。香港粵語口語常說「晾衫架」或「晒衫架」。
explanation_english: A rack used for drying clothes, typically placed on a balcony or outdoors. Commonly called '晾衫架' in Hong Kong Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲衫乾晒，快啲收返晾衫架啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 saam1 gon1 saai3, faai3 di1 sau1 faan1 loeng3 saam1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 衣服都干了，快把晾衣架收起来吧。
examples.english_sentence: The clothes are dry, quickly put the drying rack away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我新買咗個可摺嘅晾衫架，好方便喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 san1 maai5 zo2 go3 ho2 zip3 ge3 loeng3 saam1 gaa3, hou2 fong1 bin6 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我新买了一个可折叠的晾衣架，很方便。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a new foldable clothes rack — it's really convenient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣預報話聽日會落雨，唔好喺戶外晾衫架。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 jyu6 bou3 waa6 ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5, m4 hou2 hai2 wu6 ngoi6 loeng3 saam1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天气预报说明天会下雨，不要把晾衣架放在户外。
examples.english_sentence: The forecast says it'll rain tomorrow; don't leave the drying rack outside.

mandarin_meaning: 晾衣繩 / 曬衣繩
english_meaning: clothesline (rope used for hanging clothes to dry)
explanation_mandarin: 指用來晾曬衣物的繩子或繩索，常見於家居或陽台上。
explanation_english: A rope or line used to hang clothes for drying, commonly found at home or on balconies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要收埋晾衫繩上嘅衫，天開始落雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 sau1 maai4 loeng3 saam1 sing4 seong6 ge3 saam1, tin1 hoi1 ci2 lok6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們要把晾衣繩上的衣服收起來，天開始下雨了。
examples.english_sentence: We need to take in the clothes on the clothesline — it's starting to rain.

mandarin_meaning: （把衣物）晾起、挂起以便晾干
english_meaning: to hang up (clothes) to dry; to air (out)
explanation_mandarin: 指把已洗或潮濕的衣物掛起來讓其晾乾或通風。也可用於口語中表示把東西掛起或擺放起來晾放。
explanation_english: Refers to hanging washed or damp clothing up so they can dry or air out. In colloquial use it can also mean to hang or put things up to air.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啲衫已經洗咗，可以晾起啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 di1 saam1 ji5 ging1 sai2 zo2, ho2 ji5 loeng6 hei2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的衣服已经洗了，可以晾起来了。
examples.english_sentence: My clothes are already washed; you can hang them up to dry.

mandarin_meaning: 曉/晓（xiǎo）：明白、知道；破曉、天剛亮
english_meaning: to know; to understand; dawn (daybreak)
explanation_mandarin: 「暁」為「曉/晓」的異體字。常用義有兩個：一是動詞，表示明白、知道（如「曉得」）；二是名詞，表示天剛亮、破曉（如「天未曉」）。在中文書寫中常見為「曉」或簡化為「晓」。
explanation_english: “暁” is a variant form of 曉/晓. It has two common senses: (1) verb — to know or understand (as in 曉得); (2) noun — dawn or daybreak (as in 天未曉). In Chinese writing the standard forms are 曉 (traditional) or 晓 (simplified).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔曉點算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 hiu2 dim2 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不知道怎麼辦。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know what to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天未曉我已經起身跑步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 mei6 hiu2 ngo5 ji5 ging1 hei2 san1 paau2 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天還沒亮我已經起來跑步。
examples.english_sentence: I was already up and running before dawn.

mandarin_meaning: 温暖、暖和；多用于书面或文言，表示阳光或气候暖和
english_meaning: warm; mild (usually describing weather); often literary
explanation_mandarin: 表示天氣或陽光溫暖、和煦，常見於書面語或與其他字組合（如「暄煦」）使用。
explanation_english: Denotes warmth or mildness (often of weather or sunlight). It is commonly used in written or literary contexts and appears in compounds such as '暄煦'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢日天氣好暄，啱晒出街散步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 jat6 tin1 hei3 hou2 hyun1, ngaam1 saai3 ceot1 gaai1 saan3 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天天气很暖和，非常适合出去散步。
examples.english_sentence: The weather is very warm today, perfect for going out for a walk.

mandarin_meaning: 閒暇，空閒（書面語）
english_meaning: leisure; spare time; free
explanation_mandarin: 表示空閒的時間或處於空閒的狀態，常見於書面語或與「閒」組成「閒暇」。
explanation_english: Denotes spare time or being free; often literary and commonly appears in compounds like "閒暇" (leisure).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近份工好忙，冇乜閒暇放鬆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 fan6 gung1 hou2 mong4, mou5 mat1 haan4 haa6 fong3 sung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近工作很忙，沒什麼閒暇放鬆。
examples.english_sentence: Work has been busy lately; I haven't had much free time to relax.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇暇一陣幫我？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 haa6 jat1 zan6 bong1 ngo5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有沒有空/閒暇一下幫我？
examples.english_sentence: Do you have a moment to help me?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 利用閒暇時間學多啲廣東話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lei6 jung6 haan4 haa6 si4 gaan3 hok6 do1 di1 gwong2 dung1 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 利用閒暇時間多學一點廣東話。
examples.english_sentence: Use your spare time to learn a bit more Cantonese.

mandarin_meaning: 头晕；晕眩；昏倒
english_meaning: dizzy; faint; nauseous; to feel faint
explanation_mandarin: 表示感到頭腦不清、暈眩或有昏厥感覺，可用來描述暈眩（形容詞）或昏倒/感到暈（動詞）。此外也可用於暈船、暈車等情況。
explanation_english: Indicates feeling dizzy, faint, or nauseous. Can be used as an adjective to describe dizziness or as a verb to indicate becoming faint. Also used in compounds like 'seasick' or 'carsick'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我頭暈，要坐低休息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tau4 wan1, jiu3 co5 dai1 jau1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我头晕，要坐下休息。
examples.english_sentence: I'm dizzy; I need to sit down and rest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到個消息，暈咗一陣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teng1 dou3 go3 siu1 sik1, wan1 zo2 jat1 zan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他听到那个消息，晕了一下。
examples.english_sentence: He felt dizzy/stunned for a moment when he heard the news.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好易暈船，坐船嘅時候要食暈船藥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 ji6 wan1 syun4, co5 syun4 ge3 si4 hau6 jiu3 sik6 wan1 syun4 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很容易晕船，坐船的时候要吃晕船药。
examples.english_sentence: I get seasick easily; I need to take motion sickness medicine when I go on a boat.

mandarin_meaning: 昏倒；頭暈而倒下（口語）
english_meaning: to faint; to pass out (colloquial); to feel dizzy and collapse or nearly collapse
explanation_mandarin: 「暈低」是廣東話的口語用法，用來形容因頭暈、疲倦或身體不適而昏倒或差點昏倒的狀態。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to faint or nearly faint due to dizziness, weakness, or physical discomfort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺熱天行咗好耐，突然暈低咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jit6 tin1 haang4 zo2 hou2 noi6, dat6 syun4 wan1 dai1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在炎熱的天氣走了很久，突然暈倒了。
examples.english_sentence: He walked for a long time in the heat and suddenly fainted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 坐長途車我差啲暈低，因為冇嘢食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: co5 coeng4 tou4 ce1 ngo5 caa1 di1 wan1 dai1, jan1 wai6 mou5 je5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 坐長途車時我差點兒暈倒，因為沒吃東西。
examples.english_sentence: I almost fainted on the long bus ride because I hadn't eaten.

mandarin_meaning: 間歇性地頭暈；時不時感到暈眩
english_meaning: to feel dizzy off and on; to experience intermittent bouts of dizziness
explanation_mandarin: 口語廣東話表達，表示不時或間歇性地感到頭暈，通常形容輕微的暈眩發作或忽然感到頭暈。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to experience dizziness in spells or intermittently; used to describe brief, recurring episodes of lightheadedness or faintness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幾日我成日暈得一陣陣，可能係血壓有問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gei2 jat6 ngo5 seng4 jat6 wan1 dak1 jat1 zan6 zan6, ho2 nang4 hai6 hyut3 ngaat3 jau5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這幾天我老是時不時頭暈，可能是血壓有問題。
examples.english_sentence: I've been getting dizzy off and on lately; it might be a blood pressure problem.

mandarin_meaning: 暈頭轉向、手足無措、被事情弄得非常混亂或不知所措（口語）
english_meaning: to be completely stunned, dazed, or overwhelmed; to be confused and not know what to do (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「暈晒大浪」是廣東話口語說法，字面意為被大浪弄到暈，常用來形容因突發事情、資訊過多或複雜情況而感到頭腦混亂、迷惘或不知所措。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression literally meaning 'dizzy from big waves.' It describes feeling overwhelmed, dazed, or confused by sudden events or an overload of information, leaving one unsure what to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 收到咁多新資料，我一陣間真係暈晒大浪，唔知由邊度開始做起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau1 dou3 gam2 do1 san1 zi1 liu6, ngo5 jat1 zan6 gaan1 zan1 hai6 wan4 saai3 daai6 long6, m4 zi1 jau4 bin1 dou6 hoi1 ci2 zou6 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 收到這麼多新資料，我一時間真的暈到不知從哪裡開始做起。
examples.english_sentence: Having received so much new information, I'm completely overwhelmed and don't know where to start.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上次應聘嗰啲問題太多，我面試完出嚟就覺得暈晒大浪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng6 ci3 jing3 pan3 go2 di1 man6 tai4 taai3 do1, ngo5 min6 si3 jyun4 ceot1 lai4 zau6 gok3 dak1 wan4 saai3 daai6 long6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上次應聘時問題太多，面試結束出來我就覺得暈頭轉向。
examples.english_sentence: The last job interview had so many questions; after it I felt completely dazed.

mandarin_meaning: 晕船（因海浪搖晃而頭暈、想吐）
english_meaning: seasick; motion sickness caused by the rocking of a boat
explanation_mandarin: 指在船上或遇到海浪晃動時感到頭暈、噁心甚至嘔吐的狀態。
explanation_english: Refers to feeling dizzy, nauseous, or vomiting due to the motion of waves while on a boat (seasickness).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一上船就暈浪，成日想嘔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 soeng5 syun4 zau6 wan4 long6, seng4 jat6 soeng2 au2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一上船就晕船，老是想吐。
examples.english_sentence: I get seasick as soon as I get on the boat; I keep wanting to vomit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排海面好唔穩，大家記得攞暈浪藥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 hoi2 min6 hou2 m4 wan2, daai6 gaa1 gei3 dak1 lo2 wan4 long6 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近海面很不穩，大家記得帶暈船藥。
examples.english_sentence: The sea's been rough lately; everyone remember to bring seasickness pills.

mandarin_meaning: 晕船药；用于预防或治疗因船只摇晃而引起的眩晕的药丸
english_meaning: seasickness pill; medication used to prevent or treat motion sickness on boats
explanation_mandarin: 指用來預防或治療暈船（在海上或乘船時因船體搖晃引起的頭暈、噁心等症狀）的藥丸。口語中常與「暈船藥」互換使用。
explanation_english: Refers to pills taken to prevent or treat seasickness (symptoms like dizziness or nausea caused by a boat's motion). Colloquially interchangeable with 'seasickness pills' or 'motion-sickness medication'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出海之前記得帶埋暈浪丸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 hoi2 zi1 cin4 gei3 dak1 daai3 maai4 wan6 long6 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出海之前記得帶上晕船药。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to bring seasickness pills before going out to sea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽一上船就會暈浪，佢成日要食暈浪丸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 jat1 soeng5 syun4 zau6 wui5 wan6 long6, keoi5 sing4 jat6 jiu3 sik6 wan6 long6 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈一上船就会晕船，她经常要吃晕船药。
examples.english_sentence: My mom gets seasick as soon as she gets on a boat; she often needs to take motion-sickness pills.

mandarin_meaning: 眩晕 / 头晕
english_meaning: dizzy; vertigo; feeling lightheaded
explanation_mandarin: 表示感到头昏、头晕或有眩晕的感觉，有时接近晕厥或恶心的不适感。
explanation_english: Describes the sensation of dizziness or vertigo — feeling lightheaded, unsteady, or nauseous; sometimes close to fainting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家覺得有啲暈眩，想坐低休息下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 gok3 dak1 jau5 di1 wan1 hyun6, soeng2 co5 dai1 jau1 sik1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我现在觉得有点头晕，想坐下休息一下。
examples.english_sentence: I feel a bit dizzy right now; I want to sit down and rest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 坐船成日暈眩，好辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: co5 syun4 sing4 jat6 wan1 hyun6, hou2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 坐船总是头晕，很难受。
examples.english_sentence: I always get dizzy on boats; it's really unpleasant.

mandarin_meaning: 晕船（因船隻搖晃而產生的暈眩、噁心）
english_meaning: seasick; motion sickness caused by a boat's motion
explanation_mandarin: 指因乘船時船身搖晃而引起的頭暈、噁心等不適，等同普通話的“晕船”。
explanation_english: Refers to the dizziness and nausea caused by the motion of a boat; equivalent to the Mandarin term '晕船' (seasickness).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一坐船就會暈船浪，所以上船前要食藥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 co5 syun4 zau6 wui5 wan6 syun4 long6, so2 ji5 soeng5 syun4 cin4 jiu3 sik6 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一坐船就会晕船，所以上船前要吃药。
examples.english_sentence: I get seasick as soon as I board a boat, so I need to take medicine before boarding.

mandarin_meaning: 晕车 (yùn chē)
english_meaning: carsickness; motion sickness (feeling dizzy/nauseous while traveling)
explanation_mandarin: 指乘坐交通工具（如汽车、巴士、船等）时，由于内耳平衡受影响而出现头晕、恶心、想吐等不适反应，也可作动词使用（如“我晕车”）。
explanation_english: Refers to the dizziness, nausea, or vomiting experienced while traveling in a vehicle (car, bus, boat, etc.) due to disturbances in the inner ear/balance system. Can be used as a verb or adjective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我搭車好易暈車，要食止暈藥先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daap3 ce1 hou2 ji6 wan1 ce1, jiu3 sik6 zi2 wan1 joek6 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我坐车很容易晕车，需要吃止晕药才好一些。
examples.english_sentence: I get carsick easily when I ride in vehicles; I need to take motion sickness medicine to feel better.

mandarin_meaning: 晕车发作 / 晕动病的阵发性感觉
english_meaning: a bout or wave of motion sickness (carsickness/seasickness); episodic nausea/dizziness from motion
explanation_mandarin: 表示因交通工具或晃动而出现的阵发性晕眩、恶心等不适感，口语用法。
explanation_english: Refers to episodic episodes of dizziness and nausea caused by motion (e.g., in a car, bus, or boat). Colloquial usage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一坐車就會有暈車浪，成日要食暈車藥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 co5 ce1 zau6 wui5 jau5 wan1 ce1 long6, seng4 jat6 jiu3 sik6 wan1 ce1 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一坐车就会晕车发作，经常要吃晕车药。
examples.english_sentence: I get bouts of carsickness as soon as I sit in a vehicle; I often need to take motion-sickness medicine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 海上顛簸會令到啲人有暈車浪，唔少人要靠藥或望遠方緩解。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi2 soeng5 din1 bo3 wui5 ling6 dou3 di1 jan4 jau5 wan1 ce1 long6, m4 siu2 jan4 jiu3 haau3 joek6 waak6 mong6 jyun5 fong1 wun6 gaai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 海上颠簸会让一些人出现晕车/晕船的症状，很多人需要靠药物或望远方缓解。
examples.english_sentence: Rough seas can cause some people to experience waves of motion sickness; many rely on medication or looking at the horizon to ease it.

mandarin_meaning: 頭暈、臉紅或微微發暈的狀態（口語）
english_meaning: dizzy and flushed; feeling woozy or lightheaded (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: “暈酡酡”是廣東話口語，形容人感到頭暈、微微發暈，或面色泛紅、血液上湧的感覺，常用於描述短暫的不適狀態。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial adjective describing a state of feeling dizzy or woozy, often accompanied by a flushed face or lightheadedness; used for brief, mild episodes of discomfort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家有啲暈酡酡，可能係血糖低。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 jau5 di1 wan1 to4 to4, ho2 nang4 hai6 hyut3 tong4 dai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在有點暈酡酡，可能是血糖低。
examples.english_sentence: I'm feeling a bit woozy and flushed right now; it might be low blood sugar.

mandarin_meaning: 頭暈、昏沉、迷糊（口語）
english_meaning: dizzy, lightheaded, dazed; feeling groggy or disoriented (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 口語廣東話詞彙，用來形容因天熱、暈車、酒醉、疲勞等引起的頭暈、昏沉或精神不清的狀態，也可表示短暫的迷糊或頭腦不清楚。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term used to describe feeling dizzy, lightheaded, groggy, or dazed — often caused by heat, motion sickness, alcohol, fatigue, etc. It can also imply a brief state of confusion or muddled thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日太熱，我行咗一陣就覺得有啲暈陀陀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 taai3 jit6, ngo5 haang4 zo2 jat1 zan6 zau6 gok3 dak1 jau5 di1 wan1 to4 to4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天太熱，我走了一會就覺得有點頭暈。
examples.english_sentence: It's so hot today; after walking for a bit I felt a bit dizzy.

mandarin_meaning: 辉（光辉、光彩）
english_meaning: radiance; brilliance; glow; sunshine
explanation_mandarin: 表示光亮、光辉、光彩，常用于如「晨暉」等词汇，亦见于人名或书面语，带有较文雅的色彩。
explanation_english: Refers to brightness, radiance, or glow (e.g., morning glow). Often found in literary expressions or names and carries an elegant tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 晨暉照耀住成個村莊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san4 fai1 ziu3 jiu6 zyu6 sing4 go3 cyun1 zong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晨辉照耀着整个村庄。
examples.english_sentence: The morning glow lit up the whole village.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅成就令家族帶嚟光暉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing4 zau6 ling6 gaa1 zuk6 daai3 lai4 gwong1 fai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的成就为家族带来了光辉。
examples.english_sentence: His achievements brought glory to the family.

mandarin_meaning: （古字）相當於「若」，用於文言，表示「好像、似乎、如果」
english_meaning: (archaic) equivalent to the classical character '若' meaning 'as if', 'seem', or 'if' in literary contexts
explanation_mandarin: 暏為一個罕見或古字，常作「若」的通用或異體字，用於文言文，表示類似、好像或假設的意思，現代漢語中不常用。
explanation_english: 暏 is a rare/archaic character used as a variant of 若 in classical Chinese. It conveys meanings like 'as if', 'seem', or the conditional 'if' in literary texts. Not used commonly in modern spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇古文入面見到個字寫做「暏」，係「若」嘅古字，意思係「好似 / 若是」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 gu2 man4 jap6 min6 gin3 dou3 go3 zi6 se2 zou6 'joek6', hai6 'joek6' ge3 gu2 zi6, ji3 si1 hai6 'hou2 ci5' / 'joek6 si6'.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在這篇古文裡看到字寫作「暏」，是「若」的古字，意思是「好像／如果」。
examples.english_sentence: In this classical text I saw the character "暏", which is an archaic form of "若", meaning "as if / if".

mandarin_meaning: 暑（夏季的炎热；暑期，夏天的假期）
english_meaning: summer heat; summer (period); used in compounds like 'summer vacation'
explanation_mandarin: 「暑」表示夏季的炎热，也常出現在複合詞中，如「暑假」「暑期」，指夏天的期間或假期。
explanation_english: Refers to the heat of summer or the summer period. Often used in compounds such as 'summer vacation' (暑假).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 暑假快到，我哋要計劃去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syu2 gaa3 faai3 dou3, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gai3 waak6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 暑假快到了，我們要計劃去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: Summer vacation is coming soon; we should plan to travel.

mandarin_meaning: 暑假 (shǔjià)
english_meaning: summer vacation; summer holiday
explanation_mandarin: 學校或學生在夏季放假的期間，通常指七、八月的假期。
explanation_english: The vacation period during summer, typically the school break in July and August.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我暑假會返屋企探父母。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 syu2 gaa3 wui5 faan1 uk1 kei2 taam3 fu6 mou5。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我暑假會回家探望父母。
examples.english_sentence: I'll go home to visit my parents during summer vacation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年暑假我哋打算去日本旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 syu2 gaa3 ngo5 dei6 daa2 syun3 heoi3 jat6 bun2 leoi5 hang4。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年暑假我們打算去日本旅行。
examples.english_sentence: This summer vacation we're planning to travel to Japan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校暑假有兩個月。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 syu2 gaa3 jau5 loeng5 go3 jyut6。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學校的暑假有兩個月。
examples.english_sentence: The school's summer vacation lasts two months.

mandarin_meaning: 暑期（暑假期間；夏季的一段時間）
english_meaning: summer period; summer vacation; summer term
explanation_mandarin: 指夏天的一段時間，常用來表示學校放暑假的那段期間或夏季的學期/假期。
explanation_english: Refers to the summer period, commonly used for the school summer vacation or the summer term/season.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 暑期我打算去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syu2 kei4 ngo5 daa2 syun3 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 暑假我打算去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I plan to travel during the summer vacation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校暑期有夏令營，好多學生會參加。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 syu2 kei4 jau5 haa6 ling6 jing4, hou2 do1 hok6 saang1 wui5 caam1 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学校暑期有夏令营，很多学生会参加。
examples.english_sentence: The school has summer camps during the summer, and many students join.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你暑期有冇打工？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 syu2 kei4 jau5 mou5 daa2 gung1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你暑假有沒有打工？
examples.english_sentence: Are you working during the summer vacation?

mandarin_meaning: 暑期工作（暑假期間臨時或兼職的工作）
english_meaning: summer job (temporary or part-time work during the summer vacation)
explanation_mandarin: 指學生或年輕人在暑假期間從事的臨時或兼職工作，通常用來賺取零用錢或累積工作經驗。
explanation_english: Refers to temporary or part-time work that students or young people do during the summer vacation, often to earn pocket money or gain work experience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今年暑假想搵暑期工賺吓錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 nin4 syu2 gaa3 soeng2 wan2 syu2 kei4 gung1 zyun6 haa5 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今年暑假想找暑期工作賺點錢。
examples.english_sentence: I want to find a summer job this vacation to earn some money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打暑期工可以學到同事相處嘅技巧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 syu2 kei4 gung1 ho2 ji5 hok6 dou3 tung4 si6 soeng1 cyu5 ge3 gei6 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做暑期工作可以學到與同事相處的技巧。
examples.english_sentence: Doing a summer job can teach you skills in getting along with coworkers.

mandarin_meaning: 暑期班 (shǔqī bān) — 暑假期间举办的课程或班级
english_meaning: summer class / summer school (short-term courses held during the summer vacation)
explanation_mandarin: 指在暑假期间举办的短期课程或班级，通常由学校、补习社或培训机构提供，涵盖学科学习、才艺训练或兴趣班等。
explanation_english: Refers to short-term courses or classes held during the summer vacation, typically offered by schools, tutoring centers, or training institutions; can include academic lessons, skill training, or interest classes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今年暑期班會修英文，想提升會話能力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 nin4 syu2 kei4 baan1 wui6 sau1 jing1 man4, soeng2 tai4 sing1 wui6 waa6 nang4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今年暑期班会修英文，想提升会话能力。
examples.english_sentence: I'm taking an English course in the summer class this year to improve my conversational skills.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 暑期班通常由學校或補習社主辦，課程有學術和興趣班兩類。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syu2 kei4 baan1 tung1 soeng4 jau4 hok6 haau6 waak6 bou2 zaap6 se5 zyu2 baan6, fo3 cing4 jau5 hok6 seot6 wo4 hing3 ceoi3 baan1 loeng5 leoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 暑期班通常由学校或补习社主办，课程有学术和兴趣班两类。
examples.english_sentence: Summer classes are usually run by schools or tutoring centers, with both academic and interest-based programs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔鍾意去夏令營，但有啲家長會選擇讓小朋友上暑期班補習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 zung1 ji3 heoi3 haa6 ling6 jing4, daan6 jau5 di1 gaa1 zoeng2 wui5 syun2 zaak6 joeng6 siu2 pang4 jau5 seong5 syu2 kei4 baan1 bou2 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友喜欢去夏令营，但有些家长会选择让孩子上暑期班补习。
