examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在大学里加入了一个书院，认识了不少朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He joined a college (residential college) at the university and met many friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古代嘅書院係教授儒學嘅地方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 doi6 ge3 syu1 jyun2 hai6 gaau3 sau6 jyu4 hok6 ge3 dei6 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代的书院是教授儒学的地方。
examples.english_sentence: In ancient times, shuyuan were places that taught Confucianism.

mandarin_meaning: 书面；以书写或正式文件形式的
english_meaning: in writing; written (as opposed to oral); written document/form
explanation_mandarin: 指以書寫、文件或正式文字形式呈現的內容或形式，常用於區別口頭表達。
explanation_english: Refers to something presented in written form (documents or formal writing), often used to distinguish from oral statements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要把申請表以書面遞交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 baa2 san1 cing2 biu2 ji5 syu1 min6 dai6 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要把申请表以书面递交。
examples.english_sentence: You need to submit the application form in writing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 口頭承諾唔算數，最好有書面證明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hau2 tau4 sing4 nok6 m4 syun3 sou3, zeoi3 hou2 jau5 syu1 min6 zing3 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 口头承诺不算数，最好有书面证明。
examples.english_sentence: Oral promises don't count; it's best to have written proof.

mandarin_meaning: 书面语
english_meaning: written language; written/formal register
explanation_mandarin: 指以書寫形式出現或在正式場合使用的語體，與口語相對，通常較書面化、書面語法與詞彙較正式。
explanation_english: Refers to the form of language used in writing or in formal contexts, as opposed to spoken language; typically more formal in grammar and vocabulary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇文章用嘅係書面語，唔係口語。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 man4 zoeng1 jung6 ge3 hai6 syu1min6jyu5, m4 hai6 hau2jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这篇文章使用的是书面语，不是口语。
examples.english_sentence: This article uses written language, not spoken language.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺公文入面要用正式嘅書面語，唔可以太口語化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gung1 man4 jap6 min6 jiu3 jung6 zing3sik1 ge3 syu1min6jyu5, m4 ho2ji5 taai3 hau2jyu5 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在公文里面要使用正式的书面语，不能太口语化。
examples.english_sentence: In official documents you must use formal written language; it shouldn't be too colloquial.

mandarin_meaning: 书馆（通常指图书馆/书房）
english_meaning: library; reading room; study (older usage)
explanation_mandarin: 指供公众或特定群体借阅、阅读书籍和资料的场所，如图书馆；在某些语境下也可指书房或学舍。
explanation_english: Refers to a place where books and materials are kept for reading or borrowing (i.e., a library). In some contexts it can also mean a study room or academy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋星期六去書館溫習啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sing1 kei4 luk6 heoi3 syu1 gun2 wan1 zaap6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们星期六去书馆复习吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the library to study on Saturday.

mandarin_meaning: 書斋（書房、讀書或寫作的房間）
english_meaning: study; private study room used for reading, writing, or research
explanation_mandarin: 書齋指專門用來看書、研究或寫作的房間或空間，常用來形容學者、作家或有專用書房的人的私人學習與寫作場所。
explanation_english: A room or space dedicated to reading, study, writing, or research. Often refers to a private study used by a scholar, writer, or someone who keeps a dedicated room for work and study.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺書齋寫功課，唔好吵我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 syu1 zaai1 se2 gung1 fo3, m4 hou2 caau2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在書齋寫功課，不要吵我。
examples.english_sentence: I'm doing homework in the study; don't disturb me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有間靚嘅書齋，成日喺度寫小說。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 gaan1 leng3 ge3 syu1 zaai1, sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 se2 siu2 syut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有一間漂亮的書斋，經常在那裡寫小說。
examples.english_sentence: He has a nice study and often writes novels there.

mandarin_meaning: （姓氏）曹；古代亦指官職、部門或軍隊中的班、隊
english_meaning: The surname Cao; historically an official post, a department, or a corps/squad
explanation_mandarin: 漢字「曹」常作為姓氏使用，讀作cáo；在古代文獻中也可指官職、部門或軍隊中的小隊、班次等。
explanation_english: The character "曹" is commonly used as the surname Cao (cáo). Historically it also referred to an official post, a department, or a military corps/squad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 曹先生今日唔喺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cou4 sin1saang1 gam1jat6 m4 hai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 曹先生今天不在。
examples.english_sentence: Mr. Cao is not here today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋學校有位學生姓曹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hok6 haau6 jau5 wai6 hok6 saang1 sing3 cou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们学校有位学生姓曹。
examples.english_sentence: There is a student surnamed Cao at our school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 曹操係三國時代嘅一位著名軍閥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cou4 cou1 hai6 saam1 gwok3 si4doi6 ge3 jat1 wai6 zoek3 ming4 gwan1 fat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 曹操是三国时代的一位著名军阀。
examples.english_sentence: Cao Cao was a famous warlord during the Three Kingdoms period.

mandarin_meaning: 曹操（Cáo Cāo），三国时期的著名军阀、政治家。
english_meaning: Cao Cao, a famous warlord and statesman of the Three Kingdoms period.
explanation_mandarin: 曹操是三国时期的重要历史人物，既是军事领袖也是政治家。在现代常出现在历史、小说、影视和游戏中。少数口语或网络用法会把“曹操”用于戏谑或作为对“操”字的委婉替代，但主要含义仍为人名。
explanation_english: Cao Cao is a major historical figure from the Three Kingdoms era, both a military leader and politician. He frequently appears in history, literature, film and games. Occasionally the name is playfully or euphemistically used in informal contexts, but its primary meaning is a personal name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 曹操係三國時代嘅一位軍閥，喺歷史上好有爭議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cou4 cou1 hai6 saam1 gwok3 si4 doi6 ge3 jat1 wai2 gwan1 fat6, hai2 lik6 si2 soeng6 hou2 jau5 zang1 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 曹操是三国时代的一位军阀，在历史上很有争议。
examples.english_sentence: Cao Cao was a warlord of the Three Kingdoms period and is very controversial in history.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺手機遊戲入面揀咗曹操做主將，佢好勁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai6 sau2 gei1 jau4 hei3 jap6 min6 gaan2 zo2 cou4 cou1 zou6 zyu2 zoeng3, keoi5 hou2 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在手机游戏里选了曹操做主将，他很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: I picked Cao Cao as my main general in the mobile game; he's very strong.

cantonese: 曹操都有知心友，關公亦有對頭人
jyutping: cou4 cou1 dou1 jau5 zi1 sam1 jau5, gwaan1 gung1 jik6 jau5 deoi3 tau4 jan4
mandarin_meaning: 即便是像曹操這樣有爭議的人也會有知心朋友，像關公這樣受尊崇的人也會有對頭。比喻任何人都有支持者與反對者，世事難以一概而論。
english_meaning: Even Cao Cao has confidants and even Guan Yu has rivals — meaning everyone has supporters and opponents; no one is universally liked or disliked.
explanation_mandarin: 用曹操（被視為奸雄）和關公（被視為義士）作對比，說明再受爭議或受敬重的人，也會有人支持或反對，強調人際關係與評價的複雜性。
explanation_english: Uses the contrast between Cao Cao (often seen as a villain) and Guan Yu (often seen as a hero) to show that even controversial or respected figures have both friends and enemies — highlighting the complexity of people's relationships and reputations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁灰心，曹操都有知心友，關公亦有對頭人，大家都有支持者同反對者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 fui1 sam1, cou4 cou1 dou1 jau5 zi1 sam1 jau5, gwaan1 gung1 jik6 jau5 deoi3 tau4 jan4, daai6 gaa1 dou1 jau5 zi1 ci4 ze2 tung4 faan2 deoi3 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要這麼灰心，曹操都有知心友，關公亦有對頭人，大家都有支持者和反對者。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so discouraged — even Cao Cao has confidants and even Guan Yu has rivals; everyone has supporters and opponents.

cantonese: 曹操都有知心友，關公都有對頭人
jyutping: cou4 cou1 dou1 jau5 zi1 sam1 jau5, gwaan1 gung1 dou1 jau5 deoi3 tau4 jan4
mandarin_meaning: 即使是像曹操這樣的人也有知心朋友，像關公這樣的人也有對頭（敵人），意指人人都有支持者和反對者，事物並非絕對。
english_meaning: Even Cao Cao has confidants and even Guan Yu has adversaries — meaning everyone has supporters and opponents; nothing is absolute.
explanation_mandarin: 用歷史人物作比喻，說明即便是有名或被尊崇的人，也會有朋友和敵人，強調事物不可能完全一邊倒，提醒人們不要絕對化判斷。
explanation_english: Using historical figures as examples, this saying points out that even famous or revered people have friends and foes. It emphasizes that things are rarely absolute and warns against black-and-white judgments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好覺得世界上一定係非黑即白，曹操都有知心友，關公都有對頭人，冇咩係絕對嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gok3 dak1 sai3 gaai3 soeng6 jat1 ding6 hai6 fei1 hak1 zik1 baak6, cou4 cou1 dou1 jau5 zi1 sam1 jau5, gwaan1 gung1 dou1 jau5 deoi3 tau4 jan4, mou5 me1 hai6 zyut6 deoi3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要以為世界上非黑即白，曹操都有知心友，關公都有對頭人，沒什麼是絕對的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think the world is black and white; even Cao Cao has confidants and Guan Yu has adversaries — nothing is absolute.

mandarin_meaning: 通常不是常見的粵語詞彙，多見作人名（姓氏曹，名白），普通話讀作「Cáo Bái」。在粵語中並無廣泛固定的慣用義，如見到多半為人名或罕見用法。
english_meaning: Not a common Cantonese lexical item; most often appears as a personal name (surname Cáo, given name Bái). No widespread idiomatic meaning in Cantonese; if used, it's typically a proper name or a rare/region-specific term.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 專有名詞（人名）／罕見詞語
partOfSpeech_english: proper noun (personal name) / rare lexical item
explanation_mandarin: 「曹白」作為詞語在粵語中並不常見，若出現多為人名，讀音為 cou4 baak6（普通話：Cáo Bái）。若在某些地區或圈子中另有特殊含義，屬於地域性或少數用法，需根據語境判斷。
explanation_english: The sequence "曹白" is not a common Cantonese lexical item; it most frequently appears as a personal name (surname Cáo, given name Bái) pronounced cou4 baak6. If encountered with a different meaning, it is likely regionally or contextually specific and should be interpreted from context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 曹白就係我細個時嘅鄰居。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cou4 baak6 zau6 hai6 ngo5 sai3 go3 si4 ge3 leon4 geoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 曹白就是我小時候的鄰居。
examples.english_sentence: Cao Bai was my neighbor when I was a child.

mandarin_meaning: 曼 (màn)：優美、延長；亦用作人名或地名成分（如曼谷）
english_meaning: graceful; extended/long; also used as an element in names (e.g., Bangkok)
explanation_mandarin: “曼”常用以形容姿態優美、延展或遼闊，也常見於人名、地名及書面語中表示延伸之意。
explanation_english: “曼” denotes graceful appearance or something extended/long; frequently appears in personal and place names and in literary usage to indicate extension.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個舞姿好曼妙，吸引晒全場嘅目光。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 mou5 zi1 hou2 maan6 miu6, kap1 jan5 saai3 cyun4 coeng4 ge3 muk6 gwong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的舞姿很曼妙，吸引了全場的目光。
examples.english_sentence: Her dancing is very graceful, attracting everyone's attention.

mandarin_meaning: 曼彻斯特（城）；常指曼彻斯特城足球俱乐部
english_meaning: Manchester (City); commonly refers to Manchester City football club
explanation_mandarin: 「曼城」在華語和粵語媒體中常用來指英格蘭的曼徹斯特城（Manchester City）足球俱樂部，有時也可簡稱曼徹斯特這個城市。
explanation_english: "曼城" is commonly used to refer to Manchester City (the football club) in Chinese-language media; it can also be a short form for the city of Manchester.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今季曼城踢得好勁，成日都贏波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 gwai3 maan6 sing4 tek3 dak1 hou2 ging6, sing4 jat6 dou1 jing4 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 本赛季曼城踢得很强，经常赢球。
examples.english_sentence: This season Manchester City plays very well; they win matches all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月去曼城旅行，想去睇球場同球隊嘅博物館。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 heoi3 maan6 sing4 leoi5 hang4, soeng2 heoi3 tai2 kau4 coeng4 tung4 kau4 deoi6 ge3 bok3 mat6 gun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月去曼彻斯特旅行，想去看看球场和俱乐部的博物馆。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Manchester next month; I want to visit the stadium and the club museum.

mandarin_meaning: 曼德拉（納爾遜·曼德拉），南非反種族隔離運動領袖，曾任南非總統；亦常用於「曼德拉效應」一詞
english_meaning: Mandela (Nelson Mandela), South African anti-apartheid leader and former president; also referenced in 'Mandela effect'
explanation_mandarin: 指納爾遜·曼德拉（Nelson Mandela），南非反種族隔離運動的領袖，曾被關押多年，後成為南非首位黑人總統。詞語亦出現在「曼德拉效應」等用法中。
explanation_english: Refers to Nelson Mandela, the South African anti-apartheid leader who was imprisoned for many years and later became South Africa's first black president. The name also appears in contexts like the 'Mandela effect'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 曼德拉係南非嘅反種族隔離運動領袖，佢曾經入獄二十七年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maan6 dak1 laai1 hai6 naam4 fei1 ge3 faan2 zung2 zuk6 gaak3 lei4 wan6 dung6 ling5 zau6, keoi5 cang4 ging1 jap6 juk6 ji6 sap6 cat1 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 曼德拉是南非的反種族隔離運動領袖，他曾被關進監獄二十七年。
examples.english_sentence: Mandela was a leader of South Africa's anti-apartheid movement; he was imprisoned for 27 years.

mandarin_meaning: 曼彻斯特联（足球俱乐部，简称曼联）
english_meaning: Manchester United (football club)
explanation_mandarin: 指英格兰的曼彻斯特联足球俱乐部，常用于口语和媒体称呼。
explanation_english: Refers to the English football club Manchester United; commonly used in speech and media.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意睇曼聯嘅波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 tai2 maan6 lyun4 ge3 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢看曼联的比赛。
examples.english_sentence: I like watching Manchester United's matches.

mandarin_meaning: 曼谷（泰国首都）
english_meaning: Bangkok (capital city of Thailand)
explanation_mandarin: 曼谷是泰国的首都和最大城市，為重要的政治、經濟與旅遊中心。
explanation_english: Bangkok, the capital and largest city of Thailand, an important political, economic, and tourist center.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月會去曼谷旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 maan6 guk1 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月会去曼谷旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Bangkok next month.

mandarin_meaning: 曾（曾经）
english_meaning: once; formerly; previously
explanation_mandarin: 表示过去发生过某事，相当于“曾、曾经”，多用于书面或正式语体。注意该字在作姓氏时有不同粤读（如「曾」作姓氏常读作 zang1）。
explanation_english: Indicates that something happened in the past — equivalent to 'once' or 'formerly'. Common in written/formal contexts. Note: as a surname the character can have a different Cantonese reading (e.g. zang1).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我曽經喺香港住過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cang4 ging1 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 zyu6 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我曾经在香港住过。
examples.english_sentence: I once lived in Hong Kong.

mandarin_meaning: 曾（céng / Zēng）：作副词时表示“曾经、以前”；也可作姓氏（曾，拼音 Zēng）。
english_meaning: Zeng / Tsang (surname); once, formerly, ever (as an adverb, often in 曾經).
explanation_mandarin: “曾”作副词常与“曾經”连用，表示过去发生过的事情（例如“我曾經去過”）；作姓氏时读作“Zēng”。在粤语中有两个常见读音：cang4（用于曾經）和zang1（作为姓氏）。
explanation_english: As an adverb, 曾 (commonly in 曾經) means 'once' or 'ever' to indicate past occurrence. It is also a Chinese surname (Zeng/Tsang). In Cantonese it has two readings: cang4 (in 曾經) and zang1 (surname).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我曾經去過香港。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cang4 ging1 heoi3 gwo3 hoeng1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我曾经去过香港。
examples.english_sentence: I have been to Hong Kong before.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 曾先生今日唔喺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zang1 sin1 saang1 gam1 jat6 m4 hai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 曾先生今天不在。
examples.english_sentence: Mr. Tsang is not here today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你曾經試過呢樣嘢未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 cang4 ging1 si3 gwo3 ni1 joeng6 je5 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你曾经试过这件事吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you ever tried this?

mandarin_meaning: 曾孫 (zēngsūn) - 曾祖父母的孫子的子嗣，通常指曾孫（男性）
english_meaning: great-grandson (the son of one's grandson)
explanation_mandarin: 指孫輩中的下一代，即孫的兒子或女兒（傳統上「曾孫」多指男性，即曾祖父母的曾孫）。
explanation_english: Refers to the descendant one generation after a grandson — the grandson's child; traditionally used to mean a great-grandson (male).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿公今日見到佢嘅曾孫，好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 gung1 gam1 jat6 gin3 dou3 keoi5 ge3 cang4 syun1, hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我阿公今天見到他的曾孫，很高興。
examples.english_sentence: My grandfather was very happy to see his great-grandson today.

mandarin_meaning: 曾孙女 (zēng sūn nǚ)
english_meaning: great-granddaughter
explanation_mandarin: 指孫子的女兒，即家族中的曾孫輩的女性後代。
explanation_english: The daughter of one's grandson; a female great-grandchild (great-granddaughter).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿婆啱啱見到佢嘅曾孫女，好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 po4 ngaam1 ngaam1 gin3 dou2 keoi5 ge3 cang4 syun1 neoi5, hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我奶奶剛剛見到她的曾孫女，很高興。
examples.english_sentence: My grandma just saw her great-granddaughter and was very happy.

mandarin_meaning: 曾孙女 (zēngsūn nǚ)
english_meaning: great-granddaughter (the female great-grandchild)
explanation_mandarin: 指家族中曾孫的女性，即孫子或孫女的女兒，屬於曾祖父母一輩的曾孫女。
explanation_english: Refers to the female great-grandchild — the daughter of one's grandson or granddaughter (a great-granddaughter in family relationships).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿公話佢終於有一個曾孫女兒，成個家都好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 gung1 waa6 keoi5 zung1 jyu1 jau5 jat1 go3 cang4 syun1 neoi5 ji4, seng4 go3 gaa1 dou1 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爺爺說他終於有了一個曾孫女，整個家都很高興。
examples.english_sentence: Grandpa said he finally has a great-granddaughter; the whole family is very happy.

mandarin_meaning: 曾几何时（zēng jǐ hé shí），表示過去某個時候，常用以強調曾經的情況已經改變或不復存在。
english_meaning: Once; at one time; not long ago — an idiomatic expression used to indicate a past state or time that has since changed.
explanation_mandarin: 「曾幾何時」為書面語或文言色彩較重的成語，用來指出過去某段時間曾經如此，現在已不同或已變化。
explanation_english: A literary idiom meaning 'once' or 'at one time', used to point out that something used to be the case but has since changed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 曾幾何時，我哋都仲係學生，依家各自有穩定嘅工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cang4 gei2 ho4 si4, ngo5 dei6 dou1 zung6 hai6 hok6 saang1, ji1 gaa1 gok3 zi6 jau5 wan2 ding6 ge3 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 曾几何时，我们都还是学生，现在各自有了稳定的工作。
examples.english_sentence: Once, we were all students; now each of us has a steady job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 曾幾何時，呢條街好熱鬧，而家已經冷清晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cang4 gei2 ho4 si4, ni1 tiu4 gaai1 hou2 jit6 naau6, ji1 gaa1 ji5 ging1 laang5 cing1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 曾几何时，这条街很热闹，而现在已经冷清了。
examples.english_sentence: At one time, this street was bustling; now it's deserted.

mandarin_meaning: 曾祖母（zēng zǔ mǔ）：曾祖母，指祖父或祖母的母親，常指曾祖輩（若要特指外方則稱外曾祖母）
english_meaning: great-grandmother (the mother of one's grandfather or grandmother)
explanation_mandarin: 血親稱謂，表示上兩代的女性長輩（即祖父母的母親）。若特指母系一方，可稱外曾祖母。
explanation_english: A kinship term for the female ancestor two generations above (the mother of one's grandparent). If specifying the maternal side, use 'maternal great-grandmother'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嘅曾祖母今年九十歲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ge3 cang4 zou2 mou5 gam1 nin4 gau2 sap6 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的曾祖母今年九十岁。
examples.english_sentence: My great-grandmother is ninety years old this year.

mandarin_meaning: 曾祖父（父母的祖父），即英文的 great-grandfather
english_meaning: great-grandfather (the father of one's grandfather)
explanation_mandarin: 指家族中比祖父再上一代的男性長輩，通常稱為曾祖父，即你的祖父的父親或祖母的父親（視親屬線而定）。
explanation_english: Refers to the male ancestor one generation above a grandfather — the father of one's grandfather — commonly called a great-grandfather.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我曾祖父以前喺香港做生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cang4 zou2 fu6 ji5 cin4 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 zou6 saang1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的曾祖父以前在香港做生意。
examples.english_sentence: My great-grandfather used to do business in Hong Kong.

mandarin_meaning: 曾经 (céngjīng)
english_meaning: once; formerly; previously; ever (in the past)
explanation_mandarin: 表示過去某段時間曾發生過、存在過或有過某種經歷或狀態。
explanation_english: Indicates that something happened, existed, or someone had an experience at some point in the past.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我曾經去過香港。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cang4 ging1 heoi3 gwo3 hoeng1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我曾经去过香港。
examples.english_sentence: I have been to Hong Kong before.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢曾經係公司做工程師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cang4 ging1 hai6 gung1 si1 zou6 gung1 cing4 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他曾经在公司做工程师。
examples.english_sentence: He used to work as an engineer at the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度曾經係一個工廈，但而家已經改建成商場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 cang4 ging1 hai6 jat1 go3 gung1 haap6, daan6 ji4 gaa1 ji5 ging1 goi2 gin3 sing4 soeng1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里曾经是一个工业大厦，但现在已经改建成商场。
examples.english_sentence: This used to be an industrial building, but now it's been converted into a mall.

mandarin_meaning: 曾经见识过极其深刻或浩大的事物，其他的都显得黯然失色；常用于形容经历过刻骨铭心的爱情后，很难再被别人打动。
english_meaning: Literally 'having once experienced the vast sea'; after experiencing something profound (often an intense love), other things seem inadequate and one is hard to be moved by them.
explanation_mandarin: 出自元稹《離思》詩句「曾經滄海難為水」。原意是曾見過滄海，其他江河都顯得不足。常用於形容經歷過深刻的事或刻骨的感情後，對其他事物難以滿足或再動心，尤指愛情。
explanation_english: From a classical Chinese poem by Yuan Zhen. Literally 'having once seen the vast sea, other waters are no longer sufficient.' It describes that after a profound experience—especially an unforgettable love—one finds it hard to be moved or satisfied by others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢曾經滄海，所以之後好難再為其他人動心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cang4 ging1 cong1 hoi2, so2 ji5 zi1 hau6 hou2 naan4 zoi6 wai4 kei4 taa1 jan4 dung6 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他曾经沧海，所以之后很难再为其他人动心。
examples.english_sentence: He has once experienced a profound love, so afterwards it's hard for him to fall for someone else.

mandarin_meaning: 替（tì）——代替、为……（做某事）
english_meaning: to do something for/on behalf of someone; to replace or substitute
explanation_mandarin: “替”用来表示代替他人或为他人做某事，例如替人買東西、替人照顧等。
explanation_english: “替” indicates doing something on behalf of or instead of someone else (e.g., buying something for someone, taking care of someone).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以替我買杯咖啡？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 tai3 ngo5 maai5 bui1 gaa3 fe1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你能替我买杯咖啡吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you buy me a cup of coffee?

mandarin_meaning: 替代，取代；作为替补或替换的事情或行为
english_meaning: to replace; to substitute; an alternative or replacement
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞 / 名詞（視語境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 表示用另一個人或事物來代替原來的對象或做法，或指可作替換的選項。
explanation_english: Indicates using another person or thing in place of the original, or refers to an option that serves as a replacement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個工具可以替代人工做嗰啲工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gung1 geoi6 ho2 ji5 tai3 doi6 jan4 gung1 zou6 go2 di1 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个工具可以替代人工做的那些工作。
examples.english_sentence: This tool can replace the tasks done by humans.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果牛奶唔啱，你可以用豆漿替代。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngau4 naai5 m4 aam1, nei5 ho2 ji5 jung6 dau6 zoeng1 tai3 doi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果牛奶不合适，你可以用豆浆替代。
examples.english_sentence: If milk doesn't suit you, you can use soy milk as a substitute.

mandarin_meaning: 替代品（可用來代替原有物品的替換物）
english_meaning: substitute; alternative; replacement
explanation_mandarin: 指可以用來代替原先物品或功能的物品或方案，常用於產品、零件或材料等情況。
explanation_english: Refers to an item or option that can replace an original product or component; commonly used for products, parts, materials, or alternatives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果冇呢種電池，就用呢款替代品都得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 mou5 ni1 zung2 din6 ci4, zau6 jung6 ni1 fun2 tai3 doi6 ban2 dou1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果没有这种电池，就用这款替代品也可以。
examples.english_sentence: If we don't have this type of battery, we can use this alternative.

mandarin_meaning: 替天行道（tì tiān xíng dào）：以天命或正義之名行事，伸張正義、懲惡扶善。
english_meaning: To act on behalf of Heaven — to uphold justice or right wrongs in the name of a higher moral authority.
explanation_mandarin: 出自古典語境，指以天命或道義為名，代天行使正義、懲罰不義，常用來形容以伸張正義為目的的行動或自以為正義的人。
explanation_english: A classical idiom meaning to carry out justice on behalf of Heaven. It describes actions taken to right wrongs or punish evil under the banner of a higher moral mandate; often used for righteous (or self‑appointed) vigilante behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔鐘意啲人自命替天行道，結果只係令情況更亂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 di1 jan4 zi6 ming6 tai3 tin1 hang4 dou6, git3 gwo2 zi2 hai6 ling6 cing4 fong3 gang3 lyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不喜欢那些自命替天行道的人，結果只會令情況更亂。
examples.english_sentence: I don't like people who fancy themselves as acting for Heaven; it only makes things worse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古時小說入面，梁山好漢話要替天行道，匡扶正義。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si4 siu1 syut3 jap6 min6, loeng4 saan1 hou2 hon3 waa6 jiu3 tai3 tin1 hang4 dou6, kwong1 fu4 zing3 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古時小說裡，梁山好漢說要替天行道，匡扶正義。
examples.english_sentence: In classic novels, the heroes of Liangshan declared they would act for Heaven and uphold justice.

mandarin_meaning: 代班；頂班；替人上班
english_meaning: to cover someone's shift; to fill in at work; to do temporary/replacement work
explanation_mandarin: （口語）指替別人上班、代人值班或頂替其工作，通常為臨時性或短期的代替工作。
explanation_english: Informal Cantonese term meaning to cover someone else's shift, fill in for a coworker, or do temporary replacement work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日我幫阿明替工，佢有事走唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 ngo5 bong1 aa3 ming4 tai3 gung1, keoi5 yau5 si6 zau2 m4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天我要替阿明上班，他有事走不開。
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow I'll cover Ah Ming's shift; he can't get away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日間舖人手唔夠，搵咗個人嚟替工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 gaan1 pou3 jan4 sau2 m4 gau3, wan2 zo2 go3 jan4 lai4 tai3 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天店裡人手不夠，找了一個人來替工。
examples.english_sentence: The shop was short-staffed today, so they found someone to cover a shift.

mandarin_meaning: 替换 (tìhuàn)：用其他人或物代替，或将某物更换成新的或不同的东西。
english_meaning: to replace; to substitute; to exchange one thing or person for another
explanation_mandarin: 表示用其他人或物来代替某人或某物，或将某物更换为新的或不同的版本。
explanation_english: Indicates substituting one person or thing with another, or changing something for a new or different version.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份文件要替換成新版本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 man4 gin2 jiu3 tai3 wun6 sing4 san1 baan2 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份文件要替换成新版本。
examples.english_sentence: This document needs to be replaced with the new version.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我可以幫你替換嗰個零件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ho2 ji5 bong1 nei5 tai3 wun6 go2 go3 ling4 gin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我可以帮你替换那个零件。
examples.english_sentence: I can help you replace that part.

mandarin_meaning: 顶班 / 代班 / 替人值班
english_meaning: to cover someone's shift; to take a shift for someone
explanation_mandarin: 口語用語，指替別人去值班、頂班（尤指夜班或工作班次）。常用於工作或輪班情況下請人代替自己的班次。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase meaning to cover someone else's shift (especially a work or night shift). Used when one person takes another's scheduled duty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日我唔得閒，你可唔可以幫我替更？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 ngo5 m4 dak1 haan4, nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 tai3 gang1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天我沒空，你可以幫我代班/頂班嗎？
examples.english_sentence: I'm not free tomorrow. Can you cover my shift?

mandarin_meaning: 替人頂罪、當替罪羊
english_meaning: to take the blame for someone; to act as a scapegoat / fall guy (lit. 'take the gun')
explanation_mandarin: 俗語，指替他人承擔責任或頂罪，往往涉及隱瞞真相或代人背鍋。
explanation_english: A slang expression meaning to take the blame or responsibility on behalf of someone else—being a scapegoat or fall guy; often involves covering up or accepting blame for another person's wrongdoing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司出事，老闆唔想畀人問責，就叫阿偉替槍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ceot1 si6, lou5 baan2 m4 soeng2 bei2 jan4 man6 zaak3, zau6 giu3 aa3 wai5 tai3 coeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司出了問題，老闆不想被問責，就叫阿偉替槍。
examples.english_sentence: The company got into trouble; the boss didn't want to be held accountable, so he asked Ah Wai to take the blame.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做替槍好危險，畀人發現就唔得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 tai3 coeng1 hou2 ngai4 him2, bei2 jan4 faat3 jin4 zau6 m4 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 當替槍很危險，被人發現就不行。
examples.english_sentence: Being a fall guy is risky — if you're found out, it's no good.

mandarin_meaning: 替别人顶罪；替人承担责任或受罚
english_meaning: to take the blame for someone; to take the fall; to be a scapegoat; to sacrifice oneself on behalf of another
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，表示為別人承擔責任或受懲罰（字面亦可指代人去死，但日常多指代替承擔過錯或後果）。
explanation_english: Colloquial expression meaning to bear responsibility or punishment on behalf of someone else (literally 'die in place of', but commonly used to mean taking the blame).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細話要有人擔責，我唔會替死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai2 waa6 jiu3 jau5 jan4 daam1 zaak3, ngo5 m4 wui5 tai3 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板說要有人承担责任，我不会替人顶罪。
examples.english_sentence: The boss said someone has to take responsibility; I won't take the fall for someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果被警察問，佢就話係佢一個人做，唔好叫我替死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 bei6 ging2 caat3 man6, keoi5 zau6 waa6 hai6 keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 zou6, m4 hou2 giu3 ngo5 tai3 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果被警察問，他就說是他一個人做的，別叫我去替人頂罪。
examples.english_sentence: If the police ask, he'll say he did it alone — don't ask me to take the blame.

mandarin_meaning: 替罪羊；替別人承擔責任或懲罰的人
english_meaning: scapegoat; someone who takes the blame or punishment for others
explanation_mandarin: 指代替別人承擔責任或受罰的人，通常帶有被冤枉或被利用的含義。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who takes the blame or punishment on behalf of others, often unjustly or because they are being used.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嗰次出事，老闆唔想負責，就搵佢做替死鬼，最後佢俾炒咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 go2 ci3 ceot1 si6, lou5 baan2 m4 soeng2 fu6 zaak6, zau6 wan2 keoi5 zou6 tai3 sei2 gwai2, zeoi3 hau6 keoi5 bei2 caau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司那次出事，老闆不想負責，就找他當替死鬼，最後他被炒了。
examples.english_sentence: When the company had the incident, the boss didn't want to take responsibility, so he made him a scapegoat; in the end he was fired.

mandarin_meaning: 替人擔心/替別人操心（網絡/口語用法，常把「心」寫作「芯」）
english_meaning: to worry on behalf of someone; to feel concerned for someone (colloquial/internet usage)
explanation_mandarin: 「替芯」為廣東話口語/網絡用語，實際上是把「心」寫作「芯」。用來表達替別人擔心、替別人操心的意思，常見於非正式對話或社交媒體。
explanation_english: “替芯” is a Cantonese colloquial/internet expression that writes 心 (heart/mind) as 芯. It means to worry on someone else's behalf or to feel concerned for someone, used in informal speech or online.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使替芯啦，我自己搞得掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 tai3 sam1 laa3, ngo5 zi6 gei2 gaau2 dak1 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用替我擔心，我自己能處理好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry on my behalf; I can handle it myself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日考得唔好，大家唔好老是替芯，應該支持佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 haau2 dak1 m4 hou2, daai6 gaa1 m4 hou2 lou5 si6 tai3 sam1, jing1 goi1 zi1 ci4 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天考得不太好，大家不要總是替他擔心，應該支持他。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't do well on the test today; don't keep worrying for him — you should encourage him instead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺社交網度，成日見到人用『替芯』嚟表示同情或者關心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 se5 gaau1 mong5 dou6, sing4 jat6 gin3 dou3 jan4 jung6 'tai3 sam1' lai4 biu2 si6 tung4 cing4 waak6 ze2 gwaan1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在社交網上，經常看到有人用「替芯」來表示同情或關心。
examples.english_sentence: On social media, you often see people using '替芯' to express sympathy or concern.

mandarin_meaning: 替补
english_meaning: substitute; replacement; backup
explanation_mandarin: 指在球隊、團隊或工作中作為替代人選的人（替補），也可指替代、暫時頂替他人的動作或角色。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who serves as a substitute or backup in a team or workplace, and can also mean the act of substituting or temporarily replacing someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係隊入面嘅替補，平時都上唔到場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 deoi6 jap6 min6 ge3 tai3 bou2, ping4 si4 dou1 soeng5 m4 dou3 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是隊裡的替補，平時都上不了場。
examples.english_sentence: He's a substitute on the team and usually doesn't get to play.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 教練決定用佢做替補球員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau3 lin6 kyut3 ding6 jung6 keoi5 zou6 tai3 bou2 kau4 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 教練決定讓他做替補球員。
examples.english_sentence: The coach decided to use him as a substitute player.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我哋公司嘅替補，負責暫時頂替請病假職員嘅工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 tai3 bou2, fu6 zaak3 zaam6 si4 ding2 tai3 cing2 beng6 gaa3 zik1 jyun4 ge3 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我們公司的替補，負責暫時頂替請病假的員工的工作。
examples.english_sentence: He is our company's backup, responsible for temporarily covering the work of employees on sick leave.

mandarin_meaning: 替身，代替者（如電影或舞臺中的替身演員、替代品）
english_meaning: substitute; stand-in; body double; stunt double
explanation_mandarin: 指代替他人執行某些動作或出現在某些場景的人或物，常用於電影、舞臺表演中指替演員完成危險或專業動作的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person or thing that takes another's place to perform actions or appear in scenes; commonly used in film and theater to mean the person who performs dangerous or specialized actions for an actor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係部戲嘅替身，專門替男主角做危險動作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 bou6 hei3 ge3 tai3 san1, zyun1 mun4 tai3 naam4 zyu2 gok3 zou6 ngai4 him2 dung6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是那部電影的替身，專門替男主角做危險動作。
examples.english_sentence: He is the film's stunt double, specializing in performing dangerous stunts for the male lead.

mandarin_meaning: 最 (zuì)
english_meaning: most; -est (superlative)
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度最高，用于形容词或副词前构成最高级（例如“最好”），在口語中亦可作程度副词表示“非常”。
explanation_english: Indicates the highest degree; used before adjectives or adverbs to form the superlative (e.g. "best"); colloquially can also function as an intensifier meaning "very".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我班最聰明嘅學生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 baan1 zeoi3 cung1 ming4 ge3 hok6 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她是我班上最聪明的学生。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is the smartest student in my class.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試佢考得最好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 keoi5 haau2 dak1 zeoi3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试他考得最好。
examples.english_sentence: He got the highest score in this exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部手機喺商場入面最平。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 sau2 gei1 hai2 soeng1 coeng4 jap6 min6 zeoi3 peng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部手机在商场里最便宜。
examples.english_sentence: This phone is the cheapest in the mall.

mandarin_meaning: 最低工資
english_meaning: minimum wage
explanation_mandarin: 指法律或政策規定的僱主需支付給員工的最低薪酬標準，通常以時薪、日薪或月薪表示。
explanation_english: Refers to the minimum amount employers are legally or policy required to pay workers, usually expressed as an hourly, daily, or monthly rate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府話下個月會調高最低工資。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 waa6 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 tiu4 gou1 zeoi3 dai1 gung1 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府說下個月會提高最低工資。
examples.english_sentence: The government said it will raise the minimum wage next month.

mandarin_meaning: 最低限度 (zuì dī xiàn dù)
english_meaning: minimum; the bare minimum
explanation_mandarin: 表示達成某事或維持某狀態所需的最小程度或標準，常用來形容只有最基本、不能再減少的要求或程度。
explanation_english: Indicates the smallest degree or standard required to achieve or maintain something; often used to describe the most basic, non-negotiable level or requirement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司只提供最低限度嘅福利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 zi2 tai4 gung1 zeoi3 dai1 haan6 dou6 ge3 fuk1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司只提供最低限度的福利。
examples.english_sentence: The company only provides the minimum benefits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你而家做緊嘅只係最低限度嘅準備，仲有好多嘢未做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji4 gaa1 zou6 gan2 ge3 zi2 hai6 zeoi3 dai1 haan6 dou6 ge3 zeon2 bei6, zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 je5 mei6 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你現在做的只是最低限度的準備，還有很多事情沒做。
examples.english_sentence: What you're doing now is just the bare minimum of preparation; many things are still undone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺緊急情況下，我哋只可以做到最低限度嘅維持。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gan2 gap1 cing4 fong3 haa6, ngo5 dei6 zi2 ho2 ji5 zou6 dou3 zeoi3 dai1 haan6 dou6 ge3 wai4 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在緊急情況下，我們只能做到最低限度的維持。
examples.english_sentence: In an emergency, we can only maintain the bare minimum.

mandarin_meaning: 最佳 / 最好的
english_meaning: best; optimal; most suitable
explanation_mandarin: 表示在某個範疇或情況下最優秀、最合適的選擇或狀態。
explanation_english: Indicates the most excellent or most suitable option or state in a given context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個係最佳嘅選擇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 zeoi3 gaa1 ge3 syun2 zaak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這是最佳的選擇。
examples.english_sentence: This is the best choice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家喺最佳狀態，可以上場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai6 zeoi3 gaa1 zong6 taai3, ho2 ji5 soeng5 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在處於最佳狀態，可以上場。
examples.english_sentence: He's currently in his best form and can play.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗公司嘅利益，我哋要作出最佳決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 gung1 si1 ge3 lei6 jik6, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zok3 ceot1 zeoi3 gaa1 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 為了公司的利益，我們要做出最佳決定。
examples.english_sentence: For the company's benefit, we must make the best decision.

mandarin_meaning: 最惠國（最惠國待遇）
english_meaning: Most-favored-nation (MFN) — the policy/status of granting a country the best trade terms given to any trading partner
explanation_mandarin: 指在國際貿易中，某國被賦予與其他國家同等的最優惠關稅及貿易待遇，常用表述為「最惠國待遇」。「最優惠國」為口語或變體寫法，正式用語通常為「最惠國」。
explanation_english: Refers to the international trade principle/status where a country is granted the same most-favorable tariffs and trade conditions given to any other trading partner (Most-Favored-Nation treatment). "最優惠國" is a variant expression; the standard term is usually "最惠國" or "MFN".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個國家獲得咗最優惠國待遇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gwok3 gaa1 wok6 dak1 zo2 zeoi3 jau1 wai6 gwok3 dai6 jyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个国家获得了最惠国待遇。
examples.english_sentence: This country received most-favored-nation treatment.

mandarin_meaning: 最初 / 起初
english_meaning: initially; at first; at the beginning
explanation_mandarin: 表示在事情開始的時候、起初或最早的階段。
explanation_english: Indicates the beginning of an event or period; means 'at first' or 'initially'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最初以為佢唔會嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 co1 ji5wai4 keoi5 m4 wui5 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 起初，我以為他不會來。
examples.english_sentence: At first, I thought he wouldn't come.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最初嘅計劃係由三個人開始。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 co1 ge3 gai3 waak6 hai6 jau4 saam1 go3 jan4 hoi1 ci2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最初的計劃是由三個人開始。
examples.english_sentence: The original plan was to start with three people.

mandarin_meaning: 最多 (zuìduō) — 表示不超过的最大数量或程度
english_meaning: at most; most; maximum
explanation_mandarin: 表示数量或程度的上限，意为“不超过……”，也可用来表示“最……的/最多的”。
explanation_english: Indicates the upper limit of quantity or degree ('not more than...'); can also mean 'the most'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最多可以等你十分鐘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 do1 ho2 ji5 dang2 nei5 sap6 fan1 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最多可以等你十分钟。
examples.english_sentence: I can wait for you at most ten minutes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫最多二百蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 zeoi3 do1 ji6 baak3 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衬衫最多二百块。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt costs at most 200 dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話最多只有三個人會嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 zeoi3 do1 zi2 jau5 saam1 go3 jan4 wui5 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说最多只有三个人会来。
examples.english_sentence: He said at most only three people will come.

mandarin_meaning: 最大公因数（兩個或多個整數的最大公因數）
english_meaning: greatest common divisor (GCD)
explanation_mandarin: 兩個或多個整數的最大公因數是能整除這些整數的最大正整數。通常可透過質因數分解或輾轉相除法（歐幾里得算法）來計算。
explanation_english: The greatest common divisor (GCD) of two or more integers is the largest positive integer that divides each of them without leaving a remainder. It can be found by prime factorization or the Euclidean algorithm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師教我哋點樣搵兩個數嘅最大公因數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 gaau3 ngo5 dei6 dim2 joeng6 wan2 loeng5 go3 sou3 ge3 zeoi3 daai6 gung1 jan1 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老師教我們如何求兩個數的最大公因數。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher taught us how to find the greatest common divisor of two numbers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 12同18嘅最大公因數係6。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sap6 ji6 tung4 sap6 baat3 ge3 zeoi3 daai6 gung1 jan1 sou3 hai6 luk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 12和18的最大公因數是6。
examples.english_sentence: The GCD of 12 and 18 is 6.

mandarin_meaning: 最大公约数；比喻為各方能達成共識的共同點或最小共同立場
english_meaning: greatest common divisor (mathematics); figuratively, the common ground or minimum shared agreement
explanation_mandarin: 在數學中，指兩個或多個整數的最大公因數；在口語或社會語境中，作比喻使用，指多方能接受或達成共識的共同點或最低限度的協議。
explanation_english: In mathematics, the greatest common divisor (GCD) of two or more integers. In everyday or social contexts, used metaphorically to mean the common ground or the minimum shared position that different parties can agree on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋兩個意見唔同，但總要搵個最大公約數先可以繼續合作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5dei6 loeng5go3 ji3gin3 m4tung4, daan6 zung2jiu3 wan2 go3 zeoi3daai6gung1joek3sou3 sin1 ho2ji5 gai3zuk6 hap6zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們兩個意見不同，但總要找到一個最大公約數才能繼續合作。
examples.english_sentence: We have different opinions, but we must find a common ground (literally: greatest common divisor) to continue cooperating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 12同18嘅最大公約數係6。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sap6ji6 tung4 sap6baat3 ge3 zeoi3daai6gung1joek3sou3 hai6 luk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 12和18的最大公約數是6。
examples.english_sentence: The greatest common divisor of 12 and 18 is 6.

mandarin_meaning: 最好（表示最理想或用於提出建議：「最好……」）
english_meaning: best; (doing something) would be best; had better
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 副词 / 形容词（视语境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 「最好」可表示最高程度（最好的），也常用作提出建議或勸告的副詞，相當於「最理想」或「最好是／最好不要」。
explanation_english: “最好” can mean 'the best' (superlative) or function as an adverb to give advice or recommendation, equivalent to 'it would be best (to)...' or 'you'd better...'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你最好而家走，唔好遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeoi3 hou2 ji4 gaa1 zau2, m4 hou2 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好現在走，不要遲到。
examples.english_sentence: You'd better leave now; don't be late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最好係試下先，睇下啱唔啱你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 hou2 hai6 si3 haa5 sin1, tai2 haa5 aam1 m4 aam1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最好先試一下，看看適不適合你。
examples.english_sentence: It's best to try it first to see if it suits you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最好唔好喺佢背後講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 hou2 m4 hou2 hai2 keoi5 bui3 hau6 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最好不要在他背後說話。
examples.english_sentence: It's best not to talk about him behind his back.

mandarin_meaning: 最好不过 (zuì hǎo bù guò)
english_meaning: couldn't be better; nothing could be better; ideal
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度达到最高，无法再更好，常用于评价某事非常理想或合适。
explanation_english: Expresses that something is as good as it gets; nothing could be better. Used to say a situation or choice is ideal or perfect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個主意最好不過，即刻去做啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zyu2 ji3 zeoi3 hou2 bat1 gwo3, zik1 haak1 heoi3 zou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个主意最好不过，立刻去做吧。
examples.english_sentence: This idea couldn't be better — let's do it right away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有你幫手就最好不過，唔使我一個人做晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 nei5 bong1 sau2 zau6 zeoi3 hou2 bat1 gwo3, m4 sai2 ngo5 jat1 go3 jan4 zou6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有你帮忙就最好不过，不用我一个人做完。
examples.english_sentence: Having your help would be perfect; I won't have to finish everything by myself.

mandarin_meaning: 最少（拼音：zuì shǎo），表示至少、最低數量或程度
english_meaning: at least; minimum
explanation_mandarin: 表示某一數量或程度的下限，相當於“至少”，可用於數量或要求的描述。
explanation_english: Indicates the lower limit of an amount or degree, equivalent to 'at least'. Used to describe minimum quantities or requirements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你最少要帶身份證出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeoi3 siu2 jiu3 daai3 san1 fan6 zing3 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你至少要帶身份證出來。
examples.english_sentence: You should at least bring your ID.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最少有三十蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 siu2 jau5 saam1 sap6 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我至少有三十塊錢。
examples.english_sentence: I have at least thirty dollars.

mandarin_meaning: 最后；最终
english_meaning: at the very end; in the end; finally
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用詞，表示在最後或最終的情況，相當於普通話的「最後／最終」。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning 'at the very end' or 'in the end', used to indicate the final outcome or last position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最尾先到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 mei5 sin1 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最后才到。
examples.english_sentence: I arrived last.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最尾佢決定唔去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 mei5 keoi5 kyut3 ding6 m4 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最后他决定不去。
examples.english_sentence: In the end he decided not to go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事最尾都安排好晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 zeoi3 mei5 dou1 ngon1 paai4 hou2 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 事情最后都安排好了。
examples.english_sentence: In the end, everything was arranged.

mandarin_meaning: 最后；最终；最后阶段
english_meaning: last; final; finally; in the end
explanation_mandarin: 表示时间或顺序的最后阶段，作副词时表示“最终、最后”，作名词时指“末尾、最后一部分”。
explanation_english: Indicates the final stage in time or sequence. Used as an adverb meaning 'finally' or as a noun meaning 'the last/ending'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最後都決定唔去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 kyut3 ding6 m4 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最后还是决定不去了。
examples.english_sentence: I ended up deciding not to go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 比賽最後佢贏咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 coi3 zeoi3 hau6 keoi5 jeng4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 比赛最后他赢了。
examples.english_sentence: In the end, he won the match.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司最後揀咗佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zeoi3 hau6 gaan2 zo2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司最后选择了他。
examples.english_sentence: The company ultimately chose him.

mandarin_meaning: 最后通牒 (zuìhòu tōngdié) — 在谈判或冲突中提出的最后要求或条件，若不接受将有后果
english_meaning: ultimatum — a final demand or set of terms, refusal of which will lead to consequences
explanation_mandarin: 指一方在談判、衝突或關係中提出的最後要求或警告，對方若不接受，提出方會採取相應行動或斷絕關係。
explanation_english: A final demand or warning issued in negotiations, conflicts, or relationships; if the demand is not accepted, the issuer will take action or sever ties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府向示威者發出最後通牒，要佢哋喺廿四小時內清場，否則就會採取行動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 hoeng3 si6 wai1 ze2 faat3 ceot1 zeoi3 hau6 tung1 dip6, jiu3 keoi5 dei6 hai2 jaa6 sei3 siu2 si4 noi6 cing1 coeng4, fau2 zak1 zau6 wui5 coi2 ceoi2 hang4 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府向示威者发出最后通牒，要求他们在24小时内清场，否则将采取行动。
examples.english_sentence: The government issued an ultimatum to the protesters, demanding they clear out within 24 hours or it will take action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾咗我最後通牒，話如果我唔辭職就分手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 zo2 ngo5 zeoi3 hau6 tung1 dip6, waa6 jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 m4 ci4 zik1 zau6 fan1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他給了我最後通牒，說如果我不辭職就分手。
examples.english_sentence: He gave me an ultimatum — said if I don't quit my job he'll break up with me.

mandarin_meaning: 最惠国（zuì huì guó），通常指在国际贸易中给予的最优惠关税与贸易待遇，常见用法为“最惠国待遇”。
english_meaning: Most-favored-nation (MFN) — a trade status/treatment in which a country is given the most favorable trade terms (e.g., lowest tariffs) compared to other trading partners.
explanation_mandarin: 在国际贸易中，最惠国是指某国在关税和贸易待遇上被给予与其他受惠国相同的最优惠条件，通常以“最惠国待遇”出现，是双边或多边贸易协定中的常见条款。
explanation_english: In international trade, 'most-favored-nation' refers to the status where a country is granted the most favorable trade terms (such as lowest tariffs) available among a country's trading partners. Often referred to as 'most-favored-nation treatment'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府決定畀嗰個國家最惠國待遇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 kyut3 ding6 bei2 go2 go3 gwok3 zeoi3 wai6 gwok3 doi6 jyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府决定给予该国最惠国待遇。
examples.english_sentence: The government decided to grant that country most-favored-nation treatment.

mandarin_meaning: 最爱 / 最喜歡
english_meaning: favorite; most beloved; love the most
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞 / 名詞（口語亦可作動詞短語）
partOfSpeech_english: adjective / noun (can be used colloquially as a verb phrase)
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人或某事物是最喜愛的，可作名詞（我的最愛）或形容詞（最愛的），在口語中也可作動詞短語使用（最愛做某事）。
explanation_english: Indicates the person or thing one likes best. Can be used as a noun (my favorite) or an adjective (favorite). Colloquially it may function as a verb phrase (love to do something the most).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書係我嘅最愛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 hai6 ngo5 ge3 zeoi3 oi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這本書是我的最愛。
examples.english_sentence: This book is my favorite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我最愛嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 zeoi3 oi3 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她是我最愛的人。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is the person I love most.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最愛食蛋撻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 oi3 sik6 daan6 taat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最喜歡吃蛋撻。
examples.english_sentence: My favorite is egg tarts.

mandarin_meaning: 最为
english_meaning: most; especially; exceedingly
explanation_mandarin: “最为”是一个书面语副词，用来表示程度最高或特别，例如“最为重要”“最为关心”。常用于正式或书面场合。
explanation_english: “最為” is a formal/written adverb used to indicate the highest degree or to single something out as especially so (e.g., "most important", "most concerned"). Common in formal or written contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個決定對公司最為重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 deoi3 gung1 si1 zeoi6 wai4 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个决定对公司最为重要。
examples.english_sentence: This decision is most important to the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 家長對孩子嘅教育最為關心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa1 zoeng2 deoi3 haai4 zi2 ge3 gaau3 juk6 zeoi6 wai4 gwaan1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家长对孩子的教育最为关心。
examples.english_sentence: Parents are most concerned about their children's education.

mandarin_meaning: 最为 / 尤其 / 非常
english_meaning: most; especially; extremely
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度最高或用于强调，常见于书面语，意思接近“非常”或“尤其”。
explanation_english: Used to indicate the highest degree or to emphasize; formal/literary usage meaning 'most', 'especially', or 'extremely'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對呢件事最為關心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 zeoi3 wai4 gwaan1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对这件事最为关心。
examples.english_sentence: He is most concerned about this matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺咁多選擇入面，呢個最為適合你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gam3 do1 syun2 zaak6 jap6 min6, ni1 go3 zeoi3 wai4 sik1 hap6 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这么多选择里面，这个最为适合你。
examples.english_sentence: Among so many options, this one is the most suitable for you.

mandarin_meaning: 最终
english_meaning: finally; ultimately; in the end
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情在最後、結局或結果，與“最後”“終於”意思接近，語體較正式，常用於書面或正式場合。
explanation_english: Indicates the final outcome or the end point of an event. Similar to 'finally' or 'ultimately'. It is relatively formal and often used in written or formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋最終都決定唔去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zeoi3 zung1 dou1 kyut3 ding6 m4 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们最终都决定不去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: We ultimately decided not to go on the trip.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最終都冇畀我回覆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 zung1 dou1 mou5 bei2 ngo5 wui4 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最终也没有给我回复。
examples.english_sentence: He ultimately didn't reply to me.

mandarin_meaning: 最近 (zuìjìn)，表示不久前或不久之內的時間
english_meaning: recently; lately
explanation_mandarin: 表示在不久以前或接近現在的一段時間，常用來描述近期發生的事或狀態。
explanation_english: Indicates a time period close to the present — 'recently' or 'lately', used to describe events or states that occurred or are occurring in the near past.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近我成日訓唔夠覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 ngo5 sing4 jat6 fan3 m4 gau3 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近我經常睡眠不足。
examples.english_sentence: Lately I've often not been getting enough sleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你最近點呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 dim2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最近怎麼樣？
examples.english_sentence: How have you been recently?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近天氣好凍，記得著多件衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 tin1 hei3 hou2 dung3, gei3 dak1 zoek6 do1 gin6 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近天氣很冷，記得多穿一件衣服。
examples.english_sentence: It's been cold recently; remember to wear an extra layer.

mandarin_meaning: 会 (huì) — 表示将来/可能、能力或会议、社团等意思
english_meaning: will / be likely to / can / meeting / association
explanation_mandarin: 「會」在粤语中常用作情态动词，表示将来（会做某事）、可能性（可能会）、或表示能力（会 = 会做）；作为名词时可指会议或社团。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "會" (wui6) is commonly used as a modal verb to indicate future action, likelihood, or ability. As a noun it can mean a meeting or an association.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我會遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wui6 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我会迟到。
examples.english_sentence: I'll be late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔會講英文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 wui6 gong2 jing1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她不会说英文。
examples.english_sentence: He/She can't speak English.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚有個會議，記得準時。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 jau5 go3 wui6 ji5, gei3 dak1 zeon2 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚有个会议，记得准时。
examples.english_sentence: There's a meeting tonight; remember to be on time.

mandarin_meaning: （在）會議上；在聚會或會議的期間或場合
english_meaning: at the meeting; during a meeting or gathering
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 介词短语 / 时间状语
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事發生在會議或聚會的場合或期間，常用作時間或場合的狀語，例如“會上發言”。
explanation_english: Indicates that something happens during or at a meeting/gathering; commonly used as a time/location adverbial (e.g., 'speak at the meeting').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺會上大家都有提出意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 wui6 soeng5 daai6 gaa1 dou1 jau5 tai4 ceot1 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在會議上大家都有提出意見。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone raised opinions at the meeting.

mandarin_meaning: 小型會議／非正式聚會
english_meaning: a small/informal meeting or gathering
explanation_mandarin: 「會仔」是粵語口語用法，通常指非正式或小型的會議或聚會；也可作動詞短語，表示召開這類簡短的會議。常見於香港日常會話。
explanation_english: An informal Cantonese term for a small or informal meeting/gathering. It can be used as a noun or as a verb phrase meaning to hold a brief meeting. Commonly used in Hong Kong spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日公司開個會仔，記得準時。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 gung1 si1 hoi1 go3 wui6 zai2, gei3 dak1 zeon2 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天公司開個小會，記得準時。
examples.english_sentence: There's a small meeting at the company tomorrow; remember to be on time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使搞咁大，開個會仔傾下就得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 gaau2 gam2 daai6, hoi1 go3 wui6 zai2 king1 haa5 zau6 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用搞那麼大，開個小會討論一下就行。
examples.english_sentence: No need to make it big; a quick meeting will do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家埋一齊開個會仔傾下旅行計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 gaa1 maai4 jat1 cai4 hoi1 go3 wui6 zai2 king1 haa5 leoi5 hang4 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家一起開個小會討論旅行計劃。
examples.english_sentence: Let's have a small meeting to discuss the travel plans.

mandarin_meaning: 会务；组织或社团、会议的事务与管理
english_meaning: Affairs or administrative work of an association, organization, or meeting
explanation_mandarin: 指組織、社團或會議相關的事務、行政管理與運作事項，如會議籌備、會員管理等。
explanation_english: Refers to matters and administrative tasks related to an organization, association, or meeting, such as meeting preparation, member administration, and operational duties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我負責會務同埋活動安排。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 fu6 zaak3 wui6 mou6 tung4 maai4 wut6 dung6 ngon1 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我负责会务和活动安排。
examples.english_sentence: I'm responsible for association affairs and event arrangements.

mandarin_meaning: 会合（huìhé）：会面、集合、汇合
english_meaning: to meet; to assemble; to rendezvous
explanation_mandarin: 表示兩個或多個人或隊伍在約定的時間和地點聚集或見面，也可指匯合、集合。
explanation_english: Refers to two or more people or groups coming together at an agreed time and place; to meet, assemble, or rendezvous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚喺中環同佢會合。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 hai2 zung1 waan4 tung4 keoi5 wui6 hap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚在中环和他会合。
examples.english_sentence: We're meeting him at Central tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 救援隊已經喺山腳會合，準備上山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau3 wun4 deoi6 ji5 ging1 hai2 saan1 gok3 wui6 hap6, zeon2 bei6 soeng5 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 救援队已经在山脚会合，准备上山。
examples.english_sentence: The rescue teams have already assembled at the foot of the mountain, ready to go up.

mandarin_meaning: 會同（huìtóng）：與…一起、共同（書面用語）
english_meaning: in conjunction with; together with; jointly (formal/written)
explanation_mandarin: 會同是書面或公文常用詞，表示與某人或某機構一起、共同參與或處理某事，例如「會同各部門處理」。
explanation_english: A formal/written expression meaning to act together with or in conjunction with someone or some organization, often used in official documents (e.g., "in conjunction with various departments").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府會同各部門處理呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 wui6 tung4 gok3 bou6 mun4 cyu2 lei5 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府會同各部門處理這件事。
examples.english_sentence: The government, together with various departments, will handle this matter.

mandarin_meaning: 是否；会不会
english_meaning: whether; will or will not (used to form yes/no questions)
explanation_mandarin: 用于构成对某事是否发生或成立的疑问，相当于普通话的“是否”或“会不会”。在粤语中可用于较正式或书面语，也可出现在口语中。
explanation_english: Used to form a question about whether something will happen or be the case; equivalent to Mandarin '是否' or '会不会'. Common in more formal Cantonese but also appears in speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你會否嚟？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 wui5fau2 loi4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你会不会来？
examples.english_sentence: Will you come?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府會否延長限聚令？
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3fu2 wui5fau2 jin4coeng4 haan6zeoi6 ling6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府是否会延长限聚令？
examples.english_sentence: Will the government extend the gathering restrictions?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔肯定佢會否接電話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 hang2ding6 keoi5 wui5fau2 zip3 din6waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不确定他是否会接电话。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not sure whether he will answer the phone.

mandarin_meaning: 會員 (huìyuán)
english_meaning: member (of an organization, club, or association)
explanation_mandarin: 指某個組織、團體或機構的成員，通常享有該組織規定的權利或需履行相應義務，例如會籍、折扣或投票權等。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who belongs to an organization, club, or association, typically entitled to certain rights or expected to fulfill related duties (e.g., membership benefits, discounts, voting rights).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你想享受折扣，要先成為我哋嘅會員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 soeng2 hoeng2 sau6 zit3 kau3, jiu3 sin1 sing4 wai4 ngo5 dei6 ge3 wui6 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你想享受折扣，須先成為我們的會員。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to enjoy the discounts, you need to become our member first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間會所只限會員入內。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 wui6 so2 zi2 haan6 wui6 jyun4 jap6 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個會所只限會員進入。
examples.english_sentence: This club is for members only.

mandarin_meaning: 會場 / 會議場地
english_meaning: venue; meeting place; conference hall
explanation_mandarin: 指用作舉行會議、活動、演出等的場地或場所，例如會議廳、禮堂或展覽場。
explanation_english: Refers to a place used for holding meetings, events, performances, or exhibitions (e.g., a conference hall, auditorium, or exhibition venue).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 會議喺會場三樓舉行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wui6 ji5 hai2 wui6 coeng4 saam1 lau4 geoi2 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 會議在會場三樓舉行。
examples.english_sentence: The meeting will be held on the third floor of the venue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 婚禮嘅會場已經布置好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan1 lai5 ge3 wui6 coeng4 ji5 ging1 bou3 zi3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 婚禮的會場已經布置好了。
examples.english_sentence: The wedding venue has already been set up.

mandarin_meaning: 会客（接待来访者、会见客人）
english_meaning: to receive visitors; to meet clients or guests; to hold an audience
explanation_mandarin: 表示接待來訪的人或會見客人，常用於工作或正式場合，指會見來訪者或處理來訪事務。
explanation_english: Refers to receiving visitors or meeting clients/guests—commonly used in work or formal contexts to mean seeing callers or handling visiting appointments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司經理朝早九點都要會客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ging1 lei5 ziu1 zou2 gau2 dim2 dou1 jiu3 wui6 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司经理早上九点都要接待来访者。
examples.english_sentence: The company manager has to receive visitors every morning at 9 o'clock.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生下晝兩點會客，請預約。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 haa6 zau3 loeng5 dim2 wui6 haak3, ceng2 jyu6 joek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生下午两点接诊，请预约。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor sees patients at 2 PM; please make an appointment.

mandarin_meaning: 会展（会议与展览）
english_meaning: convention and exhibition; trade fair; expo (also can refer to the venue, e.g., convention and exhibition centre)
explanation_mandarin: 「會展」是「會議與展覽」的合成詞，通常指大型商業展覽、交易會或相關活動，也可指作為舉辦此類活動的場地（例如會展中心）。
explanation_english: '會展' refers to conventions and exhibitions — large-scale trade shows, expos, or conference-exhibition events; it can also denote the venue where such events are held (e.g., a convention and exhibition centre).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下個月會展有個國際旅遊展，我打算去參觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 go3 jyut6 wui6 zin2 jau5 go3 gwok3 zai3 leoi5 jau4 zin2, ngo5 daa2 syun3 heoi3 caam1 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下个月会展有个国际旅游展，我打算去参观。
examples.english_sentence: There's an international travel expo at the convention and exhibition next month; I plan to visit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港會展中心係舉辦大型展覽嘅主要場地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 wui6 zin2 zung1 sam1 hai6 geoi2 baan6 daai6 jing4 zin2 laam5 ge3 zyu2 jiu3 coeng4 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港会展中心是举办大型展览的主要场地。
examples.english_sentence: The Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre is a major venue for large-scale exhibitions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次會展人好多，附近交通好塞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 wui6 zin2 jan4 hou2 do1, fu6 gan6 gaau1 tung1 hou2 sak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次会展人很多，附近交通很拥堵。
examples.english_sentence: This expo is very crowded and the nearby traffic is heavily congested.

mandarin_meaning: 会展工作人员／展会展台工作人员（俗称）
english_meaning: expo/ trade-show booth staff; temporary exhibitor staff (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「會展頭」是香港口語，指在會展、展覽或博覽會上負責站台、派樣品或宣傳資料等的臨時或兼職工作人員。有時帶有輕微貶義，指工作屬低技術、臨時性質，或被動地做推廣工作。
explanation_english: “會展頭” is Hong Kong Cantonese slang for people who staff booths at conventions, trade shows or exhibitions—typically temporary or part-time workers who hand out samples, flyers, or promote products. It can carry a mildly derogatory nuance implying low-skilled, temporary promotional work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係會展頭，成日喺會場派宣傳單張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 wui6 zin2 tau4, sing4 jat6 hai2 wui6 coeng4 paai3 syun1 cyun4 daan1 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是會展頭，經常在會場派發宣傳單張。
examples.english_sentence: He's an expo booth worker; he often hands out flyers at the venue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好睇低啲會展頭，佢哋做到幾辛苦㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tai2 dai1 di1 wui6 zin2 tau4, keoi5 dei6 zou6 dou3 gei2 san1 fu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要小看那些會展頭，他們工作也很辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: Don't look down on expo staff; they work pretty hard.

mandarin_meaning: 會心（huìxīn）：心領神會、彼此默契或會心一笑
english_meaning: tacit understanding; knowing (as in a knowing smile); mutual comprehension
explanation_mandarin: 表示彼此心領神會、默契或會心一笑時流露出的意味。可用來形容笑容或表示雙方互相理解而無需多言。
explanation_english: Indicates a tacit, knowing understanding between people—often expressed as a 'knowing smile'. Used to describe mutual comprehension or a shared, wordless understanding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋交換咗一個會心嘅微笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaau1 wun6 zo2 jat1 go3 wui6 sam1 ge3 mei4 siu3
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們交換了一個會心的微笑。
examples.english_sentence: They exchanged a knowing smile.

mandarin_meaning: 会意；理解；会意字（汉字构造学术语）
english_meaning: to understand; to grasp the meaning; (linguistics) ideogrammatic compound (huiyi) character
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞 / 名詞（視語境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 表示理解、明白對方的意思、心領神會；在語言學/漢字學中，會意指由兩個或以上字形合成以表達複合意義的字（會意字）。
explanation_english: Indicates understanding or comprehension (to realize or grasp someone's meaning). In linguistics, 'huiyi' refers to ideogrammatic compound characters formed by combining elements that together convey a composite meaning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢微微一笑，我即刻會意佢嘅意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mei4mei4 jat1 siu3, ngo5 zik1 hak1 wui6 ji3 keoi5 ge3 ji3si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他微微一笑，我立刻明白了他的意思。
examples.english_sentence: He smiled slightly, and I immediately understood what he meant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 漢字入面有好多會意字，例如「休」係由人同木組成，就係會意字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hon3 zi6 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 wui6 ji3 zi6, lai6 jyu4 「jau1」 hai6 jau4 jan4 tung4 muk6 zou2 seng4, zau6 hai6 wui6 ji3 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 汉字里面有很多会意字，例如“休”是由人和木组合而成，就是会意字。
examples.english_sentence: There are many huiyi (ideogrammatic compound) characters in Chinese; for example, '休' is composed of 人 and 木, so it is an ideogrammatic compound.

mandarin_meaning: 会战（大规模的战斗或协同发起的攻势）
english_meaning: major battle; campaign; coordinated assault (also used for organized contests like guild wars)
explanation_mandarin: 指規模較大、由多方協同或持續進行的戰鬥或攻勢。引申用法可指有組織性的行動或競賽（如遊戲、公會之間的對抗）。
explanation_english: Refers to a large-scale battle or a coordinated offensive. By extension, it can mean an organized campaign or contest (for example, guild wars in games).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 第二次世界大戰中，呢場會戰決定咗前線嘅走勢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dai6 ji6 ci3 sai3 gaai3 daai6 zin3 zung1, ni1 coeng4 wui6 zin3 kyut3 ding6 zo2 cin4 sin3 ge3 zou2 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在第二次世界大战中，这场会战决定了前线的走向。
examples.english_sentence: In World War II, this battle campaign determined the direction of the front line.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公會今次嘅會戰每晚都有練習，大家都好認真。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 wui6 gam1 ci3 ge3 wui6 zin3 mui5 maan5 dou1 jau5 lin6 zaap6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 jing6 zan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們公會這次的會戰每晚都有練習，大家都很認真。
examples.english_sentence: Our guild's campaign (guild war) has practice every night; everyone is very dedicated.

mandarin_meaning: 会所（供会员或社团聚会、休闲、娱乐的场所）
english_meaning: clubhouse; club; a venue for members to gather for leisure or social activities
explanation_mandarin: 指供會員或特定團體聚會、休閒、娛樂的場所，常見於住宅屋苑、酒店或私人俱樂部內。
explanation_english: Refers to a place used by members or groups for gatherings, leisure, and recreational activities; commonly found in residential complexes, hotels, or private clubs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個屋苑嘅會所有泳池同健身室，居民可以免費使用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 uk1 jyun2 ge3 wui6 so2 jau5 wing6 ci4 tung4 gin6 san1 sat1, geoi1 man4 ho2 ji5 min5 fai3 si6 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个屋苑的会所有游泳池和健身房，居民可以免费使用。
examples.english_sentence: The estate's clubhouse has a swimming pool and gym; residents can use them for free.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺私人會所開咗個會員晚宴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 si1 jan4 wui6 so2 hoi1 zo2 go3 wui6 jyun4 maan5 jin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在私人会所举办了一个会员晚宴。
examples.english_sentence: They held a members' banquet at a private clubhouse.

mandarin_meaning: 会晤（会见、见面）
english_meaning: to meet; to hold a meeting; to have an audience (formal)
explanation_mandarin: 表示會面或會見，多用於正式或書面語、新聞報道中，語氣較正式。
explanation_english: Means to meet or hold a meeting; a formal term often used in written language or news reports.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩國元首將於下周會晤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 gwok3 jyun4 sau2 zoeng1 jyu1 haa6 zau1 wui6 ng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 兩國元首將於下周會晤。
examples.english_sentence: The two heads of state will meet next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雙方代表琴日已經會晤，商討合作事宜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng1 fong1 doi6 biu2 kam4 jat6 ji5 ging1 wui6 ng4, soeng1 tou2 hop3 zok3 si6 ji4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 雙方代表昨天已經會晤，商討合作事宜。
examples.english_sentence: Representatives from both sides already met yesterday to discuss matters of cooperation.

mandarin_meaning: 会社；社团、公司或商号（通常指组织或商行）
english_meaning: an association, society, company, or firm; an organized business or group
explanation_mandarin: 「會社」原指社团或公私组织，有时也用来指公司、商号或行会。在现代汉语与粤语语境中，多用于书面或较正式场合。
explanation_english: Historically refers to an association or organized society; can also mean a company, firm, or guild. In modern usage it often appears in formal or written contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間會社專門做進出口生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 wui6 se5 zyun1 mun4 zou6 zeon3 ceot1 hau2 saang1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司专门做进出口生意。
examples.english_sentence: This company specializes in import-export business.

mandarin_meaning: 会章；章程（组织或社团的规章）
english_meaning: bylaws; constitution (the written rules governing an organization or association)
explanation_mandarin: 指組織、社團或協會訂定的細則與規章，包含會員資格、權利義務、會議程序、選舉與修訂辦法等，用以規範內部運作。
explanation_english: The written rules or bylaws of an organization, specifying membership, rights and duties, meeting procedures, elections, amendment processes, and other internal governance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要修訂會章，須經會員大會通過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 sau1 ding6 wui6 zoeng1, syu1 ging1 wui6 jyun4 daai6 wui2 tung1 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要修订会章，须经会员大会通过。
examples.english_sentence: We need to amend the bylaws; it must be approved by the general assembly of members.

mandarin_meaning: 会籍；會員資格/會籍登記
english_meaning: membership; membership status/registration
explanation_mandarin: 指某人在某組織、團體或機構的會員身分或資格，通常記錄在名冊或系統內；也可指會籍的登記或有效期。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's membership status or qualification in an organization, club, or institution, usually recorded in a roster or system; can also refer to the membership registration or its validity period.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅會籍仲有效嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 wui6 zik6 zung6 jau5 haau6 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的会籍还有效吗？
examples.english_sentence: Is your membership still valid?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 申請會籍通常要交身份證同填表格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 cing2 wui6 zik6 tung1 soeng4 jiu3 gaau1 san1 fan6 zing3 tung4 tin4 biu2 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 申请会籍通常需要提交身份证并填写表格。
examples.english_sentence: Applying for membership usually requires submitting an ID and filling out forms.

mandarin_meaning: 会考（huìkǎo）：指中学或学校举行的公开考试或联合考试，香港语境常指中学会考/香港中学会考
english_meaning: public examination; joint/school-leaving exam (in Hong Kong often refers to the Hong Kong Certificate of Education-type exam)
explanation_mandarin: 「會考」指由教育机构或政府组织的考试，通常用于评估学生在中学阶段的学业水平。在香港语境下，常指过去的中学會考（後來改革为文凭试）。
explanation_english: “會考” refers to an examination organized by educational institutions or authorities, typically used to assess secondary school students. In the Hong Kong context it often refers to the former secondary public examination (later reformed into the Diploma of Secondary Education).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個星期有會考，要溫書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 sing1 kei4 jau5 wui6 haau2, jiu3 wan1 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个星期有会考，要复习。
examples.english_sentence: I have the public exam next week; I need to study.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅會考已經改為文憑試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 wui6 haau2 ji5 ging1 goi2 wai4 man4 ping4 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的会考已经改为文凭试。
examples.english_sentence: The Hong Kong public exam has been restructured into the Diploma of Secondary Education (DSE).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校會安排模擬會考幫學生準備。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 wui5 on1 paai4 mo4 ji5 wui6 haau2 bong1 hok6 saang1 zeon2 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学校会安排模拟会考帮助学生准备。
examples.english_sentence: The school will arrange mock public exams to help students prepare.

mandarin_meaning: 会见；接见；与……会面（通常指正式或安排好的会面）
english_meaning: to meet; to have an audience with; to see someone (often formally or by arrangement)
explanation_mandarin: 表示与某人见面或接见，常用于正式或官方场合，也可用于私人会面但带有书面或正式语气。
explanation_english: Indicates meeting or receiving someone, often used for formal or official meetings; can be used in private contexts but has a formal/written tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 總理今日會見外國代表。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung2 lei5 gam1 jat6 wui6 gin3 ngoi6 gwok3 doi6 biu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 总理今天会见了外国代表。
examples.english_sentence: The premier met with foreign delegates today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 律師今日會見咗佢嘅客戶，討論案件細節。
examples.jyutping_sentence: leot6 si1 gam1 jat6 wui6 gin3 zo2 keoi5 ge3 haak3 wu6, tou2 leon6 on3 gin6 sai3 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 律师今天会见了他的客户，讨论案件细节。
examples.english_sentence: The lawyer met his client today to discuss the case details.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司經理會見咗新入職嘅員工，介紹工作安排。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ging1 lei5 wui6 gin3 zo2 san1 jap6 zik1 ge3 jyun4 gung1, gaai3 siu6 gung1 zok3 ngon1 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司经理会见了新入职的员工，介绍工作安排。
examples.english_sentence: The company manager met the newly hired employee to introduce the work arrangements.

mandarin_meaning: 会计；会计学/会计人员
english_meaning: accountant; accounting
explanation_mandarin: 會計指在公司或機構中負責記錄、整理、分析與管理財務交易及報表的職位或職能，也可泛指會計這一職業或工作內容。
explanation_english: Refers to the person or role in a company or organization responsible for recording, organizing, analysing, and managing financial transactions and reports; can also refer to the profession or the practice of accounting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我哋公司嘅會計，負責每個月出報表。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 wui6gai3, fu6zaak3 mui5 go3 jyut6 ceot1 bou3 biu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我們公司的會計，負責每個月出報表。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is the accountant at our company, responsible for producing monthly reports.

mandarin_meaning: 会计学
english_meaning: accounting (the academic discipline)
explanation_mandarin: 一門研究會計原理與實務的學科，涉及記錄、分類、彙總和報告財務交易與資訊，以及審計與財務分析等。
explanation_english: An academic discipline that studies accounting principles and practice, including recording, classifying, summarizing, and reporting financial transactions and information, as well as auditing and financial analysis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺大學讀會計學，希望以後做會計師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 daai6 hok6 duk6 wui6 gai3 hok6, hei1 mong6 ji5 hau6 zou6 wui6 gai3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在大学学习会计学，希望以后做会计师。
examples.english_sentence: He studies accounting at university and hopes to become an accountant in the future.

mandarin_meaning: 會計師 (huìjìshī)：指從事會計、記帳、審計或財務諮詢等工作的專業人員，亦可指註冊會計師（CPA）。
english_meaning: accountant; certified public accountant (CPA) — a professional who performs accounting, bookkeeping, auditing, and financial consulting.
explanation_mandarin: 會計師是專門處理公司或個人財務、記帳、報稅與審計等工作的專業人士，部分會計師具有註冊資格（CPA）。
explanation_english: A professional responsible for financial record-keeping, auditing, tax filing, and financial advisory services; some accountants hold certified public accountant (CPA) qualifications.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司請咗一個會計師幫手做稅務申報。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ceng2 zo2 jat1 go3 wui6 gai3 si1 bong1 sau2 zou6 seoi3 mou6 san1 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司請了一個會計師幫忙做稅務申報。
examples.english_sentence: The company hired an accountant to help with the tax filing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係註冊會計師，專門處理審計同稅務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 zyu3 caak3 wui6 gai3 si1, zyun1 mun4 cyu2 lei5 sam2 gai3 tung4 seoi3 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是註冊會計師，專門處理審計和稅務。
examples.english_sentence: She is a certified public accountant who specializes in audits and tax matters.

mandarin_meaning: 会诊（医生之间就患者病情进行讨论或请求专家意见）
english_meaning: medical consultation among doctors; to consult (doctors) about a patient's condition
explanation_mandarin: 指多位醫生或專家就同一病人或病情進行共同討論、診斷或給予建議的過程。
explanation_english: The process in which multiple doctors or specialists discuss a patient's condition together to diagnose or give recommendations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫院今日有專家會診，幫手處理一個好複雜嘅個案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 jyun2 gam1 jat6 jau5 zyun1 gaa1 wui6 zan2, bong1 sau2 cyu2 lei5 jat1 go3 hou2 fuk1 zaap6 ge3 go3 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫院今天有專家會診，幫忙處理一個很複雜的個案。
examples.english_sentence: The hospital has a specialist consultation today to help handle a very complex case.

mandarin_meaning: 會試（huìshì）
english_meaning: hui-shi (the imperial/metropolitan examination in imperial China)
explanation_mandarin: 會試是中國古代科舉制度中的一種重要考試，通常在京城舉行，位於鄉試之後、殿試之前，通過會試者可成為進士的候補，取得進一步參加殿試的資格。
explanation_english: The hui-shi was a major exam in the imperial Chinese civil service examination system, held after the provincial (xiangshi) exam and before the palace (dianshi) exam; passing it qualified candidates to contend for the jinshi degree.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古時科舉制度中，會試係考取進士之前嘅重要一關。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si4 fo1 geoi2 zai3 dou6 zung1, wui6 si3 hai6 haau2 ceoi2 zeon3 si6 zi1 cin4 ge3 zung6 jiu3 jat1 gwaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代科舉制度中，會試是考取進士之前的重要一關。
examples.english_sentence: In the imperial examination system of ancient times, the hui-shi was an important stage before becoming a jinshi.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 通過會試之後，先有資格參加殿試，爭取進士名位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tung1 gwo3 wui6 si3 zi1 hau6, sin1 jau5 zi1 gaak3 caam1 gaa1 din6 si3, zang1 ceoi2 zeon3 si6 ming4 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 通過會試之後，才有資格參加殿試，爭取進士名位。
examples.english_sentence: Only after passing the hui-shi could one qualify for the palace exam and compete for the jinshi title.

mandarin_meaning: 會話（談話、對話；亦可指電腦或通訊系統中的會話/連線）
english_meaning: conversation; dialogue (also a session/connection in computing/communication contexts)
explanation_mandarin: 指兩人或多人之間的交談、對話或談話練習；在科技或通訊場景亦可指一個會話會話連線或會話階段。
explanation_english: Refers to an exchange of speech between two or more people (a dialogue or conversation); can also denote a session/connection in computing or communication contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想提升英文會話能力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 tai4 sing1 jing1 man4 wui6 waa6 nang4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想提升英文會話能力。
examples.english_sentence: I want to improve my English conversation skills.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師安排咗一個會話練習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 on1 paai4 zo2 jat1 go3 wui6 waa6 lin6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老師安排了一個會話練習。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher organized a conversation practice session.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個應用程式有即時會話功能。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jing3 jung6 cing4 sik1 jau5 zik1 si4 wui6 waa6 gung1 nang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個應用程式有即時會話功能。
examples.english_sentence: This app has a real-time chat/conversation feature.

mandarin_meaning: 会谈 (双方或多方为协商、讨论而进行的正式谈话)
english_meaning: talks; conference; to hold talks (formal discussions between parties)
explanation_mandarin: 指雙方或多方為討論、協商或解決問題而進行的正式談話或磋商，常用於政治、外交或商業場合。
explanation_english: Refers to formal discussions held between two or more parties to negotiate, consult, or resolve issues; commonly used in political, diplomatic, or business contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府代表同對方會談，討論邊界問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 doi6 biu2 tung4 deoi3 fong1 wui6 taam4, tou2 leon6 bin1 gaai3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府代表與對方會談，討論邊界問題。
examples.english_sentence: Government representatives held talks with the other side to discuss border issues.

mandarin_meaning: 会议（开会、讨论或商议的场合）
english_meaning: meeting; conference; session
explanation_mandarin: 指正式或非正式的人士聚集起來，為討論、決策或交流意見而舉行的活動或場合。
explanation_english: A gathering (formal or informal) of people held to discuss, decide, or exchange ideas — i.e., a meeting or conference.
