examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5dei6 gaan2zo2 nei5 heoi3 leoi5hang4, ging2jin4 mou5 ngo5, zan1hai6 jau5 nei5 mou5 ngo5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们选了你去旅行，却没有我，真是有你没我！
examples.english_sentence: They picked you for the trip and left me out — really, you but not me!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家幫手做嘢，你攞晒功勞——有你冇我咁樣做唔啱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6gaa1 bong1sau2 zou6 je5, nei5 lo2 saai3 gung1lou6 — jau5 nei5 mou5 ngo5 gam2 joeng6 zou6 m4 aam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家帮忙做事，你把功劳全拿走——有你没有我的做法不對。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone helped and you took all the credit — acting like 'you but not me' isn't right.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要縮編，可能係有你冇我，我要諗下出路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1si1 jiu3 suk1pin1, ho2nang4 hai6 jau5 nei5 mou5 ngo5, ngo5 jiu3 nam2 haa5 ceot1lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要裁员，可能是有你没我，我要想想出路。
examples.english_sentence: The company may downsize and it might be you staying and not me — I need to think about my options.

jyutping: jau5 bin6 ji4 m4 sai2 geng2
mandarin_meaning: 有便宜就別客氣 / 有好處就儘管去拿
english_meaning: If there's a bargain/freebie/benefit, don't be shy — go ahead and take it
explanation_mandarin: 常用於口語，意思是當有優惠、好處或免費的東西時，不用太客氣或猶豫，可以放心接受或利用。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning that when there's a bargain, benefit, or freebie you don't need to be overly polite or hesitant — just take advantage of it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間鋪而家做緊減價，買嘢快啲，有便宜唔使頸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 ji4 gaa1 zou6 gan2 gaam2 gaa3, maai5 je5 faai3 di1, jau5 bin6 ji4 m4 sai2 geng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間店現在在打折，快點買，有便宜就別客氣。
examples.english_sentence: This shop is having a sale now — buy quickly; if there's a bargain, don't be shy about it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司派咗免費下午茶，下晝唔好錯過，有便宜唔使頸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 paai3 zo2 min5 fai3 haa6 ng5 caa4, haa6 zau3 m4 hou2 co3 gwo3, jau5 bin6 ji4 m4 sai2 geng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司發了免費下午茶，下午別錯過；有便宜就別客氣。
examples.english_sentence: The company handed out free afternoon tea — don't miss it this afternoon; if there's a freebie, don't be shy.

mandarin_meaning: 有备无患
english_meaning: Being prepared prevents trouble; better safe than sorry.
explanation_mandarin: 表示事先做好準備，就能避免或減少災害、麻煩或損失。
explanation_english: Indicates that preparing in advance can prevent or lessen problems or harm; similar to 'better safe than sorry.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出門前要帶埋雨傘，天氣預報話會落雨，有備無患。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 mun4 cin4 jiu3 daai3 maai4 jyu5 saan3, tin1 hei3 jyu6 bou3 waa6 wui5 lok6 jyu5, jau5 bei6 mou4 waan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出門前要帶傘，天氣預報說會下雨，有備無患。
examples.english_sentence: Bring an umbrella before going out — the forecast says it will rain; better safe than sorry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你下星期有面試，記得準備好履歷同常見問題，有備無患。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 haa6 sing1 kei4 jau5 min6 si5, gei3 dak1 zeon2 bei6 hou2 leoi5 lik6 tung4 soeng4 gin3 man6 tai4, jau5 bei6 mou4 waan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你下星期有面試，記得準備好履歷和常見問題，有備無患。
examples.english_sentence: You have an interview next week — prepare your resume and common questions; it's better to be prepared.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企儲多啲糧食同急救用品，有備無患。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei2 cou5 do1 di1 loeng4 sik6 tung4 gap1 gau3 jung6 ban2, jau5 bei6 mou4 waan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在家多儲一些糧食和急救用品，有備無患。
examples.english_sentence: Store some extra food and first-aid supplies at home — better safe than sorry.

mandarin_meaning: 有备而来 / 事先做好准备
english_meaning: to come prepared; to arrive or act with prior preparation
explanation_mandarin: 表示事先做好準備才前來或應對某件事，強調有預備、不慌張。
explanation_english: Indicates arriving or acting after making prior preparations; emphasizes being well prepared and not caught off guard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今次有備而來，唔使擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 ci3 jau5 bei6 ji4 loi4, m4 sai2 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们这次有备而来，不用担心。
examples.english_sentence: We came prepared this time; no need to worry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師話考試會好嚴格，大家最好有備而來。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 waa6 haau2 si3 wui5 hou2 jim4 gaak3, daai6 gaa1 zeoi3 hou2 jau5 bei6 ji4 loi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师说考试会很严格，大家最好有备而来。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher said the exam will be strict; it's best everyone comes prepared.

mandarin_meaning: 有伤风化（指言行或景象不雅、淫秽，违背社会风俗）
english_meaning: Indecent; obscene; offensive to public decency
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容词（惯用词语/成语性短语）
explanation_mandarin: 用来形容言行、影像或事物不雅观、淫秽，可能损害社会风气或影响公众道德观感。
explanation_english: Used to describe speech, images, or behavior that are indecent or obscene and may harm public morals or offend social propriety.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁啲畫面唔啱畀細路睇，會有傷風化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 di1 waa2min6 m4 aam1 bei2 sai3lou6 tai2, wui5 jau5 soeng1 fung1 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这样的画面不适合给小孩子看，会有伤风化。
examples.english_sentence: Such scenes aren't suitable for children and could be considered indecent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢着得好裸露，有啲人話有傷風化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 dak1 hou2 lo2 lou6, jau5 di1 jan4 waa6 jau5 soeng1 fung1 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他穿得很暴露，有些人说这有伤风化。
examples.english_sentence: He dresses very revealingly; some people say it's indecent.

mandarin_meaning: 可以談談／可以商量
english_meaning: open to discussion; willing to talk things over; negotiable
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語表達，表示對某事願意討論或協商，還有商量的空間。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression indicating willingness to discuss or negotiate; there is room to talk things over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你唔滿意，我哋可以有傾有講，慢慢傾吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 m4 mun5 ji3, ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 jau5 king1 jau5 gong2, maan6 maan6 king1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不滿意，我們可以好好談談，慢慢商量。
examples.english_sentence: If you're not satisfied, we can talk it over—take our time to discuss.

mandarin_meaning: 有價值、好賣（暢銷）
english_meaning: valuable and easy to sell; in demand; sells well and can fetch a good price
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，用來形容某件商品或事物有價值或受歡迎，容易以好價錢賣出或暢銷。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase used to describe an item or thing that is valuable or popular and therefore easy to sell or sells well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部新手機有價好賣，成日賣斷市。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 san1 sau2 gei1 jau5 gaa3 hou2 maai6, sing4 jat6 maai6 dyun6 si5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這款新手機有價值、好賣，經常斷貨。
examples.english_sentence: This new phone is valuable and sells well; it's often sold out.

mandarin_meaning: 有价有市（意思是有价值且有市场、受欢迎或畅销）
english_meaning: Valuable and marketable; in demand; sells well
explanation_mandarin: 表示某物或某人具有價值並且在市場上受歡迎、容易出售或備受追捧。
explanation_english: Indicates that something or someone is valuable and has a market — popular, in demand, or sells well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部手錶而家好有價有市，收藏家爭住買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 sau2 biu1 ji4 gaa1 hou2 jau5 gaa3 jau5 si5, sou1 cong4 gaa1 zaang1 zyu6 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這塊手錶現在很有價有市，收藏家爭相購買。
examples.english_sentence: This watch is now highly valued and in demand; collectors are snapping it up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗幾年好嘅作品，所以喺業界好有價有市。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 gei2 nin4 hou2 ge3 zok3 ban2, so2 ji5 hai2 jip6 gaai3 hou2 jau5 gaa3 jau5 si5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了幾年優秀的作品，所以在業界非常有價有市。
examples.english_sentence: He has produced several excellent works over the years, so he's very valued and in demand in the industry.

mandarin_meaning: 值得一提 / 值得談論
english_meaning: worth mentioning / worth discussing
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，表示某事有價值或有重要性，值得提出或討論。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese expression meaning something is valuable or important enough to mention or discuss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事真係有價講，老闆要注意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 zan1 hai6 jau5 gaa3 gong2, lou5 baan2 jiu3 zyu3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事真的值得談，老闆需要注意。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is really worth discussing; the boss needs to pay attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇啲有價講嘅建議？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 di1 jau5 gaa3 gong2 ge3 gin3 ji5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有沒有一些值得一提的建議？
examples.english_sentence: Do you have any suggestions worth mentioning?

mandarin_meaning: 曾經兩度分手
english_meaning: have broken up twice
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語，表示與某人分手過兩次，曾兩次結束戀愛關係但未必永久分開。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase meaning to have broken up (with someone) twice — i.e., a relationship has ended on two separate occasions (not necessarily permanently).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋呢段戀情有兩度散手，最後先至復合。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ni1 dyun6 lyun2 cing4 jau5 loeng5 dou6 saan3 sau2, zeoi6 hau6 sin1 zi3 fuk1 hap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们这段恋情曾经两次分手，最后才复合。
examples.english_sentence: We broke up twice in this relationship and only reconciled later.

mandarin_meaning: 很有本事／很會做事；有一手
english_meaning: skilled; capable; good at something (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，表示某人在某方面有技巧或能力，做事很拿手；有時也含有有手段或有一套的意思。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase meaning someone is skilled or capable in a certain area; can also imply having clever methods or tricks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係有兩手，個項目做得好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 jau5 loeng5 sau2, go3 hong6 muk6 zou6 dak1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的很有本事，這個項目做得很好。
examples.english_sentence: He's really capable; he did this project very well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢位師傅有兩手，修冷氣好快就整好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wai2 si1 fu2 jau5 loeng5 sau2, sau1 laang5 hei3 hou2 faai3 zau6 zing2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這位師傅很有一手，修空調很快就修好了。
examples.english_sentence: This technician is skilled; he fixed the air conditioner quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 有本事；很厲害（口語）
english_meaning: to be capable/skillful; impressive (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容某人或某事有本事、很厲害或有技巧。屬香港口語用法，帶讚賞或肯定意味。
explanation_english: A colloquial Hong Kong expression used to describe someone or something as capable, skillful, or impressive. Often used to praise ability or competence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打籃球好勁，真係有兩道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 laan4 kau4 hou2 ging6, zan1 hai6 jau5 loeng5 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打籃球很厲害，真有本事。
examples.english_sentence: He's great at basketball — he really has skill.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好睇低佢，佢其實好有兩道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 tai2 dai1 keoi5, keoi5 kei4 sat6 hou2 jau5 loeng5 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你別看低他，他其實很有本事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't underestimate him; he's actually pretty capable.

mandarin_meaning: 有兩種應對方法／有備案
english_meaning: to have two ways of handling something; to have backup plans or alternative approaches
explanation_mandarin: 香港口語，指在處理事情時有兩套或多套應對方法或退路；有時也帶有機智變通、手段多的含義。
explanation_english: Hong Kong colloquial/slang meaning having two (or more) ways to deal with a situation — i.e., backup plans or alternative approaches. It can imply resourcefulness or having contingency options.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使擔心，佢有兩道散手，點都可以應付到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 daam1 sam1, keoi5 jau5 loeng5 dou6 saan3 sau2, dim2 dou1 ho2 ji5 jing3 fu6 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用擔心，他有兩套應對方法，無論如何都能應付。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry — he has two ways to handle it; he can cope no matter what.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果第一個計劃唔得，我哋仲有兩道散手可以用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 dai6 jat1 go3 gai3 waak6 m4 dak1, ngo5 dei6 zung6 jau5 loeng5 dou6 saan3 sau2 ho2 ji5 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果第一個計劃不行，我們還有兩套備用方案可以使用。
examples.english_sentence: If plan A doesn't work, we still have two backup plans we can use.

mandarin_meaning: 有没有
english_meaning: have or not; whether or not (used to form yes/no questions)
explanation_mandarin: 「有冇」是廣東話口語用法，用來構成是非問句，相當於普通話的「有沒有」，表示「是否有、是否曾經」。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese interrogative phrase used to form yes/no questions, equivalent to Mandarin "有没有" or English "have or not / whether or not".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇去過香港？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 heoi3 gwo3 hoeng1 gong2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有没有去过香港？
examples.english_sentence: Have you ever been to Hong Kong?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇收到我啲訊息？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 sau1 dou3 ngo5 di1 seon3 sik1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有没有收到我的信息？
examples.english_sentence: Did you receive my messages?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有冇人識講英文？
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 mou5 jan4 sik1 gong2 jing1 man4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有没有人会说英文？
examples.english_sentence: Is there anyone who can speak English?

mandarin_meaning: 有沒有那麼⋯ / 有必要那麼⋯（口語、反問或感嘆）
english_meaning: Is it really that... / Do you have to be so... (colloquial, rhetorical)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，常用於反問或表達驚訝、不滿、誇張語氣，等同普通話的「有沒有那麼⋯」或「有必要那麼⋯」。後接形容詞或動詞短語。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used for rhetorical questions, surprise, annoyance, or to intensify a statement. Equivalent to Mandarin "有沒有那麼..." or English "Is it really that..."/"Do you have to be so...". It is followed by an adjective or verb phrase.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇咁叻呀？唔好咁自大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 gam2 lek1 aa3? m4 hou2 gam2 zi6 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有必要那麼厲害嗎？別那麼自大。
examples.english_sentence: Do you have to be that clever? Don't be so arrogant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫有冇咁貴？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 jau5 mou5 gam2 gwi3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件衣服有沒有那麼貴？
examples.english_sentence: Is this piece of clothing really that expensive?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢遲到有冇咁離譜啦？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci4 dou3 jau5 mou5 gam2 lei6 pou2 laa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他遲到有沒有那麼離譜啊？
examples.english_sentence: Is his being late really that outrageous?

mandarin_meaning: （口語）你在開玩笑嗎？/有沒有搞錯
english_meaning: Are you kidding me? / You've got to be kidding / Are you serious?
explanation_mandarin: 用來表達對某人說話或行為感到驚訝、不滿或不可置信的口語用語。常帶有憤怒或嘲諷語氣，屬於廣東話的俗語或俚語。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to show disbelief, anger, or incredulity at someone's words or actions. Often rude or sarcastic in tone; slangy and common in Hong Kong Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你俾咗我咁少錢？有冇搞錯！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bei2 zo2 ngo5 gam2 siu2 cin2? jau5 mou5 gaau2 co3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你給了我這麼少錢？你在開玩笑吧！
examples.english_sentence: You gave me so little money? Are you kidding me!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢竟然叫我滾，真係有冇搞錯？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging2 jin4 giu3 ngo5 gwan2, zan1 hai6 jau5 mou5 gaau2 co3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他竟然叫我滾，這是在開玩笑吧？
examples.english_sentence: He actually told me to get lost — seriously, are you kidding?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做錯咗成個報告？有冇搞錯！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 co3 zo2 seng4 go3 bou3 gou3? jau5 mou5 gaau2 co3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你把整份報告都做錯了？你在開玩笑嗎！
examples.english_sentence: You messed up the entire report? Are you kidding?

jyutping: jau5 jyun1 wat1 mou4 lou6 sou3
mandarin_meaning: 有冤屈卻沒有途徑或對象可以申訴（有冤屈無處申訴）
english_meaning: To be wronged but have no way to seek redress; to have grievances with nowhere or no one to appeal to
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人遭受委屈或不公，但沒有渠道、支持或對象去申訴或討回公道，常用於口語。
explanation_english: Expresses that someone has been wronged but lacks the means, channel, or person to complain to or seek justice; commonly used colloquially.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀人冤枉，但又搵唔到人幫手，真係有冤屈無路訴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 jyun1 wong5, daan6 jau6 wan2 m4 dou3 jan4 bong1 sau2, zan1 hai6 jau5 jyun1 wat1 mou4 lou6 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被冤枉，但又找不到人幫忙，真是有冤屈無處申訴。
examples.english_sentence: He was wronged but can't find anyone to help; he truly has grievances with no way to seek redress.

mandarin_meaning: 有冤無處申訴 / 冤屈無處訴說
english_meaning: To have a grievance but nowhere to seek redress; to have a complaint but no way to voice it or get justice.
explanation_mandarin: 形容有人受到不公平對待，但沒有渠道或方法可以申訴或討回公道。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone has been wronged but has no channel or means to complain or obtain justice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋被公司不公正咁炒，冇證據亦冇人相信，真係有冤無路訴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 bei6 gung1si1 bat1 gung1zing3 gam2 caau2, mou5 zing3geoi3 jik6 mou5 jan4 soeng1seon3, zan1 hai6 jau5 jyun1 mou4 lou6 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们被公司不公正地辞退，没证据也没人相信，真是有冤无处申诉。
examples.english_sentence: They were unfairly fired by the company; there is no evidence and no one believes them — they really have grievances but nowhere to seek redress.

mandarin_meaning: 有凸起／有突起（常指身體或物件有突出的部分；口語亦可指懷孕—如「有凸肚」）
english_meaning: has a bulge/protrusion (often used for a body or item showing a bump; colloquially can imply pregnancy, e.g., 'has a bulging belly')
explanation_mandarin: 表示某處有凸出或隆起，常用來形容肚子、衣物或包包出現鼓起的地方。口語中與「肚」連用（如「有凸肚」）可暗示懷孕或肚腩明顯。
explanation_english: Describes a protrusion or bulge — commonly used for a belly, clothing, or bags that show a lump. In colloquial speech, used with 'belly' (e.g., '有凸肚') it can imply pregnancy or a noticeable paunch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近有凸肚，可能懷孕喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 jau5 dat1 tou5, ho2 nang4 waai4 jan1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她最近肚子有些凸起，可能懷孕了。
examples.english_sentence: Her belly has been bulging recently; she might be pregnant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你件褲前面有凸，係咪放咗啲嘢入面？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gin6 fu3 cin4 min6 jau5 dat1, hai6 mai6 fong3 zo2 di1 je5 jap6 min6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你那條褲子前面有凸，是不是放了東西在裡面？
examples.english_sentence: Your pants have a bulge at the front — did you put something in them?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個袋有凸，可能裝太多嘢喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 doi2 jau5 dat1, ho2 nang4 zong1 taai3 do1 je5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個袋子鼓起來了，可能裝太多東西了。
examples.english_sentence: This bag is bulging; it might be holding too much.

mandarin_meaning: 懂得分寸；行為得體
english_meaning: to be tactful; to know what's appropriate; to have a sense of propriety or moderation
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人說話或做事適當，知道分寸，不會超出界限或冒犯他人。
explanation_english: Indicates someone behaves or speaks appropriately and knows their limits; being tactful and not overstepping boundaries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做人好有分寸，講嘢從來唔會得罪人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 jan4 hou2 jau5 fan1 cyun3, gong2 je5 cung4 loi4 m4 wui5 dak1 zeoi6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做人很有分寸，說話從來不會得罪人。
examples.english_sentence: He conducts himself with tact and never offends people when he speaks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開玩笑可以，但要有分寸，唔好講得太過份。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 waan2 siu3 ho2 ji5, daan6 jiu3 jau5 fan1 cyun3, m4 hou2 gong2 dak1 taai3 gwo3 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 可以開玩笑，但要有分寸，不要說得太過分。
examples.english_sentence: Jokes are fine, but you should know your limits and not go too far.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）有可取之處/值得肯定；也可指有分數、得分
english_meaning: colloquial phrase meaning to have merit or earn credit/points; also can literally mean to have a score
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞短語/動詞短語（口語）
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語表達，表示某人或某事有值得肯定的地方、表現不錯、令人刮目相看；在字面上也可指有分數或得分。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression indicating someone/something has merit, is worthy of credit, or performs well; literally can also mean to have points/a score.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今次做得有分數，老闆應該會獎勵你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 ci3 zou6 dak1 jau5 fan1 sou3, lou5 baan2 jing1 goi1 wui5 zoeng2 lai6 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這次做得有分數，老闆應該會獎勵你。
examples.english_sentence: You did well this time; the boss should reward you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅菜有分數，值得一試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 coi3 jau5 fan1 sou3, zik1 dak1 jat1 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間餐廳的菜有分數，值得一試。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is pretty decent; worth trying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲作品有分數，評審俾咗好評。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 zok3 ban2 jau5 fan1 sou3, ping4 sam2 bei2 zo2 hou2 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的作品有分數，評審給了好評。
examples.english_sentence: His works have merit; the judges gave good reviews.

mandarin_meaning: 有别 / 有区别 / 不同
english_meaning: to be different; to have distinction; to differ
explanation_mandarin: 表示与其他事物存在差别或区分，常用于书面或较正式的语境，可与「於／于…」搭配（如「有别于…」）。
explanation_english: Indicates a distinction or difference from something else. Often used in written or formal contexts; commonly appears as '有別於/有别于...' meaning 'be different from'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩個產品有別，你唔好搞錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 loeng5 go3 caan2 ban2 jau5 bit6, nei5 m4 hou2 gaau2 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两个产品有别，你不要搞错。
examples.english_sentence: These two products are different; don't mix them up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅風格有別於其他歌手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 fung1 gaak3 jau5 bit6 jyu1 kei4 taa1 go1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的风格有别于其他歌手。
examples.english_sentence: His style is distinct from other singers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新方案與舊方案有別，細節要講清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 fong1 on3 jyu5 gau6 fong1 on3 jau5 bit6, sai3 zit3 jiu3 gong2 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新方案与旧方案有别，细节要说明清楚。
examples.english_sentence: The new plan differs from the old one; the details need to be made clear.

mandarin_meaning: 有利 (yǒulì)
english_meaning: advantageous; beneficial; profitable
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某人或某事有幫助、有利益或具有優勢，通常用作形容詞，例如在經濟、策略或決策上帶來好處。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is beneficial, advantageous, or profitable for someone or something; commonly used as an adjective to describe benefits or advantages in contexts like business, strategy, or decisions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個提議對公司有利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 tai4 ji5 deoi3 gung1 si1 jau5 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个提议对公司有利。
examples.english_sentence: This proposal is advantageous for the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買呢批貨會對公司有利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 ni1 pat1 fo3 wui5 deoi3 gung1 si1 jau5 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 买这批货会对公司有利。
examples.english_sentence: Buying this batch of goods will be profitable for the company.

mandarin_meaning: 有利可图
english_meaning: profitable; lucrative; there is profit to be made
explanation_mandarin: 表示某件事或機會可以帶來利益或賺錢的機會，值得去做或圖利。
explanation_english: Indicates that something offers profit or benefits — a situation that is worth pursuing because it can be lucrative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單生意真係有利可圖，大家都想投資。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 saang1 ji3 zan1 hai6 jau5 lei6 ho2 tou4, daai6 gaa1 dou1 soeng2 tau4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这笔生意真有利可图，大家都想投资。
examples.english_sentence: This business deal is really lucrative; everyone wants to invest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到呢個市場有利可圖，就打算擴大生產。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou3 ni1 go3 si5 coeng4 jau5 lei6 ho2 tou4, zau6 daa2 syun3 kwok3 daai6 saang1 caan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到这个市场有利可图，就打算扩大生产。
examples.english_sentence: He saw the market is profitable, so he plans to scale up production.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心唔好畀有利可圖嘅承諾騙咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 m4 hou2 bei2 jau5 lei6 ho2 tou4 ge3 sing4 nok6 pin3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心不要被有利可图的承诺骗了。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful not to be deceived by promises of profit.

jyutping: jau5 zak1 goi2 zi1, mou4 zak1 gaa1 min5
mandarin_meaning: 有則改之，無則加勉（有錯就改，沒有就要自勉）
english_meaning: If there are faults, correct them; if not, encourage yourself to do even better.
explanation_mandarin: 一句勉勵或規勸的話：遇到自己的缺點或錯誤要改正，若沒有錯則要更加努力、自我勉勵。
explanation_english: A motto/admonition meaning: correct your mistakes when you have them; if you have none, continue to encourage and improve yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面試完之後，主管提醒大家：有則改之，無則加勉，希望大家繼續努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 si3 jyun4 zi1 hau6, zyu2 gun2 tai4 sing2 daai6 gaa1: jau5 zak1 goi2 zi1, mou4 zak1 gaa1 min5. hei1 mong6 daai6 gaa1 gai3 zuk6 nou5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面试结束后，主管提醒大家：有则改之，无则加勉，希望大家继续努力。
examples.english_sentence: After the interview, the supervisor reminded everyone: 'If there are mistakes, correct them; if not, strive to improve,' hoping everyone would keep working hard.

mandarin_meaning: 有前沒後 / 有頭無尾（可指做事有開始沒延續或家無後代）
english_meaning: lit. 'have front, no back' — indicates something exists at the start but not afterwards; used to describe starting things without finishing, or having predecessors but no descendants
explanation_mandarin: 表示前面有（開頭、資源或前人），但後面沒有（延續、結果或後代）；可用來形容做事有頭無尾或家中無後嗣。
explanation_english: Indicates that there is something at the front (a beginning, resources, or predecessors) but nothing afterwards (continuation, outcome, or descendants). Used to describe someone who starts things but doesn't finish, or a family with no descendants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢成日有前冇後，諗到一半就唔做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 sing4 jat6 jau5 cin4 mou5 hau6, lam2 dou3 jat1 bun3 zau6 m4 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事總是有頭無尾，想了一半就不做。
examples.english_sentence: He always starts things but never finishes them; he stops halfway.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢冇仔冇女，屋企人擔心佢會冇後，成日話佢有前冇後。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou5 zai2 mou5 neoi5, uk1 kei5 jan4 daam1 sam1 keoi5 wui5 mou5 hau6, sing4 jat6 waa6 keoi5 jau5 cin4 mou5 hau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他沒有兒女，家人擔心他會沒有後代，常說他有前沒後。
examples.english_sentence: He has no children; the family worries he will have no descendants and often say he 'has no offspring to carry on the line'.

jyutping: jau5 cin4 mou5 hau6, daa2 sei2 baa6 zau6
mandarin_meaning: 前途無望／沒出路，乾脆打死算了（口語化、帶誇張的罵人或誓言）
english_meaning: No future/no prospect; (exaggerated) might as well beat/kill it — a colloquial, hyperbolic expression of resignation or contempt
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 口語化片語／俚語（感嘆、罵人用語）
explanation_mandarin: 「有前冇後」指沒有前途或沒有後路；「打死罷就」是誇張性的口語說法，表示放棄、了結或用粗暴語氣表達厭惡與絕望。整句多用作鄉土口語、帶侮蔑或無奈的語氣，並含有暴力誇張成分，屬於非正式用語。
explanation_english: “有前冇後” literally means “there is a front but no back,” i.e. no future or no backing/outlet. “打死罷就” is a hyperbolic, colloquial tag meaning “might as well beat/kill it” used to express giving up or scorn. The full phrase is an informal, often insulting or resigned remark; it uses violent exaggeration and should be treated as slang.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲生意做得咁差，真係有前冇後，打死罷就。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 saang1 ji3 zou6 dak1 gam2 caa1, zan1 hai6 jau5 cin4 mou5 hau6, daa2 sei2 baa6 zau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的生意做得這麼差，真是前途無望，乾脆打死算了。
examples.english_sentence: His business is doing so badly—there's no future; might as well kill it (i.e., just give up).

mandarin_meaning: 懂禮貌、顧及前後、有分寸
english_meaning: considerate; well-mannered; knows proper decorum and is tactful
explanation_mandarin: 形容一個人待人處事有禮貌、懂得顧及前後與他人感受、做事有分寸與分別場面。
explanation_english: Describes someone who behaves with proper manners and tact, mindful of the consequences of their actions on others and observing appropriate social propriety.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要有前有後，唔好亂講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 jau5 cin4 jau5 hau6, m4 hou2 lyun6 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要有分寸，不要亂說話。
examples.english_sentence: You should be considerate; don't speak recklessly.

mandarin_meaning: 有剩（有剩餘、剩下）
english_meaning: to have leftovers; to have something remaining; there is spare/left over
explanation_mandarin: 表示某物沒有全部用完，還有剩餘，多用於口語，例如說飯菜或物資還留有部分沒有被吃掉或使用。
explanation_english: Indicates that something remains or is left over (not completely used up). Commonly used in everyday speech to refer to leftover food or spare amounts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚飯有剩，可以聽日當午餐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 faan6 jau5 zing6, ho2 ji5 ting1 jat6 dong3 ng5 caan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚的飯有剩，可以明天當午餐。
examples.english_sentence: There's leftover dinner tonight; we can use it for lunch tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢盒蛋糕有剩，你要一件嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 hap6 daan6 gou1 jau5 zing6, nei5 jiu3 jat1 gin6 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這盒蛋糕有剩，你要一塊嗎？
examples.english_sentence: There are some pieces of cake left in this box; do you want one?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好買咁多，免得有剩浪費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 maai5 gam3 do1, min5 dak1 jau5 zing6 long6 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別買那麼多，免得有剩浪費。
examples.english_sentence: Don't buy so much, so you won't have leftovers and waste them.

mandarin_meaning: 有創意 (yǒu chuàngyì)
english_meaning: creative; inventive; imaginative
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人或某事具有新穎、富有想像力或能提出創新點子的特質。
explanation_english: Describes a person or thing that is original, inventive, or full of imagination and new ideas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你呢個主意好有創意！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ni1 go3 zyu2 ji3 hou2 jau5 cong3 ji3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的這個主意很有創意！
examples.english_sentence: Your idea is very creative!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司好鍾意搵有創意嘅設計師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 hou2 zung1 ji3 wan2 jau5 cong3 ji3 ge3 cit3 gai3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司很喜歡找有創意的設計師。
examples.english_sentence: The company likes to hire creative designers.

mandarin_meaning: 有力 / 强有力、有影响力、有效
english_meaning: powerful; forceful; effective; convincing
explanation_mandarin: 表示具有力量或效力，能產生顯著影響或效果；口語中也可用來形容言語、表現有說服力或氣勢。
explanation_english: Indicates having strength or force — powerful or effective. Can describe things that produce noticeable impact or effect, and in colloquial use can describe speech or performance that is forceful or convincing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻廣告好有力，吸引到好多客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 gwong2 gou3 hou2 jau5 lik6, kap1 jan5 dou3 hou2 do1 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個廣告很有力，吸引了很多客人。
examples.english_sentence: This advertisement is very effective and attracted many customers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢好有力，成班人聽完都有共鳴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 jau5 lik6, seng4 baan1 jan4 teng1 jyun4 dou1 jau5 gung6 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他／她說話很有力，大家聽完都有共鳴。
examples.english_sentence: He/She speaks forcefully and everyone felt a resonance after listening.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個方案好有力，可以改善生產效率。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fong1 on3 hou2 jau5 lik6, ho2 ji5 goi2 sin6 saang1 caan2 haau6 leot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個方案很有力，可以改善生產效率。
examples.english_sentence: This plan is strong/effective and can improve production efficiency.

mandarin_meaning: 增加；有所增長（偏書面或文言用法）
english_meaning: to increase; to add (more formal/literary usage)
explanation_mandarin: 「有加」在粵語中多見於書面或較文言的表達，表示數量或程度上有所增加。在口語中多用「增加」「多了」等說法。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, 有加 is a more formal or literary expression meaning that something has increased or been added. In everyday speech speakers typically use 增加, 多咗, or similar expressions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工作嘅壓力有加。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 zok3 ge3 ngaat3 lik6 jau5 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這份工作的壓力增加了。
examples.english_sentence: The pressure of this job has increased.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司人手有加，我哋可以分擔得少啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jan4 sau2 jau5 gaa1, ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 fan1 daam1 dak1 siu2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司人手增加了，我們可以分擔得少一些。
examples.english_sentence: The company has more staff now, so we can share the workload a bit less.

mandarin_meaning: 有助（于）/ 有益
english_meaning: be helpful to; be conducive to
explanation_mandarin: 表示對實現某事有幫助或有利，常用來說明某種行為或情況能促進或改善結果。
explanation_english: Indicates that something helps, is beneficial, or contributes to achieving or improving something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 定期運動有助保持身體健康。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ding6 kei4 wan6 dung6 jau5 zo6 bou2 ci4 san1 tai2 gin6 hong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 定期運動有助保持身體健康。
examples.english_sentence: Regular exercise helps maintain physical health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲措施有助減低感染風險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 cou3 si1 jau5 zo6 gaam2 dai1 gam2 jim5 fung1 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些措施有助降低感染風險。
examples.english_sentence: These measures help reduce the risk of infection.

mandarin_meaning: 既有勇气又有谋略
english_meaning: both brave and resourceful; brave and tactically astute
explanation_mandarin: 形容一個人既勇敢又有策略，能夠果斷行動並善於策劃和應變。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is both courageous and strategic—able to act decisively and plan or adapt cleverly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺呢次談判入面表現得好有勇有謀，成功為公司爭取到最有利嘅條件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ni1 ci3 taam4pun3 jap6min6 biu2jin6 dak1 hou2 jau5 jung5 jau5 mau4, sing4gung1 wai4 gung1si1 zang1ceoi2 dou3 zeoi3 jau5lei6 ge3 tiu4gin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在這次談判中表現得既有勇氣又有謀略，成功為公司爭取到最有利的條件。
examples.english_sentence: He performed with both bravery and strategic skill in this negotiation, successfully securing the most favorable terms for the company.

mandarin_meaning: 有勇无谋
english_meaning: Brave but lacking strategy or prudence; rash and ill-considered
explanation_mandarin: 形容一個人有勇氣但缺乏計劃或智慧，做事莽撞，容易導致失敗或麻煩。
explanation_english: Describes someone who has courage but lacks strategy or wisdom; acts rashly without careful planning, often causing mistakes or problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做事成日有勇無謀，結果害公司損失咗幾多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 si6 seng4 jat6 jau5 jung5 mou4 mau4, git3 gwo2 hoi6 gung1 si1 syun2 sat1 zo2 gei2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事常常有勇无谋，结果害公司损失了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: He often acts bravely without planning, and as a result caused the company to lose a lot of money.

mandarin_meaning: 麻烦 / 劳驾
english_meaning: Please; sorry to trouble you; (a polite way to request help or a favor)
explanation_mandarin: 「有勞」是粤语中的礼貌用语，用来在请求别人帮忙或委婉表达“麻烦你……”时表示客气或致谢。
explanation_english: A Cantonese polite expression used when asking someone to do something or to politely indicate 'please' or 'sorry to trouble you.' Often used to request help or to thank someone for their effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有勞你幫我改一改呢份文件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 lou4 nei5 bong1 ngo5 goi2 jat1 goi2 ni1 fan6 man4 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦你帮我修改一下这份文件。
examples.english_sentence: Please could you help me edit this document?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有勞您等一陣，唔該。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 lou4 nei5 dang2 jat1 zan6, m4 goi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 劳驾您等一下，谢谢。
examples.english_sentence: Please wait a moment, thank you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有勞儘快回覆，多謝晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 lou4 zeon2 faai3 wui4 fuk1, do1 ze6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 劳烦尽快回复，非常感谢。
examples.english_sentence: Please reply as soon as possible; many thanks.

mandarin_meaning: 有地位/有面子/有排面
english_meaning: to have status, prestige, or face; to be classy/ respected
explanation_mandarin: 香港廣東話俗語，表示一個人在社會或某個圈子裡有地位、面子或影響力，常用來形容受人尊重或很有排面的情況。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang phrase meaning someone has social status, prestige, or 'face' — i.e., they are respected, influential, or appear classy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺業界好有卡士，大家都好尊重佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jip6 gaai3 hou2 jau5 kaa1 si6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 zyun1 zung6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在業界很有地位，大家都很尊重他。
examples.english_sentence: He has a lot of standing in the industry; everyone respects him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你着咁高級嘅衫，好有卡士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoek3 gam2 gou1 kap1 ge3 saam1, hou2 jau5 kaa1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你穿那麼高級的衣服，很有排面。
examples.english_sentence: Wearing such expensive clothes makes you look very classy.

mandarin_meaning: 危机中有机会；有风险才有机会
english_meaning: Where there's risk (danger), there's opportunity; crisis brings opportunity.
explanation_mandarin: 一句粵語俗語/俚語，強調危險或危機常伴隨機會，鼓勵在風險中尋找商機或轉機。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial saying/idiom meaning that danger or crisis often brings opportunity; it encourages seeking chances in risky situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單投資雖然有風險，但有危先有機，唔試點知有冇機會？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 tau4 zi1 seoi1 jin4 jau5 fung1 him2, daan6 jau5 ngai4 sin1 jau5 gei1, m4 si3 dim2 zi1 jau5 mou5 gei1 wui6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次投資雖然有風險，但有危才有機會，不試怎麼知道有沒有機會？
examples.english_sentence: This investment has risks, but where there's risk there's opportunity — if you don't try, how will you know if there's a chance?

mandarin_meaning: 人人称赞／广为传颂
english_meaning: universally praised; widely acclaimed
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語（用作形容詞或謂語）
explanation_mandarin: 形容大家一致稱讚，廣為傳頌，沒有負面評價。
explanation_english: An idiom describing something or someone that is praised by everyone and widely acclaimed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲一出就有口皆碑，票房仲好過預期。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 jat1 ceot1 zau6 jau5 hau2 gaai1 bei1, piu3 fong4 zung6 hou2 gwo3 jyu6 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影一上映就受到一致好评，票房也超出预期。
examples.english_sentence: This movie was universally praised as soon as it was released, and the box office even exceeded expectations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做事一向認真，喺公司入面有口皆碑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 si6 jat1 hoeng3 jing6 zan1, hai2 gung1 si1 jap6 min6 jau5 hau2 gaai1 bei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事一向认真，在公司里人人称赞。
examples.english_sentence: He has always been conscientious; he's widely praised within the company.

jyutping: jau5 hau2 waa6 jan4, mou5 hau2 waa6 zi6 gei2
mandarin_meaning: 只敢说别人，不肯反省或检讨自己
english_meaning: Quick to criticize others but unwilling to criticize or reflect on oneself; hypocritical
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人總是指責別人，卻不檢討或承認自己的錯誤，有雙重標準或虛偽的意味。
explanation_english: Describes someone who readily blames or criticizes others but refuses to examine or admit their own faults — implies hypocrisy or double standards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日有口話人，冇口話自己，點可以做好團隊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 jau5 hau2 waa6 jan4, mou5 hau2 waa6 zi6 gei2, dim2 ho2 ji5 zou6 hou2 tyun4 deoi6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是只會說別人，不會檢討自己，怎麼能做好團隊？
examples.english_sentence: He always criticizes others and never reflects on himself — how can he help the team succeed?

mandarin_meaning: 难以言表 / 难以启齿
english_meaning: unable to express in words; hard to say; at a loss for words (often because it's difficult, embarrassing, or inappropriate to speak)
explanation_mandarin: 指雖然有口，但難以用言語把心中的苦衷、委屈或尴尬說出來，或因為不便公開而無法表達。
explanation_english: Indicates that one cannot easily put something into words — whether due to embarrassment, injustice, complexity, or because it's inappropriate or inconvenient to speak publicly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人誤會咁深，真係有口難言。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 ng6 wui6 gam2 sam1, zan1 hai6 jau5 hau2 naan4 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人误会得这么深，真是有口难言。
examples.english_sentence: He's been so deeply misunderstood that he really has nothing to say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 關於公司嘅內部問題，員工真係有口難言，唔敢公開講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwaan1 jyu1 gung1 si1 ge3 noi6 bou6 man6 tai4, jyun4 gung1 zan1 hai6 jau5 hau2 naan4 jin4, m4 gaam2 gung1 hoi1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 关于公司的内部问题，员工真是有口难言，不敢公开说出来。
examples.english_sentence: Regarding the company's internal issues, the employees really can't speak up; they don't dare to speak out publicly.

mandarin_meaning: 口齒伶俐；說話清楚、有條理（也可指能言善道）
english_meaning: articulate; having clear diction; able to speak well
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人說話清楚、有條理、能言善道，或在辯論、表達上有優勢。
explanation_english: Describes someone who speaks clearly and coherently, is articulate or persuasive in speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好有口齒，做銷售好啱佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jau5 hau2 ci2, zou6 siu1 sau6 hou2 aam1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很會說話，做銷售很適合他。
examples.english_sentence: He's very articulate; sales suits him well.

mandarin_meaning: 有點不對勁／有蹊蹺
english_meaning: there's something strange/fishy; something's not right
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事或某情況不尋常、可疑或可能有問題，常用於口語中表達懷疑或警覺。
explanation_english: Used to indicate that something is unusual, suspicious, or not right. Commonly used in spoken Cantonese to express doubt or concern.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲解釋聽落有古怪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 gaai2 sik1 teng1 lok6 jau5 gu2 gwaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的解释听起来有点蹊跷。
examples.english_sentence: His explanations sound fishy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事有古怪，最好唔好一個人去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 jau5 gu2 gwaai3, zeoi3 hou2 m4 hou2 jat1 go3 jan4 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事有点不对劲，最好不要一个人去。
examples.english_sentence: There's something off about this; it's best not to go alone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好耐冇返工，係咪有古怪？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 noi6 mou5 faan1 gung1, hai6 mai6 jau5 gu2 gwaai3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很久没上班，是不是有什么问题？
examples.english_sentence: He hasn't gone to work for a long time — is something up?

mandarin_meaning: 有史以来 (yǒushǐ yǐlái)
english_meaning: since the beginning of recorded history; in all of history; ever
explanation_mandarin: 表示从有记录的历史开始到现在，常用于强调程度、范围或在历史中前所未有的情况。
explanation_english: Indicates from the beginning of recorded history until now; often used to emphasize extent, scope, or that something is unprecedented in history.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事係有史以來最嚴重嘅災難之一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 hai6 jau5 si2 ji5 loi4 zeoi3 jim4 zung6 ge3 zoi1 naan6 zi1 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事是有史以来最严重的灾难之一。
examples.english_sentence: This is one of the most serious disasters in recorded history.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢創下嘅紀錄係有史以來冇人打破過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cong3 haa6 ge3 gei2 luk6 hai6 jau5 si2 ji5 loi4 mou5 jan4 daa2 po3 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他创下的纪录是有史以来无人打破过的。
examples.english_sentence: The record he set has never been broken in recorded history.

mandarin_meaning: 有關部門；有關官員
english_meaning: the relevant authorities; the officials in charge
explanation_mandarin: 書面或公文用語，指負責處理某事的有關官員或主管部門。
explanation_english: A formal/literary term referring to the officials or departments responsible for handling a matter; commonly used in official documents and formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事要交畀有司處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 jiu3 gaau1 bei2 jau5 si1 cyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事要交給有關部門處理。
examples.english_sentence: This matter should be handed over to the authorities for handling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有司會盡快回覆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 si1 wui5 zeon6 faai3 wui4 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有關部門會盡快回覆。
examples.english_sentence: The relevant authorities will reply as soon as possible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 此事由有司負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ci2 si6 jau4 jau5 si1 fu6 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 此事由有關部門負責。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is the responsibility of the relevant authorities.

mandarin_meaning: 有名；著名
english_meaning: famous; well-known; renowned
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人、某地或某事被很多人知道或熟悉，即著名。可用於描述人、地方、事物等，口語中常說「好有名」或「很有名」。
explanation_english: Indicates that a person, place, or thing is widely known or famous. Used to describe people, places, or things; commonly appears in speech as "very famous" or "well-known."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳好有名，成日都要排隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 hou2 jau5 ming4, sing4 jat6 dou1 jiu3 paai4 deoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅很有名，经常要排队。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is very famous; you often have to queue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個有名嘅演員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 jau5 ming4 ge3 jin2 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是个有名的演员。
examples.english_sentence: He is a well-known actor.

mandarin_meaning: 你有名嗎？（帶諷刺或反問）
english_meaning: Are you famous? (sarcastic/taunting)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語俚語，常用作反問或諷刺，挖苦對方自以為出名或愛出風頭。字面是「有名（嗎）你叫？」實際意思相當於「你以為自己很出名嗎？」
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang expression used sarcastically to mock someone who thinks they're famous or who seeks attention. Literally 'Are you famous?' but used as a taunt or rhetorical question.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話自己係名人，我就笑住話：「有名你叫？」
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 zi6 gei2 hai6 ming4 jan4, ngo5 zau6 siu3 zyu6 waa6: "jau5 ming4 nei5 giu3?"
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說自己是名人，我就笑著說：「有名你叫？」
examples.english_sentence: He said he's a celebrity; I just laughed and said, "Are you famous?" (sarcastic)

mandarin_meaning: 有名有姓（字面：有名字有姓氏），引申為可辨認、有名、或有身份可負責
english_meaning: Literally 'has a name and a surname' — means identifiable, known by name, reputable, or having a real identity so one can be held accountable
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是「有名字有姓氏」。常用來表示某人或某事是有名可辨認、有聲譽，或強調要以實名負責，而非匿名或不負責任。
explanation_english: Literally 'has a name and a surname'. Used to indicate someone or something is identifiable or reputable, or to stress that a person should have a real identity and be held accountable rather than remaining anonymous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係有名有姓嘅作家，成日出書，大家都識佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jau5 ming4 jau5 sing3 ge3 zok3 gaa1, sing4 jat6 ceot1 syu1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 sik1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一位有名有姓的作家，經常出書，大家都認識他。
examples.english_sentence: He is a well-known, reputable author who publishes regularly; everyone knows him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果有人做錯事，要佢有名有姓負責，唔可以匿名逃避責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 jau5 jan4 zou6 co3 si6, jiu3 keoi5 jau5 ming4 jau5 sing3 fu6 zaak3, m4 ho2 ji5 mak6 ming4 tou4 bei6 zaak3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果有人做錯事，要他有名有姓負責，不能匿名逃避責任。
examples.english_sentence: If someone did something wrong, they should be held accountable with their real identity; they shouldn't avoid responsibility anonymously.

mandarin_meaning: 有名無實 / 名不副實
english_meaning: in name only; merely famous but lacking substance; nominal rather than real
explanation_mandarin: 表示只有名聲或名義，沒有實際內容、實質利益或效果，名不副實。
explanation_english: Describes something that exists only in name or reputation but lacks real substance, value, or effectiveness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司好出名，但其實有名無實，業績同管理都唔達標。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 hou2 ceot1 ming4, daan6 kei4 sat6 jau5 ming4 mou4 sat6, jip6 zik1 tung4 gun2 lei5 dou1 m4 daat6 biu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司很出名，但其实名不副实，业绩和管理都不达标。
examples.english_sentence: This company is very famous, but in reality it's only nominal; its performance and management both fail to meet the standards.

mandarin_meaning: 是否有 / 有没有
english_meaning: whether there is/are; whether
explanation_mandarin: 書面或正式語氣用法，用來詢問某事是否存在或是否發生，相當於「是否」、「有沒有」。
explanation_english: A formal/written interrogative phrase used to ask whether something exists or has occurred; equivalent to "whether" or "have/has".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有否收到我嘅電郵？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 fau2 sau1 dou3 ngo5 ge3 din6 jau4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你是否收到了我的电子邮件？
examples.english_sentence: Have you received my email?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請告知最近有否任何更新。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 gou3 zi1 zeoi3 gan6 jau5 fau2 jan6 ho4 geng1 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请告知最近是否有任何更新。
examples.english_sentence: Please let me know if there have been any recent updates.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有否參加面試？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 fau2 caam1 gaa1 min6 si5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是否参加了面试？
examples.english_sentence: Did he/she attend the interview?

mandarin_meaning: 有味道；有特色；（口語）可疑或帶暗示性
english_meaning: having a smell; flavorful/characterful; (colloquial) suspicious or suggestive
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話中「有味」可指有氣味（通常指難聞的味道），也可口語化表示有味道/有特色、耐人尋味，有時在語境中可表示可疑或帶暗示性的意味，具體含義需視上下文而定。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '有味' (jau5 mei6) can mean 'to have a smell' (often unpleasant), or colloquially 'to have flavor/character' or 'intriguing'. In some contexts it can also imply something suspicious or suggestive. The exact sense depends on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條魚有味，唔新鮮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 jyu4 jau5 mei6, m4 san1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這條魚有味，不新鮮。
examples.english_sentence: This fish smells (bad); it's not fresh.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間茶餐廳好有味，有種懷舊嘅感覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caa4 caan1 teng1 hou2 jau5 mei6, jau5 zung2 waai4 gau3 ge3 gam2 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間茶餐廳很有味道，有種懷舊的感覺。
examples.english_sentence: This cha chaan teng has a lot of character; it feels nostalgic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今晚無故遲到，好有味，可能有問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 maan5 mou4 gu3 ci4 dou3, hou2 jau5 mei6, ho2 nang4 jau5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今晚無故遲到，很可疑，可能有問題。
examples.english_sentence: He was late tonight for no reason — suspicious; there might be a problem.

mandarin_meaning: 帶有性暗示或下流意味的笑話（類似黃色笑話）
english_meaning: a risqué/suggestive joke; a dirty joke with sexual innuendo or double entendre
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，指帶有性暗示、下流或令人覺得有特殊意味的笑話，通常是黃色笑話或雙關語，用作名詞。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term for a joke that is risqué, suggestive, or carries sexual innuendo—basically a 'dirty' or suggestive joke, often involving double entendres. Used as a noun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講有味笑話，大家有時都唔知點反應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 jau5 mei6 siu3 waa6, daai6 gaa1 jau5 si4 dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 faan2 jing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常講帶有下流意味的笑話，大家有時不知道怎麼反應。
examples.english_sentence: He often tells suggestive jokes; sometimes people don't know how to react.

mandarin_meaning: 有命；有福氣；幸運（口語）
english_meaning: to be fortunate/blessed; to have good luck or destiny
explanation_mandarin: 表示一個人有好運、被命運眷顧或註定得到好處，常用於廣東話口語中。
explanation_english: Indicates someone is lucky, blessed, or destined to receive good fortune; commonly used colloquially in Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日咁順，真係有命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 gam2 seon6, zan1 hai6 jau5 ming6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天這麼順，真是有命／很幸運。
examples.english_sentence: I've been so lucky today — I'm really fortunate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試考到第一，真係有命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si3 haau2 dou3 dai6 jat1, zan1 hai6 jau5 ming6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考試考到第一，真是有福氣／很幸運。
examples.english_sentence: He got first in the exam — he's really lucky.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔係人人都有命去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hai6 jan4 jan4 dou1 jau5 ming6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不是人人都有機會／福氣去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: Not everyone is fortunate enough to be able to travel.

mandarin_meaning: 有这么……只有/仅有这么……
english_meaning: There is so… but only so… (used to contrast amount/degree; indicates limitation)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 句型 / 语法结构（口语）
explanation_mandarin: 口語中的一種句型，用來表示某事物存在某個程度或數量，但同時限定為只有這個程度或數量，常用來做對比或強調有限性。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese sentence pattern used to state that something exists to a certain degree or amount but is limited to that degree/amount; often used to contrast or emphasize the restriction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日地鐵有咁多人，得咁少位坐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 dei6 tit3 jau5 gam2 do1 jan4, dak1 gam2 siu2 wai2 co5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天地铁上人这么多，只有这么少座位可以坐。
examples.english_sentence: There are so many people on the MTR today; there are only so few seats to sit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有咁努力，得咁少分，真係唔公平。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 gam2 nou5 lik6, dak1 gam2 siu2 fan1, zan1 hai6 m4 gung1 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那么努力，却只得到那么少的分数，真不公平。
examples.english_sentence: He worked so hard but only got so few points; it's really unfair.

mandarin_meaning: 有那麼……只有那麼……（表示程度對比或限定）
english_meaning: There is so... but only so... (expresses a contrast or limitation in degree)
explanation_mandarin: 「有咁⋯得咁⋯」是廣東話口語句式，用來描述兩種性質或情況在程度上的對比或限定，通常表示雖然存在某種程度，但結果或另一面只有相對有限的程度。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese sentence pattern used to state the degree of two attributes or situations, often contrasting them or showing a limitation — i.e. there is such an amount/degree, but only such an amount/degree in the other aspect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有咁多時間，得咁少嘢做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 gam2 do1 si4 gaan3, dak1 gam2 siu2 je5 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有那麼多時間，卻只有那麼少事情可做。
examples.english_sentence: He has so much time, but so little to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有咁叻，得咁懶？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 gam2 lak6, dak1 gam2 laan5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那麼能幹，卻那麼懶？
examples.english_sentence: He's so capable, yet so lazy?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司有咁多工作，得咁少人做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jau5 gam2 do1 gung1 zok3, dak1 gam2 siu2 jan4 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司有那麼多工作，卻只有那麼少人做。
examples.english_sentence: The company has so much work, but so few people to do it.

cantonese: 有咁耐風流就有咁耐折墮落
jyutping: jau5 gam2 noi6 fung1 lau4 zau6 jau5 gam2 noi6 zit3 do6 lok6
mandarin_meaning: 享樂多久，就要承受多久的墮落或衰敗；常語，用來警示放縱享樂會有相應後果。
english_meaning: The longer one indulges in pleasure, the longer the resulting downfall; a proverb warning that prolonged indulgence leads to prolonged consequences.
explanation_mandarin: 這句話用來描述或警告那些長期沉溺於風流享樂的人，強調享樂會帶來相應的墮落或惡果，具有因果或警示意味。
explanation_english: An admonitory saying that implies if someone lives a long life of indulgence, they will also suffer a correspondingly long downfall; emphasizes consequence and moral causality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日玩樂，真係有咁耐風流就有咁耐折墮落，依家事業同家庭都垮晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 waan4 lok6, zan1 hai6 jau5 gam2 noi6 fung1 lau4 zau6 jau5 gam2 noi6 zit3 do6 lok6, ji4 gaa1 si6 jip6 tung4 gaa1 ting4 dou1 kwaa3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天縱情享樂，真是有這麼久的風流就有這麼久的墮落，現在事業和家庭都垮了。
examples.english_sentence: He spent all his time partying; it's true that prolonged pleasures bring prolonged downfall — now his career and family have collapsed.

cantonese: 有咁耐風流有咁耐折墮
jyutping: jau5 gam2 noi6 fung1 lau4 jau5 gam2 noi6 zit3 do6
mandarin_meaning: 享樂多久，就要承受多久的墮落或後果；風流有代價
english_meaning: You enjoy pleasure for a time, but correspondingly you will suffer downfall or consequences; pleasures have a price.
explanation_mandarin: 這句粵語俗語用來提醒或評論：人若一味放縱享樂，最終會有相應的墮落或不良後果，是對享樂行為的警示或因果評價。
explanation_english: This Cantonese proverb warns or comments that if one indulges in pleasure or libertine behavior, one will eventually face corresponding downfall or negative consequences — a caution about the cost of indulgence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢年輕時一路風流，依家就證明咗有咁耐風流有咁耐折墮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nin4 heng1 si4 jat1 lou6 fung1 lau4, ji4 gaa1 zau6 zing3 ming4 zo2 jau5 gam2 noi6 fung1 lau4 jau5 gam2 noi6 zit3 do6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他年輕時很風流，現在就印證了「有咁耐風流有咁耐折墮」——享樂終有代價。
examples.english_sentence: He was very libertine when he was young; now it proves the proverb 'you reap what you sow' — pleasures ultimately have a price.

mandarin_meaning: 有了 / 怀孕了（口语）
english_meaning: have/there is (now) / (colloquially) be pregnant
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词短语 / 语态助词结构
explanation_mandarin: 「有咗」是粵語口語表達，主要用來表示已經有了某物或出現某種狀態（相當於普通話的「有了」或「有了⋯」）。在口語情境中，對於人稱主語（尤指女性）單獨說「有咗」時，也常被理解為「怀孕了」。
explanation_english: “有咗” (jau5 zo2) is a Cantonese colloquial expression combining 有 (have/there is) with the perfective particle 咗 (zo2). It indicates possession or the emergence of a new state (equivalent to Mandarin "有了" / English "have/there is now"). In colloquial use, when said about a person (especially a woman) as "(佢)有咗", it can mean "(she) is pregnant."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我有咗一部新電話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jau5 zo2 jat1 bou6 san1 din6 waa2。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我有了一部新电话。
examples.english_sentence: I have a new phone now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家有咗女朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 jau5 zo2 neoi5 pang4 jau5。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在有了女朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He has a girlfriend now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢有咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 jau5 zo2。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她说她怀孕了。
examples.english_sentence: She said she's pregnant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰度有咗一間新餐廳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 dou6 jau5 zo2 jat1 gaan1 san1 caan1 teng1。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那里有了一家新餐厅。
examples.english_sentence: There's a new restaurant there now.

mandarin_meaning: 怎么了？/有什么烦恼？
english_meaning: What's wrong? / What's bothering you?
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語用語，通常用來詢問對方是否不開心、生氣或有煩惱。根據語氣可以是關心、嘲諷或挑釁。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression used to ask if someone is upset, annoyed, or troubled. Depending on tone it can be caring, teasing, or confrontational.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日咁唔開心，有咩依郁？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 gam2 m4 hoi1 sam1, jau5 me1 ji1 juk1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天这么不开心，怎么了？有什么烦恼？
examples.english_sentence: You're so unhappy today — what's wrong? Any problems?

jyutping: jau5 me1 dung1 gwaa1 dau6 fu6
mandarin_meaning: 这是胡说八道／你在说什么？（表示不满、质疑或轻蔑地否定对方的话）
english_meaning: What's this nonsense?/What are you talking about? (a dismissive/sarcastic rhetorical question used to call something rubbish)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語俚語，通常用作反問或嗤之以鼻，表示對對方言論的不相信或不屑。字面上的「冬瓜豆腐」無實際含義，只是押韻、搞笑的組合，用以加強諷刺效果。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese slang expression used to ridicule or dismiss something someone said. Literally 'winter melon tofu' — a nonsensical rhyming pairing with no literal meaning; functions as a sarcastic 'what's that nonsense?'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講咩啊？有咩冬瓜豆腐？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 me1 aa3? jau5 me1 dung1 gwaa1 dau6 fu6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在说什么？这是什么鬼（胡说）？
examples.english_sentence: What are you talking about? What nonsense is that?

mandarin_meaning: 通情達理、肯商量且心胸寬厚
english_meaning: reasonable and willing to negotiate; fair-minded and magnanimous
explanation_mandarin: 表示一個人講道理、肯商量或願意讓步，處事有分寸且心胸寬厚。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is reasonable, willing to negotiate or compromise, and who is fair-minded and magnanimous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆今日出咗好多讓步，睇得出佢好有商有量。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 gam1 jat6 ceot1 zo2 hou2 do1 joeng6 bou6, tai2 dak1 ceot1 keoi5 hou2 jau5 soeng1 jau5 loeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板今天让了很多步，看得出他很会商量、很有度量。
examples.english_sentence: The boss made a lot of concessions today — you can tell he's reasonable and magnanimous.

mandarin_meaning: 有點 / 有些
english_meaning: a little; somewhat; some
explanation_mandarin: 「有啲」可作程度副词，表示「有一點、稍微」，也可作限定詞，表示「有些、一些」。常用於口語廣東話。
explanation_english: Used in Cantonese as an adverb meaning 'a little' or 'somewhat', and as a determiner/pronoun meaning 'some' or 'a few'. Common in colloquial speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日有啲唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jau5 di1 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天有點不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: I'm feeling a bit unwell today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人唔鐘意食辣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 m4 zung1 ji3 sik6 laat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人不喜歡吃辣。
examples.english_sentence: Some people don't like spicy food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫有啲細，我著唔落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 jau5 di1 sai3, ngo5 zoek3 m4 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件衣服有點小，我穿不上。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is a bit small; I can't put it on.

mandarin_meaning: 有點那個（口語用法，表示尷尬、遲疑或不便直說）
english_meaning: a bit 'that', a colloquial filler meaning 'kind of.../um...', indicating hesitation or awkwardness
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 口語填充詞 / 語助詞
explanation_mandarin: 「有啲那個」是粵語口語中的填充語或委婉說法，用來表示說話者有點尷尬、遲疑或不方便直接說明某事，類似普通話的「有點那個」或「有點……（不好說）」。
explanation_english: “有啲那個” is a Cantonese colloquial filler or euphemism used to signal slight awkwardness, hesitation, or that the speaker is reluctant to say something directly. It functions like saying “kind of...” or “um... that thing” in English.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢問我可唔可以借錢，我就有啲那個，唔知點答好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 man6 ngo5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 ze3 cin2, ngo5 zau6 jau5 di1 naa5 go3, m4 zi1 dim2 daap3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他問我可不可以借錢，我就有點那個，不知道怎麼回答好。
examples.english_sentence: He asked me to lend him money; I was kind of awkward about it and didn't know how to answer.

mandarin_meaning: 怀孕
english_meaning: to be pregnant; to expect a baby (euphemism); literally 'have joy'
explanation_mandarin: 「有喜」在粤语中常用作对怀孕的委婉说法，也可字面理解为“有喜事/有好消息”。用于口语，较为礼貌或含蓄。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "有喜" is commonly used as a euphemism for being pregnant. It can also be read literally as "having joy" or good news. It's a polite/indirect colloquial expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢有喜喇，聽日有產檢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 jau5 hei2 laa3, ting1 jat6 jau5 caan2 gim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她說她懷孕了，明天要去產檢。
examples.english_sentence: She said she's pregnant; she has a prenatal check-up tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢有喜，依家要注意飲食同休息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 jau5 hei2, ji1 gaa1 jiu3 zyu3 ji3 jam2 sik6 tung4 jau1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生說她懷孕了，現在要注意飲食和休息。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said she is pregnant; she now needs to watch her diet and rest.

jyutping: jau5 go2 geoi3 gong2 go2 geoi3
mandarin_meaning: 說句實話 / 直說
english_meaning: To be frank; to say it like it is; to speak bluntly
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 插入語 / 片語（語用標記）
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，用於在發表坦率或直白意見前的語句，相當於「說句實話／直說」。通常用來為接下來的直言辯解或作鋪墊。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to preface a frank or blunt statement. Literally 'if there is that sentence, say that sentence,' it functions as a discourse marker meaning 'to be honest' or 'I'll be blunt.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有嗰句講嗰句，我真係唔認同你講嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 go2 geoi3 gong2 go2 geoi3, ngo5 zan1 hai6 m4 jing6 tung4 nei5 gong2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 說句實話，我真的不同意你說的。
examples.english_sentence: To be honest, I really don't agree with what you said.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有嗰句講嗰句，如果你唔想做就直頭講啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 go2 geoi3 gong2 go2 geoi3, nei5 jyu4 gwo2 m4 soeng2 zou6 zau6 zik6 tau4 gong2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 說句實話，如果你不想做就直接說吧。
examples.english_sentence: Frankly, if you don't want to do it, just say so.

mandarin_meaning: 有东西 / 有事 / 有问题
english_meaning: there is something; something's up; something's wrong; to have something
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 口语短语 / 动词短语
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語用法，字面可指「有東西」，也常用來表示「有事」或「有問題/不對勁」。需視語境判斷具體含義。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression literally meaning "there is something." It can indicate the presence of an object, or idiomatically mean "something's up" / "there's a problem." The exact sense depends on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 枱度有嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: toi4 dou6 jau5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 桌子上有東西。
examples.english_sentence: There is something on the table.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得呢度有嘢唔啱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 ni1 dou6 jau5 je5 m4 ngaam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我覺得這裡有不對勁/有問題。
examples.english_sentence: I feel something's not right here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都好神秘，肯定有嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 hou2 san4 bei6, hang2 ding6 jau5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是很神祕，肯定有事/有什麼事。
examples.english_sentence: He's always secretive; there's definitely something going on.

jyutping: jau5 je5 zau6 gong2, jau5 pei3 zau6 fong3
mandarin_meaning: 有話就說，有話就直說（不用顧忌或壓抑）
english_meaning: Say what's on your mind; don't hold back (be blunt/honest)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 俚語 / 短語（感嘆/勸告語氣）
explanation_mandarin: 這是一句廣東話俚語，用比喻方式表示要人直說心裡的話或不需壓抑，常帶有不客氣、要直率表達的語氣。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang phrase that figuratively tells someone to speak up and not hold back; it urges bluntness and honesty, often with a brusque or joking tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有嘢就講，有屁就放，唔好淨係喺背後講人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 je5 zau6 gong2, jau5 pei3 zau6 fong3, m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 hai2 bui3 hau6 gong2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有話就說，有話就直說，不要只在背後議論別人。
examples.english_sentence: Say what's on your mind and don't hold back — don't just gossip about people behind their backs.

mandarin_meaning: 愛挑食／愛吃零食（口語、俗語）
english_meaning: to be picky about food; to nibble or pick at food (colloquial/slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「有嘰吃」為廣東話口語用法，常用來形容一個人挑食、只吃零碎或只愛吃某些小吃，或吃東西時虎咬零嘴、唔肯好好食正餐。屬俗語／地區性口語表達，常見於香港粵語環境。
explanation_english: “有嘰吃” is a Cantonese colloquial/slang phrase used to describe someone who is picky about food, nibbles on snacks, or prefers small bites rather than eating proper meals. It is an informal regional expression common in Hong Kong Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日有嘰吃，唔肯食媽媽煮嘅飯，淨係食零食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 jau5 gei1 hek3, m4 hang2 sik6 maa4 maa1 zyu2 ge3 faan6, zing6 hai6 sik6 ling4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是挑食，不肯吃媽媽煮的飯，只吃零食。
examples.english_sentence: He is always picky about food; he won't eat the meal his mother cooks and only eats snacks.

mandarin_meaning: 有型（有型、帥氣、時尚）
english_meaning: stylish; cool; fashionable; good-looking
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人或事物有風格、帥氣或時尚感。屬廣東話常用口語／俚語，可用於形容衣着、動作、外表或物件。
explanation_english: Used to describe a person or thing as stylish, cool, or fashionable. Common Cantonese colloquial/slang; can refer to clothing, appearance, movements, or objects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日著得好有型。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 dak1 hou2 jau5 jing4
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天穿得很有型。
examples.english_sentence: You look very stylish today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲動作好有型，好似電影主角。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 dung6 zok3 hou2 jau5 jing4 hou2 ci5 din6 jing2 zyu2 gok3
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的動作很有型，像電影主角。
examples.english_sentence: His moves are very cool, like a movie lead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部車真係有型！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 ce1 zan1 hai6 jau5 jing4
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這輛車真有型！
examples.english_sentence: This car is really stylish!

mandarin_meaning: 既有型又有气派（形容人或物很有风格、时尚、帅气）
english_meaning: stylish and classy; cool and fashionable; having style and presence
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人或物外表或氣質很有型、時尚、有格調和氣派，常用於稱讚穿著、造型或整體形象。
explanation_english: Used to describe a person or thing that looks stylish, fashionable, cool and has presence or class; often used to compliment someone's outfit, look, or overall image.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢著嗰件衫真係有型有款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 go2 gin6 saam1 zan1 hai6 jau5 jing4 jau5 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他穿那件衣服真的很有型、很有氣派。
examples.english_sentence: That outfit really looks stylish and classy on him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條領呔令佢有型有款，成個人都精神晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 ling5 taai1 ling6 keoi5 jau5 jing4 jau5 fun2, seng4 go3 jan4 dou1 zing1 san4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那條領帶讓他看起來有型有氣派，整個人都精神了。
examples.english_sentence: The tie makes him look stylish and classy; he looks more energetic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部新手機有型有款，吸引到好多目光。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 san1 sau2 gei1 jau5 jing4 jau5 fun2, kap1 jan5 dou3 hou2 do1 muk6 gwong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這款新手機又有型又有氣派，吸引了很多目光。
examples.english_sentence: This new phone is stylish and classy; it attracted a lot of attention.

mandarin_meaning: 有格調／有境界／有品味
english_meaning: classy; tasteful; has a good vibe or ambience
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，通常用來形容人、地方或事物有格調、氣質或氛圍好（可視為「有境界」的簡略說法）。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese adjective used to describe a person, place, or thing as stylish, tasteful, or having a strong/pleasant vibe (shortened from '有境界').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳好有境，裝修好有格調。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 hou2 jau5 ging2, zong1 sau1 hou2 jau5 gaak3 diu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間餐廳很有格調，裝修很有品味。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is very classy; the decor has a lot of taste.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人真係好有境，講嘢嗰陣好有自信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 ging2, gong2 je5 go2 zan6 hou2 jau5 zi6 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他這個人真的很有格調，說話時很有自信。
examples.english_sentence: He/she is really classy and confident when speaking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個設計好有境，色彩配搭好有心思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 cit3 gai3 hou2 jau5 ging2, sik1 coi2 pui3 daap3 hou2 jau5 sam1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個設計很有品味，色彩搭配很用心。
examples.english_sentence: This design is very tasteful; the color pairing shows a lot of thought.

mandarin_meaning: 有增无减
english_meaning: increasing rather than decreasing; more and more
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語/短語（可作述語或狀語）
explanation_mandarin: 表示數量、程度或情況一直在增加，沒有減少，常用於描述趨勢持續上升。
explanation_english: Indicates that a quantity, degree, or situation keeps increasing with no reduction; often used to describe a continuing upward trend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家物價有增無減，買嘢真係越嚟越貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 mat6 gaa3 jau5 zang1 mou4 gaam2, maai5 je5 zan1 hai6 jyut6 loi4 jyut6 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在物價有增無減，買東西真的是越來越貴。
examples.english_sentence: Prices keep rising now; buying things really is getting more and more expensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅工作量有增無減，大家都要花更多時間做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ge3 gung1 zok3 loeng6 jau5 zang1 mou4 gaam2, daai6 gaa1 dou1 jiu3 faa1 gung1 do1 si4 gaan3 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的工作量有增無減，大家都要花更多時間工作。
examples.english_sentence: The company's workload is increasing rather than decreasing, and everyone has to spend more time working.

mandarin_meaning: （用于询问程度/数量）有多……（如“有多高”“有多远”）
english_meaning: how (much/adj); to what extent
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 疑問程度短語（程度副詞短語）
explanation_mandarin: “有多”常用来询问事物的程度或数量，后接形容词或量词，例如“有多高”“有多厉害”，相当于“有多么/多……”。
explanation_english: “有多” is used to ask about the extent or amount of something; it is followed by an adjective or measure word (e.g. “有多高”, “有多远”) and corresponds to “how + adjective/adverb” or “to what extent.”

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢座山有多高？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zo6 saan1 jau5 do1 gou1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这座山有多高？
examples.english_sentence: How tall is this mountain?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你覺得佢有多聰明？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 jau5 do1 cung1 ming4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你觉得他有多聪明？
examples.english_sentence: How smart do you think he is?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我未諗到佢有多勁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mei6 lam2 dou3 keoi5 jau5 do1 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我没想到他有多厉害。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't realize how formidable he was.

mandarin_meaning: 有了本錢就得寸進尺/恃勢而驕
english_meaning: To act like a big shot or take advantage once one has power/resources; to get greedy or overbearingly entitled
explanation_mandarin: 俗語，指一個人在擁有權力、錢財或其他優勢後變得驕橫、得寸進尺或趁機佔便宜，常用來批評趁勢行事、不知謙遜的人。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning someone, once they gain power, money, or advantage, behaves arrogantly, takes more than their share, or otherwise exploits the situation—used to criticize boastful or greedy behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞咗升職之後就有大食大，成日擺架子，叫啲同事幫佢做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 zo2 sing1 zik1 zi1 hau6 zau6 jau5 daai6 sik6 daai6, sing4 jat6 baai2 gaa3 zi2, giu3 di1 tung4 si6 bong1 keoi5 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他升職後就得寸進尺，常常擺架子，叫同事幫他做事。
examples.english_sentence: After he got promoted he started acting like a big shot—always putting on airs and getting colleagues to do his work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人贏咗一場小勝利就有大食大，完全唔識謙遜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 jing4 zo2 jat1 coeng4 siu2 sing3 lei6 zau6 jau5 daai6 sik6 daai6, jyun4 cyun4 m4 sik1 him1 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人贏了一場小勝利就驕傲自大，完全不懂謙遜。
examples.english_sentence: Some people get cocky after a small victory and completely lack humility.

mandarin_meaning: 有夫之妇（已婚的女性；妻子）
english_meaning: a married woman; a wife (a woman who has a husband)
explanation_mandarin: 文言或較正式的用語，指已有丈夫的女性，即妻子。常見於法律、書面或文學語境，有時帶古體或正式色彩。
explanation_english: A literary or formal term referring to a woman who has a husband — i.e., a wife. Often used in legal, written, or literary contexts and can sound somewhat archaic or formal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係有夫之婦，唔應該再拍拖其他男人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jau5 fu1 zi1 fu5, m4 jing1 goi1 zoi3 paak3 to1 kei4 taa1 naam4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她是有夫之婦，不應該再和其他男人談戀愛。
examples.english_sentence: She is a married woman; she shouldn't be dating other men.

mandarin_meaning: 未能远道迎接，显得失礼或未尽周到
english_meaning: to fail to go out to welcome someone from afar; an apologetic phrase for not offering a proper warm reception
explanation_mandarin: 用於主人或接待方在對方遠道而來時，表示未能前往遠處迎接或未能熱情接待的致歉用語，含謙遜與禮貌意味。
explanation_english: Used by a host or greeter to apologize when a guest has traveled from afar, indicating they failed to go out to welcome the guest; it conveys modesty and polite regret for an inadequate reception.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你由咁遠嚟，真係有失遠迎，唔好意思我哋冇出去迎你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau4 gam2 jyun5 loi4, zan1 hai6 jau5 sat1 jyun5 jing4, m4 hou2 ji3 si1 ngo5 dei6 mou5 ceot1 heoi3 jing4 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你從這麼遠地方來，真是有失遠迎，抱歉我們沒出去迎接你。
examples.english_sentence: You came from so far—I'm really sorry we didn't come out to welcome you.

mandarin_meaning: 如同；好像
english_meaning: as if; like; similar to
explanation_mandarin: 用于比喻，表示像……一样，多用于书面或较正式的语境。
explanation_english: Used to make a simile — means 'as if' or 'like'. Often used in more formal or literary contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢有如機械人咁，冇感情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 jau5 jyu4 gei1 haai6 jan4 gam2, mou5 gam2 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话如同机器人一样，没有感情。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks like a robot, with no emotion.

mandarin_meaning: 有始有终（yǒu shǐ yǒu zhōng），從開始到結束都能堅持或保持一致
english_meaning: to see something through from beginning to end; to be consistent from start to finish
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語（可作形容詞或副詞）
explanation_mandarin: 表示從開始到結束都能堅持下去或保持一致，不半途而廢。
explanation_english: Indicates maintaining consistency or completing something from start to finish; not giving up halfway.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢要有始有終，唔好半途而廢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 jiu3 jau5 ci2 jau5 zung1, m4 hou2 bun3 tou4 ji4 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事要有始有终，不要半途而废。
examples.english_sentence: You should see things through to the end; don't give up halfway.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個有始有終嘅人，做事好有責任感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 jau5 ci2 jau5 zung1 ge3 jan4, zou6 si6 hou2 jau5 zaak3 jam6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一个有始有终的人，做事很有责任感。
examples.english_sentence: He is a person who sees things through; very responsible in his work.

jyutping: jau5 zi1 si6 mou5 sat6 zai3
mandarin_meaning: 華而不實；只有表面姿勢，沒有實際內容或效果
english_meaning: all style and no substance; showy but lacking real content or practical effect
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人、計劃或做法看起來有面子、有形式，但缺乏實際內容、成效或可行性。
explanation_english: Used to describe a person, plan, or action that looks flashy or stylish on the surface but lacks real substance, effectiveness, or practicality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個計劃好有姿勢冇實際，講得好聽但做唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 gai3 waak6 hou2 jau5 zi1 si6 mou5 sat6 zai3, gong2 dak1 hou2 teng1 daan6 zou6 m4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的計劃只是有花樣沒有實際內容，說得好聽卻做不到。
examples.english_sentence: His plan is all style and no substance — it sounds good but can't be put into practice.

jyutping: jau5 zi1 si6, mou5 sat6 zai3
mandarin_meaning: 有面子但沒實際內容；外表好看但沒有實質可行性
english_meaning: All show and no substance; looks stylish/impressive but lacks real content or practicality
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容某人或某事表面很好看、有排場或講得漂亮，但缺乏實際內容或執行力，不能落到實處。
explanation_english: Used to describe a person or thing that looks good or sounds impressive on the surface but lacks real substance, practicality, or follow-through.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲計劃好有姿勢，冇實際，最後根本做唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 gai3 waak6 hou2 jau5 zi1 si6, mou5 sat6 zai3, zeoi3 hau6 gan1 bun2 zou6 m4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們的計劃很有姿勢，但沒有實際，最後根本做不到。
examples.english_sentence: Their plan looks impressive but has no substance; in the end it simply couldn't be done.

mandarin_meaning: 有妻子的男人；已婚男子
english_meaning: a married man (literally: a man who has a wife)
explanation_mandarin: 指已婚的男人，字面意思是「有妻子的丈夫」。在口語或書面語中常用來強調對方已有配偶，有時在談及婚外情或不道德關係時帶有負面或批評意味。
explanation_english: Refers to a man who is married — literally "a man who has a wife." Used to emphasize that someone has a spouse; can carry negative connotations when discussing affairs or inappropriate relationships.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我早就知佢係有婦之夫，點解仲要同佢保持聯絡？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zou2 zau6 zi1 keoi5 hai6 jau5 fu5 zi1 fu1, dim2 gaai2 zung6 jiu3 tung4 keoi5 bou2 ci4 lyun4 lok3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我早就知道他是有妇之夫，为什么还要和他保持联系？
examples.english_sentence: I knew long ago he was a married man — why are you still keeping in touch with him?

mandarin_meaning: 已经安排好了 / 已经确定了
english_meaning: It's sorted / It's settled / All set
explanation_mandarin: 粤语口语表达，表示事情已安排好或已确定，用来安抚或表示不用再担心。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase meaning something has been arranged or confirmed; used to reassure someone that it's been taken care of.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔使擔心，我已經有定啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 sai2 daam1 sam1, ngo5 ji5 ging1 jau5 ding6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不用担心，我已经安排好了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, I've already sorted it out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚個飯局有定啦，你可以放心去玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 go3 faan6 guk6 jau5 ding6 laa1, nei5 ho2 ji5 fong3 sam1 heoi3 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚的聚餐安排好了，你可以放心去玩。
examples.english_sentence: The dinner tonight is all arranged, you can go and relax.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢電話講咗，已經有人幫手，有定啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 din6 waa2 gong2 zo2, ji5 ging1 jau5 jan4 bong1 sau2, jau5 ding6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打电话说已经有人帮忙了，事情已确定。
examples.english_sentence: He called and said someone is helping already — it's been taken care of.

mandarin_meaning: 沉着、冷静、有自制力（粤语俗语）
english_meaning: to be composed; calm and steady; have self-control or patience
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，形容一個人遇事能保持冷靜、沉着、有耐性與自制力，不易衝動或慌張。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression describing a person who remains calm, composed, patient, and self-controlled; not easily agitated or impulsive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢處事好有定性，遇到問題都會慢慢分析。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cyu3 si6 hou2 jau5 ding6 sing3, jyu6 dou3 man6 tai4 dou1 wui5 maan6 maan6 fan1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他處事很沉着，遇到問題都會慢慢分析。
examples.english_sentence: He handles things with composure; when problems arise he analyzes them slowly and carefully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁衝動，試下有定性啲，先諗清楚先講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 cung1 dung6, si3 haa5 jau5 ding6 sing3 di1, sin1 nam2 cing1 co2 sin1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那麼衝動，試著冷靜一點，想清楚再說。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so impulsive; try to be more composed — think clearly before you speak.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友坐唔定，我教佢點樣有定性啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 co5 m4 ding6, ngo5 gaau3 keoi5 dim2 joeng6 jau5 ding6 sing3 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子坐不住，我教他怎麼有耐性一點。
examples.english_sentence: The kid can't sit still; I'll teach him how to be a bit more patient/composed.

mandarin_meaning: 有害 (yǒuhài)
english_meaning: harmful; damaging
explanation_mandarin: 表示對人、動植物或環境會造成傷害或不良影響。
explanation_english: Indicates that something causes harm or has detrimental effects to people, organisms, or the environment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲化學物質對人體有害。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 faa3 hok6 mat6 zat1 deoi3 jan4 tai2 jau5 hoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些化学物质对人体有害。
examples.english_sentence: These chemicals are harmful to the human body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 長期吸煙對健康有害。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 kei4 kap1 jin1 deoi3 gin6 hong1 jau5 hoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 长期吸烟对健康有害。
examples.english_sentence: Long-term smoking is harmful to health.

mandarin_meaning: 有容乃大（yǒu róng nǎi dà）：寬容就是胸懷寬廣、氣度非凡
english_meaning: Tolerance is greatness; being magnanimous and broad-minded
explanation_mandarin: 表示寬容別人、包容不同意見或缺點，才顯示出人的氣度與偉大。常用來讚揚人的胸襟或勸人應該寬容。
