explanation_english: Expresses that being tolerant and accepting of others demonstrates true greatness and magnanimity. Used to praise someone's broad-mindedness or to advise tolerance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一向對人好有包容心，真係有容乃大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 hoeng3 deoi3 jan4 hou2 jau5 baau1 jung4 sam1, zan1 hai6 jau5 jung4 noi5 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一向對人很有包容心，真是有容乃大。
examples.english_sentence: He has always been very tolerant of others; truly, tolerance is greatness.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語）很有趣/有點古怪/有意思
english_meaning: (slang) quirky; amusing; a bit odd
explanation_mandarin: 「有寶」是香港粵語口語俚語，用來形容一個人或行為古怪、有趣、讓人覺得好笑或出乎意料，語氣可帶玩笑或輕微貶義。
explanation_english: “有寶” is a Hong Kong Cantonese slang term used to describe a person or behaviour that is quirky, amusing, or a bit odd. It can be used jokingly or with a mild critical tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講啲古怪嘢，真係有寶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gong2 di1 gu2 gwaai3 je5, zan1 hai6 jau5 bou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是说些古怪的話，真是很有意思／有點怪。
examples.english_sentence: He always says strange things — he's really a character.

mandarin_meaning: 有約 / 有安排 / 有聚會
english_meaning: to have plans / to have an appointment or a meetup
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，表示已經有安排或約定（通常指聚會、飯局或行程），相當於普通話的「有約/有安排」。
explanation_english: Cantonese colloquial expression meaning one already has plans or an appointment (often a gathering, dinner, or outing). Equivalent to "have plans" or "have an arrangement."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚有局，你去唔去？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 jau5 guk6, nei5 heoi3 m4 heoi3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚有約/今晚有聚會，你去不去？
examples.english_sentence: There's a get-together tonight — are you going?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話聽日有局，唔得閒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 ting1 jat6 jau5 guk6, m4 dak1 haan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說明天有安排，沒空。
examples.english_sentence: He said he has plans tomorrow and isn't available.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日冇局，得閒一齊食飯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 mou5 guk6, dak1 haan4 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天沒安排，有空一起吃飯吧。
examples.english_sentence: I don't have plans today — I'm free to grab a meal together.

mandarin_meaning: 有話就說；有本事就拿出來（口語、帶挑釁或催促）
english_meaning: If you've got something to say, say it; speak up. (Can be used challengingly — 'put up or shut up')
explanation_mandarin: 字面是「有屁就放」，引申為如果有話或證據就直接說出來，不要吞吞吐吐；常用作催促或挑釁性的表達。
explanation_english: Literally 'if you have a fart, let it out'; figuratively means 'if you have something to say, say it' — telling someone to speak up or to produce proof. Often used in a confrontational or urging tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有嘢就直頭講，有屁就放，唔好淨係喺度含糊其詞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 je5 zau6 zik6 tau4 gong2, jau5 pei3 zau6 fong3, m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 hai2 dou6 ham4 wu4 kei4 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有事就直接說，有話就說，不要總是含糊其詞。
examples.english_sentence: If you've got something, just say it — speak up; don't keep being vague.

mandarin_meaning: 有便宜 / 有折扣 / 有優惠
english_meaning: cheap; on sale; there's a bargain
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，表示某物或某處正在有較便宜的價格、折扣或優惠，常用於購物或討論價格時。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression indicating that something is cheap or there is a discount/offer — used when talking about bargains or reduced prices.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間舖而家有平，快啲去睇下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 pou3 ji4 gaa1 jau5 ping4, faai3 di1 heoi3 tai2 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那間店現在有便宜／有折扣，快去看看吧。
examples.english_sentence: That shop has discounts now — go check it out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部手機真係有平，原價八百而家只係五百蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 sau2 gei1 zan1 hai6 jau5 ping4, jyun4 gaa3 baat3 baak3 ji4 gaa1 zi2 hai6 ng5 baak3 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部手機真的很便宜，原價八百，現在只要五百塊。
examples.english_sentence: This phone is really cheap—was 800, now only 500.

mandarin_meaning: 有幸（能夠……；幸運）
english_meaning: to be fortunate; to have the good fortune (to...)
explanation_mandarin: 表示很幸運或有機會做某事，常用於謙遜或正式語境，如「我有幸…」。
explanation_english: Indicates being fortunate or honored to have the opportunity to do something; often used in modest or formal contexts (e.g., "I was fortunate to...").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我有幸可以參加今次嘅活動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jau5 hang6 ho2 ji5 caam1 gaa1 gam1 ci3 ge3 wut6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我有幸能參加這次的活動。
examples.english_sentence: I am fortunate to be able to participate in this event.

mandarin_meaning: 有多少；有几何（书面/文言用法）
english_meaning: how many/how much; to what extent (literary/formal)
explanation_mandarin: 「有幾何」為書面或文言式的疑問表達，意指「有多少／程度如何」。口語中多用「有幾多」或「有多少」，在詩詞、散文或正式語境較常見。
explanation_english: A literary/formal Cantonese expression meaning "how many/how much" or "to what extent." It is more common in written or literary contexts; speakers typically use "有幾多" in everyday speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人生有幾何，要把握當下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 sang1 jau5 gei2 ho4, jiu3 baa2 ngok6 dong1 haa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人生有多少，要把握當下。
examples.english_sentence: How many years does life have? You should seize the present.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你以為有幾何啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji5 wai6 jau5 gei2 ho4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你以為有多少啊？
examples.english_sentence: How much do you think there is?

mandarin_meaning: 怎麼可能／有多可能
english_meaning: How possible?/How likely?/No way! (expressing disbelief)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，常用來表示懷疑或不相信某事的可能性，相當於「怎麼可能？」或「不可能」。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to show doubt or disbelief about how likely something is—equivalent to "How is that possible?" or "No way!"

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話考一百分？有幾可？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 haau2 jat1 baak3 fan1? jau5 gei2 ho2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說考了一百分？怎麼可能？
examples.english_sentence: He said he got 100 on the exam? How is that possible?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話佢會遲到？有幾可，佢一向準時。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 keoi5 wui5 ci4 dou3? jau5 gei2 ho2, keoi5 jat1 hoeng3 zeon2 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你說他會遲到？怎麼可能，他一向準時。
examples.english_sentence: You think he'll be late? That's unlikely—he's always on time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢會買咁貴嘅鞋？有幾可！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wui5 maai5 gam3 gwai3 ge3 haai4? jau5 gei2 ho2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他會買那麼貴的鞋？怎麼可能！
examples.english_sentence: He would buy such expensive shoes? No way!

mandarin_meaning: 有點忙 / 稍微不閒
english_meaning: somewhat busy; a bit occupied
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語說法，用來表示某人有點忙、沒空。語氣可作敘述或輕微強調，常用於日常對話。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to indicate someone is somewhat busy or not free. It can be used as a statement or mild emphasis in everyday conversation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日有幾唔閒，可能要遲啲覆你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jau5 gei2 m4 haan4, ho2 nang4 jiu3 ci4 di1 fuk1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天有點忙，可能要晚一點回你。
examples.english_sentence: I'm a bit busy today; I might reply to you later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都有幾唔閒，唔太得閒陪家人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 jau5 gei2 m4 haan4, m4 taai3 dak1 haan4 pui4 gaa1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他常常有點忙，不太有空陪家人。
examples.english_sentence: He's often somewhat busy and doesn't have much time to spend with his family.

mandarin_meaning: 有秩序；井然有条
english_meaning: orderly; in order; organized
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物按一定次序或規律排列、安排得井然、有條理。
explanation_english: Describes things that are arranged or organized according to a sequence or rules; orderly and well-organized.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 圖書館入面保持得好有序，書本擺得整齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou4 syu1 gun2 jap6 min6 bou2 ci4 dak1 hou2 jau5 zeoi6, syu1 bun2 baai2 dak1 zing2 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 图书馆里面保持得很有序，书本摆放得整齐。
examples.english_sentence: The library is kept very orderly; the books are arranged neatly.

jyutping: jau5 koeng4 gaan1 mou5 guk6 dou2
mandarin_meaning: 有強暴卻沒有追究或懲罰（俚語，用於諷刺沒有公道或沒有負責任）
english_meaning: Literally 'there is rape but no gambling den' — a coarse Cantonese slang phrase used figuratively to accuse that a serious wrongdoing occurred but there is no accountability or justice.
explanation_mandarin: 此句為廣東話粗俗俚語，直譯字面意思並不重要，常用來諷刺或批評某件明顯嚴重的事情發生了，卻沒有受到處理、追究或懲罰，帶有強烈不滿與指責的語氣。因含敏感詞彙，屬粗俗表達。
explanation_english: This is a coarse Cantonese slang expression. The literal words are not meant literally in normal use; it is used sarcastically to criticize situations where an obvious serious wrongdoing has occurred but there is no investigation, punishment, or accountability. It carries a strongly critical and vulgar tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次調查做得好差，簡直有強姦冇局賭，根本冇人被問責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 diu6 caa4 zou6 dak1 hou2 caa1, gaan2 zik6 jau5 koeng4 gaan1 mou5 guk6 dou2, gan1 bun2 mou5 jan4 bei6 man6 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次調查做得很差，簡直是有強姦卻沒有被追究，根本沒有人被問責。
examples.english_sentence: This investigation was terribly done — it's as if there's rape but no accountability; nobody is being held responsible.

jyutping: jau5 koeng4 gaan1 mou5 guk6 dou2
mandarin_meaning: 有強姦卻沒有人被追究/懲罰（俚語／諷刺用法）
english_meaning: There is rape but no one is held accountable (slang, sarcastic)
explanation_mandarin: 這是一句香港粵語的俚語或諷刺性說法，字面上是「有強姦（犯罪）但沒有人被處罰」，用來批評某些明顯錯誤或嚴重懲罰性行為卻沒有任何追究或制裁。此語帶有粗俗和諷刺意味，屬非正式用語，使用時需注意場合與對象。
explanation_english: This is a Hong Kong Cantonese slang/sarcastic phrase. Literally 'there is rape but no one gets punished,' it is used to criticize situations where obvious wrongdoing or serious offenses occur yet no one is held accountable. The phrase is coarse and ironic, informal and should be used with caution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋話有強姦冇焗賭，冇人肯負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waa6 jau5 koeng4 gaan1 mou5 guk6 dou2, mou5 jan4 hang2 fu6 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們說「有強姦冇焗賭」，意思是有嚴重罪行卻沒有人承擔責任。
examples.english_sentence: They said '有強姦冇焗賭', meaning there is a serious crime but nobody takes responsibility.

mandarin_meaning: 只有批評沒有讚賞／被罵卻沒有人稱讚
english_meaning: All criticism, no praise; getting flak but no compliments
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俚語，字面是「有彈（被彈/被批評）冇讚（沒有讚賞）」，用來形容一個人或一件事只收到批評或負面留言，沒有得到任何稱讚或正面回應，常見於社交媒體或日常抱怨中。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang phrase meaning 'all criticism, no praise'. Literally 'have criticism, no praise'. It describes someone or something that receives negative comments or ridicule but no compliments—commonly used about social media posts or situations where people only get flak and no positive feedback.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢響IG度炫耀新衫，但留言多數係講衰嘢，真係有彈冇讚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 heong2 IG dou6 syun3jiu6 san1 saam1, daan6 leoi4min4 do1sou3 hai6 gong2 seoi1 je5, zan1hai6 jau5 daan6 mou5 zaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在 IG 上曬新衣，但留言大多是在說壞話，真是只有批評沒有讚賞。
examples.english_sentence: He posted his new outfit on IG, but most comments were negative — really all criticism, no praise.

mandarin_meaning: 既有讚賞也有批評；反應兩極或褒貶並存
english_meaning: to receive both praise and criticism; to have mixed reactions
explanation_mandarin: 常用於網絡或口語，表示某事或某帖子同時有支持（讚）和反對或批評（彈），即反應不一致或兩極化。
explanation_english: A colloquial/slang expression used often online to indicate that something (like a post or piece of content) attracts both praise (likes) and criticism (comments), i.e. mixed or polarized reactions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條片好有爭議，下面有彈有讚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 pin3 hou2 jau5 zang1 ji6, haa6 min6 jau5 daan6 jau5 zaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這段影片很有爭議，下面既有讚也有批評。
examples.english_sentence: This video is controversial; it has both likes and criticisms in the comments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲貼文成日有彈有讚，討論好熱烈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 tit3 man4 sing4 jat6 jau5 daan6 jau5 zaan3, tou2 leon6 hou2 jit6 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的貼文常常既有讚賞也有批評，討論很熱烈。
examples.english_sentence: His posts often attract both praise and criticism; the discussion gets heated.

mandarin_meaning: 有型；時髦、酷
english_meaning: stylish, cool, fashionable
explanation_mandarin: 在香港廣東話口語中，常用來形容人或打扮很時髦、有型、很酷，表示外觀或氣質好、有風格。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese slang, used to describe a person or their outfit as stylish, cool, or fashionable—indicating an attractive, stylish appearance or vibe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日著得好有形。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 dak1 hou2 jau5 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天穿得很有型。
examples.english_sentence: He/She looks very stylish today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢對波鞋好有形，你買咗未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 deoi3 bo1 haai4 hou2 jau5 jing4, nei5 maai5 zo2 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這雙運動鞋很有型，你買了嗎？
examples.english_sentence: These sneakers look really cool—did you buy them?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺台上好有形，好有存在感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 toi4 soeng6 hou2 jau5 jing4, hou2 jau5 cyun4 zoi6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在台上很有型，很有存在感。
examples.english_sentence: He looks very stylish on stage and has a strong presence.

mandarin_meaning: 有待（仍需、尚需）
english_meaning: to be pending; to remain to be done; needs (further improvement/action)
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示某事尚未完成或需要進一步處理或改進，常見於書面或正式語境，如「有待改進」、「有待商榷」。
explanation_english: Used to indicate that something remains to be done, needs further action or improvement; commonly used in formal or written contexts (e.g., "needs improvement", "remains to be discussed").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告仲有待完善。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 zung6 jau5 doi6 jyun4 sin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告还有待完善。
examples.english_sentence: This report still needs to be improved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃有待商榷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 jau5 doi6 soeng1 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划有待商榷。
examples.english_sentence: This plan remains open to discussion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅表現有待改進。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 biu2 jin6 jau5 doi6 goi2 zeon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的表现有待改进。
examples.english_sentence: His performance needs improvement.

mandarin_meaning: 可以 / 有機會 / 有可能
english_meaning: can / there's a chance / it's possible / have the opportunity
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 情态助词 / 口语短语
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，表示有可能或有機會做某事，類似「可以」或「有得做」。常出現在「有得 + 動詞」或「有得 + 名詞/形容詞」的結構中。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression indicating possibility, permission, or having the opportunity to do something. Often appears as "有得 + verb" or "有得 + noun/adjective".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我有得去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jau5 dak1 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我有機會/可以去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I can / have the opportunity to go traveling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 仲有得傾嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung6 jau5 dak1 king1 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 還有得談嗎？/ 還有機會談嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Is there still time/opportunity to talk?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚電視有得睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 din6 si6 jau5 dak1 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚電視有得看/有好看的節目。
examples.english_sentence: There's something to watch on TV tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 有餘地／有閒錢可花（有回旋餘地）
english_meaning: to have room to spare; to have disposable money to spend; to have wiggle room
explanation_mandarin: 「有得揮」是香港粵語口語，常用來表示有餘錢可以揮霍或在某事上有回旋、空間，不必太擔心或可以放手去做。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese colloquial expression meaning to have spare money to spend or to have leeway/wiggle room in a situation — i.e., the freedom or margin to act without tight constraints.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個月慳咗啲，仲有得揮，可以去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 jyut6 haan1 zo2 di1, zung6 jau5 dak1 fai1, ho2 ji5 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個月省下了一些，還有得揮，可以去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I saved some money this month, I have some to spare and can go traveling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單生意談得好，仲有得揮，唔使驚蝕底。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 saang1 ji3 taam4 dak1 hou2, zung6 jau5 dak1 fai1, m4 sai2 geng1 sik1 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這筆生意談得好，還有餘地，不用擔心吃虧。
examples.english_sentence: The deal went well; there's room to maneuver, so there's no need to worry about losses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔趕住用錢，你就有得揮，可以買部新電話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 gon2 zyu6 jung6 cin2, nei5 zau6 jau5 dak1 fai1, ho2 ji5 maai5 bou6 san1 din6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不急著用錢，你就有得揮，可以買一部新手機。
examples.english_sentence: If you're not in urgent need of money, you have some to spare and can buy a new phone.

mandarin_meaning: 可以商量；可談條件/可討價還價
english_meaning: negotiable; there's room for negotiation; can be negotiated
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，表示某事或某價錢有協商的空間，可以討價還價或商量條件。語氣偏非正式，常用於價格、人工、條款等情況。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning there is room to negotiate or that something is negotiable. Commonly used about prices, salaries, or terms. Informal/slang register.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個價錢有得斟嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gaa3 cin4 jau5 dak1 zam1 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个价格可以商量吗？
examples.english_sentence: Is this price negotiable?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺人工方面有得斟，佢哋肯傾條件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 jan4 gung1 fong1 min6 jau5 dak1 zam1, keoi5 dei6 hang2 king1 tiu4 gin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在工资方面可以商量，他们愿意谈条件。
examples.english_sentence: There's room to negotiate the salary; they're willing to discuss the terms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次交易唔錯，但係仲有得斟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 gaau1 jik6 m4 co3, daan6 hai6 zung6 jau5 dak1 zam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这笔交易不错，但还有商量的余地。
examples.english_sentence: This deal's not bad, but there's still room for negotiation.

jyutping: jau5 dak1 zan3 mou5 dak1 fan3
mandarin_meaning: 兴奋到睡不着/又能炫耀但睡不着
english_meaning: lit. 'able to show off but can't sleep' — used to say someone is too excited or restless to sleep
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語俚語，字面意思是「可以震撼（或炫耀）但不能睡覺」，常用來形容因為興奮、緊張或心緒不寧以致睡不着。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang phrase literally meaning 'can show off but can't sleep.' It describes being so excited, anxious, or restless that you cannot sleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日去旅行，今晚興奮到有得震冇得瞓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4, gam1 maan5 hing1 fan5 dou3 jau5 dak1 zan3 mou5 dak1 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天要去旅行，今晚興奮得睡不著。
examples.english_sentence: We're going on a trip tomorrow — I'm so excited I can't sleep tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 有心 (yǒu xīn)：用心、体贴；也可表示有意、故意
english_meaning: thoughtful/caring; intentional/deliberate
explanation_mandarin: 「有心」在廣東話中可表示一個人很用心、體貼或有關懷（例如做事細心、為人着想）；亦可表示有意圖或故意（例如刻意做某事）。具體含義要視上下文而定。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, 有心 can mean being thoughtful, attentive, or caring (e.g., doing things with care or consideration). It can also mean intentional or deliberate (i.e., doing something on purpose). The exact sense depends on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你真係好有心，多謝你幫我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5-sam1, do1-ze6 nei5 bong1 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你真是很用心，謝謝你幫我。
examples.english_sentence: You're really thoughtful — thank you for helping me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做呢件事好有心，留意到每一個細節。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 ni1 gin6 si6 hou2 jau5-sam1, lau4-ji6 dou3 mui5 jat1 go3 sai3-zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做这件事很用心，注意到了每一个细节。
examples.english_sentence: He did this very carefully, paying attention to every detail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有心想贏，所以刻意早啲到場練習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5-sam1 soeng2 jeng4, so2-ji5 hak1-ji3 zou2-di1 dou3 coeng4 lin6-zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有意想赢，所以刻意早一点到场练习。
examples.english_sentence: He was intent on winning, so he deliberately arrived early to practice.

mandarin_meaning: 有心人
english_meaning: a thoughtful/considerate person; someone acting with intention
explanation_mandarin: 指有心、有心思、願意幫忙或留心別人的人；也可指故意、有意圖做某事的人（根據語境可帶褒義或表示「蓄意」）。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who is thoughtful, caring, or willing to help. It can also mean a person who does something deliberately or with intent (context-dependent; may be positive or imply intentional action).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你幫我搬屋，你真係有心人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 bong1 ngo5 bun1 uk1, nei5 zan1 hai6 jau5 sam1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 謝謝你幫我搬家，你真是個有心人。
examples.english_sentence: Thanks for helping me move; you're really a thoughtful person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都記得我嘅生日，真係有心人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 gei3 dak1 ngo5 ge3 saang1 jat6, zan1 hai6 jau5 sam1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是記得我的生日，真的是個有心人。
examples.english_sentence: He always remembers my birthday; he's really a considerate person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事唔係意外，好似係有心人做嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 m4 hai6 ji3 ngoi6, hou2 ci5 hai6 jau5 sam1 jan4 zou6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事不是意外，好像是有人故意做的。
examples.english_sentence: This incident wasn't an accident; it seems someone did it on purpose.

mandarin_meaning: 有心無力／好心但做不到或做得不周到
english_meaning: Well-intentioned but ineffective; willing to help or try but lacking the ability, skill, energy, or luck to do it properly
explanation_mandarin: 表示雖然有意願想做某事，但缺乏能力、技巧、精力或運氣，做不成或做得不周到；常用來形容好心卻無法達到效果。
explanation_english: Indicates someone has the intention or willingness to do something but lacks the ability, skill, energy, or luck, so the effort is ineffective or results are poor; often used to describe well-meaning but ineffectual actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有心幫手，但做事有心冇神，反而整到更麻煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 sam1 bong1 sau2, daan6 zou6 si6 jau5 sam1 mou5 san4, faan2 ji4 zing2 dou3 gang3 maa4 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想幫忙，但做事有心無力，反而把事情弄得更麻煩。
examples.english_sentence: You mean well and want to help, but you're ineffective and end up making things more troublesome.

mandarin_meaning: 好心但不體貼／沒考慮周到
english_meaning: well-intentioned but insensitive; means well but tactless
explanation_mandarin: 形容一個人出發點是好的，但說話或做事欠缺體貼、圓滑或考慮周到，常常無意中冒犯或令別人不開心。
explanation_english: Describes someone who has good intentions but lacks tact or sensitivity; they mean well but are often blunt or inconsiderate and may unintentionally upset others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係有心冇肺，淨係想幫人，講嘢又好直接，成日令啲人唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 jau5 sam1 mou5 fai3, zing6 hai6 soeng2 bong1 jan4, gong2 je5 jau6 hou2 zik6 zip3, sing4 jat6 ling6 di1 jan4 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的是好心但不體貼，只想幫人，說話很直，常常讓人不開心。
examples.english_sentence: He's really well-intentioned but insensitive — he only wants to help, but speaks very bluntly and often makes people upset.

mandarin_meaning: 只要有心，就不怕迟（开始晚也不怕）
english_meaning: If you're determined, don't worry about being late; better late than never.
explanation_mandarin: 表示只要有意愿去做某事，就不用担心开始晚或起步慢，强调态度和决心比时间更重要。
explanation_english: Expresses that if someone has the willingness to do something, it's okay to start late; determination matters more than timing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你而家先開始學都唔緊要，有心唔怕遲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji4 gaa1 sin1 hoi1 ci2 hok6 dou1 m4 gan2 jiu3, jau5 sam1 m4 paa3 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你现在才开始学也没关系，有心不怕迟。
examples.english_sentence: It's okay that you're only starting to learn now; if you're willing, it's never too late.

mandarin_meaning: 用心、下功夫（有时也指心思多、爱算计）
english_meaning: to be attentive/meticulous; to put effort into something; sometimes, to be scheming or calculating
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，表示做事很用心、很講究或下功夫；在某些语境下可带贬义，表示心思多、爱算计。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase meaning someone puts effort into something, is meticulous or thoughtful; in some contexts it can be negative, meaning scheming or calculating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日化妝好有心機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 faa3 zong1 hou2 jau5 sam1 gei1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天化妆很用心。
examples.english_sentence: You put a lot of effort into your makeup today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳擺碟好有心機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 baai2 dip6 hou2 jau5 sam1 gei1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的摆盘很用心。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's plating is very carefully done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日諗計，真係好有心機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 lam2 gai3, zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 sam1 gei1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想办法，真是很有心机。
examples.english_sentence: He's always thinking up schemes; really scheming.

mandarin_meaning: 有心无力 / 心有余而力不足（表示想做但缺乏能力、力量或条件）
english_meaning: Willing but unable; having the intention or desire but lacking the ability, strength, or resources to act
explanation_mandarin: 表示雖然有心想做某事，但因為能力、力量或條件不足，無法完成或幫助。
explanation_english: Indicates someone has the intention or goodwill to do something but lacks the ability, strength, or resources to accomplish it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我真係有心無力，想幫你但做唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zan1 hai6 jau5 sam1 mou4 lik6, soeng2 bong1 nei5 daan6 zou6 m4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我真的是有心无力，想帮你但做不到。
examples.english_sentence: I really want to help, but I'm unable to.

mandarin_meaning: 志趣相同、意志一致
english_meaning: to be of one mind; to share the same aims and act together
explanation_mandarin: 表示大家志向一致、意志相同，常用來形容多人共同努力或持相同立場。
explanation_english: Indicates that people share the same aspirations or will and act together; often used to describe collective effort or unity of purpose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋有志一同，一齊幫手整理社區花園。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jau5 zi3 jat1 tung4, jat1 cai4 bong1 sau2 zing2 lei5 se5 keoi1 faa1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們志趣一致，一起幫忙整理社區花園。
examples.english_sentence: We were of one mind and worked together to tidy up the community garden.

jyutping: jau5 zi3 ze2 si6 ging2 sing4
mandarin_meaning: 有志者事竟成（拼音：yǒu zhì zhě shì jìng chéng）— 有志向並努力的人，事情最終能成功。
english_meaning: Where there's a will, there's a way; determined people can achieve success.
explanation_mandarin: 這句成語表示有志向並肯努力的人，最終能克服困難、取得成功。常用以鼓勵人堅持不放棄。
explanation_english: An idiom expressing that people with determination and effort can overcome difficulties and succeed. Commonly used to encourage perseverance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然而家好困難，但有志者事竟成，唔好放棄，繼續努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 ji4 gaa1 hou2 kwan3 naan4, daan6 jau5 zi3 ze2 si6 ging2 sing4, m4 hou2 fong3 hei3, gai3 zuk6 nou5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 雖然現在很困難，但有志者事竟成，不要放棄，繼續努力。
examples.english_sentence: Although it's difficult now, where there's a will there's a way — don't give up, keep working hard.

synonyms: 世上無難事，只怕有心人

jyutping: jau5 zi3 ze2 dang6 ging2 sing4
mandarin_meaning: 對成語「有志者事竟成」的諧音/戲仿；意指有志向的人最終會成功，亦可用來指名為「鄧竟成」的人或作為玩笑用語。
english_meaning: A pun on the proverb "有志者事竟成" (Where there's a will, there's a way), replacing "事" with the surname 鄧. Used humorously to mean "a determined person will succeed" or to refer to someone named "Deng Jingcheng."
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 短語（諧音俚語／戲仿成語）
explanation_mandarin: 這句話把成語「有志者事竟成」中的「事」字換成姓氏「鄧」，形成諧音笑話。常用於幽默地鼓勵別人或戲稱某位名為「鄧竟成」的人成功。
explanation_english: A humorous Cantonese pun on the proverb "有志者事竟成" by substituting the character for "thing" (事) with the surname 鄧. It's used jokingly to encourage someone or to refer to a person named "Deng Jingcheng."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 加油啦，有志者鄧竟成！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa1 jau2 laa3, jau5 zi3 ze2 dang6 ging2 sing4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 加油，有志者事竟成！
examples.english_sentence: Keep it up — where there's a will, there's a way!

mandarin_meaning: 有念头 / 有想法、有意图（口语）
english_meaning: to have an idea/intention; to be interested (often romantic); to be thinking about something
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，表示對某人或某事有想法、打算或好感，視語境可指計劃、意圖或情感上的興趣。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase meaning to have an idea, intention, or interest. Depending on context it can indicate planning to do something, having ulterior motives, or romantic interest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對個新同事好似有念頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 go3 san1 tung4 si6 hou2 ci5 jau5 nim6 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他好像對新同事有好感。
examples.english_sentence: He seems to have feelings for the new colleague.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家真係有念頭辭職，諗緊下一步點做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 zan1 hai6 jau5 nim6 tau4 ci4 zik1, nam2 gan2 haa6 jat1 bou6 dim2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在真的有辭職的念頭，在想下一步怎麼做。
examples.english_sentence: I'm seriously thinking about quitting; I'm considering what to do next.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日約你出去，係咪有念頭想追你？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 joek3 nei5 ceot1 heoi3, hai6 mai6 jau5 nim6 tau4 soeng2 zeoi1 nei5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常約你出去，是不是有追你的意思？
examples.english_sentence: He often asks you out — could he be trying to pursue you?

mandarin_meaning: 有性格 / 有個性
english_meaning: to have character; to be distinctive or strong-willed; to have personality
explanation_mandarin: 形容一個人或事物有鮮明的個性或特色，可能指性格強烈、獨特或有風格；語氣可正面或負面，視語境而定。
explanation_english: Describes a person or thing as having a distinctive personality or character—often meaning strong-willed, quirky, or stylish. Can be positive or negative depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好有性格，唔鍾意人指手畫腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jau5 sing3 gaak3, m4 zung1 ji3 jan4 zi2 sau2 waa6 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很有性格，不喜歡別人指手畫腳。
examples.english_sentence: He has a strong personality and doesn't like people bossing him around.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件外套好有性格，好多人問邊度買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 ngoi6 tou3 hou2 jau5 sing3 gaak3, hou2 do1 jan4 man6 bin1 dou6 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件外套很有个性，很多人问在哪里买。
examples.english_sentence: This coat is very distinctive; many people ask where to buy it.

mandarin_meaning: 如果有什麼奇怪的地方，請別見怪／別介意
english_meaning: If there's anything odd, don't be surprised / don't take offense
explanation_mandarin: 口語用語，常在事前表示歉意或請求體諒，提醒對方若有奇怪、不如常的情況，別見怪或不要責怪。
explanation_english: A colloquial phrase used to preface an apology or request for understanding — telling others not to be surprised or to blame you if something seems odd.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋第一次試做，可能有啲唔順，有怪莫怪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dai6 jat1 ci3 si3 zou6, ho2 nang4 jau5 di1 m4 seon6, jau5 gwaai3 mok6 gwaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們第一次嘗試，可能會有些不順，請別見怪。
examples.english_sentence: This is our first try; there may be some hiccups — please don't be surprised.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司更新系統，可能會有啲錯誤，有怪莫怪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 gan1 san1 hai6 tung2, ho2 nang4 wui5 jau5 di1 co3 ng6, jau5 gwaai3 mok6 gwaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司在更新系統，可能會有些錯誤，請別見怪。
examples.english_sentence: We're updating the company's system; there may be some errors — please don't be surprised.

mandarin_meaning: 有恃无恐
english_meaning: to act without fear because one has backing; emboldened by power or support
explanation_mandarin: 形容因為依仗某種勢力、背景或靠山，而毫不畏懼、放肆行事。
explanation_english: Describes someone who, relying on support or power, feels secure and therefore behaves brazenly or without fear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有後台，有恃無恐，成日亂嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 hau6 toi4, jau5 si6 mou4 hung2, sing4 jat6 lyun6 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有后台，有恃无恐，总是胡作非为。
examples.english_sentence: He has backing and acts without fear, always behaving recklessly.

jyutping: jau5 cing4 jan4 zung1 sing4 gyun3 suk6
mandarin_meaning: 有情人终成眷属（有情人最終成為夫妻或家屬）
english_meaning: Lovers will eventually become a married couple / May lovers be united as family
explanation_mandarin: 表示相愛的人最終成為夫妻或家人，常用作祝賀婚姻或感情圓滿的說法。
explanation_english: States that lovers eventually become spouses or family; commonly used to congratulate a marriage or a happy romantic union.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋終於結婚啦，真係有情人終成眷屬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zung1 jyu1 git3 fan1 laa1, zan1 hai6 jau5 cing4 jan4 zung1 sing4 gyun3 suk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们终于结婚了，真是有情人终成眷属。
examples.english_sentence: They finally got married — truly, lovers have become a married couple.

mandarin_meaning: 有情有義 (yǒuqíng yǒuyì) — 重感情、有義氣
english_meaning: having affection and loyalty; sentimental and righteous; loyal and righteous
explanation_mandarin: 形容人重感情、有義氣，對朋友或親人忠誠，講情義、重道義與同情心。
explanation_english: Describes a person who values feelings and righteousness — loyal, compassionate, and steadfast to friends or family; shows a strong sense of loyalty and moral obligation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係有情有義，永遠唔會拋低啲老朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 jau5 cing4 jau5 ji6, wing5 jyun5 m4 wui5 paau1 dai1 di1 lou5 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的有情有義，永遠不會拋下老朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He's truly loyal and compassionate; he'll never abandon his old friends.

mandarin_meaning: 有感情就心滿意足 / 感情比物質重要
english_meaning: Affection fills you up; love/companionship is more important than material wealth
explanation_mandarin: 這句俗語字面意思是「有感情的話，喝水也覺得飽」。用來表達感情或關係能彌補物質上的不足，強調情感滿足勝於金錢或物質享受。
explanation_english: Literally 'with affection, even drinking water feels filling.' It means emotional bonds or love can make up for lack of material wealth — emotional fulfillment matters more than money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋雖然窮，但有情飲水飽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jin4 kung4, daan6 jau5 cing4 jam2 seoi2 baau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们虽然穷，但有感情就心满意足。
examples.english_sentence: Although we're poor, having affection makes us feel content.

mandarin_meaning: 有意；有興趣；有意圖
english_meaning: interested; to have intention; intentional; on purpose
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞 / 動詞（視語境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某事有興趣或有意願去做；也可表示故意、蓄意的行為。
explanation_english: Indicates having interest or the intention to do something; can also mean doing something deliberately or on purpose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇有意去嗰個展覽？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 jau5 ji3 heoi3 go2 go3 zin2 laam5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有沒有興趣去那個展覽？
examples.english_sentence: Are you interested in going to that exhibition?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔係有意咁做，可能係疏忽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 hai6 jau5 ji3 gam2 zou6, ho2 nang4 hai6 sou1 fat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不是有意這麼做，可能是疏忽。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't do it on purpose; it was probably negligence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你對呢份工作有意，記得聯絡我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 deoi3 ni1 fan6 gung1 zok3 jau5 ji3, gei3 dak1 lyun4 lok3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你對這份工作有意，記得聯絡我。
examples.english_sentence: If you're interested in this job, remember to contact me.

mandarin_meaning: 有意思（有趣、引人注意或有意義）
english_meaning: interesting; amusing; meaningful
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容词 / 形容词短语
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事物令人感到有趣、引起興趣或有意義。語氣可正面（有趣、有價值）或帶有幽默/諷刺意味，常用作形容詞。
explanation_english: Used to indicate that something is interesting, engaging, or meaningful. Can be used positively (interesting/valuable) or with a humorous/sarcastic tone. Functions like an adjective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電影好有意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 jing2 hou2 jau5 ji3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影很有意思。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is very interesting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘢好有意思，大家都聽得入迷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 je5 hou2 jau5 ji3 si1, daa6 gaa1 dou1 teng1 dak1 jap6 mai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说话很有意思，大家都听得入迷。
examples.english_sentence: What you say is very interesting; everyone is fascinated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個主意幾有意思，值得試下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zyu2 ji3 gei2 jau5 ji3 si1, zik1 dak1 si3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个主意挺有意思，值得试试。
examples.english_sentence: This idea is quite interesting; it's worth trying.

mandarin_meaning: 有意或無意；故意或無心
english_meaning: Whether intentional or unintentional; deliberately or not
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某個行為或言語是否帶有意圖不確定，含有「有意還是無意」的意思，可用來描述故意或無心的情況。
explanation_english: Indicates ambiguity about whether an action or remark was done on purpose or accidentally. Used to describe acts that may be deliberate or unintentional.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有意無意咁提起嗰件事，令我覺得唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 ji3 mou4 ji3 gam2 tai4 hei2 go2 gin6 si6, ling6 ngo5 gok3 dak1 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有意無意地提起那件事，讓我覺得不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: He mentioned that matter, deliberately or not, which made me feel uncomfortable.

mandarin_meaning: 有感（有感覺、感觸或被打動）
english_meaning: to feel; to be moved; to resonate; to have a sense or impression
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某事物或情況有感覺、感觸或被打動。口語中可單獨使用或出現在短語如「有感而發」。
explanation_english: Indicates having a feeling or emotional response to something—being moved or resonating with it. Commonly used colloquially and appears in phrases like "有感而發" (speak from the heart).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首歌好有感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 go1 hou2 jau5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首歌很有感染力／很有感触。
examples.english_sentence: This song is very moving / it really resonates.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺講到佢嘅童年時，好有感而發，眼泛淚光。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gong2 dou3 keoi5 ge3 tung4 nin4 si4, hou2 jau5 gam2 ji4 faat3, ngaan5 faan6 leoi6 gwong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在讲到他的童年时，感慨万分，眼眶含泪。
examples.english_sentence: When he talked about his childhood, he spoke from the heart and teared up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對呢件事冇乜有感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 mou5 mat1 jau5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对这件事没什么感觉。
examples.english_sentence: I don't really feel strongly about this.

mandarin_meaning: 因有感觸而表達自己的情感或意見
english_meaning: to speak or express spontaneously from one's feelings; to be moved to speak or write
explanation_mandarin: 表示因為受到某事觸動心情，隨即發表感想或意見，常用於描述情緒驅使下的言行。
explanation_english: Indicates expressing thoughts or feelings prompted by an emotional response to something; used to describe speaking or writing spontaneously out of feeling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇完嗰套紀錄片之後，我有感而發，寫咗篇觀後感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 jyun4 go2 tou3 gei2 luk6 pin2 zi1 hau6, ngo5 jau5 gam2 ji4 faat3, se2 zo2 pin1 gun1 hau6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看完那部紀錄片後，我有感而發，寫了一篇觀後感。
examples.english_sentence: After watching that documentary, I was moved to write a reflective piece.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會嗰陣，佢有感而發，講咗好多對公司嘅建議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui6 go2 zan6, keoi5 jau5 gam2 ji4 faat3, gong2 zo2 hou2 do1 deoi3 gung1 si1 ge3 gin3 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 開會的時候，他有感而發，說了很多對公司的建議。
examples.english_sentence: During the meeting he spoke from the heart and offered many suggestions for the company.

mandarin_meaning: 態度傲慢、對人不禮貌或輕視別人
english_meaning: to be arrogant or insolent; to treat others disrespectfully
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞/形容詞（表示態度或行為）
partOfSpeech_english: verb / adjective (describing an attitude or behaviour)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俗語，形容某人對他人態度傲慢、輕視或無禮，常用來批評言行不尊重別人的人。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression describing someone who behaves arrogantly or disrespectfully toward others. Used to criticize impolite or condescending behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日對人有慢，唔識得尊重人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 deoi3 jan4 jau5 maan6, m4 sik1 dak1 zyun1 zung3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是對人傲慢，不懂得尊重別人。
examples.english_sentence: He is always arrogant toward others and doesn't know how to respect people.

mandarin_meaning: 有所（在某种程度上有；表示存在或有变化）
english_meaning: to some extent; somewhat; there is (something); to have certain/partial ...
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 副词 / 动词短语（用作程度或存在的修饰）
explanation_mandarin: “有所”通常放在动词前，表示在某种程度上有（某种变化、情况或程度），例如“有所改进”“有所不同”。语气较书面或正式。
explanation_english: “有所” is typically placed before a verb to indicate 'to some extent' or that there is some degree/occurrence of something (e.g., '有所改进', '有所不同'). It is relatively formal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢呢幾個月嘅表現有所進步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ni1 gei2 go3 jyut6 ge3 biu2 jin6 jau5 so2 zeon3 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这几个月的表现有所进步。
examples.english_sentence: His performance has improved somewhat over the past few months.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 對於你提出嘅意見，我會有所考慮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi3 jyu1 nei5 tai4 ceot1 ge3 ji3 gin3, ngo5 wui5 jau5 so2 haau2 leoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 对于你提出的意见，我会有所考虑。
examples.english_sentence: I will give your suggestions some consideration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次會議嘅結果有所不同，大家要討論下點樣跟進。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 wui6 ji5 ge3 git3 gwo2 jau5 so2 bat1 tung4, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 tou2 leon6 haa5 dim2 joeng6 gan1 zeon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次会议的结果有所不同，大家要讨论一下怎样跟进。
examples.english_sentence: The results of this meeting differ somewhat; everyone needs to discuss how to follow up.

mandarin_meaning: 對某事物或某方面不完全了解 / 有所不知
english_meaning: to not be fully informed about something; to have things one does not know
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語 / 短語（動詞短語）
explanation_mandarin: 表示說話者承認對某事或某方面不完全了解或不知道，常用於較客氣或謙遜的語境中。
explanation_english: Used to acknowledge that the speaker is not fully knowledgeable about something or an aspect of a topic; often used politely or modestly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 關於呢個法律問題，我有所不知，最好問律師比較保險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwaan1 jyu1 ni1 go3 faat3 leot6 man6 tai4, ngo5 jau5 so2 bat1 zi1, zeoi3 hou2 man6 leot6 si1 bei2 gaau3 bou2 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 關於這個法律問題，我有所不知，最好問律師比較保險。
examples.english_sentence: Regarding this legal issue, I'm not fully informed; it's best to consult a lawyer to be safe.

mandarin_meaning: 有手有脚；身体健全、能自己行动或自理（有时带有责备或催促意味）
english_meaning: able-bodied; physically capable; able to take care of oneself or do things independently (sometimes used reproachfully)
explanation_mandarin: 「有手有腳」常用來形容一個人身體健全、能自行行動或自理。口語中也常用來催促或責備對方做事，意思相當於「你有手有腳，自己做吧」。
explanation_english: Literally “have hands and feet.” Used to describe someone who is physically capable or able to take care of themselves. In colloquial use it can also be used reproachfully to urge someone to do something themselves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有手有腳，唔好成日等人幫你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 sau2 jau5 goek3, m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 dang2 jan4 bong1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有手有脚，不要总是等别人帮你。
examples.english_sentence: You're able-bodied — don't always rely on others to help you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢雖然年紀大，但仲有手有腳，可以自己照顧自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seoi1jin4 nin4gei3 daai6, daan6 zung6 jau5 sau2 jau5 goek3, ho2 ji5 zi6 gei2 ziu3 gu3 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他雖然年紀大，但還是有手有脚，可以自己照顧自己。
examples.english_sentence: Although he's old, he's still able-bodied and can take care of himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有手有腳，自己做啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 sau2 jau5 goek3, zi6 gei2 zou6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有手有脚，自己做吧！
examples.english_sentence: You have hands and feet — do it yourself!

mandarin_meaning: （有）找（錢）；有零錢
english_meaning: there is change (to give back); have change
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，常在買賣或付錢時使用，表示需要找回的錢存在或有找錢可給對方。也可用於詢問是否有零錢。
explanation_english: Colloquial expression used during transactions to indicate that there is change to give back, or to ask whether someone has change.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你畀咗一百蚊，我有找你三十蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bei2 zo2 jat1 baak3 man1, ngo5 jau5 zaau2 nei5 saam1 sap6 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你给了一百块，我要找你三十块。
examples.english_sentence: You paid 100 dollars; I have 30 dollars in change for you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇找錢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 zaau2 cin2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有没有零钱？
examples.english_sentence: Do you have change?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使找，正好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 zaau2, zing3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用找了，正好。
examples.english_sentence: No change needed — it's exact.

mandarin_meaning: 愛吹牛、愛誇張地說話
english_meaning: to boast; to talk big; to be cocky
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，通常用來形容一個人喜歡誇大、吹噓自己或說大話，帶有貶義，屬非正式用語。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang expression used to describe someone who boasts, brags, or talks big. It's informal and often carries a negative nuance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺度話自己有幾勁，真係好有把炮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4jat6 hai2 dou6 waa6 zi6gei2 jau5 gei2 ging6, zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 baa2 paau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是在那裡說自己多厲害，真是很會吹牛。
examples.english_sentence: He always talks about how great he is — he's really boastful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好有把炮，做唔到就唔好亂答應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 jau5 baa2 paau3, zou6 m4 dou3 zau6 m4 hou2 lyun6 daap3 jing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你別吹牛了，做不到就不要亂答應。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk big — if you can't do it, don't promise it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 其實佢講嘅大多數都係誇張嘅，唔好太信，有把炮啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kei4sat6 keoi5 gong2 ge3 daai6 do1sou3 dou1 hai6 kwaa1zoeng1 ge3, m4 hou2 taai3 seon3, jau5 baa2 paau3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 其實他說的大多是誇張的，別太信，他只是吹牛而已。
examples.english_sentence: Actually most of what he says is exaggerated — don't trust him too much, he's just boasting.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）拖延、拖拉、不履行或敷衍責任的行為或狀態
english_meaning: A colloquial Cantonese expression describing procrastination or stalling—delaying tasks or shirking responsibility
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 口語片語（可作動詞或形容詞用）
explanation_mandarin: 「有拖冇欠」是廣東話口語，常用來形容一個人做事拖拉、愛耽擱、不願負責或把事情拖著不處理。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase used to describe someone who habitually delays, stalls, or avoids fulfilling responsibilities—i.e., procrastinates or leaves things unfinished.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好有拖冇欠，答應咗就要做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 jau5 to1 mou5 him3, daap3 jing3 zo2 zau6 jiu3 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要拖拖拉拉，答应了就要做。
examples.english_sentence: Don't procrastinate; if you promised, follow through.

mandarin_meaning: 可疑、有端倪（口語，香港粵語）
english_meaning: suspicious; there are signs/clues that something is amiss (colloquial Cantonese)
explanation_mandarin: 「有指」為香港粵語口語用法，用來表示某事有可疑之處或有線索顯示可能有問題／貓膩，相當於「可疑」或「有問題」。屬非正式用語。
explanation_english: A colloquial Hong Kong Cantonese expression used to indicate that something is suspicious or there are clues/signs that something is wrong or fishy. It is informal and roughly equivalent to 'suspicious' or 'there's something off.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單交易有指，最好唔好即刻簽名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 gaau1 jik6 jau5 zi2, zeoi3 hou2 m4 hou2 zik1 hak1 cim1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這筆交易有可疑，最好不要立刻簽名。
examples.english_sentence: This transaction seems suspicious; it's best not to sign immediately.

mandarin_meaning: （疑為口誤）有憑有據 / 有理有據 — 有證據或理由支持
english_meaning: Likely a nonstandard/mistaken variant meaning 'with evidence' or 'well-founded' (i.e., having proof to support a claim).
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 短语 / 形容詞性短語
explanation_mandarin: 此詞並非標準成語，可能是口語或筆誤，常見意圖為“有憑有據”或“有理有據”，表示某事有證據或理由支撐；在非正式語境偶見。
explanation_english: This is not a standard idiom; it appears to be a colloquial or mistaken variant of '有憑有據'/'有理有據', meaning that something is backed by evidence. It is rare and mainly seen in informal speech/writing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好亂講，講嘢要有挨有憑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lyun6 gong2, gong2 je5 jiu3 jau5 aai1 jau5 pang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要亂說，說話要有憑有據。
examples.english_sentence: Don't speak recklessly; what you say should be backed by evidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢冇做，但我有挨有憑，證明佢做過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 mou5 zou6, daan6 ngo5 jau5 aai1 jau5 pang4, zing3 ming4 keoi5 zou6 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說他沒有做，但我有憑有據，證明他做過。
examples.english_sentence: He says he didn't do it, but I have proof showing he did.

mandarin_meaning: 要很久；還要一段時間（口語）
english_meaning: a long time; it'll be a while (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語短語，表示需要很長時間或還要等很久，常與「先」連用（如「有排先」）。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase meaning 'for a long time' or 'it will take a while'. Often used with '先' (e.g., '有排先').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋有排先到啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jau5 paai4 sin1 dou3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們還要很久才能到。
examples.english_sentence: It'll be a while before we get there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日冇得休息，仲有排做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 mou5 dak1 jau1 sik1, zung6 jau5 paai4 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天沒得休息，還有很多工作要做。
examples.english_sentence: No rest today; there's still a lot of work to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 想買樓？有排啦，依家買唔起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng2 maai5 lau4? jau5 paai4 laa3, ji1 gaa1 maai5 m4 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 想買房子？還得等很久，現在買不起。
examples.english_sentence: Want to buy a flat? Not for a long time — we can't afford it now.

mandarin_meaning: 要長時間受苦／受折磨（口語）
english_meaning: to have to endure/suffer for a long time; be in for a long rough time
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語，表示要長時間承受不愉快或困難的狀況，通常帶有抱怨或警告的語氣。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang phrase meaning one will have to endure unpleasantness or hardship for a long time; often used with a tone of complaint or warning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日唔交功課，返學嗰陣有排受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 m4 gaau1 gung1 fo3, faan1 hok6 go2 zan6 jau5 paai4 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天不交作业，上学的时候会受很久的罪。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't hand in your homework today, you'll be in for a rough time at school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部車壞咗，要整成個月，真係有排受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 ce1 waai6 zo2, jiu3 zing2 sing4 go3 jyut6, zan1 hai6 jau5 paai4 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车坏了，要修好一个月，真是要受很久。
examples.english_sentence: This car broke down and will take a month to fix — it's going to be a long ordeal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日加班，咁落去有排受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gaa1 baan1, gam2 lok6 heoi3 jau5 paai4 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常加班，这样下去要受很長時間的苦。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps working overtime; if this continues he'll be suffering for a long time.

mandarin_meaning: 有损（对名誉、利益、形象等造成不利或损害）
english_meaning: detrimental; damaging; harmful; to cause harm or impairment
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某人或某事的名譽、利益、形象等造成不利或損害，常用於警告言行可能帶來負面影響。
explanation_english: Indicates causing harm or damage to someone's reputation, interests, image, etc.; often used to warn that an action or remark may have negative consequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁講可能會有損佢嘅名譽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 gong2 ho2 nang4 wui5 jau5 syun2 keoi5 ge3 ming4 jyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那麼說可能會有損他的名誉。
examples.english_sentence: Saying that might be damaging to his reputation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲評論對公司形象有損。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 ping4 leon6 deoi3 gung1 si1 jing4 zoeng6 jau5 syun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些评论对公司的形象有损。
examples.english_sentence: These comments are damaging to the company's image.

mandarin_meaning: （粗俗）用作加強語氣的語助詞，類似「他媽的／他X的」，表示強烈的強調或不滿
english_meaning: A vulgar Cantonese intensifier roughly meaning 'fucking' used to add strong emphasis, contempt, or anger
explanation_mandarin: 「有撚」是香港粵語粗口，字面上「撚」有性器意涵，但常用作語氣助詞，放在句中以加強語氣或表不滿。屬粗俗用語，正式場合不宜使用。
explanation_english: A coarse Hong Kong Cantonese profanity. Literally related to a vulgar word, but commonly used as a sentence particle to intensify emotion or express irritation/insult. Very informal and offensive — avoid in polite contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有撚叻喎，唔好小看佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 lan2 lek1 wo3, m4 hou2 siu2 hon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他他媽的很厲害，別小看他。
examples.english_sentence: He's fucking skilled — don't underestimate him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝交通有撚亂，我遲到晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 gaau1 tung1 jau5 lan2 lyun6, ngo5 ci4 dou3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上交通他媽的很亂，我遲到了。
examples.english_sentence: This morning the traffic was fucking chaotic — I'm late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有撚冇禮貌呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 lan2 mou5 lai5 maau6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你他媽的沒禮貌嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Are you fucking rude?

mandarin_meaning: 有效 (yǒuxiào)
english_meaning: effective; valid
explanation_mandarin: 表示具有作用或能产生预期效果；也可指票据、证件等仍然具有法律或使用效力。
explanation_english: Indicates something produces the intended effect or works; can also mean something (e.g., a ticket or document) is still valid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個藥仲有效。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 joek6 zung6 jau5 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個藥還有效。
examples.english_sentence: This medicine is still effective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張票已經唔有效喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 piu3 ji5 ging1 m4 jau5 haau6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這張票已經不再有效了。
examples.english_sentence: This ticket is no longer valid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅方法好有效，可以試多幾次。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 fong1 faat3 hou2 jau5 haau6, ho2 ji5 si3 do1 gei2 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的方法很有效，可以再試幾次。
examples.english_sentence: Your method is very effective; you can try a few more times.

mandarin_meaning: 有效期
english_meaning: validity period; expiry date
explanation_mandarin: 指某物或某項許可在一定時間內具有法律效力或可使用的期限，例如證件、優惠券、食品或藥品的有效期限。
explanation_english: Refers to the period during which something (a document, permit, coupon, food, or medicine) remains valid or usable; essentially the time span before something expires.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢盒牛奶嘅有效期仲有三日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 hap6 ngau4 naai5 ge3 jau5 haau6 kei4 zung6 jau5 saam1 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這盒牛奶的有效期還有三天。
examples.english_sentence: This carton of milk still has three days before its expiry date.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅護照有效期仲有幾耐？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 wu6 ziu3 jau5 haau6 kei4 zung6 jau5 gei2 noi6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的護照有效期還有多久？
examples.english_sentence: How long is your passport still valid for?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張優惠券嘅有效期係到下個月底。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 jau1 wai6 hyun3 ge3 jau5 haau6 kei4 hai6 dou3 haa6 go3 jyut6 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這張優惠券的有效期到下個月底。
examples.english_sentence: This coupon is valid until the end of next month.

mandarin_meaning: 有救（有希望、可挽回）
english_meaning: to be salvageable; there is hope; can be saved
explanation_mandarin: 表示有希望被救治或挽回。也可用於比喻，指某事仍有轉圜或改變的可能。
explanation_english: Indicates that something can be rescued or recovered; used literally for rescue/medical contexts and figuratively to mean there's still a chance or it's salvageable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近病情好咗，醫生話有救。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 beng6 cing4 hou2 zo2, ji1 sang1 waa6 jau5 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近病情好了，醫生說有救。
examples.english_sentence: His condition has improved recently; the doctor says there's hope.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你肯努力，呢個項目仲有救。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 hang2 nou5 lik6, ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 zung6 jau5 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你肯努力，這個項目還有得救。
examples.english_sentence: If you work hard, this project can still be salvaged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日會放晴，咁我哋嘅旅行就有救喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 wui5 fong3 ceng4, gam2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 leoi5 hang4 zau6 jau5 gau3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天會放晴，那我們的旅行就有著落了。
examples.english_sentence: If it clears up tomorrow, our trip will be saved.

mandarin_meaning: 有教無類（教育不分貴賤，人人皆可受教）
english_meaning: Education for all; to teach without discrimination; providing instruction regardless of social class or background.
explanation_mandarin: 原指教育不應區分貴賤門第，人人皆可受教。現用於表示教育普及或不分出身地提供教導的理念。
explanation_english: Originally meant that education should not distinguish by social class and that everyone is entitled to instruction. Now used to express the idea of accessible, non-discriminatory education.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間學校秉承「有教無類」嘅精神，唔會因為家庭背景而拒收學生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 hok6 haau6 bing2 sing4 jau5 gaau3 mou4 leoi6 ge3 zing1 san4, m4 wui5 jan1 wai6 gaa1 ting4 bui3 ging2 ji4 geoi2 sau1 hok6 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這所學校秉承「有教無類」的精神，不會因為家庭背景而拒絕錄取學生。
examples.english_sentence: This school upholds the principle of 'education for all' and does not refuse to admit students because of their family background.

mandarin_meaning: 有人撐腰/有靠山
english_meaning: to have backing/support; to have influential people on one's side
explanation_mandarin: 口語或俚語，表示某人在背後有支持力量或靠山，因而處於有利位置或不易被觸犯。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang phrase meaning someone has backing or influential supporters behind them, giving them an advantage or protection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以為自己有數圍，但其實根本冇人撐佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 wai6 zi6 gei2 jau5 sou3 wai4, daan6 kei4 sat6 gan1 bun2 mou5 jan4 caang1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以為自己有人撐腰，但其實根本沒有人支持他。
examples.english_sentence: He thinks he has backing, but in fact nobody is supporting him.

mandarin_meaning: 有辦法、能算計並達到目的；精明且能得逞
english_meaning: to be shrewd/resourceful and able to carry out schemes successfully; to have effective tricks or plans
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容某人有手段、精明能幹，能算計並成功實現目的。多用於口語或粵語語境。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is shrewd and resourceful, able to devise and execute plans successfully. Informal Cantonese expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你以為可以呃到佢？佢好有數得計㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji5 wai6 ho2 ji5 ngaak1 dou3 keoi5? keoi5 hou2 jau5 sou3 dak1 gai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你以為可以騙到他？他很有辦法、很會算計。
examples.english_sentence: Do you think you can trick him? He's very shrewd and resourceful.

mandarin_meaning: 有把握；佔優勢
english_meaning: to have confidence / to have the upper hand
explanation_mandarin: 口語表達，表示對某事有把握或佔有優勢（常見於粵語語境）。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to be confident or to hold the advantage in a situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次比賽佢哋有數為，唔使擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 bei2 coi3 keoi5 dei6 jau5 sou3 wai6, m4 sai2 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次比赛他们有把握，不用担心。
examples.english_sentence: They have the upper hand in this match; no need to worry.

mandarin_meaning: 心里有数 / 有把握
english_meaning: to know what's going on; to have an idea or confidence about the outcome
explanation_mandarin: 「有數」在廣東話中常用來表示對情況有理解或估計、心裡有底，或表示有勝算、有把握。後綴或變體（此處以「爲*」表示可接不同字或詞）可用於不同語境，但核心意思不變。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "有數" commonly means to have an idea/understanding of the situation (to be aware or to have it figured out), or to be confident/have a good chance. The suffix or variations (represented here by "爲*") may attach different words, but the core meaning stays the same.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你心裏有數啦，唔使再問我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sam1 leoi5 jau5 sou3 laa3, m4 sai2 zoi3 man6 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你心里有数了，不用再问我。
examples.english_sentence: You know the situation; no need to ask me again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次佢哋有數，可能會贏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 keoi5 dei6 jau5 sou3, ho2 nang4 wui5 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次他们有把握，可能会赢。
examples.english_sentence: This time they have a good chance of winning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做咗功課未？做咗就會有數啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 zo2 gung1 fo3 mei6? zou6 zo2 zau6 wui5 jau5 sou3 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做完作业了吗？做完就会心里有数一些。
examples.english_sentence: Did you finish the homework? If you did you'll have a clearer idea.

mandarin_meaning: 心裡有數 / 有把握 / 知道情況
english_meaning: to know the score; to have a clear idea or confidence about the situation; to have it under control
explanation_mandarin: 「有數維」是廣東話口語說法，等同「心裡有數」或「有把握」，表示對某事知道底細或有把握處理，也可用來提醒別人不用多慮或交給對方處理。句尾的「維」為語氣/呼喚性詞，帶口語色彩。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning 'to know the score' or 'to be confident/know how to handle something.' The final character 維 functions as an informal sentence particle, giving a colloquial/vocative tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好亂講，呢單嘢佢有數維，交畀佢做啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lyun6 gong2, ni1 daan1 je5 keoi5 jau5 sou3 wai4, gaau1 bei2 keoi5 zou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要亂說，這件事他有數（知道怎麼處理），交給他做吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't blurt things out; he's got this under control — leave it to him.

mandarin_meaning: 有文化、有出路；受過教育且前途光明
english_meaning: educated and with good prospects; cultured and likely to have a bright future
explanation_mandarin: 口語用語，形容一個人有學識或文化教養，並且有好前途或發展機會。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase describing someone who is educated/cultured and has good prospects or opportunities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢讀完書，搵到份好工，真係有文有路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 duk6 jyun4 syu1, wan2 dou3 fan6 hou2 gung1, jan1 hai6 jau5 man4 jau5 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他念完書，找到了一份好工作，真是既有文化又有出路。
examples.english_sentence: He finished his studies and found a good job — he's really educated and has good prospects.

mandarin_meaning: 有料（表示有內容、有本事或令人印象深刻）
english_meaning: impressive; having substance; talented; interesting
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語，形容人或事物有料（有內容、有能力、值得注意或令人印象深刻）。可用來稱讚能力、表現或作品有看頭。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang expression meaning someone or something has substance, talent, or is impressive/interesting. Used to praise a person's ability, performance, or a work that is noteworthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你呢個人好有料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ni1 go3 jan4 hou2 jau5 liu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这个人很有料。
examples.english_sentence: You're quite impressive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲好有料，有好多伏筆同驚喜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 hou2 jau5 liu6, jau5 hou2 do1 fuk1 bat1 tung4 ging1 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部戏很有料，有很多伏笔和惊喜。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is full of substance, with many plot twists and surprises.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係有料，演技好犀利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 jau5 liu6, jin2 gei6 hou2 sai1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她真有料，演技很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: They're really impressive; their acting is superb.

mandarin_meaning: 很有看头 / 很有料（口语）
english_meaning: impressive; interesting; has substance (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「有料到」是香港廣東話的口語用法，從「有料」衍生而來，加上「到」作程度強調，用來稱讚某人或某事很有內容、很有看頭、令人印象深刻或有驚喜感。
explanation_english: “有料到” is Hong Kong Cantonese slang derived from “有料” with the particle “到” for emphasis. It’s used to praise someone or something as substantial, impressive, entertaining, or unexpectedly talented.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次佢嘅演講真係有料到，啲例子又生動又實際。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 keoi5 ge3 jin2 gong2 zan1 hai6 jau5 liu6 dou3, di1 lai6 zi2 jau6 saang1 dung6 jau6 sat6 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次他的演讲真的很有看头，例子既生动又实际。
examples.english_sentence: His talk this time was really impressive — the examples were vivid and practical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇完佢新出的節目，我真係覺得好有料到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 jyun4 keoi5 san1 ceot1 ge3 zit3 muk6, ngo5 zan1 hai6 gok3 dak1 hou2 jau5 liu6 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看完他新出的节目，我真的觉得很有看头。
examples.english_sentence: After watching his new show, I really thought it was impressive.

mandarin_meaning: 有分量；有影响力；有能力
english_meaning: to have weight/authority/credibility; to be influential or capable
explanation_mandarin: 指某人或某事有分量、能力或影響力，能讓人重視或信服。常用於口語，形容有實力、有威望或有處事能力。
explanation_english: Refers to someone or something that has weight, capability, or influence — someone people take seriously or respect. A colloquial expression used to describe authority, competence, or clout.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個有斤兩嘅領導，員工都好服氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 jau5 gan1 loeng5 ge3 ling5 dou6, jyun4 gung1 dou1 hou2 fuk6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是個有分量的領導，員工都很服氣。
examples.english_sentence: He's a leader with real authority; the staff all respect him.

jyutping: jau5 zou2 zi1 mou5 hat1 ji4
mandarin_meaning: 早知道就不會落到要乞討的地步／早知道就不會這樣（用以表示後悔或諷刺）
english_meaning: If I'd known earlier, I wouldn't have ended up like this / If I had known, I wouldn't be begging (used to express regret or irony)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語說法，表示對現在情況的後悔或自嘲，意思是「早知道會這樣，就不會做出某些決定或落到這種地步」。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression used to convey regret or irony — literally 'if (I) had known earlier, there would be no beggar' — meaning 'had I known, I wouldn't have ended up like this' or 'I wouldn't have done that'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我有早知冇乞兒，我就唔會辭職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 jau5 zou2 zi1 mou5 hat1 ji4, ngo5 zau6 m4 wui5 ci4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果早知道會這樣，我就不會辭職。
examples.english_sentence: If I'd known it would turn out like this, I wouldn't have quit my job.

jyutping: jau5 zou2 zi1 mou5 hat1 ji1
mandarin_meaning: 早知道就不用白費力氣／早知如此就不必做那些沒用的事
english_meaning: If I'd known earlier, I wouldn't have bothered (i.e., I wasted effort unnecessarily).
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示對白費力氣或做了無謂事情的懊悔或埋怨，屬廣東話口語俗語。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to express regret or annoyance about having wasted time or effort; literally 'if (I) had known earlier, (I) wouldn't have bothered.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司突然取消個project，搞到我做咗一大堆嘢，有早知冇乞衣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 dat6 ceoi4 ceoi2 go3 project, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 zou6 zo2 jat1 daai6 deoi1 je5, jau5 zou2 zi1 mou5 hat1 ji1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司突然取消了那個專案，弄得我做了很多事，早知道就不用白費力氣了。
examples.english_sentence: The company suddenly canceled the project, so I ended up doing a lot of work — if I'd known earlier, I wouldn't have bothered.

synonyms: 早知道就不用白費力氣

jyutping: jau5 zou2 zi1, mou5 hat1 ji4
mandarin_meaning: 早知如此，何必當初；要是早知道就不會落得如此下場（表示事後的懊悔）
english_meaning: Literally 'if I had known earlier, I wouldn't be a beggar' — expresses hindsight regret about missed opportunities or bad outcomes.
explanation_mandarin: 這是一句廣東話俗語，字面意思是「早知道就不會變成乞丐」，用來表達對過去決定或機會錯過的後悔與感嘆。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial saying literally meaning 'had I known earlier, I wouldn't be a beggar.' It conveys regret or lamentation about not knowing something earlier and thus missing an opportunity or ending up in a bad situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有早知，冇乞兒，我就唔會投資嗰間公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 zou2 zi1, mou5 hat1 ji4, ngo5 zau6 m4 wui5 tau4 zi1 go2 gaan1 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要是早知道，就不會投資那家公司了。
examples.english_sentence: If I'd known earlier, I wouldn't have invested in that company.

mandarin_meaning: 有时 (yǒushí)
english_meaning: sometimes; occasionally
explanation_mandarin: 表示在某些时候，偶尔发生或出现，不是一直或经常发生。
explanation_english: Indicates that something happens occasionally or at certain times, not always or frequently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我有時喺街市買餸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jau5 si4 hai2 gaai1 si5 maai5 sung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我有时在菜市场买菜。
examples.english_sentence: Sometimes I buy groceries at the market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有時我返工會遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 si4 ngo5 faan1 gung1 wui5 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有时我上班会迟到。
examples.english_sentence: Sometimes I'm late for work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有時講嘢幾好笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 si4 gong2 je5 gei2 hou2 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有时说话很有趣。
examples.english_sentence: He is sometimes quite funny.

mandarin_meaning: 有时/有时候
english_meaning: sometimes; occasionally
explanation_mandarin: 表示在某些時間或情況下會發生，描述頻率不固定的情況。
explanation_english: Indicates that something happens at certain times; describes an indefinite or occasional frequency.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我有時候好忙，冇時間出去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jau5 si4 hau6 hou2 mong4, mou5 si4 gaan3 ceot1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我有时候很忙，没时间出去。
examples.english_sentence: Sometimes I'm very busy and don't have time to go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有時候佢會遲到，唔係故意嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 si4 hau6 keoi5 wui5 ci4 dou3, m4 hai6 gu3 ji3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有时候他会迟到，不是故意的。
examples.english_sentence: Sometimes he is late; it's not intentional.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣有時候會好熱，有時候又會落雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 jau5 si4 hau6 wui5 hou2 jit6, jau5 si4 hau6 jau6 wui5 lok6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天气有时候会很热，有时候又会下雨。
examples.english_sentence: The weather is sometimes very hot, and sometimes it rains.

mandarin_meaning: 有前景；有希望；有出路
english_meaning: promising; having prospects; likely to succeed
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，表示某事物或前途有發展空間或有希望成功，類似「有前景」。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning something has prospects or a promising future (similar to 'has potential' or 'promising').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工好有景，將來升職機會多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 hou2 jau5 ging2, zoeng1 loi4 sing1 zik1 gei1 wui6 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作很有前景，未来升职机会多。
examples.english_sentence: This job is very promising; there will be many promotion opportunities in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果呢個生意改善營運方式，可能會有景。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ni1 go3 saang1 ji3 goi2 sin6 jing4 wan6 fong1 sik1, ho2 nang4 wui5 jau5 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果这个生意改善营运方式，可能会有前景。
examples.english_sentence: If this business improves its operations, it might become promising.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家學IT仲有景，人工升得快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hok6 IT zung6 jau5 ging2, jan4 gung1 sing1 dak1 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在学IT还很有前景，工资上涨得快。
examples.english_sentence: Studying IT now is still promising; salaries rise quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 有望爆紅；可能引起轟動
english_meaning: likely to blow up / go viral; likely to cause a sensation
explanation_mandarin: 「有景轟」是香港廣東話的俚語，表示某事物（例如影片、帖子、表演等）有很大機會迅速走紅或引起轟動。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang phrase meaning something is likely to become a big hit or go viral—expected to attract widespread attention or cause a sensation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲片咁吸引，遲啲一定有景轟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 pin3 gam2 kap1 jan5, ci4 di1 jat1 ding6 jau5 ging2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那些影片很吸引，遲早會爆紅。
examples.english_sentence: His videos are so captivating — they'll definitely go viral sooner or later.

jyutping: jau5 pang4 zi6 jyun5 fong1 loi4
mandarin_meaning: 有朋友從遠方來（原出自《論語》「有朋自遠方來，不亦樂乎」）
english_meaning: Having friends come from afar; (from Confucius) 'Isn't it a pleasure to have friends come from afar?'
explanation_mandarin: 出自《論語》，原句為「有朋自遠方來，不亦樂乎」。用來表達有朋友從遠方來訪，感到高興、歡迎和款待之意。
explanation_english: Originally from the Analects ('Isn't it a pleasure to have friends come from afar?'). Used to express joy and hospitality when friends arrive from far away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有朋自遠方來，梗係要請佢食嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 pang4 zi6 jyun5 fong1 loi4, gang2 hai6 jiu3 cing2 keoi5 sik6 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 朋友從遠方來，當然要請他吃飯。
examples.english_sentence: When friends come from afar, of course you should treat them to a meal.

mandarin_meaning: 有希望；可能實現
english_meaning: hopeful; promising; likely to happen
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事有實現的希望或可能性，常用來描述結果有望發生或達成。
explanation_english: Indicates that something has a good chance of happening or being achieved; used to describe a promising or likely outcome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家有望喺比賽入選。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 jau5 mong6 hai2 bei2 coi3 jap6 syun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在有望在比賽中入選。
examples.english_sentence: He now has a good chance of being selected in the competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你繼續努力，升職就有望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 gai3 zuk6 nou5 lik6, sing1 zik1 zau6 jau5 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你繼續努力，升職就有希望。
examples.english_sentence: If you keep working hard, promotion is likely.

mandarin_meaning: 总有一天；将来某日
english_meaning: someday; one day in the future
explanation_mandarin: 表示在将来的某一天，常用于表达愿望、期盼或推测。
explanation_english: Indicates that something will happen at some future time; often used to express hope, aspiration, or speculation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有朝一日，我希望可以自己開間咖啡店。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 ziu1 jat1 jat6, ngo5 hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 zi6 gei2 hoi1 gaan1 gaa3 fe1 dim3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有朝一日，我希望可以自己开一家咖啡店。
examples.english_sentence: Someday, I hope to open my own café.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話有朝一日會還返啲錢畀我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 jau5 ziu1 jat1 jat6 wui5 waan4 faan1 di1 cin2 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说总有一天会把钱还给我。
examples.english_sentence: He says he'll pay me back someday.

mandarin_meaning: 有期徒刑（固定期限的徒刑，即在一定期限内剥夺人身自由的刑罚）
english_meaning: fixed-term imprisonment (a prison sentence for a specified period)
explanation_mandarin: 指法院對被告判處在一定期限內剝奪其人身自由的刑罰，期滿後通常可以釋放；與無期徒刑（終身監禁）相對。
explanation_english: A prison sentence that lasts for a specified period. It deprives a person of their liberty for a fixed term and is contrasted with life imprisonment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為貪污被判有期徒刑十年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 taam1 wu1 bei6 pun3 jau5 kei4 tou4 jing4 sap6 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為貪污被判處有期徒刑十年。
examples.english_sentence: He was sentenced to ten years' fixed-term imprisonment for corruption.

mandarin_meaning: 有條理、講究規矩；做事或擺設很有章法
english_meaning: methodical; proper; well-organized; punctilious
explanation_mandarin: 表示人或事物有條理、講究形式或規矩，做事有章法、不馬虎。
explanation_english: Describes a person or thing that is orderly, proper, and follows rules or conventions—doing things with method and attention to form.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做事有板有眼，老闆好放心交畀佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 si6 jau5 baan2 jau5 ngaan5, lou5 baan2 hou2 fong3 sam1 gaau1 bei2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事有板有眼，老板很放心把工作交給他。
examples.english_sentence: He works methodically; the boss is comfortable entrusting tasks to him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳擺設有板有眼，感覺好有格調。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 baai2 cit3 jau5 baan2 jau5 ngaan5, gam2 gok3 hou2 jau5 gaak3 diu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這家餐廳擺設有板有眼，感覺很有格調。
examples.english_sentence: The restaurant's decor is well-arranged and tasteful.

mandarin_meaning: 有不正當的感情或性關係；被牽連或染上不良名聲
english_meaning: to have an illicit romantic/sexual relationship (to have an affair); to be implicated or tainted
explanation_mandarin: 「有染」多用來形容在感情或婚姻中與第三者發生不正當關係（即出軌、有外遇）；也可泛指牽涉不正當行為而被牽連或名譽受損。
explanation_english: Commonly used to describe being involved in an illicit romantic or sexual relationship (i.e., having an affair). It can also be used more generally for being implicated or having one's reputation tainted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀人傳有染，已經辭職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 cyun4 jau5 jim2, ji5 ging1 ci4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被传有染，已经辞职。
examples.english_sentence: He was rumored to have had an affair and has resigned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果證實佢有染，佢就要負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 zing3 sat6 keoi5 jau5 jim2, keoi5 zau6 jiu3 fu6 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果证实他有染，他就要负责。
examples.english_sentence: If it turns out he had an affair, he will have to take responsibility.

mandarin_meaning: 有根有据（有依据、有证据）
english_meaning: well-founded; supported by evidence; not groundless
explanation_mandarin: 形容說法、推論或指控有依據或證據，不是憑空捏造或沒有根據。
explanation_english: Describes a statement, claim, or accusation that is supported by facts or evidence — not baseless or made up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅指控要有根有據，唔可以淨係憑感覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 zi2 hung3 jiu3 jau5 gan1 jau5 geoi3, m4 ho2 ji5 zing6 hai6 pang4 gam2 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的指控要有根有據，不能只是憑感覺。
examples.english_sentence: Your accusation needs to be well-founded; you can't just rely on a hunch.

mandarin_meaning: 有根有据 / 有凭据
english_meaning: well-founded; supported by evidence; has a basis
explanation_mandarin: 「有根有蔃」是香港口語用法，通常視為「有根有據」的變體。用來表示某個說法或指控有依據、有證據，不是憑空捏造。
explanation_english: “有根有蔃” is a Hong Kong colloquial variant of the standard phrase “有根有據”. It means that a claim or accusation is supported by evidence or has a factual basis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘅事最好有根有蔃，唔好冇憑無據就話人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 ge3 si6 zeoi3 hou2 jau5 gan1 jau5 geoi3, m4 hou2 mou5 pang4 mou4 geoi3 zau6 waa6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你說的事情最好有根有據，不要沒憑沒據就說別人。
examples.english_sentence: What you claim should be well-founded; don't accuse others without evidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記者追問可唔可以出示證據，佢話有根有蔃，之後冇再補充。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 ze2 zeoi1 man6 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 ceot1 si6 zing3 geoi3, keoi5 waa6 jau5 gan1 jau5 geoi3, zi1 hau6 mou5 zoi3 bou2 cung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 記者追問能否出示證據，他說有根有據，之後沒有再補充。
examples.english_sentence: When reporters asked for evidence, he said it was well-founded and didn't provide further details.

jyutping: jau5 gan1 geoi3 (疑為筆誤，正確應為「有根據」 j au5 gan1 geoi3)
mandarin_meaning: （疑為筆誤）有根據／有依據
english_meaning: has basis/evidence; well-founded (likely a misspelling of '有根據')
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞短語/形容詞短語（視語境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 「有根蔃」並非標準粵語詞彙，極可能是書寫或輸入錯誤，正確用法應為「有根據」，意思是有證據或根據。也有少數情況下出現字形誤用（如把『根據』錯寫為『根蔃』）。
explanation_english: “有根蔃” is not a standard Cantonese expression and is most likely a misspelling of “有根據” (jau5 gan1 geoi3), which means “to have a basis/evidence” or “to be well-founded.” The entry notes common orthographic error rather than a distinct lexical item.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有人喺留言寫「有根蔃」，其實應該寫「有根據」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 jan4 hai2 lau4 jin4 se2 “jau5 gan1 coeng4”, kei4 sat6 jing1 goi1 se2 “jau5 gan1 geoi3”.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有人在留言寫「有根蔃」，其實應該寫「有根據」。
examples.english_sentence: Someone wrote “有根蔃” in the comment, but they should have written “有根據.”

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇報道有根據，唔係人哋亂講嘅。 (等同於：有根蔃為誤寫)
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ppin1 bou3 dou6 jau5 gan1 geoi3, m4 hai6 jan4 dei6 lyun6 gong2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这篇报道有根据，不是别人随便说的。（“有根蔃”為誤寫）
examples.english_sentence: This report has a basis; it's not something people made up. (Note: “有根蔃” would be a misspelling)

mandarin_meaning: 有条不紊 (yǒu tiáo bù wěn) — 做事有秩序、有條理
english_meaning: orderly and methodical; doing things in a well-organized, systematic way
explanation_mandarin: 表示處理事情有秩序、步驟分明、不慌不忙，通常用來形容做事有條理。
explanation_english: Describes handling tasks in an orderly, well-organized, and methodical manner; often used to say someone is not flustered and follows a clear sequence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然時間好趕，但佢哋都能夠有條不紊地完成任務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 si4 gaan3 hou2 gon2, daan6 keoi5 dei6 dou1 nang4 gau3 jau5 tiu4 bat1 man2 dei6 jyun4 sing4 jam6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 雖然時間很緊，但他們仍能有條不紊地完成任務。
examples.english_sentence: Although time was tight, they were still able to complete the tasks in an orderly, methodical way.

mandarin_meaning: 有模有樣 (yǒu mú yǒu yàng)：看起來像樣、體面、有架勢
english_meaning: to look the part; presentable; to have an impressive or proper appearance
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語 / 形容詞性短語
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人的言行、打扮或表現看起來像樣、有架勢、體面。可用作誇讚，也可帶一點諷刺意味。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone's manner, appearance, or performance as presentable, looking the part, or striking a proper pose. Can be complimentary or slightly ironic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁講都幾有模有樣喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 gong2 dou1 gei2 jau5 mou4 jau5 joeng6 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣說也頗有模有樣呀。
examples.english_sentence: You say it like that and it actually sounds quite convincing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢第一次表演已經有模有樣，觀眾都鼓掌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dai6 jat1 ci3 biu2 jin2 ji5 ging1 jau5 mou4 jau5 joeng6, gun1 zung3 dou1 gu2 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他第一次表演就已經很有模有樣，觀眾都鼓掌了。
examples.english_sentence: His first performance already looked quite professional; the audience applauded.

mandarin_meaning: 有样学样 / 学样子，效仿、跟风（口语）
english_meaning: to follow suit; to imitate someone else's behavior, often unthinkingly or by habit
explanation_mandarin: 表示模仿別人的行為或做法，常帶有盲目跟從或缺乏主見的含意。
explanation_english: Expresses copying someone else's actions or behavior, often implying blind following or a lack of independent judgment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見公司啲人上班都遲到，就有樣學樣日日遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 gung1si1 di1 jan4 soeng5baan1 dou1 ci4dou3, zau6 jau5 joeng6 hok6 joeng6 jat6jat6 ci4dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到公司的人上班都迟到，就跟着学样子天天迟到。
examples.english_sentence: He saw that people at the company were all late for work, so he followed suit and was late every day.
