examples.mandarin_sentence: 那張板凳很舊，坐下去會吱吱作響。
examples.english_sentence: That bench is very old; it squeaks when you sit on it.

mandarin_meaning: 呆滯、僵硬、不靈活或運作緩慢
english_meaning: stiff; rigid; dull; sluggish; not flexible or smooth
explanation_mandarin: 「板滯」用來形容人說話、動作或機器反應等顯得僵硬、不流暢或遲鈍。
explanation_english: Used to describe speech, movements, or devices that are stiff, not fluid, or respond sluggishly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近講嘢好板滯，好似冇精神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 gong2 je5 hou2 baan2 zai6, hou2 ci5 mou5 zing1 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近說話很板滯，像是沒精神。
examples.english_sentence: He's been speaking very stiffly lately, as if he's low on energy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦反應好板滯，要重新開機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 faan2 jing3 hou2 baan2 zai6, jiu3 cung4 san1 hoi1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部電腦反應很板滯，要重新開機。
examples.english_sentence: The computer is responding sluggishly; it needs a restart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 跳舞啲動作有啲板滯，要更加流暢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu3 mou5 di1 dung6 zok3 jau5 di1 baan2 zai6, jiu3 gang1 ga1 lau4 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 跳舞的動作有點呆滯，需要更流暢。
examples.english_sentence: The dance moves are a bit stiff and need to be more fluid.

mandarin_meaning: 板球（運動）
english_meaning: cricket (the sport)
explanation_mandarin: 一種源自英國的球類運動，兩隊各有十一名球員，使用球拍（bat）和球（ball）在長形草地球場上比賽，包含投球、擊球和跑壘等規則。
explanation_english: A bat-and-ball sport originating in England, played between two teams of eleven players on an oval field with a rectangular 22-yard pitch; involves bowling, batting, and running between wickets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋學校有個板球隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hok6 haau6 jau5 go3 baan2 kau4 deoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們學校有一支板球隊。
examples.english_sentence: Our school has a cricket team.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意打板球，每個禮拜都去練習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 daa2 baan2 kau4, mui5 go3 lai5 baai3 dou1 heoi3 lin6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜歡打板球，每個星期都去練習。
examples.english_sentence: He really likes playing cricket and practises every week.

mandarin_meaning: 板著臉；擺出嚴肅或高傲的表情
english_meaning: to put on a stern, serious, or haughty face; to sulk or look aloof
explanation_mandarin: 表示擺出嚴肅、冷淡或高傲的表情，通常帶有不悅、不屑或不願交流的意思。
explanation_english: A Cantonese expression meaning to adopt a stern, cold, or haughty facial expression — often indicating displeasure, aloofness, or unwillingness to interact.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到老細就板起塊面，唔敢講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou3 lou5 sai3 zau6 baan2 hei2 faai3 min6, m4 gam2 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一看到老闆就板起臉，不敢說話。
examples.english_sentence: He puts on a stern face when he sees the boss and doesn't dare to speak.

mandarin_meaning: 板门店（Bǎnméndiàn），位于朝鲜半岛非军事区（DMZ）内的停战村与会谈场所，是朝鲜战争停战协议签署地，常作为南北韩会谈的代称。
english_meaning: Panmunjom — the truce village in the Korean Demilitarized Zone (DMZ); the site of the Korean War armistice signing and a location for inter-Korean meetings.
explanation_mandarin: 板门店位于朝鲜半岛非军事区，是1953年朝鲜战争停战协定签署的地点，也是历次南北韩高层会晤与会谈的场所，常被用来指代在该处举行的会谈或会面。
explanation_english: Panmunjom is located in the Korean Demilitarized Zone. It is where the 1953 Korean War armistice was signed and has been the site of high-level inter-Korean meetings. The name is often used to refer to talks or meetings held there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 板門店係朝鮮半島非軍事區入面一個著名嘅地方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan2 mun4 dim3 hai6 ziu1 sin3 bun3 dou2 fei1 gwan1 si6 keoi1 jap6 min6 jat1 go3 zoek3 ming4 ge3 dei6 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 板门店是朝鲜半岛非军事区内一个著名的地方。
examples.english_sentence: Panmunjom is a well-known place inside the Korean Demilitarized Zone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去年領導人喺板門店舉行咗重要會面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 nin4 ling5 dou6 jan4 hai2 baan2 mun4 dim3 geoi2 hang4 zo2 zung6 jiu3 wui6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去年领导人在板门店举行了重要的会面。
examples.english_sentence: Last year leaders held an important meeting at Panmunjom.

mandarin_meaning: 板間房 / 劏房（隔成多個小間的出租房，通常空間狹窄且條件差）
english_meaning: subdivided room / partitioned room (a small rented space created by partitioning a flat, often with poor living conditions)
explanation_mandarin: 香港口語，指將單位用木板或薄牆隔成多個小房間出租的居住單位，通常面積細、通風採光差，部分屬非法或不合規格的分間住屋。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong colloquial term for rooms created by partitioning a flat with boards or thin walls for separate rental. These units are typically very small, poorly ventilated and lit, and some are illegal or substandard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多人住喺板間房，租金平但環境差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 jan4 zyu6 hai2 baan2 gaan1 fong4, zou1 gam1 ping4 daan6 waan4 ging2 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在很多人住在板間房，租金便宜但環境差。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays many people live in subdivided rooms; the rent is cheap but the living conditions are poor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府打算清拆一啲非法嘅板間房，安置居民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 daa2 syun3 cing1 caak3 jat1 di1 fei1 faat3 ge3 baan2 gaan1 fong4, on1 zi6 geoi1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府打算清拆一些非法的板間房，安置居民。
examples.english_sentence: The government plans to demolish some illegal subdivided rooms and resettle the residents.

mandarin_meaning: 臨時圍板；作為阻擋或隔離用的木板／圍欄
english_meaning: temporary hoarding/board used as a barrier or partition; a physical obstacle
explanation_mandarin: 「板障」在粤語中常指施工或臨時用途的圍板、護欄等，用來隔離或阻擋出入，也可泛指實體的障礙物。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "板障" commonly refers to temporary hoardings or boards used as barriers or partitions at construction sites or for temporary isolation; it can also generically mean a physical obstacle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個工地四周都圍咗板障，行人要繞路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 gung1 dei6 sei3 zau1 dou1 wai4 zo2 baan2 zoeng3, haang4 jan4 jiu3 jyu4 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工地四周都圍上了圍板，行人要繞道。
examples.english_sentence: The construction site is surrounded by hoardings, pedestrians have to detour.

mandarin_meaning: 极（極）；表示程度很高；也可作名词表示极点、两极
english_meaning: extreme; very; utmost; (noun) pole, extreme
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 副词 / 形容词 / 名词（视用法而定）
explanation_mandarin: “极”常用来表示程度非常高（如“极好”、“极快”），也可作名词表示极点或两极（如“北极”、“南极”）。
explanation_english: Used to indicate a very high degree (e.g., 'extremely good', 'extremely fast'); can also function as a noun meaning a pole or extreme (e.g., 'North Pole').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日熱極喇，大家要多啲飲水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 jit6 gik6 laa3, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 do1 di1 jam2 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天热极了，大家要多喝水。
examples.english_sentence: It's extremely hot today; everyone should drink more water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部手機快極喇，開應用程式好流暢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 sau2 gei1 faai3 gik6 laa3, hoi1 jing3 jung6 cing4 sik1 hou2 lau4 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部手机快极了，打开应用程序很流畅。
examples.english_sentence: This phone is extremely fast; opening apps is very smooth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地球有北極同南極。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 kau4 jau5 bak1 gik6 tung4 naam4 gik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地球有北极和南极。
examples.english_sentence: The Earth has the North Pole and the South Pole.

mandarin_meaning: （多見於“枇杷”）指枇杷樹或枇杷果
english_meaning: Loquat (as in loquat tree or loquat fruit); usually appears in the compound '枇杷'.
explanation_mandarin: “枇”通常不單獨使用，多見於“枇杷”一詞，指枇杷樹或其果實。
explanation_english: '枇' is rarely used alone and most commonly appears in the compound '枇杷', referring to the loquat tree or its fruit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企有棵枇杷樹，今季枇杷好甜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei2 jau5 fo1 pei4 paa4 syu6, gam1 gwai3 pei4 paa4 hou2 tim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家有一棵枇杷樹，今年枇杷很甜。
examples.english_sentence: There is a loquat tree at my home; the loquats are very sweet this season.

mandarin_meaning: 枇杷（pípá），一种常见的亚热带/温带果树及其果实，果肉黄色至橙色，味甜或微酸，可鲜食或加工成蜜饯、果酱，叶子亦常用于中药（枇杷叶）。
english_meaning: Loquat — an evergreen tree and its fruit with yellow to orange sweet-tart flesh, eaten fresh or preserved; its leaves are also used in traditional medicine.
explanation_mandarin: 枇杷指枇杷树及其果实，果皮薄、果肉多汁，常在春季或初夏成熟。枇杷葉在中醫中用於潤肺、止咳化痰。
explanation_english: Refers to the loquat tree and its fruit. The fruit has thin skin and juicy flesh, typically ripening in spring/early summer. Loquat leaves are used in traditional medicine for respiratory remedies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企院有棵枇杷樹，今年結咗好多果，啲枇杷好甜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei5 jyun2 jau5 fo1 pei4 paa4 syu6, gam1 nin4 git3 zo2 hou2 do1 gwo2, di1 pei4 paa4 hou2 tim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家院子有一棵枇杷树，今年结了很多果，枇杷很甜。
examples.english_sentence: There's a loquat tree in my yard; this year it produced a lot of fruit and the loquats are very sweet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽用枇杷葉煲糖水俾我，話可以紓緩喉嚨痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 jung6 pei4 paa4 jip6 bo1 tong4 seoi2 bei2 ngo5, waa6 ho2 ji5 syu1 wun6 hau4 lung4 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈用枇杷叶煲糖水给我，说可以缓解喉咙痛。
examples.english_sentence: My mom brewed a sweet soup with loquat leaves for me, saying it can ease a sore throat.

mandarin_meaning: 枇杷（pípá）水果，枇杷果
english_meaning: loquat (the fruit of the loquat tree)
explanation_mandarin: 枇杷的一種水果，果肉多汁、酸甜可口，通常在春末或初夏成熟，可鮮食或用來製作果醬、蜜餞等。
explanation_english: The loquat fruit — a juicy, sweet-tart fruit that ripens in late spring to early summer. Eaten fresh or used for jams, preserves, and desserts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意食枇杷果，夏天見到一定會買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 pei4 paa4 gwo2, haa6 tin1 gin3 dou3 jat1 ding6 wui5 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很喜欢吃枇杷，夏天看到一定會買。
examples.english_sentence: I really like loquats; if I see them in summer I'll definitely buy some.

mandarin_meaning: 枇杷膏（pípá gāo）：一種以枇杷為主要材料，配合中藥和蜂蜜等製成的止咳化痰糖漿或藥膏，用於舒緩咳嗽和喉嚨不適。
english_meaning: Loquat syrup (pipa gao): a traditional remedy made from loquat and other herbs/honey, a syrup or paste used to relieve coughs and soothe sore throats.
explanation_mandarin: 一種傳統中藥製劑，常見為甜味的膏狀或糖漿狀，可直接食用或含服，用來止咳、化痰、潤喉，常見於家庭藥櫃或中藥店。
explanation_english: A traditional Chinese medicinal preparation, typically sweet and syrupy or paste-like, taken directly to suppress coughs, reduce phlegm, and soothe the throat; commonly found in households and herbal shops.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喉嚨痛，今晚食咗一啖枇杷膏，舒服啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hau4 lung4 tung3, gam1 maan5 sik6 zo2 jat1 daam2 pei4 paa4 gou1, syu1 fuk6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喉嚨痛，今晚吃了一點枇杷膏，舒服一點。
examples.english_sentence: My throat hurts — I had a spoonful of loquat syrup tonight and feel a bit better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路有咳嗽，媽媽畀佢食枇杷膏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 jau5 hat1 sou3, maa4 maa1 bei2 keoi5 sik6 pei4 paa4 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子咳嗽，媽媽讓他吃枇杷膏。
examples.english_sentence: The child had a cough, so his mother gave him loquat syrup.

mandarin_meaning: （副）白費、枉然；（動）冤枉、不公平對待
english_meaning: as an adverb: in vain / wasted; as a verb: to wrong, to treat unjustly
explanation_mandarin: 「枉」可作副詞，表示白費、徒然、枉然（如「枉費心機」、「都枉然」）；亦可作動詞，表示冤枉、誤判或對人不公（如「枉殺」、「被枉判」）。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, 「枉」 can be used as an adverb meaning 'in vain' or 'wasted' (e.g. '枉費心機', '都枉然'), and as a verb meaning 'to wrong' or 'to treat unjustly' (e.g. '枉殺', '被枉判').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁做，係枉費心機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 zou6, hai6 wong6 fai3 sam1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣做，是白費心機。
examples.english_sentence: Doing that is a waste of effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 辛苦咗咁耐，最後都枉然。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 fu2 zo2 gam2 noi6, zeoi3 hau6 dou1 wong6 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 辛苦了這麼久，最後都枉然。
examples.english_sentence: After working so hard for so long, it was all in vain in the end.

mandarin_meaning: 被冤枉/被誣為小人（被錯誤地說成卑鄙或不良的人）
english_meaning: to be unfairly portrayed or maligned as a petty/villainous person; to be wrongfully accused of being mean or dishonorable
explanation_mandarin: 表示被他人錯誤或不公正地說成是小人（即卑鄙、陰險或無良的人）；有時也可指白白變成小人或做出小人行為而無必要。
explanation_english: Indicates being unjustly labeled or slandered as a petty or villainous person (i.e., mean, deceitful, or dishonorable). It can also sometimes mean having become petty or acted meanly for no good reason.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我畀人枉作小人，真係冤枉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bei2 jan4 wong6 zok3 siu2 jan4, zan1 hai6 jyun1 wong5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我被人誣陷成小人，真是冤枉。
examples.english_sentence: I've been wrongly portrayed as a petty person; it's really unfair.

mandarin_meaning: 枉死（冤枉死、不應該或白白死去）
english_meaning: to die unjustly; to die in vain; an undeserved or wasted death
explanation_mandarin: 指因冤枉、不公平或不值得的原因而死去，含有可惜、無辜或被冤枉的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to dying unjustly or in vain — a death that is undeserved, unfair, or a tragic waste of life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明明冇做錯嘢，點解會枉死呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4ming4 mou5 zou6 co3 je5, dim2 gaai2 wui5 wong6 sei2 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明明沒有做錯事，為什麼會枉死呢？
examples.english_sentence: He clearly didn't do anything wrong — why would he die unjustly?

mandarin_meaning: 枉然（徒劳无功）
english_meaning: in vain; futile; to no avail
explanation_mandarin: 表示白費力氣、毫無結果，常用來形容努力或期待最終落空。
explanation_english: Indicates that efforts or hopes were wasted and produced no result; commonly used to say something was in vain or futile.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁做都枉然，因為佢唔會改變主意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 zou6 dou1 wong5 jin4, jan1 wai6 keoi5 m4 wui5 goi2 bin3 zyu2 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣做也是徒勞無功，因為他不會改變主意。
examples.english_sentence: Doing this is in vain, because he won't change his mind.

mandarin_meaning: 枉读圣贤书（白读/读书无用；教育或读书成了徒然）
english_meaning: to have studied the sages' books in vain; to have one’s education wasted; studies rendered pointless
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人即使讀過書、受過教養，行為卻不合道德或不成材，導致讀書成了徒然、教育白費。
explanation_english: An idiom describing someone whose education or classical learning has been wasted because their behavior or character does not reflect what they have studied; all the schooling was for nothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁樣做，真係枉讀聖賢書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 joeng6 zou6, zan1 hai6 wong5 duk6 sing3 jin4 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样做，真是枉读圣贤书。
examples.english_sentence: Doing that really makes his scholarly studies a waste.

mandarin_meaning: 白費；徒然（浪費時間、力氣或心思）
english_meaning: to be wasted; to be in vain; to waste (effort, time, resources)
explanation_mandarin: 表示付出（時間、心思、力氣、金錢等）沒有得到應有的回報，白白浪費或徒然。
explanation_english: Indicates that effort, time, money, or care has been spent for no result — wasted or in vain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好枉費心機啦，佢唔會改變主意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 wong6 fai3 sam1 gei1 laa1, keoi5 m4 wui5 goi2 bin3 zyu2 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要白費心機了，他不會改變主意。
examples.english_sentence: Don't waste your effort; he won't change his mind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做只會枉費力氣，唔會有結果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng6 zou6 zi2 wui5 wong6 fai3 lik6 hei3, m4 wui5 jau5 git3 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣做只會白費力氣，不會有結果。
examples.english_sentence: Doing this will only be a waste of effort; it won't lead to any results.

mandarin_meaning: 枋（fāng）：方形的木料、横木或梁柱，亦作地名或姓氏使用，古文中常指木构件。
english_meaning: A squared timber, plank or crossbeam; a structural piece of wood (also appears in place names and surnames).
explanation_mandarin: “枋”通常指方形或横放的木料，用作支撑或构件；在地名或姓氏中亦可见。現代漢語中使用頻率較低，多出現於書面或專業建築語境。
explanation_english: The character refers to a piece of squared timber or a crossbeam used for support or as a structural member; it also appears in place names and surnames. It is relatively uncommon in everyday modern speech and is found more in written or technical/building contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條枋係用嚟支撐樓梯嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 fong1 hai6 jung6 lai4 zi1 caang1 lau4 tai1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这根枋是用来支撑楼梯的。
examples.english_sentence: This beam is used to support the stairs.

mandarin_meaning: 分析、分解 (xī)
english_meaning: to analyze; to dissect; to split apart
explanation_mandarin: 表示把整體分開或對事物進行分析、剖析。常見於「分析」「剖析」「分解」等詞語中，用於描述將事物拆解或探討其構成與原因。
explanation_english: Indicates splitting something apart or analyzing/dissecting it. Commonly appears in compounds such as "分析" (analyze), "剖析" (dissect), and "分解" (decompose); used to describe breaking down an object or examining its components and causes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要分析呢個問題嘅原因，先可以搵到解決方法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 fan1 sik1 ni1 go3 man6 tai4 ge3 jyun4 jan1, sin1 ho2 ji5 wan2 dou3 gaai2 kyut3 fong1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要分析这个问题的原因，才能找到解决方法。
examples.english_sentence: We need to analyze the causes of this problem before we can find a solution.

mandarin_meaning: 枕（枕頭）
english_meaning: pillow
explanation_mandarin: 枕，指用來支撐頭部或頸部的軟墊，通常在睡覺或休息時使用。
explanation_english: A pillow — a soft cushion used to support the head or neck, typically used when sleeping or resting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我訓覺冇枕頭訓唔著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 fan3 gaau3 mou5 zam2 tau4 fan3 m4 zoek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我睡覺沒有枕頭睡不著。
examples.english_sentence: I can't fall asleep without a pillow.

mandarin_meaning: 枕著（把頭放在某物上並保持該姿勢）
english_meaning: to rest one's head on (something); to lie with one's head on; to be resting/sleeping with head on
explanation_mandarin: 表示把頭放在某個物體上並保持那個姿勢（多用於睡覺或休息）。其中「住」為表示動作持續或狀態的助詞。
explanation_english: Indicates placing and keeping one's head on something (commonly used for sleeping or resting). The particle '住' marks a continuous or ongoing state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家枕住個枕頭瞓緊覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 zam2 zyu6 go3 zam2 tau4 fan3 gan2 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她現在把頭枕在枕頭上睡覺。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is now sleeping with his/her head on the pillow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我枕住本書發呆，唔知諗緊啲咩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zam2 zyu6 bun2 syu1 faat3 ngoi1, m4 zi1 lam2 gan2 di1 me1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我把頭枕在一本書上發呆，不知道在想什麼。
examples.english_sentence: I rested my head on a book and spaced out, not sure what I'm thinking about.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好枕住張枱喇，會頸痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zam2 zyu6 zoeng1 toi2 laa3, wui5 geng2 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把頭枕在桌子上，會脖子痛。
examples.english_sentence: Don't rest your head on the table; it will hurt your neck.

mandarin_meaning: 枕套（覆盖枕头的布套）
english_meaning: pillowcase
explanation_mandarin: 用來套在枕頭外面的布或其他材質的套子，用以保持枕頭清潔或裝飾。
explanation_english: A cover made of fabric or other material that slips over a pillow to keep it clean or for decoration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗兩個新枕套。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 loeng5 go3 san1 zam2 tou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了两个新的枕套。
examples.english_sentence: I bought two new pillowcases.

mandarin_meaning: 枕边人（指配偶或睡在枕边的人，即伴侣、爱人）
english_meaning: bedfellow; spouse/partner; the person who sleeps beside one's pillow (lover/partner)
explanation_mandarin: 指在枕頭邊睡覺的人，引申為配偶、伴侶或愛人，常用來表示親密關係中的另一半。
explanation_english: Refers literally to the person who sleeps beside one's pillow; by extension it means a spouse, partner, or lover — the intimate other half.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢就係我嘅枕邊人，陪咗我好多年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Keoi5 zau6 hai6 ngo5 ge3 zam2 bin1 jan4, pui4 zo2 ngo5 hou2 do1 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他就是我的枕边人，陪了我很多年。
examples.english_sentence: He is my partner/bedfellow; he has been with me for many years.

mandarin_meaning: 字面上指「長的枕頭」，但在廣東話中並非常見或標準用法；也可能是誤寫，常用表達為「長枕」或「枕頭」。
english_meaning: Literally "long pillow"; not a common or standard Cantonese term — possibly a typo or rare usage. Common alternatives are "long pillow" (長枕) or simply "pillow" (枕頭).
explanation_mandarin: 「枕長」不是廣東話常見詞彙，按字面可理解為「長的枕頭」，但更自然的說法是「長枕」或「枕頭」。在見到此詞時多為打字或書寫錯誤或是地區性罕用詞。
explanation_english: Not a commonly used Cantonese word. Literally it reads as "long pillow", but speakers would normally say "長枕" (long pillow) or "枕頭" (pillow). When encountered, it is often a typo, nonstandard usage, or very rare/regional form.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢寫咗個詞「枕長」，我估係寫錯，應該係「長枕」或者「枕頭」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 se2 zo2 go3 ci4 "zam2 coeng4", ngo5 gu2 hai6 se2 co3, jing1 goi1 hai6 "coeng4 zam2" waak6 ze2 "zam2 tau4".
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他寫了個詞「枕長」，我猜是寫錯，應該是「長枕」或「枕頭」。
examples.english_sentence: He wrote the term "枕長"; I guess it's a mistake — it should be "長枕" or "枕頭" (pillow).

mandarin_meaning: 枕頭 (zhěntou) — 用來墊頭、睡覺時放在頭下的軟墊
english_meaning: pillow — a soft cushion used to support the head while sleeping
explanation_mandarin: 枕頭是放在睡覺時頭下以支撐和增加舒適度的軟墊，常見材質有羽毛、記憶棉、棉花等。
explanation_english: A pillow is a soft cushion placed under the head during sleep for support and comfort; common fillings include feathers, memory foam, and cotton.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我瞓覺要換個舒服啲嘅枕頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 fan3 gaau3 jiu3 wun6 go3 syu1 fuk6 di1 ge3 zam2 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我睡覺要換一個比較舒服的枕頭。
examples.english_sentence: I need to replace my pillow with a more comfortable one for sleeping.

mandarin_meaning: 枕头包（指一种外形像枕头的小包子，常见有奶黄、叉烧等馅料，作为点心或饮茶食品）
english_meaning: pillow bun (a small, pillow-shaped bun often filled with custard, char siu, etc.; served as dim sum)
explanation_mandarin: 粤语中常用来指一种点心，外皮柔软、形状像小枕头，内有各类馅料（如奶黄、叉烧），常见于饮茶／点心菜单。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, it refers to a type of dim sum: a soft, pillow-shaped bun with various fillings (e.g., custard or char siu), commonly eaten during yum cha.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去飲茶食枕頭包啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 heoi3 jam2 caa4 sik6 zam2 tau4 baau1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚去喝点心，吃枕头包吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go for dim sum tonight and eat pillow buns.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間店嘅奶黃枕頭包好香甜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 dim3 ge3 naai5 wong4 zam2 tau4 baau1 hou2 hoeng1 tim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店的奶黄枕头包很香甜。
examples.english_sentence: This shop's custard pillow buns are very fragrant and sweet.

mandarin_meaning: 枕套；套在枕頭外面的布或織物，用於保護枕頭並保持衛生
english_meaning: pillowcase; a removable cover for a pillow used to protect it and maintain hygiene
explanation_mandarin: 指套在枕頭外部的布或其他材質的罩，用來保護枕頭、吸收汗液與油脂，便於清洗更換。
explanation_english: A cover made of fabric or other material that fits over a pillow to protect it, absorb sweat and oils, and be easily washed or replaced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你記得換枕頭套未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gei3 dak1 wun6 zam2 tau4 tou3 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你記得換枕頭套了嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Did you remember to change the pillowcase?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔定期清洗，枕頭套會好污糟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 ding6 kei4 cing1 sai2, zam2 tau4 tou3 wui5 hou2 wu1 zou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不定期清洗，枕頭套會很髒。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't clean it regularly, the pillowcase will get very dirty.

mandarin_meaning: 枕头状（呈现像枕头的形状）
english_meaning: pillow-shaped (having the shape of a pillow)
explanation_mandarin: 用來描述物體外形像枕頭的狀態或形狀，常用於產品或物件的形容。
explanation_english: Used to describe an object whose shape resembles a pillow; often used to describe the form of products or items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個設計係枕頭狀，用嚟支撐頭部。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sik1 gai3 hai6 zam2 tau4 zong6, jung6 lai4 zi1 caang1 tau4 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个设计是枕头状，用来支撑头部。
examples.english_sentence: This design is pillow-shaped, used to support the head.

mandarin_meaning: 枕頭套 / 枕套
english_meaning: pillowcase; pillow cover
explanation_mandarin: 指套在枕頭外面的布或套子，用於保護枕頭並保持清潔與舒適。
explanation_english: A fabric cover that slips over a pillow to protect it and keep it clean and comfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個枕頭袋係純棉嘅，瞓覺好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zam2 tau4 doi2 hai6 seon4 min4 ge3, fan3 gaau3 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個枕頭套是純棉的，睡得很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: This pillowcase is pure cotton; it's very comfortable to sleep on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企有幾個備用枕頭袋，換洗嘅時候好方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei2 jau5 gei2 go3 bei6 jung6 zam2 tau4 doi2, wun6 sai2 ge3 si4 hau6 hou2 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家裡有幾個備用的枕頭套，換洗的時候很方便。
examples.english_sentence: We have several spare pillowcases at home; it's convenient when washing them.

mandarin_meaning: 林（姓氏；森林、樹林）
english_meaning: Lam (surname); forest, woods, grove
explanation_mandarin: 「林」既可以作為常見的中文姓氏，也可以作為名詞，指樹木聚集的地方，如森林或樹林。
explanation_english: “林” can be used as a common Chinese surname or as a noun meaning a wooded area — forest, woods, or grove.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 林先生喺邊度？
examples.jyutping_sentence: lam4 sin1 saang1 hai2 bin1 dou6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 林先生在哪裡？
examples.english_sentence: Where is Mr. Lam?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢片林好大，入面有好多樹同小徑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin3 lam4 hou2 daai6, jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 syu6 tung4 siu2 ging3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這片林很大，裡面有很多樹和小徑。
examples.english_sentence: This forest is large; inside there are many trees and paths.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我朋友叫阿林。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 pang4 jau5 giu3 aa3 lam4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我朋友叫阿林。
examples.english_sentence: My friend is called Ah Lam.

mandarin_meaning: 林貝貝（暱稱/綽號）
english_meaning: Lam Beibei (a playful/affectionate nickname for someone with the surname Lam)
explanation_mandarin: 「林betbet」是一個網絡或口語中常見的暱稱，將姓氏「林」與擬聲或可愛化的重疊詞結合，用來親暱或戲謔地稱呼姓林的人。具體含義視語境而定，可帶有親昵、戲謔或調侃的語氣。
explanation_english: “Lam Beibei” is a colloquial or internet nickname combining the surname Lam with a reduplicated playful element. It's used to address or refer to someone named Lam in an affectionate, joking, or teasing way; the exact nuance depends on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你見過林betbet未？佢好搞笑㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gin3 gwo3 lam4 bet1-bet1 mei6? keoi5 hou2 gaau2 siu3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你見過林貝貝沒？她很搞笑。
examples.english_sentence: Have you seen Lam Beibei? She's really funny.

mandarin_meaning: 顯得頭暈或發呆/怦然心動（多指因醉、興奮或迷戀而失神）
english_meaning: dizzy, giddy, or lovestruck; dazed/tipsy and slightly out of it (often from alcohol, excitement, or infatuation)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語詞，形容人因為喝醉、情緒激動或被迷住而顯得頭腦不清、神志恍惚或害羞怦然心動。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term describing someone who appears dazed, giddy, or lovestruck — often the result of drinking, strong emotion, or infatuation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到偶像嘅時候，整個人林冧冧，講唔出話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou3 ngau5soeng2 ge3 si4hau6, zing2 go3 jan4 lam4 lam5 lam5, gong2 m4 ceot1 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到偶像的時候，整個人怦然心動/發呆，說不出話來。
examples.english_sentence: When he saw his idol, he became all lovestruck and couldn't speak.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飲多咗酒，行路都林冧冧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jam2 do1 zo2 zau2, haang4 lou6 dou1 lam4 lam5 lam5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喝多了酒，走路都東倒西歪/搖搖晃晃。
examples.english_sentence: Had too much to drink — walking all wobbly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢知自己中咗獎，興奮到林冧冧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi1 zi6 gei2 zung1 zo2 zoeng2, hing1 fan5 dou3 lam4 lam5 lam5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他知道自己中了獎，興奮得有點發暈/失神。
examples.english_sentence: He found out he won a prize and was so excited he was all giddy.

mandarin_meaning: 林法官（姓林的審判官）
english_meaning: Judge Lam (a judge with the surname Lam)
explanation_mandarin: 「林審」通常不是固定成語，而是口語或新聞中用來指稱姓林的法官或審判員。字面上由「林」（姓氏）和「審」（審判）組成，用於表示該名法官。
explanation_english: “林審” is not a fixed idiom but a colloquial or journalistic way to refer to a judge surnamed Lam. Literally composed of the surname Lam (林) and the character for adjudicate/examine (審), it denotes Judge Lam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 林審今日喺高等法院開庭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lam4 sam2 gam1 jat6 hai2 gou1 dang2 faat3 jyun2 hoi1 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 林审今天在高等法院开庭。
examples.english_sentence: Judge Lam is presiding at the High Court today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果對林審嘅判決唔滿意，可以上訴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 deoi3 lam4 sam2 ge3 pun3 kyut3 m4 mun5 ji3, ho2 ji5 soeng5 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果对林审的判决不满意，可以上诉。
examples.english_sentence: If you are dissatisfied with Judge Lam's verdict, you can appeal.

mandarin_meaning: 林宝（人名）；林（姓）+ 宝（珍贵、爱称）
english_meaning: Lin Bao (personal name); 'Lin' (surname) + 'bao' meaning 'treasure' — often an affectionate name/nickname
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语环境中，'林寶'通常是人名或昵称，表示姓林且名字或爱称带有'寶'字，常用作亲昵称呼。
explanation_english: '林寶' is typically used as a personal name or affectionate nickname in Cantonese: 'Lam/Lin' as the surname and 'bou/bǎo' meaning 'treasure'. It functions as a proper name or endearing form of address.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 林寶，你今晚有冇時間一齊食飯？
examples.jyutping_sentence: lam4 bou2, nei5 gam1 maan5 jau5 mou5 si4 gaan3 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 林宝，你今晚有时间一起吃饭吗？
examples.english_sentence: Lin Bao, do you have time to have dinner together tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家都叫佢林寶，因為佢名入面有個「寶」字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 gaa1 dou1 giu3 keoi5 lam4 bou2, jan1 wai6 keoi5 ming4 jap6 min6 jau5 go3 bou2 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家都叫他林宝，因为他名字里有个“宝”字。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone calls him Lin Bao because his name includes the character 'bao' (treasure).

mandarin_meaning: 可能為人名，無固定的通用詞義
english_meaning: Likely a personal name; not an established common word or phrase
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 專有名詞（人名）／非通用詞彙
partOfSpeech_english: Proper noun (personal name) / Not a common lexical item
explanation_mandarin: 「林擒」字面上由姓氏「林」與字「擒」組成。查無作為常用詞語的固定意義，通常視為人名或筆名。若在特定方言或語境中另有特殊用法，需提供語境以便判定。
explanation_english: The characters combine the surname 林 (Lam) and 擒 (kam, 'to capture'); there is no recorded usage as a common Cantonese word or idiom. It is most likely a personal name. If it appears in a specific dialectal or contextual usage with another meaning, context is needed to determine it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 林擒係我細個時嘅同學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lam4 kam4 hai6 ngo5 sai3 go3 si4 ge3 tung4 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 林擒是我小時候的同學。
examples.english_sentence: Lam Kam was my classmate when I was young.

mandarin_meaning: 林明顿（英國地名的音譯）
english_meaning: Lymington (a place name; transliteration)
explanation_mandarin: 「林明頓」是英語地名 Lymington 在粵語中的音譯，通常用作地名或專有名詞，指英國南部的一個城鎮／海濱小鎮。
explanation_english: “林明頓” is the Cantonese transliteration of the English place name Lymington. It is used as a proper noun, referring to a town/coastal town in southern England.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋打算去林明頓旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 daa2 syun3 heoi3 lam4 ming4 deon6 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们打算去林明顿旅行。
examples.english_sentence: We're planning to travel to Lymington.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 林明頓係英國南部一個海邊小鎮，有好多碼頭同船隻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lam4 ming4 deon6 hai6 jing1 gwok3 naam4 bou6 jat1 go3 hoi2 bin1 siu2 zan3, jau5 hou2 do1 maa5 tau4 tung4 syun4 zek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 林明顿是英国南部一个海边小镇，有很多码头和船只。
examples.english_sentence: Lymington is a coastal town in southern England with many piers and boats.

mandarin_meaning: 林木（指森林或区域内的树木与植被）
english_meaning: trees; wooded areas; trees and vegetation
explanation_mandarin: 指森林或地方中的树木与植被，泛指树木，常用于书面或正式语境。
explanation_english: Refers to trees and vegetation in a forest or area; generally means trees. Often used in formal or written contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度林木茂密，好適合郊遊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 lam4 muk6 mau6 mat6, hou2 sik1 hap6 gaau1 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里林木茂密，很适合郊游。
examples.english_sentence: The trees here are dense; it's very suitable for an outing.

mandarin_meaning: 形容樹木茂密、景象陰沉或沉鬱
english_meaning: Describes a scene with dense vegetation and a sombre, gloomy atmosphere; thick and gloomy
explanation_mandarin: 常用來形容樹木繁茂、叢生且帶有陰沉、沉鬱或陰森的氣氛，也可用於比喻景象密集或情緒沉重。
explanation_english: Often used to describe trees or vegetation that are dense and overgrown with a sombre or gloomy atmosphere; can also be used metaphorically for a crowded or heavy, melancholic scene.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰條山路兩旁林林沈沈，夜晚行過好有驚嚇感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 tiu4 saan1 lou6 loeng5 pong4 lam4 lam4 cam4 cam4, je6 maan5 hang4 gwo3 hou2 jau5 ging1 haak3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那條山路兩旁樹木林林沈沈，晚上走過很有驚悚感。
examples.english_sentence: The mountain path's sides were thickly lined with trees, making it feel very creepy at night.

mandarin_meaning: 林林总总 (línlín zǒngzǒng) — 各種各樣、繁多
english_meaning: all kinds of; a great many and varied; numerous and diverse
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞/副詞（用來修飾名詞或描述種類繁多）
partOfSpeech_english: adjective/adverb (used as a modifier to indicate many-varied kinds)
explanation_mandarin: 四字成語，用來形容種類繁多、形形色色的事物，通常作為定語或狀語使用。
explanation_english: A four-character idiom meaning many different kinds or a wide variety of things; commonly used to modify nouns or describe a situation with diverse elements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市集上擺咗林林總總嘅手作同小食，行街好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 zaap6 soeng6 baai2 zo2 lam4 lam4 zung2 zung2 ge3 sau2 zok3 tung4 siu2 sik6, haang4 gaai1 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市集上摆了林林总总的手作和小吃，逛街很开心。
examples.english_sentence: The market had all sorts of handmade goods and snacks; it was fun strolling around.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 圖書館裏面有林林總總嘅書籍，乜嘢題材都有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou4 syu1 gun2 leoi5 min6 jau5 lam4 lam4 zung2 zung2 ge3 syu1 zik6, mat1 je5 tai4 coi4 dou1 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 图书馆里有林林总总的书籍，什么题材都有。
examples.english_sentence: The library has books of all kinds; every subject is covered.

mandarin_meaning: 字面上是「林家的柿子」或作人名／綽號使用（林柿），並無普遍固定成語義；常用作綽號、筆名或網絡別稱
english_meaning: Literally "Lam's persimmon"; not a standard idiom — typically used as a personal name, nickname, pen name, or playful online handle
explanation_mandarin: 「林柿」並非廣泛流通的成語或固定俚語。由姓氏「林」與水果「柿」組成，常被用作人的綽號、網名或創作名稱，帶有戲謔或親暱色彩，亦可按字面理解為「林家（或叫林的人）的柿子」。具體含義視語境而定。
explanation_english: "林柿" is not a widely used idiom or fixed slang. It combines the surname 林 (Lam) and the fruit 柿 (persimmon) and is commonly used as a personal nickname, online handle, or pen name with a playful or affectionate tone. It can also be read literally as "the Lam family's persimmon." The exact meaning depends on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋班有個同學綽號叫「林柿」，因為佢好鍾意收集柿子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 baan1 jau5 go3 tung4 hok6 coek3 hou6 giu3 "lam4 si6", jan1 wai6 keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 sau1 zaap6 si6 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們班有個同學綽號叫「林柿」，因為他很喜歡收集柿子。
examples.english_sentence: In our class there's a student nicknamed "Lam Si" because he really likes collecting persimmons.

mandarin_meaning: 林、沈（兩個姓氏並列；可作人名、合夥名稱或公司名）
english_meaning: Compound of the surnames Lam (Lin) and Shum/Shen; typically a proper noun used as a personal name, partnership or firm name.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 專有名詞（姓氏 / 人名）
partOfSpeech_english: proper noun (surname / personal or company name)
explanation_mandarin: 「林沈」本身不是常見的成語或俗語，通常是兩個姓氏並列，用來表示人名、合夥人或公司名稱。粵語讀音為 lam4 sam2（沈作姓氏時讀 sam2）。
explanation_english: Not a standard idiom or slang; usually a pairing of the surnames Lam and Shen/Shum used as a proper noun (personal name, partnership, or firm). In Cantonese it is pronounced lam4 sam2 (沈 as the surname is read sam2).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 林沈係我哋公司嘅合夥人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Lam4 sam2 hai6 ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 hap6 fo2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 林沈是我們公司的合夥人。
examples.english_sentence: Lam & Shen are partners in our company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚要同林沈開會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 jiu3 tung4 Lam4 sam2 hoi1 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚要和林沈開會。
examples.english_sentence: I have a meeting with Lam & Shen tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 林立 (línlì)：大量并列、密集出现，常用来形容建筑、商铺等成群出现
english_meaning: To stand close together in large numbers; numerous and clustered (often used to describe buildings, shops, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 表示许多事物并列、聚集，呈现出像树林一样密集的状态。常用于“高楼林立”、“商店林立”等搭配。
explanation_english: Indicates many items appearing side by side or clustered densely, like a forest. Commonly used in phrases such as 'skyscrapers stand densely' or 'shops are everywhere.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度成條街都係食肆林立，夜晚好熱鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 sing4 tiu4 gaai1 dou1 hai6 sik6 si2 lam4 lap6, je6 maan5 hou2 jit6 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里整条街都是餐馆林立，晚上很热闹。
examples.english_sentence: This whole street is packed with restaurants; it's very lively at night.

mandarin_meaning: （量词）枚（用于计数硬币、邮票、戒指、奖章等）
english_meaning: measure word (used for small items like coins, stamps, rings, medals)
explanation_mandarin: 「枚」是汉语的量词，常用于计数小而常呈扁平或成单件的物品，例如硬币、邮票、戒指、奖章等。在粤语中读作 mui4。
explanation_english: “枚” is a Chinese measure word used to count small items often flat or single-piece, such as coins, stamps, rings, and medals. In Cantonese it is pronounced mui4.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我有一枚硬幣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jau5 jat1 mui4 ngaang6 bai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我有一枚硬币。
examples.english_sentence: I have one coin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢枚戒指好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 mui4 gaai3 zi2 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这枚戒指很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: This ring is very pretty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞咗三枚郵票。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 zo2 saam1 mui4 jau4 piu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿了三枚邮票。
examples.english_sentence: He took three stamps.

mandarin_meaning: 果（水果）；（在合成詞中）表示果然、確實
english_meaning: fruit; (in compounds) as in 'indeed' or 'as expected' (e.g., 果然)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词；（在合成詞中作副词/语气成分）
explanation_mandarin: 「果」常作「水果」的简称，表示可食用的果實；在一些詞語（如「果然」）中表示『果真、的確』的意思。
explanation_english: Commonly a shorthand for 'fruit' (edible fruit). In compounds like '果然' it conveys 'indeed' or 'as expected'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我去街市買咗啲果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 heoi3 gaai1 si5 maai5 zo2 di1 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我去菜市場買了些水果。
examples.english_sentence: I went to the market and bought some fruit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢果然準時到咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gwo2 jin4 zyun2 si4 dou3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他果然準時到了。
examples.english_sentence: He indeed arrived on time.

mandarin_meaning: 果酱
english_meaning: fruit jam; jam (fruit preserve)
explanation_mandarin: 口語混合用法，將漢字「果」與英文「jam」結合，指果醬（用於塗抹麵包等的果味醬）。常見於非正式書寫或社交媒體。
explanation_english: A colloquial mixed-language term combining the Chinese character '果' with the English word 'jam', meaning fruit jam (a fruit preserve used on toast, etc.). Common in informal writing and social media.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最鍾意草莓果jam。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 cou2 mui4 gwo2 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最喜歡草莓果酱。
examples.english_sentence: I like strawberry jam the most.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件衫沾咗果jam，要洗乾淨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 saam1 zim1 zo2 gwo2 jam1, jiu3 sai2 gon1 zeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 衣服沾上了果酱，要洗干净。
examples.english_sentence: The shirt got jam on it; it needs to be washed.

mandarin_meaning: 果仁（guǒrén），指果實或堅果內可食的核或仁
english_meaning: nut kernel; the edible inner part of a fruit or nut
explanation_mandarin: 指果實或堅果內可食的部分，常見於堅果（如杏仁、開心果）或某些果實的內核。
explanation_english: Refers to the edible inner part or kernel of a fruit or nut, commonly found in nuts (e.g., almonds, pistachios) or the inner core of some fruits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意食果仁，特別係開心果同杏仁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 gwo2 jan4, dak6 bit6 hai6 hoi1 sam1 gwo2 tung4 hang6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很喜欢吃果仁，特别是开心果和杏仁。
examples.english_sentence: I really like eating nuts, especially pistachios and almonds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個蛋糕入面有好多果仁，食落好有口感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 daan6 gou1 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 gwo2 jan4, sik6 lok6 hou2 jau5 hau2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个蛋糕里面有很多果仁，吃起来很有口感。
examples.english_sentence: This cake has a lot of nut pieces inside; it has a nice texture.

mandarin_meaning: 果冻 (guǒdòng)
english_meaning: jelly; gelatin dessert
explanation_mandarin: 一种以明胶、琼脂等制成的甜点，质地呈凝胶状，口感弹牙；在日常用语中也可指类似果冻状的物质或甜品。
explanation_english: A dessert made from gelatin, agar, or similar gelling agents, with a gel-like, springy texture; in everyday use it can also refer to jelly-like substances or desserts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗一杯草莓味嘅果凍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 bui1 cou2 mui4 mei6 ge3 gwo2 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一杯草莓味的果冻。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a cup of strawberry-flavored jelly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友成日鍾意食果凍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 sing4 jat6 zung1 ji3 sik6 gwo2 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子总是喜欢吃果冻。
examples.english_sentence: Kids always like to eat jelly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢款果凍好彈牙，唔會太甜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fun2 gwo2 dung6 hou2 daan6 ngaa4, m4 wui5 taai3 tim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种果冻很有弹性，不会太甜。
examples.english_sentence: This jelly is very springy and not too sweet.

mandarin_meaning: 罕見詞，無固定或廣泛接受的含義；字面上可解作「果實占據」或「以果實占卜」；在香港粵語中也可能是打字或聽寫錯誤
english_meaning: A rare/obscure term with no widely accepted meaning; literally could mean "fruit occupies" or "fruit divination"; in Hong Kong Cantonese it may also be a typo/mishearing
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 罕見詞 / 口語 / 俚語（視語境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 「果占」不是一個常見或標準的粵語詞彙。沒有可靠的詞典記載其固定含義。字面上可拆為「果」（水果、果實或指示代詞）與「占」（佔據、占卜），因此在不同語境下可能被理解為字面意或被視作打錯字。遇到此詞時，宜查證原文上下文或向說話者求證。
explanation_english: “果占” is not a commonly attested or standardized Cantonese word. There is no authoritative dictionary entry with a fixed meaning. Literally the characters are "fruit/that" (果) and "occupy/divine" (占), so it might be interpreted as "fruit occupies" or "fruit divination," but in many contexts it may simply be a typo or mishearing. When you see this term, check the surrounding context or ask the speaker/writer for clarification.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔肯定「果占」係咩意思，可能係打錯字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 hang2 ding6 "gwo2 zim1" hai6 me1 ji3 si1, ho2 nang4 hai6 daa2 co3 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不確定「果占」是什麼意思，可能是打錯字。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not sure what "果占" means; it might be a typo.

mandarin_meaning: 果园 (種植果樹供採收水果的地方)
english_meaning: orchard
explanation_mandarin: 指種植果樹並用以採收水果的土地或場地，通常種有蘋果、桃子、柑橘等果樹。
explanation_english: A place where fruit trees are cultivated for harvesting fruit; land planted with fruit trees such as apples, peaches, or citrus.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋週末去果園摘蘋果啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zau1 mut6 heoi3 gwo2 jyun4 zaak6 ping4 gwo2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們週末去果園摘蘋果。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to the orchard to pick apples this weekend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屋企後面有個細細嘅果園，種咗好多桃樹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 uk1 kei5 hau6 min6 jau5 go3 sai3 sai3 ge3 gwo2 jyun4, zung3 zo2 hou2 do1 tou4 syu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們家後面有一個小小的果園，種了很多桃樹。
examples.english_sentence: They have a small orchard behind their house with many peach trees.

mandarin_meaning: 果子；果实（水果）
english_meaning: fruit; fruit/produce
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语中，“果子”（gwo2 zi2）通常指水果或果实，用作名词。根据地域差异，華語其他方言中“果子”有时也指某些小吃或油炸点心，但在香港粤语中以“果实/水果”为主。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '果子' (gwo2 zi2) typically means fruit or fruit produce and is used as a noun. Note that in other Chinese dialects 'guǒzi' can sometimes refer to certain snacks or fried pastries, but in Hong Kong Cantonese it mainly denotes fruit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個果子好甜，我想食多啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gwo2 zi2 hou2 tim4, ngo5 soeng2 sik6 do1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个果子很甜，我想多吃一些。
examples.english_sentence: This fruit is very sweet; I want to eat more.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇下啲果子都熟晒啦，快啲摘落嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 haa5 di1 gwo2 zi2 dou1 suk6 saai3 laa1, faai3 di1 zaak6 lok6 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看看那些果子都熟了，快点摘下来。
examples.english_sentence: Look, those fruits are ripe; pick them quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 果子狸 (guǒzǐlí)
english_meaning: masked palm civet (Paguma larvata)
explanation_mandarin: 果子狸是一種中型夜行哺乳動物（學名 Paguma larvata），屬於靈貓科，分布於亞洲多個地區。牠們多在夜間活動，主要以果實、小型動物和昆蟲為食，有時會出現在郊區或城市邊緣。
explanation_english: The masked palm civet (Paguma larvata) is a medium-sized nocturnal mammal in the viverrid family, found across parts of Asia. It is active at night and feeds on fruit, small animals and insects; it can sometimes be seen in rural areas or on the edges of towns.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜晚我喺山上見到隻果子狸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 maan5 ngo5 hai2 saan1 soeng6 gin3 dou3 zek3 gwo2 zi2 lei4
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚上我在山上看到了一只果子狸。
examples.english_sentence: I saw a masked palm civet on the mountain last night.

mandarin_meaning: 果实（植物的果子）；比喻成果、结果
english_meaning: fruit (of a plant); (figurative) result, outcome, achievement
explanation_mandarin: 指植物結出的果子，通常可食；亦常用作比喻，表示努力或行為的成果或結果。
explanation_english: Refers to the fruit produced by a plant, often edible; also used figuratively to mean the result, outcome, or achievement of efforts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢棵樹上有好多果實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fo1 syu6 soeng6 jau5 hou2 do1 gwo2 sat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这棵树上有很多果实。
examples.english_sentence: There are many fruits on this tree.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 努力終於有咗果實，佢畢業後搵到份好工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nou5 lik6 zung1 jyu1 jau5 zo2 gwo2 sat6, keoi5 bat1 jip6 hau6 wan2 dou2 fan6 hou2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 努力终于有了果实，他毕业后找到了一份好工作。
examples.english_sentence: The hard work finally paid off — he found a good job after graduation.

mandarin_meaning: 果断 (做决定迅速、坚决不犹豫)
english_meaning: decisive; resolute; quick to make decisions without hesitation
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人在面對選擇或需要決定的時候，能夠乾脆、迅速且堅定地作出決定，不拖泥帶水。
explanation_english: Describes someone who makes decisions quickly and firmly without hesitation; resolute and decisive in action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好果斷，做決定唔會猶豫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 gwo2 dyun6, zou6 kyut3 ding6 m4 wui5 jau4 jyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很果断，做决定不会犹豫。
examples.english_sentence: He is very decisive; he doesn't hesitate when making decisions.

mandarin_meaning: 果树 (結出可食用果實的樹，例如蘋果樹、橙樹等)
english_meaning: fruit tree
explanation_mandarin: 指結出可供食用或採收的果實的樹木，如蘋果樹、柑橘樹等。
explanation_english: A tree that bears edible or harvestable fruit, such as apple trees or citrus trees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企後院有一棵果樹，夏天可以摘水果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei2 hau6 jyun2 jau5 jat1 fo1 gwo2 syu6, haa6 tin1 ho2 ji5 zaap6 seoi2 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家後院有一棵果树，夏天可以摘水果。
examples.english_sentence: There is a fruit tree in my backyard; in summer you can pick the fruit.

mandarin_meaning: 果栏；果摊
english_meaning: fruit stall; the area or stall in a market selling fruit
explanation_mandarin: 指在街市或露天市集內賣水果的攤檔或專區，通常用來稱呼售賣各類新鮮水果的地方。
explanation_english: Refers to a stall or section in a market where fruit is sold, commonly found in wet markets or street markets selling fresh fruit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺果欄度買咗啲橙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gwo2 laan4 dou6 maai5 zo2 di1 caang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在果栏买了些橙子。
examples.english_sentence: He bought some oranges at the fruit stall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 果欄係街市嘅一部分，通常賣新鮮水果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwo2 laan4 hai6 gaai1 si5 ge3 jat1 bou6 fan6, tung1 soeng4 maai6 san1 sin1 seoi2 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 果栏是菜市场的一部分，通常卖新鲜水果。
examples.english_sentence: A fruit stall is part of the market and typically sells fresh fruit.

mandarin_meaning: 果汁
english_meaning: fruit juice
explanation_mandarin: 由水果榨取的液體飲料，可指鮮榨或經過加工的果汁飲品。
explanation_english: Liquid beverage extracted from fruit; can refer to freshly squeezed juice or processed fruit juice drinks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想飲杯果汁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 jam2 bui1 gwo2 zap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想喝一杯果汁。
examples.english_sentence: I want to drink a glass of fruit juice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友好鍾意飲果汁，尤其係蘋果同橙汁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 hou2 zung1 ji3 jam2 gwo2 zap1, jau4 kei4 hai6 ping4 gwo2 tung4 caang4 zap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子很喜歡喝果汁，尤其是蘋果汁和橙汁。
examples.english_sentence: Kids really like drinking juice, especially apple and orange juice.

mandarin_meaning: 果然 (guǒrán)
english_meaning: as expected; sure enough; indeed
explanation_mandarin: 表示某種預期或猜測成真，用來確認事情如預料般發生，等於「的確」、「果真」。
explanation_english: Used to indicate that something happened as expected or that a prediction/assumption proved correct; equivalent to "as expected," "sure enough," or "indeed."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗佢會遲到，果然佢遲到咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nam2 keoi5 wui5 ci4 dou3, gwo2 jin4 keoi5 ci4 dou3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想他會遲到，果然他遲到了。
examples.english_sentence: I thought he would be late; sure enough, he was late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣預報講會落雨，果然落咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 jyu6 bou3 gong2 wui5 lok6 jyu5, gwo2 jin4 lok6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天氣預報說會下雨，果然下雨了。
examples.english_sentence: The weather forecast said it would rain; indeed it rained.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試好難，但佢果然考到第一名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 hou2 naan4, daan6 keoi5 gwo2 jin4 haau2 dou3 dai6 jat1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考試很難，但他果然考到第一名。
examples.english_sentence: The exam was hard, but he indeed got first place.

mandarin_meaning: 果皮（水果的外皮；也指被丟棄的果皮、垃圾）
english_meaning: fruit peel; rind; (colloquially) discarded fruit skins as litter
explanation_mandarin: 指水果的外層皮，也常用來指被丟棄的果皮，屬於生活垃圾的一種。
explanation_english: Refers to the outer skin or peel of fruit. It can also mean discarded fruit skins considered as trash or litter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好將果皮亂拋喺地下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng1 gwo2 pei4 lyun6 paau1 hai2 dei6 haa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把果皮亂丟在地上。
examples.english_sentence: Don't throw fruit peels on the ground.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度滿地都係果皮，好唔衞生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 mun5 dei6 dou1 hai6 gwo2 pei4, hou2 m4 wai6 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這裡到處都是果皮，很不衛生。
examples.english_sentence: There are fruit peels everywhere here; it's very unhygienic.

mandarin_meaning: 果盘（盛水果的盘子）
english_meaning: fruit plate; fruit platter
explanation_mandarin: 指盛放切好或整顆水果的盘子或托盘，常見於宴會、餐桌或家中作為點心或招待用。
explanation_english: A plate or platter used to hold fruit (whole or cut), commonly seen at meals, banquets, or as a serving dish at gatherings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食完飯之後，佢哋端出一個大果盤畀大家食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 jyun4 faan6 zi1 hau6, keoi5 dei6 dyun1 ceot1 jat1 go3 daai6 gwo2 pun4 bei2 daai6 gaa1 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃完饭后，他们端出一个大果盘让大家一起吃。
examples.english_sentence: After dinner, they brought out a large fruit platter for everyone to share.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 婚宴上通常會有果盤擺喺枱面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan1 jin6 soeng6 tung1 soeng4 wui5 jau5 gwo2 pun4 baai2 hai2 toi2 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 婚宴上通常会有果盘摆在桌子上。
examples.english_sentence: At weddings there is usually a fruit platter on the table.

mandarin_meaning: 果然 / 真是
english_meaning: indeed; really; as expected
explanation_mandarin: 表示某件事確實如此，或如預期發生，等同於「果然」或「真是」。在廣東話口語中常用來強調結果與預期一致或感到意外但確實發生。
explanation_english: Used to indicate that something is indeed the case or happened as expected; equivalent to 'indeed' or 'as expected.' Common in Cantonese speech to emphasize that the result matches expectation or to express confirmation/surprise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話唔會嚟，果眞嚟到咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 m4 wui5 lai4, gwo2 zan1 lai4 dou3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說不會來，果然來了。
examples.english_sentence: He said he wouldn't come, but indeed he arrived.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我早就估到，果眞係咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zou2 zau6 gu2 dou3, gwo2 zan1 hai6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我早就猜到了，果然就是這樣。
examples.english_sentence: I predicted it; indeed, that's how it was.

mandarin_meaning: 果然；确实
english_meaning: indeed; as expected; really
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情如預期或證明為真，常用於強調結果與預料一致。
explanation_english: A word used to indicate that something turned out to be true or as expected, often emphasizing that the outcome matches one's expectation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢識做，果真做得好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 sik1 zou6, gwo2 zan1 zou6 dak1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他会做，果然做得很好。
examples.english_sentence: He said he could do it, and indeed he did it very well.

mandarin_meaning: 水果篮（裝水果的籃子，常作禮物）
english_meaning: fruit basket (a basket for holding fruits; often given as a gift)
explanation_mandarin: 指用來盛放水果的籃子，常見於節日或探訪時作為禮物；也可泛指裝水果的容器。
explanation_english: Refers to a basket used to hold fruits. Commonly given as a gift during holidays or visits; can also generally mean any container for fruit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗個果籃送俾阿媽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 go3 gwo2 laam4 sung3 bei2 aa3 maa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我買了一個果籃送給媽媽。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a fruit basket to give to my mother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司節日會送果籃畀客戶表達謝意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 zit3 jat6 wui5 sung3 gwo2 laam4 bei2 haak3 wu6 biu2 daat6 ze6 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司在節日時會送果籃給客戶表示謝意。
examples.english_sentence: The company gives fruit baskets to clients during the holidays to show appreciation.

mandarin_meaning: 果糖（guǒtáng）——一种天然存在于水果和蜂蜜的单糖，也常被用于食品工业作为甜味剂。
english_meaning: Fructose — a simple sugar (fruit sugar) naturally found in fruits and honey, and used as a sweetener in foods.
explanation_mandarin: 果糖是一种单糖，广泛存在于水果、蜂蜜和一些甜味剂中。工业上也会以高果糖糖浆等形式加入加工食品。大量摄取果糖可能与肥胖、代谢综合症等健康问题相关。
explanation_english: Fructose is a monosaccharide commonly found in fruit and honey and used as a sweetener in food products (e.g., high-fructose syrups). Excessive intake has been linked to obesity and metabolic health issues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲汽水入面有好多果糖，飲多咗唔健康。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 hei3 seoi2 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 gwo2 tong4, jam2 do1 zo2 m4 gin6 hong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些汽水里面有很多果糖，喝多了不健康。
examples.english_sentence: These sodas contain a lot of fructose; drinking too much is unhealthy.

mandarin_meaning: 果肉（guǒròu）：水果或植物果實中可食用、通常多汁的部分。
english_meaning: fruit pulp; the flesh of a fruit (the edible, usually juicy part).
explanation_mandarin: 指水果或某些植物果實中可以吃的組織部分，通常質地多汁、柔軟，與果皮和果核相對。
explanation_english: Refers to the edible tissue of a fruit or plant fruit, typically juicy and soft; contrasted with the peel/skin and the pit/seed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個芒果嘅果肉好甜，好多汁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 mong1 gwo2 ge3 gwo2 juk6 hou2 tim4, hou2 do1 zap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个芒果的果肉很甜，很多汁。
examples.english_sentence: The flesh of this mango is very sweet and juicy.

mandarin_meaning: 果脯 (guǒfǔ)：指以糖、蜜或鹽等處理、風乾或熬製的水果製品，類似蜜餞或糖漬果
english_meaning: candied/preserved fruit; dried or sugar-preserved fruit (like candied fruit or preserved fruit)
explanation_mandarin: 果脯是將水果用糖、蜜或其他方法醃製、熬煮或風乾而成的零食或配料，口味多為甜或酸甜。
explanation_english: Fruit that has been preserved by sugar, honey, drying, or similar processes; a snack or condiment often sweet or sweet-and-sour in taste.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆成日整果脯俾我食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 sing4 jat6 zing2 gwo2 pou2 bei2 ngo5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶经常做果脯给我吃。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma often makes candied fruit for me to eat.

mandarin_meaning: 果蓉（果泥）
english_meaning: fruit puree; fruit pulp
explanation_mandarin: 指將水果搗碎或打成泥狀的食材，常用於甜點、醬料或餡料中。
explanation_english: Refers to fruit that has been mashed or blended into a puree; commonly used in desserts, sauces, or fillings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個芝士蛋糕面層係用芒果做成嘅果蓉，味道好香。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi1 si6 daan6 gou1 min6 cang4 hai6 jung6 mong1 gwo2 zou6 sing4 ge3 gwo2 jung4, mei6 dou6 hou2 hoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個芝士蛋糕的表層是用芒果做成的果蓉，味道很香。
examples.english_sentence: The topping of this cheesecake is made from mango puree; it tastes very fragrant.

mandarin_meaning: 果蝇（昆虫）
english_meaning: fruit fly
explanation_mandarin: 指一种小型昆虫，常见于腐烂或发酵的水果上；有些果蝇属（例如秀丽果蝇）是遗传学研究的重要模式生物，同时在厨房和果盘附近也常被视为害虫。
explanation_english: A small insect commonly found on decaying or fermenting fruit. Some species (e.g. Drosophila) are important model organisms in genetics research; fruit flies are also common household pests around kitchens and fruit bowls.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企廚房有好多果蠅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei2 cyu4 fong4 jau5 hou2 do1 gwo2 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家裡廚房有很多果蝇。
examples.english_sentence: There are a lot of fruit flies in the kitchen at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲水果唔好放太耐，會招惹果蠅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 seoi2 gwo2 m4 hou2 fong3 taai3 noi6, wui5 ziu1 je5 gwo2 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 水果不要放太久，會招惹果蝇。
examples.english_sentence: Don't leave fruit out too long; it will attract fruit flies.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）感到酸、嫉妒或心裡不爽
english_meaning: colloquial 'sour' feeling — jealous, bitter, or resentful
explanation_mandarin: 「果酸」為粵語口語用法，形容對別人的情況感到酸（常帶有嫉妒、不服或不開心的情緒），語氣上有酸溜溜的意味，常用於日常對話或俚語語境。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term meaning to feel 'sour' — i.e., jealous, bitter, or resentful. Often used informally to describe someone's tone or attitude when they show envy or displeasure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到舊愛啱啱有新拖，整日表現到好果酸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ting1 dou3 gau6 oi3 aam1 aam1 jau5 san1 to1, zing2 jat6 biu2 jin2 dou3 hou2 gwo2 syun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他聽到前任剛交了新戀人，整天表現得很酸。
examples.english_sentence: He heard his ex got a new partner and has been acting really sour/jealous all the time.

mandarin_meaning: 果酱 (guǒjiàng)
english_meaning: jam; fruit preserve
explanation_mandarin: 由水果和糖煮製而成的甜醬，常用來塗抹麵包、烘焙或當作甜點配料。
explanation_english: A sweet spread made from fruit and sugar, commonly used on bread, in baking, or as a dessert topping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我朝早喺多士上塗果醬食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 hai2 do1 si6 soeng6 tou4 gwo2 zoeng3 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我早上在吐司上抹果酱吃。
examples.english_sentence: I spread jam on my toast for breakfast.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 超市有好多款口味嘅果醬，例如草莓同藍莓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ciu1 si5 jau5 hou2 do1 fun2 hau2 mei6 ge3 gwo2 zoeng3, lai6 jyu4 cou2 mui4 tung4 laam4 mui4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 超市有很多口味的果酱，例如草莓和蓝莓。
examples.english_sentence: The supermarket has many flavors of jam, such as strawberry and blueberry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢樽果醬開咗兩個月，應該唔新鮮，丟咗佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zeon1 gwo2 zoeng3 hoi1 zo2 loeng5 go3 jyut6, jing1 goi1 m4 san1 sin1, diu1 zo2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這瓶果酱開了兩個月，應該不新鮮，扔掉它吧。
examples.english_sentence: This jar of jam was opened two months ago; it's probably not fresh—throw it away.

mandarin_meaning: （名）树枝；（量词）用于细长的物体（如笔、枪）；（口语）也作俗称或代词用
english_meaning: branch; (measure word) for long slender objects like pens, sticks, guns
explanation_mandarin: 「枝」既可指植物的枝条，也常用作量词，表示细长、成条状的物体（例如一枝筆、一枝手槍）。在粤语口语中经常使用。
explanation_english: “枝” can mean a branch of a plant and is commonly used as a classifier for long, slender objects (e.g., a pen, a gun). It is frequently used in Cantonese speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢枝筆係咪你嘅？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zi1 bat1 hai6 mai6 nei5 ge3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这支笔是你的吗？
examples.english_sentence: Is this pen yours?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻雀停喺枝上，唔肯飛走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 zoek3 teng4 hai2 zi1 soeng6, m4 hang2 fei1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那只鸟停在树枝上，不肯飞走。
examples.english_sentence: The bird perched on the branch and wouldn't fly away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方檢獲一枝手槍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 gim2 wok6 jat1 zi1 sau2 coeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方缴获一把手枪。
examples.english_sentence: The police seized a handgun.

mandarin_meaning: 辦法；招數；計策
english_meaning: trick; tactic; a way/means to handle something
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用詞，指應付某件事的辦法、招數或策略，常用於詢問或討論可行的處理方法。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term referring to a method, trick, or tactic for dealing with something; commonly used when asking for or discussing possible ways to handle a situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事好麻煩，你有冇枝竹？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 hou2 maa4faan4, nei5 jau5 mou5 zi1 zuk1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事很麻煩，你有沒有什麼辦法？
examples.english_sentence: This matter is troublesome — do you have any tricks/solutions?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面試嗰陣你要準備啲枝竹，應付啲難題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 si3 go2 zan6 nei5 jiu3 zeon2 bei6 di1 zi1 zuk1, jing3 fu6 di1 naan4 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面試的時候你要準備一些辦法，以應付那些難題。
examples.english_sentence: During the interview you should prepare some tactics to handle the difficult questions.

mandarin_meaning: 枝节（指琐碎的细节或由此产生的麻烦、障碍）
english_meaning: literally 'branches and joints'; figuratively, minor details or petty issues that cause complications or snags
explanation_mandarin: “枝節”本義指樹木的枝幹與節點，常用作比喻，表示那些雖然不是關鍵但會引起麻煩或阻礙進展的瑣碎細節或問題。
explanation_english: Originally refers to branches and joints of a plant; used figuratively to mean small details or minor issues that nevertheless create trouble or obstacles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好為枝節分心，專注大方向。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 wai6 zi1 zit3 fan1 sam1, zyun1 zyu3 daai6 fong1 hoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要為枝節分心，專注大方向。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be distracted by trivialities; focus on the big picture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個工程好順利，唯一有啲枝節係交期延誤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gung1 cing4 hou2 seon6 lei6, wai6 jat1 jau5 di1 zi1 zit3 hai6 gaau1 kei4 jin4 ng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個工程進展順利，唯一的枝節是交期延誤。
examples.english_sentence: The project is going smoothly; the only snag is the delayed delivery date.

mandarin_meaning: 枝叶（字面：树枝和叶子；引申：不重要的细节、次要部分）
english_meaning: branches and leaves (literal); details, minor or peripheral matters (figurative)
explanation_mandarin: “枝叶”字面指树的枝和叶，常用于比喻不重要或次要的细节，强调与“根本”相对的部分。
explanation_english: Literally refers to branches and leaves of a plant. Figuratively used to mean minor details or peripheral matters, contrasted with the root or core issue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係睇枝葉，要睇清根本原因。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 tai2 zi1 jip6, jiu3 tai2 cing1 gan1 bun2 jyun4 jan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只是看枝叶，要看清根本原因。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just look at the branches and leaves; look clearly at the root cause.

mandarin_meaning: 毛豆（即未成熟的大豆荚，日語稱枝豆／edamame）
english_meaning: edamame (young soybean pods, typically boiled and salted)
explanation_mandarin: 指未成熟的大豆荚，常作小吃或下酒菜，通常煮熟後加鹽食用，日本料理中稱為「枝豆」。
explanation_english: Refers to young soybean pods (edamame), commonly served boiled and salted as a snack or appetizer, often enjoyed with beer; popular in Japanese cuisine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意食枝豆，尤其係配啤酒嗰陣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 zi1 dau6, jau4 kei4 hai6 pui3 be1 zau2 go2 zan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很喜歡吃毛豆，尤其是在配啤酒的時候。
examples.english_sentence: I really like eating edamame, especially when having it with a beer.

mandarin_meaning: 枝头；树枝的顶端或枝上的位置（也可引申为显眼或突出的位置）
english_meaning: branch tip; the top of a branch (can also figuratively mean a prominent or conspicuous position)
explanation_mandarin: 指树枝的顶端或位于树枝上的位置；在比喻用法中可指处于显眼、突出或重要的位置。
explanation_english: Refers to the tip of a tree branch or a position on a branch; figuratively it can mean being in a prominent, conspicuous, or elevated position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻小鳥停喺枝頭唱歌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 siu2 niu5 ting4 hai2 zi1 tau4 coeng3 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小鸟停在枝头唱歌。
examples.english_sentence: The little bird is perched on the branch singing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲熟透嘅果實都掛喺枝頭，等人摘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 suk6 tau3 ge3 gwo2 sat6 dou1 gwaa3 hai2 zi1 tau4, dang2 jan4 zaak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 熟透的果实都挂在枝头，等人摘。
examples.english_sentence: The ripe fruits are hanging on the branches, waiting to be picked.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家喺事業嘅枝頭，好多人留意佢嘅動向。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai2 si6 jip6 ge3 zi1 tau4, hou2 do1 jan4 lau4 ji3 keoi5 ge3 dung6 hoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在处于事业的枝头，很多人关注他的动向。
examples.english_sentence: He's currently at a prominent stage of his career; many people are watching his moves.

mandarin_meaning: 枪（火器，槍）
english_meaning: gun; firearm
explanation_mandarin: 指用于发射子弹或弹药的武器，亦可泛指枪械或火器。
explanation_english: A weapon designed to fire bullets or projectiles; generally refers to a firearm or gun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢拎住一枝枪行入嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ling1 zyu6 jat1 zi1 coeng1 hang4 jap6 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿着一把枪走了进来。
examples.english_sentence: He walked in holding a gun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方喺屋企附近搵到一枝枪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 hai2 uk1 kei2 fu6 gan6 wan2 dou3 jat1 zi1 coeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方在住宅附近找到一把枪。
examples.english_sentence: Police found a gun near the house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂拎枪，會好危險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 ling1 coeng1, wui5 hou2 ngai4 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要随便拿枪，会很危险。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pick up a gun carelessly; it's very dangerous.

mandarin_meaning: 梟；（古）斬首並示眾；在複合詞如「枭雄」中指凶狠、有勢力的人
english_meaning: owl (literary); (classical) to behead and display; used in compounds like '枭雄' meaning a ruthless or powerful leader
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞 / 動詞（古義）；在複合詞中可作名詞或形容詞成分
partOfSpeech_english: noun; (classical) verb; also used in compounds as noun/adjective
explanation_mandarin: 「枭」為「梟」的簡化字，原指貓頭鷹（文言用法），現常見於複合詞如「枭雄」表示凶狠、有權勢的人；在古文中亦有斬首示眾的含義（如「枭首」）。
explanation_english: The character 枭 (traditional 梟), pronounced hiu1 in Cantonese, originally means 'owl' (literary). It appears in compounds such as 枭雄, meaning a ruthless or powerful leader. In classical Chinese it can also mean to behead and display (e.g., 枭首).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜晚喺公園聽到枭嘅叫聲，好驚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 maan5 hai2 gung1 jyun4 teng1 dou3 hiu1 ge3 giu3 sing1, hou2 geng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚上在公园听到枭的叫声，很害怕。
examples.english_sentence: At night I heard an owl's call in the park and felt frightened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 歷史上有啲枭雄曾短期統治過一個地區。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lik6 si2 soeng6 jau5 di1 hiu1 hung4 cang4 dyun2 kei4 tung2 zi6 gwo3 jat1 go3 dei6 keoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 历史上有些枭雄曾短期统治过一个地区。
examples.english_sentence: In history there were some warlords who briefly ruled a region.

mandarin_meaning: 枯、枯萎、乾枯（kū）
english_meaning: withered; dry; withered-looking; (by extension) dull or depleted
explanation_mandarin: 表示植物因缺水、病害或年老而乾枯、失去生機；引申可表示枯燥、枯竭、沒有生氣。
explanation_english: Describes plants that are dried up or withered due to lack of water, disease, or aging; by extension it can describe things that are dry, dull, or depleted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢棵樹枯咗，要剪走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fo1 syu6 fu1 zo2, jiu3 zim2 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這棵樹枯死了，要砍掉。
examples.english_sentence: This tree has withered; it needs to be cut down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工作好枯燥，我做得好悶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 zok3 hou2 fu1 zou6, ngo5 zou6 dak1 hou2 mun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這份工作很枯燥，我做得很無聊。
examples.english_sentence: This job is very dull; I'm really bored doing it.

mandarin_meaning: 干枯；枯萎；变干
english_meaning: withered; dried up; desiccated
explanation_mandarin: 表示植物、土地或物体因缺水、老化或受损而变得干瘪、失去生气；也可比喻人的精神、感情或事物失去活力。
explanation_english: Describes plants, soil, or objects that have become dry, withered, or lifeless due to lack of water, aging, or damage; can also be used figuratively for a person's spirit or emotions that have lost vitality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過咗幾個月冇落雨，啲田都枯乾晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 zo2 gei2 go3 jyut6 mou5 lok6 jyu5, di1 tin4 dou1 fu1 gon1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过几个月没下雨，田地都枯干了。
examples.english_sentence: After several months without rain, the fields have all dried up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經歷咗咁多挫折，佢嘅心靈都枯乾咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 lik6 zo2 gam2 do1 co3 zit3, keoi5 ge3 sam1 ling4 dou1 fu1 gon1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经历了这么多挫折，他的心灵都枯干了。
examples.english_sentence: After so many setbacks, his spirit has become dried up.

mandarin_meaning: 比喻遭受挫折或衰敗後重新振作或復甦（拼音：kū mù féng chūn）
english_meaning: An idiom meaning revival or resurgence after a period of decline; literally 'a withered tree meeting spring'.
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物或人經過衰敗、低潮或困境之後，重新恢復生機、好轉或振作起來。
explanation_english: Describes a person, organization, or thing that regains vitality and improves after a period of decline or setback.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司經歷咗低潮，靠住新策略終於有起色，真係枯木逢春。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ging1 lik6 zo2 dai1 ciu4, kaau3 zyu6 san1 caak3 loek6 zung1 jyu1 jau5 hei2 sik1, zan1 hai6 fu1 muk6 fung4 ceon1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司經歷了低潮，靠新的策略終於有起色，真是枯木逢春。
examples.english_sentence: The company went through a slump, but thanks to new strategies it finally showed improvement — truly a case of revival.

mandarin_meaning: 枯朽 (kūxiǔ)：乾枯、腐爛或衰敗、老朽
english_meaning: withered, decayed, rotten; metaphorically decrepit or archaic
explanation_mandarin: 形容植物、木材或事物因乾枯、腐爛而變壞，也可比喻事物、制度或人因年久或衰敗而失去生機或功能。
explanation_english: Describes something dried up, decayed, or rotten; can also be used figuratively for things or systems that are decrepit, outdated, or have lost vitality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰棵樹已經枯朽，應該砍掉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 fo1 syu6 ji5 ging1 fu1 sau2, jing1 goi1 ham2 diu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那棵樹已經枯朽，應該砍掉。
examples.english_sentence: That tree has already decayed and should be cut down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嗰啲制度好枯朽，唔適合現代市場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 go2 di1 zai3 dou6 hou2 fu1 sau2, m4 sik1 hap6 jin6 doi6 si5 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間公司的那些制度很枯朽，不適合現代市場。
examples.english_sentence: The company's policies are very outdated and not suitable for the modern market.

mandarin_meaning: 枯燥（kūzào）：枯槁、干燥或缺乏趣味、單調無聊
english_meaning: dry; dull; boring; monotonous
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容事物缺乏趣味或內容單調無聊，也可指乾枯、乾燥的狀態。在口語中多用於表達無聊、乏味。
explanation_english: Describes something lacking interest or variety — dry, dull, monotonous. It can also refer to a dry or withered state, but is commonly used to express boredom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書好枯燥，我睇唔落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 hou2 fu1 zou6, ngo5 tai2 m4 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书很枯燥，我看不下去。
examples.english_sentence: This book is very dull — I can't bring myself to finish it.

mandarin_meaning: 枯燥乏味（kūzào fáwèi）：形容無聊、缺乏趣味或生動性的事物
english_meaning: dry and dull; boring; uninteresting; lacking in interest or excitement
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容內容或事物單調、乏味、缺乏吸引力，讓人感到無聊或難以投入。
explanation_english: Describes something that is monotonous, uninteresting, and lacking in liveliness or appeal, causing boredom or difficulty in engaging.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本教科書好枯燥乏味，我好難集中精神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 gaau3 fo1 syu1 hou2 fu1 cou3 fat6 mei6, ngo5 hou2 naan4 zaap6 zung1 zing1 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這本教科書枯燥乏味，我很難集中精神。
examples.english_sentence: This textbook is dry and dull; I find it hard to concentrate.

mandarin_meaning: 枯竭 (kūjié)：資源、精力或水分等耗盡或乾涸
english_meaning: to be exhausted or depleted (resources, energy, water); to dry up
explanation_mandarin: 表示水源、資源或人的精力等被耗盡、乾涸或不再充足。
explanation_english: Indicates that water, resources, or a person's energy have been used up, dried up, or are no longer sufficient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個地區嘅地下水已經枯竭，農民好擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dei6 keoi1 ge3 dei6 haa6 seoi2 ji5 ging1 fu1 git6, nung4 man4 hou2 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个地区的地下水已经枯竭，农民很担心。
examples.english_sentence: The groundwater in this area has been depleted; the farmers are very worried.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗成日冇食嘢，精力完全枯竭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 sing4 jat6 mou5 sik6 je5, zing1 lik6 jyun4 cyun4 fu1 git6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了一整天没吃东西，精力完全枯竭。
examples.english_sentence: He worked all day without eating; his energy was completely exhausted.

mandarin_meaning: 枯糠（字面為糧食的糠殼）；引申為微薄的食物或窮困時期的口糧；常見於成語「枯糠之妻」，比喻在艱苦時期陪伴的妻子。
english_meaning: Literally 'dried chaff' (rice/brans); figuratively meager food or subsistence in hard times; appears in the idiom '枯糠之妻' referring to a wife who stayed during poverty (a faithful first wife).
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞（可用作成語的一部分）
explanation_mandarin: 「枯糠」本義為糠殼、穀物的殘渣，常用來形容吃食微薄或生活清苦；在「枯糠之妻」等用法中帶有比喻意，指艱苦時期仍相伴的妻子或伴侶。
explanation_english: The literal meaning is chaff or husks of grain; it is used to describe meager food or poverty. In idiomatic use (e.g. '枯糠之妻') it metaphorically denotes a spouse who stood by one during hard times.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一直照顧佢個枯糠之妻，無論窮唔窮都冇拋低佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 zik6 ziu3 gu3 keoi5 go3 fu1 kong1 zi1 cai1, mou4 leon6 hung4 m4 hung4 dou1 mou5 paau1 dai1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一直照顧他的枯糠之妻，無論窮不窮都沒有拋棄她。
examples.english_sentence: He has always looked after his wife who stood by him in hard times, never abandoning her whether rich or poor.

mandarin_meaning: 枯萎（枯萎、凋萎）
english_meaning: wither; wilt; to become dry and shriveled (often of plants); figuratively, to decline or lose vitality
explanation_mandarin: 指植物因缺水、營養不足或受損而變得乾枯、萎縮；也可引申用來形容事物衰退或失去生氣。
explanation_english: Refers to plants becoming dry and shriveled due to lack of water, nutrients, or damage; can also be used figuratively to describe decline or loss of vitality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲花因為冇水，已經枯萎晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 faa1 jan1wai6 mou5 seoi2, ji5 ging1 fu1 wai2 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些花因为没有水，已经枯萎了。
examples.english_sentence: The flowers have withered because they haven't been watered.

mandarin_meaning: 枯萎、凋零、衰落（口語）
english_meaning: to wither, to decline, to dry up (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，通常形容事物、關係或生意等逐漸沒有生氣、衰落或乾涸。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term used to describe something (e.g., business, a relationship, vitality) gradually withering, declining, or drying up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖啲生意近排開始枯行喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 di1 saang1 ji3 gan6 paai4 hoi1 ci2 fu1 hang4 laa3。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間店的生意最近開始枯萎了。
examples.english_sentence: This shop's business has started to dry up recently.

mandarin_meaning: 枯黄 (kūhuáng) — 干枯发黄
english_meaning: withered and yellow; dry and yellowish
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容植物、葉子或面色因缺水、衰老或生病而變得乾枯、呈黃色或晦暗。
explanation_english: Describes plants, leaves, or a complexion that have become dry and yellowish due to lack of water, aging, or illness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天冇澆水，啲花都枯黃咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 mou5 gaau1 seoi2, di1 faa1 dou1 fu1 wong4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天没浇水，花都枯黄了。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't water them in summer, and the flowers withered and turned yellow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 樹葉因病變得枯黃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syu6 jip6 jan1 beng6 bin3 dak1 fu1 wong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 树叶因病变得枯黄。
examples.english_sentence: The leaves became withered and yellow because of disease.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近瞓唔好，面色睇落有啲枯黃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 fan3 m4 hou2, min6 sik1 tai2 lok3 jau5 di1 fu1 wong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近睡得不好，面色看起来有点枯黄。
examples.english_sentence: He hasn't been sleeping well lately; his complexion looks a bit sallow.

mandarin_meaning: （等于“桌子”）用来放置物品、吃饭或工作的家具
english_meaning: table (a piece of furniture with a flat top and legs used for placing items, dining, or working)
explanation_mandarin: 「枱」是廣東話常用字，指具有平面和支腳、用來放東西、吃飯或工作的家具，相當於普通話的「桌」或「桌子」。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "枱" refers to a table — a flat-topped piece of furniture with legs used for placing items, dining, or working. It corresponds to Mandarin "桌/桌子".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張枱幾錢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 toi4 gei2 cin2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张桌子多少钱？
examples.english_sentence: How much is this table?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 把杯放喺枱上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baa2 bui1 fong3 hai2 toi4 soeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把杯子放在桌子上。
examples.english_sentence: Put the cup on the table.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚喺枱邊食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 hai2 toi4 bin1 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚在桌边吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: We're eating at the table tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 桌布
english_meaning: tablecloth
explanation_mandarin: 指鋪在桌子上用作保護或裝飾的布料，常見於日常用餐或宴會佈置。
explanation_english: A piece of cloth spread over a table for protection or decoration, commonly used during meals or at banquets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要換個新枱布，呢個已經好污糟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wun6 go3 san1 toi4 bou3, ni1 go3 ji5 ging1 hou2 wu1 zou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們要換一塊新桌布，這個已經很髒了。
examples.english_sentence: We need to change to a new tablecloth; this one is already very dirty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 婚宴枱上鋪咗紅色枱布，好有喜慶氣氛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan1 jin3 toi4 seong6 pou1 zo2 hung4 sik1 toi4 bou3, hou2 jau5 hei2 hing3 hei3 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 婚宴的桌子上鋪了紅色的桌布，很有喜慶氣氛。
examples.english_sentence: The wedding banquet tables were covered with red tablecloths, creating a festive atmosphere.

mandarin_meaning: 桌子底下；暗中、私下（做事）
english_meaning: under the table (literally); secretly/illicitly (figurative), e.g., under-the-table deals or payments
explanation_mandarin: 一方面可指桌子底下的地方（字面意思）；另一方面在口語中常用來表示暗地裡、私下或不公開進行的行為，如「枱底交易」表示秘密或非法的交易。
explanation_english: Literally refers to the underside of a table. Colloquially in Cantonese it’s used to mean doing something secretly or unofficially (e.g., an 'under-the-table' deal or payment).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻貓鑽咗入枱底，見唔到佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 maau1 zyun1 zo2 jap6 toi4 dai2, gin3 m4 dou2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 猫钻到桌子底下了，看不到它。
examples.english_sentence: The cat crawled under the table; I can't see it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺枱底做交易，冇公開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 toi4 dai2 zou6 gaau1 jik6, mou5 gung1 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在暗地里做交易，没有公开。
examples.english_sentence: They made a deal under the table; it wasn't public.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆畀咗枱底錢畀官員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 bei2 zo2 toi4 dai2 cin2 bei2 gun1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板私下给了官员钱。
examples.english_sentence: The boss gave the official money under the table.

mandarin_meaning: 私下交易 / 暗箱交易（通常指不公開或非法的交易，例如賄賂）
english_meaning: under-the-table deal; secret or illicit transaction (often involving bribery)
explanation_mandarin: 指在公開程序之外進行的交易或協議，通常為私下或非法手段以規避監管或獲取不正當利益，例如賄賂、暗中分包等。
explanation_english: Refers to transactions or agreements made outside public procedures, usually secret or illegal, aimed at evading oversight or obtaining improper advantages — e.g., bribery or covert deals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺呢個工程有好多枱底交易，用現金賄賂先拎得到合約。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 ni1 go3 gung1 cing4 jau5 hou2 do1 toi4 dai2 gaau1 jik6, jung6 jin6 gam1 wai6 lou6 sin1 ling1 dak1 dou3 hap6 joek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們在這個工程上有很多暗箱操作，用現金行賄才能拿到合約。
examples.english_sentence: They had many under-the-table deals on this project, using cash bribes to secure the contract.

mandarin_meaning: 台曆 / 桌曆
english_meaning: desk calendar; a standing calendar placed on a desk
explanation_mandarin: 放在桌面上用來顯示日期的日曆，通常是立式可翻頁的日曆，用於辦公或家居查看日期。
explanation_english: A calendar designed to sit on a desk, typically a standing flip calendar used in offices or homes to display dates.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新一年開始，我換咗個枱曆，擺喺辦公室枱面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 jat6 nin4 hoi1 ci2, ngo5 wun6 zo2 go3 toi4 lik6, baai2 hai2 baan6 gung1 sat1 toi4 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新的一年開始，我換了個台曆，放在辦公室的桌面上。
examples.english_sentence: At the start of the new year I replaced my desk calendar and put it on the office desk.

mandarin_meaning: 每張桌子和凳子都有人坐；座無虛席，場地非常擠迫
