examples.english_sentence: This brownfield is well-suited for a community development project.

mandarin_meaning: 棕榈（棕榈树）
english_meaning: palm (palm tree)
explanation_mandarin: 指生长在热带或亚热带的一类高大木本植物，通常有长叶（羽状或掌状叶片）和直立的单干，统称为棕榈树。
explanation_english: Refers to a group of tall woody plants native to tropical or subtropical regions, typically with long fronds and an unbranched trunk — commonly called palm trees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公園入面有好多棕櫚樹，影相好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jyun4 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 zung1 leoi4 syu6, jing2 soeng2 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公园里面有很多棕榈树，拍照很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: There are many palm trees in the park; they make nice photo backdrops.

mandarin_meaning: 棕色（棕褐色）
english_meaning: brown
explanation_mandarin: 表示介於紅色與黃色之間、像樹皮或咖啡的顏色，一種常見的中性色彩。
explanation_english: A color between red and yellow, like the shade of tree bark or coffee; a common neutral color.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗件棕色嘅外套。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 gin6 zung1 sik1 ge3 ngoi6 tou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我買了一件棕色的外套。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a brown coat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅眼睛係棕色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ngaan5 zing1 hai6 zung1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的/她的眼睛是棕色的。
examples.english_sentence: His/Her eyes are brown.

mandarin_meaning: 撐；支撐、撐起（罕用字或古字，與「撐」義近）
english_meaning: to prop up; to support; to brace (rare/archaic character, similar to 撐)
explanation_mandarin: 「棖」為較罕見或古字，常用意義與現代漢語的「撐」相近，可表示用物體支撐或撐住某物，也可引申為支持。
explanation_english: A rare or archaic character generally used with the same meanings as modern 撐: to prop up, to support or brace something; can also mean to back or support someone/something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 段樑塌咗，我哋要用支棖撐住先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dyun6 loeng4 taat3 zo2, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jung6 zi1 caang1 zyu6 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 樑塌了，我們要用一根棍子先撐住。
examples.english_sentence: The beam collapsed; we need to prop it up with a pole first.

mandarin_meaning: （粵語俗語，非正式）笨蛋；傻瓜（帶貶義）
english_meaning: (Cantonese slang, informal) fool; idiot (pejorative)
explanation_mandarin: 「棖雞」是廣東話俗語，用來稱呼行為愚笨或做出蠢事的人。此詞帶有貶義，多用於口語、非正式場合。有時區域/個別社群使用較多，並非標準書面詞彙。
explanation_english: “棖雞” is Cantonese slang used to call someone foolish or to criticize someone for doing something silly. It is pejorative and informal; usage is mainly spoken and may be regional.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做棖雞，諗清楚先做決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 cang1 gai1, nam2 cing1 co2 sin1 zou6 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要當笨蛋，先想清楚再做決定。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a 棖雞; think clearly before making a decision.

mandarin_meaning: 笨蛋；傻瓜（粗俗罵人用語，類似「蠢雞」）
english_meaning: idiot; fool (vulgar insult, similar to 'stupid chicken')
explanation_mandarin: 「棖鷄*」為粵語粗俗罵人詞，常用來指責別人愚蠢或做了蠢事。此詞與常見的「蠢雞」意義接近，可能為書寫或口語變體。屬於非正式和帶侮辱性的用語，使用時需注意場合。
explanation_english: “棖鷄*” is a Cantonese vulgar insult used to call someone stupid or foolish. It is similar in meaning to the more common term “蠢雞” (ceon2 gai1). This is informal and offensive language, so be careful with context and audience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做咗嗰啲嘢，真係棖鷄*！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 zo2 go2 di1 je5, zan1 hai6 ceon2 gai1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做了那些事，真是個笨蛋！
examples.english_sentence: What you did was really foolish, you idiot!

mandarin_meaning: 枣（棗），即棗樹所結的果實，常見為紅棗/大棗
english_meaning: jujube (Chinese date); red date
explanation_mandarin: 棗是指棗樹的果實，果肉甜，可鮮食或乾燥成紅棗，用於烹飪或中藥材。
explanation_english: The fruit of the jujube tree; sweet, eaten fresh or dried (red dates), commonly used in cooking and traditional medicine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽成日用紅棗煲湯，話對身體好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 sing4 jat6 jung6 hung4 zou2 bou1 tong1, waa6 deoi3 san1 tai2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈经常用红枣煲汤，说对身体好。
examples.english_sentence: Mom often uses red dates to make soup; she says they're good for your health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢棵棗樹今年結咗好多棗，可以收成啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fo1 zou2 syu6 gam1 nin4 git3 zo2 hou2 do1 zou2, ho2 ji5 sau1 sing4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这棵枣树今年结了很多枣，可以收成了。
examples.english_sentence: This jujube tree produced many fruits this year; it's ready for harvest.

mandarin_meaning: 棘（刺、带刺的植物；引申为棘手、麻烦）
english_meaning: thorn; spiny (literally); figuratively: thorny, troublesome, difficult
explanation_mandarin: 棘本义为植物的刺或多刺的植物，常用于比喻困难、麻烦或难以处理的情况（如“棘手”）。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a thorn or a spiny plant. Figuratively used to describe something troublesome or difficult to handle (e.g., "棘手" = thorny).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個問題好棘手，唔容易解決。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 hou2 gik6 sau2, m4 jung4 ji6 gaai2 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个问题很棘手，不容易解决。
examples.english_sentence: This problem is very thorny and not easy to solve.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢棵植物有好多棘，唔好亂摸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fo1 zik6 mat6 jau5 hou2 do1 gik6, m4 hou2 lyun6 mo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这株植物有很多刺，不要乱摸。
examples.english_sentence: This plant has a lot of thorns; don't touch it.

mandarin_meaning: 卡住了／麻煩了（粵語俚語）
english_meaning: jammed / stuck / in trouble (Cantonese slang interjection)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語或俚語，用來形容機器卡住或事情陷入困境，表示麻煩、尷尬或處理不了的情況。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang interjection used to describe something being jammed or a situation becoming troublesome/awkward — expressing that something's stuck or problematic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部打印機棘嚦卡嘞，複印唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 daa2 jan3 gei1 gik1 lik6 kaa1 laa3, fuk1 jan3 m4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 打印机卡住了，复印不了。
examples.english_sentence: The printer jammed — can't make copies.

mandarin_meaning: 棘手，難以處理或解決的事
english_meaning: tricky; thorny; difficult to deal with
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情棘手、難以處理或解決，帶有麻煩和困難的含義，常用來形容問題或情況不易應付。
explanation_english: Describes a situation or problem that is troublesome or hard to handle; implies difficulty and complexity in resolving or dealing with it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事真係有啲棘手，我哋要多啲時間諗辦法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 zan1 hai6 jau5 di1 gik6 sau2, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 do1 di1 si4 gaan3 nam2 baan6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事真的有點棘手，我們需要多一點時間想辦法。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is really a bit tricky; we'll need more time to think of a solution.

mandarin_meaning: 棘皮动物（棘皮动物门的一类海洋无脊椎动物）
english_meaning: echinoderm (a phylum of marine invertebrates such as starfish, sea urchins, sea cucumbers)
explanation_mandarin: 棘皮动物是海洋无脊椎动物的一门，包括海星、海膽、海參、蛇尾等，典型特徵有放射對稱和體表多有突起或刺。
explanation_english: Echinoderms are a phylum of marine invertebrates that includes starfish, sea urchins, sea cucumbers, and brittle stars. They typically exhibit radial symmetry and often have spiny or tuberculate skin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 海灘上發現咗幾隻棘皮動物，好似海星同海膽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi2 taan1 soeng6 faat3 jin6 zo2 gei2 zek3 gik6 pei4 dung6 mat6, hou2 ci5 hoi2 sing1 tung4 hoi2 daam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在海滩上发现了几只棘皮动物，比如海星和海胆。
examples.english_sentence: We found several echinoderms on the beach, such as starfish and sea urchins.

synonyms: 棘皮动物（同詞異體：棘皮动物）

mandarin_meaning: 露出破綻／被識破
english_meaning: to be exposed/give oneself away; to have a flaw revealed
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語（口語），指在說話或行為中不慎露出破綻或弱點，因而被人識破或抓住把柄。用法偏向非正式場合。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang expression meaning to accidentally reveal a flaw or weakness and be found out. Used in informal contexts to say someone has been caught out or given themselves away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一講就棘馬腳，畀人發現佢講大話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 gong2 zau6 gik6 maa5 goek3, bei2 jan4 faat3 jin6 keoi5 gong2 daai6 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一說就露出破綻，被人發現他說謊。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as he spoke he gave himself away; people discovered he was lying.

mandarin_meaning: 棚；简易的遮蔽物、棚屋、摊位
english_meaning: shed; canopy; stall; temporary structure used for shelter or as a booth
explanation_mandarin: 指临时或简陋的遮蔽物或结构，常用作避雨、存放或摆摊，也出现在合成词如“摄影棚”、“棚屋”等。
explanation_english: Refers to a temporary or simple shelter/structure such as a shed, canopy, or market stall. Also used in compounds like 'photography studio' (攝影棚).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度有個小棚，落雨可以避一陣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 jau5 go3 siu2 pung4, lok6 jyu5 ho2 ji5 bei6 jat1 zan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里有个小棚，下雨可以躲一下。
examples.english_sentence: There's a small shelter here; you can take cover from the rain for a while.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺攝影棚入面拍攝廣告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 sip3 jing2 pung4 jap6 min6 paak3 sit3 gwong2 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在摄影棚里面拍摄广告。
examples.english_sentence: We're shooting a commercial in the photo studio.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市集有啲小棚賣手作嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 zaap6 jau5 di1 siu2 pung4 maai6 sau2 zok3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市集有一些小棚卖手工制品。
examples.english_sentence: There are small stalls at the market selling handmade items.

mandarin_meaning: 棚內的群演；在片場做臨時或背景演員的人
english_meaning: an extra/background actor who works on a film or TV set
explanation_mandarin: 「棚仔」是香港粵語俗稱，指在攝影棚或片場擔任群演、臨時演員或背景演員的人，通常負責在鏡頭後或鏡頭邊出現以增加場面人數或氛圍。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese slang, "棚仔" refers to extras or background actors who work on film/TV sets (in the studio or on set), usually appearing in scenes to fill out crowds or atmosphere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家做緊電視劇嘅棚仔，日日都要喺棚入面企住幾個鐘頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 zou6 gan2 din6 si6 kek6 ge3 paang4 zai2, jat6 jat6 dou1 jiu3 hai2 paang4 jap6 min6 kei5 zyu6 gei2 go3 zung1 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在在電視劇當群演，每天都要在棚裡站好幾個小時。
examples.english_sentence: He's currently working as an extra on a TV drama; he has to stand on set for several hours every day.

mandarin_meaning: 棚屋；簡陋的臨時小屋或儲物棚
english_meaning: shed; shack; makeshift hut or temporary shelter
explanation_mandarin: 指用竹木、鐵皮或其他簡單材料搭建的簡陋臨時小屋或棚子，常用於儲存雜物或作臨時遮蔽之用。
explanation_english: Refers to a simple, makeshift small structure (shed or shack) built from wood, metal sheeting, or other basic materials, typically used for storage or temporary shelter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋屋企後園有個舊棚寮，擺咗好多雜物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei2 hau6 jyun4 jau5 go3 gau6 paang4 liu4, baai2 zo2 hou2 do1 zaap6 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們家後院有個舊棚寮，放了很多雜物。
examples.english_sentence: There's an old shed in our backyard where a lot of junk is stored.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 工地旁邊搭咗好幾個臨時棚寮，工人喺入面休息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 dei6 pong4 bin1 daap3 zo2 hou2 gei2 go3 lam4 si4 paang4 liu4, gung1 jan4 hai2 jap6 min6 jau1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工地旁邊搭了好幾個臨時棚子，工人在裡面休息。
examples.english_sentence: Several temporary sheds have been erected next to the construction site; workers are resting inside.

mandarin_meaning: 收拾行李離開 / 收檔走人
english_meaning: pack up and leave; clear out (usually after finishing work or closing up a stall)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語說法，字面是把箱子拉走，常指工作結束、收檔或臨時收拾離開。有時帶有突然或無奈離開的語氣。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang phrase literally meaning 'pull the suitcase at the back.' It commonly means to pack up and leave (e.g., finish work, close a stall, or clear out), sometimes implying a sudden or reluctant departure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚唔夠生意，老闆話要棚尾拉箱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 m4 gau3 sang1 ji3, lou5 baan2 waa6 jiu3 pung4 mei5 laai1 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚生意不好，老板说要收摊走人。
examples.english_sentence: Business wasn't good tonight; the boss said we'd pack up and leave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 拍完戲佢哋就棚尾拉箱，冇再加戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: paak3 jyun4 hei3 keoi5 dei6 zau6 pung4 mei5 laai1 soeng1, mou5 zoi6 gaa1 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拍完戏他们就收工走人，没有再加戏。
examples.english_sentence: After filming they packed up and left; there were no extra scenes.

mandarin_meaning: 棚屋 (péngwū)：臨時搭建或簡陋的房屋、草棚或鐵皮屋
english_meaning: shack; makeshift hut; rudimentary dwelling
explanation_mandarin: 指用木板、鐵皮、帆布等臨時或簡陋材料搭建的房屋，常見於工地、農田或貧民區，強調結構簡單與臨時性。
explanation_english: Refers to a makeshift or rudimentary dwelling constructed from materials like wood, corrugated metal, or tarpaulin. Often found in construction sites, farms, or informal settlements and emphasizes improvisation and temporary structure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰啲人住喺棚屋度，生活好艱苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 di1 jan4 zyu6 hai2 pung4-uk1 dou6, saang1-wut6 hou2 gaan1-fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些人住在棚屋裡，生活很艱苦。
examples.english_sentence: Those people live in shacks; life is very hard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府打算清拆嗰啲違章棚屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3-fu2 daa2-syun3 cing1-caak3 go2 di1 wai4-zoeng1 pung4-uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府打算清拆那些違章搭建的棚屋。
examples.english_sentence: The government plans to demolish those illegally erected shacks.

mandarin_meaning: 棚架；支架、支撑结构（如棚子、货架或脚手架的框架）
english_meaning: scaffold; frame; rack; supporting structure (e.g., awning frame, shelving, scaffolding)
explanation_mandarin: 指用來支撐或搭建的框架結構，可指臨時的建築腳手架、貨架或棚子的骨架等。
explanation_english: Refers to a supporting frame or structure used for building or holding things in place; can mean temporary scaffolding, shelving racks, awning frames, or trellises.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 工人喺棚架上面做緊嘢，大家小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jan4 hai2 paang4 gaa3 soeng6 min6 zou6 gan2 je5, daai6 gaa1 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工人在棚架上面工作，大家要小心一些。
examples.english_sentence: Workers are working on the scaffold; everyone be a bit careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 貨倉入面啲棚架已經擺滿咗貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fo3 cong1 jap6 min6 di1 paang4 gaa3 ji5 ging1 baai2 mun5 zo2 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 货仓里面的棚架已经摆满了货。
examples.english_sentence: The warehouse racks are already filled with goods.

mandarin_meaning: 栋；（量词）用于建筑物的量词，也可指屋梁或比喻为栋梁
english_meaning: dòng (measure word for buildings); building; beam; mainstay/pillar (figurative)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词 / 量词（用于建筑物）
explanation_mandarin: 「棟」在粤语讀作 dung6，常用作建筑物的量词，如「一棟樓」；也可指房屋的梁柱，或比喻为国家或團體的栋梁之材。
explanation_english: In Cantonese pronounced dung6. Commonly used as a measure word for buildings (e.g., '一棟樓'). It can also mean a beam or, figuratively, a pillar/mainstay of an organization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰棟樓好高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 dung6 lau4 hou2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那栋楼很高。
examples.english_sentence: That building is very tall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個屋苑有三棟大廈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 uk1 jyun2 jau5 saam1 dung6 daai6 haa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个屋苑有三栋大厦。
examples.english_sentence: The housing estate has three blocks of buildings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係公司嘅棟樑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 gung1 si1 ge3 dung6 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是公司的栋梁。
examples.english_sentence: He is the company's pillar (key person).

mandarin_meaning: 栋梁（比喻国家或团体的中坚力量或重要人才）
english_meaning: pillar; mainstay; backbone; a key person or talent of an organization or country
explanation_mandarin: 「棟梁」原指房屋的横梁，常用作比喻，指國家、團體或機構的中堅力量或重要人才。
explanation_english: Originally referring to a roof beam, this term is used metaphorically to denote the backbone or mainstay of an organization, country, or group — an important or leading person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係公司嘅棟樑，冇佢好多項目都做唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 gung1si1 ge3 dung6 loeng4, mou5 keoi5 hou2 do1 hong6 muk6 dou1 zou6 m4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是公司的栋梁，没有他很多项目都做不成。
examples.english_sentence: He is the company's backbone; without him many projects couldn't be completed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府要培養年輕人做國家嘅棟樑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jiu3 pui4 joeng5 nin4 hing1 jan4 zou6 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 dung6 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府要培养年轻人成为国家的栋梁。
examples.english_sentence: The government should cultivate young people to become the nation's pillars.

mandarin_meaning: 栋梁（指国家、团体或家庭中的中坚人物、主要支柱）
english_meaning: a pillar; the mainstay or backbone of an organization, society, or family
explanation_mandarin: 「棟樑」原指房屋的梁柱，借指在團體或社會中起核心、支撐作用的中堅人物或重要力量。
explanation_english: Originally referring to the main beams of a house, '棟樑' is used metaphorically for a person or group that serves as the core support or backbone of an organization, society, or family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係公司嘅棟樑，一直帶領住個團隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 gung1si1 ge3 dung6 loeng4, jat1zik6 daai3 ling5 zyu6 go3 tyun4 deoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是公司的棟樑，一直帶領著團隊。
examples.english_sentence: He is the backbone of the company and has been leading the team.

mandarin_meaning: 單口喜劇（立足於講笑話、故事或對時事評論的現場喜劇表演）
english_meaning: stand-up comedy (a live solo comedy performance featuring jokes, stories, or social commentary)
explanation_mandarin: 「棟篤笑」是香港常用來指單口喜劇或脫口秀的詞語，通常是一位表演者在舞台上以講笑話、講故事或評論社會時事為主的現場喜劇表演，名稱源自英語 stand-up（脫口秀/單口演出）的概念在本地化後的稱呼。
explanation_english: A Cantonese term for stand-up comedy or a solo comedy act. Typically one performer on stage telling jokes, stories, or offering social commentary. The term is a local Hong Kong usage corresponding to the English concept of stand-up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚去睇棟篤笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 heoi3 tai2 dung6 duk1 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚去看棟篤笑表演。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to watch a stand-up comedy show tonight.

mandarin_meaning: （常指海棠）一种树或其花；亦用作人名、地名或文学用字
english_meaning: the flowering crabapple (haitang) / crabapple tree or its blossoms; also used in names and literary contexts
explanation_mandarin: 「棠」常见于复合词如「海棠」，指海棠树或其花；在古文、地名和人名中亦有使用。
explanation_english: The character refers to the flowering crabapple tree or its blossoms (as in 'haitang'); it is also used in personal and place names and in literary contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企門口有海棠，今年開得好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei2 mun4 hau2 jau5 hoi2 tong4, gam1 nin4 hoi1 dak1 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家門口有海棠，今年開得很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: There's a flowering crabapple tree in front of my house; it bloomed very beautifully this year.

mandarin_meaning: 栈；客栈；木板、码头等支撑或停放的构造
english_meaning: inn/hostel; wooden platform, pallet, or trestle; a structure for loading/unloading
explanation_mandarin: 「棧」常見於複合詞，表示客棧（旅店）或指木製的板、棧道、棧板等用於支撐或放置貨物的構造。
explanation_english: Commonly appears in compounds. It can mean an inn/hostel (as in 客棧) or a wooden platform/pallet, trestle, or structure used for supporting or storing goods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚住喺客棧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 zyu6 hai2 haak3 zaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚住在客栈。
examples.english_sentence: We're staying at the inn tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 遊手好閒的人；整天閒逛、不務正業的人（俚語、貶義）
english_meaning: A loafer/bum; someone who idles or shirks work (slang, derogatory)
explanation_mandarin: 「棧鬼」是粵語口語俚語，常用來貶稱成日在某處閒逛、不做正經事或偷懶的人。語感帶有嘲諷或責備意味，常見於香港口語。
explanation_english: “棧鬼” is Cantonese slang used to derogatorily refer to someone who loiters, idles, or avoids doing proper work. It conveys a mocking or reproachful tone and is common in Hong Kong colloquial speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做棧鬼，成日喺度閒逛，快啲搵啲正經事做啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 zaan6 gwai2, sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 haan4 gwaang3, faai3 di1 wan2 di1 zing3 ging1 si6 zou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別當棧鬼，成天在那裡閒逛，快點找些正經事做吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a loafer—stop hanging around all day and find something proper to do.

mandarin_meaning: （表示）森林；樹木茂密
english_meaning: forest; dense (of trees); wooded
explanation_mandarin: 漢字「森」常用來表示樹木繁茂、濃密，也可作「森林」一詞中的字，表示林地或樹木密集的地方。
explanation_english: The character denotes a forest or dense growth of trees. It appears in words like '森林' (forest) and can describe wooded or tree‑dense areas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋行入咗森林，樹好多，空氣好清新。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haang4 jap6 zo2 sam1 lam4, syu6 hou2 do1, hung1 hei3 hou2 cing1 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们走进了森林，树很多，空气很清新。
examples.english_sentence: We walked into the forest; there were many trees and the air was very fresh.

mandarin_meaning: 森严；严厉、严密
english_meaning: strict; severe; tightly guarded; imposing
explanation_mandarin: 形容气氛、纪律、守卫等非常严格、严密或庄严肃穆，常用于描述管理、警戒或场面的严厉程度。
explanation_english: Describes something very strict, severe, tightly guarded, or imposing; often used for security, discipline, or a solemn atmosphere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 軍營守衛森嚴，閒人唔准入內。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwan1 jing4 sau2 wai6 sam1 jim4, haan4 jan4 m4 zeon2 jap6 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 军营守卫森严，闲人不得入内。
examples.english_sentence: The military camp is heavily guarded; unauthorized people are not allowed in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試監場好森嚴，大家要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 gaam1 coeng4 hou2 sam1 jim4, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试监场很森严，大家要小心些。
examples.english_sentence: The exam invigilation is very strict; everyone should be careful.

mandarin_meaning: 桑巴舞（源自巴西的舞蹈與音樂風格）
english_meaning: Samba (a Brazilian dance and music style)
explanation_mandarin: 指起源於巴西的舞蹈與音樂風格，節奏強烈、富有活力，常見於嘉年華等慶典表演。
explanation_english: Refers to a Brazilian dance and music style with energetic, rhythmic movements; commonly performed at carnivals and festive events.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個嘉年華有森巴舞表演，好熱鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 gaa1 nin4 waa4 jau5 sam1 baa1 mou5 biu2 jin2, hou2 jit6 nou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个嘉年华有森巴舞表演，很热闹。
examples.english_sentence: There's a samba dance performance at this carnival — it's very lively.

mandarin_meaning: 森林 (sēn lín)
english_meaning: forest; woods
explanation_mandarin: 由大量樹木組成的大片自然植被，通常指較廣闊、樹木密集的地方。
explanation_english: A large area covered chiefly with trees and undergrowth; an extensive area of trees, woods, or timber.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上星期我同朋友去嗰片森林行山，風景好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng6 sing1 kei4 ngo5 tung4 pang4 jau5 heoi3 go2 pin3 sam1 lam4 haang4 saan1, fung1 ging2 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上星期我和朋友去那片森林爬山，風景很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: Last week my friend and I went hiking in that forest; the scenery was beautiful.

mandarin_meaning: 樹木茂密／森林裡的樹木
english_meaning: trees (esp. dense trees); forest trees
explanation_mandarin: 通常為書面或詩意用法，指成片或茂密的樹木，與「樹林／森林」近義。
explanation_english: A literary/poetic term referring to trees or stands of dense trees — similar in meaning to 'trees', 'grove', or 'forest trees'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公園入面有好多森樹，夏天可以遮陰好涼快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jyun2 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 sam1 syu6, haa6 tin1 ho2 ji5 ze1 jam1 hou2 loeng4 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公園裡有很多樹木，夏天可以遮蔭，很涼快。
examples.english_sentence: There are many trees in the park; they provide shade in summer and make it cool.

mandarin_meaning: 森罗万象
english_meaning: the myriad phenomena of the world; everything under heaven; all sorts of things
explanation_mandarin: 表示世間萬事萬物、各種事物和現象繁多，範圍廣泛。
explanation_english: A literary idiom meaning the myriad phenomena of the world — a vast, varied range of things; everything imaginable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度嘅市集商品森羅萬象，乜都有得揀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ge3 si5 zaap6 soeng1 ban2 sam1 lo4 maan6 zoeng6, mat1 dou1 jau5 dak1 gaan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的市集商品森罗万象，什么都有得选。
examples.english_sentence: The market here has a bewildering variety of goods—there's everything to choose from.

mandarin_meaning: 古代或方言中指木製的柱、木樁（屬於罕見或已廢用字）
english_meaning: a wooden post/pillar or stake (rare/archaic character; dialectal)
explanation_mandarin: 「棯」為一個較罕見或古字，常見於方言或舊文獻中，用以指稱木製的柱子、木樁或類似支撐用的木構件。現代書面語較少使用，常以「柱」、「樁」等字代替。
explanation_english: 棯 is a rare or archaic character, historically used in dialects or older texts to denote a wooden post, pillar, or stake — a timber element used for support. It is uncommon in modern written usage and is usually replaced by words like '柱' (post) or '樁' (stake).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢支棯擺耐咗，應該換一支新嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zi1 jyun4 baai2 noi6 zo2, jing1 goi1 wun6 jat1 zi1 san1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這根棯放很久了，應該換一根新的。
examples.english_sentence: This wooden post has been there a long time; it should be replaced with a new one.

mandarin_meaning: 傻小子；笨蛋（廣東話俚語）
english_meaning: a little fool; simpleton (Cantonese slang, mildly insulting)
explanation_mandarin: 「棯仔」是廣東話口語俚語，用來形容行為或做事笨拙、不靈光、常犯小錯的人，語氣可帶輕微戲謔或不滿。主要在香港粵語口語中使用。
explanation_english: “棯仔” is a Cantonese slang term used to describe someone who is clumsy, dim-witted, or prone to small mistakes. The tone can be teasing or mildly reproachful. It’s commonly used in colloquial Hong Kong Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係一個棯仔，成日做嘢唔小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 waan4 zai2, seng4 jat6 zou6 je5 m4 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是個棯仔，做事總是不小心。
examples.english_sentence: He's such a棯仔 — always careless when doing things.

mandarin_meaning: 棱；棱角；棱线（léng）
english_meaning: edge; ridge; corner; facet
explanation_mandarin: 指物体的棱、棱角或棱线，常用于描述几何体或物体表面的边缘或锋利处。例如“棱角”、“棱线”等用法。
explanation_english: Refers to the edge, ridge, or corner of an object. Commonly used to describe the edges or facets of geometric solids or sharp parts of a surface (e.g., in compounds like 'edges' or 'ridges').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊石頭有好多棱，拎住要小心，會割傷手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 sek6 tau4 jau5 hou2 do1 ling4, ling1 zyu6 jiu3 siu2 sam1, wui5 got3 soeng1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这块石头有很多棱，拿着要小心，会割伤手。
examples.english_sentence: This rock has many edges/ridges; hold it carefully or it will cut your hand.

mandarin_meaning: 棱角（物體的尖利邊角；比喻人的性格或言行上的尖銳、不圓滑）
english_meaning: edges/corners; (figurative) sharpness or roughness in character or manner; distinct, angular features
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指物體的尖銳邊角；比喻用於描述人的性格或言行不夠圓滑、較為尖銳或直接。
explanation_english: Literally the sharp edges or corners of an object. Figuratively used to describe someone's personality or manner as having sharpness or roughness — not smooth or easily palatable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊石頭有好多棱角，小心會割傷手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 sek6 tau4 jau5 hou2 do1 ling4 gok3, siu2 sam1 wui5 got3 soeng1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這塊石頭有很多棱角，小心會割傷手。
examples.english_sentence: This rock has many sharp edges — be careful, it can cut your hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢性格有棱角，唔係好易相處，但好誠實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing3 gok3 jau5 ling4 gok3, m4 hai6 hou2 ji6 soeng1 cyu3, daan6 hou2 sing4 sat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他性格有棱角，不是很容易相處，但很誠實。
examples.english_sentence: He has sharp edges to his personality — not easy to get along with, but very honest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做新人嘅時候，應該磨平啲棱角，學識同人相處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 san1 jan4 ge3 si4 hau6, jing1 goi1 mo4 ping4 di1 ling4 gok3, hok6 sik1 tung4 jan4 soeng1 cyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做新人的時候，應該磨平些棱角，學會與人相處。
examples.english_sentence: When you're new, you should smooth some of your edges and learn how to get along with others.

mandarin_meaning: 棲、棲息；停留或居住（多指鳥類在枝頭或動物暫時停留）
english_meaning: to perch; to roost; to dwell; to take shelter (often of birds or temporary resting)
explanation_mandarin: 表示停留或居住，多用於鳥類停在樹上或作為文言用詞，亦可用於人或動物暫時落腳、棲身。
explanation_english: Indicates resting, dwelling, or taking shelter—commonly used for birds roosting on branches; also a literary verb for temporarily lodging or sheltering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜晚有好多雀喺樹上棲息，聽落好寧靜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 maan5 jau5 hou2 do1 zoek3 hai2 syu6 soeng6 cai1 sik1, teng1 lok6 hou2 ning4 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚上有很多鳥在樹上棲息，聽起來很寧靜。
examples.english_sentence: At night many birds roost on the tree; it sounds very peaceful.

mandarin_meaning: 栖息（停留、歇息、栖居，尤指动物停留或栖居）
english_meaning: to perch; to roost; to settle or rest (usually of animals); to inhabit/occupy
explanation_mandarin: 指動物在某處停留或棲居、休息，也可指暫時居住或停留。
explanation_english: Refers to animals settling, roosting, or resting at a place; can also mean to stay or reside temporarily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 候鳥每年都會喺嗰條河岸棲息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hau6 niu5 mui5 nin4 dou1 wui5 hai2 go2 tiu4 ho4 ngaan6 cai1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 候鸟每年都会在那条河岸栖息。
examples.english_sentence: Migratory birds roost on that riverbank every year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢暫時喺朋友屋企棲息，等新屋整好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zaam6 si4 hai2 pang4 jau5 uk1 kei2 cai1 sik1, dang2 san1 uk1 zing2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他暫時在朋友家棲息，等新房修好。
examples.english_sentence: He is staying temporarily at a friend's place while waiting for his new home to be ready.

mandarin_meaning: 棲息地（栖息地）
english_meaning: habitat
explanation_mandarin: 指動物或植物生活、繁衍或暫時停留的場所與環境，常用於生態學與保育語境中。
explanation_english: Refers to the place or environment where animals or plants live, reproduce, or temporarily reside; commonly used in ecology and conservation contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 森林裏係好多動物嘅棲息地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sam1 lam4 leoi5 hai6 hou2 do1 dung6 mat6 ge3 cai1 sik1 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 森林裡是很多動物的棲息地。
examples.english_sentence: The forest is the habitat for many animals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 濕地保育對維持生物嘅棲息地好重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sap1 dei6 bou2 juk6 deoi3 wai4 ci4 sang1 mat6 ge3 cai1 sik1 dei6 hou2 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 濕地保育對維持生物的棲息地很重要。
examples.english_sentence: Wetland conservation is important for maintaining species' habitats.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 城市化破壞咗好多動物嘅棲息地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 si5 faa3 po3 waai6 zo2 hou2 do1 dung6 mat6 ge3 cai1 sik1 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 城市化破壞了許多動物的棲息地。
examples.english_sentence: Urbanization has destroyed many animals' habitats.

mandarin_meaning: 栖身（暂时居住、借住）
english_meaning: to take shelter; to lodge; to find a place to stay (often temporarily)
explanation_mandarin: 指暫時借住或找地方居住，多用於書面或較正式語境，也可指動物找地方棲息。
explanation_english: Refers to temporarily staying or taking shelter somewhere; often used in more literary or formal contexts. Can also mean animals finding a place to roost or dwell.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我暫時喺朋友屋企棲身，搵緊工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zaam6 si4 hai2 pang4 jau5 uk1 kei2 cai1 san1, wan2 gan2 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我暂时在朋友家栖身，正在找工作。
examples.english_sentence: I'm temporarily staying at a friend's place while looking for work.

mandarin_meaning: （量词）用于树木、植物等的量词，普通话读作 kē
english_meaning: classifier/measure word for trees and plants
explanation_mandarin: “棵”是用于计量树木、花草等植物数量的量词，例如“一棵树”、“三棵花”。在粤语中常用作植物的计量词。
explanation_english: “棵” is a classifier used to count trees and plants (e.g., 'one tree', 'three plants'). In Cantonese it functions as the measure word for vegetation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 附近有一棵大樹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fu6 gan6 jau5 jat1 fo1 daai6 syu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 附近有一棵大树。
examples.english_sentence: There is a big tree nearby.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 種一棵樹可以改善空氣質素。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung3 jat1 fo1 syu6 ho2 ji5 goi2 sin6 hung1 hei3 zat1 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 种一棵树可以改善空气质量。
examples.english_sentence: Planting a tree can improve air quality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰棵椰子樹已經有好多椰子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 fo1 je4 zi2 syu6 ji5 ging1 jau5 hou2 do1 je4 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那棵椰子树已经有很多椰子。
examples.english_sentence: That coconut tree already has many coconuts.

mandarin_meaning: 桨；划船（用桨划船）
english_meaning: oar, paddle; to row (with an oar)
explanation_mandarin: 指用來划船的木桨或划槳的動作，既可作名詞（桨），亦可作動詞（用桨划船）。
explanation_english: Refers to an oar or paddle used for rowing a boat; can be used as a noun (the oar) or as a verb (to row with an oar).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用棹划緊條船。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 zaau6 waak6 gan2 tiu4 syun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他正在用桨划船。
examples.english_sentence: He is rowing the boat with an oar.

mandarin_meaning: 罕見或方言詞語，字面可解作「划船時的忌諱」，引申指「忌諱出頭、避免引人注意或避免觸及某件事」
english_meaning: A rare/regional Cantonese expression; literally "paddle taboo," used figuratively to mean avoiding drawing attention, keeping a low profile, or refraining from doing something considered taboo
explanation_mandarin: 「棹忌」並非常見的現代廣東話詞彙。字面由「棹」（划船的槳）與「忌」（忌諱）組成，可能源自海上或水上活動的禁忌說法，後來被引申為在某些情況下應避開出頭或迴避某些話題或行為。使用時常帶有方言或口語色彩，語義及用法因地區和語境而異。
explanation_english: “棹忌” is not a common modern Cantonese term. Literally combining “棹” (paddle/oar) and “忌” (taboo/avoid), it may originally refer to superstitions or taboos around rowing, later extended figuratively to mean keeping a low profile or avoiding certain topics or actions. It carries a regional/colloquial flavor and usage can vary by context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事好敏感，最好棹忌唔好公開講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 hou2 man5 gam2, zeoi3 hou2 zaau2 gei3 m4 hou2 gung1 hoi1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事很敏感，最好忌讳不要公开说。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is sensitive; it's best to avoid discussing it publicly.

mandarin_meaning: 划艇（用槳划的小艇）
english_meaning: rowboat; small boat propelled by oars; (also refers to the activity of rowing a small boat)
explanation_mandarin: 棹艇指以槳（棹）划動的較小船隻，可指單人或多人使用的小艇，亦可泛指划艇這項活動。
explanation_english: A small boat propelled by oars (a rowboat); can refer to single- or multi-person small boats and, sometimes, to the activity of rowing such a boat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下個禮拜會去湖上坐棹艇，欣賞日落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 wui5 heoi3 wu4 soeng6 co5 ziu2 ting5, jan1 soeng2 jat6 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们下个礼拜会去湖上坐棹艇，欣赏日落。
examples.english_sentence: Next week we'll go out on the lake in a rowboat to enjoy the sunset.

mandarin_meaning: 棺（棺材）
english_meaning: coffin; casket
explanation_mandarin: 棺，指用來安放遺體以便下葬或火化的箱子，通常由木材或其他材質製成，有時也稱為棺材或棺槨。
explanation_english: A coffin or casket: a box, typically made of wood or other materials, used to contain a deceased body for burial or cremation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企人已經將遺體放入棺內，準備聽日下葬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei2 jan4 ji5 ging1 zoeng1 wai4 tai2 fong3 jap6 gun1 noi6, zeon2 bei6 ting1 jat6 haa6 zong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家人已經把遺體放入棺內，準備明天下葬。
examples.english_sentence: The family has already placed the body into the coffin, preparing for burial tomorrow.

mandarin_meaning: 棺材（放置遺體以供出殯或下葬用的箱子）
english_meaning: coffin; casket
explanation_mandarin: 棺木指用來放置遺體，在葬禮、出殯或下葬時使用的木製或其他材質的箱子。
explanation_english: A coffin: a box, traditionally wooden, used to hold a corpse for funeral rites or burial.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋訂咗個棺木，下個星期會用嚟出殯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ding6 zo2 go3 gwaan1 muk6, haa6 go3 sing1 kei4 wui5 jung6 lai4 ceot1 ban1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們訂了一口棺材，下個星期會用來出殯。
examples.english_sentence: They ordered a coffin; it will be used for the funeral next week.

mandarin_meaning: 棺材（guān cái）
english_meaning: coffin; casket
explanation_mandarin: 棺材是用來盛放或安葬死者屍體的長方形容器，通常由木材或其他材料製成，常見於喪葬儀式中。
explanation_english: A coffin or casket — a box used to hold a deceased person's body for burial or funeral, typically made of wood or other materials and used in funerary rites.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 棺材係用嚟擺放死者嘅屍體。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwaan1 coi4 hai6 jung6 lai4 baai2 fong3 sei2 ze2 ge3 si1 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 棺材是用來安放死者的屍體。
examples.english_sentence: A coffin is used to hold a deceased person's body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋要訂做一個棺材畀阿媽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jiu3 deng6 zou6 jat1 go3 gwaan1 coi4 bei2 aa3 maa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們要訂做一個棺材給媽媽。
examples.english_sentence: They need to order a coffin for their mother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 葬禮上，棺材會放喺靈堂中央。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zong6 lai5 soeng5, gwaan1 coi4 wui5 fong3 hai2 ling4 tong4 zung1 joeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在葬禮上，棺材會放在靈堂中央。
examples.english_sentence: At the funeral, the coffin is placed at the center of the chapel.

mandarin_meaning: 小棺材；祭祀用的小紙棺；也可指抬棺者（俗稱）
english_meaning: Literally 'little coffin' — a small coffin (often a paper coffin) used as an offering in funerary rituals; can also colloquially refer to a pallbearer (someone who carries a coffin).
explanation_mandarin: 字面上是「小棺材」。在粵語語境中常指祭祀或還願時焚燒的紙製小棺（供亡靈使用），也是口語中可用來稱呼負責抬棺材的人（抬棺者）。此詞帶有殯葬與民俗色彩，使用時常有文化語境限制。
explanation_english: Literally 'little coffin.' In Cantonese usage it commonly denotes small, often paper, coffins burned as offerings or votive items for the deceased. Colloquially it can also refer to a pallbearer (a person who carries a coffin). The term is culturally specific to funeral and ritual contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農曆七月，廟裡有街坊買咗好多棺材仔去燒俾先人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 lik6 cat1 jyut6, miu6 leoi5 jau5 gaai1 fong1 maai5 zo2 hou2 do1 gwaan1 coi4 zai2 heoi3 siu1 bei2 sin1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 農曆七月，廟裡有鄰居買了很多棺材仔去燒給先人。
examples.english_sentence: In the seventh lunar month, neighbors bought many little coffins at the temple to burn for their ancestors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以前做過棺材仔，話抬棺嗰份工又辛苦又唔易做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 cin4 zou6 gwo3 gwaan1 coi4 zai2, waa6 taai1 gwaan1 go2 fan6 gung1 jau6 san1 fu2 jau6 m4 ji6 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以前做過抬棺的人，說抬棺那份工作既辛苦又不容易做。
examples.english_sentence: He used to be a pallbearer; he said carrying coffins was hard work and not easy to do.

mandarin_meaning: 殯葬業者；製棺或負責喪禮事務的人（口語）
english_meaning: undertaker; coffin maker; funeral director (colloquial Cantonese)
explanation_mandarin: 「棺材佬」是廣東話的俗稱或口語，指從事做棺材或辦理殯葬事務的從業人員。語氣較口語化，視語境可中性或略帶俗稱意味。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term for a person who makes coffins or works in the funeral business (undertaker/funeral director). It is informal and can carry a neutral or slightly slangy tone depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企附近有個棺材佬，佢做事好細心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei2 fu6 gan6 jau5 go3 gun1 coi4 lou2, keoi5 zou6 si6 hou2 sai3 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家附近有個殯葬業者，他做事很細心。
examples.english_sentence: There is an undertaker near my home; he is very meticulous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講棺材佬今日好忙，要趕返幾單喪禮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 gong2 gun1 coi4 lou2 gam1 jat6 hou2 mong4, jiu3 gon2 faan1 gei2 daan1 song1 lai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聽說殯葬業者今天很忙，要趕好幾場喪禮。
examples.english_sentence: I heard the undertaker is very busy today and has to rush several funerals.

mandarin_meaning: 棺材房 / 棺材般大小的房間（俗稱，指極為狹小或無窗的居住空間）
english_meaning: coffin room — a very small, coffin-sized living space (slang for extremely cramped or windowless rental room)
explanation_mandarin: 俗稱，指像棺材一樣狹窄或無窗的居住空間，常用來形容劏房、床位或其他極為擠迫的租住單位，帶有貶義，常見於香港社會語境中。
explanation_english: A slang term for an extremely small, coffin-like living space — often windowless or very cramped. Used to describe subdivided flats, tiny cubicles or bedspaces; carries a negative connotation and is common in Hong Kong contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲樓價咁貴，好多人要住入棺材房。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 lau4 gaa3 gam2 gwai3, hou2 do1 jan4 jiu3 zyu6 jap6 gwaan1 coi4 fong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在房價這麼貴，很多人不得不住進棺材房。
examples.english_sentence: With housing prices so high now, many people have no choice but to live in coffin rooms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間屋冇窗又好細，真係似棺材房咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 uk1 mou5 coeng1 jau6 hou2 sai3, zan1 hai6 ci5 gwaan1 coi4 fong4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間房沒有窗又很小，真的像棺材房一樣。
examples.english_sentence: This room has no windows and is very small; it's really like a coffin room.

mandarin_meaning: 棺材本／喪葬費；留作終老或喪葬用的積蓄
english_meaning: Burial fund; savings set aside for funeral expenses or one's last savings (literally 'coffin money')
explanation_mandarin: 俗稱留作喪葬或最後生活費用的積蓄，原指留給下葬用的錢；現亦用來指不應輕易動用的家中積蓄或最後的存款。
explanation_english: A colloquial term for money saved for funeral expenses or one's final savings; literally 'coffin money'. It often refers to family savings or a nest egg that shouldn't be spent recklessly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想亂花我啲棺材本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 lyun6 faa3 ngo5 di1 gwaan1-coi4-bun2
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想亂花我的棺材本。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to waste my burial savings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢筆錢係做棺材本用嘅，唔好亂拎出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bat1 cin2 hai6 zou6 gwaan1-coi4-bun2 jung6 ge3, m4 hou2 lyun6 ling1 ceot1 lai4
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這筆錢是做棺材本用的，不要隨便拿出來。
examples.english_sentence: This sum is meant as a burial fund; don't take it out recklessly.

mandarin_meaning: 棺材的蓋子；（臺灣小吃）棺材板（將厚片吐司挖空後填入濃湯或餡料的料理）
english_meaning: coffin lid; (Taiwanese snack) 'coffin bread' — thick toast hollowed and filled with stew or fillings
explanation_mandarin: 「棺材板」可指棺材上的板蓋；在飲食文化上，特指源自台灣的料理——把厚片吐司挖空或炸脆後，填入濃湯、海鮮或其他配料，外觀形似棺材蓋因此得名。
explanation_english: “棺材板” can mean the lid of a coffin. In culinary context it refers to a Taiwanese dish—thick toast hollowed out (sometimes fried) and filled with thick soup, seafood, or other fillings; its appearance resembles a coffin lid, hence the name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚想食棺材板，聽講嗰間舖好出名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 soeng2 sik6 gun1 coi4 baan2, teng1 gong2 go2 gaan1 pou3 hou2 ceot1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚想吃棺材板，聽說那家店很有名。
examples.english_sentence: I want to eat coffin bread tonight; I heard that shop is famous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 工人小心咁裝好棺材板，避免移位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jan4 siu2 sam1 gam2 zong1 hou2 gun1 coi4 baan2, bei6 min6 ji4 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工人小心地把棺材板安裝好，以免移位。
examples.english_sentence: The workers carefully secured the coffin lid to prevent it from shifting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺夜市買咗個棺材板，入面有濃湯同海鮮，好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 je6 si5 maai5 zo2 go3 gun1 coi4 baan2, jap6 min6 jau5 nung4 tong1 tung4 hoi2 sin1, hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在夜市買了一個棺材板，裡面有濃湯和海鮮，很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a coffin bread at the night market; it had thick soup and seafood inside and was delicious.

mandarin_meaning: 喪事投機者／靠他人喪事牟利的人（貶義）
english_meaning: A derogatory term for someone who profits from others' deaths or who opportunistically hangs around funerals; a funeral profiteer/scavenger.
explanation_mandarin: 俗稱，帶貶義，用來形容那些在喪事或他人不幸時趁機牟利、圍事索取好處或暗中撿便宜的人。
explanation_english: Colloquial, derogatory term used to describe people who take advantage of funerals or others' misfortune to profit, freeload, or gain benefits opportunistically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日去親戚嘅喪禮攞好處，真係棺材老鼠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 heoi3 can1 cik1 ge3 song1 lai5 lo2 hou2 co3, zan1 hai6 gwaan1 coi4 lou5 syu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常去親戚的丧礼拿好处，真是棺材老鼠。
examples.english_sentence: He always goes to relatives' funerals to get benefits — he's really a 'coffin rat'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人靠做喪事生意被人罵做棺材老鼠，但有時只係誤解。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 haau3 zou6 song1 si6 saang1 ji3 bei6 jan4 maa3 zou6 gwaan1 coi4 lou5 syu2, daan6 jau5 si4 zi2 hai6 ng6 gaai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人靠做丧事生意被人骂作棺材老鼠，但有时只是误解。
examples.english_sentence: Some people who work in the funeral business are called 'coffin rats', but sometimes that's just a misunderstanding.

mandarin_meaning: 棺材铺；殡葬行业的店铺或相关场所
english_meaning: coffin shop; a shop that sells coffins (also broadly: funeral-related business/place)
explanation_mandarin: 指專門出售棺材的店鋪；在粵語語境中亦可泛指與喪葬、殯儀相關的行業或場所。
explanation_english: Refers to a shop that sells coffins. In Cantonese usage it can also broadly denote businesses or places related to funerals and burial services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿叔喺棺材舖做嘢，成日接觸喪事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 suk1 hai2 gwaan1 coi4 pou3 zok3 je5, sing4 jat6 zip3 zuk1 song3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 叔叔在棺材铺工作，经常接触丧事。
examples.english_sentence: My uncle works at a coffin shop and often deals with funerals.

mandarin_meaning: 棺材酒店：指房间狭小、像棺材一样的酒店或旅馆，常用于形容胶囊式床位或极为狭窄、压抑的住宿（俚语）。
english_meaning: “coffin hotel” — a slang term for a lodging whose rooms or beds are extremely small and coffin‑like, often referring to capsule-style accommodations or very cramped, run-down hotels.
explanation_mandarin: 口語/俚語，用來形容住宿空間非常狹小或壓抑，房間或床位像棺材一樣，常用於批評廉價、擠迫或改造成膠囊床位的旅館。
explanation_english: A colloquial/slang expression describing lodging with extremely small, coffin-like rooms or beds. Used to criticize cheap, cramped, or capsule-style accommodations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我昨晚住咗間棺材酒店，房間細到連行都唔方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zok6 maan5 zyu6 zo2 gaan1 gwaan1 coi4 zau2 dim3, fong4 gaan1 sai3 dou3 lin4 haang4 dou1 m4 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨晚住了一家棺材酒店，房间小到连走路都不方便。
examples.english_sentence: I stayed in a coffin hotel last night; the room was so small it was even hard to walk around.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲旅館為咗節省空間，改裝成棺材酒店式嘅膠囊床位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 leoi5 gun2 wai4 zo2 zit3 saang2 hung1 gaan1, goi2 zong1 sing4 gwaan1 coi4 zau2 dim3 sik1 ge3 gaau1 nong4 cong4 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些旅馆为了节省空间，改造成棺材酒店式的胶囊床位。
examples.english_sentence: Some inns, to save space, have been converted into coffin‑hotel‑style capsule beds.

jyutping: gun1 coi4 tau4 siu1 paau3 zoeng6
mandarin_meaning: 自找麻烦 / 找死 / 玩命（招惹不必要的危险或不幸）
english_meaning: to tempt fate; to court disaster; to ask for trouble by doing something reckless or provocative
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語。字面意思是「在棺材前燒炮仗」，比喻做出危險、挑釁或不合時宜的行為，像是在招惹不幸，等於自找麻煩或找死。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang phrase literally meaning "lighting firecrackers at the head of a coffin." It figuratively describes doing something reckless, provocative, or ill-timed that invites misfortune — i.e., tempting fate or asking for trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做真係棺材頭燒炮仗，遲早會出事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng6 zou6 zan1 hai6 gun1 coi4 tau4 siu1 paau3 zoeng6, ci4 zou2 wui5 ceot1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么做真是在自找麻烦，迟早会出事。
examples.english_sentence: What you're doing is really tempting fate — sooner or later something bad will happen.

mandarin_meaning: 椅子 (yǐzi)
english_meaning: chair; seat
explanation_mandarin: 表示供人坐的家具，单字“椅”在口語或書面語中常與量詞（如“張”）連用，構成“椅子”等詞。
explanation_english: A piece of furniture for sitting; a chair. The character '椅' is commonly used with classifiers (e.g., '一張椅') and in compounds like '椅子'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張椅好舒服，你坐下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 ji2 hou2 syu1 fuk6, nei5 co5 haa6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这把椅子很舒服，你坐下吧。
examples.english_sentence: This chair is very comfortable; sit down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 會議室嘅椅唔夠，大家要輪住坐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wui6 ji5 sat1 ge3 ji2 m4 gau3, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 leon4 zyu6 co5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 会议室的椅子不够，大家要轮流坐。
examples.english_sentence: There aren't enough chairs in the meeting room; everyone has to take turns sitting.

mandarin_meaning: 椅垫 (yǐdiàn)
english_meaning: chair cushion; seat cushion
explanation_mandarin: 放在椅子上用來增加舒適度或保護椅面的軟墊。
explanation_english: A padded cushion placed on a chair to increase comfort or protect the chair's surface.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗一個新嘅椅墊，坐得舒服啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 go3 san1 ge3 ji2 din6, co5 dak1 syu1 fuk6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一个新的椅垫，坐得更舒服。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a new chair cushion; it's more comfortable to sit on.

mandarin_meaning: 椅子 (yǐzi)
english_meaning: chair
explanation_mandarin: 指供人坐的家具，通常有靠背，有時有座墊或扶手。
explanation_english: A piece of furniture used for sitting, typically with a backrest and sometimes a seat cushion or armrests.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張椅子幾舒服，我一坐低就唔想郁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 ji2 zi2 gei2 syu1 fuk6, ngo5 jat1 co5 dai1 zau6 m4 soeng2 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这把椅子很舒服，我一坐下就不想动。
examples.english_sentence: This chair is very comfortable; once I sit down I don't want to move.

mandarin_meaning: （非標準寫法）依憑；憑藉；作為依據
english_meaning: (nonstandard spelling) to rely on; to be based on; basis/evidence
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 介詞/動詞（非標準用法，對應「憑」或「依憑」）
partOfSpeech_english: preposition/verb (nonstandard usage; corresponds to 'rely on' / 'based on')
explanation_mandarin: 「椅憑」為在書寫上用「椅」代替「依」或「憑」的非標準、口語化寫法，含義與「依憑/憑藉/憑據」相同，用來表示有依據或憑藉。
explanation_english: "椅憑" is a nonstandard/colloquial orthographic variant where the character 椅 (chair) is used in place of 依 or 憑. It carries the same meaning as 依憑/憑藉/憑據 — to rely on, to be based on, or a basis/evidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你冇任何椅憑就唔好亂指責人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 mou5 jam6 ho4 ji2 ping4 zau6 m4 hou2 lyun6 zi2 zaak3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你沒有任何依憑就不要亂指責人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't accuse someone without any basis/evidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告嘅結論有足夠嘅椅憑支持。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 git3 leon6 jau5 zuk1 gau3 ge3 ji2 ping4 zi1 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這份報告的結論有足夠的依憑支持。
examples.english_sentence: The conclusion of this report is supported by sufficient evidence.

mandarin_meaning: 佔位者；替人佔座位的人
english_meaning: seat-saver; a person who saves a seat for someone else
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語／俚語，通常指替朋友或同伴佔座位或放物品保留座位的人（例如在食堂、影院或活動現場）。偶爾也用作自嘲或戲稱某人替他人看位。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang term for a person who saves a seat or holds a place for someone else (for example in a canteen, cinema, or event). It can be used literally or jokingly to describe someone acting as a seat-holder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你等陣我幫你做椅手，去買嘢快啲返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dang2 zan6 ngo5 bong1 nei5 zou6 ji2 sau2, heoi3 maai5 je5 faai3 di1 faan1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等一下我幫你佔位，去買東西快點回來。
examples.english_sentence: Wait a moment — I'll save you a seat. Go buy something and come back quickly.

mandarin_meaning: （不常用）可能指椅套或椅罩，用來覆蓋或保護椅子的布或罩子
english_meaning: (rare/colloquial) likely 'chair cover' — a fabric cover or protective cover for a chair
explanation_mandarin: 「椅披」並非標準或常見的詞彙，可能是地區性或口語用法，用來表示「椅套、椅罩」；標準用法通常說「椅套」或「椅罩」。
explanation_english: “椅披” is not a standard or widely used term; it appears to be a regional/colloquial expression likely meaning a chair cover (椅套/椅罩). The common standard terms are “椅套” or “椅罩”.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張椅要套個椅披先唔會污糟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 ji2 jiu3 tou3 go3 ji2 pei1 sin1 m4 wui5 wu1 zou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这把椅子要套个椅披才不会弄脏。
examples.english_sentence: This chair needs a chair cover so it won't get dirty.

mandarin_meaning: （網絡/口語）一起嘗試／較量（為「一拼」的變體）
english_meaning: Colloquial/internet variant of '一拼' — to give it a try together; to compete or have a go
explanation_mandarin: 「椅拼」是粵語網絡或口語用法，字面用了「椅」作替代，實際讀作與「一拼」相同，用來表示大家一起嘗試、合力一試或彼此較量。
explanation_english: “椅拼” is a Cantonese internet/colloquial writing variant that plays on the word “一拼”. It’s used to mean joining in to try something together, having a go, or competing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係等，椅拼啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 dang2, jat1 ping3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只是等着，大家一起試試吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't just wait around — let's give it a try together!

mandarin_meaning: 橫坐（占兩個或多個座位）／霸位
english_meaning: to sit crosswise/hog seats (taking up more than one seat)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，指在公共場所（如港鐵、巴士）側向或橫向坐，佔用多個座位，令人不便或惹人不滿。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquialism meaning to sit sideways or crosswise in public (e.g., on the MTR or bus), occupying more than one seat and inconveniencing others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺港鐵度唔好椅橫，會惹人唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gong2 tit3 dou6 m4 hou2 ji2 wong4, wui5 je5 jan4 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在地鐵上不要橫坐，會惹人生氣。
examples.english_sentence: Don't sit crosswise on the MTR; it will upset people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日椅橫，霸住兩個位，其他人要企喺旁邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 ji2 wong4, baa3 zyu6 loeng5 go3 wai6, kei4 taa1 jan4 jiu3 kei5 hai2 pong4 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他常常橫坐，霸佔兩個座位，其他人要站在旁邊。
examples.english_sentence: He often sits crosswise, hogging two seats, and others have to stand beside him.

mandarin_meaning: 字面：椅子上的籠／籃；（粵語罕見、地區用語或口語）可能指放在椅子下或椅子上的儲物籃／籠子
english_meaning: Literal: a cage/basket associated with a chair; (rare/regional Cantonese) likely refers to a storage basket/cage attached to or placed under a chair
explanation_mandarin: 「椅籠」在廣東話中並非常見詞彙，多數按字面理解為與椅子有關的籠或籃，用來放置雜物或作為保護、固定功能。某些地區或語境下可指椅子下方的儲物格或固定的籠狀結構。
explanation_english: “椅籠” is an uncommon Cantonese term. Taken literally it means a cage or basket related to a chair, used for storing miscellaneous items or as a protective/fixing structure. In some regional contexts it may refer to a storage compartment beneath a chair or a cage-like attachment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啲雜物放咗喺椅籠度，等陣再拎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 di1 zaap6 mat6 fong3 zo2 hai2 ji2 lung4 dou6, dang2 zan6 zoi6 ling1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的杂物放在椅籠里，等一下再拿。
examples.english_sentence: I put my miscellaneous items in the chair basket; I'll take them later.

mandarin_meaning: 椅脚（yǐjiǎo）
english_meaning: chair leg; the leg(s) of a chair
explanation_mandarin: 椅子下方用來支撐整張椅子的部分，通常指單隻或多隻椅腿。
explanation_english: The leg(s) of a chair — the parts beneath a chair that support it. Can refer to one leg or multiple legs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張椅嘅椅腳唔穩，坐落去會搖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 ji2 ge3 ji2 goek3 m4 wan2, co5 lok6 heoi3 wui5 jiu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这把椅子的椅脚不稳，坐下去会摇。
examples.english_sentence: The legs of this chair are unstable; it'll rock if you sit down.

mandarin_meaning: 重重地坐下 / 撲通一坐
english_meaning: to plop or flop down heavily into a chair/sofa
explanation_mandarin: 口語、俗語用法，形容人疲倦或懶散時重重地坐下、撲通一屁股坐在椅子或梳化上。
explanation_english: Colloquial/slang term describing the action of plopping or flopping down heavily into a chair or sofa, often from tiredness or laziness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一返到屋企就椅𩩍喺梳化度，唔肯起身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2 zau6 ji2 ngaap6 hai2 so1 faa3 dou6, m4 hang2 hei2 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一回到家就重重地一屁股坐在沙發上，不肯起身。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as he got home he plopped down on the sofa and wouldn't get up.

mandarin_meaning: 植（zhí）— 种植、栽种；将物体或器官植入体内（如植牙、植入）；常见于复合词中
english_meaning: to plant; to implant; to graft; used in compounds like 'planting', 'implantation'
explanation_mandarin: 表示把植物栽种或把某物/器官安置、植入到另一处（例如植树、植入、植牙、植物等词语中常见）。
explanation_english: Verb meaning to plant or to implant something. Frequently appears in compounds such as '植树' (plant trees), '植入' (implant), '植牙' (dental implant), and '植物' (plant).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今日去植樹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 heoi3 zik6 syu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今天去植树。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to plant trees today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生建議幫佢植牙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 gin3 ji3 bong1 keoi5 zik6 ngaa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生建议帮他植牙。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor recommended doing a dental implant for him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 工程師將新元件植入電路板。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 cing4 si1 zoeng1 san1 jyun4 gin6 zik6 jap6 din6 lou6 baan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工程师将新元件植入电路板。
examples.english_sentence: The engineer implanted the new component into the circuit board.

mandarin_meaning: 植入（把某物插入或安置到另一個體內或系統中）
english_meaning: to implant; to insert or embed (an organ, device, idea, or component into a body or system)
explanation_mandarin: 表示把某樣東西（例如器官、人工裝置、軟件模組或想法）放入或安置到另一個人體、系統或結構內。常見於醫療（植入器官）、科技（植入功能）或比喻（植入觀念）的用法。
explanation_english: Indicates placing or embedding something (such as an organ, artificial device, software module, or idea) into another body, system, or structure. Commonly used in medical (implanting devices), technological (embedding features), or figurative (instilling ideas) contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話要喺佢身體裏面植入人工心臟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 jiu3 hai2 keoi5 san1 tai2 leoi5 min6 zik6 jap6 jan4 gung1 sam1 zong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说要在他/她身体里面植入人工心脏。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said they need to implant an artificial heart into his/her body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個廣告好似想喺你腦入面植入一啲消費念頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gwong2 gou3 hou2 ci5 soeng2 hai2 nei5 nou5 jap6 min6 zik6 jap6 jat1 di1 siu1 fai3 nim6 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个广告好像想在你脑子里植入一些消费念头。
examples.english_sentence: This advertisement seems to try to implant some consumerist ideas in your mind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司決定將新嘅功能植入現有系統。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 zoeng1 san1 ge3 gung1 nang4 zik6 jap6 jin6 jau5 hai6 tung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司决定将新的功能植入现有系统。
examples.english_sentence: The company decided to embed the new feature into the existing system.

mandarin_meaning: 植入式广告 (zhírùshì guǎnggào)
english_meaning: embedded advertising / product placement
explanation_mandarin: 指將商品、品牌或廣告元素自然地融入電影、電視劇、綜藝或其他內容中的廣告形式，而非以獨立廣告時段插播的方式出現。
explanation_english: An advertising method where products or brands are integrated naturally into media content (films, TV shows, variety programs, etc.) instead of appearing as separate commercial breaks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套劇入面有好多植入式廣告，成日見到嗰啲牌子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 kek6 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 zaak6 jap6 sik1 gwong2 gou3, sing4 jat6 gin3 dou3 go2 di1 paai4 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這套劇裡有很多植入式廣告，經常看到那些品牌。
examples.english_sentence: There are a lot of product placements in this drama; you often see those brands.

mandarin_meaning: 排字；排版（在印刷或出版中將文字編排到版面上）
english_meaning: typesetting; to set type; arranging text into a layout for printing or publication
explanation_mandarin: 在印刷、設計或出版領域，指把文字輸入並編排到版面上以便印刷或出版的工序（即排版）。
explanation_english: In printing, design, or publishing, refers to the process of inputting and arranging text into a layout for printing or publication (i.e., typesetting).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份傳單係我哋公司植字、排版同埋印刷嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 cyun4 daan1 hai6 ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 zik6 zi6, paai4 baan2 tung4 maai4 jan3 sat3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這份傳單是我們公司負責植字、排版和印刷的。
examples.english_sentence: This leaflet was typeset, laid out, and printed by our company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做雜誌要花好多時間植字同校對。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 zaap6 zi3 jiu3 faa1 hou2 do1 si4 gaan3 zik6 zi6 tung4 haau6 deoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 製作雜誌要花很多時間進行植字和校對。
examples.english_sentence: Producing a magazine takes a lot of time for typesetting and proofreading.

mandarin_meaning: 紮根；根植於（某地或某事物）
english_meaning: to take root; to be rooted in; to become firmly established
explanation_mandarin: 表示在某地或某事物中穩固地生根，比喻思想、制度、觀念或做法長期紮根並持續存在。
explanation_english: Indicates becoming firmly rooted in a place or context; metaphorically used for ideas, practices, or institutions that become well established and persist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間社區中心嘅服務已經深深植根喺社區入面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 se5 keoi1 zung1 sam1 ge3 fuk6 mou6 ji5 ging1 sam1 sam1 zik6 gan1 hai2 se5 keoi1 jap6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間社區中心的服務已經深深根植於社區之中。
examples.english_sentence: The services of this community center have become deeply rooted in the community.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲價值觀已經植根喺我哋嘅文化度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 gaa3 zik6 gun1 ji5 ging1 zik6 gan1 hai2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 man4 faa3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些價值觀已經根植於我們的文化中。
examples.english_sentence: These values have already taken root in our culture.

mandarin_meaning: 植物
english_meaning: plants; vegetation
explanation_mandarin: 泛指所有植物的總稱，包括草、樹、花等植物生物。
explanation_english: A general term for plant life, including grasses, trees, flowers, and other plant organisms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企擺多啲植物可以改善空氣質素。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei5 baai2 do1 di1 zik6 mat6 ho2 ji5 goi2 sin6 hung1 hei3 zat1 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在家裡擺放多些植物可以改善空氣質量。
examples.english_sentence: Having more plants at home can improve air quality.

mandarin_meaning: 植物人（指處於植物狀態的患者）
english_meaning: vegetative patient; person in a vegetative state
explanation_mandarin: 醫學術語，指處於植物狀態的患者（醒著但喪失意識或對外界無持續反應），在口語中也可用來形容毫無反應或精神恍惚的人。
explanation_english: A medical term for a person in a vegetative state (awake but lacking awareness or sustained responses). Colloquially, it can also describe someone who is unresponsive or mentally zoned out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢變咗植物人，要長期照顧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 bin3 zo2 zik6 mat6 jan4, jiu3 coeng4 kei4 ziu3 gu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他变成了植物人，需要长期照顾。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said he became a vegetative patient and needs long-term care.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排返工返到好似植物人咁，完全冇精神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 faan1 gung1 faan1 dou3 hou2 ci5 zik6 mat6 jan4 gam2, jyun4 cyun4 mou5 zing1 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近上班回來好像植物人一樣，完全沒有精神。
examples.english_sentence: Lately I've been coming home from work like a vegetable, totally exhausted and without energy.

mandarin_meaning: 植皮（皮膚移植）
english_meaning: skin graft (to transplant skin)
explanation_mandarin: 指將皮膚從身體某處移植到另一處的醫療手術，常用於燒傷或大面積皮膚缺損的修復。
explanation_english: A medical procedure in which skin is transplanted from one part of the body to another, commonly used to repair burns or large skin defects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話要替佢植皮，先可以覆蓋返嗰度嘅傷口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 jiu3 tai3 keoi5 zik6 pei4, sin1 ho2 ji5 fuk1 gwat3 faan1 go2 dou6 ge3 soeng1 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说要给他植皮，才能覆盖那里的伤口。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said he needs a skin graft to cover that wound.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗植皮手術，而家仲喺病房復原緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 zik6 pei4 sau2 seot6, ji4 gaa1 zung6 hai6 beng6 fong4 fuk6 jyun4 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了植皮手术，现在还在病房恢复。
examples.english_sentence: He had a skin graft operation and is currently recovering in the ward.

mandarin_meaning: 植被（zhíbèi）：地表的植物覆蓋或植物群落。
english_meaning: Vegetation; the plant cover or plant community on the ground.
explanation_mandarin: 指生長在某一區域、覆蓋地表的各種植物總稱，常用於描述生態、土地保護與環境狀況。
explanation_english: Refers to all the plants growing in a particular area that cover the ground; commonly used when describing ecology, land protection, and environmental conditions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 山坡嘅植被一旦被破壞，就好容易出現水土流失。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saan1 bo1 ge3 zik6 bei6 jat1 daan6 bei6 po3 waai6, zau6 hou2 jung4 ji6 ceot1 jin6 seoi2 tou2 lau4 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 山坡的植被一旦被破坏，就很容易出现水土流失。
examples.english_sentence: If the vegetation on the hillside is destroyed, soil erosion easily occurs.

mandarin_meaning: 植发
english_meaning: hair transplant; hair implantation
explanation_mandarin: 指將毛囊或頭髮移植到頭皮上以改善脫髮或禿頭的醫療或美容手術。
explanation_english: Refers to the medical or cosmetic procedure of transplanting hair follicles or hair to the scalp to treat hair loss or baldness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為嚴重禿頭決定去植髮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 jim4 zung6 tuk1 tau4 kyut3 ding6 heoi3 zik6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為嚴重禿頭決定去植發。
examples.english_sentence: He decided to get a hair transplant because of severe baldness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個朋友上個禮拜返嚟話佢做咗植髮，效果幾好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 pang4 jau5 soeng6 go3 lai5 baai3 faan1 lai4 waa6 keoi5 zou6 zo2 zik6 faat3, haau6 gwo2 gei2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的朋友上個禮拜回來說他做了植發，效果還不錯。
examples.english_sentence: My friend came back last week and said he had a hair transplant; the results were pretty good.

mandarin_meaning: 椎（zhuī）：椎骨（如頸椎、脊椎）；（古或方言）敲打、捶打
english_meaning: vertebra (e.g., cervical vertebra); (archaic/colloquial) to beat/strike
explanation_mandarin: 「椎」常用於解剖學上指構成脊柱的椎骨，如頸椎、脊椎；在古代或某些方言中也可作動詞，表示用棍或棒敲打、捶打。
explanation_english: The character refers to a vertebra (a bone of the spine), as in cervical vertebra or spinal vertebra. In older or dialectal usage it can also be a verb meaning to strike or pound with a club or mallet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢頸椎有問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 geng2 zeoi1 jau5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他颈椎有问题。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said he has a problem with his cervical vertebra.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搬重嘢要小心，唔好傷到脊椎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun1 zung6 je5 jiu3 siu2 sam1, m4 hou2 soeng1 dou3 zik6 zeoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搬重物要小心，不要伤到脊椎。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful when lifting heavy items; don't injure your spine.

mandarin_meaning: 椎心泣血（形容极度悲痛，像心被刺穿、痛到流血）
english_meaning: to be heartbroken/heart-rending; to grieve intensely (literally: pierce the heart and weep blood)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語（可作形容詞或動詞用）
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容極度悲痛、哀傷，痛苦深切，彷彿心被刺穿並流血。常用以表達對不幸事件或遭遇的強烈悲憤或同情。
explanation_english: Describes extreme sorrow or grief so intense it feels as if the heart is pierced and bleeding. Often used to convey deep heartbreak, anguish, or profound pity for tragic events or suffering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇到嗰啲受害者嘅遭遇，真係令人椎心泣血。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 dou3 go2 di1 sau6 hoi6 ze2 ge3 zou1 jyu6, zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 zeoi1 sam1 kap1 hyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到那些受害者的遭遇，真令人椎心泣血。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing the victims' plight is truly heart-wrenching.

mandarin_meaning: 树枝分叉处；枝叉（如“椏枝”、“椏叉”）
english_meaning: a forked branch; the place where a tree branch splits
explanation_mandarin: “椏”指树木枝条分叉的部位，常见于书面或植物学用语，可与“枝”、“叉”结合成“椏枝”、“椏叉”等词。
explanation_english: “椏” denotes the forked part of a tree branch where it splits; used in written or botanical contexts and appears in compounds like '椏枝' or '椏叉'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 果樹個椏枝太長，要修剪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwo2 syu6 go3 aa3 zi1 taai3 coeng4, jiu3 sau1 zim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 果树的椏枝太长，需要修剪。
examples.english_sentence: The fruit tree's forked branch is too long and needs pruning.

mandarin_meaning: 枝叉；樹枝分岔的部位
english_meaning: a forked branch; the branching part of a tree
explanation_mandarin: 指樹木上分叉的枝條或分岔部位。此詞偏書面或方言用法，也可泛指任何分叉的部分。
explanation_english: Refers to the forked parts of a tree (branch forks) or any branching/forked part. The term is somewhat dialectal/literary and used as a noun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰棵樹嘅椏杈好茂密，唔啱爬上去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 fo1 syu6 ge3 aa3 caa1 hou2 mau6 mat6, m4 aam1 paa4 soeng5 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那棵樹的枝杈很茂密，不適合爬上去。
examples.english_sentence: The tree's branches are very dense; it's not suitable to climb up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路爬樹嗰陣要小心椏杈，唔好畀手滑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 paa4 syu6 go2 zan6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 aa3 caa1, m4 hou2 bei2 sau2 waat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子爬樹時要小心枝杈，別讓手滑掉下來。
examples.english_sentence: When kids climb trees, be careful of the branches; don't let your hand slip.

mandarin_meaning: 椒（如辣椒、花椒）——指各類可用作調味的椒類植物
english_meaning: pepper (e.g., chili pepper or Sichuan pepper)
explanation_mandarin: 「椒」常指可用來調味的椒類，如辣椒（增加辛辣）或花椒（帶麻香），可單獨使用或作為複合詞的一部分。
explanation_english: ‘椒’ refers to pepper plants used as spices, such as chili peppers (adding heat) or Sichuan (flower) pepper (adding a numbing aroma). It appears alone or in compound words.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 煲湯記住加啲椒，會有好嘅香味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou1 tong1 gei3 zyu6 gaa1 di1 ziu1, wui5 jau5 hou2 ge3 hoeng1 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 煲汤记得加点椒，会有很香的味道。
examples.english_sentence: When cooking soup, remember to add some pepper; it will give a nice aroma.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢碟菜用咗好多花椒同辣椒，味道好麻好辣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dip6 coi3 jung6 zo2 hou2 do1 faa1 ziu1 tung4 laat6 ziu1, mei6 dou6 hou2 maa4 hou2 laat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这道菜用了很多花椒和辣椒，味道很麻很辣。
examples.english_sentence: This dish uses a lot of Sichuan pepper and chili pepper; it's numbing and spicy.

mandarin_meaning: 椒盐（调味料）；指椒盐口味或以椒盐烹调的菜式
english_meaning: salt and pepper (seasoning); salt-and-pepper flavor or dishes prepared with it
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词（调味料 / 口味 / 菜名）
explanation_mandarin: 指由胡椒和盐组成的调味料，也用来表示带有这种调味的口味或菜式，比如“椒盐排骨”“椒盐虾”等。
explanation_english: A seasoning made from salt and ground pepper; also denotes a salt-and-pepper flavor or dishes cooked with that seasoning (e.g., salt-and-pepper ribs, shrimp).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個椒鹽雞翼好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ziu1 jim4 gai1 jik6 hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这道椒盐鸡翅很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: These salt-and-pepper chicken wings are delicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你鍾意椒鹽定係黑椒口味？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung1 ji3 ziu1 jim4 ding6 hai6 hak1 ziu1 hau2 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你喜欢椒盐还是黑椒口味？
examples.english_sentence: Do you prefer salt-and-pepper or black-pepper flavor?

mandarin_meaning: 木製門閂；用來閂門的木條（古或方言用詞）
english_meaning: wooden door bolt / latch (a wooden bar used to secure a door; archaic/dialectal)
explanation_mandarin: 椗為一較少見的漢字，常見於古文或方言語境，指用來閂門或固定門扇的木製閂條。現代漢語中較少使用，屬於方言或古語詞彙。
explanation_english: 椗 is a rare/archaic character, typically found in classical texts or dialects. It denotes a wooden bolt or latch used to secure a door. It is uncommon in modern standard Chinese and mainly appears in regional or historical contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆話以前屋企都用椗嚟閂門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 waa6 ji5 cin4 uk1 kei2 dou1 jung6 ding1 lai4 saan1 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶說以前家裡都用木椗來閂門。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma said that in the past households used wooden latches to bolt the door.

mandarin_meaning: 拟声词，模仿一连串敲击或碰撞的声音；口语用来形容喧闹、嘈杂或混乱的场面。
english_meaning: An onomatopoeic expression mimicking a series of banging/clattering sounds; used to describe a noisy commotion or chaotic racket.
explanation_mandarin: 「椗呤鄧㨢」並非正式書面詞彙，而是以漢字拼寫出的廣東話擬聲詞，常用於口語或俚語語境，用來描寫多重撞擊、敲擊或雜亂的聲響，亦可引申指場面熱鬧或混亂。
explanation_english: “椗呤鄧㨢” is an informal, written representation of Cantonese onomatopoeia. It imitates a sequence of thuds, tings, bangs and pops and is used colloquially to describe loud, clattering noises or a chaotic/noisy situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隔離屋成晚都係椗呤鄧㨢，我訓唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaak3 lei4 uk1 sing4 maan5 dou1 hai6 dung1 ling4 dang6 paak3, ngo5 fan3 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 隔壁家整晚都是椗呤鄧㨢，我睡不著。
examples.english_sentence: The neighbors were making a racket all night — dung ling dang paak — I couldn't sleep.

mandarin_meaning: 擬聲詞，形容連串敲打、碰撞或雜亂作響的聲音；也可比喻場面混亂或嘈雜。
english_meaning: An onomatopoeic expression mimicking a series of clattering/banging noises; can also figuratively describe a chaotic or noisy situation.
explanation_mandarin: 「椗呤鄧掕」通常用作擬聲詞，模仿碗碟碰撞、東西掉落或機器雜響等連續的叩擊聲，也可形容現場嘈雜、雜亂無章。
explanation_english: Used as an onomatopoeic expression to imitate continuous clattering sounds (e.g., plates crashing, things falling, machinery rattling). It can also be used metaphorically to describe a noisy, chaotic scene.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲杯碟跌落嚟，椗呤鄧掕，嚇親我一跳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 bui1 dip6 dit3 lok6 lai4, dung2 ling4 dang6 loeng6, haak3 can1 ngo5 jat1 tiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 杯碟掉下來，叮噹作響，把我嚇了一跳。
examples.english_sentence: The cups and plates fell and clattered — it startled me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搬運嗰陣大家手忙腳亂，椗呤鄧掕，成間屋都亂晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan1 wan6 go2 zan6 daai6 gaa1 sau2 mong4 goek3 lyun6, dung2 ling4 dang6 loeng6, sing4 gaan1 uk1 dou1 lyun6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搬運的時候大家手忙腳亂，叮噹作響，整間屋都亂掉了。
examples.english_sentence: While moving things everyone was in a flap and there was a lot of clattering — the whole room ended up a mess.

mandarin_meaning: 椰子（或椰子樹）
english_meaning: coconut (the fruit) / coconut tree
explanation_mandarin: 指椰子或椰子樹，椰子的果肉可食用，椰汁可飲用，常見於熱帶地區。
explanation_english: Refers to the coconut (the fruit) or the coconut tree. The coconut's flesh is edible and its juice is drinkable; commonly found in tropical regions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗個椰青嚟飲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 go3 je4 cing1 lai4 jam2
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我買了一個青椰子來喝。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a young coconut to drink.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天飲椰汁好清涼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 jam2 je4 zap1 hou2 cing1 loeng4
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天喝椰子汁很清涼。
examples.english_sentence: Drinking coconut juice is refreshing in summer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰棵椰子樹好高，已經有好多年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 fo1 je4 zi2 syu6 hou2 gou1, ji5 ging1 jau5 hou2 do1 nin4
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那棵椰子樹很高，已經有很多年了。
examples.english_sentence: That coconut tree is very tall; it's been there for many years.

mandarin_meaning: 椰奶
english_meaning: coconut milk
explanation_mandarin: 由椰肉榨出來的白色液體，常用於烹飪、甜品和飲品，與椰子水不同，較濃稠且含油脂。
explanation_english: A white liquid extracted from grated coconut meat, commonly used in cooking, desserts, and drinks. It is different from coconut water and is thicker and oilier.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想買一罐椰奶嚟煮咖哩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 jat1 gun3 je4 naai5 lai4 zyu2 gaa3 lei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想買一罐椰奶來煮咖喱。
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy a can of coconut milk to cook curry.

mandarin_meaning: 椰子（yēzi）
english_meaning: coconut (the fruit of the coconut palm)
explanation_mandarin: 椰子是棕榈科椰子树结出的热带水果，可饮用椰汁、食用椰肉，壳和纤维也有多种用途。
explanation_english: A coconut is the fruit of the coconut palm, common in tropical regions. It yields coconut water and coconut meat; its shell and fibers are also used for various purposes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺街市買咗個椰子，打開嚟飲椰汁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 gaai1 si5 maai5 zo2 go3 je4 zi2, daa2 hoi1 lai4 jam2 je4 zap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在街市買了一個椰子，打開來喝椰子汁。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a coconut at the market and opened it to drink the coconut water.

mandarin_meaning: 椰子壳 (yēzi ké)：椰子的外层坚硬部分
english_meaning: coconut shell — the hard outer shell of a coconut
explanation_mandarin: 指椰子的坚硬外壳，常用作燃料、容器或手工材料。
explanation_english: Refers to the hard outer shell of a coconut; commonly used as fuel, containers, or craft material.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋用椰子殼做燃料，燒爐同燒造花園用嘅炭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jung6 je4 zi2 hok3 zou6 jan4 liu6, siu1 lou4 tung4 siu1 zou6 faa1 jyun4 jung6 ge3 taan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们用椰子壳当燃料，烧炉和做园艺用的炭。
examples.english_sentence: They use coconut shells as fuel, burning them for stoves and charcoal for gardening.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲椰子殼可以整成手工藝品，例如小碗或者花盆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 je4 zi2 hok3 ho2 ji5 zing2 seng4 sau2 gung1 ngai6 ban2, lai6 jyu4 siu2 wun2 waak6 ze2 faa1 pun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些椰子壳可以做成手工艺品，例如小碗或者花盆。
examples.english_sentence: These coconut shells can be made into handicrafts, such as small bowls or plant pots.

mandarin_meaning: 椰子挞（椰蓉挞），一种以椰子馅为主的挞类或酥皮糕点
english_meaning: coconut tart (a tart/pastry filled with shredded coconut or coconut filling)
explanation_mandarin: 椰撻是香港及粤港澳地区常见的一种点心或糕点，通常为酥皮或挞皮，内部填有椰蓉、椰奶或甜椰子馅，常作为下午茶或面包店的售卖品。
explanation_english: A coconut tart commonly found in Hong Kong and surrounding regions: a tart or pastry with a crisp crust filled with shredded coconut, coconut milk, or a sweet coconut filling. Often eaten as a snack or with afternoon tea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間麵包店個椰撻好好味，酥皮又香又脆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 min6 baau1 dim3 go3 je4 taat3 hou2 hou2 mei6, sou1 pei4 jau6 hoeng1 jau6 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间面包店的椰子挞很好吃，酥皮又香又脆。
examples.english_sentence: The coconut tarts at this bakery are delicious—the crust is fragrant and crispy.

mandarin_meaning: 椰果（椰子果冻，即 nata de coco）
english_meaning: nata de coco; coconut jelly (chewy coconut gel used in desserts and drinks)
explanation_mandarin: 由椰子水發酵凝固製成的透明、彈牙的果凍狀食材，常用於甜品、飲品或罐頭中。
explanation_english: A translucent, chewy jelly made from fermented coconut water (nata de coco); commonly used in desserts, drinks, and canned fruit mixes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意喺奶茶入面加椰果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 hai2 naai5 caa4 jap6 min6 gaa1 je4 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢在奶茶里加椰果。
examples.english_sentence: I like to add nata de coco to milk tea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲椰果好彈牙，配埋水果好正。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 je4 gwo2 hou2 daan6 ngaa4, pui3 maai4 seoi2 gwo2 hou2 zeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些椰果很有嚼劲，配上水果很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The nata de coco is very chewy and tastes great with fruit.

mandarin_meaning: 椰子壳
english_meaning: coconut shell
explanation_mandarin: 指椰子外面的硬殼。除字面意思外，有時也可比喻堅硬的外表或空殼狀態，但此為延伸用法，並非固定俚語。
explanation_english: Refers to the hard outer shell of a coconut. Besides the literal meaning, it can be used metaphorically to describe a hard exterior or an empty shell, though that is an extended (not fixed slang) usage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲椰殼可以用嚟做花盆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 je4 hok3 ho2 ji5 jung6 lai4 zou6 faa1 pun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些椰壳可以用来做花盆。
examples.english_sentence: These coconut shells can be used as flower pots.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用椰殼盛住湯，感覺幾特別。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 je4 hok3 sing4 zyu6 tong1, gam2 gok3 gei2 dak6 bit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用椰壳盛着汤，感觉很特别。
examples.english_sentence: He serves the soup in a coconut shell; it feels quite special.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢外表好硬，好似椰殼咁，但內裏幾軟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngoi6 biu2 hou2 ngaang6, hou2 ci5 je4 hok3 gam2, daan6 noi6 leoi5 gei2 jyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他外表很硬，好像椰壳一样，但里面很软。
examples.english_sentence: He looks tough on the outside like a coconut shell, but is soft inside.

mandarin_meaning: 椰殼頭（俚語），指像椰子殼一樣圓形且剃得很短的髮型，類似平頭或光頭
english_meaning: Coconut-shell head (slang) — a very short, rounded haircut or shaved head resembling a coconut shell; similar to a crew cut or bald head
explanation_mandarin: 香港口語俚語，用來形容一種圓形且剃得很短的髮型，往往類似平頭或接近光頭。用於描述髮型或戲謔他人的外貌，有時帶貶義或玩笑性質。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong colloquial slang term for a rounded, very short haircut that looks like a coconut shell. It is similar to a crew cut or shaved head. Used to describe someone's hairstyle or to tease/make fun of someone's appearance; can be pejorative or playful depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢剪咗個椰殼頭，睇落精神晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zin2 zo2 go3 je4 hok3 tau4, tai2 lok6 zing1 san4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他剪了個椰殼頭，看起來很精神。
examples.english_sentence: He got a coconut-shell haircut; he looks really lively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好笑佢個椰殼頭，佢就係鍾意咁樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 siu3 keoi5 go3 je4 hok3 tau4, keoi5 zau6 hai6 zung1 ji3 gam2 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別笑他的椰殼頭，他就是喜歡這樣。
examples.english_sentence: Don't laugh at his coconut-head haircut; he just likes it that way.

mandarin_meaning: 椰子水 / 椰汁（可互換，但椰奶不同）
english_meaning: coconut water (the clear liquid inside a young coconut)
explanation_mandarin: 指椰子內部的清液，常作為飲料飲用。與椰奶（椰汁經濃縮或加入果肉）不同，椰水較清爽、含電解質，適合補充水分。
explanation_english: Refers to the clear liquid found inside a coconut, commonly consumed as a beverage. Different from coconut milk (which is thicker); coconut water is light, hydrating, and contains electrolytes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想買一罐椰水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 jat1 gun3 je4 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想買一罐椰子水。
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy a can of coconut water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天飲冷椰水幾舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 jam2 laang5 je4 seoi2 gei2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天喝冰椰子水很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: Drinking chilled coconut water in summer is very refreshing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢樽椰水係新鮮嘅，唔好放耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zeon1 je4 seoi2 hai6 san1 sin1 ge3, m4 hou2 fong3 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這瓶椰子水很新鮮，不要放太久。
examples.english_sentence: This bottle of coconut water is fresh; don't leave it for too long.

mandarin_meaning: 椰子汁；椰奶（從椰子中榨取的液體）
english_meaning: coconut juice / coconut milk (liquid extracted from a coconut)
explanation_mandarin: 從椰子中榨出的液體，可指清爽的椰子水或較濃稠的椰奶，常用作飲品或烹調材料。
explanation_english: Liquid extracted from a coconut; can refer to clear coconut water or the thicker coconut milk. Commonly used as a beverage or a cooking ingredient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想買罐椰汁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 gun3 je4 zap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想買罐椰汁。
