explanation_english: “橕” is a rare character that refers to a small wooden peg or stump — a short wooden post used for support or driven into the ground. It is uncommon in modern Mandarin and Cantonese and is usually replaced by words like “樁” or “柱”.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用條橕固定住個籬笆嘅底部。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 tiu4 dang3 gwat1 ding6 zyu6 go3 lei4 baa1 ge3 dai2 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用一根木樁把籬笆底部固定住。
examples.english_sentence: He used a wooden peg to secure the bottom of the fence.

mandarin_meaning: 橘（橘子）；柑橘類，亦可指橘色
english_meaning: tangerine/mandarin (a citrus fruit); can also refer to the color orange (orangish)
explanation_mandarin: 指柑橘類水果，常指橘子（小型甜柑），在某些語境下也可用來表示顏色（橘色）。
explanation_english: Refers to a citrus fruit, especially tangerines/mandarins; in some contexts it can also denote the color orange.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢籃橘好新鮮，啱晒冬天食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 laam4 gwat1 hou2 san1 sin1, ngaam1 saai3 dung1 tin1 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这筐橘子很新鲜，很适合冬天吃。
examples.english_sentence: This basket of tangerines is very fresh — perfect for eating in winter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢著咗件橘色外套，好搶眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 zo2 gin6 gwat1 sik1 ngoi6 tou3, hou2 coeng2 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她穿了橘色外套，很醒目。
examples.english_sentence: They wore an orange coat; it's very eye-catching.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽話買橘子有益健康，咁我就買咗幾個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 waa6 maai5 gwat1 zi2 jau5 jik1 gin6 hong1, gam2 ngo5 zau6 maai5 zo2 gei2 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈说买橘子有益健康，所以我就买了几个。
examples.english_sentence: My mom said buying tangerines is good for health, so I bought a few.

mandarin_meaning: 橙子（水果）；橙色（顏色）
english_meaning: orange (the fruit); orange (the color)
explanation_mandarin: 指一種柑橘類水果（橙子），亦可指顏色（橙色）。在廣東話中「橙」可單獨用來表示果實或顏色。
explanation_english: Refers to the citrus fruit (orange) and can also denote the color orange. In Cantonese, '橙' is used for both the fruit and the color.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗兩個橙，今晚可以榨橙汁飲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 loeng5 go3 caang4, gam1 maan5 ho2 ji5 zaa3 caang4 zap1 jam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了两个橙子，今晚可以榨橙汁喝。
examples.english_sentence: I bought two oranges; we can make orange juice tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢著咗一件橙色嘅外套，好搶眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 zo2 jat1 gin6 caang4 sik1 ge3 ngoi6tou3, hou2 coeng2 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她穿了一件橙色的外套，很搶眼。
examples.english_sentence: They put on an orange coat; it really stands out.

mandarin_meaning: 橙汁 / 橙子榨出的果汁
english_meaning: orange juice
explanation_mandarin: 由橙子（或柳橙）榨出的果汁，通常作为饮料饮用，也可用于烹饪或调制饮品。
explanation_english: Juice extracted from oranges, commonly consumed as a beverage; also used in cooking or mixed drinks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我要一杯橙汁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jiu3 jat1 bui1 caang4 zap1。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我要一杯橙汁。
examples.english_sentence: I want a glass of orange juice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度有冇新鮮橙汁？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 jau5 mou5 san1 sin1 caang4 zap1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里有新鲜橙汁吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you have fresh orange juice here?

mandarin_meaning: 橙红（橙红色）
english_meaning: orange-red
explanation_mandarin: 表示介於橙色與紅色之間的顏色，可用來形容日落、服飾或植物的色澤。
explanation_english: A color between orange and red. Used to describe hues in sunsets, clothing, foliage, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夕陽將天際染成一片橙紅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zik6 joeng4 zoeng1 tin1 zai3 jim5 sing4 jat1 pin3 caang4 hung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夕阳把天边染成一片橙红。
examples.english_sentence: The sunset dyed the horizon orange-red.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢着咗件橙紅色嘅裙，好搶眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 zo2 gin6 caang4 hung4 sik1 ge3 kwan4, hou2 coeng2 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她穿了一条橙红色的裙子，很抢眼。
examples.english_sentence: She wore an orange-red dress; it was eye-catching.

mandarin_meaning: 橙色 (chéngsè)
english_meaning: orange (color)
explanation_mandarin: 表示一種顏色，介於紅色與黃色之間，類似橙子皮的顏色。也可用於描述鮮豔或帶暖色調的色彩。
explanation_english: Denotes the color orange, between red and yellow — similar to the peel of an orange fruit. Also used to describe bright, warm-toned hues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意件橙色衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 gin6 caang4 sik1 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢那件橙色的衣服。
examples.english_sentence: I like that orange shirt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個橙色好鮮艷，好啱夏天。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 caang4 sik1 hou2 sin1 jim6, hou2 aam1 haa6 tin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个橙色很鲜艳，很适合夏天。
examples.english_sentence: This orange is very bright and suits summer well.

mandarin_meaning: （木）楔子；木栓
english_meaning: wedge; peg (usually wooden)
explanation_mandarin: 指用來固定或撬開物件的木製楔子或栓，常用於建築或木工中。屬較書面或古舊用詞。
explanation_english: Refers to a wooden wedge or peg used to fasten or pry objects, commonly used in carpentry or construction. The term is somewhat literary or archaic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 師傅用橛將門框固定住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si1 fu1 jung6 kyut3 zoeng1 mun4 kwaang1 gu3 ding6 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 师傅用橛子把门框固定住。
examples.english_sentence: The craftsman used a wedge to secure the door frame.

mandarin_meaning: 机（機）：机器、设备；机会、时机等
english_meaning: machine; device; chance; opportunity (used mainly as a morpheme in compounds)
explanation_mandarin: 「機」常用于复合词，表示机器、设备（如機器、飛機）或机会、时机（如機會）；粤语读作 gei1。
explanation_english: Commonly used as a morpheme in compounds to mean machine/device (e.g. 機器, 飛機) or chance/opportunity (e.g. 機會). Pronounced gei1 in Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰部機壞咗，要整修。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 bou6 gei1 waai6 zo2, jiu3 zing2 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那台机器坏了，要修理。
examples.english_sentence: That machine is broken and needs repair.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今次有冇機會去面試？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 ci3 jau5 mou5 gei1 wui6 heoi3 min6 si5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次你有机会去面试吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you have a chance to go to the interview this time?

mandarin_meaning: 机不可失（机会不可错过）
english_meaning: Don't miss the opportunity; a good opportunity should not be missed.
explanation_mandarin: 表示机会难得，不可错失良机，应当把握时机。
explanation_english: Indicates that an opportunity is rare and should not be missed; one should seize the moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個投資機會難得，機不可失。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 tau4 zi1 gei1 wui6 naan4 dak1, gei1 bat1 ho2 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个投资机会难得，机不可失。
examples.english_sentence: This investment opportunity is rare — don't miss it.

mandarin_meaning: 机件（机器或设备的零部件）
english_meaning: machine part; component; mechanical part
explanation_mandarin: 指機器或設備中的零部件或元件，通常用於說明需要維修、更換或檢查的部分。
explanation_english: Refers to the parts or components of a machine or device, usually mentioned in contexts of repair, replacement, or inspection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部機啲機件壞咗，要換新嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 gei1 di1 gei1 gin6 waai6 zo2, jiu3 wun6 san1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這台機的機件壞了，要換新的。
examples.english_sentence: Some parts of this machine are broken and need to be replaced.

mandarin_meaning: 飞机座位；（口语）名额、空位
english_meaning: seat on an airplane; (colloquial) a slot, vacancy or quota
explanation_mandarin: 通常指飛機上的座位，在口語中也可引申為某種名額或可用的空位。
explanation_english: Usually refers to a seat on an airplane. Colloquially it can also be used to mean a slot, vacancy, or available quota.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺網上揀咗窗邊嘅機位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 mong5 soeng6 gaan2 zo2 coeng1 bin1 ge3 gei1 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在网上选了靠窗的飞机座位。
examples.english_sentence: I chose a window seat online.

mandarin_meaning: 對機械、電子產品或科技很有興趣的人；也可指負責機器維修的技術員（口語、俚語）
english_meaning: A techie/gearhead (someone into machines or gadgets); also a mechanic/technician who works on machines (colloquial/slang)
explanation_mandarin: 香港廣東話口語或俚語。通常指熱衷於電子產品、機械或科技的人（類似「科技迷」或「技術宅」），也可指工廠或車間裡負責機器維修的技術員。語氣非正式，有時帶戲謔或調侃意味。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese colloquial/slang term. Commonly refers to someone keen on electronics, machines, or technology (like a 'techie' or 'gearhead'), and can also mean a technician/mechanic who repairs machines in a factory/workshop. Informal and sometimes teasing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明係個機佬，一有新手機就要買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 hai6 go3 gei1 lou2, jat1 jau5 san1 sau2 gei1 zau6 jiu3 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明是個科技迷，一有新手機就要買。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming is a techie — whenever there's a new phone he has to buy it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廠入面嗰個機佬而家喺度幫手維修生產機器。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cong2 jap6 min6 go2 go3 gei1 lou2 ji4 gaa1 hai2 dou6 bong1 sau2 wai4 sau1 saang1 caan2 gei1 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工廠裡面的那個技術員正在幫忙維修生產機器。
examples.english_sentence: The technician in the factory is helping to repair the production machine right now.

mandarin_meaning: 机制 / 機制（指系统或组织的运作方式、程序或制度）
english_meaning: mechanism; system; procedure; arrangement
explanation_mandarin: 指某一系統、機構或過程內部運作的方式、程序或制度，通常用來描述如何處理事務、分配權責或應對問題。
explanation_english: Refers to the internal way, procedures, or system by which an organization or process operates; often used to describe how tasks are handled, responsibilities allocated, or problems responded to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司需要建立一個有效嘅獎懲機制。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1si1 seoi1 jiu3 gin3laap6 jat1 go3 jau5haau6 ge3 zoeng2cam4 gei1zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司需要建立一个有效的奖惩机制。
examples.english_sentence: The company needs to establish an effective reward-and-punishment mechanism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該改善公共衛生應對嘅機制。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3fu2 jing1goi1 goi2sin6 gung1gung6 wai6sang1 jing3deoi3 ge3 gei1zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府应该改善公共卫生应对的机制。
examples.english_sentence: The government should improve the mechanism for responding to public health issues.

mandarin_meaning: 机动（灵活、可调动、可移动）
english_meaning: mobile; flexible; movable
explanation_mandarin: 表示具有灵活性或可調動、可移動的特性，常用來形容部隊、資源、安排等能迅速變動或調整的狀況。
explanation_english: Indicates being mobile or flexible — able to be moved, reallocated, or adjusted. Commonly used to describe units, resources, or arrangements that can change or be deployed quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府派咗一支機動部隊去支援災區。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 paai3 zo2 jat1 zi1 gei1 dung6 bou6 deoi6 heoi3 zi1 wun6 zoi1 keoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府派出了一支机动部队去支援灾区。
examples.english_sentence: The government dispatched a mobile unit to support the disaster area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃要保持機動，隨時可以改變。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 jiu3 bou2 ci4 gei1 dung6, ceoi4 si4 ho2 ji5 goi2 bin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划要保持机动，随时可以改变。
examples.english_sentence: This plan needs to remain flexible and can be changed at any time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司有啲機動資金，用嚟應付緊急開支。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jau5 di1 gei1 dung6 zi1 gam1, jung6 lai4 jing3 fu6 gan2 gap1 hoi1 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司有些机动资金，用来应付紧急开支。
examples.english_sentence: The company has some flexible funds to cover emergency expenses.

mandarin_meaning: 機動遊戲（jīdòng yóuxì）指遊樂場或主題公園中以機械動力運行的遊樂設施，如過山車、摩天輪等。
english_meaning: Mechanical amusement rides; ride attractions in amusement parks (e.g., roller coasters, Ferris wheels).
explanation_mandarin: 指以機械或動力系統運作的遊樂設施，通常出現在遊樂園、嘉年華或展覽，為遊客提供刺激或娛樂的乘坐體驗。
explanation_english: Refers to amusement-park attractions that operate by mechanical or powered systems, typically found in theme parks or carnivals and providing rides for entertainment or thrills.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去遊樂園玩機動遊戲啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 heoi3 jau4 lok6 jyun4 waan2 gei1 dung6 jau4 hei3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們今晚去遊樂園玩機動遊戲吧！
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the amusement park tonight to ride the mechanical rides!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遊樂園啲機動遊戲好刺激，但要注意安全。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau4 lok6 jyun4 di1 gei1 dung6 jau4 hei3 hou2 cik1 gik1, daan6 jiu3 zyu3 ji3 on1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 遊樂園的機動遊戲很刺激，但要注意安全。
examples.english_sentence: The amusement park's rides are thrilling, but you should pay attention to safety.

mandarin_meaning: 机动部队 (jīdòng bùduì)：可快速调动执行任务的警察或军队单位，香港常指负责处置示威、维持秩序的警队
english_meaning: mobile unit / mobile force (often the police tactical/riot unit); a rapidly deployable police or military unit for crowd control and emergency responses
explanation_mandarin: 指能够快速调动、执行任务的警察或军队单位。在香港語境中，通常指警方的機動部隊，負責處理示威、維持公共秩序和執行清場等任務。
explanation_english: Refers to a police or military unit that can be rapidly mobilized to carry out tasks. In the Hong Kong context it commonly denotes the police tactical/riot unit responsible for crowd control, clearing scenes, and restoring order.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋日示威升級，機動部隊上街清場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 jat6 si6 wai1 sing1 kap1, gei1 dung6 bou6 deoi6 soeng5 gaai1 cing1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天示威升级，机动部队上街清场。
examples.english_sentence: Yesterday the protest escalated and the mobile unit/riot police went onto the streets to clear the area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 軍方成立咗一支機動部隊，用嚟快速反應災難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwan1 fong1 sing4 laap6 zo2 jat1 zi1 gei1 dung6 bou6 deoi6, jung6 lai4 faai3 cuk1 faan2 jing3 zoi1 naan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 军方成立了一个机动部队，用来快速应对灾难。
examples.english_sentence: The military formed a mobile unit to respond quickly to disasters.

mandarin_meaning: 自慰夥伴／手淫夥伴
english_meaning: masturbation partner (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 俗語，指與他人互相進行自慰（包括面對面或視訊）的夥伴或約定對象，通常為非正式或網路用語，含性意味且涉及私密與風險。
explanation_english: A slang term for a partner with whom one mutually masturbates (in person or via video). It's informal, often used online, sexually explicit, and involves privacy and safety risks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺網上搵緊機友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 mong5 soeng6 wan2 gan2 gei1 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她在網上找機友。
examples.english_sentence: He/she is looking for a masturbation partner online.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想同陌生人做機友，太危險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 tung4 mak6 sang1 jan4 zou6 gei1 jau5, taai3 ngai4 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想和陌生人做機友，太危險。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to be a masturbation partner with a stranger; it's too risky.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人會喺聊天室約機友視訊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 wui5 hai2 liu4 tin1 sat1 joek3 gei1 jau5 si6 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人會在聊天室約機友視訊。
examples.english_sentence: Some people arrange video calls with masturbation partners in chat rooms.

mandarin_meaning: 机器 (jīqì)
english_meaning: machine; device; apparatus; (figuratively) someone who works mechanically
explanation_mandarin: 指用于执行特定工作或任务的机械设备或装置；口语中也可比喻像机器一样机械地工作或行动的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a mechanical device or apparatus used to perform specific tasks; can also be used figuratively to describe a person who works in a mechanical, repetitive way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部機器壞咗，要叫人嚟整。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 gei1 hei3 waai6 zo2, jiu3 giu3 jan4 lai4 zing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台机器坏了，要叫人来修。
examples.english_sentence: This machine is broken; we need to call someone to fix it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司買咗一部新嘅包裝機器。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 maai5 zo2 jat1 bou6 san1 ge3 baau1 zong1 gei1 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司买了一台新的包装机器。
examples.english_sentence: The company bought a new packaging machine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好似機器，成日重複同一樣嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 ci5 gei1 hei3, sing4 jat6 cung4 fuk1 tung4 jat1 joeng6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作像机器一样，总是重复同样的事情。
examples.english_sentence: He works like a machine, always repeating the same tasks.

mandarin_meaning: 機械工；修理工；負責操作或維修機器的人
english_meaning: mechanic/technician; a person who operates or repairs machines (colloquial/slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「機器佬」為粵語俗稱，用來指在工廠或車間負責操作、維修或調校機械設備的人，語氣較口語，有時帶輕微親暱或不正式的意味。
explanation_english: “機器佬” is a Cantonese colloquial term referring to someone who operates, maintains, or repairs machinery—typically a mechanic or technician in a factory/workshop. The term is informal and can sound casual or slightly familiar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間工場啲機器壞咗，要搵個機器佬嚟修理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 coeng4 di1 gei1 hei3 waai6 zo2, jiu3 wan2 go3 gei1 hei3 lou2 lai4 sau1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間工廠的機器壞了，要找個修理工來修理。
examples.english_sentence: The machines in this factory broke down; we need to find a mechanic to fix them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係公司入面嘅機器佬，專門整生產線啲設備。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 gung1 si1 jap6 min6 ge3 gei1 hei3 lou2, zyun1 mun4 zing2 saang1 caan2 sin3 di1 cit3 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是公司裡面的機械工，專門維修生產線的設備。
examples.english_sentence: He's the company's mechanic, specializing in repairing the production line equipment.

mandarin_meaning: 机场 (jīchǎng)
english_meaning: airport
explanation_mandarin: 供飛機起降、旅客與貨物處理的場所或設施。
explanation_english: A facility where aircraft take off and land and where passengers and cargo are handled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚要去機場接阿媽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 jiu3 heoi3 gei1 coeng4 zip3 aa3 maa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚要去机场接妈妈。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to the airport tonight to pick up Mom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 機場好多人，要預早到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei1 coeng4 hou2 do1 jan4, jiu3 jyu6 zou2 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 机场人很多，要提前到达。
examples.english_sentence: The airport is very crowded; you should arrive early.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你喺機場邊度攞行李？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai2 gei1 coeng4 bin1 dou6 lo2 hang4 lei5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在机场哪里取行李？
examples.english_sentence: Where do you collect luggage at the airport?

mandarin_meaning: 机场巴士 / 机场大巴
english_meaning: airport bus (bus service between an airport and the city/other locations)
explanation_mandarin: 指在机场与市区或其他地点之间运行的巴士服务，常用于连接航站楼与市区、酒店或交通枢纽（也称机场大巴或机场穿梭巴士）。
explanation_english: A bus service that runs between an airport and the city or other locations, commonly used to connect terminals with urban areas, hotels, or transport hubs (also called airport coach or airport shuttle).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚要搭機場巴士去機場，千祈唔好遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 jiu3 daap3 gei1 coeng4 baa1 si2 heoi3 gei1 coeng4, cin1 kei4 m4 hou2 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚要坐机场巴士去机场，千万别迟到。
examples.english_sentence: We're taking the airport bus to the airport tonight; don't be late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 機場巴士幾多分鐘一班？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei1 coeng4 baa1 si2 gei2 do1 fan1 zung1 jat1 baan1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 机场巴士几分钟一班？
examples.english_sentence: How often does the airport bus run? (How many minutes between buses?)

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搭機場巴士可以用八達通嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: daap3 gei1 coeng4 baa1 si2 ho2 ji5 jung6 baat3 daat6 tung1 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 坐机场巴士可以用八达通吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can I use an Octopus card to pay on the airport bus?

mandarin_meaning: 机场快线
english_meaning: Airport Express (airport railway service)
explanation_mandarin: 香港的機場快線（Airport Express）是港鐵營運的機場列車服務，連接市區（如中環、九龍）與香港國際機場，行程時間短、速度快並常作為往返機場旅客的交通選擇。
explanation_english: The Airport Express is an MTR rapid rail service in Hong Kong that links urban stations (e.g., Central, Kowloon) with Hong Kong International Airport. It offers fast, short travel times and is primarily used by air travelers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我搭機場快綫去機場，差唔多二十分鐘就到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daap3 gei1 coeng4 faai3 sin3 heoi3 gei1 coeng4, caa1 m4 do1 ji6 sap6 fan1 zung1 zau6 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我坐机场快线去机场，差不多二十分钟就到。
examples.english_sentence: I take the Airport Express to the airport; it takes about twenty minutes.

mandarin_meaning: 机场快线（指连接市区与机场的快速铁路或地铁线路）
english_meaning: Airport Express (airport express train/line)
explanation_mandarin: 指连接市区与机场的快速铁路或地铁线路。在香港通常特指港铁的机场快线（Airport Express），提供快速的机场接驳服务，車程較市區巴士或的士穩定且快捷。
explanation_english: Refers to a fast rail/metro service connecting the city and the airport. In Hong Kong it commonly refers to the MTR's Airport Express, providing quick and reliable airport transfers that are typically faster than road transport.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我會坐機場快線去機場，最快又唔使塞車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wui5 co5 gei1 coeng4 faai3 sin3 heoi3 gei1 coeng4, zeoi3 faai3 jau6 m4 sai2 sak1 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我会坐机场快线去机场，最快又不用塞车。
examples.english_sentence: I'll take the Airport Express to the airport — it's the fastest and avoids traffic.

mandarin_meaning: 机密 (jīmì) — 秘密、机要的事项
english_meaning: confidential; secret; classified
explanation_mandarin: 表示資訊、文件或事項屬於秘密或受限制，只有特定人員可以知悉或處理。
explanation_english: Indicates information, documents, or matters that are secret or restricted, accessible only to authorized personnel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份文件係機密，唔好畀人睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 man4 gin6 hai6 gei1 mat6, m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份文件是机密，不要让别人看。
examples.english_sentence: This document is confidential; don't let others see it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲資料好機密，淨係經理先可以睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 zi1 liu2 hou2 gei1 mat6, zing6 hai6 ging1 lei5 sin1 ho2 ji5 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些资料很机密，只有经理才能看。
examples.english_sentence: These materials are highly confidential; only the manager can view them.

mandarin_meaning: 机帆（常指机帆船）
english_meaning: motor sailer; a vessel with both sail and engine
explanation_mandarin: 指既有帆又有機動力的船隻，可用風帆或引擎航行，常見說法為「機帆船」。
explanation_english: Refers to a vessel equipped with both sails and an engine; it can be propelled by wind or by motor. Often called a motor-sailer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋買咗一艘機帆船，夏天出海好方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 maai5 zo2 jat1 sou3 gei1 faan4 syun4, haa6 tin1 ceot1 hoi2 hou2 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们买了一艘机帆船，夏天出海很方便。
examples.english_sentence: They bought a motor sailer; it's very convenient for going out to sea in summer.

mandarin_meaning: 飞行员 / 机师
english_meaning: pilot (aircraft pilot)
explanation_mandarin: 指驾驶飞机的人，通常用于指商业航空或军事航空中的飞行员。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who pilots an aircraft, typically used for commercial or military airplane pilots.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個機師，主要駕駛客機飛長途。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 gei1 si1, zyu2 jiu3 gaa3 si2 haak3 gei1 fei1 coeng4 tou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一名机师，主要驾驶客机飞长途。
examples.english_sentence: He is a pilot who mainly flies long-haul passenger planes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 機師喺起飛前做咗安全檢查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei1 si1 hai6 hei2 fei1 cin4 zou6 zo2 on1 cyun4 gim2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 机师在起飞前做了安全检查。
examples.english_sentence: The pilot performed a safety check before takeoff.

mandarin_meaning: 心机；别有用心
english_meaning: scheming; having ulterior motives; cunning
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词（亦可用于形容词结构，如“有心机”）
partOfSpeech_english: noun (can be used attributively or in phrases like 'has scheming intentions')
explanation_mandarin: 指心思狡猾、有算计，常含贬义，用来形容有人别有用心或暗中谋划。
explanation_english: Refers to a scheming or calculating mindset; implies someone is cunning and has ulterior motives. Often used pejoratively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心佢，佢好有機心，可能想利用你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 keoi5, keoi5 hou2 jau5 gei1 sam1, ho2 nang4 soeng2 lei6 jung6 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心他／她，他很有心机，可能想利用你。
examples.english_sentence: Watch out for them; they're very scheming and may try to use you.

mandarin_meaning: 罕見詞／可能為方言或筆誤，含義不確定
english_meaning: rare/uncertain term (possibly dialectal or a misspelling); meaning unclear
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 詞性不確定（可能為口語/俚語）
partOfSpeech_english: part of speech uncertain (possibly slang, interjection, or verb)
explanation_mandarin: 「機恤」在現代廣東話書面與口語語料中極罕見，沒有明確且廣泛接受的定義。可能為地區性用語、俚語、或書寫錯誤（如與其他詞混淆）。在沒有更多語境時難以斷定其精確含義或詞性。
explanation_english: The term "機恤" is extremely rare in contemporary Cantonese resources and lacks a clear, widely accepted definition. It may be a regional expression, slang, or a misspelling/confusion with another term. Without additional context it is difficult to determine its precise meaning or part of speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個詞「機恤」我真係好少聽到，唔肯定佢係咩意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ci4 "gei1 seot1" ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 siu2 teng1 dou3, m4 hang2 ding6 keoi5 hai6 me1 ji3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个词「機恤」我真的很少听到，不确定它是什么意思。
examples.english_sentence: I've hardly ever heard the word "機恤" and I'm not sure what it means.

mandarin_meaning: 机房（服务器机房、设备机房）
english_meaning: machine room; server room; equipment room
explanation_mandarin: 指放置伺服器、網絡設備或其他機械電子設備的專用房間或空間，常見於公司、數據中心或樓宇機電系統中。
explanation_english: A room or space used to house servers, network equipment, or other mechanical/electronic machinery; commonly found in companies, data centers, or building facilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司喺地下室開咗間機房，放哂啲伺服器同網絡設備。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 hai2 dei6 haa6 sat1 hoi1 zo2 gaan1 gei1 fong4, fong3 saai3 di1 ci3 fuk6 hei3 tung4 mong5 lok3 cit3 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司在地下室開了一間機房，放置了所有的伺服器和網絡設備。
examples.english_sentence: The company opened a server room in the basement and stored all the servers and network equipment there.

mandarin_meaning: 机智；反应敏捷、说话巧妙
english_meaning: quick-witted; clever; able to respond cleverly and promptly
explanation_mandarin: 形容人反應敏捷、說話巧妙，能即時化解尷尬或提出合適的回應與解決方案。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is quick-witted and clever, able to respond with smart remarks or solutions that defuse awkward situations or solve problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好機智，見到尷尬嘅場面即刻講句笑話化解。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 gei1 zi3, gin3 dou3 gaan1 gaai3 ge3 coeng4 min6 zik1 hak1 gong2 geoi3 siu3 waa6 faa3 gaai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很机智，看到尴尬的场面就马上讲个笑话化解。
examples.english_sentence: He's very quick-witted; when he sees an awkward situation he immediately tells a joke to defuse it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 主持人即場回應好機智，觀眾都笑翻晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zyu2 ci4 jan4 zik1 coeng4 wui4 jing3 hou2 gei1 zi3, gun1 zung3 dou1 siu3 faan1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 主持人现场反应很机智，观众都笑翻了。
examples.english_sentence: The host's on-the-spot responses were very witty; the audience burst out laughing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅機智喺討論時好有用，幫我哋快速搵到解決方法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gei1 zi3 hai2 tou2 leon6 si4 hou2 jau5 jung6, bong1 ngo5 dei6 faai3 cuk1 wan2 dou3 gaai2 kyut3 fong1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的机智在讨论时很有用，帮我们快速找到解决方法。
examples.english_sentence: His quick wit is very useful during discussions; it helped us quickly find solutions.

mandarin_meaning: 机会 (jī huì)
english_meaning: opportunity; chance
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事發生的可能性或可供利用的時機，例如工作、學習或其他活動中可把握的良好條件。
explanation_english: Refers to an occasion or circumstance that makes it possible to do something; a favorable time or chance for action or advancement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇機會去面試？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 gei1 wui6 heoi3 min6 si3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有机会去面试吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you have a chance to go to the interview?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你唔試，永遠都冇機會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 m4 si3, wing5 jyun5 dou1 mou5 gei1 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不尝试，就永远没有机会。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't try, you'll never have a chance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好幸運，得到一個升職嘅機會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 hang6 wan6, dak1 dou3 jat1 go3 sing1 zik1 ge3 gei1 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很幸运，得到了一个升职的机会。
examples.english_sentence: He was lucky and got an opportunity for promotion.

mandarin_meaning: 机会主义 (指见利忘义、随形势或利益改变立场的一种行为或态度)
english_meaning: Opportunism (acting based on expediency or short-term advantage rather than principles)
explanation_mandarin: 指在行為或決策上不堅持原則，根據眼前的利益或時機改變立場或採取行動，常帶有貶義，用來批評投機取巧、見風轉舵的態度。
explanation_english: Refers to behavior or decision-making that sacrifices principles in favor of short-term gains or convenient opportunities; often used pejoratively to criticize someone for being opportunistic or unprincipled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做事好機會主義，見到有利就改口支持。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 si6 hou2 gei1 wui6 zyu2 ji6, gin3 dou3 jau5 lei6 zau6 goi2 hau2 zi1 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很機會主義，看到有利就改口支持。
examples.english_sentence: He acts opportunistically; when he sees an advantage he changes his stance to support it.

mandarin_meaning: 机会成本 (jīhuì chéngběn)
english_meaning: opportunity cost
explanation_mandarin: 因為選擇某一方案而放棄其他可得方案所失去的最大收益或價值，稱為機會成本。
explanation_english: The value of the next-best alternative that is forgone when a choice is made; what you give up to pursue a particular option.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 投資股票前，要計埋機會成本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 zi1 gu2 piu3 cin4, jiu3 gai3 maai4 gei1 wui6 sing4 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在投资股票之前，要把机会成本算进去。
examples.english_sentence: Before investing in stocks, you should factor in the opportunity cost.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢放棄升學去打工，機會成本係可能錯過更好嘅職業機會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fong3 hei3 sing1 hok6 heoi3 daa2 gung1, gei1 wui6 sing4 bun2 hai6 ho2 nang4 co3 gwo3 gang3 hou2 ge3 zik1 jip6 gei1 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他放弃升学去打工，机会成本是可能错过更好的职业机会。
examples.english_sentence: He gave up further studies to work; the opportunity cost is possibly missing out on better job opportunities.

mandarin_meaning: 織布機；用來經緯交錯織造布匹的機械
english_meaning: loom; a weaving machine used to interlace warp and weft threads to make fabric
explanation_mandarin: 機杼指用於織布的機器或其部件，可指整台織機或織布過程中的梭子等器具。在現代語境常等同於織機或織布設備。
explanation_english: Refers to a machine or component used for weaving cloth. It can mean the entire loom or parts like the shuttle; in modern usage it is often synonymous with a weaving machine or textile equipment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間紡織廠入面嗰部機杼壞咗，要即刻維修。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 fong3 zik1 cong2 jap6 min6 go2 bou6 gei1 zyu6 waai6 zo2, jiu3 zik1 haak1 wai4 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家纺织厂里面那台织机坏了，需要立即维修。
examples.english_sentence: The loom in this textile factory is broken and needs immediate repair.

mandarin_meaning: 机械（机器；机械式、机械般的）
english_meaning: machine; mechanical; mechanicalness (rigid, automatic)
explanation_mandarin: 指机器或与机器有关的事物；也可形容动作、表情或反应僵硬、像机械一样缺乏灵活或感情。
explanation_english: Refers to machines or things related to machines; can also describe actions, expressions, or reactions that are rigid, automatic, or lacking emotion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部機械壞咗，要搵人維修。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 gei1 haai6 waai6 zo2, jiu3 wan2 jan4 wai4 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台机械坏了，要找人维修。
examples.english_sentence: This machine is broken; we need to find someone to repair it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做事好機械，冇乜表情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 si6 hou2 gei1 haai6, mou5 mat1 biu2 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很机械，没什么表情。
examples.english_sentence: He works very mechanically, without much expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 工廠入面有好多機械自動運作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 cong2 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 gei1 haai6 zi6 dung6 wan6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工厂里面有很多机械自动运作。
examples.english_sentence: There are many machines operating automatically in the factory.

mandarin_meaning: 机器人 (jīqìrén)
english_meaning: robot
explanation_mandarin: 指由人制造并可按程序或控制执行特定任务的机器装置，有时也指外形或行为像人的机械体。
explanation_english: Refers to a machine or mechanical device that can be programmed or controlled to perform specific tasks, often resembling or emulating human actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司買咗幾部機械人去做生產線嘅工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 maai5 zo2 gei2 bou6 gei1 haai6 jan4 heoi3 zou6 saang1 caan2 sin3 ge3 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司买了几台机器人去做生产线的工作。
examples.english_sentence: The company bought several robots to work on the production line.

mandarin_meaning: 机械臂
english_meaning: robotic arm; mechanical arm
explanation_mandarin: 一种可编程的机械装置，通常用于工业生产、装配、搬运或医疗等场景，用来代替或辅助人工完成重复或高精度的动作。
explanation_english: A programmable mechanical arm used in industry, manufacturing, laboratories, or medical settings to handle, weld, assemble, or assist humans by performing repetitive or high-precision tasks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廠房入面而家用緊好多機械臂做包裝工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cong2 fong4 jap6 min6 ji4 gaa1 jung6 gan2 hou2 do1 gei1 haai6 bei3 zou6 baau1 zong1 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 厂房里面现在用很多机械臂做包装工作。
examples.english_sentence: The factory is now using many robotic arms for packaging work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫院用機械臂做微創手術，準確度高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 jyun2 jung6 gei1 haai6 bei3 zou6 mei4 cong1 sau2 seot6, zeon2 kok3 dou6 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医院用机械臂做微创手术，准确度高。
examples.english_sentence: The hospital uses a robotic arm for minimally invasive surgery; it has high accuracy.

mandarin_meaning: 机械键盘 (jīxiè jiànpán)
english_meaning: mechanical keyboard
explanation_mandarin: 一種每個按鍵下方採用獨立機械開關的鍵盤，具有明顯的觸感反饋、較長的使用壽命，並且常可自訂鍵帽與軸體，常用於打字與遊戲。
explanation_english: A keyboard that uses individual mechanical switches beneath each key, offering pronounced tactile feedback, greater durability, and customization options; commonly used for typing and gaming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住買部機械鍵盤，用嚟打機同埋打字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 zyu6 maai5 bou6 gei1 haai6 gin6 pun4, jung6 lai4 daa2 gei1 tung4 maai4 daa2 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算买一个机械键盘，用来打游戏和打字。
examples.english_sentence: I'm planning to buy a mechanical keyboard to play games and type.

mandarin_meaning: 機構 / 组织 / 機關 (指有特定功能或任務的單位)
english_meaning: organization; institution; agency
explanation_mandarin: 指具有特定職能或目的的團體或單位，例如公司、非營利組織、政府機關等，用於表示組織體的整體。
explanation_english: Refers to an entity or unit with a specific function or purpose (e.g., companies, NGOs, government agencies); used to denote an organized body or institution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間機構專門做環保研究。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gei1kau3 zyun1mun4 zou6 waan4bou2 jin4gau3。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這家機構專門從事環保研究。
examples.english_sentence: This organization specializes in environmental research.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府一向支持本地社會服務機構。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3fu2 jat1hoeng3 zi1ci4 bun2dei6 se5wui6 fuk6mou6 gei1kau3。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府一向支持本地的社會服務機構。
examples.english_sentence: The government has always supported local social service organizations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 簽約之前，我哋要查清楚對方嘅機構背景。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cim1joek3 zi1cin4, ngo5dei6 jiu3 caa4 cing1co2 deoi3fong1 ge3 gei1kau3 bui3ging2。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 簽約之前，我們要查清楚對方的機構背景。
examples.english_sentence: Before signing the contract, we need to check the other party's organizational background.

mandarin_meaning: 机枪 (jīqiāng)
english_meaning: machine gun
explanation_mandarin: 一种自动或半自动射击武器，能连续发射子弹，常用于军队或防御用途。
explanation_english: A firearm capable of continuous or rapid automatic fire, used by military forces or for defensive purposes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 軍人喺戰場上用機槍防守陣地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwan1 jan4 hai2 zin3 coeng4 soeng5 jung6 gei1 coeng1 fong4 sau2 zan6 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 军人在战场上用机枪防守阵地。
examples.english_sentence: Soldiers use machine guns to defend positions on the battlefield.

mandarin_meaning: 机油；（俚语）油滑、圆滑、油腔滑调的人或表现
english_meaning: engine oil; (slang) someone/something slick, oily, smooth-talking or insincere
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词（字面）；俚语时可作形容词或名词
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指发动机使用的润滑油。作粤语俚语时，用来形容人言行油滑、圆滑或过于会讨好、让人觉得不真实。
explanation_english: Literally refers to oil used in engines. As Cantonese slang, it describes a person who is slick, smooth-talking, obsequious or insincere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我部車要換機油，聽日要去維修舖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bou6 ce1 jiu3 wun6 gei1 jau4, teng1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 wai4 sau1 pou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的車要换机油，明天要去维修店。
examples.english_sentence: My car needs an oil change; I have to go to the repair shop tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日對上司講嘢好機油，大家都唔太信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 deoi3 soeng5 si1 gong2 je5 hou2 gei1 jau4, daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 taai3 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常对上司说话很油，很难让大家信任他。
examples.english_sentence: He's always very slick when talking to the boss; people don't really trust him.

mandarin_meaning: 概率
english_meaning: probability; chance; likelihood
explanation_mandarin: 表示某件事情發生的可能性或機會，常用於統計、數學或描述概率性的情況。
explanation_english: Indicates the likelihood that an event will occur; the probability or chance, often used in statistics, mathematics, or when describing likelihoods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你唔溫書，考試及格嘅機率好低。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 m4 wan1 syu1, haau2 si3 kap6 gaak3 ge3 gei1 leot6 hou2 dai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不複習，考試及格的概率很低。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't study, the probability of passing the exam is very low.

mandarin_meaning: 机票
english_meaning: plane ticket; airline ticket
explanation_mandarin: 指乘坐飞机所需的票证，通常写明航班、日期、座位等信息。
explanation_english: A ticket required to board an airplane; typically shows the flight number, date, seat class, and other travel details.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗兩張機票去日本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 loeng5 zoeng1 gei1 piu3 heoi3 jat6 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了两张机票去日本。
examples.english_sentence: I bought two plane tickets to Japan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 機票好貴，要早啲買先抵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei1 piu3 hou2 gwai3, jiu3 zou2 di1 maai5 sin1 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 机票很贵，要早点买才划算。
examples.english_sentence: Plane tickets are expensive; you should buy earlier to get a better price.

mandarin_meaning: 漏洞；破綻；可被利用的空子
english_meaning: a loophole or flaw; a weak point or opening that can be exploited
explanation_mandarin: 口語用詞，指事物、制度或說法中的破綻、漏洞，或可以被利用的空子或機會。
explanation_english: A colloquial term referring to a flaw, loophole, or weakness in something (a system, contract, statement, etc.) that can be exploited or taken advantage of.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好搵機竇，直接講清楚啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 wan2 gei1 dou6, zik6 zip3 gong2 cing1 co2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你別找漏洞，直接說清楚吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't look for loopholes; just say it clearly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份合約有啲機竇，簽之前要小心睇清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 hap6 joek3 jau5 di1 gei1 dou6, cim1 zi1 cin4 jiu3 siu2 sam1 tai2 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這份合約有些漏洞，簽之前要小心看清楚。
examples.english_sentence: This contract has some loopholes; be careful to read it thoroughly before signing.

mandarin_meaning: 機場管理局（指負責機場運作與管理的機構，香港常指香港機場管理局）
english_meaning: Airport Authority (an organization responsible for managing and operating an airport; in Hong Kong often refers to the Airport Authority Hong Kong)
explanation_mandarin: 「機管局」是「機場管理局」的簡稱，用來指負責機場日常運作、管理、規劃和安全監督的機構。在香港語境下通常指香港機場管理局（Airport Authority Hong Kong）。
explanation_english: “機管局” is an abbreviation of 機場管理局 (Airport Authority). It refers to the organization responsible for airport operations, management, planning, and oversight. In Hong Kong context it commonly denotes the Airport Authority Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 機管局負責管理香港國際機場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei1 gun2 guk6 fu6 zaak3 gun2 lei5 hoeng1 gong2 gwok3 zai3 gei1 coeng4。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 機場管理局負責管理香港國際機場。
examples.english_sentence: The Airport Authority is responsible for managing Hong Kong International Airport.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為大霧，機管局暫停咗啲航班。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 daai6 mou6, gei1 gun2 guk6 zaam6 ting4 zo2 di1 hong4 baan1。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因為大霧，機場管理局暫時停飛了一些航班。
examples.english_sentence: Because of heavy fog, the Airport Authority temporarily suspended some flights.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你想投訴，可以聯絡機管局。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 soeng2 tau4 sou3, ho2 ji5 lyun4 lok3 gei1 gun2 guk6。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你想投訴，可以聯絡機場管理局。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to file a complaint, you can contact the Airport Authority.

mandarin_meaning: 机组
english_meaning: crew; (machine) unit/set (e.g., generator set)
explanation_mandarin: 「机组」可指執行任務的人員組（如飛機機組人員、拍攝機組），也可指成套的機械設備（如發電機組）。
explanation_english: “機組” can refer to a team of personnel operating a vehicle or production (e.g., aircraft crew, filming crew), or to a set/unit of machinery (e.g., a generator set).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飛機機組人員已經檢查完畢，準備起飛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fei1 gei1 gei1 zou2 jan4 jyun4 ji5 ging1 gim2 caa4 jyun4 bat1, zeon2 bei6 hei2 fei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 飞机机组人员已经检查完毕，准备起飞。
examples.english_sentence: The aircraft crew has completed checks and is ready for takeoff.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司買咗一套發電機組，應付停電。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 maai5 zo2 jat1 tou3 faat3 din6 gei1 zou2, jing3 fu6 ting4 din6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司买了一套发电机组，以应付停电。
examples.english_sentence: The company bought a generator set to cope with power outages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電視台嘅拍攝機組嚟到現場做採訪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 si6 toi4 ge3 paak3 sip3 gei1 zou2 lai4 dou3 jin6 coeng4 zou6 coi2 fong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电视台的拍摄机组来到现场做采访。
examples.english_sentence: The TV station's filming crew arrived on site to conduct an interview.

mandarin_meaning: 机组人员
english_meaning: crew members (e.g., flight crew, cabin crew)
explanation_mandarin: 指飞机、航天器或其他交通工具上的工作人员，尤指负责飞行操作或客舱服务的人员。
explanation_english: Refers to personnel on an aircraft, spacecraft, or other vehicles, especially those responsible for flight operations or cabin services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 機組人員請於登機門集合，準備登機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei1 zou2 jan4 jyun4 ceng2 jyu1 dang1 gei1 mun4 zaap6 hap6, zeon2 bei6 dang1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 机组人员请在登机口集合，准备登机。
examples.english_sentence: Crew members, please assemble at the boarding gate and prepare to board.

mandarin_meaning: 机缘；机遇、缘分（表示促成某事的机会或命中注定的巧合）
english_meaning: an opportunity or favorable chance, often with a sense of fate or serendipity
explanation_mandarin: 表示机会、缘分或命中注定的巧合，指某种使事情成为可能的时机或因缘。
explanation_english: Refers to an opportunity or favorable chance, often carrying a sense of fate or serendipity — a circumstance that makes something possible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次能夠見到你，真係一個機緣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 nang4 gau3 gin3 dou2 nei5, zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 gei1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次能见到你，真是一个机缘。
examples.english_sentence: Being able to meet you this time is truly a providential opportunity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話係因為有機緣先搵到呢份工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 hai6 jan1 wai6 jau5 gei1 jyun4 sin1 wan2 dou3 ni1 fan6 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说是因为有机缘才找到这份工作。
examples.english_sentence: He said he only found this job because of a stroke of luck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果有機緣，我想去海外進修。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 jau5 gei1 jyun4, ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 hoi2 ngoi6 zeon3 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果有机缘，我想去海外进修。
examples.english_sentence: If there's an opportunity, I'd like to go abroad for further study.

mandarin_meaning: 机缘巧合
english_meaning: a fortunate coincidence; serendipity; by chance
explanation_mandarin: 表示因為時機或條件剛好而發生的巧合或偶然事件，常用來形容事情湊巧發生或有某種緣分。
explanation_english: Refers to coincidences or chance occurrences brought about by favorable timing or circumstances; often used to describe events that happen serendipitously or as if by fate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋係機緣巧合先識嘅，完全冇計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai6 gei1 jyun4 haau2 hap6 sin1 sik1 ge3, jyun4 cyun4 mou5 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们是机缘巧合才认识的，完全没有计划。
examples.english_sentence: We met by chance; it was totally unplanned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 機緣巧合，佢今日返嚟遇到以前嘅老師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei1 jyun4 haau2 hap6, keoi5 gam1 jat6 faan1 lai4 jyu6 dou3 ji5 cin4 ge3 lou5 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 机缘巧合，他今天回来时遇到了以前的老师。
examples.english_sentence: By coincidence, he ran into his former teacher when he came back today.

mandarin_meaning: 机翼
english_meaning: wing (of an aircraft)
explanation_mandarin: 指飞机等航空器两侧用于产生升力的翼面或结构。
explanation_english: The surface or structure on either side of an aircraft that generates lift, enabling flight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飛機嘅機翼有啲破損，要維修先可以安全起飛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fei1 gei1 ge3 gei1 jik6 jau5 di1 po3 syun2, jiu3 wai4 sau1 sin1 ho2 ji5 on1 cyun4 hei2 fei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 飞机的机翼有些破损，需要维修才能安全起飞。
examples.english_sentence: The airplane's wing has some damage and needs repair before it can take off safely.

mandarin_meaning: 功能
english_meaning: function; capability; functionality
explanation_mandarin: 「機能」指物件或生物的功能與作用，可用來描述電子產品的功能、系統能力或身體器官的功能。
explanation_english: Refers to the functions or capabilities of an object or organism; used to describe features of devices or systems, or physiological functions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部手機嘅機能好強，拍相同續航都唔錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 sau2 gei1 ge3 gei1 nang4 hou2 koeng4, paak3 soeng2 tung4 zuk6 hong4 dou1 m4 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部手機的機能很強，拍照和續航都不錯。
examples.english_sentence: This phone's functions are very strong; the camera and battery life are both good.

mandarin_meaning: （香港粵語）指擺放投幣式遊戲機或賭博機台的場所；類似電玩廳或賭博機舖
english_meaning: Cantonese slang for an arcade or slot-machine/gambling parlor (places with coin-operated game or gambling machines)
explanation_mandarin: 「機舖」是香港粵語俗稱，多指擺放街機、投幣遊戲機、或賭博機的場所。某些機舖以賭博為主，可能涉及違法活動，因此有時帶貶義或不安全的含義。
explanation_english: “機舖” is Hong Kong Cantonese slang referring to places with arcade machines or slot/gambling machines. Some are simple game arcades, while others focus on gambling and can be illegal or unsafe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺嗰間機舖打機，最後輸咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 go2 gaan1 gei1 pou3 daa2 gei1, zeoi3 hau6 syu1 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常在那間機舖打機，最後輸了很多錢。
examples.english_sentence: He often plays at that arcade/slot parlor and ended up losing a lot of money.

mandarin_meaning: 机舱（飛機或船等交通工具內供人員或貨物乘坐、存放的艙室）
english_meaning: cabin; the compartment in an aircraft, ship, or vehicle for passengers, crew, or cargo
explanation_mandarin: 指飛機、船隻或其他交通工具內的艙室，通常用來指飛機的乘客區（客艙）或放置機械設備、貨物的空間。
explanation_english: Refers to the compartment inside an aircraft, ship, or other vehicle; commonly used for an aircraft's passenger area (cabin) or spaces that house equipment or cargo.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 機艙入面嘅空氣好乾，我成日會飲水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei1 cong1 jap6 min6 ge3 hung1 hei3 hou2 gon1, ngo5 seng4 jat6 wui5 jam2 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 机舱里面的空气很干，我经常会喝水。
examples.english_sentence: The air inside the cabin is very dry; I often drink water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 機艙上嘅行李櫃太細，冇位放大件行李。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei1 cong1 soeng5 ge3 hang4 lei5 gwai6 taai3 sai3, mou5 wai2 fong3 daai6 gin6 hang4 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 机舱上的行李柜太小，没有地方放大件行李。
examples.english_sentence: The overhead bins in the cabin are too small; there's no space for large luggage.

mandarin_meaning: 机舱里的老鼠；（俚语）藏匿在飞机机舱内的偷渡者或企图偷渡的人
english_meaning: Literally, a mouse in an aircraft cabin; (slang) a stowaway who hides in an airplane cabin or someone who sneaks onto planes
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是飛機機艙裡的老鼠。引申為俚語時，可指藏匿在機艙內偷渡的人或企圖偷乘飛機的人，有時也帶貶義用於形容經常出入機艙的人。
explanation_english: Literally refers to a mouse found inside an airplane cabin. Figuratively (slang), it can mean a stowaway hiding in the cabin or someone who sneaks onto planes; it can also be used derogatorily for people who spend a lot of time on aircraft.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講嗰班機入面發現機艙老鼠，成班乘客都好驚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 gong2 go2 baan1 gei1 jap6 min6 faat3 jin6 gei1 cong1 lou5 syu2, sing4 baan1 sing4 haak3 dou1 hou2 geng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说那班飞机在机舱里发现了老鼠，整班乘客都很害怕。
examples.english_sentence: I heard that a mouse was found in the cabin of that flight; the whole group of passengers were very scared.

mandarin_meaning: 机警；警觉、机敏
english_meaning: alert; vigilant; quick-witted
explanation_mandarin: 表示對周圍環境敏銳且警覺，能迅速發現異常並作出反應。
explanation_english: Describes being alert and vigilant to one's surroundings, quick to notice irregularities and react.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好機警，見到可疑人士即刻報警。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 gei1 ging2, gin3 dou3 ho2 ji4 jan4 si6 zik1 hak1 bou3 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很机警，看到可疑人物就立刻报警。
examples.english_sentence: He is very alert; when he saw a suspicious person, he immediately reported it to the police.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語）討人厭、刁難；（普通話詞義）機動車、摩托車
english_meaning: slang for being annoying, petty, or difficult; (in Mandarin) can also mean motorcycle
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞（俚語）／名詞（指車輛，普通話用法）
explanation_mandarin: 在香港廣東話中，『機車』是俚語，用來形容某人很煩、很刁鑽或態度惡劣、故意為難別人。注意在普通話中『機車』也可以指摩托車或機動車。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese, '機車' (gei1 ce1) is slang used to describe someone who is annoying, petty, or deliberately difficult. Note that in Mandarin '機車' can also mean a motorcycle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日好機車，成日搵我麻煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 hou2 gei1 ce1, sing4 jat6 wan2 ngo5 maa4 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天很機車，整天找我麻煩。
examples.english_sentence: He's being really annoying today, constantly causing me trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁機車，做乜嘢都要刁難人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 gei1 ce1, zou6 mat1 je5 dou1 jiu3 diu1 naan6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這麼機車，做什麼都要刁難別人。
examples.english_sentence: You're so petty/annoying, you make everything difficult for others.

mandarin_meaning: 机遇（有利的机会）
english_meaning: Opportunity; a favorable chance or circumstance
explanation_mandarin: 指有利的時機或機會，通常意味著能促成重要發展或改變的際遇。
explanation_english: Refers to a favorable occasion or chance, often one that can lead to significant development or change.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次出國交流係一個難得嘅機遇，對我將來好有幫助。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 ceot1 gwok3 gaau1 lau4 hai6 jat1 go3 naan4 dak1 ge3 gei1 jyu6, deoi3 ngo5 zoeng1 loi4 hou2 jau5 bong1 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次出国交流是一个难得的机遇，对我将来很有帮助。
examples.english_sentence: This exchange abroad is a rare opportunity and will be very helpful for my future.

mandarin_meaning: 機場鐵路 / 機場快線
english_meaning: Airport Express (airport railway)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，常指香港的機場鐵路或機場快線（前往機場的鐵路服務）。
explanation_english: A colloquial term referring to the airport railway or Airport Express in Hong Kong (the rail service to the airport).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我搭機鐵去機場，十幾分鐘就到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daap3 gei1 tit3 heoi3 gei1 coeng4, sap6 gei2 fan1 zung1 zau6 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我坐機鐵去機場，十幾分鐘就到。
examples.english_sentence: I took the Airport Express to the airport; it takes just over ten minutes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 機鐵班次唔多，要早啲出發，免得趕唔切。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei1 tit3 baan1 ci3 m4 do1, jiu3 zou2 di1 ceot1 faat3, min5 dak1 gon2 m4 cit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 機鐵班次不多，要早點出發，免得趕不及。
examples.english_sentence: There aren't many Airport Express departures, so leave earlier to avoid missing your train.

mandarin_meaning: 机长
english_meaning: pilot; captain (of an aircraft)
explanation_mandarin: 指飛機上負責駕駛與整體飛行安全的首席飛行員，對航班有最終決定權。
explanation_english: The pilot in command of an aircraft; the captain responsible for flying the plane and the overall safety and final decisions for the flight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家係我哋班機嘅機長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai6 ngo5 dei6 baan1 gei1 ge3 gei1 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在是我们这班飞机的机长。
examples.english_sentence: He is now the captain of our flight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 機長喺廣播入面講話天氣好，可以準時起飛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei1 zoeng2 hai2 gwong2 bo3 jap6 min6 gong2 waa6 tin1 hei3 hou2, ho2 ji5 zeon2 si4 hei2 fei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 机长在广播中说天气良好，可以准时起飞。
examples.english_sentence: The captain announced over the speaker that the weather is good and we can depart on time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺緊急情況下，機長有最終決定權。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gan2 gap1 cing4 fong3 haa6, gei1 zoeng2 jau5 zeoi3 zung1 kyut3 ding6 kyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在紧急情况下，机长有最终决定权。
examples.english_sentence: In an emergency, the captain has the final authority.

mandarin_meaning: 机关；機構；機械裝置；（口）詭計、圈套
english_meaning: agency/organization; mechanism/device; (colloquial) trick or plot
explanation_mandarin: 名词。1) 指政府或其他組織的部門、機構（例如：行政機關）。2) 指機械的構造或裝置（例如：鐘錶的機關）。3) 口語中可指詭計、圈套或陰謀。
explanation_english: Noun. 1) An agency, department, or organization (e.g., a government agency). 2) A mechanical mechanism or device (e.g., the mechanism inside a clock). 3) Colloquially, a trick, plot, or scheme.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個機關話佢哋會跟進呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 gei1-gwaan1 waa6 keoi5 dei6 wui5 gan1-zeon3 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个机关说他们会跟进这件事。
examples.english_sentence: That agency said they will follow up on this matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部鐘嘅機關壞咗，唔會走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 zung1 ge3 gei1-gwaan1 waai6 zo2, m4 wui5 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这只钟的机关坏了，不会走了。
examples.english_sentence: The mechanism of this clock is broken; it stopped working.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日諗機關整蠱人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4-jat6 lam2 gei1-gwaan1 zing2-gu2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想出机关整别人。
examples.english_sentence: He is always thinking up tricks to fool people.

mandarin_meaning: 机关枪
english_meaning: machine gun
explanation_mandarin: 一种自动或半自动的枪械，能够快速连续射击，常见于军事用途。
explanation_english: A firearm capable of rapid, continuous fire; commonly used in military contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰部機關槍好重，兩個人都拎唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 bou6 gei1 gwaan1 coeng1 hou2 zung6, loeng5 go3 jan4 dou1 ling1 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那挺机关枪很重，兩個人都拿不動。
examples.english_sentence: That machine gun is very heavy; two people can't lift it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢快到好似機關槍，聽得我頭都暈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 faai3 dou3 hou2 ci5 gei1 gwaan1 coeng1, teng1 dak1 ngo5 tau4 dou1 wan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话快得像机关枪，听得我头都晕。
examples.english_sentence: He talks so fast like a machine gun that it makes my head spin.

mandarin_meaning: 机关算尽
english_meaning: to exhaust all schemes; to plot every trick (often implying ultimate failure or being exposed)
explanation_mandarin: 指用盡各種心機、機關和手段來算計、設謀，常含貶義，並常暗示最終被識破或失敗。
explanation_english: Refers to using every trick or stratagem to scheme or manipulate; usually pejorative and often implies the plots are eventually discovered or fail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以為自己機關算盡，點知最後都俾人識破。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5wai6 zi6 gei2 gei1 gwaan1 syun3 zeon6, dim2 zi1 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 bei2 jan4 sik1 po3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以為自己机关算尽，没想到最后还是被人识破了。
examples.english_sentence: He thought he had exhausted all his schemes, but in the end he was exposed.

mandarin_meaning: 机电；机电（指机械与电气相关的领域或设备）
english_meaning: mechanical and electrical; electromechanical (relating to machinery and electrical systems/equipment)
explanation_mandarin: “机电”指机械与电气相关的领域、设备或工程，常见於“机电工程”“机电设备”“机电一体化”等词组中。
explanation_english: “機電” refers to the mechanical and electrical aspects of equipment, systems, or disciplines—often used in terms like "mechanical and electrical engineering," "M&E systems," or "electromechanical equipment."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺大學讀機電工程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 daai6 hok6 duk6 gei1 din6 gung1 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在大学读机电工程。
examples.english_sentence: He is studying mechanical and electrical engineering at university.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司專門做機電設備維修。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zyun1 mun4 zou6 gei1 din6 cit3 bei6 wai4 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司专门做机电设备维修。
examples.english_sentence: This company specializes in electromechanical equipment maintenance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新樓嘅機電系統要安裝好先可以用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 lau4 ge3 gei1 din6 hai6 tung2 jiu3 ngon1 zong1 hou2 sin1 ho2 ji5 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新楼的机电系统要安装好才能使用。
examples.english_sentence: The new building's mechanical and electrical systems need to be installed properly before they can be used.

mandarin_meaning: 机灵（反应快、聪明、机智）
english_meaning: clever; quick-witted; alert; smart
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人反應快、靈活或精明，能迅速應對情況或想到辦法。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is quick to react, sharp, or resourceful — able to respond or come up with solutions quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好機靈，學嘢好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 gei1 ling4, hok6 je5 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很机灵，學東西很快。
examples.english_sentence: He's very quick-witted and learns things fast.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細路仔好機靈，成日有新主意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3 lou6 zai2 hou2 gei1 ling4, sing4 jat6 jau5 san1 zyu2 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個小孩子很机灵，總是有新主意。
examples.english_sentence: That kid is very clever; he always has new ideas.

mandarin_meaning: 机顶盒（用于接收和解码电视信号的设备）
english_meaning: set-top box (a device that receives and decodes television signals)
explanation_mandarin: 連接在電視上的裝置，用來接收、解碼並播放有線、衛星或IPTV等來源的電視信號。
explanation_english: A device that connects to a television to receive, decode, and play signals from cable, satellite, or IPTV providers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 客廳嘅機頂盒插咗線，但冇訊號。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haak3 teng1 ge3 gei1 ding2 hap6 caap3 zo2 sin3, daan6 mou5 seon3 hou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 客廳的机顶盒已經插上電源，但沒有訊號。
examples.english_sentence: The set-top box in the living room is plugged in, but there's no signal.

mandarin_meaning: 橡（xiàng）——指橡樹、橡木；在複合詞中可指橡膠（如橡膠）
english_meaning: oak; oak wood; (in compounds) rubber
explanation_mandarin: 「橡」常作名詞，表示橡樹或橡木，在複合詞如「橡膠」中用以表示橡膠或橡膠製品。廣東話中常見於詞語如「橡膠」「橡木」。
explanation_english: The character refers to oak or oak wood and appears in compounds to mean rubber (e.g., 橡膠). In Cantonese it is commonly seen in words like 橡膠 (rubber) and 橡木 (oak wood).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張枱係用橡木整嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 toi2 hai6 jung6 zoeng6 muk6 zing2 ge3
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這張桌子是用橡木做的。
examples.english_sentence: This table is made of oak.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落雨要著橡膠鞋，防止滑倒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 jyu5 jiu3 zoek3 zoeng6 gaau1 haai4, fong4 zi2 waat6 dou2
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下雨天要穿橡膠鞋，防止滑倒。
examples.english_sentence: Wear rubber shoes on rainy days to prevent slipping.

mandarin_meaning: 橡皮（口語，常指橡皮擦）；也可指橡膠（作為材料）
english_meaning: eraser (rubber used to erase pencil marks); rubber (material)
explanation_mandarin: 「橡皮」在粵語中常用來指代用來擦鉛筆痕跡的橡皮擦，有時也泛指橡膠材料或橡膠製品。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, 橡皮 commonly refers to an eraser (used to remove pencil marks). It can also refer broadly to rubber as a material or rubber products.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我冇帶橡皮，可以借我塊橡皮用吓嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mou5 daai3 zoeng6 pei4, ho2 ji5 ze3 ngo5 faai3 zoeng6 pei4 jung6 haa5 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我沒有帶橡皮，可以借我一塊橡皮用一下嗎？
examples.english_sentence: I didn't bring an eraser. Can I borrow your eraser for a bit?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢對鞋用橡皮做底，耐磨啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 deoi3 haai4 jung6 zoeng6 pei4 zou6 dai2, noi6 mo4 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這雙鞋用橡皮做鞋底，更耐磨一些。
examples.english_sentence: These shoes use rubber soles, so they're more durable.

mandarin_meaning: 橡皮圈 / 橡膠圈（xiàng pí quān）
english_meaning: rubber band
explanation_mandarin: 指由橡膠或彈性材料製成的圈狀物，常用來捆綁、固定或整理物品。
explanation_english: A circular band made of rubber or elastic material, commonly used to bind, secure, or organize items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以借條橡皮圈畀我？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 ze3 tiu4 hoeng6 pei4 hyun1 bei2 ngo5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以借我一條橡皮圈嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Can you lend me a rubber band?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我用條橡皮圈將啲信綁埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jung6 tiu4 hoeng6 pei4 hyun1 zoeng1 di1 seon3 bong2 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我用橡皮圈把信捆起來。
examples.english_sentence: I used a rubber band to bundle the letters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條橡皮圈斷咗，要換一條。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 hoeng6 pei4 hyun1 dyun6 zo2, jiu3 wun6 jat1 tiu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 橡皮圈斷了，要換一條。
examples.english_sentence: The rubber band snapped; I need to replace it.

mandarin_meaning: 橡皮圖章（比喻）
english_meaning: rubber stamp (figurative)
explanation_mandarin: 原指用來蓋章的橡皮印章。比喻某個機構、委員會或個人只是形式上批准或同意，沒有獨立判斷或實質影響力。
explanation_english: Literally a rubber stamp. Figuratively, it describes an organization, committee, or person that merely gives formal approval without independent judgment or real influence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個委員會淨係做橡皮圖章，完全冇發表意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 wai2 jyun4 wui6 zing6 hai6 zou6 zoeng6 pei4 tou4 zoeng1, jyun4 cyun4 mou5 faat3 biu2 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个委员会只是个橡皮图章，完全没有发表意见。
examples.english_sentence: That committee is just a rubber stamp; it never expresses any independent opinion.

mandarin_meaning: 軟糖；有彈性的糖果（如小熊軟糖）
english_meaning: gummy candy; chewy, rubbery candy (e.g., gummy bears)
explanation_mandarin: 指質地有彈性、軟而有嚼勁的糖果，常見種類包括小熊軟糖、果味軟糖等。
explanation_english: Refers to chewy, elastic candies with a rubbery texture; common types include gummy bears and fruit-flavored gummies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意食橡皮糖，果味嗰啲最好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 zoeng6 pei4 tong4, gwo2 mei6 go2 di1 zeoi3 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很喜歡吃軟糖，水果味的最好吃。
examples.english_sentence: I really like eating gummy candy; the fruit-flavored ones taste the best.

mandarin_meaning: 橡皮筋；橡膠製的環狀彈性物
english_meaning: rubber band; elastic band
explanation_mandarin: 指用橡膠或彈性材料做成的環狀物，常用來綑紮或固定物件。在口語中也常與「皮筋」互換使用。
explanation_english: A loop of rubber or elastic material used to hold or bind items together. Commonly used in everyday contexts and often interchangeable with the colloquial term "pei gan" (皮筋).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以借我條橡筋？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 ze3 ngo5 tiu4 zoeng6 gan1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以把那條橡皮筋借給我嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Can you lend me a rubber band?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我用條橡筋綁住啲文件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jung6 tiu4 zoeng6 gan1 bong2 zyu6 di1 man4 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我用一條橡皮筋把文件綁起來。
examples.english_sentence: I used a rubber band to hold the documents together.

mandarin_meaning: 橡皮筋圈；用橡膠做的圈子（可當髮圈或綁東西用）
english_meaning: rubber band; elastic loop (used to tie hair or bind objects)
explanation_mandarin: 指由橡膠或彈性材料做成的環狀物，可用來綁東西或當作紮頭髮的髮圈。廣東話中常用於指小型彈性圈。
explanation_english: A loop made of rubber or elastic material used to bind items or as a hair tie. In Cantonese it's commonly used to refer to small elastic loops.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以借我條橡筋箍？我要紮頭髮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 ze3 ngo5 tiu4 joeng6 gan1 gu1? ngo5 jiu3 zaat3 tau4faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以借我一條橡皮筋圈嗎？我要紮頭髮。
examples.english_sentence: Can you lend me a rubber band? I want to tie my hair.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲橡筋箍好易斷，要買啲耐用嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 joeng6 gan1 gu1 hou2 ji6 dyun6, jiu3 maai5 di1 noi6 jung6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些橡皮筋圈很容易斷，要買些耐用的。
examples.english_sentence: These rubber bands break easily; we should buy some durable ones.

mandarin_meaning: 松紧裤；带松紧腰的裤子
english_meaning: elastic-waist pants; pants or shorts with an elastic waistband
explanation_mandarin: 指腰部用松紧带或橡皮筋的裤子，通常穿着舒适、方便活动，常见於居家或运动服装。
explanation_english: Refers to pants whose waistband is elastic (an elastic band); typically comfortable and easy to wear, common as loungewear, sportswear, or casual clothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日著橡筋褲喺屋企瞓覺或者煲劇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zoek3 zoeng6 gan1 fu3 hai2 uk1 kei2 fan3 gaau3 waak6 ze2 bou1 kek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他常常穿著橡筋裤在家睡覺或看劇。
examples.english_sentence: He often wears elastic-waist pants at home to sleep or watch shows.

mandarin_meaning: 橡胶（材料）
english_meaning: rubber (material)
explanation_mandarin: 指從橡樹提取或人工合成的有彈性材料，常用於製造輪胎、密封件、鞋底等。
explanation_english: Refers to an elastic material extracted from rubber trees or produced synthetically, commonly used for tires, seals, soles, and other products.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個手柄係用橡膠做嘅，握住好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sau2 bing2 hai6 jung6 joeng6-gaau1 zou6 ge3, ngok6 zyu6 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個手柄是用橡膠做的，握著很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: This handle is made of rubber; it feels comfortable to hold.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條橡膠帶斷咗，要換一條。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 joeng6-gaau1 daai3 dyun6 zo2, jiu3 wun6 jat1 tiu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這條橡膠帶斷了，要換一條。
examples.english_sentence: This rubber strap has broken; it needs to be replaced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 橡膠可以做密封圈、墊片同埋車胎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: joeng6-gaau1 ho2 ji5 zou6 mat6 fung1 hyun1, din6 pin3 tung4 maai4 ce1 taai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 橡膠可以用來做密封圈、墊片以及車胎。
examples.english_sentence: Rubber can be used to make seals, gaskets, and tires.

mandarin_meaning: 橡膠子彈（又稱橡皮子彈），一種用橡膠或橡膠包覆的非致命性彈丸，常用於鎮暴或控制人群
english_meaning: rubber bullet — a less-lethal projectile made of rubber (or rubber-coated) often used for crowd control or riot suppression
explanation_mandarin: 指用橡膠製成或包覆的彈丸，警方或安全部隊有時用作非致命性武器以驅散或控制人群，但仍可能造成嚴重受傷或致命風險。
explanation_english: Refers to projectiles made of or coated with rubber, used by police or security forces as a less-lethal weapon for dispersing or controlling crowds; however, they can still cause serious injury or death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方喺示威期間發射咗橡膠子彈，導致多人受傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 hai2 si6 wai1 kei4 gaan1 faat3 se6 zo2 hoeng6 gaau1 zi2 daan6, dou6 zi3 do1 jan4 sau6 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方在示威期間發射了橡膠子彈，導致多人受傷。
examples.english_sentence: The police fired rubber bullets during the protest, resulting in multiple injuries.

mandarin_meaning: 椭（表示椭圆、椭圆形的“橢”，用于构成词语，如“橢圓”）
english_meaning: oval; elliptical (used as the morpheme meaning 'oval' in compounds)
explanation_mandarin: “橢”表示椭圆或椭圆形，通常不单独使用，多见于复合词中，如“橢圓”、“橢圓形”。
explanation_english: “橢” denotes an oval or elliptical shape. It usually appears as part of compound words (e.g., 橢圓) rather than standing alone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個蛋糕係橢圓形嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 daan6 gou1 hai6 to4 jyun4 jing4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个蛋糕是椭圆形的。
examples.english_sentence: This cake is oval-shaped.

mandarin_meaning: 椭圆（橢圓）
english_meaning: ellipse; elliptical
explanation_mandarin: 橢圓是一種平面幾何圖形，類似拉長的圓；平面上任一點到兩個焦點的距離之和為常數。
explanation_english: An ellipse is a plane geometric figure resembling a stretched circle; for any point on the ellipse, the sum of the distances to the two foci is constant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 畫一個橢圓，你要知道兩個焦點同長軸同短軸嘅長度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waa6 jat1 go3 to2 jyun4, nei5 jiu3 zi1 dou3 loeng5 go3 ziu1 dim2 tung4 coeng4 zuk6 tung4 dyun2 zuk6 ge3 coeng4 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 畫一個橢圓，你要知道兩個焦點和長軸、短軸的長度。
examples.english_sentence: To draw an ellipse, you need to know the two foci and the lengths of the major and minor axes.

mandarin_meaning: 椭圆形（tuǒyuánxíng）
english_meaning: oval; ellipse
explanation_mandarin: 表示一種扁長、兩端彎曲的幾何圖形，即椭圆，常用於描述物件的形狀或數學上的橢圓曲線。
explanation_english: Refers to an oval or ellipse — a flattened circular shape with curved ends. Used to describe shapes in everyday objects and in geometry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張餐枱係橢圓形，可以坐多人，較方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 caan1 toi2 hai6 to2 jyun4 jing4, ho2 ji5 co5 do1 jan4, gaau3 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這張餐桌是橢圓形，可以坐較多人，比較方便。
examples.english_sentence: This dining table is oval; it can seat more people and is more convenient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅圖上面畫咗一個橢圓形。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 tou4 soeng6 min6 waak6 zo2 jat1 go3 to2 jyun4 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這幅圖上面畫了一個橢圓形。
examples.english_sentence: There's an ellipse drawn on this picture.

mandarin_meaning: 横（héng / hèng）：表示水平方向、橫放；也可表示專橫、粗暴、不講理
english_meaning: horizontal; across; (of a person) domineering, arbitrary, forceful
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容词 / 副词 / 动词
explanation_mandarin: 可表示物件的水平方向或橫放；在口語中常用來形容人專橫、粗暴、任性或強勢的行為或態度。
explanation_english: Can indicate a horizontal orientation or placement; colloquially often used to describe someone as domineering, violent, arbitrary, or forceful in behavior or attitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張紙要擺橫啲，先至夠闊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 zi2 jiu3 baai2 waang4 di1, sin1 zi6 gau3 fut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 紙要橫著放，才夠寬。
examples.english_sentence: Put the paper horizontally so it's wide enough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做事好橫，成日唔聽人講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 si6 hou2 waang4, sing4 jat6 m4 teng1 jan4 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很專橫，總是不聽別人勸。
examples.english_sentence: He acts really domineering and never listens to others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰班人喺街頭橫行，無人敢阻佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 baan1 jan4 hai2 gaai1 tau4 waang4 hang4, mou5 jan4 gam2 zo2 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那幫人在街上橫行，沒人敢阻止他們。
examples.english_sentence: Those people are running rampant on the street; no one dares to stop them.

mandarin_meaning: 雜亂無序、亂七八糟
english_meaning: in a mess; chaotic; disorderly
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容東西排列或狀況非常凌亂、沒有秩序。
explanation_english: Used to describe things arranged chaotically or a situation that is very messy and disordered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間房擺得橫七豎八，我唔知點開始收好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong2 baai2 dak1 waang4 cat1 syu6 baat3, ngo5 m4 zi1 dim2 hoi1 ci2 sau1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房間摆得横七竖八，我不知道從哪裡開始收拾。
examples.english_sentence: The room is a mess; I don't know where to start tidying up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲文件擺滿張枱，橫七豎八，等陣先整理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 man4 gin2 baai2 mun5 zoeng1 toi2, waang4 cat1 syu6 baat3, dang2 zan6 sin1 zing2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 文件摆滿了桌子，横七竖八，等一下再整理。
examples.english_sentence: The documents are all over the table in disorder; I'll sort them out in a bit.

mandarin_meaning: 很倔強、固執，不肯妥協（有時帶有強硬或好鬧的語氣）
english_meaning: stubborn/obstinate and uncooperative (sometimes aggressive or truculent)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語俚語，用來形容人性格倔強、任性或態度強硬、難以說服；語氣可帶有輕微貶義或玩笑成分，常見於香港口語。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang term describing someone who is stubborn, uncooperative, or willfully contrary; the tone can be mildly derogatory or joking and is common in Hong Kong speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日咁橫丫腸，連屋企人講佢都唔聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gam2 waang4 aa1 coeng4, lin4 uk1 kei2 jan4 gong2 keoi5 dou1 m4 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是這麼固執，連家人勸他都不聽。
examples.english_sentence: He's always so stubborn and uncooperative; he won't even listen to his family.

mandarin_meaning: 橫穿馬路；亂穿馬路（口語）
english_meaning: to jaywalk; to cross the road recklessly (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用語，指不按規則或魯莽地橫穿馬路，常含有不顧安全之意。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to cross the road carelessly or jaywalk, often implying disregard for safety.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺呢度橫丫路，太危險啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 ni1 dou6 waang4 aa1 lou6, taai3 ngai4him2 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在這裡橫穿馬路，太危險了！
examples.english_sentence: Don't jaywalk here — it's too dangerous!

mandarin_meaning: 亂七八糟；混亂、不整齊的狀態
english_meaning: messy; chaotic; in a state of disarray
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用語，形容某處或某事很亂、不整齊，常用來形容房間、桌面或安排混亂。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression used to describe a place or situation that is messy, chaotic, or disorderly; often used for rooms, desks, or disorganized arrangements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企又橫九掂十，你快啲收拾吓啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei5 jau6 waang4 gau2 dim3 sap6, nei5 faai3 di1 sau1 sap6 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家裡又亂七八糟，你快點收拾一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: The house is a mess again — tidy it up quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 横传（将球横向传给队友，常见于足球或篮球）
english_meaning: lateral pass; square pass (to pass the ball sideways to a teammate, common in football/soccer and basketball)
explanation_mandarin: 指在球场上把球横向传给队友，通常用于足球或篮球等球类比赛，常见用法为“橫傳入禁區”“橫傳波”。
explanation_english: Refers to passing the ball sideways to a teammate on the field. Common in sports like football (soccer) and basketball; often used in phrases like “lateral pass into the penalty area.”

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢橫傳入禁區，前鋒一腳射入咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hoeng4 cyun4 jap6 gam3 keoi1, cin4 fung1 jat1 goek3 se6 jap6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他横传到禁区，前锋一脚射门得手。
examples.english_sentence: He made a lateral pass into the penalty area, and the striker scored with one shot.

mandarin_meaning: 粗暴地打斷／壓制（別人說話或意見）
english_meaning: to rudely/forcefully cut someone off or shut someone down (in conversation); to drown out or suppress others' opinions
explanation_mandarin: 口語（帶有粗俗色彩）的香港粵語用語，表示以強勢或粗暴的方式打斷、壓制或蓋過別人的講話或意見。
explanation_english: A colloquial (often coarse) Hong Kong Cantonese slang term meaning to abruptly or forcefully cut someone off, shut them down, or overpower their opinion in conversation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日橫冚我講嘢，唔畀我講完。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 waang4 ham2 ngo5 gong2 je5, m4 bei2 ngo5 gong2 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是粗暴地打斷我說話，不讓我說完。
examples.english_sentence: He always rudely cuts me off when I speak and doesn't let me finish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 會議上有人橫冚其他人嘅意見，氣氛變得好差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wui6 ji5 soeng6 jau5 jan4 waang4 ham2 kei4 taa1 jan4 ge3 ji3 gin3, hei3 fan1 bin3 dak1 hou2 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 會議上有人把別人的意見強行壓制，氣氛變得很差。
examples.english_sentence: At the meeting someone shut down others' opinions, and the atmosphere turned really bad.

mandarin_meaning: 横刀夺爱（插足他人感情，夺走恋人）
english_meaning: to swoop in and steal someone's lover; to interfere in a romantic relationship and take away a partner
explanation_mandarin: 形容第三者介入他人恋爱关系，夺走对方的爱人，含贬义。
explanation_english: An idiom describing a third party intervening in someone else's romantic relationship and taking their partner; carries a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日橫刀奪愛，咁樣只會傷害人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 waang4 dou1 dyut6 oi3, gam2 joeng6 zi2 wui5 soeng1 hoi6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是横刀夺爱，这样只会伤害别人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep swooping in to steal people's lovers; that will only hurt others.

mandarin_meaning: 横切面
english_meaning: cross-section (transverse section)
explanation_mandarin: 表示沿物體橫向切開後所顯示的截面，常用於解剖、工程、材料分析或影像檢查中。
explanation_english: Refers to the surface or view obtained by cutting an object transversely; commonly used in anatomy, engineering, materials analysis, or imaging (e.g., CT/MRI) to show internal structure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋切開蘋果，睇到一個橫切面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 cit3 hoi1 ping4 gwo2, tai2 dou3 jat1 go3 waang4 cit3 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們切開蘋果，看到一個橫切面。
examples.english_sentence: We cut open the apple and saw a cross-section.

mandarin_meaning: 横向
english_meaning: horizontal; lateral; sideways
explanation_mandarin: 表示與垂直相對的方向，指水平方向或側向的移動或排列方式。
explanation_english: Indicates a direction or orientation across the horizontal axis; used to describe something arranged, moving, or oriented side-to-side rather than up-and-down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅圖係橫向擺放，方便睇到整體趨勢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 tou4 hai6 waang4 hoeng3 baai2 fong3, fong1 bin6 tai2 dou3 zing2 tai2 ceoi1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這幅圖是橫向擺放，方便看到整體趨勢。
examples.english_sentence: This chart is placed horizontally, making it easier to see the overall trend.

mandarin_meaning: 屍橫遍野；街頭到處都是屍體
english_meaning: corpses strewn across the streets; bodies lying all over the streets (describing mass death or a gruesome scene)
explanation_mandarin: 用來描述戰亂、災難或暴力事件後街頭到處都是屍體的慘烈景象，既可作為字面描述，也可用來誇張地形容局勢嚴重。
explanation_english: Used to describe a horrific scene where corpses are scattered across the streets after war, disaster, or violent incidents. It can be used literally or figuratively to emphasize extreme severity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 戰亂之後，成個城入面都係橫屍街頭，景象慘不忍睹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zin3 lyun6 zi1 hau6, sing4 go3 sing4 jap6 min6 dou1 hai6 waang4 si1 gaai1 tau4, ging2 zoeng6 caam2 bat1 jan2 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 戰亂之後，整個城市街頭到處都是屍體，景象慘不忍睹。
examples.english_sentence: After the conflict, the whole city had corpses strewn across the streets; the scene was harrowing.

mandarin_meaning: 横批；春联上方横向的题词或匾额
english_meaning: horizontal inscription/banner (the horizontal title placed above a pair of couplets, often during Lunar New Year)
explanation_mandarin: 指貼在春聯上方、橫向書寫的題詞或匾額，通常為四字成語或短語，用以概括對聯主旨或表達祝福。
explanation_english: Refers to the horizontal inscription placed above couplets (such as Spring Festival couplets); typically a four-character phrase or short slogan that summarizes the couplets' theme or expresses a blessing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年貼春聯嘅時候，要記得掛好橫批。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 tip3 ceon1 lyun4 ge3 si4 hau6, jiu3 gei3 dak1 gwaa3 hou2 waang4 pai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 貼春聯的時候，要記得把橫批掛好。
examples.english_sentence: When putting up spring couplets for Lunar New Year, remember to hang the horizontal banner properly.

mandarin_meaning: 反正 / 無論如何
english_meaning: anyway; in any case; regardless
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，表示不論情況如何、強調既定事實或敷衍意味，相當於「反正／橫豎」。常置於句中或句首，用來淡化差別或表示無所謂。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese adverb meaning 'anyway' or 'in any case.' It indicates disregard for alternatives or emphasizes an outcome is inevitable — similar to 'anyway' or 'either way.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想唔想去都無所謂，橫掂我哋都會去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 m4 soeng2 heoi3 dou1 mou4 so2 wai6, waang4 dim6 ngo5 dei6 dou1 wui5 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想不想去都無所谓，反正我们都会去。
examples.english_sentence: Whether you want to go or not doesn't matter — we're going anyway.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事橫掂都要做，唔好再拖喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 waang4 dim6 dou1 jiu3 zou6, m4 hou2 zoi3 to1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事反正都要做，别再拖了。
examples.english_sentence: This has to be done anyway, so stop procrastinating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買唔買都無所謂，橫掂價錢都貴得差唔多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 m4 maai5 dou1 mou4 so2 wai6, waang4 dim6 gaa3 cin2 dou1 gwai3 dak1 caa1 m4 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 买不买都无所谓，反正价格都差不多很贵。
examples.english_sentence: Whether we buy it or not doesn't matter — the price is pretty expensive either way.

mandarin_meaning: 横扫 (héngsǎo)：彻底清除或在比赛中取得压倒性胜利
english_meaning: to sweep; to sweep away; to achieve an overwhelming victory (a clean sweep)
explanation_mandarin: 表示徹底掃除或摧毀；在競賽語境中常指以壓倒性優勢擊敗所有對手，取得全部勝利。
explanation_english: Means to sweep away completely or to obliterate; in competitive contexts it often means to defeat all opponents decisively, achieving a clean sweep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 球隊今季橫掃咗所有對手，贏晒所有比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kau4 deoi6 gam1 gwai3 waang4 sou3 zo2 so2 jau5 deoi3 sau2, jing4 saai3 so2 jau5 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球隊本賽季橫掃了所有對手，贏下了所有比賽。
examples.english_sentence: The team swept all its opponents this season, winning every match.

mandarin_meaning: 横扫千军
english_meaning: to achieve a sweeping victory; to sweep aside all opponents
explanation_mandarin: 原指軍隊橫掃敵軍，後用來比喻取得壓倒性勝利，擊潰所有對手或快速取得巨大勝果。
explanation_english: Originally referred to an army sweeping through enemy ranks; figuratively it means to win decisively or to wipe out all opposition, achieving a comprehensive victory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次比賽，我哋隊橫掃千軍，贏晒所有場次。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 bei2 coi3, ngo5 dei6 deoi6 waang4 sou3 cin1 gwan1, jing4 saai3 so2 jau5 coeng4 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次比赛，我们队横扫千军，赢下了所有场次。
