explanation_english: A drink made from lemon and water (often with sugar or ice). Common in Hong Kong and other Chinese-speaking areas. Note: colloquially '檸檬' can imply jealousy, but '檸檬水' primarily refers to the beverage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想飲杯檸檬水，天氣咁熱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 jam2 bui1 ning4 mung1 seoi2, tin1 hei3 gam2 jit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想喝一杯檸檬水，天氣這麼熱。
examples.english_sentence: I want a glass of lemon water — it's so hot.

mandarin_meaning: 柠檬茶
english_meaning: lemon tea
explanation_mandarin: 由茶和檸檬製成的飲料，可熱飲或冰飲。香港常見的茶餐廳和飲品店會供應檸檬茶，口味可偏酸或加糖調和。
explanation_english: A beverage made from tea and lemon, served hot or iced. Common in Hong Kong cafés and tea restaurants; flavor can be tart or sweetened to taste.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想飲檸檬茶，最好係凍嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 jam2 ning4 mung1 caa4, zeoi3 hou2 hai6 dung3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想喝柠檬茶，最好是冰的。
examples.english_sentence: I want to drink lemon tea; preferably iced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺茶餐廳佢啱啱端咗杯熱檸檬茶畀我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 caa4 caan1 teng1 keoi5 aam1 aam1 dyun1 zo2 bui1 jit6 ning4 mung1 caa4 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在茶餐厅他刚端给我一杯热柠檬茶。
examples.english_sentence: At the cha chaan teng, he just brought me a cup of hot lemon tea.

mandarin_meaning: 檸檬水
english_meaning: lemon water / lemonade
explanation_mandarin: 「檸水」是粵語口語，指以檸檬加水（常加糖，亦有時加梳打水）製作的飲品，常見於香港茶餐廳。視乎做法可稱為檸檬水、凍檸水或檸檬汽水。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "檸水" refers to lemon water or lemonade — a drink made from lemon and water, often with sugar and sometimes soda. It's commonly served in Hong Kong cha chaan tengs and can be served iced ("凍檸水") or hot depending on preparation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日好熱，飲杯凍檸水啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 hou2 jit6, jam2 bui1 dung3 ning4 seoi2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天很熱，喝杯冰檸檬水吧。
examples.english_sentence: It's hot today — have a glass of iced lemon water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想要少甜啲嘅檸水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 siu2 tim4 di1 ge3 ning4 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想要少甜一點的檸檬水。
examples.english_sentence: I want my lemon water less sweet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 茶餐廳嗰度嘅檸水好出名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caa4 caan1 teng1 go2 dou6 ge3 ning4 seoi2 hou2 ceot1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 茶餐廳那裡的檸檬水很有名。
examples.english_sentence: Their lemon water at the cha chaan teng is famous.

mandarin_meaning: 柠檬茶
english_meaning: lemon tea
explanation_mandarin: 一种在香港常见的饮品，通常以红茶加入柠檬片和糖调制，可冷饮或热饮。口味可以是冰镇的（凍檸茶）或热的。
explanation_english: A common Hong Kong beverage made by adding lemon slices (and often sugar) to black tea. It can be served hot or cold (iced lemon tea).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想飲杯檸茶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 jam2 bui1 ning4 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想喝杯柠檬茶。
examples.english_sentence: I want to drink a cup of lemon tea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間茶餐廳嘅凍檸茶好正。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caa4 caan1 teng1 ge3 dung3 ning4 caa4 hou2 zeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家茶餐厅的冻柠茶很好喝。
examples.english_sentence: The iced lemon tea at this cha chaan teng is really good.

mandarin_meaning: 檸檬蜜／蜂蜜檸檬（飲品）
english_meaning: honey lemon (drink)
explanation_mandarin: 「檸蜜」是廣東話口語，通常是「檸檬蜜」或「蜂蜜檸檬水」的簡稱，指以檸檬與蜂蜜調製的飲品。亦可用來形容味道酸甜的飲料或感覺。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "檸蜜" is a colloquial shortening of "檸檬蜜" (honey lemon) or "蜂蜜檸檬 water", referring to a drink made from lemon and honey. It can also describe a sweet-and-sour taste.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣咁熱，飲杯檸蜜最過癮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 gam2 jit6, jam2 bui1 ning4 mat6 zeoi3 gwo3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天氣這麼熱，喝杯檸蜜最過癮。
examples.english_sentence: It's so hot; a honey lemon drink would be perfect.

mandarin_meaning: 门槛；栏杆；障碍
english_meaning: threshold; sill; railing; barrier (literal or figurative)
explanation_mandarin: 檻（简体作槛）一般指門檻、窗檻或欄杆等物，也可比喻为進入、通过的门槛或限制。
explanation_english: Refers to a physical threshold, sill, or railing; can also be used figuratively to mean a hurdle, requirement, or barrier.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅入職門檻好高，唔係人人都合資格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1si1 ge3 jap6 zik1 mun4 haam2 hou2 gou1, m4 hai6 jan4 jan4 dou1 hap6 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间公司的入职门槛很高，不是人人都有资格。
examples.english_sentence: The company's hiring threshold is very high; not everyone is qualified.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開門時要小心門檻，免得絆親腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 mun4 si4 jiu3 siu2 sam1 mun4 haam2, min5 dak1 baan6 can1 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开门时要小心门槛，免得绊倒。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful of the threshold when opening the door to avoid tripping.

mandarin_meaning: 字面：有欄杆的火盆；引申：處於進退兩難或受責罵、受訓斥的困境
english_meaning: Literal: a brazier with bars (a caged brazier); Figurative: being in a tight spot or the 'hot seat' where one is subject to scolding or criticism
explanation_mandarin: 「檻火盆」為粵語中較少見或俗用的說法，字面上可理解為有欄柵的火盆。比喻用法常用來形容一個人處於被眾人指責、坐在「火窩」上難以脫身的境地或尷尬處境。
explanation_english: A relatively rare/colloquial Cantonese term. Literally a brazier enclosed by bars. Figuratively it describes someone in the 'hot seat' — trapped in an awkward situation where they are being criticized or punished and cannot easily get out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家好似坐喺檻火盆度，乜嘢講都會畀人鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hou2 ci5 co5 hai2 haam2 fo2 pun4 dou6, mat1 je5 gong2 dou1 wui5 bei2 jan4 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在好像坐在檻火盆上，無論說什麼都會被罵。
examples.english_sentence: He's like he's sitting in a caged brazier — whatever he says he'll get yelled at.

synonyms: 火上涼椅（比喻類似熱位）

mandarin_meaning: 桨；划船用的长柄器具（桨、橹）
english_meaning: oar; paddle (a long-handled implement used to row or steer a boat)
explanation_mandarin: 指划船用的長柄器具，用來推水或操控船隻，與「槳／桨」同義。
explanation_english: A long-handled implement used to propel or steer a boat by pushing against the water; synonymous with 'oar' or 'paddle'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條櫂斷咗，我哋划唔到岸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 zau2 dyun6 zo2, ngo5 dei6 waat6 m4 dou3 ngon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 桨断了，我们划不到岸。
examples.english_sentence: The oar broke; we can't row to shore.

mandarin_meaning: 柜（guì）——用于存放物品的橱柜、柜台或储物柜
english_meaning: cabinet; cupboard; counter; locker
explanation_mandarin: 指用來收納或展示物品的家具或櫃台，也可指特定用途的櫃，如雪櫃（冰箱）、文件櫃等。
explanation_english: Refers to a piece of furniture or counter used to store or display items; can also denote specific types of cabinets such as a refrigerator (雪櫃) or filing cabinet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啲衫擺咗喺新買嘅櫃入面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 di1 saam1 baai2 zo2 hai2 san1 maai5 ge3 gwai6 jap6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的衣服放在新买的柜子里。
examples.english_sentence: I put my clothes in the newly bought cabinet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雪櫃壞咗，啲嘢唔夠凍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syut3 gwai6 waai6 zo2, di1 je5 m4 dung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 冰箱坏了，东西不够冷。
examples.english_sentence: The fridge broke, the stuff isn't cold enough.

mandarin_meaning: 柜位；柜台/摊位；（柜台的）岗位或位置
english_meaning: counter; booth; stall; (a job/position at a counter/booth)
explanation_mandarin: 通常指商场、展览或市集中的柜台、摊位或其所在的位置；在职场语境下也可指在柜台工作的岗位或职位。
explanation_english: Usually refers to a counter, booth, or stall in a mall, exhibition, or market, or the location of such; in a work context it can also mean the job/position of working at a counter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新開嘅店喺商場攞咗兩個櫃位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 hoi1 ge3 dim3 hai2 soeng1 coeng4 lo2 zo2 loeng5 go3 gwai6 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新开的店在商场取得了两个柜位。
examples.english_sentence: The newly opened shop secured two booths/counters in the mall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想轉做櫃位嘅售貨員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 zyun3 zou6 gwai6 wai6 ge3 sau6 fo3 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想调去做柜台的售货员。
examples.english_sentence: I want to switch to a counter sales position.

mandarin_meaning: 柜台
english_meaning: counter; front desk
explanation_mandarin: 指商店、銀行、酒店等接待顧客或辦理業務的櫃檯或服務處。
explanation_english: A counter or desk where staff receive customers or handle transactions, such as in shops, banks, or hotels.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我去櫃台問吓可唔可以退貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 heoi3 gwai6 toi4 man6 haa5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 teoi3 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我去柜台问一下能不能退货。
examples.english_sentence: I'll go to the counter to ask if I can return the item.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺酒店辦入住嘅時候，要去櫃台拎房卡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zau2 dim3 baan6 jap6 uk1 ge3 si4 hau6, jiu3 heoi3 gwai6 toi4 ling1 fong2 kaat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在酒店办理入住时，要到柜台领取房卡。
examples.english_sentence: When checking in at the hotel, you need to go to the front desk to collect your room key card.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請喺櫃台填一張表。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 hai2 gwai6 toi4 tin4 jat1 zoeng1 biu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请在柜台填写一张表。
examples.english_sentence: Please fill out a form at the counter.

mandarin_meaning: 柜员
english_meaning: teller; cashier; counter clerk
explanation_mandarin: 指在銀行、商店或其他機構櫃台負責辦理交易、出納或接待客戶的職員。
explanation_english: Refers to staff who work at a counter in a bank, store, or other institution handling transactions, cash services, or customer assistance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺銀行等咗半個鐘先輪到櫃員幫我辦手續。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 ngan4 hong4 dang2 zo2 bun3 go3 zung1 sin1 leon4 dou3 gwai6 jyun4 bong1 ngo5 baan6 sau2 zuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在銀行等了半個小時才輪到柜員幫我辦手續。
examples.english_sentence: I waited at the bank for half an hour before it was my turn for the teller to handle my transaction.

mandarin_meaning: 自動櫃員機 / 提款機
english_meaning: automated teller machine (ATM)
explanation_mandarin: 指銀行或其他金融機構用來讓客戶領取現金、查詢帳戶或進行簡單交易的自動機器，即自動櫃員機（ATM）。
explanation_english: Refers to the bank machine used for cash withdrawals, balance inquiries, and simple transactions — the automated teller machine (ATM).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我去櫃員機攞錢，部機吞咗張卡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 heoi3 gwai6 jyun4 gei1 lo2 cin2, bou6 gei1 tan1 zo2 zoeng1 kaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我去提款機取錢，結果機器吞了我的卡。
examples.english_sentence: I went to the ATM to withdraw money, and the machine swallowed my card.

mandarin_meaning: 柜子 / 櫃子（用于存放物品的家具）
english_meaning: cabinet; cupboard; wardrobe; locker
explanation_mandarin: 指用來存放衣物、書籍或雜物的有門或抽屜的家具或箱櫃，例如衣櫃、廚櫃或書櫃。
explanation_english: A piece of furniture with doors or drawers used for storing items such as clothes, books, or household goods (e.g., wardrobe, kitchen cabinet, bookshelf).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以幫我攞下櫃子入面嗰本書？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 lo2 haa5 gwai6 zi2 jap6 min6 go2 bun2 syu1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以幫我拿一下櫃子裡面的那本書嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Can you help me get that book inside the cabinet?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廚房嘅櫃子入面有好多調味料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyu4 fong4 ge3 gwai6 zi2 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 diu6 mei6 liu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 廚房的櫃子裡有很多調味料。
examples.english_sentence: There are many condiments in the kitchen cabinet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個櫃子係鎖住㗎，要記得帶鎖匙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gwai6 zi2 hai6 so2 zyu6 gaa3, jiu3 gei3 dak1 daai3 so2 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個櫃子是鎖著的，要記得帶鑰匙。
examples.english_sentence: This cabinet is locked; remember to bring the key.

mandarin_meaning: 柜台；服务台；收银台
english_meaning: counter; service counter; cashier's counter; reception desk
explanation_mandarin: 指商店、酒店或辦公場所中用來接待顧客、查詢或收款的桌面或台面。
explanation_english: Refers to the desk or surface in a shop, hotel, or office used to serve customers, answer enquiries, or process payments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你去櫃枱問下職員，佢哋會幫你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 heoi3 gwai6 toi2 man6 haa5 zik1 jyun4, keoi5 dei6 wui5 bong1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你去柜台问一下职员，他们会帮你。
examples.english_sentence: Go to the counter and ask the staff; they'll help you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖嘅櫃枱好整潔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 ge3 gwai6 toi2 hou2 zing2 git3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店的柜台很整洁。
examples.english_sentence: The store's counter is very tidy.

mandarin_meaning: 抽屜（櫃子裡可拉出的儲物格）
english_meaning: drawer (a pull-out storage compartment in a cabinet)
explanation_mandarin: 指櫃子內可拉出以儲存物品的格子或容器，常見於衣櫃、廚櫃、辦公櫃等。
explanation_english: Refers to the pull-out compartment inside a cabinet used for storing items; commonly found in wardrobes, kitchen cabinets, and office cabinets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 櫃桶入面有啲文件，你幫我拎出嚟啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwai6 tung4 jap6 min6 jau5 di1 man4 gin6, nei5 bong1 ngo5 ling1 ceot1 lai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 抽屜裡有一些文件，你幫我拿出來吧。
examples.english_sentence: There are some documents in the drawer — please help me take them out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廚房個櫃桶鎖壞咗，開唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyu4 fong4 go3 gwai6 tung4 so2 waai6 zo2, hoi1 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 廚房的抽屜鎖壞了，打不開。
examples.english_sentence: The kitchen drawer's lock is broken and can't be opened.

mandarin_meaning: 小抽屜
english_meaning: small drawer; little drawer
explanation_mandarin: 指家具上用來放置雜物的小抽屜，「仔」帶有縮小或親暱的口語色彩。
explanation_english: Refers to a small drawer in a piece of furniture; the suffix "-zai" gives a diminutive or affectionate colloquial tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啲文件放咗喺櫃桶仔入面，等陣拎出嚟俾你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 di1 man4 gin2 fong3 zo2 hai2 gwai6 tung4 zai2 jap6 min6, dang2 zan6 ling1 ceot1 lai4 bei2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的文件放在小抽屜裡，等會拿給你。
examples.english_sentence: I put my documents in the small drawer; I'll take them out and give them to you later.

mandarin_meaning: 柜台
english_meaning: counter (e.g., service counter, reception desk)
explanation_mandarin: 指商店、銀行、酒店等場所供客人辦理業務、詢問或付款的長台或櫃位。
explanation_english: Refers to a counter or desk in places like shops, banks, or hotels where customers are served, make inquiries, or pay.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你去櫃檯問下職員啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 heoi3 gwai6 toi4 man6 haa5 zik1 jyun4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你去柜台问一下工作人员吧。
examples.english_sentence: Go ask the staff at the counter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺櫃檯付款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 gwai6 toi4 fuk6 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在柜台付款。
examples.english_sentence: I paid at the counter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 酒店嘅接待櫃檯喺大堂右手邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zau2 dim3 ge3 zip3 doi6 gwai6 toi4 hai2 daai6 tong4 jau6 sau2 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 酒店的接待柜台在大堂右手边。
examples.english_sentence: The hotel's reception desk is on the right side of the lobby.

mandarin_meaning: 櫃台；面向顧客的服務窗口（如銀行或商店的櫃台），亦可指櫃檯所處理的對客業務
english_meaning: counter; the service window facing customers (e.g., in a bank or shop); also refers to over-the-counter/front-desk operations
explanation_mandarin: 指商店或銀行等處面向顧客的櫃台或服務窗口。在香港語境中也常用來表示對客的櫃面業務或櫃面處理的工作。
explanation_english: Refers to the counter or service window in a shop, bank, etc., facing customers. In Hong Kong usage it also commonly denotes front-desk or over-the-counter operations and related work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 客人要去櫃面辦理存款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haak3 jan4 jiu3 heoi3 gwai6 min6 baan6 lei5 cyun4 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 客人要去櫃台辦理存款。
examples.english_sentence: The customer needs to go to the counter to make a deposit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺櫃面排咗好耐，終於輪到我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 gwai6 min6 paai4 zo2 hou2 noi6, zung1 jyu1 leon4 dou3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在櫃台排了很久，終於輪到我。
examples.english_sentence: I queued at the counter for a long time; finally it was my turn.

mandarin_meaning: 凳子；小板凳
english_meaning: stool; small bench
explanation_mandarin: 表示一種簡單的坐具，通常為沒有靠背的凳子，與「凳」意思相近。
explanation_english: A simple seat, typically a backless stool or small bench; synonymous with 'stool'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 拎張櫈出嚟俾客人坐下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ling1 zoeng1 dang2 ceot1 lai4 bei2 haak3 jan4 co5 haa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把凳子拿出來給客人坐。
examples.english_sentence: Take out a stool for the guest to sit on.

mandarin_meaning: 小凳子；小椅子（粵語口語）
english_meaning: a small stool; little seat (Cantonese colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「櫈仔」是粵語口語，指體積較小的凳子或小椅子，常見於家庭、街市或茶樓等處，語氣較為口語化。
explanation_english: “櫈仔” is Cantonese colloquial for a small stool or little seat, commonly found at home, markets, or tea houses; the term is informal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你拎個櫈仔嚟畀我坐得唔得？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ling1 go3 dang2 zai2 lai4 bei2 ngo5 co5 dak1 m4 dak1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你拿把小凳子過來給我坐可以嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Can you bring me that little stool to sit on?

mandarin_meaning: 倚靠椅子（字面）；比喻仗着位置或坐享其成、偷懶（引申）
english_meaning: Literally: to lean on a chair; Figuratively: to rely on one's position/status or to sit back and do nothing
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞（口語/俚語，偏向地區性用法）
explanation_mandarin: 「櫈憑」為粵語口語用法，字面上可理解為倚靠或靠在椅／凳上。引申義上常用來形容某人仗着地位、身份或只是坐着不做事、偷懶。此詞較口語且地區性，並不一定在所有粵語區通行。
explanation_english: “櫈憑” is a Cantonese colloquial expression. Literally it means leaning on a chair/stool. Figuratively it is used to describe someone who relies on their position/status or who just sits back and does nothing (i.e., being idle or shirking work). The term is informal and regionally used.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好淨係櫈憑喇，出嚟幫手啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 dang3 peng4 laa3，ceot1 lai4 bong1 sau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要只是坐着不动，出来帮忙吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just sit there doing nothing — come help.

mandarin_meaning: 椅子或凳子的腳（支撐部分）
english_meaning: the leg of a chair or stool; the support that touches the floor
explanation_mandarin: 指椅子、凳子等家具用來支撐、接觸地面的部分，也可用於描述該處損壞或需更換的情況。
explanation_english: Refers to the part of a chair or stool that supports it and contacts the floor; can also be used when describing damage or replacement of that part.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張櫈嘅櫈腳斷咗，坐唔穩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 dang2 ge3 dang2 goek3 dyun6 zo2, co5 m4 wan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那張凳子的凳腳壞了，坐不穩。
examples.english_sentence: The leg of that stool is broken; it isn't stable to sit on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張櫈修好咗，換咗新櫈腳就穩返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 dang2 sau1 hou2 zo2, wun6 zo2 san1 dang2 goek3 zau6 wan2 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那張凳子修好了，換了新的凳腳就穩了。
examples.english_sentence: The stool was repaired; after replacing the leg it became stable.

mandarin_meaning: 坐着无所事事；游手好闲（俗語/俚語）
english_meaning: to sit idly / to loaf around; (slang) a bench‑warmer or someone who does nothing
explanation_mandarin: 「櫈𩩍」是廣東話俚語，字面上有「坐在凳上」的意思，常用來形容人在一旁無所事事、遊手好閒或只坐着不幫忙。屬口語或俗語用法，地區性較強，常見於香港口語。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term literally referring to sitting on a stool; it is used to describe someone who sits around doing nothing or shirks work (a bench‑warmer / idler). It is informal and regionally used (e.g. Hong Kong).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺度做櫈𩩍，冇乜幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 zou6 dang2 lap3, mou5 mat1 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常坐在那裡閒著，沒怎麼幫忙。
examples.english_sentence: He always just sits there doing nothing and doesn't help much.

mandarin_meaning: 橹 / 桨（用来划船的长形器具）
english_meaning: oar; paddle
explanation_mandarin: 指用來划船的長形器具，亦稱槳或櫂，用以推動或掌舵。
explanation_english: A long handheld implement with a flat blade used for propelling, steering, or rowing a boat; an oar or paddle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用櫓划船到岸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 lou5 waak6 syun4 dou3 ngon6
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用橹划船到岸。
examples.english_sentence: He used an oar to row the boat to shore.

mandarin_meaning: 棕榈（樹）；通常出現在合成詞如「棕榈」、「棕榈油」、「棕榈树」中
english_meaning: palm (as in palm tree); used in compounds like palm tree or palm oil
explanation_mandarin: 「櫚」指棕櫚科植物或其樹木名稱，多用於構詞，例如「棕櫚樹」、「棕櫚油」。
explanation_english: Refers to palms (plants of the Arecaceae family) or the tree itself. Commonly appears in compounds such as 'palm tree' or 'palm oil'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 海邊種滿咗棕櫚樹，望落好有熱帶風情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi2 bin1 zung6 mun5 zo2 zung1 lou4 syu6, mong6 lok6 hou2 jau5 jit6 daai3 fung1 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 海边种满了棕榈树，看起来很有热带风情。
examples.english_sentence: The beach is lined with palm trees; it looks very tropical.

mandarin_meaning: 梳子；用來梳理頭髮的器具（書面用字）
english_meaning: comb (a tool for grooming hair)
explanation_mandarin: 櫛為書面或古漢語用字，指用來梳理頭髮的器具，相當於日常所說的「梳」或「梳子」。亦見於成語如「櫛風沐雨」。
explanation_english: 櫛 is a literary/archaic character meaning a comb, the tool used to groom hair. It corresponds to the everyday words "梳" or "comb" and appears in expressions like "櫛風沐雨".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 媽媽用一把櫛幫我梳頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maa4 maa1 jung6 jat1 baa2 zat1 bong1 ngo5 sou1 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈用一把梳子帮我梳头。
examples.english_sentence: My mom used a comb to brush my hair.

mandarin_meaning: 櫛瓜（又稱西葫蘆），即義大利南瓜/嫩南瓜（zucchini）
english_meaning: zucchini (courgette), a type of summer squash
explanation_mandarin: 櫛瓜是一種常見的蔬菜，屬葫蘆科的夏季瓜類，質地細嫩，可用於清炒、煮湯或焗烤料理。
explanation_english: A common vegetable belonging to the summer squash family (zucchini/courgette). It has a tender texture and is used in stir-fries, soups, baking, and other dishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我買咗啲櫛瓜，打算煮湯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 maai5 zo2 di1 zat6 gwaa1, daa2 syun3 zyu2 tong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我買了些櫛瓜，打算煮湯。
examples.english_sentence: I bought some zucchinis tonight and plan to make soup.

mandarin_meaning: 櫥（橱）：櫥櫃、櫃子，指用來收納物品的家具（如衣櫥、廚櫥）。
english_meaning: cabinet; cupboard; wardrobe (a storage piece of furniture for clothes or other items).
explanation_mandarin: 指用來放置或收納物品的櫃子，常見於衣櫥、廚櫥等複合詞中。
explanation_english: Refers to a piece of furniture used for storing items; commonly appears in compounds like 'wardrobe' or 'kitchen cupboard'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個衣櫥好實用，放晒我啲衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 ji1 cyu4 hou2 sat6 jung6, fong3 saai3 ngo5 di1 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個衣櫥很實用，可以放下我所有的衣服。
examples.english_sentence: The wardrobe is very practical; it can hold all my clothes.

mandarin_meaning: 橱窗
english_meaning: shop window; display window; showcase
explanation_mandarin: 商店或展覽場所用來展示商品或物品的玻璃窗或展示區，通常在門面可見以吸引顧客。
explanation_english: A glass-fronted window or display area used by shops or exhibitions to showcase goods or items, typically placed at the storefront to attract customers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 櫥窗入面擺咗好多靚衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyu4-coeng1 jap6-min6 baai2 zo2 hou2-do1 leng3-saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 橱窗里摆了很多漂亮的衣服。
examples.english_sentence: There are many beautiful clothes displayed in the shop window.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋每日都換櫥窗嘅擺設。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5-dei6 mui5-jat6 dou1 wun6 cyu4-coeng1 ge3 baai2-sit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们每天都更换橱窗的摆设。
examples.english_sentence: They change the shop window display every day.

mandarin_meaning: （古）一種樹木或用木器；多見於古籍，現代少用
english_meaning: A rare, classical Chinese character referring to a type of tree or wooden object; found in classical texts and seldom used in modern language
explanation_mandarin: 櫫為一較罕見的漢字，帶有木字旁，古籍中常用以指稱某種樹木或木製器物。現代漢語中使用甚少，屬文言或專名用字。
explanation_english: 櫫 is a rare character containing the wood radical. In classical Chinese it often denotes a particular kind of tree or a wooden vessel/object. It is uncommon in modern usage and primarily appears in literary or historical contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古書記載櫫木可用來製作器皿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 syu1 gei3 zoi6 zyu1 muk6 ho2 jung6 lai4 zai3 zok3 hei3 ming5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古書記載，櫫木可用來製作器皿。
examples.english_sentence: Ancient texts record that zhu wood can be used to make vessels.

mandarin_meaning: lóng（笼；籠子；包圍、盛放的器具，亦為「籠」的異體字）
english_meaning: lóng (a cage, basket, or container; variant of 籠 meaning to enclose or hold items)
explanation_mandarin: 「櫳」為較少見字，多為「籠」的異體，指籠子或用來盛放、包覆物品的器具；亦可引申為包圍或籠罩的意思。常見於古書或人名、地名裡。
explanation_english: A rare/archaic character often used as a variant of 籠 (lóng). It refers to a cage, basket, or a container used to hold things, and can also imply enclosing or covering. Mostly seen in older texts, names, or place names.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個古董嘅櫳係用嚟盛嘢嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gu2 dung2 ge3 lung4 hai6 jung6 lai4 sing4 je5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個古董的櫳是用來盛東西的。
examples.english_sentence: This antique '櫳' is used to hold things.

mandarin_meaning: （籠子的）底部；有時引申為隱蔽處或暗藏之物
english_meaning: the bottom of a cage (or similar container); sometimes used figuratively for a hidden place or something stashed out of sight
explanation_mandarin: 「櫳底」原指籠子或籠狀容器的底部；口語中有時引申為放在隱蔽位置的東西或暗處。此詞屬較口語/方言用法，常見於廣東話語境。
explanation_english: Originally refers to the bottom of a cage or basket-like container. In colloquial Cantonese it can also be extended to mean a hidden spot or something tucked away out of sight. This is a dialectal/colloquial usage common in Cantonese contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢就將啲舊嘢擺喺櫳底，唔想人知道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zau6 zoeng1 di1 gau6 je5 baai2 hai2 lung4 dai2, m4 soeng2 jan4 zi1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把那些舊東西放在籠底，不想讓人知道。
examples.english_sentence: He put those old things at the bottom of the cage, not wanting others to know.

mandarin_meaning: 樱（如：樱花、樱树、樱桃）
english_meaning: cherry; cherry blossom; cherry tree
explanation_mandarin: 表示樱属植物或与樱相关的事物，常见于“樱花”“樱树”“樱桃”等词语中，既可指植物也可作为复合词的词根。
explanation_english: Refers to cherry trees or things related to cherries/cherry blossoms; commonly used in compounds like 'cherry blossom' (櫻花) and 'cherry tree' (櫻樹).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 春天公園嘅櫻花好靚，大家去影相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceon1 tin1 gung1 jyun4 ge3 jing1 faa1 hou2 leng3, daai6 gaa1 heoi3 jing2 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 春天公园的樱花很漂亮，大家去拍照。
examples.english_sentence: The cherry blossoms in the park are beautiful in spring; everyone goes to take photos.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢屋企後院有一棵櫻樹，年年開花。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 uk1 kei2 hau6 jyun2 jau5 jat1 fo1 jing1 syu6, nin4 nin4 hoi1 faa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他家后院有一棵樱树，年年开花。
examples.english_sentence: There is a cherry tree in his backyard that blooms every year.

mandarin_meaning: 樱唇；指樱桃般红润的嘴唇
english_meaning: cherry lips; lips that are red and rosy like a cherry
explanation_mandarin: 指像樱桃一样红润、娇嫩的嘴唇。常用于文学描写、化妆品广告或口语中形容唇色性感、迷人。
explanation_english: Refers to lips that are red and tender like cherries. Commonly used in literary descriptions, cosmetics advertising, or colloquially to describe attractive, rosy lips.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有一對櫻唇，好吸引。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 jat1 deoi3 jing1 seon4, hou2 kap1 jan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她有一对樱唇，很吸引。
examples.english_sentence: She has a pair of cherry lips; very attractive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢支唇膏令佢嘅櫻唇更加鮮紅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 seon4 gou1 ling6 keoi5 ge3 jing1 seon4 gang1 gaa1 sin1 hung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这支唇膏让她的樱唇更加鲜红。
examples.english_sentence: This lipstick made her cherry lips even more vivid red.

mandarin_meaning: 樱桃 (yīngtáo)
english_meaning: cherry (the fruit; also the tree that bears cherries)
explanation_mandarin: 一种小而多汁的水果，通常为红色或深红色，也可指结这种果实的树木。
explanation_english: A small, round, juicy fruit, usually red or dark red; can also refer to the tree that produces the fruit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食櫻桃，但今日買唔到新鮮嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 jing1 tou4, daan6 gam1 jat6 maai5 m4 dou3 san1 sin1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢吃樱桃，但今天买不到新鲜的。
examples.english_sentence: I like eating cherries, but I couldn't find fresh ones today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市場有好多新鮮櫻桃，買返屋企食啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 coeng4 jau5 hou2 do1 san1 sin1 jing1 tou4, maai5 faan1 uk1 kei2 sik6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市场有很多新鲜的樱桃，买回家吃吧。
examples.english_sentence: There are lots of fresh cherries at the market; buy some to take home and eat.

mandarin_meaning: 樱桃树
english_meaning: cherry tree
explanation_mandarin: 指能结出樱桃果实的树木，常见于果园或庭院，春天开花，夏天结果。
explanation_english: A tree that produces cherries; commonly found in orchards or gardens, blooming in spring and bearing fruit in summer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企後園有棵櫻桃樹，夏天可以摘櫻桃食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei2 hau6 jyun4 jau5 fo1 jing1 tou4 syu6, haa6 tin1 ho2 ji5 zaap6 jing1 tou4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家后院有一棵樱桃树，夏天可以摘樱桃吃。
examples.english_sentence: There is a cherry tree in my backyard; in summer you can pick cherries to eat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 春天櫻桃樹開咗好多花，好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceon1 tin1 jing1 tou4 syu6 hoi1 zo2 hou2 do1 faa1, hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 春天樱桃树开了很多花，很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: In spring the cherry tree blooms with many flowers; it's very beautiful.

mandarin_meaning: 樱花 (yīnghuā)
english_meaning: cherry blossom
explanation_mandarin: 櫻花是櫻樹所開的花，春季盛開。常見於日本、韓國和中國部分地區，也常作為賞花、文化象徵。
explanation_english: Cherry blossoms are the flowers of cherry trees that bloom in spring. They are common in Japan, Korea, and parts of China, and are often associated with seasonal viewing and cultural symbolism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋每年都會去日本賞櫻花。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 mui5 nin4 dou1 wui5 heoi3 jat6 bun2 soeng2 jing1 faa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们每年都会去日本赏樱花。
examples.english_sentence: They go to Japan to see the cherry blossoms every year.

mandarin_meaning: 櫻花蝦（小型海蝦，常乾燥用作調味或配料）
english_meaning: sakura shrimp (small pink shrimp often dried and used as an ingredient or seasoning)
explanation_mandarin: 櫻花蝦是一種體型小、顏色偏粉紅的海蝦，常見於台灣與日本等地。通常會乾燥後用作調味或配料，常用在炒飯、蛋料理、沙拉或當作配菜與裝飾。
explanation_english: Sakura shrimp are small pinkish shrimp commonly found in Taiwanese and Japanese cuisine. They are often dried and used as an ingredient or seasoning, frequently added to fried rice, omelettes, salads, or used as a garnish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚買咗啲櫻花蝦，打算整蛋炒飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 maai5 zo2 di1 jing1 faa1 haa1, daa2 syun3 zeng2 daan6 caau2 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚買了些櫻花蝦，打算做蛋炒飯。
examples.english_sentence: I bought some sakura shrimp tonight and plan to make egg fried rice.

jyutping: 讀音不詳 (no standard Cantonese reading)
mandarin_meaning: 罕用漢字，為古字或異體字，現代普通話及粵語中通常無通用意義或固定讀音。
english_meaning: A rare/archaic Chinese character; generally has no common modern Mandarin or Cantonese meaning or fixed pronunciation.
explanation_mandarin: 「櫼」屬於罕見或古代字形，文獻中出現較少，現代漢語資料中多標注為異體或罕用字，沒有穩定的粵語讀音。
explanation_english: The character '櫼' is an uncommon or archaic glyph that appears rarely in texts. Modern lexicons typically mark it as a variant or rare character and it lacks a standardized Cantonese pronunciation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個字「櫼」係好罕見嘅漢字，現時粵語冇固定讀音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi6 '櫼' (duk6 jam1 bat1 coeng4) hai6 hou2 ham2 gin3 ge3 hon3 zi6, jin6 si4 jyut6 jyu5 mou5 gu3 ding6 duk6 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个字“櫼”是很罕见的汉字，现代汉语中没有固定读音。
examples.english_sentence: The character '櫼' is a very rare Chinese character and has no fixed pronunciation in modern Chinese.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語）解散、散隊
english_meaning: (slang) to disband; to break up (a group)
explanation_mandarin: 「櫼隊」為廣東話口語俚語，用於描述一群人結束活動後各自散開或解散隊伍。多見於香港地區非正式對話中。
explanation_english: "櫼隊" is a Cantonese slang term used to describe a group breaking up or dispersing after an event or activity. Common in informal Hong Kong Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 比賽完後，嗰班人就櫼隊咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 coi3 jyun4 hau6, go2 baan1 jan4 zau6 ngaau1 deoi6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 比賽結束後，那隊人就解散了。
examples.english_sentence: After the match ended, that group disbanded.

mandarin_meaning: 顛倒、混亂、亂七八糟（常寫作「顛頭倒腳」）
english_meaning: topsy-turvy; in a mess; chaotic; upside-down
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，用來形容事情或地方非常混亂、顛倒、亂成一團。此短語常見的正字為「顛頭倒腳」，意思與「亂七八糟」、「顛三倒四」相近。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial idiom describing something that is chaotic, turned upside-down, or in a mess. The commonly written form is "顛頭倒腳". It is used to describe disordered situations or people being flustered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企搬完嘢之後成個客廳都櫼頭倒腳，仲要幾日先執得返好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei5 bun1 jyun4 je5 zi1 hau6 sing4 go3 haak3 teng1 dou1 din1 tau4 dou2 goek3 , zung6 jiu3 gei2 jat6 sin1 zap1 dak1 faan1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搬完家之後整個客廳都亂七八糟，還要幾天才能收拾好。
examples.english_sentence: After moving, the whole living room was in a mess; it'll take a few days to tidy up.

mandarin_meaning: 從頭到腳；全身
english_meaning: from head to toe; the whole body; completely
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 副詞 / 副詞短語（狀語）
explanation_mandarin: 表示從頭到腳、整個身體，常用來形容某種狀態遍及全身或完全、徹底地發生。
explanation_english: Indicates 'from head to toe' — the entire body; commonly used to describe a state that affects the whole body or something that is complete/thorough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢驚到櫼頭到腳發冷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 geng1 dou3 cung4 tau4 dou3 goek3 faat3 laang5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他害怕得從頭到腳發冷。
examples.english_sentence: He was so scared that he felt cold from head to toe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我落雨濕到櫼頭到腳，要換衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lok6 jyu5 sap1 dou3 cung4 tau4 dou3 goek3, jiu3 wun6 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我被雨淋得從頭到腳都濕了，要換衣服。
examples.english_sentence: I got soaked from head to toe in the rain; I need to change clothes.

mandarin_meaning: 前後顛倒；排列混亂、不合拍
english_meaning: topsy-turvy; arranged in a muddled or inconsistent way; not matching
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用語，形容事情、排列或做法前後顛倒、順序混亂或彼此不相配（屬地區性俗語，資料可能不完全一致）。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase used to describe something that is topsy-turvy, out of order, or mismatched. It often describes situations where sequence or arrangement is confused (regional slang; usage may vary).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事擺咗櫼頭對腳，大家都唔知邊個先做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 baai2 zo2 ngau6 tau4 deoi3 goek3, daa1gaa1 dou1 m4 zi1 bin1 go3 sin1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事擺得前後顛倒，大家都不知道誰先做。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is all topsy-turvy; nobody knows who should do it first.

mandarin_meaning: 栏（lán）——栏杆、护栏；也可指报刊或网站的专栏/栏目
english_meaning: railing, fence; (media) column or section
explanation_mandarin: 「欄」通常指用來隔開或保護的欄杆、護欄；在媒體語境下也可指報紙、雜誌或網站中的專欄、欄目。
explanation_english: Refers to a railing or fence used for separation or protection. In media contexts it can mean a column or section in a newspaper, magazine, or website.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 樓梯邊嘅欄好高，唔好企喺度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lau4 tai1 bin1 ge3 laan4 hou2 gou1, m4 hou2 kei5 hai2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 樓梯邊的欄很高，不要站在那裡。
examples.english_sentence: The railing beside the stairs is very high; don't stand there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺報紙有一個專欄，每個星期都會寫文章。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 bou3 zi2 jau5 jat1 go3 zyun1 laan4, mui5 go3 sing1 kei4 dou1 wui5 se2 man4 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在報紙有一個專欄，每個星期都會寫文章。
examples.english_sentence: He has a column in the newspaper and writes articles every week.

mandarin_meaning: 欄位（表格、資料庫或表單中的欄或格）
english_meaning: field; column; slot (in a form, table, or database)
explanation_mandarin: 指表格、資料庫或表單中用來顯示或填寫特定資料的欄、格或欄目。
explanation_english: Refers to a field, column, or slot in a form, table, or database used to display or enter specific information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請填妥表格入面嘅每一個欄位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 tin4 to2 biu2 gaak3 jap6 min6 ge3 mui5 jat1 go3 laan4 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 請填妥表格中的每一個欄位。
examples.english_sentence: Please complete every field in the form.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個網站嘅會員資料欄位好齊全。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 mong5 zaam6 ge3 wui6 jyun4 zi1 liu2 laan4 wai6 hou2 cai4 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個網站的會員資料欄位很齊全。
examples.english_sentence: The member data fields on this website are very comprehensive.

mandarin_meaning: 栏杆
english_meaning: railing; banister; handrail
explanation_mandarin: 指建築物、陽台、樓梯等邊緣用來阻隔或支撐的欄杆或護欄，常用來防止墜落或作為扶手。
explanation_english: A barrier or guardrail found on buildings, balconies, stairways, etc., used to prevent falls or serve as a handrail for support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你企喺欄杆度望住海景。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 kei5 hai2 laan4 gon1 dou6 mong6 zyu6 hoi2 ging2
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你站在栏杆边看着海景。
examples.english_sentence: You stand by the railing looking at the sea view.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好靠欄杆，好危險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 kaau3 laan4 gon1, hou2 ngai4 him2
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要靠栏杆，很危险。
examples.english_sentence: Don't lean on the railing; it's very dangerous.

mandarin_meaning: 跳過欄杆（逃走／迅速離開）
english_meaning: to jump over a railing (to escape or make a hasty exit)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，直譯為「欄杆飛」，指跳過或跨過欄杆以逃走或迅速離開；亦可引申為匆忙脫身、迴避的動作。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese phrase literally 'rail-jump'; it means to jump over a railing to escape or to make a quick exit. It can also be used metaphorically for hastily getting away or evading a situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到差人嚟，我即刻欄杆飛走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou3 caa1 jan4 lai4, ngo5 zik1 hak1 laan4 gon1 fei1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到警察來，我立刻跳過欄杆逃走。
examples.english_sentence: When I saw the police coming, I immediately jumped over the railing and ran away.

mandarin_meaning: 欄河（罕見詞）——字面上可解作有欄杆的河流，亦可能作地名使用，現代粵語中並不常見。
english_meaning: Rare/obsolete term: literally 'river with a railing'; may be used as a place name. Not commonly used in modern Cantonese.
explanation_mandarin: 「欄河」不是常見的粵語詞彙。按字面理解，指河邊有欄杆的河段；在實際語境中更可能出現在地名或舊文獻中，而非口語日常用語。
explanation_english: “欄河” is not a common Cantonese word. Literally it denotes a stretch of river with a railing; in practice it is more likely to appear as a place name or in older texts rather than in everyday speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰條欄河好靚，成日有人喺度散步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 tiu4 laan4 ho4 hou2 leng3, sing4 jat6 jau5 jan4 hai2 dou6 saan3 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那條欄河很漂亮，經常有人在那裡散步。
examples.english_sentence: That Laan Ho river is beautiful; people often stroll there.

mandarin_meaning: 權（權力、權利、權勢）
english_meaning: power; authority; right; influence
explanation_mandarin: 表示權力、權利或影響力，常見於複合詞如「權力」「權利」「權衡」。也可指暫時的權宜之計（如「權宜」）。
explanation_english: Refers to power, authority, rights, or influence. Commonly appears in compounds such as "權力" (power), "權利" (rights), and "權衡" (weighing). Can also appear in contexts meaning an expedient or temporary measure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢冇權決定呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou5 kyun4 kyut3 ding6 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他沒有權決定這件事。
examples.english_sentence: He has no right to decide this matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做決定之前要權衡利弊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 kyut3 ding6 zi1 cin4 jiu3 kyun4 hang4 lei6 bai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做決定之前要權衡利弊。
examples.english_sentence: You should weigh the pros and cons before making a decision.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 股東有表決權。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 dung1 jau5 biu2 kyut3 kyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 股東有表決權。
examples.english_sentence: Shareholders have voting rights.

mandarin_meaning: 權力和地位
english_meaning: power and position; authority and rank
explanation_mandarin: 指掌握權力與地位的職位或位置，常用於描述官職、權勢與影響力。
explanation_english: Refers to a position that holds power and status; used to describe official rank, authority, and influence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗保住自己嘅權位，做咗好多唔光彩嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai4 zo2 bou2 zyu6 zi6 gei2 ge3 kyun4 wai6, zou6 zo2 hou2 do1 m4 gwong1 coi2 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為了保住自己的權位，做了很多不光彩的事。
examples.english_sentence: He did many dishonorable things to protect his power and position.

mandarin_meaning: 权利
english_meaning: right(s); entitlement; privilege
explanation_mandarin: 指個人或集體在法律、道德或社會上應享有的權益或利益。
explanation_english: Refers to entitlements or benefits that a person or group is legally, morally, or socially entitled to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每個人都有基本的權利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 go3 jan4 dou1 jau5 gei1 bun2 dik1 kyun4 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每个人都有基本的权利。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone has basic rights.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要保護自己嘅權利，唔好畀人剝奪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 bou2 wu6 zi6 gei2 ge3 kyun4 lei6, m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 bok3 deoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要保护自己的权利，不要让别人剥夺。
examples.english_sentence: You should protect your rights; don't let others take them away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 勞工權利應該受法律保障。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou4 gung1 kyun4 lei6 jing1 goi1 sau6 faat3 leot6 bou2 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 劳工权利应该受法律保障。
examples.english_sentence: Workers' rights should be protected by law.

mandarin_meaning: 權力 (quánlì)
english_meaning: power; authority
explanation_mandarin: 表示控制、支配或決策的能力與權威，常用於政治、組織或人際關係中。
explanation_english: Refers to the ability or authority to control, make decisions, or influence others; commonly used in political, organizational, or interpersonal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司有好大嘅權力，可以決定人事安排。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1si1 jau5 hou2 daai6 ge3 kyun4lik6, ho2ji5 kyut3ding6 jan4si6 ngon1paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司有很大的權力，可以決定人事安排。
examples.english_sentence: He has a lot of power in the company and can decide personnel arrangements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 權力同責任係同時存在嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kyun4lik6 tung4 zaak3jam6 hai6 tung4si4 cyun4zoi6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 權力和責任是同時存在的。
examples.english_sentence: Power and responsibility coexist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢擁有權力，所以可以影響政府政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung5 jau5 kyun4lik6, so2ji5 ho2ji5 jing2hoeng2 zing3fu2 zing3cai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他擁有權力，所以可以影響政府政策。
examples.english_sentence: He holds power, so he can influence government policies.

mandarin_meaning: 權力、影響力；權威、勢力
english_meaning: power; influence; authority; clout
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人或某團體在政治、經濟或社會中擁有的控制力和影響力，常用來形容有實權或能左右他人的地位與勢力。
explanation_english: Refers to the control and influence a person or group holds in political, economic, or social contexts; often used to describe real authority or the ability to sway others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢靠住老細嘅權勢喺公司升得好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kaau3 zyu6 lou5 sai3 ge3 kyun4 sai3 hai2 gung1si1 sing1 dak1 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他靠老闆的權勢在公司升得很快。
examples.english_sentence: He got promoted quickly in the company thanks to the boss's influence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 社會上有錢有權嘅人通常好有權勢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se5 wui6 soeng6 jau5 cin2 jau5 kyun4 ge3 jan4 tung1 soeng4 hou2 jau5 kyun4 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 社會上有錢有權的人通常很有權勢。
examples.english_sentence: In society, people with money and power usually have considerable influence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢有權勢，但係唔代表佢啱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 jau5 kyun4 sai3, daan6 hai6 m4 doi6 biu2 keoi5 aam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 雖然他有權勢，但不代表他就是對的。
examples.english_sentence: Although he has influence, that doesn't mean he's right.

mandarin_meaning: 权威；有权威的人或具有权威性的事物
english_meaning: authority; authoritative; someone or something with recognized power, influence, or expertise
explanation_mandarin: 指在某個領域具有影響力、專業地位或能夠決定事務的人或事物，也可形容具有令人信服的權威性。
explanation_english: Refers to a person or thing that has recognized influence, expertise, or power in a particular field; can also describe something as authoritative and convincing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺醫學界好有權威。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ji1 hok6 gaai3 hou2 jau5 kyun4 wai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在医学界很有权威。
examples.english_sentence: He is very authoritative in the medical field.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該聽下權威人士嘅建議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jing1 goi1 teng1 haa5 kyun4 wai1 jan4 si6 ge3 gin3 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该听听权威人士的建议。
examples.english_sentence: We should listen to the recommendations of authoritative figures.

mandarin_meaning: 权宜之计；临时的应急办法
english_meaning: a makeshift solution; a temporary expedient to deal with an immediate problem
explanation_mandarin: 指為應付眼前困難或緊急情況而採取的臨時措施，通常不是長久之策。
explanation_english: Refers to a temporary measure taken to cope with an immediate difficulty or emergency; typically not a long-term or ideal solution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個只係權宜之計，唔係長遠解決方法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi2 hai6 kyun4 ji4 zi1 gai3, m4 hai6 coeng4 jyun5 gaai2 kyut3 fong1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這只是權宜之計，不是長遠的解決方法。
examples.english_sentence: This is only a makeshift solution, not a long-term remedy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆話依家先用權宜之計，等有更多資料先再決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 waa6 ji1 gaa1 sin1 jung6 kyun4 ji4 zi1 gai3, dang2 jau5 gang1 do1 zi1 liu2 sin1 zoi6 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板說現在先用權宜之計，等有更多資料再決定。
examples.english_sentence: The boss said we'll use a temporary expedient for now and decide after we have more data.

mandarin_meaning: 权柄（权力、职权）
english_meaning: authority; power; jurisdiction
explanation_mandarin: 指行使權力或作出決定的權利與能力，常用於正式或書面語境，強調職權或掌控力。
explanation_english: Refers to the right or ability to exercise power and make decisions; often used in formal or written contexts, emphasizing official authority or control.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司畀咗佢好大嘅權柄，佢要對員工負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 bei2 zo2 keoi5 hou2 daai6 ge3 kyun4 bing2, keoi5 jiu3 deoi3 jyun4 gung1 fu6 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司给了他很大的权柄，他要对员工负责。
examples.english_sentence: The company has given him great authority; he must be accountable to the employees.

mandarin_meaning: 权益（权利和利益）
english_meaning: rights and interests; rights and benefits
explanation_mandarin: 指個人或團體在法律、經濟、社會等方面所享有的權利和利益，常用於法律、政策與勞資關係的語境中。
explanation_english: Refers to the rights and interests that an individual or group holds in legal, economic, or social contexts; commonly used in legal, policy, and labor relations discussions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 員工嘅權益應該受到法律保障。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyun4 gung1 ge3 kyun4 jik1 jing1 goi1 sau6 dou3 faat3 leot6 bou2 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 員工的權益應該受到法律保障。
examples.english_sentence: Employees' rights and interests should be protected by law.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府要平衡企業嘅利益同市民嘅權益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jiu3 ping4 hang4 kei5 jip6 ge3 lei6 jik1 tung4 si5 man4 ge3 kyun4 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府要平衡企業的利益和市民的權益。
examples.english_sentence: The government must balance corporate interests and the rights and interests of citizens.

mandarin_meaning: 权臣
english_meaning: powerful minister; minister who wields real power (often behind the throne)
explanation_mandarin: 指掌握實際政權、對君主或中央政府有重大影響力的臣僚或官員，常含有權力過大或專權的貶義。
explanation_english: Refers to a minister or official who holds real political power and significantly influences or controls the ruler/government; often carries a negative sense of excessive or usurped authority.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 權臣把持朝政，皇帝形同虛位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kyun4 san4 baa2 ci4 ciu4 zing3, wong4 dai3 jing4 tung4 heoi1 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 权臣把持朝政，皇帝形同虚位。
examples.english_sentence: The powerful minister controls state affairs, and the emperor is effectively a figurehead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果冇監察，權臣好易貪污，人民就會受害。
examples.jyutping_sentence: joek6 gwo2 mou5 gaam1 caat3, kyun4 san4 hou2 ji6 taam1 wu1, jan4 man4 zau6 wui5 sau6 hoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果没有监督，权臣很容易贪污，人民就会受害。
examples.english_sentence: Without oversight, powerful ministers can easily become corrupt, and the people will suffer.

mandarin_meaning: 权术；指为谋取权力或利益而使用的手段与策略，常含贬义。
english_meaning: Political maneuvering or tactics; the use of power plays and manipulative strategies to gain advantage, often with a negative connotation.
explanation_mandarin: 指運用權力、手段或策略進行權謀操作，以達到自身目的，通常含有狡詐、陰險或不光明正大的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to the tactical use of power, tricks, or manipulative strategies to achieve one's aims; usually implies scheming or underhanded behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司入面成日用權術上位，令其他同事覺得好反感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1si1 jap6min6 sing4jat6 jung6 kyun4 seot6 soeng5wai6, ling6 kei4taa1 tung4si6 gok3dak1 hou2 faan2gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司裡經常用權術上位，讓其他同事覺得很反感。
examples.english_sentence: He often uses political maneuvering to get ahead at the company, which makes other colleagues feel resentful.

mandarin_meaning: 权衡；衡量利弊，比较各种因素以便做出决定
english_meaning: to weigh; to balance or consider different factors (weigh pros and cons) before making a decision
explanation_mandarin: 表示比較各種因素或利弊，做出有根據的選擇或決定。
explanation_english: To compare and consider various factors or pros and cons in order to make an informed choice or decision.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺做決定之前，我哋要權衡吓各種利弊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zou6 kyut3 ding6 zi1 cin4, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 kyun4 hang4 haa5 gok3 zung2 lei6 bai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在做决定之前，我们要权衡各种利弊。
examples.english_sentence: Before making a decision, we need to weigh the pros and cons.

mandarin_meaning: 权衡轻重（对事物的重要性或利弊进行衡量）
english_meaning: to weigh the relative importance or pros and cons; to balance priorities before making a decision
explanation_mandarin: 表示對事情的輕重、利弊或優先次序進行比較和衡量，以便作出決定。
explanation_english: To compare and evaluate the relative importance, advantages and disadvantages, or priorities of things in order to make a decision.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會之前，我哋要先權衡輕重，決定優先處理邊樣嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui6 zi1 cin4, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 sin1 kyun4 hang4 hing1 zung6, kyut3 ding6 jau1 sin1 cyu2 lei5 bin1 joeng6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 開會之前，我們要先權衡輕重，決定先處理哪件事。
examples.english_sentence: Before the meeting, we need to weigh the priorities and decide what to handle first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對兩個方案，佢花咗好耐時間權衡輕重，先揀咗其中一個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 loeng5 go3 fong1 on3, keoi5 faa1 zo2 hou2 noi6 si4 gaan3 kyun4 hang4 hing1 zung6 sin1 gaan2 zo2 kei4 zung1 jat1 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面對兩個方案，他花了很長時間權衡輕重，最後選了其中一個。
examples.english_sentence: Facing two proposals, he spent a long time weighing the pros and cons before choosing one.

mandarin_meaning: 權變（quánbiàn）：根據情況靈活變通、採取臨時或權宜的對策
english_meaning: Ad hoc adjustment; taking measures according to circumstances; expedient action or strategy
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞/動詞（表示採取權宜之計或靈活調整的行為或策略）
partOfSpeech_english: noun/verb (denoting an act or strategy of making ad hoc adjustments)
explanation_mandarin: 權變指根據情勢或突發狀況，採取靈活、臨時或權宜的措施來應對，常用於描述臨機應變的策略。
explanation_english: Refers to taking flexible, provisional, or expedient measures in response to changing circumstances or unexpected events; often used to describe ad hoc or pragmatic strategies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對疫情，公司作出權變，改為在家工作並實行彈性上班時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 jik6 cing4, gung1 si1 zok3 ceot1 kyun4 bin3, goi2 wai4 zoi6 gaa1 gung1 zok3 bing6 sat6 hang4 daan6 sing3 soeng5 baan1 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面對疫情，公司作出權變，改為在家工作並實行彈性上班時間。
examples.english_sentence: Facing the epidemic, the company made ad hoc adjustments, switching to working from home and implementing flexible working hours.

mandarin_meaning: 權力與責任
english_meaning: authority and responsibility; powers and duties; jurisdiction and accountability
explanation_mandarin: 指某個職位或組織所擁有的權限（權）以及應承擔的責任（責），常用於職務說明、責任分配與管理制度中。
explanation_english: Refers to the authority/power and the corresponding responsibilities associated with a role, position, or organization; commonly used in job descriptions, allocation of duties, and governance contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工作嘅權責已經喺合約上寫得好清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 zok3 ge3 kyun4 zaak3 ji5 ging1 hai6 hap6 joek3 soeng6 se2 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這份工作的權責已經在合約上寫得很清楚。
examples.english_sentence: The authority and responsibilities for this job are already clearly stated in the contract.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果權責分配唔清，部門之間就好容易互相推諉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 kyun4 zaak3 fan1 pui3 m4 cing1, bou6 mun4 zi1 gaan1 zau6 hou2 jung4 ji6 wu6 soeng1 teoi1 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果權責分配不清，部門之間就很容易互相推諉。
examples.english_sentence: If authority and responsibilities are not clearly allocated, departments can easily shift blame onto each other.

mandarin_meaning: 权贵
english_meaning: the powerful and privileged; people of authority and high status
explanation_mandarin: 指掌握權力和特權、有影響力的個人或階層，常帶貶義，暗指與一般民眾利益不同的上層人士。
explanation_english: Refers to individuals or groups who hold power and privileges; often used pejoratively to denote elites whose interests differ from ordinary people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府唔應該淨係照顧權貴，要公平對待普通市民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 m4 jing1 goi1 zing6 hai6 ziu3 gu3 kyun4 gwai3, jiu3 gung1 ping4 deoi3 daai3 pou2 tung1 si5 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府不應該只照顧權貴，要公平對待普通市民。
examples.english_sentence: The government should not only look after the powerful and privileged; it should treat ordinary citizens fairly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲政策只利於權貴，窮人根本得唔到好處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 zing3 caak3 zi2 lei6 jyu1 kyun4 gwai3, kung4 jan4 gan1 bun2 dak1 m4 dou3 hou2 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些政策只利於權貴，窮人根本得不到好處。
examples.english_sentence: These policies only benefit the powerful; the poor get no benefits at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日同權貴打交道，講嘢有時顯得好圓滑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 tung4 kyun4 gwai3 daa2 gaau1 dou6, gong2 je5 jau5 si4 hin2 dak1 hou2 jyun4 waat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常與權貴打交道，說話有時顯得很圓滑。
examples.english_sentence: He often deals with the powerful and sounds very smooth sometimes.

mandarin_meaning: 权限
english_meaning: authority; permission; scope of rights (e.g., access rights)
explanation_mandarin: 指某人或某個角色被允許執行某些操作的範圍或權力，常用於管理、組織或資訊系統中，例如檔案或系統的訪問權限。
explanation_english: Refers to the scope of authority or permission granted to a person or role to perform certain actions; commonly used in management, organizations, and IT (e.g., file or system access rights).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你冇權限更改呢個文件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 mou5 kyun4 haan6 gang1 goi2 ni1 go3 man4 gin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你沒有權限更改這個文件。
examples.english_sentence: You don't have permission to modify this document.

mandarin_meaning: 權力鬥爭
english_meaning: power struggle; struggle for power
explanation_mandarin: 指在組織、團體或政治圈內為爭奪權力、地位或影響力而進行的鬥爭或爭鬥。
explanation_english: Refers to conflicts within an organization, group, or political circle where people compete for power, status, or influence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司內部最近發生咗好多權鬥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 noi6 bou6 zeoi3 gan6 faat3 sang1 zo2 hou2 do1 kyun4 dau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司內部最近發生了很多權力鬥爭。
examples.english_sentence: There have been many power struggles within the company recently.

mandarin_meaning: 欒（拼音：luán），常作姓氏；亦指欒樹，一種常見的觀賞喬木（如金雨樹）
english_meaning: Luan (a Chinese surname); the Luan tree (e.g., golden rain tree), an ornamental deciduous tree
explanation_mandarin: 欒字既可作為姓氏，也常用於植物名稱，如欒樹（常見的觀賞樹木）。在日常語境中多見於人名或植物名稱的書寫。
explanation_english: The character 欒 is used as a Chinese surname and appears in plant names such as the Luan tree (an ornamental tree, e.g. golden rain tree). It is commonly seen in personal names or botanical names.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企門口有一棵欒樹，春天開花好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei2 mun4 hau2 jau5 jat1 fo1 lyun4 syu6, ceon1 tin1 hoi1 faa1 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家門口有一棵欒樹，春天開花很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: There is a Luan (golden rain) tree at my doorstep; it looks very beautiful when it flowers in spring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 欒先生係我公司嘅經理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lyun4 sin1 saang1 hai6 ngo5 gung1 si1 ge3 ging1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 欒先生是我公司的經理。
examples.english_sentence: Mr. Luan is the manager at my company.

mandarin_meaning: 橄欖（果實），如橄欖油等相關食材
english_meaning: olive (the fruit); also used for olive-related products like olive oil
explanation_mandarin: 「欖」常作「橄欖」使用，指橄欖樹所結的果實，或指由此果實製成的食用產品（例如橄欖油、醃橄欖等）。
explanation_english: “欖” (olive) is usually used in the compound “橄欖” and refers to the fruit of the olive tree or products made from it (e.g., olive oil, pickled olives).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗罐橄欖油，今晚炒菜用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 gun3 gam2 laam5 jau4, gam1 maan5 caau2 coi3 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一罐橄榄油，今晚炒菜用。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a jar of olive oil to use for cooking tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺沙律入面加咗啲橄欖，味道好夾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 saa1 leot6 jap6 min6 gaa1 zo2 di1 gam2 laam5, mei6 dou6 hou2 gaap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在沙拉里加了一些橄榄，味道很搭。
examples.english_sentence: He added some olives to the salad; the flavor goes well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去睇橄欖球比賽，大家好期待。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 heoi3 tai2 gam2 laam5 kau4 bei2 coi3, daai6 gaa1 hou2 kei4 doi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚去看橄榄球比赛，大家很期待。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to watch a rugby match tonight; everyone is looking forward to it.

mandarin_meaning: 橄榄球
english_meaning: rugby (a team sport played with an oval ball)
explanation_mandarin: 欖球（全寫為橄欖球）是以橄欖形球進行的團隊運動，香港一般指英式欖球（如rugby union或rugby league）。欖球有不同賽制，例如15人制與13人制，玩法與美式橄欖球有所不同。
explanation_english: A team sport played with an oval (egg-shaped) ball. In Hong Kong, 欖球 commonly refers to rugby (e.g., rugby union or rugby league). There are different formats such as 15-a-side and 13-a-side; it is distinct from American football.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺學校打欖球。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai6 hok6 haau6 daa2 laam5 kau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在学校打橄榄球。
examples.english_sentence: I play rugby at school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋今晚有欖球比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gam1 maan5 jau5 laam5 kau4 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们今晚有橄榄球比赛。
examples.english_sentence: They have a rugby match tonight.

mandarin_meaning: （咸）橄榄（橄榄角，常作腌制或佐料）
english_meaning: olive (often salted/preserved olive pieces used as a condiment)
explanation_mandarin: 欖角通常指橄榄的一部分或腌製的橄榄（如鹹欖角），在廣東菜、粥品或作下酒菜時常用作調味或配料。
explanation_english: Refers to olives or pieces of preserved/salted olives (often called salted olives). Commonly used as a condiment or ingredient in Cantonese dishes such as congee or as a snack/side dish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢碗欖角肉碎粥好香。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wun2 laam5 gok3 juk6 seoi3 zuk1 hou2 hoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这碗橄榄肉碎粥很香。
examples.english_sentence: This bowl of olive and minced pork congee smells great.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你買咗啲欖角返嚟未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 maai5 zo2 di1 laam5 gok3 faan1 lai4 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你买了些橄榄回来了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you bought the olives yet?

mandarin_meaning: 欖豉（可能指以欖類或欖角與豆豉/發酵黃豆製成的鹹香醬料或醃製品）
english_meaning: A regional condiment/preserved food of olives (or olivelets) combined with fermented soybeans (douchi); a salty, savory olive-fermented-soybean relish used to season or steam dishes.
explanation_mandarin: 欖豉在華南沿岸和潮汕一帶有出現，通常指以欖（或欖角）與豆豉或發酵黃豆製成的調味料或醃製食品。風味偏鹹香、帶發酵氣味，可用來蒸、拌或作為配料。此詞較為地域性、非通用普通話詞彙。
explanation_english: A regional Cantonese term referring to a salty, savory condiment or preserved item made from olives (or olivelets) combined with fermented soybeans (douchi). It has a pronounced umami/fermented aroma and is used for steaming, stir-ins, or as a seasoning. The term is region-specific and not common in standard Mandarin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢罐欖豉好香，用嚟蒸排骨一流。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gun3 laam5 si6 hou2 hoeng1, jung6 lai4 zing1 paai4 gwat1 jat1 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這罐欖豉很香，用來蒸排骨一流。
examples.english_sentence: This jar of '欖豉' smells great; it's perfect for steaming spare ribs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 媽媽買咗樽欖豉返嚟，今晚拌飯啱嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maa4 maa1 maai5 zo2 zeon1 laam5 si6 faan1 lai4, gam1 maan5 bun6 faan6 aam1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媽媽買了一罐欖豉回來，今晚拌飯很合適。
examples.english_sentence: Mom bought a jar of '欖豉' home — it'll be great mixed into rice tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 欠；欠缺；欠债（qiàn）
english_meaning: to owe; to be lacking; (colloquial) deserve punishment/beating
explanation_mandarin: 表示欠債或不足、缺少，也可在口語中表示應受責罵或挨打（如「欠打」）。常見用法有「欠錢」「欠缺」「欠打」等。
explanation_english: Indicates owing (debt), lacking or being short of something; in colloquial usage can mean 'deserve a beating' or punishment (e.g., '欠打'). Common compounds: '欠錢', '欠缺', '欠打'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我欠咗佢一千蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 him3 zo2 keoi5 jat1 cin1 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我欠了他一千塊錢。
examples.english_sentence: I owe him one thousand dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅經驗有啲欠缺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ging1 jim6 jau5 di1 him3 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的經驗有點欠缺。
examples.english_sentence: His experience is somewhat lacking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁講真係欠打。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 gong2 zan1 hai6 him3 daa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣說真是欠打。
examples.english_sentence: What you said really deserves a beating.

mandarin_meaning: 不佳
english_meaning: not good; unsatisfactory; below par
explanation_mandarin: 表示情況、表現或狀態不太好、不理想，常用來描述成績、天氣等不佳的情況。
explanation_english: Indicates that a situation, performance, or condition is not very good or is unsatisfactory; often used to describe things like results, weather, or performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日嘅天氣欠佳，唔適合郊遊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 ge3 tin1 hei3 him3 gaai1, m4 sik1 hap6 gaau1 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天的天氣不佳，不適合郊遊。
examples.english_sentence: Today's weather isn't great; it's not suitable for an outing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近公司業績欠佳，要檢討一下經營策略。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 gung1 si1 jip6 zik1 him3 gaai1, jiu3 gim2 tou2 jat1 haa5 ging1 jing4 caak3 loek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近公司業績不佳，需要檢討一下經營策略。
examples.english_sentence: The company's recent performance has been poor and needs a review of its business strategy.

mandarin_meaning: 欠债（欠下债务）
english_meaning: to owe money; to be in debt
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞短語（有時可作名詞）
explanation_mandarin: 表示欠下金錢或其他債務，常用於日常會話。既可以指欠錢，也可比喻欠下人情或其他義務。
explanation_english: Indicates owing money or having debt; commonly used in everyday speech. Can refer to monetary debt or, figuratively, owing a favor or obligation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我欠咗債，依家要還錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 him3 zo2 zaai3, ji4 gaa1 jiu3 waan4 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我欠了债，现在要还钱。
examples.english_sentence: I owe money; I have to pay it back now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗啲生意，結果欠咗好多債。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 di1 sang1 ji3, git3 gwo2 him3 zo2 hou2 do1 zaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了些生意，結果欠了很多债。
examples.english_sentence: He went into some business and ended up owing a lot of debt.

mandarin_meaning: 欠债还钱（qiàn zhài huán qián）
english_meaning: Pay your debts; debts must be repaid
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是欠了債就應該還錢。常用來提醒或斥責應承擔責任、兌現欠款或承諾的人。
explanation_english: Literally 'owe debt, repay money.' Used to tell someone to pay back what they owe or, more generally, to take responsibility for one's obligations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做人要負責，欠債還錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jan4 jiu3 fu6 zaak3, him3 zaai3 waan4 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做人要負責，欠债还钱。
examples.english_sentence: You should be responsible — pay your debts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講到底，欠債還錢，無得商量。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 dou3 dai2, him3 zaai3 waan4 cin2, mou4 dak1 soeng1 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 說到底，欠债还钱，没得商量。
examples.english_sentence: At the end of the day, debts must be repaid — there's no negotiation.

mandarin_meaning: 欠账；拖欠付款（赊账/未结账）
english_meaning: to run a tab; to owe payment; to leave without paying an outstanding bill
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，常見於香港，指欠下賬單或未結帳、拖欠付款，也可指吃完或消費後離開而沒有付錢（賒帳或打欠）。
explanation_english: Cantonese colloquial/slang used mainly in Hong Kong meaning to have an outstanding bill or to owe payment (to run a tab). It can also refer to leaving after consuming goods/services without paying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好欠單，記住埋單先走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 him3 daan1, gei3 zyu6 maai4 daan1 sin1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別欠账，记得付账再走。
examples.english_sentence: Don't run a tab; remember to pay the bill before you leave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有個客食完嘢欠單走咗，老闆好嬲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 go3 haak3 sik6 jyun4 je5 him3 daan1 zau2 zo2, lou5 baan2 hou2 nau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有個客人吃完東西就欠账走了，老闆很生氣。
examples.english_sentence: A customer left without paying after eating; the boss is very angry.

mandarin_meaning: 無法提供／無法奉上；（客套或婉拒）無法出席或答應
english_meaning: to be unable to provide/offer; politely decline or be unavailable (no show)
explanation_mandarin: 口語或書面中常用來婉拒或表示無法提供某事物或出席，意思是「無法奉上／無法參與」。
explanation_english: A Cantonese expression used to politely indicate inability to provide something or to decline/ be unavailable (i.e., 'nothing to offer' or 'I can't attend').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，今晚請我食飯，我要欠奉，因為要加班。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, gam1 maan5 ceng2 ngo5 sik6 faan6, ngo5 jiu3 him3 fung6, jan1 wai6 jiu3 gaa1 baan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，今晚請我吃飯我要婉拒，因為要加班。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I have to decline your dinner invitation tonight because I need to work overtime.

mandarin_meaning: 欠款 (qiàn kuǎn) — 欠下的款項，欠債；未償還的金錢
english_meaning: to owe money; an outstanding payment or debt
explanation_mandarin: 指欠下的金錢或尚未償還的款項。可作名詞（欠款）表示負債，也可作動詞短語表示欠錢的行為。
explanation_english: Refers to money owed or outstanding payments. Can be used as a noun (an owed amount) or as a verb phrase (to owe money).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我仲有兩千蚊嘅欠款未還。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung6 jau5 loeng5 cin1 man1 ge3 him3 fun2 mei6 waan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我還有兩千塊的欠款沒還。
examples.english_sentence: I still have an outstanding debt of 2,000 dollars that I haven't repaid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果遲啲唔還欠款，銀行會收利息同埋罰款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ci4 di1 m4 waan4 him3 fun2, ngan4 hong4 wui5 sau1 lei6 sik1 tung4 maai4 fat6 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果遲些不還欠款，銀行會收利息並處罰款。
examples.english_sentence: If you delay repaying the debt, the bank will charge interest and penalties.

mandarin_meaning: 缺乏；不足
english_meaning: to lack; to be deficient; deficiency
explanation_mandarin: 表示缺少、不足或不完善，可作动词或形容词使用。
explanation_english: Indicates lacking, insufficient, or incomplete; can be used as a verb or adjective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告仲有好多數據欠缺，未能交差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 sou3 geoi3 him3 kyut3, mei6 nang4 gaau1 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告还有很多数据缺失，无法提交。
examples.english_sentence: This report still has a lot of missing data and cannot be submitted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為經驗欠缺，暫時未能勝任嗰份工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 ging1 jim6 him3 kyut3, zam6 si4 mei6 nang4 sing3 jam6 go2 fan6 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为经验不足，暂时无法胜任那份工作。
examples.english_sentence: He lacks experience and can't take on that job for now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個系統設計有啲欠缺，導致使用時會出錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 tung2 cit3 gai3 jau5 di1 him3 kyut3, dou6 zi3 si6 jung6 si4 wui5 ceot1 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个系统设计有些缺陷，导致使用时会出错。
examples.english_sentence: The system design has some flaws, causing errors during use.

mandarin_meaning: 欠发工资；拖欠工资
english_meaning: to withhold/pay late wages; unpaid wages
explanation_mandarin: 指公司或僱主未按時發放或拖欠員工應得的薪資，可用作動詞（欠薪）或名詞（欠薪情況）。
explanation_english: Refers to an employer failing to pay or delaying payment of wages owed to employees. Can be used as a verb (to withhold pay) or a noun (the state of unpaid wages).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司欠薪，啲員工唔知點算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 him3 san1, di1 jyun4 gung1 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司拖欠工资，员工不知道怎么办。
examples.english_sentence: The company is withholding pay; the employees don't know what to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果長期欠薪，可以向勞工處投訴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 coeng4 kei4 him3 san1, ho2 ji5 hoeng3 lou4 gung1 cyu3 tau4 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果长期拖欠工资，可以向劳动部门投诉。
examples.english_sentence: If wages are withheld for a long time, you can file a complaint with the labor department.

mandarin_meaning: 不妥 / 不合適 / 不可接受
english_meaning: improper; inappropriate; unacceptable (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「欠行」是香港廣東話的口語用語，用來表示某事或某人言行不妥、不合適或讓人難以接受，含有「不得體／不合情理」的意思。
explanation_english: "欠行" is a Hong Kong Cantonese colloquial expression used to say that something or someone's behavior/words are inappropriate, improper, or unacceptable — i.e., out of line or not right.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁講真係欠行啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 gong2 zan1 hai6 him3 haang4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣說真的不妥／不合適。
examples.english_sentence: What you said is really out of line/inappropriate.

mandarin_meaning: 欠账（欠钱、拖欠账款）
english_meaning: to owe money; to have an outstanding bill or unpaid debt (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，指欠下的錢或帳款沒還，亦可引申為欠人情或人情債。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial verb meaning to owe money or have an unpaid bill; can also be used figuratively to mean owing someone a favor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你仲欠我賬未還呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung6 him3 ngo5 zoeng3 mei6 waan4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你還欠着我的帳沒還嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Are you still owing me money (haven't paid me back yet)?

mandarin_meaning: 欠身（身體前傾/微躬）
english_meaning: to lean/bend forward slightly; to bow slightly (as a polite gesture or to avoid hitting something)
explanation_mandarin: 表示身體向前或向下微微彎曲，通常用於表示禮貌、讓路或通過狹窄處時避讓碰撞等情況。
explanation_english: To bend or lean the body forward or down slightly, commonly used as a polite bow, to make way for someone, or to avoid hitting an obstacle when passing through a tight space.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 當佢行過我面前，我就欠身讓佢過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dong1 keoi5 haang4 gwo3 ngo5 min6 cin4, ngo5 zau6 him3 san1 joeng6 keoi5 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 當他走過我面前，我就欠身讓他過。
examples.english_sentence: When he walked past me, I leaned forward to let him pass.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 過窄門時要欠身，小心撞到頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwo3 zaak3 mun4 si4 jiu3 him3 san1, siu2 sam1 zong6 dou3 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 經過窄門時要欠身，小心撞到頭。
examples.english_sentence: When passing through a narrow door you should duck/lean to avoid hitting your head.

mandarin_meaning: （一次的）次 / 次数；（表示次数）
english_meaning: time; occurrence; (used as a measure word for occurrences)
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情發生的次數或次序，如「三次」、「下次」。在口語中常用作量詞表示發生的次數。
explanation_english: Indicates the number of occurrences or sequence (e.g., "three times", "next time"). Commonly used as a measure word for occurrences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經去過嗰間餐廳三次。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 heoi3 gwo3 go2 gaan1 caan1 teng1 saam1 ci3。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已经去过那家餐厅三次。
examples.english_sentence: I've already been to that restaurant three times.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下次記得帶鎖匙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 ci3 gei3 dak1 daai3 so2 si4。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下次记得带钥匙。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to bring your keys next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次我冇帶現金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 ngo5 mou5 daai3 jin6 gam1。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次我没有带现金。
examples.english_sentence: This time I didn't bring any cash.

mandarin_meaning: 第二名
english_meaning: second place (ranking)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，等同於「第二名」或「亞軍」，用來表示競賽或排名中的第二位。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term equivalent to "第二名" or "runner-up", used to indicate the second position in a competition or ranking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺比賽攞到次名，都幾開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 bei2coi3 lo2 dou3 ci3 ming4, dou1 gei2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在比賽拿到第二名，也很開心。
examples.english_sentence: I got second place in the competition and I'm quite happy.

mandarin_meaning: 次子（家中排行第二的兒子）
english_meaning: second son (the son born second in a family)
explanation_mandarin: 指家中排行第二的兒子，多為書面或傳統用語，在現代口語中常說「第二子」或「次男」。
explanation_english: Refers to the second-born son in a family. The term is largely literary or traditional; in modern usage people often say "second son."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係屋企嘅次子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 uk1 kei5 ge3 ci3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是家裡的次子。
examples.english_sentence: He is the second son in the family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古代嗰啲家庭，次子有時唔會繼承家產。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 doi6 go2 di1 gaa1 ting4, ci3 zi2 jau5 si4 m4 wui5 gai3 sing4 gaa1 caan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代那些家庭，次子有時不會繼承家產。
examples.english_sentence: In older households, the second son sometimes did not inherit the family property.

mandarin_meaning: 次序；顺序、秩序
english_meaning: order; sequence; orderliness
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物排列的先後順序，也可指秩序或規矩。
explanation_english: Refers to the order or sequence of things; can also mean orderliness or proper arrangement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 排隊要有次序，唔好亂插隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: paai4 deoi2 jiu3 jau5 ci3 zeoi6, m4 hou2 lyun6 caap3 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 排队要有次序，不要乱插队。
examples.english_sentence: When lining up, keep order; don't cut in line.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做嘢要有次序，先可以做好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 je5 jiu3 jau5 ci3 zeoi6, sin1 ho2 ji5 zou6 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做事要有次序，才能做好。
examples.english_sentence: You should do things in order so you can do them well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 社會要有次序先至可以平穩運作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se5 wui6 jiu3 jau5 ci3 zeoi6 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 ping4 wan2 wan6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 社会要有次序才能平稳运作。
examples.english_sentence: Society needs order to function smoothly.

mandarin_meaning: 次数 (cìshù) — 某事发生的次数或出现的频率
english_meaning: number of times; frequency
explanation_mandarin: 表示某件事發生的次數或出現的頻率，可用於描述事件出現的次數、重複次數等。
explanation_english: Denotes how many times something occurs or its frequency; used to describe counts or repetition of events.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做呢個運動嘅次數夠未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 ni1 go3 wan6 dung6 ge3 ci3 sou3 gau3 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做这个运动的次数够了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you done this exercise enough times?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我記錄咗我食藥嘅次數，方便睇返紀錄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gei3 luk6 zo2 ngo5 sik6 joek6 ge3 ci3 sou3, fong1 bin6 tai2 faan1 gei2 luk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我记录了我吃药的次数，方便查看记录。
examples.english_sentence: I recorded how many times I took the medicine so it's easy to check the record.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 調查顯示，呢類問題發生嘅次數越嚟越多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: diu6 caa4 jin2 si6, ni1 leoi6 man6 tai4 faat3 sang1 ge3 ci3 sou3 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 调查显示，这类问题发生的次数越来越多。
examples.english_sentence: Surveys show that the frequency of such problems is increasing.

mandarin_meaning: 次文化（亚文化）
english_meaning: subculture
explanation_mandarin: 指在社会中与主流文化有所不同，具有独特价值观、习俗或生活方式的群体文化，如青年文化、次文化圈子或地下文化。
explanation_english: Refers to cultural groups within a society that differ from mainstream culture, having distinct values, customs, or ways of life (e.g., youth cultures, fan communities, underground scenes).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港有好多次文化，例如二次創作同地下音樂圈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jau5 hou2 do1 ci3 man4 faa3, lai6 jyu4 ji6 ci3 cong3 zok3 tung4 dei6 haa6 jam1 ngok6 hyun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港有很多次文化，例如二次创作和地下音乐圈。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong has many subcultures, such as fan works (doujin) and the underground music scene.

mandarin_meaning: 次方（表示冪運算，例如 x 的 n 次方）
english_meaning: power; exponent (e.g., x to the n-th power)
explanation_mandarin: 表示冪運算，指把一個數乘以自身若干次，用於表示 x 的 n 次方。
explanation_english: Denotes exponentiation — raising a number to a power, i.e. multiplying a number by itself n times (x to the n-th power).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 五嘅三次方係一百二十五。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ng5 ge3 saam1 ci3 fong1 hai6 jat1 baak3 ji6 sap6 ng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 五的三次方是125。
examples.english_sentence: Five to the power of three is 125.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺課堂上學咗點樣計平方同其他次方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 fo3 tong4 soeng6 hok6 zo2 dim2 joeng6 gai3 ping4 fong1 tung4 kei4 taa1 ci3 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在课堂上学了如何计算平方和其他次方。
examples.english_sentence: We learned in class how to calculate squares and other powers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺電腦程式入面，你可以用 pow(x,n) 去計次方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 din6 nou5 cing4 sik1 jap6 min6, nei5 ho2 ji5 jung6 pow(x,n) heoi3 gai3 ci3 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在电脑程序中，你可以用 pow(x,n) 来计算次方。
examples.english_sentence: In computer programs, you can use pow(x,n) to compute powers.

mandarin_meaning: （在程度、名次等）次于；遜於；僅次於
english_meaning: to be inferior to; to be second to; to rank below
explanation_mandarin: 表示在程度、名次或重要性上低於某人或某事，常用於比較或排名的描述中。
explanation_english: Indicates being lower in degree, rank, or importance than someone or something; commonly used in comparisons or ranking descriptions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅成績只次於班長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing4 zik1 zi2 ci3 jyu1 baan1 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的成績僅次於班長。
examples.english_sentence: His grades are second only to the class monitor.

mandarin_meaning: 次日；第二天；翌日
english_meaning: the next day; the following day
explanation_mandarin: 表示在當天之後的那一天，口語或書面皆可使用，常用於粵語和書面中文中，意同「第二天」或「翌日」。
explanation_english: Indicates the day after the current/mentioned day. Used in Cantonese and in written Chinese to mean 'the next day' or 'the following day.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋次日再去啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ci3 jat6 zoi3 heoi3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们第二天再去吧。
examples.english_sentence: We'll go again the next day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話會次日交貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 wui5 ci3 jat6 gaau1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她说会次日交货。
examples.english_sentence: He/She said the delivery would be the next day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 次日天氣轉好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ci3 jat6 tin1 hei3 zyun2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 次日天气转好。
examples.english_sentence: The next day, the weather improved.

mandarin_meaning: 每次
english_meaning: every time; each time
explanation_mandarin: 表示每一次、每回，屬於口語常用表達，通常用來強調事情反覆發生。
explanation_english: Used to indicate each occasion or every time something happens; a colloquial adverb often used to emphasize repeated occurrences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我次次考試都好緊張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ci3 ci3 haau2 si5 dou1 hou2 gan2 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每次考试都很紧张。
examples.english_sentence: I'm nervous every time I take an exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢次次遲到，真係好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci3 ci3 ci4 dou3, zan1 hai6 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每次都迟到，真是很烦。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is late every time; it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 次次食完飯都要食甜品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ci3 ci3 sik6 jyun4 faan6 dou1 jiu3 sik6 tim4 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每次吃完饭都要吃甜点。
examples.english_sentence: Every time after a meal, (we) have to eat dessert.

mandarin_meaning: 次等；劣等；品質或地位較低
english_meaning: second-rate; inferior; of lower quality or status
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容事物或人品質、地位或價值較低、不如一流或優等。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone as lower in quality, status, or value—second-rate or inferior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電話係次等產品，唔推薦買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 waa2 hai6 ci3 dang2 caan2 ban2, m4 teoi1 zin2 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部電話是次等產品，不推薦購買。
examples.english_sentence: This phone is a second-rate product; not recommended to buy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好用次等嘅標準去評價佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jung6 ci3 dang2 ge3 biu1 zeon2 heoi3 ping4 gaa3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要用次等的標準去評價他。
examples.english_sentence: Don't judge him by inferior standards.

mandarin_meaning: 次要 (cìyào)：次於主要、重要性較低
