english_meaning: main text; body (of a document or article)
explanation_mandarin: 指文章或文件中主要的內容或主體部分，不包括標題、目錄、註釋、附錄等。
explanation_english: Refers to the main content or body of a document or article, excluding the title, table of contents, footnotes, appendices, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇報告嘅正文仲未寫完。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 bou3 gou3 ge3 zing3 man4 zung6 mei6 se2 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这篇报告的正文还没写完。
examples.english_sentence: The main body of this report isn't finished yet.

mandarin_meaning: 很搞笑／非常有趣
english_meaning: hilarious; very funny; amusing
explanation_mandarin: 「正斗」是廣東話口語俚語，用來形容某事或某人非常好笑、十分滑稽，也可作感嘆用。
explanation_english: “正斗” is a Cantonese colloquial/slang term used to describe something or someone as extremely funny or amusing; it can also be used as an exclamation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲笑話真係好正斗，成班人笑到喊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 siu3waa6 zan1 hai6 hou2 zing3 dau2, seng4 baan1 jan4 siu3 dou3 haam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那些笑話真的很搞笑，全班人笑到喊。
examples.english_sentence: His jokes are really hilarious; the whole group laughed until they cried.

mandarin_meaning: 正方（辯論或比賽中支持某一觀點的一方）
english_meaning: the affirmative/proposition side (in a debate); the positive side
explanation_mandarin: 通常指辯論、辯論賽或討論中支持某一主張或論點的一方，也可泛指正面、肯定的一方。
explanation_english: Usually refers to the side in a debate or contest that supports a motion or argument (the affirmative/proposition side). It can also generally mean the positive or supporting side.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次辯論比賽我係正方，要支持自己嘅論點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 bin6 leon6 bei2 coi3 ngo5 hai6 zing3 fong1, jiu3 zi1 ci4 zi6 ge3 leon6 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次辯論比賽我在正方，要支持自己的論點。
examples.english_sentence: In this debate tournament I'm on the affirmative side; I need to support my own arguments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 主持人叫正方發言，每人有一分鐘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zyu2 ci4 jan4 giu3 zing3 fong1 faat3 jin4, mui5 jan4 jau5 jat1 fan1 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 主持人叫正方發言，每人有一分鐘。
examples.english_sentence: The moderator asked the affirmative side to speak; each person has one minute.

mandarin_meaning: 正方形 (zhèngfāngxíng)
english_meaning: square (geometric shape)
explanation_mandarin: 一种四边相等、四个直角的几何图形。
explanation_english: A geometric figure with four equal sides and four right angles; a square.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張紙係正方形。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 zi2 hai6 zing3 fong1 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张纸是正方形。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of paper is square.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校教我哋點樣計正方形嘅面積同周長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 gaau3 ngo5 dei6 dim2 joeng6 gai3 zing3 fong1 jing4 ge3 min6 zik1 tung4 zau1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学校教我们怎样计算正方形的面积和周长。
examples.english_sentence: School taught us how to calculate the area and perimeter of a square.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個盒係正方形，好易擺放。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hap6 hai6 zing3 fong1 jing4, hou2 ji6 baai2 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个盒是正方形，很容易摆放。
examples.english_sentence: This box is square and easy to place.

mandarin_meaning: 在某事发生的当天；就是那一天
english_meaning: on the very day; the exact day (of an event)
explanation_mandarin: 表示某件事正好在指定的那一天發生，強調是『當天』而非前後的日子。
explanation_english: Indicates that something happens on the exact, specified day; emphasizes the day itself rather than days before or after.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢正日先到，唔係預早嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zing3 jat6 sin1 dou3, m4 hai6 jyu6 zou2 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是在正日才到，不是提前来的。
examples.english_sentence: He only arrived on the actual day, not earlier.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 婚禮正日唔好遲到，最好早啲到場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan1 lai5 zing3 jat6 m4 hou2 ci4 dou3, zeoi3 hou2 zou2 di1 dou3 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 婚礼当天不要迟到，最好早点到场。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be late on the wedding day; it's best to arrive early.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要求我哋喺正日交報告，唔可以延遲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu1 kau4 ngo5 dei6 hai6 zing3 jat6 gaau1 bou3 gou3, m4 ho2 ji5 jin4 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要求我们在指定那天交报告，不能延迟。
examples.english_sentence: The company requires us to submit the report on the specified day; no delays allowed.

mandarin_meaning: 正是（恰恰是、正好是；用于强调，常见于书面语，如“正是因为……”）
english_meaning: exactly; precisely; (used to emphasize, as in “it is precisely because…”)
explanation_mandarin: “正是”用于强调某事恰恰如此、正好如此，常用于书面或正式语境，例：正是因為⋯⋯。口語中廣東話更常用“正係”或“就係”。
explanation_english: Used to emphasize that something is exactly or precisely the case (e.g. “it is precisely because…”). More common in written or formal registers; in spoken Cantonese speakers often say “正係” or “就係”.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 正是因為你幫我，我先做完。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 si6 jan1 wai6 nei5 bong1 ngo5, ngo5 sin1 zou6 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 正是因为你帮我，我才能做完。
examples.english_sentence: It was precisely because you helped me that I was able to finish.

mandarin_meaning: 非常棒／超讚／完全（用作強調）
english_meaning: awesome; totally (as an intensifier); really great
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 口語，感嘆詞 / 副詞（俗語）
explanation_mandarin: 「正晒」是廣東話口語，源自「正」(好、讚) 加上程度副詞「晒」(完全/非常)，用來強調事物很棒、很正或完全符合預期。有時也做感歎用。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial intensifier combining '正' (good/awesome) with the completive particle '晒' (completely). Used to emphasize that something is really great or totally so; can function as an intensifier or an exclamatory remark.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚嘅演唱會正晒！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ge3 jin2 coeng3 wui2 zing3 saai3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚的演唱会太棒了！
examples.english_sentence: Tonight's concert was awesome!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個新髮型正晒，好襯佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 san1 faat3 jing4 zing3 saai3, hou2 can3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他／她的新髮型超好看，非常適合他／她。
examples.english_sentence: Their new hairstyle looks awesome — it really suits them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢道菜做得正晒，好好味！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 coi3 zou6 dak1 zing3 saai3, hou2 hou2 mei6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這道菜做得非常好吃！
examples.english_sentence: This dish is really well made and delicious!

mandarin_meaning: 正月（农历一月）
english_meaning: the first month of the lunar year (Lunar January)
explanation_mandarin: 指農曆的一月，通常涵蓋春節期間及相關習俗（如拜年、放鞭炮、返鄉探親）。在粵語語境中常用來特指農曆新年期間。
explanation_english: Refers to the first month of the lunar calendar (Lunar January). It commonly includes Lunar New Year period and related customs (e.g., visiting relatives, setting off firecrackers). In Cantonese contexts it often specifically refers to the Lunar New Year period.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 正月入面大家會拜年，放鞭炮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 jyut6 jap6 min6 daai6 gaa1 wui5 baai3 nin4, fong3 bin1 paau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 正月里大家会拜年、放鞭炮。
examples.english_sentence: During the first lunar month, everyone visits relatives and sets off firecrackers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農曆正月初一係新年嘅第一日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 lik6 zing3 jyut6 co1 jat1 hai6 san1 nin4 ge3 dai6 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 农历正月初一是新年的第一天。
examples.english_sentence: The first day of the first lunar month (Lunar New Year's Day) is the first day of the new year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 正月嗰陣好多年青人會返鄉探親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 jyut6 go2 zan6 hou2 do1 nin4 cing1 jan4 wui5 faan1 hoeng1 taam3 can1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 正月那段時間很多年輕人會回鄉探親。
examples.english_sentence: In the first lunar month, many young people return to their hometowns to visit relatives.

mandarin_meaning: 承認某政權為正統；指朝代的正統地位或其年號、曆法（史書語境中常指是否承認朝廷的年號與正統性）
english_meaning: Recognition of a regime's legitimacy (historically: acknowledging an emperor's era name/calendar and thus his rightful authority)
explanation_mandarin: 史學與古文中用語，指朝廷所定的年號、曆法以及由此衍生的正統地位。各方是否"承認正朔"常用以表明承認某一政權為正統或合法。
explanation_english: A historical term referring to the recognition of an imperial regime's legitimacy—specifically its era name and calendar. Whether other states recognize the 'zhengshuo' often signals acceptance of that regime as the legitimate authority.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 周邊勢力會唔會承認新帝嘅正朔，決定咗佢嘅合法性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zau1 bin1 sai3 lik6 wui5 m4 wui5 sing4 jing6 san1 dai3 ge3 zing3 sok3, kyut3 ding6 zo2 keoi5 ge3 hap6 faat3 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 周边势力是否承认新帝的正朔，决定了他的合法性。
examples.english_sentence: Whether neighboring powers recognize the new emperor's zhengshuo determines his legitimacy.

mandarin_meaning: 正本（文件或證件的原件）
english_meaning: original copy (of a document); the original
explanation_mandarin: 指文件或證件的原件，相對於影印本、複本或副本。通常在辦理手續或法律程序時需要提交正本以作核驗。
explanation_english: Refers to the original version of a document or certificate, as opposed to a photocopy or duplicate. Often required for verification in administrative or legal procedures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我張合約要交正本畀公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zoeng1 hap6 joek3 jiu3 gaau1 zing3 bun2 bei2 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我需要把合約的正本交給公司。
examples.english_sentence: I need to hand the original copy of the contract to the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校只會收學生證正本，唔收影印本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 zi2 wui5 sau1 hok6 saang1 zing3 bun2, m4 sau1 jing2 jan3 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學校只會收學生證的正本，不收影印本。
examples.english_sentence: The school only accepts the original student ID, not photocopies.

mandarin_meaning: 正戏；主要的节目或表演；真正的高潮或重头戏
english_meaning: the main show; the main event; the real/climactic part
explanation_mandarin: 指演出或活動中最重要、最精彩或最具看點的部分；也常用作比喻，表示事情的重頭或真正要緊的部分。
explanation_english: Refers to the most important or spectacular part of a performance or event; also used metaphorically to mean the main event, the climax, or the part that really matters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好插嘴，正本戲仲未開始喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 caap3 zeoi2, zing3 bun2 hei3 zung6 mei6 hoi1 ci2 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別插嘴，正戲還沒開始呢。
examples.english_sentence: Don't interrupt, the main act hasn't started yet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等咗咁耐，正本戲而家先開始啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 zo2 gam2 noi6, zing3 bun2 hei3 ji4 gaa1 sin1 hoi1 ci2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等了這麼久，正戲現在才開始啦。
examples.english_sentence: After waiting so long, the main event is only just starting now.

mandarin_meaning: 非常棒；極好；很酷（口語、俚語）
english_meaning: extremely awesome; very cool; excellent (colloquial/slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「正極」是香港粵語口語/俚語，用來強調某事物非常好、很讚或很酷，類似「非常棒」、「超正」。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese colloquial/slang adjective used to emphasize that something is extremely good, awesome, or cool — similar to "super great" or "awesome."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電影正極，值得一睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 jing2 zing3 gik6, zik6 dak1 jat1 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部電影非常棒，值得一看。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is awesome — worth watching.

mandarin_meaning: 正楷（楷书）
english_meaning: regular script (kaishu); standard/block handwriting or font
explanation_mandarin: 指汉字的一种书体——楷书，笔画端正、结构规范，常用于正式书写、教学或印刷字体。
explanation_english: Refers to the regular script (kaishu) style of Chinese writing: strokes are neat and structure standardized. Commonly used for formal handwriting, teaching, and printed fonts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 功課要用正楷寫，老師先至容易批改。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 fo3 jiu3 jung6 zing3 kaai2 se2, lou5 si1 sin1 zi3 jung4 ji6 bat1 goi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作业要用正楷写，老师才容易批改。
examples.english_sentence: Homework should be written in standard regular script; it's easier for the teacher to grade.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學書法要由正楷開始學起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 syu1 faat3 jiu3 jau4 zing3 kaai2 hoi1 ci2 hok6 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学书法要从正楷开始学起。
examples.english_sentence: When learning calligraphy, you should start with regular script.

mandarin_meaning: 好歌；優秀的歌曲（口語）
english_meaning: a great song; an excellent track (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，用來稱讚一首歌曲很出色、好聽或有質感，相當於「好歌」或「靚歌」。常見於香港日常對話中。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese expression used to praise a song as excellent, catchy, or high-quality. Equivalent to 'a great song' or 'a banger' in casual speech, commonly used in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首歌真係正歌！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 go1 zan1 hai6 zing3 go1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這首歌真的是好歌！
examples.english_sentence: This song is really awesome!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢出嘅新碟有幾首真係正歌，特別係第三首。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ceot1 ge3 san1 dik2 jau5 gei2 sau2 zan1 hai6 zing3 go1, dak6 bit6 hai6 dai6 saam1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他出的新專輯有好幾首真的是好歌，特別是第三首。
examples.english_sentence: His new album has several really great tracks, especially the third one.

mandarin_meaning: 正好；恰好；正確地
english_meaning: exactly; precisely; just (right)
explanation_mandarin: 用來加強語氣，表示恰好、正是或強調準確性，常見於口語。例如「時間正正好」。
explanation_english: Used to emphasize that something is exactly/precisely so or just right. Common in colloquial Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 時間正正好，我哋依家出發。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si4 gaan1 zing3 zing3 hou2, ngo5 dei6 ji1 gaa1 ceot1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 时间正好，我们现在出发。
examples.english_sentence: The timing is just right — let's leave now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢正正係咁講嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zing3 zing3 hai6 gam2 gong2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他正正就是这么说的。
examples.english_sentence: That's exactly what he said.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條裙長度正正啱我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 kwan4 coeng4 dou6 zing3 zing3 aam1 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条裙子的长度正好合适我。
examples.english_sentence: The dress length fits me exactly.

mandarin_meaning: 正比（數學術語，表示兩個量成正比例）
english_meaning: direct proportion; directly proportional
explanation_mandarin: 表示兩個量隨另一量按同一比例變化，關係稱為正比或成正比。
explanation_english: A mathematical term indicating that two quantities change in the same ratio; they are directly proportional.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩個數係正比。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 go3 sou3 hai6 zeng3 bei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 兩個數是正比。
examples.english_sentence: The two numbers are directly proportional.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 收入未必同開支成正比。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau1 jap6 mei6 bat1 tung4 hoi1 zi1 sing4 zeng3 bei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 收入未必與開支成正比。
examples.english_sentence: Income is not necessarily directly proportional to expenses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 壓力同工作量通常係成正比。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aat3 lik6 tung4 gung1 zok3 loeng6 tung1 soeng4 hai6 sing4 zeng3 bei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 壓力和工作量通常成正比。
examples.english_sentence: Stress and workload are usually directly proportional.

mandarin_meaning: 正气（正直的氣概；中醫所說的“正氣”）
english_meaning: zhengqi; righteous uprightness or moral integrity; (in TCM) vital/defensive qi
explanation_mandarin: 可指人的正直、正義感與骨氣，也可指中醫所說維持身體健康的“正氣”。
explanation_english: Can mean a person's uprightness, righteousness, or moral integrity; also refers to 'zhengqi' in traditional Chinese medicine — the vital/defensive energy that keeps one healthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做人好有正氣，從來唔做虧心嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 jan4 hou2 jau5 zing3 hei3, cung4 loi4 m4 zou6 kwai1 sam1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為人很有正氣，從來不做虧心事。
examples.english_sentence: He is very upright and never does shameful things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中醫話正氣不足會容易生病，要調理好正氣先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 ji1 waa6 zing3 hei3 bat1 zuk1 wui5 jung6 ji6 saang1 beng6, jiu3 tiu4 lei5 hou2 zing3 hei3 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中醫說正氣不足會容易生病，要先調理好正氣。
examples.english_sentence: TCM says insufficient zhengqi makes one prone to illness; you should restore your zhengqi first.

mandarin_meaning: 正氣凜然（形容充滿正義感和威嚴，令人敬畏）
english_meaning: To be full of righteous spirit and gravitas; imposing moral integrity that inspires awe.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或言行充滿正義感、威嚴，使人感到敬畏與尊重。
explanation_english: Describes a person or demeanour marked by strong righteousness and solemn dignity, evoking respect or awe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺法庭上，佢以正氣凜然嘅態度為受害人陳述真相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 faat3 ting4 soeng6, keoi5 ji5 zing3 hei3 lam5 jin4 ge3 taai3 dou6 wai6 sau6 hoi6 jan4 can4 seot6 zan1 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在法庭上，他以正氣凜然的態度為受害者陳述真相。
examples.english_sentence: In court, he spoke on behalf of the victim with a demeanor full of righteous dignity.

mandarin_meaning: 正派 (zhèngpài)：品行端正、正直、值得信賴；行為合乎正當或規矩。
english_meaning: upright; honest; respectable; proper; aboveboard
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人品端正、正直、不做壞事；也可指做事方式正當、不欺詐、不投機取巧。
explanation_english: Describes a person or behavior that is honest, upright, and respectable; also refers to actions that are proper and aboveboard without deceit or trickery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個好正派嘅人，從來唔做騙人嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 zing3 paai3 ge3 jan4, cung4 loi4 m4 zou6 pin3 jan4 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是個很正派的人，從來不做騙人的事。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very upright person; he never does deceitful things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺公司裏面，老細好重視正派同誠信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gung1 si1 leoi5 min6, lou5 sai3 hou2 zung6 si6 zing3 paai3 tung4 sing4 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在公司裡面，老闆很重視正派和誠信。
examples.english_sentence: In the company, the boss values uprightness and honesty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅處事方式正派，唔會利用人哋嚟達到目的。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 cyu3 si6 fong1 sik1 zing3 paai3, m4 wui5 lei6 jung6 jan4 dei6 lai4 daat6 dou3 muk6 dik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的處事方式正派，不會利用別人來達到目的。
examples.english_sentence: His way of handling matters is upright; he won't use others to achieve his goals.

mandarin_meaning: 正片 (zhèngpiān)：電影的正片、主要影片；攝影中的正片（反轉片/幻燈片）
english_meaning: feature film; main feature; (in photography) positive/reversal (slide) film
explanation_mandarin: 指電影裡作為主要放映的片段或完整影片（相對於預告片、短片等）；在攝影領域也指反轉片/正片（slide），需要專業沖洗處理。口語中亦用作「正式播放的影片」。
explanation_english: Refers to the main film shown in a cinema (as opposed to trailers or short clips); in photography it denotes reversal/positive (slide) film which requires special development. Colloquially used for the official/main version of a movie.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去戲院睇正片啦，預告我已經睇過喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 heoi3 hei3 jyun2 tai2 zing3 pin2 laa1, jyu6 gou3 ngo5 ji5 ging1 tai2 gwo3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們今晚去電影院看正片吧，預告我已經看過了。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the cinema to watch the main feature tonight; I've already seen the trailers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢卷底片係正片（反轉片），沖洗時要交俾專業實驗室處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gyun2 dai2 pin3 hai6 zing3 pin2 (faan2 zyun2 pin3), cung1 sai2 si4 jiu3 gaau1 bei2 zyun1 jip6 sat6 jim6 sat1 cyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這卷底片是正片（反轉片），沖洗時要交給專業實驗室處理。
examples.english_sentence: This roll is reversal/positive film (slide film); it should be developed by a professional lab.

mandarin_meaning: 正版 (zhèngbǎn) — 官方、正式或原版的版本/拷貝
english_meaning: official/legitimate/original edition (e.g., official copy of software, media)
explanation_mandarin: 指由官方或原作者發行的正式版本，與盜版或翻印版相對。常用於軟件、電影、書籍等領域。
explanation_english: Refers to an official or original version released by the rights holder, as opposed to pirated or bootleg copies. Commonly used for software, movies, books, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套電影係正版，唔係盜版。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 din6 jing2 hai6 zing3 baan2, m4 hai6 dou6 baan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這套電影是正版，不是盜版。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is an official/genuine copy, not a pirated one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你最好買正版軟件，唔好用盜版。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeoi3 hou2 maai5 zing3 baan2 jyun5 gin6, m4 hou2 jung6 dou6 baan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好買正版軟件，不要用盜版。
examples.english_sentence: You'd better buy the legitimate software; don't use pirated versions.

mandarin_meaning: 正牌；正式的／真正的；（口語）官方或正規的，亦可指「正式交往的（男/女朋友）」
english_meaning: legitimate; genuine; official; bona fide; (colloquial) the 'official' or 'real' one (e.g., an official boyfriend/girlfriend)
explanation_mandarin: 「正牌」是粵語口語用詞，表示事物是真正、正宗或正式的；亦常用來指已確認的正式伴侶（如「正牌男朋友」）。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '正牌' denotes something genuine, official, or legitimate. It is also used colloquially to refer to an established/official romantic partner (e.g., 'official boyfriend').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我正牌男朋友，唔係玩嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 zing3 paai4 naam4 pang4 jau5, m4 hai6 waan2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我的正牌男朋友，不是玩玩的。
examples.english_sentence: He's my official boyfriend, not someone I'm just playing around with.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部係正牌貨，唔係仿冒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 hai6 zing3 paai4 fo3, m4 hai6 fong2 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部是正牌貨，不是仿冒的。
examples.english_sentence: This is an authentic product, not a counterfeit.

mandarin_meaning: 名副其实的烂仔／正牌渣男
english_meaning: a bona fide 'bad boy' or scoundrel; a real jerk/womanizer (colloquial, derogatory)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人是地道的壞蛋或渣男，帶貶義，常在口語中評價其感情或行為不負責任。
explanation_english: A colloquial, derogatory Cantonese phrase describing someone as a genuine troublemaker or 'bad boy'—often implying a confirmed womanizer or irresponsible jerk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好俾佢呃，你睇佢咁樣，正牌爛仔嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 aak1, nei5 tai2 keoi5 gam2 joeng6, zing3 paai4 laan6 zai2 lei4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別讓他騙你，看他那樣，真的是個正牌爛仔。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let him fool you — look at him, he's a real scoundrel.

mandarin_meaning: （粵語俚語）非常好、很棒
english_meaning: Cantonese slang meaning very good, awesome, or spot-on
explanation_mandarin: 「正球」是香港粵語口語俚語，用來誇讚某事或某人非常好、很厲害或很潮，帶有強烈的肯定語氣。
explanation_english: "Zing kau" is Hong Kong Cantonese slang used to praise something or someone as very good, awesome, or stylish. It carries a strong affirmative/emphatic tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫真係正球！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 zan1 hai6 zing3 kau4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件衣服真是太棒了！
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is really awesome!

mandarin_meaning: 正当 (zhèngdāng)；合適、合理或合法；也可指處於恰當的時機
english_meaning: justifiable; proper; appropriate; legitimate
explanation_mandarin: 表示某種行為或理由是合理、合情或符合法律與道德標準，也可用來形容事情處在恰當的時機或情況下。
explanation_english: Indicates that an action or reason is reasonable, appropriate, or legally/ethically justified; can also describe something occurring at an appropriate or timely moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你淨係為咗自衛而反擊，法庭可能會認為你係正當防衛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 zing6 hai6 wai4 zo2 zi6 wai6 ji4 faan2 gik1, faat3 ting4 ho2 nang4 wui5 jing6 wai6 nei5 hai6 zing3 dong1 fong4 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你只是为了自卫而反击，法庭可能会认为你属于正当防卫。
examples.english_sentence: If you only fought back to defend yourself, the court may consider it legitimate (justifiable) defense.

mandarin_meaning: 很調皮、頑皮（口語/俚語），多用來形容人或言行俏皮、有趣、有點狡黠但令人覺得可愛或好笑
english_meaning: very cheeky/playfully mischievous (slang); used to describe someone or something that is playfully bold, amusing, or a bit naughty in an endearing way
explanation_mandarin: 「正皮」是香港粵語俚語，通常用來形容人或行為很調皮、俏皮或好玩，有時帶讚賞或覺得好笑的語氣，而不是嚴重的壞或不禮貌。
explanation_english: “正皮” is Hong Kong Cantonese slang used to describe someone or something as cheeky, playful, or amusingly naughty. It usually carries a positive or amused tone rather than serious disapproval.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日成日扮嘢，好正皮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 sing4 jat6 baan6 je5, hou2 zing3 pei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天一直在耍寶，很調皮/很俏皮。
examples.english_sentence: He kept clowning around today — so cheeky.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嗰句真係正皮，笑死我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 go2 geoi3 zan1 hai6 zing3 pei4, siu3 sei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你說的那句真的很俏皮，笑死我了。
examples.english_sentence: That line you said was so cheeky — it cracked me up.

mandarin_meaning: 正直，誠實、正派
english_meaning: upright; honest; straightforward
explanation_mandarin: 形容一個人品行端正、誠實、不說謊、不做虛偽的事，通常用來稱讚人的品德。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is morally upright, honest, and straightforward; does not deceive or act hypocritically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做人好正直，大家都好信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 jan4 hou2 zing3 zik6, daai6gaa1 dou1 hou2 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為人很正直，大家都很信任他。
examples.english_sentence: He is very upright and honest; everyone trusts him.

mandarin_meaning: 正确 (zhèngquè)
english_meaning: correct; accurate; right
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物没有错误、符合事实或标准。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is free from error, accurate, or conforms to facts or standards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你提供嘅資料唔正確。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai4 gung1 ge3 zi1 liu2 m4 zeng3 kok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你提供的资料不正确。
examples.english_sentence: The information you provided is not correct.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢題答案係正確。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tai4 daap3 on3 hai6 zeng3 kok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这题的答案是正确的。
examples.english_sentence: The answer to this question is correct.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅說法唔完全正確，但有啲道理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 syut3 faat3 m4 jyun4 cyun4 zeng3 kok3, daan6 jau5 di1 dou6 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的说法不完全正确，但有些道理。
examples.english_sentence: His statement isn't entirely correct, but there's some truth to it.

mandarin_meaning: 站好／站正
english_meaning: stand properly; stand straight
explanation_mandarin: 由「正」（正確、端正）與「站」（站立）組成，表示站得端正或站好，常用於指導姿勢或要求某人站直。
explanation_english: Formed from '正' (proper/upright) and '站' (to stand); it means to stand properly or stand straight, often used to instruct posture or tell someone to stand correctly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 教練叫我哋上場前要正站。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau3 lin6 giu3 ngo5 dei6 soeng5 coeng4 cin4 jiu3 zing3 zaam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 教练叫我们上场前要站好。
examples.english_sentence: The coach told us to stand properly before we went on the field.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 影相嗰陣，大家要正站，好似模特咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jing2 soeng2 go2 zan6, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 zing3 zaam6, hou2 ci2 mo4 dak6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拍照的时候，大家要站好，像模特那样。
examples.english_sentence: When taking photos, everyone should stand properly like models.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路學跳舞，老師教佢哋要正站。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 hok6 tiu3 mou5, lou5 si1 gaau3 keoi5 dei6 jiu3 zing3 zaam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩学跳舞，老师教他们要站好。
examples.english_sentence: Children learning dance are taught by the teacher to stand properly.

mandarin_meaning: 正统（正宗、合乎傳統或官方認可）
english_meaning: orthodox; legitimate; authentic; traditional
explanation_mandarin: 表示符合傳統、正宗或被公認為正當、合法、傳承正確的樣式或觀念，可形容文化、觀點、風格或血統等。
explanation_english: Indicates something orthodox, legitimate, or authentically traditional—conforming to established, recognized, or classical standards. Can describe styles, views, lineage, institutions, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅菜式好正統，味道好似以前一樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 coi3 sik1 hou2 zing3 tung2, mei6 dou6 hou2 ci5 ji5 cin4 jat1 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間餐廳的菜式很正統，味道好像以前一樣。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's dishes are very authentic—the taste is like it used to be.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅係正統歷史觀，唔係幾偏激嘅解讀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 hai6 zing3 tung2 lik6 si2 gun1, m4 hai6 gei2 pin1 gik6 ge3 gaai2 duk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說的是正統的歷史觀，不是很偏激的解讀。
examples.english_sentence: What he is saying is the orthodox view of history, not a radical interpretation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲唔係好創新，係比較正統嘅港式喜劇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 m4 hai6 hou2 cong3 san1, hai6 bei2 gaau3 zing3 tung2 ge3 gong2 sik1 hei2 kek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部戲不太創新，是比較正統的港式喜劇。
examples.english_sentence: This film isn't very innovative; it's a relatively traditional Hong Kong-style comedy.

mandarin_meaning: 正经（规矩、严肃、端正）
english_meaning: proper; serious; respectable; decent
explanation_mandarin: 表示人或言行端正、严肃、不轻浮，也可表示合乎体面、规矩。
explanation_english: Describes a person or behavior that is proper, serious, respectable, not frivolous; can also mean decent or upright.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好正經，唔會開玩笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zing3 ging1, m4 wui5 hoi1 waan6 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很正经，不会开玩笑。
examples.english_sentence: He is very serious/proper and doesn't joke around.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘢好唔正經。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 je5 hou2 m4 zing3 ging1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说话很不正经。
examples.english_sentence: You talk in a very unserious/inappropriate way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個正經人，做事好有原則。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 zing3 ging1 jan4, zou6 si6 hou2 jau5 jyun4 zak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是个正经人，做事很有原则。
examples.english_sentence: He's a respectable/serious person who is principled in his work.

mandarin_meaning: 非常正經；一本正經；很規矩
english_meaning: very serious/proper; strictly respectable; utterly legitimate
explanation_mandarin: 「正經八百」是粵語慣用語，形容人或事非常正經、規矩或一本正經，也可表示某事物很正式或可信。
explanation_english: A Cantonese idiom meaning very serious, proper, or respectable. It describes a person or thing as solemn, well-behaved, formal, or legitimately reliable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好正經八百，成日都好仔細。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 zing3 ging1 baat3 baak3, sing4 jat6 dou1 hou2 zai2 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很正經，非常仔細。
examples.english_sentence: He takes his work very seriously and is always meticulous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為佢唔笑就唔幽默，佢其實好正經八百。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 keoi5 m4 siu3 zau6 m4 jau1 mo1, keoi5 kei4 sat6 hou2 zing3 ging1 baat3 baak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別以為他不笑就不幽默，他其實很正經。
examples.english_sentence: Don't assume he's not funny because he doesn't laugh; he's actually very straight-laced.

mandarin_meaning: 主线；正规路线、正規渠道
english_meaning: main line; main storyline; official/legitimate channel
explanation_mandarin: 指主要的路線或主線故事，也可指走正規、合法或正式的渠道或方式。
explanation_english: Refers to the primary route or main storyline; can also mean using the official, legitimate, or proper channel/method.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲嘅正線好吸引，唔好俾支線搶晒風頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 ge3 zing3 sin3 hou2 hap1 jan5, m4 hou2 bei2 zi1 sin3 coeng2 saai3 fung1 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部戏的主线很吸引，不要被支线抢了风头。
examples.english_sentence: The main plot of this film is very compelling; don't let the side plots steal the limelight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做project要行正線，唔好亂加太多支線，會拖慢進度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 project jiu3 haang4 zing3 sin3, m4 hou2 lyun6 gaa1 taai3 do1 zi1 sin3, wui5 to1 maan6 zeon3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做项目要走主线，不要随便增加太多支线，会拖慢进度。
examples.english_sentence: For the project, stick to the main line; don't randomly add too many side tasks—they'll slow progress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果想攞批文要走正線，唔好偷步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 soeng2 lo2 pai1 man4 jiu3 zau2 zing3 sin3, m4 hou2 tau1 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果想拿到批准文件要走正规渠道，不要走捷径。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to obtain approval, go through the proper channels—don't take shortcuts.

mandarin_meaning: 正义
english_meaning: justice; righteousness
explanation_mandarin: 指符合公正、道德或法律標準的正當性、正確性或正直的行為與原則，常用來表示維護公平與道德正當的立場或行動。
explanation_english: Refers to justice or righteousness — the principle of fairness and moral or legal rightness. Often used to describe actions or principles that uphold fairness and moral correctness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要為正義出聲，唔好畀不公義繼續發生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wai4 zing3 ji6 ceot1 sing1, m4 hou2 bei2 bat1 gung1 ji6 gai3 zuk6 faat3 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要为正义发声，不要让不公义继续发生。
examples.english_sentence: We should speak up for justice and not let injustice continue to happen.

mandarin_meaning: 正义之师
english_meaning: a force/army of justice; champions of justice; righteous force
explanation_mandarin: 「正義之師」為文言或書面語，字面指為伸張正義而出征的軍隊或力量，現多用作比喻，指自稱或被視為維護正義的人或團體，亦可帶諷刺意味。
explanation_english: A classical/literary phrase literally meaning 'a force/army of justice.' It can refer to armies fighting for justice or, metaphorically, to people or groups who claim to defend justice (sometimes used ironically).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋自稱係正義之師，但其實只係打住正義嘅旗號嚟謀私利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zi6 cing1 hai6 zing3 ji6 zi1 si1, daan6 kei4 sat6 zi2 hai6 daa2 zyu6 zing3 ji6 ge3 kei4 hou6 lai4 mou4 si1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们自称是正义之师，但其实只是打着“正义”的旗号谋取私利。
examples.english_sentence: They claim to be a force of justice, but in reality they're only using 'justice' as a banner to pursue selfish interests.

mandarin_meaning: 正义感
english_meaning: sense of justice; a sense of righteousness
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人对于公平与正义的敏感，以及愿意维护公理、反对不公平行为的意识和倾向。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's sensitivity to fairness and justice and the tendency or willingness to uphold what is right and oppose injustice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有強烈嘅正義感，成日幫人講公道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 koeng4 lit6 ge3 zing3 ji6 gam2, sing4 jat6 bong1 jan4 gong2 gung1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有强烈的正义感，经常为别人伸张公道。
examples.english_sentence: He has a strong sense of justice and often stands up for others.

mandarin_meaning: 正職（正式的工作/全職崗位）
english_meaning: a regular/official job; a full-time position (as opposed to part-time or temporary work)
explanation_mandarin: 指正式的工作崗位或全職職位，與兼職、臨時工或合約工相對。
explanation_english: Refers to an official or regular job position, typically full-time, as opposed to part-time, temporary, or contract work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家搵緊工，希望搵到一份正職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4gaa1 wan2 gan2 gung1, hei1mong6 wan2 dou3 jat1 fan6 zing3 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在正在找工作，希望能找到一份正職。
examples.english_sentence: I'm currently job hunting; I hope to find a full-time/regular job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢之前喺公司做兼職，而家搵到正職，工資穩定啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi1cin4 hai2 gung1si1 zou6 gim1zik1, ji4gaa1 wan2 dou3 zing3 zik1, gung1zi1 wan5ding6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以前在公司做兼職，現在找到正職，薪水比較穩定。
examples.english_sentence: He used to work part-time at the company; now he got a full-time job, so his pay is more stable.

mandarin_meaning: 正能量（表示積極、向上、鼓舞人心的影響或情緒）
english_meaning: positive energy; positive vibes — an uplifting, motivating or encouraging influence or attitude
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词（短语 / 口语用法）
explanation_mandarin: 指能帶來積極、鼓舞或正面影響的情緒、言行或資訊，常用於社交媒體與日常口語，表示給人動力或希望的力量。
explanation_english: Refers to uplifting, encouraging, or positive influence conveyed by people, words, actions, or content. Commonly used in casual speech and social media to describe things that give motivation or hope.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日講嘅嘢好有正能量，令到我想努力多啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 gong2 ge3 je5 hou2 jau5 zing3 nang4 loeng6, ling6 dou3 ngo5 soeng2 nou5 lik6 do1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天說的話很有正能量，讓我想更努力。
examples.english_sentence: What you said today was full of positive energy; it made me want to work harder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 社交媒體有時會充斥負面消息，記得睇啲正能量嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se5 gaau1 mui4 tai2 jau5 si4 wui5 cung1 cik1 fu6 min6 siu1 sik1, gei3 dak1 tai2 di1 zing3 nang4 loeng6 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 社交媒體有時會充斥負面消息，記得多看些正能量的內容。
examples.english_sentence: Social media can be full of negative news sometimes; remember to look for more positive content.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）非常漂亮／很吸引（帶有俏皮或物化意味）
english_meaning: (colloquial, slang) very attractive; hot; strikingly pretty (can be playful or slightly objectifying)
explanation_mandarin: 「正花」是粵語口語俗語，由「正」（好、正／好看）和「花」（花、嬌豔）組合。常用來形容人或相片非常吸引、漂亮或性感，語氣非正式，有時帶玩笑或物化意味，主要在香港等粵語社群使用。
explanation_english: “正花” is Cantonese colloquial slang formed from 正 (good/attractive) + 花 (flower/bloom). It’s used to describe someone or an image as very attractive, pretty, or sexy. The term is informal, often playful, and can sometimes be slightly objectifying. Common in Hong Kong Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇下嗰個女仔，正花到爆！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 haa5 go2 neoi5 zai2, zing3 faa1 dou3 baau3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看看那個女孩，超級漂亮！
examples.english_sentence: Look at that girl—she's super hot!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢張相真係好正花，吸引到唔得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 soeng2 zan1 hai6 hou2 zing3 faa1, kap1 jan5 dou3 m4 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的照片真的很漂亮，非常吸引。
examples.english_sentence: Her photo is really gorgeous and extremely eye-catching.

mandarin_meaning: 非常痛苦／很辛苦
english_meaning: really painful; extremely tough or miserable
explanation_mandarin: 香港粵語口語（俚語）用法，用來形容某件事或經歷非常辛苦、難受或令人折磨。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese colloquial/slang term used to describe something that is very hard, miserable, or a painful experience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排工作忙到冇時間瞓，真係正苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 gung1 zok3 mong4 dou3 mou5 si4 gaan3 fan3, zan1 hai6 zing3 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近工作忙到沒有時間睡，真是很痛苦。
examples.english_sentence: I've been so busy with work lately I don't even have time to sleep—it's really miserable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幫人搬屋嗰日真係正苦，全部嘢都好重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bong1 jan4 bun1 nguk1 go2 jat6 zan1 hai6 zing3 fu2, cyun4 bou6 je5 dou1 hou2 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 幫人搬家的那天真的很辛苦，所有東西都很重。
examples.english_sentence: Helping someone move that day was really tough; everything was heavy.

mandarin_meaning: 正莊位
english_meaning: dealer's seat / seat of honour; the official/main position
explanation_mandarin: 「正莊位」在廣東話中可指正式的莊家席位（例如打麻將時的莊家座位），或宴會、合照等場合的主位；也可引申指正式負責或主導的職位或位置。屬口語用法，常見於遊戲或社交情境。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "正莊位" refers to the official dealer's seat (e.g., the dealer's position in mahjong) or the seat of honour at events/photos; by extension it means the official or primary position/person in charge. It is colloquial and used in gaming and social contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺打麻將嗰陣，坐喺正莊位嘅人就係莊家，輪到佢發牌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 daa2 maa4zoeng1 go2 zan6, cok3 hai2 zing3 zong1 wai2 ge3 jan4 zau6 hai6 zong1 gaa1, leon4 dou3 keoi5 faat3 paai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 打麻將時，坐在正莊位的人就是莊家，輪到他發牌。
examples.english_sentence: In mahjong, the person sitting in the dealer's seat (正莊位) is the dealer and it's their turn to deal.

mandarin_meaning: 主菜；比喻重頭戲或最精彩的部分
english_meaning: main dish / main course; figuratively: the main act or the highlight
explanation_mandarin: 「正菜」原指正餐中的主菜，也可作比喻用來指活動或節目中最重要、最精彩的部分。在香港粵語口語中常見，既可字面表示餐飲的主菜，也可表示「重頭戲」、「精華」等意思。
explanation_english: “Zing coi” literally refers to the main dish of a meal. Figuratively it is used to mean the main act, highlight, or the best/most important part of an event. In Hong Kong Cantonese it appears both in literal food contexts and as slang to praise something as the real/main attraction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋食完頭盤，正菜就係燒鴨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sik6 jyun4 tau4 pun2, zing3 coi3 zau6 hai6 siu1 aap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們吃完頭盤，正菜就是燒鴨。
examples.english_sentence: After the appetizers, the main course is roast duck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演唱會到尾先係正菜，頭先嗰啲只係暖場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin2 coeng3 wui6 dou3 mei5 sin1 hai6 zing3 coi3, tau4 sin1 go2 di1 zi2 hai6 nyun5 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱會到最後才是正菜，剛才那些只是暖場。
examples.english_sentence: The concert's finale is the main act; the earlier performances were just warm-ups.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰套戲真係正菜，值得再睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 tou3 hei3 zan1 hai6 zing3 coi3, zik1 dak1 zoi3 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那部電影真是正菜，值得再看。
examples.english_sentence: That movie is really top-notch — worth watching again.

mandarin_meaning: 基本工资；固定薪水（不含佣金、奖金或津贴）
english_meaning: basic salary; base pay (fixed salary excluding commissions, bonuses, or allowances)
explanation_mandarin: 指工作中的固定基本工资，通常不包括佣金、花红或各种津贴。常在招聘或谈薪时使用。
explanation_english: Refers to the fixed/basic salary for a job, usually excluding commissions, bonuses, or allowances. Commonly used in job ads and salary discussions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工嘅正薪係一萬五蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 ge3 zing3 san1 hai6 jat1 maan6 ng5 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作的基本工资是 15,000 港元。
examples.english_sentence: The basic salary for this job is HK$15,000.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個職位嘅正薪唔包佣金同花紅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zik1 wai6 ge3 zing3 san1 m4 baau1 jung4 gam1 tung4 faa1 hung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个职位的基本工资不包含佣金和奖金。
examples.english_sentence: The base salary for this position does not include commissions or bonuses.

mandarin_meaning: 正經／正派／正當（指合規、光明正大、不弄虛作假）
english_meaning: legitimate; proper; aboveboard; respectable
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人或某事合乎規範、正當或光明正大，不做欺騙或見不得人的事，常用於評價人或行為是否「正經」或「老實」。
explanation_english: Indicates that a person or action is proper, legitimate, and aboveboard — not deceitful or shady. Often used to describe someone or something as upright or respectable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間店做生意好正行，唔會呃人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 dim3 zou6 sang1 ji3 hou2 zing3 haang4, m4 wui5 aak1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間店做生意很正經，不會欺騙顧客。
examples.english_sentence: This shop does business properly and won't cheat customers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做人好正行，大家都好尊重佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 jan4 hou2 zing3 haang4, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 zyun1 zung3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為人很正派，大家都很尊重他。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very upright person; everyone respects him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單買賣要正行處理，唔好偷偷摸摸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 maai5 maai6 jiu3 zing3 haang4 cyu3 lei5, m4 hou2 tau1 tau1 mo1 mo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這筆買賣要正當處理，不要偷偷摸摸。
examples.english_sentence: This deal must be handled properly, not secretly.

mandarin_meaning: 正要（zhèng yào）
english_meaning: just about to; on the point of
explanation_mandarin: 表示某動作或事情馬上就要發生或開始，強調即將發生的時刻。
explanation_english: Indicates an action or event is about to happen or start, emphasizing that something is imminent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我正要出門，你就打嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zing3 jiu3 ceot1 mun4, nei5 zau6 daa2 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我正要出门，你就打来。
examples.english_sentence: I was just about to go out when you called.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢正要開會，唔方便傾偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zing3 jiu3 hoi1 wui6, m4 fong1 bin6 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他正要开会，不方便聊天。
examples.english_sentence: He's about to start a meeting, not convenient to chat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可能正要落雨，我哋快啲返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 nang4 zing3 jiu3 lok6 jyu5, ngo5 dei6 faai3 di1 faan1 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 可能正要下雨，我们快点回家。
examples.english_sentence: It might be about to rain; let's hurry home.

mandarin_meaning: 正規 / 正规（標準、合乎規範、正式）
english_meaning: standard; regular; formal; legitimate; proper
explanation_mandarin: 表示符合規範、正式或合法的狀態，常用來形容程序、機構或做法是否合乎標準。
explanation_english: Indicates something that is standard, regular, formal, or compliant with rules—used to describe procedures, organizations, or practices as proper or legitimate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲做法唔正規，可能有問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 zou6 faat3 m4 zing3 kwai1, ho2 nang4 jau5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些做法不正規，可能有問題。
examples.english_sentence: These practices are not standard; there may be problems.

mandarin_meaning: 正视 (zhèngshì)
english_meaning: to face squarely; to confront; to face up to
explanation_mandarin: 表示正面地看待或面对某事，不回避，勇于面对现实或问题。
explanation_english: To look squarely at something or to confront an issue or reality instead of avoiding it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要正視呢個問題，唔可以再迴避。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zing3 si6 ni1 go3 man6 tai4, m4 ho2 ji5 zoi6 wui4 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要正视这个问题，不能再回避。
examples.english_sentence: We need to face this problem; we can't avoid it any longer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要正視自己嘅不足，先可以進步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 zing3 si6 zi6 gei2 ge3 bat1 zuk1, sin1 ho2 ji5 zeon3 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要正视自己的不足，才能进步。
examples.english_sentence: You must face your own shortcomings in order to improve.

mandarin_meaning: 正面評價；好評
english_meaning: positive review; favorable comment; praise
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示對某事物或表現的正面評價或讚賞，常見於口語或網絡語境（例如影片、商品、表現等）。
explanation_english: Used to indicate a positive evaluation or praise for something (e.g., a film, product, or performance). Commonly used in colloquial speech and online contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電影喺網上攞咗好多正評。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 jing2 hai2 mong5 soeng6 lo2 zo2 hou2 do1 zing3 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影在网上获得了很多好评。
examples.english_sentence: This movie received many positive reviews online.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅報告攞到老闆嘅正評。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 bou3 gou3 lo2 dou3 lou5 baan2 ge3 zing3 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的报告得到了老板的好评。
examples.english_sentence: His report received praise from the boss.

mandarin_meaning: 說實話／說真的
english_meaning: to be honest; 'real talk' (speak honestly/seriously)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 口語短語（動詞/感嘆用法）
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，表示要說實話、直接講或認真講述意見。常作句首的提示語或作動詞短語（例如「講正話」）。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression used to introduce honest, straightforward, or serious talk. Often used at the start of a sentence or as a verb phrase (e.g., "gong2 zing3 waa6" = "say it straight").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講正話啦，你真係想去定係唔想？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 zing3 waa6 laa1, nei5 zan1 hai6 soeng2 heoi3 ding6 hai6 m4 soeng2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 說實話，你真的想去還是不想？
examples.english_sentence: Be honest — do you really want to go or not?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 正話，我覺得佢做得唔錯，但要改進。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 waa6, ngo5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 zou6 dak1 m4 co3, daan6 jiu3 goi2 zeon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 說實話，我覺得他做得不錯，但需要改進。
examples.english_sentence: To be honest, I think he did okay, but needs improvement.

mandarin_meaning: （粵語口語）非常、很、很棒；強調語氣的俗語
english_meaning: Cantonese slang intensifier meaning really / very / awesome (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「正誕」是香港粵語的俗語或網路用語，用來為形容詞或整句話加強語氣，表示程度很高、非常、好（通常為口語或年輕人用語）。
explanation_english: “正誕” is a Hong Kong Cantonese slang/intensifier used to boost the degree of an adjective or sentence, meaning very/really/awesome. It is colloquial and commonly used among younger speakers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間茶餐廳嘅蛋撻正誕好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caa4 caan1 teng1 ge3 daan6 taat1 zing3 daan3 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間茶餐廳的蛋撻非常好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The egg tarts at this cha chaan teng are really delicious.

mandarin_meaning: 正货；货真价实；真品（口语）
english_meaning: genuine article; the real deal; authentic product (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 指正宗、真正、有保障的商品或有真材實料的人，常用於口語對商品真偽或人實力的評價。
explanation_english: Refers to an authentic/genuine product or a person who is 'the real deal'—reliable, first-rate. Commonly used colloquially to judge authenticity of goods or someone's ability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電話係正貨，唔係水貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 waa2 hai6 zing3 fo3, m4 hai6 seoi2 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部手机是正货，不是水货。
examples.english_sentence: This phone is genuine, not a gray-market import.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係正貨，做嘢好專業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 zing3 fo3, zou6 je5 hou2 zyun1 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是货真价实，做事很专业。
examples.english_sentence: He's really the real deal; very professional.

mandarin_meaning: 正路 / 正道；正當、合規或合適的方式或途徑
english_meaning: the right way; proper/legitimate path or method; on the right track
explanation_mandarin: 「正路」是廣東話常用口語，表示做事合乎正道、合規或合情理，也可指正當的途徑或方式。例如說某種做法是「正路」，就是指可接受、正當或正確的做法。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "正路" is a colloquial term meaning the proper, legitimate, or correct way of doing something. It can describe a course of action that is acceptable, lawful, or morally right, or simply being on the right track.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁做唔係正路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 zou6 m4 hai6 zing3 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣做不是正路（不是正當的做法）。
examples.english_sentence: What you're doing isn't the right/proper thing to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做生意一向走正路，唔會做非法勾當。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 saang1 ji3 jat1 hoeng3 zau2 zing3 lou6, m4 wui5 zou6 fei1 faat3 gau1 dong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做生意一向走正路，不會做非法勾當。
examples.english_sentence: He runs his business legitimately and doesn't get involved in illegal deals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你想成功，就要行正路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 soeng2 sing4 gung1, zau6 jiu3 haang4 zing3 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你想成功，就要走正路/走正當的途徑。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to succeed, you should follow the proper/right path.

mandarin_meaning: 正途（正路、正當的道路或方法）
english_meaning: the right path; the proper or legitimate way/course
explanation_mandarin: 表示正當、合規或正確的道路或做法，常用來指回到正當的生活或行為方式。
explanation_english: Refers to a proper, legitimate, or correct path or method; often used to mean returning to honest or acceptable behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢終於認清自己嘅錯誤，決定返正途。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 jing6 cing1 zi6 gei2 ge3 co3 ng6, kyut3 ding6 faan1 zeng3 tou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他终于认清自己的错误，决定回到正途。
examples.english_sentence: He finally realized his mistakes and decided to return to the right path.

mandarin_meaning: 正选（主要/正式入选的人选或首选）
english_meaning: main/official selection; primary pick; starting player or official candidate
explanation_mandarin: 指在隊伍、組織或選拔中被認定為主要或正式入選的成員或候選人，常見於體育（先發球員）或選舉/聘用場景。
explanation_english: Refers to the officially selected main member or candidate in a team or organization; commonly used in sports (starting player) or in elections/hiring (official candidate/primary pick).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今季終於做咗球隊嘅正選後衛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 gwai3 zung1 jyu1 zou6 zo2 kau4 deoi6 ge3 zing3 syun2 hau6 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今季终于成为球队的正选后卫。
examples.english_sentence: He finally became the team's starting defender this season.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢被黨提名做下屆嘅正選人選。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei6 dong2 tai4 ming4 zou6 haa6 gaai3 ge3 zing3 syun2 jan4 syun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被党提名为下届的正选人选。
examples.english_sentence: He was nominated by the party as the official candidate for the next term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面試之後，公司選咗兩位正選，另外兩位做候補。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 si3 zi1 hau6, gung1 si1 syun2 zo2 loeng5 wai2 zing3 syun2, ling6 ngoi6 loeng5 wai2 zou6 hau6 bou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面试之后，公司选了两位正选，另外两位做候补。
examples.english_sentence: After the interviews, the company selected two main hires and made two others alternates.

mandarin_meaning: 正门 (主要入口、前门)
english_meaning: main entrance; front gate; main door
explanation_mandarin: 指建築物的主要出入口或正面的門，常用來區別側門或後門。
explanation_english: Refers to the primary entrance or front gate of a building, used to distinguish it from side or back doors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 正門已經鎖咗，你由側門入啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 mun4 ji5 ging1 so2 zo2, nei5 jau4 zak1 mun4 jap6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 正门已经锁了，你从侧门进吧。
examples.english_sentence: The main gate is locked; go in through the side gate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 博物館嘅正門星期一會關閉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bok3 mat6 gun2 ge3 zing3 mun4 sing1 kei4 jat1 wui5 gwaan1 bai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 博物馆的正门星期一会关闭。
examples.english_sentence: The museum's main entrance is closed on Mondays.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請喺正門集合，唔好喺後門等。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 hai2 zing3 mun4 zaap6 hap6, m4 hou2 hai2 hau6 mun4 dang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请在正门集合，不要在后门等。
examples.english_sentence: Please meet at the main entrance; don't wait at the back door.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語）非常好；極棒；很讚（另亦可作書面語：正確的階級/階段）
english_meaning: slang: extremely good; awesome; really great (also, literally: proper rank/stage in formal contexts)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞（俚語）；名詞（書面/正式用法，指階級或階段）
explanation_mandarin: 「正階」在粵語口語中常作俚語使用，表示某事物非常好、很厲害或很讚，相當於「超正」或「好正」。在正式或書面語境中，按字面可解作「正確的階級/階段」。
explanation_english: In Cantonese colloquial usage, "正階" is slang meaning something is extremely good, awesome, or really impressive (similar to "super cool" or "very awesome"). In formal/literal contexts it can mean a proper rank or stage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個歌手嘅新歌正階好聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 go1 sau2 ge3 san1 go1 zing3 gaai1 hou2 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個歌手的新歌非常好聽。
examples.english_sentence: This singer's new song is really good.

mandarin_meaning: 正离子（指失去电子、带正电荷的原子或分子，化学术语）
english_meaning: positive ion (cation) — an atom or molecule that has lost one or more electrons and carries a positive charge
explanation_mandarin: 在化學和物理中，正離子（陽離子）是指失去電子而帶正電荷的原子或分子，常用於描述離子反應、電解質行為等現象。
explanation_english: In chemistry and physics, a positive ion (cation) is an atom or molecule that has lost one or more electrons and thus carries a positive electric charge. The term is used when discussing ionic reactions, electrolytes, and related phenomena.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 正離子係指失去電子、帶正電荷嘅原子或分子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeng3 lei4 zi2 hai6 zi2 sat1 heoi3 din6 zi2, daai3 zeng3 din6 ho6 ge3 jyun4 zi2 waak6 fan1 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 正离子是指失去电子、带正电荷的原子或分子。
examples.english_sentence: A positive ion (cation) refers to an atom or molecule that has lost electrons and carries a positive charge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲研究關注正離子對健康嘅影響，但結果未必一致。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jin4 gau3 gwaan1 zyu3 zeng3 lei4 zi2 deoi3 gin6 hong1 ge3 jing2 hoeng2, daan6 git3 gwo2 mei6 bit1 jat1 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些研究關注正離子對健康的影響，但結果不一定一致。
examples.english_sentence: Some studies have looked at the effects of positive ions on health, but the findings are not consistent.

mandarin_meaning: 正面（可指方位的前面，或指態度/評價上的正向、積極）
english_meaning: front; positive; favorable; on the positive side
explanation_mandarin: 1) 表示方位：物體或建築的前面。2) 表示態度或評價：積極、正向、有利的一面或表現。
explanation_english: 1) Denotes physical orientation: the front side of an object or building. 2) Describes attitude or evaluation: positive, optimistic, or favorable aspect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋嘅正面種咗幾朵花，好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 ge3 zing3 min6 zung3 zo2 gei2 do2 faa1, hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房子的正面種了幾朵花，很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: The front of the house has several flowers; it's very pretty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好正面，成日用正面嘅態度去面對困難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 zing3 min6, seng4 jat6 jung6 zing3 min6 ge3 taai3 dou6 heoi3 min6 deoi3 kwan3 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他這個人很正面，總是以正面的態度面對困難。
examples.english_sentence: He is very positive and always faces difficulties with a positive attitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 報告主要講咗計劃嘅正面同負面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou3 gou3 zyu2 jiu3 gong2 zo2 gai3 waak6 ge3 zing3 min6 tung4 fu6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 報告主要講了計劃的正面和負面。
examples.english_sentence: The report mainly discussed the plan's positive and negative aspects.

mandarin_meaning: 正面回应
english_meaning: positive response; respond positively
explanation_mandarin: 指以肯定、支持或建設性的方式回應某事或某人，而非消極或攻擊性的反應。
explanation_english: To reply in an affirmative, supportive, or constructive way rather than with negative or attacking reactions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司對客人嘅投訴作出正面回應，解釋咗問題並提供賠償。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 deoi3 haak3 jan4 ge3 tau4 sou3 zok3 ceot1 zing3 min6 wui4 jing3, gaai2 sik1 zo2 man6 tai4 bing6 tai4 gung1 pui4 soeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司對顧客的投訴做出了正面回應，解釋了問題並提供了賠償。
examples.english_sentence: The company gave a positive response to the customer's complaint, explained the issue and offered compensation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 當有人提出建設性批評，最好畀正面回應，表示你願意改進。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dong1 jau5 jan4 tai4 ceot1 gin3 cit3 sing3 pei1 ping4, zeoi3 hou2 bei2 zing3 min6 wui4 jing3, biu2 si6 nei5 jyun6 ji3 goi2 zeon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 當有人提出建設性批評時，最好給予正面回應，表示你願意改進。
examples.english_sentence: When someone gives constructive criticism, it's best to respond positively, showing you're willing to improve.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師要求學生對同學嘅報告做正面回應，唔好淨係批評。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 jiu1 kau4 hok6 saang1 deoi3 tung4 hok6 ge3 bou3 gou3 zou6 zing3 min6 wui4 jing3, m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 pei1 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老師要求學生對同學的報告做正面回應，不要只是批評。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher asked students to give positive responses to classmates' presentations, not just criticism.

mandarin_meaning: 正題 / 主要議題、重點
english_meaning: main topic; the main point; getting back to the point
explanation_mandarin: 指談話或討論中的主要議題或重點，常用於提醒回到主題／切入正題。
explanation_english: Refers to the main topic or key point of a discussion; often used to remind people to return to or state the main subject.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋返去正題啦，唔好再講啲冇關嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 faan1 heoi3 zing3 tai4 laa1, m4 hou2 zoi3 gong2 di1 mou5 gwaan1 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們回到正題吧，不要再講無關的事。
examples.english_sentence: Let's get back to the main topic; don't talk about irrelevant things anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會之前，先講下今日正題係咩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui6 zi1 cin4, sin1 gong2 haa5 gam1 jat6 zing3 tai4 hai6 me1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 開會之前，先說一下今天的正題是什麼。
examples.english_sentence: Before the meeting, let's first state what today's main topic is.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講咁耐背景故事，依家講返正題啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 gam2 noi6 bui3 ging2 gu3 si6, ji4 gaa1 gong2 faan1 zing3 tai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你講了這麼久的背景故事，現在回到正題吧。
examples.english_sentence: You've been telling the background story for so long; now get back to the main point.

mandarin_meaning: 正餐（主餐，正式的一頓飯）
english_meaning: proper meal; main meal (a full/regular meal as opposed to a snack)
explanation_mandarin: 指正式的一餐或主餐，通常為早餐、午餐或晚餐中的一頓，與零食、點心或簡單快餐相對。
explanation_english: Refers to a proper or main meal — typically breakfast, lunch, or dinner — as opposed to snacks, light bites, or fast food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日我哋喺餐廳食正餐，唔好再食快餐啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 ngo5 dei6 hai2 caan1 teng1 sik6 zing3 caan1, m4 hou2 zoi3 sik6 faai3 caan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天我们在餐厅吃正餐，不要再吃快餐了。
examples.english_sentence: Today we're having a proper meal at the restaurant; let's not eat fast food again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為趕工，連正餐都冇時間食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 gon2 gung1, lin4 zing3 caan1 dou1 mou5 si4 gaan3 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为赶工，连正餐都没有时间吃。
examples.english_sentence: He was so busy finishing work that he didn't even have time for a proper meal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺香港，晚餐通常都係比較豐富嘅正餐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 hoeng1 gong2, maan5 caan1 tung1 soeng4 dou1 hai6 bei2 gaau3 fung1 fu3 ge3 zing3 caan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在香港，晚餐通常是比较丰盛的正餐。
examples.english_sentence: In Hong Kong, dinner is usually a relatively rich main meal.

mandarin_meaning: 正骨：用手法調整或復位骨骼（如脊椎），屬傳統整復術，也可指從事此療法的治療或行為。
english_meaning: Bone-setting; to set or manipulate bones/spine (a traditional manual therapy). Can be used as a noun (bone-setting treatment) or verb (to set bones).
explanation_mandarin: 指用手法、外力或技術將錯位或不正的骨骼、關節或脊椎復位、矯正的治療方法，常見於傳統中醫整復或民間骨傷治療。
explanation_english: A manual therapy that uses hands-on techniques to realign or reset displaced or misaligned bones, joints, or the spine; common in traditional Chinese manual medicine and folk bone-injury treatments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我頸仔痛，打算去正骨睇下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 geng2 zai2 tung3, daa2 syun3 heoi3 zing3 gwat1 tai2 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我脖子痛，打算去正骨看看。
examples.english_sentence: My neck hurts; I'm planning to go to a bone-setter to have it checked.

mandarin_meaning: 繁體字；傳統漢字
english_meaning: traditional Chinese characters (Traditional script)
explanation_mandarin: 指漢字的傳統字形，常見於臺灣、香港和澳門，與簡體字相對。
explanation_english: Refers to the traditional forms of Chinese characters, commonly used in Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macau; opposite of Simplified Chinese characters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你用正體字定係簡體字？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jung6 zing3 tai2 zi6 ding6 hai6 gaan2 tai2 zi6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你用繁體字還是簡體字？
examples.english_sentence: Do you use Traditional or Simplified characters?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多香港人習慣用正體字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 hoeng1 gong2 jan4 zaap6 gwaan3 jung6 zing3 tai2 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多香港人習慣使用繁體字。
examples.english_sentence: Many people in Hong Kong are used to using Traditional characters.

mandarin_meaning: 此（表示靠近說話者的事物或時間）
english_meaning: this; this (near the speaker) / the current
explanation_mandarin: 「此」為書面語的指示代詞，用來指示靠近說話者或當前談論的事物或時間，常見於正式或書面語境，如「此刻」「此人」「此處」。口語中多用「呢／這／呢度」。
explanation_english: “此” is a formal/written demonstrative pronoun meaning “this” or “the current” (e.g., this person, this time, this place). It is commonly used in formal or written contexts; in spoken Cantonese people more often use words like “呢/呢度/呢個”.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 此刻我好忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ci2 hak1 ngo5 hou2 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 此刻我很忙。
examples.english_sentence: I am very busy at this moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 此人不可信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ci2 jan4 bat1 ho2 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 此人不可信。
examples.english_sentence: This person is not trustworthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請把資料放在此處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 baa2 zi1 liu6 fong3 zoi6 ci2 cyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 請把資料放在此處。
examples.english_sentence: Please put the materials here.

jyutping: ci2 jat1 si4 bei2 jat1 si4
mandarin_meaning: 此一時彼一時 (cǐ yī shí bǐ yī shí)：表示隨著時間或時代變化，情況會不同。
english_meaning: This idiom means that times change; what is true or appropriate at one time may not be so at another time.
explanation_mandarin: 用來說明不同時期情況不同，不能把某一時期的做法或標準硬套到另一時期。
explanation_english: Used to point out that circumstances differ across times; one should not apply the same standards or practices from one period to another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前公司好收工快，依家忙到爆，真係此一時彼一時。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 gung1 si1 hou2 sau1 gung1 faai3, ji1 gaa1 mong4 dou3 baau3, zan1 hai6 ci2 jat1 si4 bei2 jat1 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前公司下班很快，現在忙得不得了，真是此一時彼一時。
examples.english_sentence: The company used to finish work quickly, but now it's unbearably busy — really, times have changed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔可以用以前嘅標準嚟評價佢，時代變咗，實在係此一時彼一時。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 ho2 ji5 jung6 ji5 cin4 ge3 biu1 zeon2 lai4 ping4 gaa3 keoi5, si4 doi6 bin3 zo2, sat6 zoi6 hai6 ci2 jat1 si4 bei2 jat1 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不能用以前的標準去評價他，時代變了，實在是此一時彼一時。
examples.english_sentence: You can't judge him by old standards; times have changed — truly, this is a different era.

jyutping: ci2 cau4 bat1 bou3 fei1 gwan1 zi2
mandarin_meaning: 不为此仇报仇就不是君子（意指应为仇怨讨回公道或雪耻）
english_meaning: If you do not avenge this grievance, you are not a gentleman (i.e., one ought to avenge a wrong or reclaim honor)
explanation_mandarin: 一句古语，原意是如果不为所受的仇恨报复或讨回公道，就称不上真正的君子。常用于强调报仇或讨回公道的必要性，有时亦可讽刺或半开玩笑地使用。
explanation_english: A classical proverb meaning that one who does not avenge a wrong is not a true gentleman. It stresses the idea of taking revenge or restoring one's honor; it can be used seriously or ironically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事咁大，唔可以就咁算，真係此仇不報非君子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 gam2 daai6, m4 ho2 ji5 zau6 gam2 syun3, zan1 hai6 ci2 cau4 bat1 bou3 fei1 gwan1 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事这么严重，不能就这么算了，真是“此仇不报非君子”。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is so serious; we can't just let it go — it's really 'one who doesn't avenge this grievance is no gentleman.'

mandarin_meaning: 此刻（现在、此时）
english_meaning: this moment; at this moment; right now
explanation_mandarin: 表示当前的时间点，等同于“此时”或“现在”，偏书面语。
explanation_english: Refers to the current point in time — equivalent to 'this moment' or 'right now'. It is somewhat formal/written.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 此刻我正喺公司加班，冇法出去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ci2 hak1 ngo5 zing3 hai2 gung1 si1 gaa1 baan1, mou5 faat3 ceot1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 此刻我正在公司加班，不能出去。
examples.english_sentence: Right now I'm working overtime at the office and can't go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 此刻最重要係保持冷靜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ci2 hak1 zeoi3 zung6 jiu3 hai6 bou2 ci4 laang5 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 此刻最重要的是保持冷静。
examples.english_sentence: At this moment, the most important thing is to stay calm.

mandarin_meaning: 此地无银（全称：此地无银三百两）
english_meaning: An attempt to deny or cover up something that, by the denial, only reveals the truth (i.e. 'the cover-up exposes itself')
explanation_mandarin: 源自寓言：有人把銀子埋起來，卻立告示「此地無銀三百兩」，本想掩飾反而暴露。用於形容欲蓋彌彰、否認反而顯得可疑。
explanation_english: From a fable where a person buries silver and posts a sign saying 'there are no 300 taels of silver here' — the denial itself reveals the truth. Used to describe attempts to hide something that only draw attention and make it more suspicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話自己冇偷嘢，講得咁多反而更似此地無銀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 waa6 zi6 gei2 mou5 tau1 je5, gong2 dak1 gam2 do1 faan2 ji4 gang3 ci5 ci2 dei6 mou4 ngan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说自己没有偷东西，说得越多反而越像“此地无银三百两”。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps insisting he didn't steal anything; the more he says it, the more it sounds like he's trying to cover it up.

jyutping: ci2 dei6 mou4 ngan4 saam1 baak3 loeng5
mandarin_meaning: 此地无银三百两（成语）：比喻掩饰过失或犯罪时，言行反而暴露真相。
english_meaning: This place has no 300 taels of silver (idiom): used to describe a clumsy or obvious attempt to deny or cover up wrongdoing that only reveals guilt.
explanation_mandarin: 出自民間寓言：小偷把銀子埋好後在地上寫『此地無銀三百兩』想掩飾，結果反而暴露了銀子的位置。用來比喻企圖掩飾或否認，反而使自己顯得可疑或露出馬腳。
explanation_english: From a folktale in which a thief buries silver and then writes a notice denying it, thereby exposing the hiding place. It refers to an attempt to hide or deny something that is so clumsy it only makes one look more suspicious or reveals the truth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話自己冇做錯，講多幾句只會令自己更可疑，真係此地無銀三百両。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 waa6 zi6 gei2 mou5 zou6 co3, gong2 do1 gei2 geoi3 zi2 wui5 ling6 zi6 gei2 gang3 ho2 ji4, zan1 hai6 ci2 dei6 mou4 ngan4 saam1 baak3 loeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是說自己沒有做錯，說得越多反而讓人更懷疑，真是此地无银三百两。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps insisting he didn't do anything wrong; the more he talks, the more suspicious he becomes — it's a classic case of 'this place has no 300 taels of silver.'

jyutping: ci2 dei6 mou4 ngan4 saam1 baak3 loeng5
mandarin_meaning: 此地無銀三百兩（成語）
english_meaning: An idiom meaning that by denying or trying to hide something in an obvious way, one actually reveals it; to expose oneself while attempting to cover up.
explanation_mandarin: 出自一則寓言笑話：有人怕別人偷銀子，把銀子埋好又立告示寫「此地無銀三百兩」，結果反而露餡。比喻想掩飾某事，卻因否認或解釋過度而暴露真相或自己的過失。
explanation_english: From a humorous folktale in which someone buries silver and posts a sign that says "There are no 300 taels of silver here," thereby revealing the theft. It describes attempts to cover something up that, because they are clumsy or overly defensive, end up exposing the very thing one is trying to hide.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣解釋，只會變成此地無銀三百兩，反而洩漏咗自己嘅問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng6 gaai2 sik1, zi2 wui5 bin3 sing4 ci2 dei6 mou4 ngan4 saam1 baak3 loeng5, faan2 ji4 sit3 lau6 zo2 zi6 gei2 ge3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣解釋，只會變成此地無銀三百兩，反而洩漏了自己的問題。
examples.english_sentence: By explaining it like that you only make it 'there are no 300 taels of silver here,' and end up revealing your own problem.

mandarin_meaning: 此外 / 除此之外（表示另外、此外）
english_meaning: besides; in addition; moreover
explanation_mandarin: 用于句首或句中，表示在已說的事情之外還有其他補充的訊息，常見於書面或正式語境。
explanation_english: Used to introduce additional information beyond what has been mentioned; commonly used in written or formal contexts to add a supplementary point.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 此外，佢仲識講三種語言。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ci2 ngoi6, keoi5 zung6 sik1 gong2 saam1 zung2 jyu5 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 此外，他還會說三種語言。
examples.english_sentence: Besides, he also speaks three languages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司為咗留住員工，除了加薪，此外仲提供彈性上班時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 wai6 zo2 lau4 zyu6 jyun4 gung1, ceoi4 zo2 gaa1 san1, ci2 ngoi6 zung6 tai4 gung1 daan6 sing3 soeng5 baan1 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司為了留住員工，除了加薪之外，此外還提供彈性上班時間。
examples.english_sentence: To retain employees, the company, in addition to raises, also offers flexible working hours.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要按時完成報告，此外要準備簡報。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 on3 si4 jyun4 sing4 bou3 gou3, ci2 ngoi6 jiu3 zeon2 bei6 gaan2 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們要按時完成報告，此外還要準備簡報。
examples.english_sentence: We must finish the report on time; additionally, we need to prepare the presentation.

mandarin_meaning: 此后 / 从此以后
english_meaning: from now on; thereafter; henceforth
explanation_mandarin: 表示从现在或某个时间点之后，常用于书面语，意思相当于“以后”“从此以后”。
explanation_english: Indicates the time after now or after a specific point; commonly used in writing. Equivalent to 'from now on', 'thereafter'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 此後，我會更加努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ci2 hau6, ngo5 wui5 gang1 gaa1 nou5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 从此以后，我会更加努力。
examples.english_sentence: From now on, I will work even harder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 此後唔好再犯同樣嘅錯誤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ci2 hau6 m4 hou2 zoi3 faan6 tung4 joeng6 ge3 co3 ng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 此后不要再犯同样的错误。
examples.english_sentence: Do not make the same mistake again from now on.

mandarin_meaning: 此时此刻（cǐ shí cǐ kè）
english_meaning: at this very moment; right now
explanation_mandarin: 表示當下的某一個確切時間點，強調當下此刻。多用於書面語或強調語境。
explanation_english: Refers to the exact present moment, emphasizing the here-and-now. Commonly used in formal or emphatic contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 此時此刻，大家都要保持冷靜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ci2 si4 ci2 hak1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 jiu3 bou2 ci4 laang5 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 此时此刻，大家都要保持冷静。
examples.english_sentence: At this very moment, everyone must remain calm.

mandarin_meaning: 此消彼长 (cǐ xiāo bǐ zhǎng)：一方衰退、另一方興起，表示相互消長的變化。
english_meaning: One wanes while another waxes; describes opposing changes where one side decreases as the other increases.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一方衰落而另一方興起，彼此的消長或勢力、地位變化。
explanation_english: Used to describe a situation in which one party or factor declines while another rises—indicating a shift in relative strength, fortune, or influence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近年網購興起，實體鋪頭嘅生意此消彼長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan6 nin4 mong5 gau3 hing1 hei2, sat6 tai2 pou3 tau2 ge3 saang1 ji3 ci2 siu1 bei2 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 近年来网购兴起，实体店的生意此消彼长。
examples.english_sentence: In recent years, with online shopping on the rise, business at physical stores has declined while others have grown.

mandarin_meaning: 此致（書信用語，常與「敬禮」「敬上」連用，表示敬意或作結語）
english_meaning: hereby / (formal) sincerely (formulaic closing in letters)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 書面語、格式化用語（書信結尾用語）
partOfSpeech_english: formulaic closing phrase (discourse marker in written correspondence)
explanation_mandarin: 「此致」多見於書信或公文的結尾，通常與「敬禮」「敬上」等詞連用，作為表示敬意或正式結語的格式語。
explanation_english: A formal closing used in written correspondence, often followed by phrases like '敬禮' or '敬上'. It functions as a conventional sign-off meaning 'hereby' or 'sincerely'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺公函嘅結尾通常寫「此致敬禮」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gung1 hon4 ge3 git3 mei5 tung1 soeng4 se2 「ci2 zi3 ging3 lai5」。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在公函的結尾通常寫「此致敬禮」。
examples.english_sentence: At the end of official letters, one usually writes '此致敬禮'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公告內寫住「此致通知」，表示正式通知大家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 gou3 noi6 se2 zyu6 「ci2 zi3 tung1 zi1」，biu2 si6 zing3 sik1 tung1 zi1 daai6 gaa1。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公告內寫著「此致通知」，表示正式通知大家。
examples.english_sentence: The notice says '此致通知', indicating a formal notification to everyone.

mandarin_meaning: 此举；这个举动/做法
english_meaning: this action; this move; this measure
explanation_mandarin: “此舉”指某個特定的行動或做法，常用於書面或正式語境，用來評價或描述某人或某組織的行為。
explanation_english: “此舉” refers to a specific action or measure; it is often used in formal or written contexts to describe or evaluate someone's or an organization's behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府嘅此舉令市民非常不滿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ge3 ci2 geoi2 ling6 si5 man4 fei1 soeng4 bat1 mun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府的此举令市民非常不满。
examples.english_sentence: The government's move caused great dissatisfaction among citizens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司單方面解僱員工嘅此舉惹來罷工風波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 daan1 fong1 min6 gaai2 gu3 jyun4 gung1 ge3 ci2 geoi2 je5 loi4 baa6 gung1 fung1 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司單方面解僱員工的此舉引發了罷工風波。
examples.english_sentence: The company's unilateral dismissal of employees triggered a strike.

mandarin_meaning: 此話說錯了 / 你的說法有誤
english_meaning: That statement is mistaken; you are wrong
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 文言短語 / 否定表達
explanation_mandarin: 此為文言或書面用語，用來否定或糾正對方的說法，相當於「你說錯了」或「此說不正確」。
explanation_english: A classical/literary expression used to indicate that someone's statement is incorrect or mistaken; equivalent to "you are mistaken" or "that is not correct."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 此言差矣，事情並非如此。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ci2 jin4 caa1 ji5, si6 cing4 bing6 fei1 jyu4 ci2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的說法錯了，事情並非如此。
examples.english_sentence: That statement is mistaken; the matter is not like that.

mandarin_meaning: 此起彼伏 (cǐ qǐ bǐ fú)：接連不斷、交替出現，起伏不定
english_meaning: Occurring one after another; rising and falling alternately; in successive waves
explanation_mandarin: 形容聲音或事件接連不斷、彼此交替出現，時有起伏。
explanation_english: Describes sounds or events that happen alternately and continuously, with rises and falls in succession.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演唱會嗰晚掌聲此起彼伏，全場都好熱鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin2 coeng3 wui2 go2 maan5 zoeng2 sing1 ci2 hei2 bei2 fuk6, cyun4 coeng4 dou1 hou2 jit6 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱會那晚掌聲此起彼伏，全場都很熱鬧。
examples.english_sentence: At the concert that night the applause rose and fell in succession; the whole venue was very lively.

mandarin_meaning: 此起彼落（接連不斷，輪流出現或此消彼長）
english_meaning: One thing after another; occurring alternately or in succession; rising and falling repeatedly.
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物、聲音或事件接連不斷、輪流出現或時起時落，常用來描述聲響或情況的此消彼長。
explanation_english: An idiom describing events or sounds that occur in succession or alternately rise and fall; used to indicate repeated or successive occurrences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 街上嘅車輛此起彼落，過馬路要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaai1 soeng6 ge3 ce1 loeng6 ci2 hei2 bei2 lok6, gwo3 maa5 lou6 jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 街上的车流此起彼落，过马路要小心。
examples.english_sentence: Vehicles on the street come one after another; be careful when crossing the road.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演唱會上掌聲此起彼落，場面好熱鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin2 coeng3 wui2 soeng6 zoeng2 sing1 ci2 hei2 bei2 lok6, coeng4 min6 hou2 jit6 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱会上掌声此起彼落，场面很热闹。
examples.english_sentence: At the concert, applause rose and fell repeatedly, making the scene very lively.

mandarin_meaning: 这条路不通；比喻某种做法或途径行不通/不可行
english_meaning: Literally 'this road does not pass through'; figuratively used to say an approach or option won't work or is unacceptable
explanation_mandarin: 本义指道路不通路；引申义用于比喻某种方法、途径或请求行不通、不可接受或无效。
explanation_english: Originally means a road is blocked; figuratively it indicates that a method, approach, or request will not work or is not acceptable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你用威脅佢嘅方法係此路不通，佢唔會屈服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jung6 wai1hip3 keoi5 ge3 fong1faat3 hai6 ci2 lou6 bat1 tung1, keoi5 m4 wui5 wat1fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你用威胁他的办法行不通，他不会屈服。
examples.english_sentence: Using threats against him won't work; he won't give in.

mandarin_meaning: 這種風氣/做法不可繼續下去；不應縱容
english_meaning: This trend/practice must not be allowed to continue; it should be stopped
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示某種不良風氣或壞習慣不應該被縱容或繼續下去，應該加以制止或糾正。
explanation_english: Used to state that a harmful trend or bad practice should not be tolerated or allowed to continue, and must be curtailed or corrected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司啲人日日遲到，真係此風不可長，老闆要嚴肅處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 di1 jan4 jat6 jat6 ci4 dou3 , zan1 hai6 ci2 fung1 bat1 ho2 coeng4 , lou5 baan2 jiu3 jim4 suk1 cyu2 lei5 .
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司裡的人天天遲到，這種風氣不可長，老闆要嚴肅處理。
examples.english_sentence: People at the company are late every day; this sort of trend must not be allowed to continue, the boss needs to deal with it strictly.

mandarin_meaning: 步 (bù) — 步、步伐；步驟
english_meaning: step; pace; a single stride; (also) a step in a sequence or procedure
explanation_mandarin: 表示腳步、行走的一步，也可指步伐或程序中的一個步驟。在口語或成語中常作單位或比喻使用。
explanation_english: Refers to a footstep or stride, a pace, or a single step in a sequence/process. Used both literally for walking and figuratively for stages or measures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每一步都計劃好晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 jat1 bou6 dou1 gai3 waak6 hou2 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每一步都计划好。
examples.english_sentence: He has planned every step.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 再行多一步就到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoi3 haang4 do1 jat1 bou6 zau6 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 再走多一步就到了。
examples.english_sentence: Take one more step and you'll arrive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要一步一個腳印咁做，唔好心急。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 jat1 bou6 jat1 go3 goek3 jan3 gam2 zou6, m4 hou2 sam1 gap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要一步一个脚印地做，不要心急。
examples.english_sentence: Do it step by step; don't rush.

mandarin_meaning: 步伐 (bù fá)：指走路時的步子，亦可比喻進展的速度或步調
english_meaning: pace; stride; the pace or tempo of progress
explanation_mandarin: 「步伐」原指行走時的步子，常用來形容行進的節奏或比喻事情發展的速度與步調。
explanation_english: Originally refers to the steps or stride when walking; commonly used to describe the tempo of movement or metaphorically the pace/tempo of progress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅步伐好穩定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 bou6 faat3 hou2 wan2 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的步伐很稳定。
examples.english_sentence: Their pace is very steady.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅發展步伐太快，員工跟唔上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ge3 faat3 zin2 bou6 faat3 taai3 faai3, jyun4 gung1 gan1 m4 soeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的发展步伐太快，员工跟不上。
examples.english_sentence: The company's pace of development is too fast; employees can't keep up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩隊行軍時要步伐同步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 deoi2 hang4 gwan1 si4 jiu3 bou6 faat3 tung4 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 两队行军时要步伐同步。
examples.english_sentence: When marching, the two units must keep step.

mandarin_meaning: 进入；步入（某个阶段或地点）
english_meaning: to enter; to step into; to move into (a stage or place)
explanation_mandarin: 表示走入某個地方或進入某個階段，常用於書面或正式語境。
explanation_english: Indicates entering a place or moving into a stage/phase; often used in more formal or written contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一齊步入會場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 bou6 jap6 wui6 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一起走进会场。
examples.english_sentence: We walked into the venue together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港已經步入冬季，天氣開始轉冷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ji5 ging1 bou6 jap6 dung1 gwai3, tin1 hei3 hoi1 ci2 zyun3 laang5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港已经进入冬季，天气开始变冷。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong has entered winter; the weather is starting to get colder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢步入咗職場好多年，經驗豐富。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bou6 jap6 zo2 zik1 coeng4 hou2 do1 nin4, ging1 jim6 fung1 fu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他进入职场很多年，经验丰富。
examples.english_sentence: He has been in the workforce for many years and is very experienced.
