english_meaning: “dead cat” (metaphor/slang): a deliberate distraction tactic or a scapegoat; also literal dead cat.
explanation_mandarin: 在香港語境中，“死貓”常指政治或媒體上拋出的一個突發、轟動或具爭議性的話題，用以分散公眾對真正問題的注意力；也可指代替死鬼或替人頂罪的對象。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong usage, 'dead cat' commonly refers to a sensational or controversial topic deliberately introduced to divert public attention from the real issue; it can also mean a scapegoat. It can also be used literally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府拋出一隻死貓，想分散市民嘅注意力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 paau1 ceot1 jat1 zek3 sei2 maau1, soeng2 fan1 saan3 si5 man4 ge3 zyu3 ji3 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府抛出一只“死猫”，想分散市民的注意力。
examples.english_sentence: The government threw out a 'dead cat' to try to divert the public's attention.

mandarin_meaning: 指故意拋出耸人听闻或无关话题以转移公众或媒体注意力的策略（即“抛出死猫”以掩盖真正问题）。
english_meaning: A diversionary tactic ("dead cat strategy") where a shocking or irrelevant issue is introduced deliberately to distract public or media attention from a more damaging topic.
explanation_mandarin: 政治或公關場合常用的說法，指有意製造或放出耸動話題，藉此轉移對方或公眾對真正問題的注意力。
explanation_english: A colloquial/political term for deliberately releasing a sensational or distracting story to shift attention away from a real issue or scandal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府為咗掩蓋醜聞，拋出個死貓彈，轉移公眾視線。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 wai6 zo2 jim2 goi3 cau2 man4, paau1 ceot1 go3 sei2 maau1 daan6, zyun2 ji4 gung1 zung3 si6 sin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府为了掩盖丑闻，抛出一个「死猫弹」，转移公众视线。
examples.english_sentence: The government threw out a "dead cat" to divert public attention and cover up the scandal.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語）废物、没用的人；滯销品
english_meaning: Cantonese slang insult meaning a useless person/loser; can also mean dead stock/unsellable goods
explanation_mandarin: 「死貨」是粤语粗俗俚語，常用來罵人表示某人沒用、無能或無用，也可指滯銷、賣不出的商品。屬於貶義用法，不宜在正式場合使用。
explanation_english: In Cantonese slang, '死貨' is a coarse derogatory term used to call someone useless/a loser. It can also refer to unsellable 'dead stock' items. It is insulting and not appropriate in formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你真係死貨，乜都唔識做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zan1 hai6 sei2 fo3, mat1 dou1 m4 sik1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你真是个废物，什么都不会做。
examples.english_sentence: You're such a useless person; you can't do anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲貨係死貨，賣唔出去，老細唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 fo3 hai6 sei2 fo3, maai6 m4 ceot1 heoi3, lou5 sai3 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些货是滞销品，卖不出去，老板不高兴。
examples.english_sentence: These goods are dead stock and won't sell; the boss is unhappy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 死貨！你又遲到！
examples.jyutping_sentence: sei2 fo3! nei5 jau6 ci4 dou3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 混蛋！你又迟到了！
examples.english_sentence: You idiot! You're late again!

mandarin_meaning: 该死的贱人；可恶的混蛋（侮辱性称呼）
english_meaning: damn bastard; despicable person (insult)
explanation_mandarin: 粗俗的粤语侮辱用语，用来强烈贬低或咒骂他人，语气非常激烈，不适合正式场合。
explanation_english: A coarse Cantonese insult used to strongly demean or curse someone. Very aggressive and vulgar; inappropriate in formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日出賣我，真係死賤種！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 seng4 jat6 ceot1 maai6 ngo5, zan1 hai6 sei2 zin3 zung2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你老是出卖我，真是该死的贱人！
examples.english_sentence: You keep betraying me — you damn bastard!

mandarin_meaning: 死路；走不通的路；比喻没有出路、绝境
english_meaning: dead end; no way out; a hopeless situation (literally a road that leads nowhere)
explanation_mandarin: 1. 作為名詞，指沒有通行的道路（死胡同）。2. 比喻處境絕望、沒有出路的情況或選擇。
explanation_english: 1. As a noun, refers to a road that ends with no way through (a dead end). 2. Figuratively, a hopeless situation or course of action with no way forward.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條街係死路，行唔通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 gaai1 hai6 sei2 lou6, haang4 m4 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条街是死路，走不通。
examples.english_sentence: This street is a dead end; you can't pass through.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔改變策略，公司就會行入死路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 goi2 bin3 caak3 loek6, gung1 si1 zau6 wui5 haang4 jap6 sei2 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不改变策略，公司就会走入死路。
examples.english_sentence: If the company doesn't change its strategy, it will end up in a dead end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁做只會害你行向死路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 zou6 zi2 wui5 hoi6 nei5 haang4 hoeng3 sei2 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那样做只会害你走向绝路。
examples.english_sentence: Doing that will only lead you toward a dead end.

mandarin_meaning: 走投無路；沒有出路
english_meaning: a dead end; no way out; a hopeless situation
explanation_mandarin: 表示沒有出路或走投無路，形容處境沒有希望、難以挽回或無法繼續發展。
explanation_english: An idiomatic phrase meaning there is no way out or a hopeless situation; used to describe circumstances with no prospects or escape.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你唔反省，繼續咁樣落去，就會係死路一條。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 m4 faan2 sing2, gai3 zuk6 gam2 joeng6 lok6 heoi3, zau6 wui5 hai6 sei2 lou6 jat1 tiu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不反省，繼續這樣下去，就會是走投無路。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't reflect and keep going like this, you'll be headed for a dead end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰條路入面封咗，走唔通，係真真正正嘅死路一條。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 tiu4 lou6 jap6 min6 fung1 zo2, zau2 m4 tung1, hai6 zan1 zan1 zing3 zing3 ge3 sei2 lou6 jat1 tiu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那條路被封了，走不通，真是死路一條。
examples.english_sentence: That road is blocked and impassable — really a dead end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你從事呢啲犯法活動，最終可能會步入死路一條。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 cung4 si6 ni1 di1 faat3 faan6 wut6 dung6, zeoi3 zung1 ho2 nang4 wui5 bou6 jap6 sei2 lou6 jat1 tiu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你從事這些違法活動，最終可能會步入死路一條。
examples.english_sentence: If you engage in these illegal activities, you may ultimately end up on a dead-end path.

mandarin_meaning: 熄火；停滯（俚語：停擺、陷入僵局）
english_meaning: to stall (engine); to be stalled or stuck; (slang) a situation that cannot proceed or is deadlocked
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俚語，原指車輛引擎熄火或故障而停下，延伸為任何事情停滯、無法繼續或陷入僵局的情況，可作動詞或名詞使用。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang term originally referring to a vehicle's engine stalling or breaking down. It has been extended to describe any situation that is stalled, stuck, or deadlocked and cannot proceed. Used as a verb or noun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架的士喺高速公路上突然死車，搞到成條路塞晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 dik1 si2 hai2 gou1 cuk1 gung1 lou6 soeng6 dat6 jin4 si2 ce1, gaau2 dou3 sing4 tiu4 lou6 sak1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那輛計程車在高速公路上突然熄火，弄得整條路都塞車。
examples.english_sentence: The taxi suddenly stalled on the highway, causing the whole road to be jammed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個項目死車咗，因為冇錢繼續做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 hong6 muk6 si2 ce1 zo2, jan1 wai6 mou5 cin2 gai3 zuk6 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個項目停擺了，因為沒錢繼續做。
examples.english_sentence: The project is stalled because there's no money to continue.

mandarin_meaning: 死过（曾经死亡）
english_meaning: have died; died before (indicates past experience of death)
explanation_mandarin: “死過”表示曾经死亡或经历过死亡，常用于叙述过去的事实或经历。有时也用于描述亲人去世的情况。
explanation_english: “死過” indicates that someone has died before; it marks a past experience of death. It is used to state a past fact or experience, such as a person who has passed away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺手術入面死過一次，醫生救返佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 sau2 seot6 jap6 min6 sei2 gwo3 jat1 ci3, ji1 sang1 gau3 faan1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在手术中死过一次，医生把他救活了。
examples.english_sentence: He died once during the operation; the doctors revived him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爺早年死過，家人都好思念佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 je4 zou2 nin4 sei2 gwo3, gaa1 jan4 dou1 hou2 si1 nim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿爷早年去世，家人都很想念他。
examples.english_sentence: Grandfather died years ago; the family misses him a lot.

mandarin_meaning: 死裡逃生 / 死而復生
english_meaning: to narrowly escape death; to be miraculously revived or to recover from a near-fatal situation
explanation_mandarin: 形容在極度危險或瀕死的情況下奇蹟般活下來；也可比喻從重大困境中轉危為安。
explanation_english: Describes surviving a situation that was extremely dangerous or close to death; can be used literally (miraculously surviving) or figuratively (escaping a severe crisis).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嗰次車禍差啲死喇，點知竟然死過翻生，依家身體好返晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go2 ci3 ce1 wo6 caa1 di1 sei2 laa3, dim2 zi1 ging2 jin4 sei2 gwo3 faan1 saang1, ji1 gaa1 san1 tai2 hou2 faan1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那次車禍差點喪命，沒想到竟然死裡逃生，現在身體已經完全康復。
examples.english_sentence: He nearly died in that car accident, but amazingly he survived; now he's fully recovered.

mandarin_meaning: 死而复生；死里逃生（从濒死中恢复或侥幸逃脱死亡）
english_meaning: to come back from the brink of death; to be miraculously saved; to be reborn or given a new lease on life
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容從瀕死或極危險的情況中恢復過來，或形容經歷巨大危機後像重獲新生。也可作誇張的口語用法表示極端驚險或侥幸逃过一劫。
explanation_english: Describes recovering from a near-death or extremely dangerous situation, or being miraculously saved. Can also be used colloquially and hyperbolically to describe narrowly escaping a disaster or having a second chance at life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰日佢病咗好耐，醫生話差啲就死，依家真係死過返生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 jat6 keoi5 beng6 zo2 hou2 noi6, ji1 sang1 waa6 caa1 di1 zau6 sei2, ji1 gaa1 zan1 hai6 sei2 gwo3 faan1 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那天他病了很久，医生说差点就死了，现在真是死而复生。
examples.english_sentence: He had been ill for a long time; the doctor said he almost died. Now he's truly come back from the brink of death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 救護員快手送去醫院，先令佢死過返生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau3 wu6 jyun4 faai3 sau2 sung3 heoi3 ji1 jyun2, sin1 ling6 keoi5 sei2 gwo3 faan1 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 救护员迅速送到医院，才使他死里逃生。
examples.english_sentence: The paramedics rushed him to the hospital, which allowed him to come back from the brink of death.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）死也要、無論如何、絕對
english_meaning: colloquial intensifier meaning 'absolutely/at all costs; even if I die'
explanation_mandarin: 「死都」是廣東話中的口語副詞，用來強調決心或堅持，表示即使付出很大代價（甚至生命）也要那麼做，或表示絕對不會做某事。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial intensifier used to emphasize determination or refusal — meaning 'no matter what/at all costs; even if I die'. It stresses absolute insistence or negation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我死都要去聽佢嘅演唱會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sei2 dou1 jiu3 heoi3 teng1 keoi5 ge3 jin2 coeng3 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我死都要去聽他的演唱會。
examples.english_sentence: I'll go to his concert no matter what.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢死都唔肯承認自己錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sei2 dou1 m4 hang2 sing4 jing6 zi6 gei2 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他死都不肯承認自己錯誤。
examples.english_sentence: He absolutely refuses to admit he's wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我死都唔信佢講嘅話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sei2 dou1 m4 seon3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我死都不相信他說的話。
examples.english_sentence: I absolutely don't believe what he says.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）死也要把（某事或某物）復活/恢復；不顧困難非要做到
english_meaning: colloquial: to insist on reviving/restoring something at all costs; to stubbornly refuse to give up
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語表達，字面意思是「即使死了也要弄回生」，用來形容不顧困難或不顧後果、非常執著地要把某事或某物恢復、完成或挽救。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression literally meaning "even if dead, force it back to life". It describes stubborn, all-out efforts to revive, restore, or accomplish something no matter how difficult or unlikely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢部舊電話壞咗，但佢死都拗返生，成日上網搵人修好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bou6 gau6 din6 waa2 waai6 zo2, daan6 keoi5 sei2 dou1 ngaau2 faan1 saang1, sing4 jat6 soeng5 mong5 wan2 jan4 siu1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的舊手機壞了，但他非要把它修好，整天上網找人修理。
examples.english_sentence: His old phone broke, but he insisted on getting it fixed no matter what, always searching online for someone to repair it.

mandarin_meaning: 走開；滾開（粗俗用語）
english_meaning: Go away; get lost; (vulgar) fuck off
explanation_mandarin: 一个粗俗的粤语祈使短语，用来叫人离开、走开或别再打扰，语气强烈，常用于愤怒或厌烦时。
explanation_english: A coarse Cantonese imperative phrase used to tell someone to leave or stop bothering you. Strong, often angry or dismissive in tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你死開啦，唔好煩我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sei2 hoi1 laa1, m4 hou2 faan4 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你走開，別煩我。
examples.english_sentence: Go away, don't bother me.

mandarin_meaning: 硬撐、逞強（明知無望或處於劣勢仍裝作堅強）
english_meaning: to stubbornly tough it out or put on a brave face despite being hopeless or weak; to bluff or stubbornly persist when defeat is likely
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容明明處於不利或無望的情況，仍然硬要逞強、撐場面或假裝沒事。通常帶有貶義，用以批評不肯承認失敗或虛張聲勢的人。
explanation_english: Describes someone who, despite being in a hopeless or disadvantageous situation, persists in pretending to be strong or refuses to admit defeat. Often pejorative and used to criticize someone who is bluffing or putting on a brave face.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 明明已經輸咗，佢仲死雞撐硬腳話仲可以贏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ming4 ming4 ji5 ging1 syu1 zo2, keoi5 zung6 sei2 gai1 caang1 ngaang6 goek3 waa6 zung6 ho2 ji5 jeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明明已經輸了，他還硬撐著說還能贏。
examples.english_sentence: He clearly already lost, but he's still putting on a brave face, saying he can still win.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面試嗰陣佢好緊張，但唔想畀人睇到軟弱，所以死雞撐硬腳笑住答問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 si5 go2 zan6 keoi5 hou2 gan2 zoeng1, daan6 m4 soeng2 bei2 jan4 tai2 dou3 jyun5 joek6, so2 ji5 sei2 gai1 caang1 ngaang6 goek3 siu3 zyu6 daap3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面試的時候他很緊張，但不想讓人看出軟弱，所以硬撐著微笑回答問題。
examples.english_sentence: He was very nervous during the interview, but didn't want to appear weak, so he forced a smile and pretended to be fine while answering questions.

mandarin_meaning: 垂死掙扎、徒勞支撐或虛張聲勢（明知無希望仍硬撐）
english_meaning: to make a last-ditch or futile effort; to put on a brave face and cling on despite hopelessness
explanation_mandarin: 俗語，用來形容在情勢已經無望或失敗時，仍然硬撐、表面裝作沒事或做出徒勞的掙扎。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese idiom describing someone who stubbornly props things up or pretends everything is fine when the situation is hopeless—a futile, last-ditch effort or bravado.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份公司生意差到無得救，佢仲死雞撐飯蓋話一切正常。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 si1 saang1 ji3 caa1 dou3 mou5 dak1 gau3, keoi5 zung6 sei2 gai1 caang1 faan6 goi3 waa6 jat1 cai3 zing3 soeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那間公司生意差到無可救藥，還在死雞撐飯蓋說一切正常。
examples.english_sentence: His company’s business is beyond saving, but he still puts on a brave face and says everything is fine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 分手之後佢成日話冇事，其實係死雞撐飯蓋，唔肯面對現實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan1 sau2 zi1 hau6 keoi5 sing4 jat6 waa6 mou5 si6, kei4 sat6 hai6 sei2 gai1 caang1 faan6 goi3, m4 hang2 min6 deoi3 jin6 sat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 分手之後他整天說沒事，其實是在死雞撐飯蓋，不肯面對現實。
examples.english_sentence: After the breakup he kept saying he was fine, but he was just putting on a brave face and refusing to face reality.

mandarin_meaning: 明知沒有希望仍然硬撐/死撐
english_meaning: to stubbornly persist or put on a brave face despite a hopeless situation
explanation_mandarin: 形容明明事情無望，仍然固執地硬撐、不願放棄或承認失敗，語氣常帶有批評或自嘲意味。
explanation_english: Describes someone who, knowing a situation is hopeless, stubbornly keeps going or pretends everything is fine. The phrase often carries a critical or self-mocking tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明知冇得救都死雞撑硬腳，唔肯認錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 zi1 mou5 dak1 gau3 dou1 sei2 gai1 caang1 ngaang6 goek3, m4 hang2 jing6 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明知道沒救還死撐，不肯認錯。
examples.english_sentence: He knows it's hopeless but keeps stubbornly holding on, refusing to admit his mistake.

mandarin_meaning: 死撐/徒勞支撐，強行維持表面或局面
english_meaning: to cling on or keep up appearances despite a hopeless or futile situation; to stubbornly keep something going just to save face
explanation_mandarin: 形容明知無望或無益，仍堅持支撐或裝作沒事，勉強維持面子或局面。
explanation_english: Describes someone who persists in a hopeless or pointless effort or pretends everything is fine to save face, essentially propping something up despite inevitable failure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好死雞撑飯蓋啦，認輸啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sei2 gai1 caang1 faan6 goi3 laa3, jing6 syu1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要死撐了，認輸吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep pretending and clinging on — admit defeat.

mandarin_meaning: 遇難；死於災難、意外或暴力（亦可指遇難者）
english_meaning: to die in a disaster/accident/violence; (noun) a person who perished (a fatality)
explanation_mandarin: 「死難」用來表示因災害、意外或暴力而喪生，也可作名詞指在此類事件中遇難的人。
explanation_english: Used to indicate dying as a result of a disaster, accident, or violence; can also be used as a noun to refer to victims who perished.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰場大火有好多市民死難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 coeng4 daai6 fo2 jau5 hou2 do1 si5 man4 sei2 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那場大火有很多市民遇難。
examples.english_sentence: Many citizens perished in that big fire.

mandarin_meaning: 死撐 / 拼到底 / 硬扛
english_meaning: to stubbornly persist; to tough it out; to hold on to the end
explanation_mandarin: 口語俗語，表示不顧困難或後果，硬着頭皮堅持做下去或不肯讓步。
explanation_english: A colloquial/slang term meaning to persist stubbornly despite difficulties or consequences; to tough it out or hold on to the bitter end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁死頂，出嚟傾下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 sei2 ding2, ceot1 lai4 king1 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別那麼固執，出來談談吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stubborn; come out and let's talk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我真係寧願死頂都唔認輸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zan1 hai6 ning4 jyun6 sei2 ding2 dou1 m4 jing6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我真的是寧可拼到底也不認輸。
examples.english_sentence: I'd rather stubbornly stick it out than admit defeat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次失敗唔好死頂，要學嘢改進。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 sat1 baai6 m4 hou2 sei2 ding2, jiu3 hok6 je5 goi2 zeon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次失敗別硬撐，要學習並改進。
examples.english_sentence: Don't stubbornly tough it out after this failure; learn from it and improve.

mandarin_meaning: （口语）小坏蛋、可爱的或带点责备的称呼；有时作轻微咒骂
english_meaning: a cheeky rascal / you little brat; a teasing or mildly scolding term (can be affectionate or mildly insulting depending on tone)
explanation_mandarin: 「死鬼」是粤语口语用语，字面为“死了的鬼”，但常用作对熟人表示调侃、责备或撒娇的称呼。语气可以亲昵（如“你这死鬼”表示撒娇、玩笑）或带点不满（表示轻微的责骂）；在正式场合不宜使用。
explanation_english: “死鬼” (sei2 gwai2) is a Cantonese colloquial term literally meaning “dead ghost” but used as a teasing or mildly scolding vocative. It can be affectionate (to tease a friend or partner) or a light insult depending on tone and context. Not appropriate in formal situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你死鬼，遲到又唔打俾我！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sei2 gwai2, ci4 dou3 jau6 m4 daa2 bei2 ngo5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这个死鬼，又迟到了还不打电话给我！
examples.english_sentence: You rascal — you're late again and didn't call me!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你食咗我嘅蛋糕，你死鬼！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sik6 zo2 ngo5 ge3 daan6 gou1, nei5 sei2 gwai2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你吃了我的蛋糕，你个小坏蛋！
examples.english_sentence: You ate my cake, you little rascal!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 死鬼，你唔好再咁樣啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: sei2 gwai2, nei5 m4 hou2 zoi6 gam2 joeng6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这个死鬼，别再这样了！
examples.english_sentence: Oh, you! Don't do that again!

mandarin_meaning: 死鱼；（口语）形容人表情呆滞、没精神、无生气
english_meaning: dead fish; (slang) someone or an expression that is lifeless, listless, deadpan, or unresponsive
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语口语中，除了字面意思“死去的鱼”外，常用来形容人面无表情、没精神或反应迟钝。例如说某人“好似死魚”就是指看起来很无生气或呆滞。
explanation_english: In Cantonese slang, beyond the literal meaning 'dead fish', it commonly describes a person who looks expressionless, listless, or unresponsive. Saying someone is 'a dead fish' implies they appear lifeless or have a blank/deadpan expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個表情好死魚，完全冇反應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Keoi5 go3 biu2 cing4 hou2 sei2 jyu4, jyun4 cyun4 mou5 faan2 jing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的表情很呆滞，完全没有反应。
examples.english_sentence: His expression was deadpan/blank, with no reaction at all.

mandarin_meaning: 拼死逞强/硬撑表面
english_meaning: to stubbornly pretend to be strong or to keep up appearances despite being hopeless or defeated
explanation_mandarin: 指明明已经没有能力或处于劣势，却还硬要撑场面、逞强或不肯认输。
explanation_english: Describes someone who stubbornly pretends to be strong or insists on being right, even when the situation is hopeless or they have clearly lost.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好死鷄撐硬腳啦，認錯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sei2 gai1 caang1 ngaang6 goek3 laa1, jing6 co3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别再死撑了，承认错误吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep pretending to be tough; admit your mistake.

mandarin_meaning: 死雞撐飯蓋（指人在情況很差或無可挽回時，仍硬撐表面或勉強維持）
english_meaning: A feeble/last-ditch attempt to keep up appearances; to prop something up despite it being hopeless.
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，字面是「死掉的雞撐著飯蓋」，用來形容在情勢已經很糟或快要失敗時，仍強顏歡笑或勉強維持表面，意思接近「垂死掙扎」或「撐門面」。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquialism literally meaning 'a dead chicken propping up the rice lid.' It describes someone making a weak or futile effort to keep up appearances or to hold something together when it's essentially beyond saving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司快要倒閉，老細仲係度死鷄撐飯蓋話生意唔差，真係撐唔住喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 faai3 jiu3 dou2 bei6, lou5 sai2 zung6 hai6 dou6 sei2 gai1 caang1 faan6 goi3 waa6 sang1 ji3 m4 caa1, zan1 hai6 caang1 m4 zyu6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司快要倒閉，老闆還在那裡死雞撐飯蓋說生意不差，真的撐不住了。
examples.english_sentence: The company is about to go under, yet the boss is still pretending business is fine — he really can't keep it up.

mandarin_meaning: 倔強地硬撐/死撐（明知無望仍硬要撐下去）
english_meaning: to stubbornly tough it out or put on a brave front despite hopelessness; to keep stubbornly persisting even when it's futile
explanation_mandarin: 俗語，形容明知無望或出現失敗跡象，仍倔強地硬撐、裝出沒事或維持面子。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression describing someone who stubbornly persists or pretends everything is fine despite a hopeless situation or clear failure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再死鷄撑硬腳啦，認錯仲嚟得及。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 sei2 gai1 caang1 ngaang6 goek3 laa1, jing6 co3 zung6 loi4 dak1 kap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再死撐了，承認錯誤還來得及。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep stubbornly insisting — it's still not too late to admit your mistake.

mandarin_meaning: 徒勞無功；逞強硬撐（做無用的掙扎或裝腔作勢）
english_meaning: to make a futile or desperate attempt; to stubbornly put on a brave front or pretend competence despite hopelessness
explanation_mandarin: 比喻在明知無法改變結果或已無希望的情況下，仍然做出徒然的努力或逞強裝腔作勢。
explanation_english: A Cantonese idiom used to describe making a useless or last-ditch effort, or pretending bravado when the situation is hopeless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明明做唔到，仲要死雞撐飯蓋講自己有本事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 ming4 zou6 m4 dou3, zung6 jiu3 sei2 gai1 caang1 faan6 goi3 gong2 zi6 gei2 jau5 bun2 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明明做不到，還要死雞撐飯蓋說自己有本事。
examples.english_sentence: He clearly can't do it, but still makes a futile show saying he's capable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然公司要裁員，佢都仲死雞撐飯蓋話唔怕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 gung1 si1 jiu3 coi4 jyun4, keoi5 dou1 zung6 sei2 gai1 caang1 faan6 goi3 waa6 m4 paa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 雖然公司要裁員，他還是死雞撐飯蓋說不怕。
examples.english_sentence: Even though the company is laying people off, he still puts on a brave front and says he's not afraid.

mandarin_meaning: 死党（sǐdǎng）：关系非常要好、亲密的朋友；也可指某个团体或政治上的坚定支持者或同党派。
english_meaning: a close/best friend; a staunch supporter; a member of a clique
explanation_mandarin: 口语用词，通常指关系非常亲密、肝胆相照的朋友；在其他语境下也可指在政治或组织中的铁杆支持者或同一派系成员。
explanation_english: A colloquial term referring to a very close, loyal friend (a bosom buddy). It can also mean a die-hard supporter or member of the same faction in political/group contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明係我嘅死黨，無論發生咩事都會支持我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 hai6 ngo5 ge3 sei2 dong2, mou4 leon6 faat3 sang1 me1 si6 dou1 wui5 zi1 ci4 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明是我的死党，无论发生什么事都会支持我。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming is one of my closest friends; no matter what happens he'll support me.

mandarin_meaning: （粗口）用作加强语气或骂人，可理解为“他妈的/该死的/混蛋”等
english_meaning: Vulgar Cantonese slang used as an intensifier or insult — roughly equivalent to 'fucking' or 'fucking bastard' in English
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 感叹词 / 骂人用语 (粗口)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語粗俗用語，常作強調或直接辱罵對象，具有冒犯性。可放在名詞前作定語（如「死𦧲佬」）或與形容詞連用（如「死𦧲煩」）。在香港口語中常見，但屬粗口，公眾場合應避免使用。
explanation_english: A vulgar Cantonese slang term used to intensify or insult; often placed before a noun (e.g. 'sei2 lan2 lou2') or before an adjective (e.g. 'sei2 lan2 faan4' = 'fucking annoying'). Common in Hong Kong speech but offensive and should be avoided in polite contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你個死𦧲，做事咁唔負責任！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 go3 sei2 lan2, zou6 si6 gam2 m4 fu6 zaak3 jam6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这个死混蛋，做事这么不负责任！
examples.english_sentence: You fucking idiot — you're so irresponsible!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日遲到，真係死𦧲煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 ci4 dou3, zan1 hai6 sei2 lan2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是迟到，真他妈烦人。
examples.english_sentence: He's always late — it's fucking annoying.

mandarin_meaning: 早死、夭折（古漢語用字）
english_meaning: to die young; premature death (literary/classical)
explanation_mandarin: 「殀」為古漢語詞，表示早死或夭折，常見於文言或成語中，現代口語少用，近義表達有「英年早逝」、「夭折」。
explanation_english: A classical/literary character meaning to die young or premature death. Rarely used in modern spoken Cantonese; appears mainly in literary contexts or idioms. Modern equivalents include "die young" or "premature death."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢英年早殀，家人好傷心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jing1 nin4 zou2 jiu3, gaa1 jan4 hou2 soeng1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他英年早逝，家人非常傷心。
examples.english_sentence: He died young; his family is deeply saddened.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）形容人瘦弱、憔悴、無精神
english_meaning: informal: gaunt, emaciated, listless-looking
explanation_mandarin: 「殀殀晒晒」是廣東話口語，用來形容一個人看起來瘦弱、憔悴或無精打采，常指生病或疲累後的樣子。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to describe someone who looks gaunt, emaciated, or listless — often after illness or prolonged fatigue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近病咗幾個禮拜，宜家殀殀晒晒，睇落好憔悴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 beng6 zo2 gei2 go3 lai5 baai3, ji4 gaa1 jiu4 jiu4 saai3 saai3, tai2 lok6 hou2 kiu4 zeoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近病了好幾個星期，現在瘦弱憔悴，看起來很沒精神。
examples.english_sentence: He's been sick for several weeks; now he's gaunt and looks very listless.

mandarin_meaning: 死；去世（文言詞）
english_meaning: to die; to pass away (literary/classical)
explanation_mandarin: 「殂」為文言用詞，意為死亡或去世，常見於史書、古文或對皇室、尊者的委婉說法。
explanation_english: A literary/classical verb meaning 'to die' or 'to pass away'. Commonly found in historical records and classical texts, often used in formal or euphemistic contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古書上記載話皇帝喺該年殂世。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 syu1 soeng6 gei3 zoi6 waa6 wong4 dai3 hai2 goi1 nin4 cou4 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 史書記載皇帝在該年去世。
examples.english_sentence: Historical records state that the emperor died in that year.

mandarin_meaning: 灾祸；遭受祸害
english_meaning: calamity; disaster; harm; (verb) to suffer harm or bring harm
explanation_mandarin: 表示不幸或災禍，常用於「遭殃」「受殃」等詞語，指受到禍害或連累他人受害。
explanation_english: Refers to calamity or harm; can be used as a noun or verb. Commonly appears in compounds like '遭殃' meaning to suffer misfortune or '殃及' meaning harm spreading to others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔小心，屋企可能會遭殃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 siu2 sam1, uk1 kei5 ho2 nang4 wui5 zou1 joeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不小心，家里可能会遭殃。
examples.english_sentence: If you're not careful, the house could suffer damage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲無辜市民被連累，最後都遭殃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 mou4 gu1 si5 man4 bei6 lin4 leoi6, zeoi3 hau6 dou1 zou1 joeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一些无辜的市民被连累，最后都遭殃。
examples.english_sentence: Some innocent citizens were implicated and ended up suffering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政治鬥爭往往會造成池魚之殃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 zi6 dau3 zang1 wong5 wong5 wui5 zou6 sing4 ci4 jyu4 zi1 joeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政治斗争往往会造成池鱼之殃。
examples.english_sentence: Political struggles often cause collateral damage to innocent bystanders.

mandarin_meaning: 殃及（波及、牽連，使他人或其他事物遭受不良影響或損害）
english_meaning: to affect adversely; to bring disaster or harm upon others as collateral damage; to spread misfortune to
explanation_mandarin: 表示災禍或不良後果波及到其他人或事物，使其受到牽連或損害，常用於描述連帶的負面影響。
explanation_english: Indicates that a disaster or adverse consequences spread to other people or things, causing collateral harm or involvement; commonly used to describe spillover negative effects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府嘅政策失誤殃及一班基層市民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ge3 zing3 caak3 sat1 ng6 joeng1 kap6 jat1 baan1 gei1 cang4 si5 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府的政策失誤殃及了一部分基層市民。
examples.english_sentence: The government's policy mistake has adversely affected a group of grassroots citizens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 火警擴散，隔離嘅大樓都殃及到無辜居民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fo2 ging2 kwaak3 saan3, gaak3 lei4 ge3 daai6 lau4 dou1 joeng1 kap6 dou3 mou4 gu1 geoi1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 火警擴散，隔壁的大樓也殃及到無辜居民。
examples.english_sentence: The fire spread, and neighboring buildings were also harmed, affecting innocent residents.

mandarin_meaning: 殃及池鱼（成语），指灾祸或不幸波及无辜的旁人或事物，牵连无关的人受害。
english_meaning: An idiom meaning to cause disaster or harm to innocent bystanders; to produce collateral damage that affects unrelated parties.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻災禍或不良後果擴散，牽連到本來無關或無辜的人或事，造成附帶損害。
explanation_english: Used figuratively to describe a situation where misfortune or negative consequences spread and unintentionally harm innocent or unrelated people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司內部嘅權力鬥爭殃及池魚，好多無辜嘅同事都受影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 noi6 bou6 ge3 kyun4 lik6 dau3 zang1 joeng1 kap6 ci4 jyu4, hou2 do1 mou4 gu1 ge3 tung4 si6 dou1 sau6 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的内部权力斗争殃及池鱼，很多无辜的同事都受到影响。
examples.english_sentence: The company's internal power struggle harmed innocent bystanders; many innocent colleagues were affected.

mandarin_meaning: 殄（tiǎn）：消滅、滅絕（書面語）
english_meaning: to exterminate; to wipe out; extinguish (literary/formal)
explanation_mandarin: 「殄」為書面或文言用字，表示徹底消滅、剿滅或使滅絕，口語中較少使用，常見於「殄滅」「殄絕」等詞語。
explanation_english: A literary/formal verb meaning to exterminate or wipe out completely. Rare in spoken Cantonese; appears in compounds like 殄滅 or 殄絕.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋擔心疫情會殄滅整個村莊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 daam1 sam1 jik6 cing4 wui5 tin2 mit6 zing2 go3 cyun1 zong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們擔心疫情會殄滅整個村莊。
examples.english_sentence: They worry the epidemic will wipe out the entire village.

mandarin_meaning: 殆 (dài)：几乎；危险、将要灭亡（多用于文言或固定词组，如“殆尽”“危殆”）
english_meaning: almost; nearly; dangerous; perilous (literary; often appears in set phrases like '殆盡' and '危殆')
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 副词（文言，用于表示“几乎”）/ 形容词或动词（文言，表示危险或将要灭亡）
partOfSpeech_english: adverb (literary) / adjective or verb (literary, indicating danger or perish)
explanation_mandarin: 殆是一个文言常用字，常作副词表示“几乎、差不多”；在其他语境可表示危险或将要灭亡。现代汉语多见于固定词组如“殆尽”“危殆”。
explanation_english: In Classical/Literary Chinese, 殆 is often used as an adverb meaning 'almost' or 'nearly'; it can also denote danger or imminent ruin. In modern usage it mainly appears in fixed expressions such as '殆盡' and '危殆'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間公司嘅資金已殆盡，快要面臨破產。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 zi1 gam1 ji5 toi4 zeon6, faai3 jiu3 min6 lam4 po3 caan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那间公司的资金已殆尽，快要面临破产。
examples.english_sentence: The company's funds have almost been exhausted and it is about to face bankruptcy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺醫院入面嘅病人情況好危殆，醫生爭分奪秒搶救。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji1 jyun2 jap6 min6 ge3 beng6 jan4 cing4 fong3 hou2 ngai4 toi4, ji1 sang1 zang1 fan1 dyut6 miu5 coeng2 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那位病人在医院里的情况很危殆，医生正在争分夺秒抢救他。
examples.english_sentence: The patient's condition in the hospital is critical; doctors are racing against time to save him.

mandarin_meaning: 殆尽（dài jìn）：几乎耗尽、几乎全部消失
english_meaning: almost exhausted; nearly all used up; virtually gone
explanation_mandarin: 表示某種資源、力量、耐性等幾乎完全耗盡，常用於書面或正式語境。
explanation_english: Indicates that a resource, strength, patience, etc. is nearly completely used up; often used in formal or literary contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅資金殆盡，差唔多冇得繼續營運。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ge3 zi1 gam1 doi6 zeon6, caa1 m4 do1 mou5 dak1 gai3 zuk6 jing4 wan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的資金幾乎耗盡，差不多無法繼續營運。
examples.english_sentence: The company's funds are nearly exhausted; it can hardly continue operating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅耐性殆盡，終於爆發咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 noi6 sing3 doi6 zeon6, zung1 jyu1 baau3 faat3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的耐心幾乎耗盡，終於爆發了。
examples.english_sentence: His patience was nearly exhausted and he finally snapped.

mandarin_meaning: 殉（xùn）：為某事或某人犧牲生命；陪葬、殉職等（多用於書面語）
english_meaning: to die for (a cause or person); to sacrifice one's life; to be buried with (accompany in death)
explanation_mandarin: “殉”常用於書面語，表示為信念、職責或某人而犧牲生命，或指隨葬陪同死去（如殉葬、殉職、殉國等）。
explanation_english: A literary/formal verb meaning to sacrifice one's life for a cause, duty, or person; also used in compounds meaning to be buried with or to die in the line of duty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰位消防員為救人而殉職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 wai6 siu1 fo2 jyun4 wai6 gau3 jan4 ji4 seon6 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那位消防員為了救人而殉職。
examples.english_sentence: The firefighter died in the line of duty trying to save people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古時有啲王侯會逼人殉葬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si4 jau5 di1 wong4 hau4 wui5 bik1 jan4 seon6 zong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古時有些王侯會逼人殉葬。
examples.english_sentence: In ancient times some nobles forced people to be buried with them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔願為信念而殉身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 jyun6 wai4 seon3 nim6 ji4 seon6 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不願為信念而殉身。
examples.english_sentence: He is not willing to sacrifice his life for his beliefs.

mandarin_meaning: 殉国（为国家牺牲生命）
english_meaning: to die for one's country; to sacrifice one's life for the nation
explanation_mandarin: 指為了國家而犧牲生命，常用於描述在戰爭或重大事件中為國捐軀的人，語氣較正式或書面。
explanation_english: To sacrifice one's life for one's country; used to describe someone who dies serving or defending the nation, often in wartime or historical contexts. Formal/literary usage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺戰場上殉國，後人永遠懷念佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 zin3 coeng4 soeng5 seon6 gwok3, hau6 jan4 wing5 jyun5 waai4 nim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在战场上殉国，后人永远怀念他。
examples.english_sentence: He died for his country on the battlefield; later generations will always remember him.

mandarin_meaning: 為愛情而殉死；為情自殺或與情人同死
english_meaning: to die for love; to commit suicide because of love or to die together with a lover
explanation_mandarin: 描述因感情糾葛或為了愛情而選擇以死結束生命，或與戀人一同自殺的行為或事件。
explanation_english: Refers to the act or event of sacrificing one's life for love—committing suicide because of romantic reasons or dying together with a lover.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方懷疑佢哋因感情問題一齊殉情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 waai4 ji4 keoi5 dei6 jan1 gam2 cing4 man6 tai4 jat1 cai4 seon6 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方怀疑他们因感情问题一起殉情。
examples.english_sentence: The police suspect they committed suicide together over relationship problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺小說入面，男主角為咗心愛嘅人殉情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 siu2 seot6 jap6 min6, naam4 zyu2 gok3 wai6 zo2 sam1 oi3 ge3 jan4 seon6 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在小說裡，男主角為心愛的人殉情。
examples.english_sentence: In the novel, the male protagonist dies for the woman he loves.

mandarin_meaning: 殉节（xùn jié）：为节义、忠义或重要理念而牺牲生命，常指为国或为正义而死。
english_meaning: to die for a cause/principle; to sacrifice one's life for righteousness (martyrdom).
explanation_mandarin: 「殉節」多用於書面語，指為了節義、忠義、國家或崇高理想而犧牲生命，有時帶有敬重或悲壯的語氣。
explanation_english: A literary term meaning to sacrifice one's life for moral integrity, loyalty, country, or a noble ideal; often used with a solemn or reverent tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰位將軍喺戰場上殉節，成咗民族英雄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 wai6 zoeng1 gwan1 hai6 zin3 coeng4 soeng6 seon6 zit3, sing4 zo2 man4 zuk6 jing1 hung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那位將軍在戰場上殉節，成了民族英雄。
examples.english_sentence: The general died on the battlefield, becoming a national hero.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 家人希望佢唔好為咗理想殉節，應該諗清楚先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa1 jan4 hei1 mong6 keoi5 m4 hou2 wai4 zo2 lei5 soeng2 seon6 zit3, jing1 goi1 nam2 cing1 co2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家人希望他不要為了理想而殉節，應該先想清楚。
examples.english_sentence: The family hopes he won't die for his ideals; he should think it through first.

mandarin_meaning: 在執行職務時犧牲生命（殉職，xùnzhí）
english_meaning: to die in the line of duty; to be killed while performing one's official duties
explanation_mandarin: 表示在執行公務或職責的過程中犧牲生命，常用於警方、消防、軍人等在職死亡的情況。
explanation_english: Indicates sacrificing one's life while performing official duties; commonly used for police officers, firefighters, soldiers, etc., who die on duty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰位消防員喺救火嘅時候殉職，大家都好唔捨得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 wai6 siu1 fong4 jyun4 hai2 gau3 fo2 ge3 si4 hau6 seon6 zik1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 m4 se2 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那位消防員在救火的時候殉職，大家都很不捨得。
examples.english_sentence: That firefighter died in the line of duty while fighting a fire; everyone was very saddened.

mandarin_meaning: 殉葬：隨著死者一同下葬（把活人或物品陪葬），常指古代以活人或自己犧牲陪葬的行為。
english_meaning: To be buried with the dead; funerary sacrifice — to accompany the deceased in burial (by burying living people or objects with them).
explanation_mandarin: 殉葬指在葬禮或墓葬中，讓他人或自身隨死者一同下葬以陪伴或侍奉，歷史上常見於某些文化的陪葬習俗。
explanation_english: Refers to the practice of burying people or objects alongside a deceased person so they accompany or serve them in the afterlife; historically found as a funerary custom in some cultures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古代有啲貴族會逼奴隸殉葬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 doi6 jau5 di1 gwai3 zuk6 wui5 bik1 nou4 lik6 seon6 zong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代有些贵族会逼迫奴隶殉葬。
examples.english_sentence: In ancient times some nobles forced their slaves to be buried with them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 歷史記載中有啲妃嬪為咗皇帝殉葬，令人惋惜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lik6 si2 gei3 zoi6 zung1 jau5 di1 fei1 pan4 wai6 zo2 wong4 dai3 seon6 zong3 ling6 jan4 maan5 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 史書記載中有些妃嬪為了皇帝殉葬，令人惋惜。
examples.english_sentence: Historical records show that some concubines were buried with emperors, which is lamentable.

mandarin_meaning: 殉道（xùndào）：為宗教、信仰或崇高理想而犧牲生命，成為殉道者（殉難、為信仰而死）。
english_meaning: to be martyred; martyrdom — to die for a religious faith, belief, or a cause.
explanation_mandarin: 指為了宗教信仰或某種崇高事業而犧牲性命。可用作動詞（殉道）或名詞（殉道者、殉道行為）。
explanation_english: Refers to sacrificing one's life for a religious faith or a noble cause. Can be used as a verb (to be martyred) or as a noun (martyrdom, a martyr).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰位傳教士為咗信仰而殉道，教會為佢舉行咗追悼禮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 wai6 cyun4 gaau3 si6 wai6 zo2 seon3 joeng5 ji4 seon6 dou6, gaau3 wui2 wai6 keoi5 geoi2 hang4 zo2 zeoi1 dou6 lai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那位傳教士為了信仰而殉道，教會為他舉行了追悼禮。
examples.english_sentence: That missionary was martyred for his faith; the church held a memorial service for him.

mandarin_meaning: 殉难（为某种崇高目标或在灾难、战争中牺牲而死亡）
english_meaning: to die (often as a martyr or while sacrificing oneself in a disaster, conflict, or for a cause)
explanation_mandarin: 表示因戰爭、災難或為某種崇高目標而喪生，含有犧牲或慘死的意思，語氣較正式，多見於書面或報導語境。
explanation_english: Indicates dying as a result of war, disaster, or while sacrificing oneself for a noble cause; carries the sense of sacrifice or tragic death and is more formal, often used in written or reporting contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多義士為咗國家殉難，後人銘記佢哋嘅犧牲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 ji6 si6 wai6 zo2 gwok3 gaa1 seon6 naan6, hau6 jan4 ming4 gei3 keoi5 dei6 ge3 hei1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多義士為了國家殉難，後人銘記他們的犧牲。
examples.english_sentence: Many patriots perished for their country; later generations remember their sacrifices.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺地震入面，有幾個救援隊員殉難，令全城好傷感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 dei6 zan3 jap6 min6, jau5 gei2 go3 gau3 wun6 deoi6 jyun4 seon6 naan6, ling6 cyun4 sing4 hou2 soeng1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在地震中，有幾名救援隊員殉難，令整個城市非常悲痛。
examples.english_sentence: Several rescue workers perished in the earthquake, leaving the whole city deeply saddened.

mandarin_meaning: 不同；特別（常用於合成詞，如「殊不知」「殊途同歸」）
english_meaning: different; special; extraordinary (often appears in compounds/idioms such as "殊不知", "殊途同歸")
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞 / 副詞（視上下文而定）
partOfSpeech_english: adjective / adverb (depends on context; frequently used in compounds and idioms)
explanation_mandarin: 表示與眾不同或特別，常見於書面語和成語中，用作形容或副詞，與其他字組合形成固定詞語。
explanation_english: Denotes difference or specialness. Commonly found in written language and idioms, functioning as an adjective or adverb and often appearing in fixed compounds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅做法殊異於常人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zou6 faat3 syu1 ji6 jyu1 soeng4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的做法殊異於常人。
examples.english_sentence: His way of doing things is markedly different from ordinary people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我本以為一切穩陣，殊不知事情已經變咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bun2 ji5 wai6 jat1 cai3 wan2 zan6, syu1 bat1 zi1 si6 cing4 ji5 ging1 bin3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我本以為一切穩當，殊不知事情已經變了。
examples.english_sentence: I thought everything was secure, but little did I know things had already changed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然方法不同，但最終殊途同歸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 fong1 faat3 bat1 tung4, daan6 zeoi3 zung1 syu1 tou4 tung4 gwai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 雖然方法不同，但最終殊途同歸。
examples.english_sentence: Although the methods differ, they ultimately lead to the same result.

mandarin_meaning: 殊不知 (shūbùzhī)：没想到；却没意识到（表示转折或出乎意料的情况）
english_meaning: little did one know; unexpectedly; unbeknownst to someone (used to introduce an unforeseen or contrary fact)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 连词 / 副词（用于表示转折、出乎意料）
explanation_mandarin: 用于引出与前面预期相反或出人意料的事实，常放在句中或句首，表示“却没想到”或“谁知”的意思。
explanation_english: Used to introduce an unexpected or contrary fact relative to what was assumed or expected; similar to 'little did one know' or 'unexpectedly'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我以為佢已經到咗，殊不知佢仲喺屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 wai6 keoi5 ji5 ging1 dou3 zo2, syu1 bat1 zi1 keoi5 zung6 hai2 uk1 kei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我以为他已经到了，殊不知他还在家里。
examples.english_sentence: I thought he had already arrived; little did I know he was still at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家都話呢套戲好悶，殊不知觀眾笑到停唔到口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 gaa1 dou1 waa6 ni1 tou3 hei3 hou2 mun6, syu1 bat1 zi1 gun1 zung3 siu3 dou3 ting4 m4 dou2 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家都说这出戏很无聊，殊不知观众笑个不停。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone said the play was boring, but little did they know the audience couldn't stop laughing.

mandarin_meaning: 殊榮 / 荣誉；特別的榮譽
english_meaning: special honor; distinction; privilege
explanation_mandarin: 表示特別的榮譽或光榮，常用來形容獲得某種肯定或榮譽，是一種值得自豪的事情。
explanation_english: Denotes a special honor or distinction; used to describe receiving recognition that is a source of pride.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 能夠代表香港去比賽，對我嚟講係一個莫大嘅殊榮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nang4 gau3 doi6 biu2 Hoeng1 gong2 heoi3 bei2 coi3, deoi3 ngo5 lai4 gong2 hai6 jat1 go3 mok6 daai6 ge3 syu1 wing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 能夠代表香港去比賽，對我來說是一種莫大的榮幸。
examples.english_sentence: Being able to represent Hong Kong in the competition is a great honor for me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 獲得呢個獎項係對佢多年努力嘅殊榮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wok6 dak1 ni1 go3 zoeng2 hong6 hai6 deoi3 keoi5 do1 nin4 nou5 lik6 ge3 syu1 wing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 獲得這個獎項是對他多年努力的殊榮。
examples.english_sentence: Receiving this award is a recognition of his years of hard work.

mandarin_meaning: （常用作昵称）表示“特别、独特”，多作为爱称或宠物名
english_meaning: A nickname meaning "special" or "unique"; often used as a term of endearment.
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语口语中，“殊殊”多以重复字形式作为人名或爱称，带有亲昵、可爱的语气。字面上与“殊（特殊、不同）”相关，但日常使用偏向昵称性质。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "殊殊" is commonly used as a personal or pet name; the reduplication creates an affectionate, cute tone. Literally related to "special/distinct," but in everyday use it functions as a nickname.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 殊殊，你今日食咗飯未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: syu1 syu1, nei5 gam1 jat6 sik6 zo2 faan6 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 殊殊，你今天吃饭了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Shu Shu, have you eaten today?

mandarin_meaning: 殊途同归（成語），意思是不同的道路最終導向相同的結果或目標。
english_meaning: An idiom meaning different paths lead to the same destination or result.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容雖然方法或途徑不同，但最終達到相同的結果或目標。
explanation_english: Used to describe situations where different methods or routes ultimately lead to the same outcome or goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然我哋嘅方法唔同，但目標一致，最終殊途同歸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 ngo5 dei6 ge3 fong1 faat3 m4 tung4, daan6 muk6 biu1 jat1 zik6, zeoi3 zung1 syu1 tou4 tung4 gwai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 雖然我們的方法不同，但目標一致，最終殊途同歸。
examples.english_sentence: Although our methods differ, because our goals are the same we ultimately reach the same result.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩間公司走嘅路線唔一樣，但業績都好，證明殊途同歸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 gaan1 gung1 si1 zau2 ge3 lou6 sin3 m4 jat1 joeng6, daan6 jip6 zik1 dou1 hou2, zing3 ming4 syu1 tou4 tung4 gwai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 兩家公司走的路線不一樣，但業績都很好，證明殊途同歸。
examples.english_sentence: The two companies took different approaches but both performed well, showing that different routes can lead to the same outcome.

mandarin_meaning: 残（残忍、残缺、残废、剩余等）
english_meaning: cruel; incomplete/damaged; disabled; remaining/leftover
explanation_mandarin: 「残」在粵語可用作形容詞表示殘忍或殘缺，也可指因傷害而殘廢，或表示剩餘、殘留。語境不同含義會有所變化。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, 「残」 (caan4) can mean cruel or brutal (adjective), indicate something is incomplete or damaged, describe someone disabled due to injury, or refer to something remaining/leftover. The exact sense depends on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘢咁殘，真係無人性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 je5 gam3 caan4, zan1 hai6 mou4 jan4 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说话这么残忍，真是没人性。
examples.english_sentence: Saying things like that is cruel; it's heartless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰次交通意外令佢殘咗條腿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 ci3 gaau1 tung1 ji3 ngoi6 ling6 keoi5 caan4 zo2 tiu4 teoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那次交通意外使他的一條腿残废了。
examples.english_sentence: That traffic accident left him with a disabled leg.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 碗入面只殘低幾啖飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wun2 jap6 min6 zi2 caan4 dai1 gei2 daam2 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 碗里只剩下几口饭。
examples.english_sentence: There are only a few mouthfuls of rice left in the bowl.

mandarin_meaning: 繁殖、殖民、繁衍（用於複合詞）
english_meaning: to breed/reproduce; to colonize; to proliferate (used mainly in compounds)
explanation_mandarin: 「殖」常見於複合詞如「繁殖」「殖民」，表示繁衍、繁殖或殖民、擴張等意思。
explanation_english: The character is mainly used in compounds (e.g. 繁殖, 殖民) meaning to breed/reproduce or to colonize/proliferate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻兔子喺農場度繁殖得好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 tou3 zi2 hai2 nung4 coeng4 dou6 faan4 zik6 dak1 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 兔子在農場繁殖得很快。
examples.english_sentence: The rabbits breed very quickly on the farm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 歷史上有唔少國家曾經殖民其他地方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lik6 si2 soeng6 jau5 m4 siu2 gwok3 gaa1 cang4 ging1 zik6 man4 kei4 taa1 dei6 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 歷史上有不少國家曾經殖民其他地方。
examples.english_sentence: Throughout history, many countries have colonized other regions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細菌喺溫床上快速繁殖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 kwan2 hai2 wan1 cong4 soeng6 faai3 cuk1 faan4 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 細菌在溫床上快速繁殖。
examples.english_sentence: Bacteria rapidly multiply on the warm medium.

mandarin_meaning: 殖民（zhímín）
english_meaning: to colonize; colonialism
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词 / 名词（视语境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 指一個國家或勢力對外地區進行佔領、統治、開拓或剝削資源的行為或制度。
explanation_english: Refers to the act or system by which a country or power establishes control over foreign territories, often involving occupation, governance, and exploitation of resources.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港曾經被英國殖民過五十多年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 cang4 ging1 bei6 jing1 gwok3 zik6 man4 gwo3 ng5 sap6 do1 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港曾经被英国殖民过五十多年。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong was colonized by Britain for over fifty years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 殖民制度對本地文化造成深遠影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zik6 man4 zai3 dou6 deoi3 bun2 dei6 man4 faa3 zou6 sing4 sam1 jyun5 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 殖民制度对本地文化造成深远影响。
examples.english_sentence: Colonial systems have had profound effects on local culture.

mandarin_meaning: 殖民地（zhímíndì），被外國控制、統治的地區
english_meaning: colony — a territory controlled and governed by a foreign power
explanation_mandarin: 指一個地區被另一個國家佔領、控制或統治，政治、經濟及文化上受殖民國影響或支配。
explanation_english: Refers to a territory that is occupied, controlled, or governed by another country; politically, economically, and culturally influenced or dominated by the colonizing power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港曾經係英國嘅殖民地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 cang4 ging1 hai6 jing1 gwok3 ge3 zik6 man4 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港曾经是英国的殖民地。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong used to be a colony of the United Kingdom.

mandarin_meaning: 残（cán）— 表示不完整、破损、残忍或残存
english_meaning: broken; damaged; incomplete; cruel; remaining; residual
explanation_mandarin: 「殘」可表示物件破损或不完整（如殘缺、殘破），也可表示殘忍、殘暴，或用於表示殘存、殘留。常見組合詞有殘缺、殘忍、殘留、殘疾等。
explanation_english: Used to indicate something broken, damaged, or incomplete; can also mean cruel or brutal; can describe what remains or is leftover. Common compounds include '殘缺' (incomplete), '殘忍' (cruel), '殘留' (remain), '殘疾' (disabled).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部舊手機殘到唔想用，成日當機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 gau6 sau2 gei1 caan4 dou3 m4 soeng2 jung6, sing4 jat6 dong3 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部旧手机坏到不想用，经常死机。
examples.english_sentence: This old phone is so broken I don't want to use it; it often crashes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇下佢啲做法，好殘忍，令人好心寒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 haa5 keoi5 di1 zou6 faat3, hou2 caan4 jan5, ling6 jan4 hou2 sam1 hon4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看他的做法，很残忍，让人心寒。
examples.english_sentence: Look at what he did — it's very cruel and chilling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅畫有一部分殘缺，唔係完整嘅作品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 waa6 jau5 jat1 bou6 fan6 caan4 kyut3, m4 hai6 jyun4 zing2 ge3 zok3 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这幅画有一部分残缺，不是完整的作品。
examples.english_sentence: This painting is partly damaged and not a complete piece.

mandarin_meaning: 残奥（会），即残疾人奥林匹克运动会的简称
english_meaning: Paralympics; the Paralympic Games (international multi-sport event for athletes with disabilities)
explanation_mandarin: 「殘奧」是「残疾人奥林匹克运动会」的簡稱，指為殘疾運動員舉辦的國際大型綜合體育賽事，與奧運會同為重要體育盛事。
explanation_english: “殘奧” is the Cantonese short form for the Paralympic Games, an international multi-sport event for athletes with disabilities. It is analogous to the Olympics and features many competitive events.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我睇咗殘奧嘅開幕禮，真係好感動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tai2 zo2 caan4 ou3 ge3 hoi1 mok6 lai5, zan1 hai6 hou2 gam2 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我看了残奥会的开幕式，真的很感动。
examples.english_sentence: I watched the Paralympics opening ceremony and was really moved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 殘奧會同奧運會一樣，有好多比賽項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caan4 ou3 wui2 tung4 ou3 wan6 wui2 jat1 joeng6, jau5 hou2 do1 bei2 coi3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 残奥会和奥运会一样，有很多比赛项目。
examples.english_sentence: The Paralympics, like the Olympics, have many sporting events.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港喺殘奧入面都有代表隊，唔少運動員都好犀利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 hai6 caan4 ou3 jap6 min6 dou1 jau5 doi6 biu2 deoi2, m4 siu2 wan6 dung6 jyun4 dou1 hou2 sai1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港在残奥会上也有代表队，不少运动员都很了不起。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong also fields teams at the Paralympics; many of the athletes are outstanding.

mandarin_meaning: 残存（残留、存留）
english_meaning: to remain; to survive; residual existence; remnants
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物在經歷破壞或變化後仍然留存、未完全消失，常用於書面或正式語境。
explanation_english: Indicates that something remains or survives after damage or change; something that has not been completely eliminated. Often used in written or formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大火過後，牆上仍有殘存嘅痕跡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 fo2 gwo3 hau6, coeng4 soeng6 jing4 jau5 caan4 cyun4 ge3 han4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大火過後，牆上仍有殘存的痕跡。
examples.english_sentence: After the big fire, there were still remnants on the wall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺老人家嘅記憶中，只有殘存嘅片段。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 lou5 jan4 gaa1 ge3 gei3 jik6 zung1, zi2 jau5 caan4 cyun4 ge3 pin3 dyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在老人的記憶中，只有殘存的片段。
examples.english_sentence: In the elderly person's memory, only fragments remain.

mandarin_meaning: 残害：残忍地伤害或杀害（人或动物）
english_meaning: to cruelly harm, injure, maim, or kill (someone or an animal)
explanation_mandarin: 指以残忍或暴力的手段伤害、虐待或杀害人或动物，含强烈的恶意或残忍成分。
explanation_english: Refers to harming, brutalizing, or killing people or animals by cruel or violent means; carries a strong sense of malice or brutality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰班罪犯殘害咗無辜嘅村民，令人心寒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 baan1 zeoi6 faan6 caan4 hoi6 zo2 mou4 gu1 ge3 cyun1 man4, ling6 jan4 sam1 hon4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些罪犯残害了无辜的村民，令人心寒。
examples.english_sentence: Those criminals cruelly harmed the innocent villagers, which is chilling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 動物保護組織譴責有人殘害動物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dung6 mat6 bou2 wu6 zou2 zik1 him2 zaak3 jau5 jan4 caan4 hoi6 dung6 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 动物保护组织谴责有人残害动物。
examples.english_sentence: The animal protection organization condemned that someone harmed animals.

mandarin_meaning: 残局；指局势已破败或无望挽回的局面（棋局中指残局、劣势局面）
english_meaning: a ruined or hopeless situation; (in board games) a lost endgame/losing position
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容局勢已經處於破敗、難以挽回的狀態；在棋類語境中亦指劣勢或已成定局的残局。
explanation_english: Used to describe a situation that is ruined or difficult to recover from; in board-game contexts it refers to a disadvantaged or effectively lost endgame position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家呢盤棋已經係殘局，幾乎冇得翻身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ni1 pun4 kei4 ji5 ging1 hai6 caan4 guk6, gei2 fu1 mou5 dak1 faan1 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在这盘棋已经是残局，几乎没有翻身的机会。
examples.english_sentence: This game is already a lost endgame; there's almost no chance to come back.

mandarin_meaning: 破舊、髒亂或損壞的廁所（口語）
english_meaning: a broken, filthy, or run-down toilet/restroom (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用詞，用來形容廁所破舊、髒亂或設備故障；有時也可比喻某處或事物質量很差。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term for a toilet that is broken, dirty, or in poor condition. It can also be used metaphorically to describe something of very poor quality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間商場嘅廁所好殘廁，我都唔敢入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 soeng1 coeng4 ge3 ci3 so2 hou2 caam4 ci3, ngo5 dou1 m4 gam2 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那間商場的廁所很破舊，我都不敢進去。
examples.english_sentence: The mall's restroom is really run-down; I don't even dare to go in.

mandarin_meaning: 残废 (cánfèi)，指身体机能严重受损或喪失，亦可引申为無用或无法发挥作用
english_meaning: disabled; crippled; (figuratively) broken beyond use or useless
explanation_mandarin: 指因疾病、事故或先天原因導致肢體或器官功能嚴重受損，影響正常生活或工作；在口語或比喻用法中，也可用來形容物品或系統嚴重損壞而無法使用。
explanation_english: Refers to severe impairment or loss of bodily function due to illness, accident, or congenital causes, affecting normal life or work; figuratively, it can describe objects or systems that are so damaged they no longer function.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺一次車禍之後變得殘廢，要用輪椅出入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 ci3 ce1 wo6 zi1 hau6 bin3 dak1 caan4 fai3, jiu3 jung6 leon4 ji2 ceot1 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在一次车祸之后变得残废，要用轮椅出入。
examples.english_sentence: He became disabled after a car accident and needs a wheelchair to get around.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部機殘廢咗，唔好拎番去修，換部新嘅啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 gei1 caan4 fai3 zo2, m4 hou2 ling1 faan1 heoi3 sau1, wun6 bou6 san1 ge3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台机器坏到无法修了，别拿去修了，换一台新的吧。
examples.english_sentence: This machine is broken beyond repair; don't bother fixing it, get a new one.

mandarin_meaning: 隨便吃的一頓/懶人餐
english_meaning: a lazy/half-hearted meal (a quick, careless, or nutritionally poor meal)
explanation_mandarin: 「殘廢餐」為香港粵語俚語，帶自嘲意味，指因懶惰、沒時間或條件不足而隨便吃的一餐，通常由速食、零食或不搭配的食物組成、營養不均衡。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang term, used jokingly or self-deprecatingly to describe a quick, careless meal eaten out of laziness or lack of time/resources—typically instant food, snacks, or mismatched items with poor nutrition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚冇時間煮，食個殘廢餐算數啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 mou5 si4 gaan3 zyu2, sik6 go3 caan4 fai3 caan1 syun3 sou3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚沒時間煮飯，就將就隨便吃一頓吧。
examples.english_sentence: I don't have time to cook tonight, I'll just have a lazy meal.

mandarin_meaning: 殘弱（cánruò）：虛弱、衰弱、體力或力量不足
english_meaning: weak, feeble, frail, debilitated
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容身體、力量或狀態衰弱、虛弱。常用於書面或較正式的語境，也可作比喻用於組織、經濟等狀況。
explanation_english: Describes a physical or functional state of being weak, feeble, or debilitated. Often used in formal or written contexts and can be used figuratively for organizations or systems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗幾個月，身體變得好殘弱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2 gei2 go3 jyut6, san1tai2 bin3 dak1 hou2 caan4 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生病了幾個月，身體變得很虛弱。
examples.english_sentence: He was ill for several months and became very weak.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢棵樹因為受病蟲侵害，樹勢好殘弱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fo1 syu6 jan1wai6 sau6 beng6 cung4 cam1hoi6, syu6sai3 hou2 caan4 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這棵樹因為受病蟲侵害，樹勢衰弱。
examples.english_sentence: This tree has been weakened by pests and disease.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅財務狀況好殘弱，難以維持日常營運。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1si1 ge3 coi4mou6 zong6fong3 hou2 caan4 joek6, naan4 ji5 wai4 ci4 jat6 soeng4 jing4 wan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的財務狀況很脆弱，難以維持日常營運。
examples.english_sentence: The company's finances are weak, making it difficult to sustain daily operations.

mandarin_meaning: 残忍 (cánrěn)
english_meaning: cruel; brutal; merciless
explanation_mandarin: 形容對他人或事物缺乏憐憫，行為或態度殘酷無情。
explanation_english: Describes a lack of compassion; behavior or attitude that is cruel and merciless toward others or things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅做法好殘忍，完全唔顧及其他人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zou6faat3 hou2 caan4 jan5, jyun4cyun4 m4 gu3 kap6 kei4taa1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的做法很残忍，完全不顾及其他人。
examples.english_sentence: His actions are very cruel, completely disregarding others.

mandarin_meaning: 残暴 (cán bào)：残忍、暴虐
english_meaning: cruel; brutal; savage; violent
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容行為或性格殘忍、暴虐、毫無同情心，常帶有暴力傾向。
explanation_english: Describes behavior or character that is cruel, brutal, merciless, often involving violence or a lack of compassion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅行為好殘暴，成日打人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hang4 wai6 hou2 caan4 bou6, sing4 jat6 daa2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的行为很残暴，经常打人。
examples.english_sentence: His behavior is very brutal; he often hits people.

mandarin_meaning: 残暴不仁（非常残酷、没有同情心或仁慈）
english_meaning: Brutal and merciless; cruel and lacking compassion
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容行為極其殘酷、沒有仁慈或同情心的人或行為，屬於成語用法。
explanation_english: An idiom describing actions or people that are extremely cruel and without compassion or mercy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個領導殘暴不仁，對市民冇一絲同情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 ling5 dou6 caam4bou6bat1jan4, deoi3 si5 man4 mou5 jat1 si1 tung4 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个领导残暴不仁，对市民毫无同情。
examples.english_sentence: That leader is cruel and merciless, showing no sympathy toward the citizens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對動物殘暴不仁，實在令人髮指。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 dung6 mat6 caam4bou6bat1jan4, sat6 zoi6 ling6 jan4 faat3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對動物殘暴不仁，實在令人髮指。
examples.english_sentence: He is cruel and merciless to animals; it's truly appalling.

mandarin_meaning: 残月（指残缺或下弦的月亮，常用作诗意描写）
english_meaning: waning moon; remnant moon; poetic image of a crescent or partially missing moon
explanation_mandarin: 指月亮残缺、未圆的状态，常用于诗歌或文学中，带有孤寂、凋零或苍凉的意象。
explanation_english: Refers to a moon that is partly missing or waning; often used in poetry and literature to evoke solitude, decline, or a melancholic atmosphere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜空只剩一輪殘月，風帶來陣陣涼意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 hung1 zi2 sing6 jat1 leon4 caan4 jyut6, fung1 daai3 loi4 zan6 zan6 loeng4 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夜空中只剩下一轮残月，风带来阵阵凉意。
examples.english_sentence: Only a remnant moon hung in the night sky, and the wind brought waves of chill.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢倚窗望住嗰輪殘月，心中泛起淡淡嘅愁緒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji2 coeng1 mong6 zyu6 go2 leon4 caan4 jyut6, sam1 zung1 faan6 hei2 daam6 daam6 ge3 cau4 seoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他倚窗望着那轮残月，心中泛起淡淡的愁绪。
examples.english_sentence: He leaned by the window watching the remnant moon, a faint sadness rising in his heart.

mandarin_meaning: 殘殺 (cánshā)：殘忍地殺害，常指大規模或毫無人道的屠戮。
english_meaning: to slaughter; to massacre; to kill brutally or mercilessly
explanation_mandarin: 指以極其殘忍或毫無憐憫心地殺害人或動物，常帶有大規模或野蠻性的含義。
explanation_english: To kill mercilessly or brutally, often implying large-scale or inhumane killing of people or animals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 軍隊喺村度殘殺咗唔少平民，情況好殘忍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwan1 deoi6 hai2 cyun1 dou6 caan4 saat3 zo2 m4 siu2 ping4 man4, cing4 fong3 hou2 caan4 jan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 軍隊在村裡殘殺了不少平民，情況非常殘忍。
examples.english_sentence: The troops massacred many civilians in the village; the situation was extremely brutal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方話有人喺夜店用刀殘殺咗兩個人，案件緊急調查中。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 waa6 jau5 jan4 hai2 je6 dim3 jung6 dou1 caan4 saat3 zo2 loeng5 go3 jan4, on3 gin6 gan2 gap1 tiu4 caa4 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方稱有人在夜店用刀殘殺了兩個人，案件正在緊急調查中。
examples.english_sentence: Police say someone used a knife to slaughter two people at the nightclub; the case is under urgent investigation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 戰爭期間好多無辜百姓被殘殺，歷史留下深刻的傷痕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zin3 zang1 kei4 gaan1 hou2 do1 mou4 gu1 baak3 sing3 bei6 caan4 saat3, lik6 si2 lau4 haa6 sam1 hak1 dik1 soeng1 han4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 戰爭期間許多無辜百姓被殘殺，歷史留下深刻的傷痕。
examples.english_sentence: During the war many innocent civilians were massacred, leaving deep scars in history.

mandarin_meaning: 残渣；剩餘的固體物或雜質
english_meaning: residue; dregs; leftover solids or remnants
explanation_mandarin: 指剩下的固體物質或雜質，常用於描述食物、液體底部的殘留物，也可做比喻用來形容無用或劣質的剩餘部分。
explanation_english: Refers to leftover solid material or dregs; commonly used to describe residues at the bottom of food or liquids, and can be used figuratively to denote useless or low-quality remnants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢碗湯飲完，鍋底留咗好多殘渣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wun2 tong1 jam2 jyun4, wo1 dai2 lau4 zo2 hou2 do1 caan4 zaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这碗汤喝完，锅底留下了很多残渣。
examples.english_sentence: After finishing the soup, a lot of residue remained at the bottom of the pot.

mandarin_meaning: 残片；碎片；（影像或物件的）破损部分
english_meaning: fragment; broken piece; damaged or leftover piece (can refer to physical fragments or damaged frames/footage)
explanation_mandarin: 指破损或只剩下一部分的東西，可以是物件的碎片，也可指照片、影片等影像的損壞或廢片。在廣東話口語中常用來形容殘缺、不完整的東西。
explanation_english: Refers to a damaged or remaining piece of something — a fragment. It can describe physical shards or the damaged frames/leftover footage in photos or film. Commonly used in Cantonese to denote something incomplete or broken.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你把啲殘片收埋，睇下仲有冇得修。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 baa2 di1 caan4 pin3 sau1 maai4, tai2 haa5 zung6 jau5 mou5 dak1 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你把那些残片收起来，看看还有没有办法修复。
examples.english_sentence: Put those fragments away and see if they can still be repaired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢卷相機沖洗出嚟全部都係殘片，冇一張完整嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gyun2 soeng2 gei1 cung1 sai2 ceot1 lei4 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 caan4 pin3, mou5 jat1 zoeng1 wan4 zing6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這卷相機沖洗出來全都是殘片，沒有一張完整的。
examples.english_sentence: This roll of film developed into nothing but damaged frames; not a single intact shot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地上有好多玻璃殘片，小心唔好畀割親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 soeng6 jau5 hou2 do1 bo1 lei4 caan4 pin3, siu2 sam1 m4 hou2 bei2 got3 can1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地上有很多玻璃碎片，小心別被割傷。
examples.english_sentence: There are a lot of glass fragments on the ground — be careful not to get cut.

mandarin_meaning: 残留（留下未被去除的部分或痕跡）
english_meaning: to remain; to be left over; residue; remnants
partOfSpeech_english: verb (can also be used as a noun: 'residue')
explanation_mandarin: 指事物的某些部分或痕跡在處理或消失後仍然留存下來。
explanation_english: Refers to parts or traces of something that remain after a process or event and have not been removed or eliminated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件衫上仲有啲污漬殘留，洗唔晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 saam1 soeng6 zung6 jau5 di1 wu1 zik6 caan4 lau4, sai2 m4 saat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 衣服上還殘留著一些污漬，洗不掉。
examples.english_sentence: There are still some stains left on the clothes that won't come out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事過咗咁耐，佢心入面嘅陰影依然殘留。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 gwo3 zo2 gam2 noi6, keoi5 sam1 jap6 min6 ge3 jam1 jing4 ji1 jin4 caan4 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 事情已經過了那麼久，他心中的陰影仍然殘留。
examples.english_sentence: Even after so long, the shadow in his heart still lingers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 檢查報告顯示水樣入面有少量化學殘留。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gim2 caa4 bou3 gou3 hin2 si6 seoi2 joeng2 jap6 min6 jau5 siu2 loeng6 faa3 hok6 caan4 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 檢查報告顯示水樣中有少量化學殘留。
examples.english_sentence: The test report shows trace chemical residues in the water sample.

mandarin_meaning: 残疾 (身体部分有永久性功能障碍或损伤，导致活动或生活能力受限)
english_meaning: disability; physical impairment (a permanent loss or limitation of bodily function that restricts activities or daily life)
explanation_mandarin: 指身體某部分有永久性或長期的功能障礙或損傷，會影響一個人的行動、感覺或生活自理能力。在日常語境中可作名詞或用作形容詞（如「殘疾人士」、「殘疾的孩子」）。
explanation_english: Refers to a permanent or long-term impairment or loss of bodily function that affects a person's movement, sensation, or ability to carry out daily activities. Used as a noun (e.g. "a person with a disability") or adjectivally (e.g. "disabled child").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個一場意外，變成殘疾，但佢一直好努力適應生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 jat1 coeng4 ji3 ngoi6, bin3 sing4 caan4 zik6, daan6 keoi5 jat1 zik6 hou2 nou5 lik6 sik1 jing3 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小時候一場意外變成了殘疾，但他一直很努力適應生活。
examples.english_sentence: He became disabled after an accident when he was a child, but he has worked hard to adapt to life.

mandarin_meaning: 残破（cánpò）
english_meaning: damaged; broken; dilapidated; fragmentary
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容物品、建築或事物破損、殘缺、不完整或破敗的狀態。
explanation_english: Describes an object, structure, or thing that is damaged, broken, dilapidated, or in a fragmentary state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢棟樓太殘破，唔適合住人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dung6 lau4 taai3 caan4 po3, m4 sik1 hap6 zyu6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这栋楼太残破，不适合居住。
examples.english_sentence: This building is too dilapidated and not suitable for living.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個詞典殘破，啲頁都撕爛晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 ci4 din2 caan4 po3, di1 jip6 dou1 si1 laan6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的词典残破，很多页都撕烂了。
examples.english_sentence: His dictionary is worn and many pages are torn.

mandarin_meaning: 残缺；不完整；有缺失或缺陷
english_meaning: incomplete; defective; missing parts; imperfect
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物缺少部分或有缺陷，不能算是完整或完好無缺。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is missing parts or has defects — not whole or intact.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書有幾頁殘缺，內容睇唔清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 jau5 gei2 jip6 caan4 kyut3, noi6 jung4 tai2 m4 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這本書有幾頁殘缺，內容看不清楚。
examples.english_sentence: This book has several missing pages; the content is hard to read.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然呢個雕像殘缺，但仍然有歷史價值。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 ni1 go3 diu1 zoeng6 caan4 kyut3, daan6 jing4 jin4 jau5 lik6 si2 gaa3 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 雖然這個雕像殘缺，但仍然有歷史價值。
examples.english_sentence: Although this statue is damaged, it still has historical value.

mandarin_meaning: 残而不废（残损但未被废弃，仍有用处或可继续发挥作用）
english_meaning: Damaged or imperfect but not discarded; still usable or still able to serve a purpose
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物或人雖然有損傷、缺陷或老舊，但仍有用處、尚未被廢棄或仍能發揮作用。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone that, despite being damaged, imperfect, or worn, is still useful or not cast aside and can still perform a function.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢架舊車雖然殘而不廢，仲可以用嚟載貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaa3 gau6 ce1 seoi1 jin4 caan4 ji4 bat1 fai3, zung6 ho2 ji5 jung6 lai4 zoi3 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆旧车虽然残而不废，仍然可以用来载货。
examples.english_sentence: Although this old truck is battered, it can still be used to carry goods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢雖然傷咗隻手，但殘而不廢，仲可以繼續教徒弟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seoi1 jin4 soeng1 zo2 zek3 sau2, daan6 caan4 ji4 bat1 fai3, zung6 ho2 ji5 gai3 zuk6 gaau3 tou4 dai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他虽然伤了一只手，但残而不废，仍然可以继续教徒弟。
examples.english_sentence: Although he injured one hand, he's still able to continue teaching apprentices.

mandarin_meaning: 残肢（被截断或残留的手臂、腿等肢体）
english_meaning: severed limb; amputated limb; dismembered limb
explanation_mandarin: 指被截断或残留的肢体（例如手臂、腿），常出现在医学、车祸或刑事报道中，也可在比喻中指残存的部分。
explanation_english: Refers to a limb that has been severed or remains after amputation (e.g., an arm or a leg). Commonly used in medical contexts, accident or crime reports, and sometimes metaphorically to denote remaining fragments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 車禍之後佢失去咗一條腿，剩下殘肢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ce1 fo2 zi1 hau6 keoi5 sat1 heoi3 zo2 jat1 tiu4 teoi2, sing6 haa6 caan4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车祸之后他失去了一条腿，剩下残肢。
examples.english_sentence: After the accident he lost a leg, leaving a severed limb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方喺現場發現咗殘肢，案件疑似謀殺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 hai2 jin6 coeng4 faat3 jin6 zo2 caan4 zi1, on3 gin6 ji4 si6 mau4 saat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方在现场发现了残肢，案件疑似谋杀。
examples.english_sentence: Police found severed limbs at the scene; the case is suspected to be murder.

mandarin_meaning: 残旧（破旧、年久失修）
english_meaning: shabby; dilapidated; worn-out; old and damaged
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容物品或建築年久、破損、破舊不堪，看起來很舊或殘破。
explanation_english: Describes something that is old, worn-out, damaged, or dilapidated in appearance or condition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間屋好殘舊，可能要整修一下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 uk1 hou2 caan4 gau6, ho2 nang4 jiu3 zing2 sau1 jat1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间房子很残旧，可能要修缮一下。
examples.english_sentence: This house is very dilapidated; it may need some repairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫已經好殘舊，唔啱再著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 ji5 ging1 hou2 caan4 gau6, m4 ngaam1 zoi3 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服已经很残旧，不适合再穿。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of clothing is already very shabby; it's not suitable to wear again.

mandarin_meaning: 残花败柳（cán huā bài liǔ）：形容容貌衰老或失去青春美丽，常含贬义。
english_meaning: An idiom meaning faded beauty or lost youthful attractiveness; often used derogatorily to describe people whose looks have declined with age.
explanation_mandarin: 「殘花敗柳」字面指凋謝的花、衰敗的柳枝，用來比喻容貌凋零、青春不再的人，通常帶有貶義或不敬的語氣。
explanation_english: Literally "withered flowers and ruined willows," this idiom metaphorically refers to people whose appearance has faded or declined with age. It usually carries a derogatory or disrespectful tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好用「殘花敗柳」嚟形容人，咁樣好傷人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jung6 "caan4 faa1 baai6 lau5" lai4 jing4 jung4 jan4, gam2 joeng6 hou2 soeng1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要用「残花败柳」来形容人，那样很伤人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't describe people as "càn huā bài liǔ"—that's hurtful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 報紙用「殘花敗柳」嚟形容嗰位演員，結果惹起咗好大爭議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou3 zi2 jung6 "caan4 faa1 baai6 lau5" lai4 jing4 jung4 go2 wai2 jin2 jyun4, git3 gwo2 je5 hei2 zo2 hou2 daai6 zang1 ji4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 报纸用「残花败柳」来形容那位演员，结果引起了很大争议。
examples.english_sentence: The newspaper described that actor as "càn huā bài liǔ," and it triggered a big controversy.

mandarin_meaning: 残迹；残留的痕迹或遗留下来的部分
english_meaning: trace; remnant; vestige; remaining marks or remains
explanation_mandarin: 指遗留下来的痕迹或残存的部分，常用于描述物品、事件或过去存在所留下的痕迹或遗迹。
explanation_english: Refers to leftover marks or surviving parts; used to describe remnants or traces left by objects, events, or past presence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考古隊喺工地度搵到古代人嘅殘跡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 gu2 deoi6 hai2 gung1 dei6 dou6 wan2 dou3 gu2 doi6 jan4 ge3 caan4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考古队在工地发现了古代人的残迹。
examples.english_sentence: The archaeological team found traces of ancient people at the construction site.

mandarin_meaning: 残酷 (cánkù)：残忍、无情、毫不留情
english_meaning: cruel; brutal; merciless
explanation_mandarin: 形容態度或行為極為殘忍、毫不留情，對別人造成痛苦或苦難。
explanation_english: Describes an attitude or action that is extremely cruel, merciless, and causes suffering or harm to others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋對犯人嘅處罰好殘酷，完全冇人性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 deoi3 faan6 jan4 ge3 cyu3 fat6 hou2 caan4 huk6, jyun4 cyun4 mou5 jan4 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们对犯人的处罚很残酷，完全没人性。
examples.english_sentence: Their punishment of the prisoners is very cruel — completely inhumane.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 殘酷嘅現實係唔會等人，大家要學識面對。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caan4 huk6 ge3 jin6 sat6 hai6 m4 wui5 dang2 jan4, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 hok6 sik1 min6 deoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 残酷的现实是不会等待人的，大家要学会面对。
examples.english_sentence: Cruel reality won't wait for anyone; we all have to learn to face it.

mandarin_meaning: 残疾；有身心障碍的人或状态
english_meaning: disabled; disability (having physical or mental impairments that limit activities)
explanation_mandarin: 指身體或精神方面的殘缺或障礙，導致日常生活或活動能力受限；也用來指有此情況的人（殘障人士）。
explanation_english: Refers to physical or mental impairments or barriers that limit everyday activities; can describe the condition (disability) or be used to refer to people with such conditions (people with disabilities).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一位殘障人士，但好積極面對生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 wai2 caan4 zoeng3 jan4 si6, daan6 hou2 zik1 gik6 min6 deoi3 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一位殘障人士，但很積極面對生活。
examples.english_sentence: He is a person with a disability, but he faces life with great positivity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府要提供更多無障礙設施，方便殘障人士出行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jiu3 tai4 gung1 gang3 do1 mou4 zoeng3 ngai6 cit3 si1, fong1 bin6 caan4 zoeng3 jan4 si6 ceot1 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府要提供更多無障礙設施，方便殘障人士出行。
examples.english_sentence: The government should provide more barrier-free facilities to make travel easier for people with disabilities.

mandarin_meaning: （粤语粗俗用語）用來辱罵某人（多指女性）貌醜或身心衰敗、喪失魅力的人
english_meaning: A derogatory Cantonese slang term (literally "crippled chicken") used to insult someone—often a woman—implying she is unattractive, worn-out, or past her prime
explanation_mandarin: 「殘雞」是香港粵語中的粗俗俚語，字面意思為「殘缺的雞」，常用作侮辱性稱呼，暗指對方貌醜、精神或外表衰敗、失去吸引力。屬於貶義詞，使用時會冒犯他人，不宜隨便使用。
explanation_english: "Caan4 gai1" is a Hong Kong Cantonese vulgar slang term literally meaning "crippled chicken." It is used as an insulting label, typically directed at women, to imply unattractiveness, a worn-out appearance, or diminished appeal. It is derogatory and offensive; avoid using it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺人背後鬧人係殘雞，真係過份。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 jan4 bui3 hau6 naau6 jan4 hai6 caan4 gai1, zan1 hai6 gwo3 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常在背後罵人是「殘雞」，真的太過分了。
examples.english_sentence: He often calls people 'caan4 gai1' behind their backs — that's really excessive.

mandarin_meaning: 残响（cán xiǎng）：指声音消失后留下的回声或余音；也可比喻影响或余波。
english_meaning: reverberation; lingering echo or aftersound; figuratively, a lingering effect or aftermath
explanation_mandarin: 指声音衰弱或停止后仍在空气中回荡的声响或余音；在比喻用法中，指事件、记忆或影响留下的余波或后续影响。
explanation_english: Refers to the residual sound or echo that lingers after a sound has faded; figuratively, it denotes the lingering effects or aftermath of an event, memory, or action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 鐘聲停咗之後，仲可以聽到殘響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 seng1 ting4 zo2 zi1 hau6, zung6 ho2 ji5 teng1 dou3 caan4 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 钟声停止了之后，仍能听到残响。
examples.english_sentence: After the bell stopped, you could still hear the lingering echo.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事帶嚟嘅殘響仲未消散。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 daai3 lai4 ge3 caan4 hoeng2 zung6 mei6 siu1 saan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事带来的余波还未消散。
examples.english_sentence: The repercussions of this matter have not yet faded.

mandarin_meaning: 残余；剩余、残留的部分
english_meaning: residue; remnant; leftover; remaining part
explanation_mandarin: 指在主要部分去除或消失後，仍然留下來的部分或物質，常用於描述剩餘、殘留的東西。
explanation_english: Refers to the part or substances left behind after the main portion has been removed or used; commonly used to describe remnants or residues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地震之後，樓宇到處仲有殘餘嘅碎石。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 zan3 zi1 hau6, lau4 jyu5 dou3 cyu3 zung6 jau5 caan4 jyu4 ge3 seoi3 sek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地震之后，楼宇到处还有残余的碎石。
examples.english_sentence: After the earthquake, there were still remnants of rubble everywhere in the buildings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 化學反應做完之後，系統入面會留低一啲殘餘物質。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faa3 hok6 faan2 jing3 zou6 jyun4 zi1 hau6, hai6 tung2 jap6 min6 wui5 lau4 dai1 jat1 di1 caan4 jyu4 mat6 zat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 化学反应完成后，系统中会留下些残余物质。
examples.english_sentence: After the chemical reaction, some residual substances remain in the system.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 社會改革之後，仲有殘餘嘅舊制度影響住新政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se5 wui6 goi2 gaak3 zi1 hau6, zung6 jau5 caan4 jyu4 ge3 gau6 zai3 dou6 jing2 hoeng2 zyu6 san1 zing3 cek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 社会改革后，仍有残余的旧制度影响着新政策。
examples.english_sentence: After social reforms, remnants of the old system still affect the new policies.

mandarin_meaning: 残骸（遗留下来的尸体、残破或碎片）
english_meaning: remains; wreckage; debris (leftover parts of structures, vehicles, or bodies)
explanation_mandarin: 指遭受破壞或死亡後遺留的殘破部分或屍體碎片，常用於描述建築、交通工具或戰爭／災難後的遺留物。
explanation_english: Refers to the remaining broken parts or fragments (including human remains) left after destruction or death; commonly used for the debris of buildings, vehicles, or remains after wars/disasters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地震之後，街上到處都係建築物嘅殘骸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 zan3 zi1 hau6, gaai1 soeng6 dou3 cyu3 dou1 hai6 gin3 zuk1 mat6 ge3 caan4 haai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地震之后，街上到处都是建筑物的残骸。
examples.english_sentence: After the earthquake, the streets were covered with the wreckage of buildings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架飛機嘅殘骸喺山谷入面被發現咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 fei1 gei1 ge3 caan4 haai4 hai2 saan1 guk1 jap6 min6 bei6 faat3 jin4 zo2.
