examples.mandarin_sentence: 飞机残骸在山谷里被发现了。
examples.english_sentence: The plane wreckage was found in the valley.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺海岸線搵到一啲疑似戰爭時期嘅殘骸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 hoi2 ngon6 sin3 wan2 dou3 jat1 di1 ji4 ci5 zin3 zeng1 si4 kei4 ge3 caan4 haai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在海岸线找到一些疑似战争时期的残骸。
examples.english_sentence: They found some suspected wartime remains along the coastline.

mandarin_meaning: 残体字（指字形残缺或变形的汉字）
english_meaning: broken/incomplete characters; nonstandard or distorted character forms
explanation_mandarin: 「殘體字」指字形不完整或被簡化、變形的漢字，可能源於潦草手寫、故意省略筆劃的網絡書寫風格，或字體/編碼錯誤造成的缺損字形。屬於非標準、不規範的文字形式，有時用作表達情緒或規避審查，但在正式場合不適合使用。
explanation_english: Refers to Chinese characters whose shapes are incomplete or distorted — nonstandard forms that result from sloppy handwriting, deliberate omission of strokes in online stylization, or font/encoding errors. Often informal and used for stylistic effect or to evade moderation; inappropriate for formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲殘體字好難睇，唔好喺正式場合用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 caan4 tai2 zi6 hou2 naan4 tai2 , m4 hou2 hai2 zing3 sik1 coeng4 hap6 jung6 .
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些残体字很难看，不要在正式场合使用。
examples.english_sentence: These 'broken characters' are hard to read; don't use them in formal situations.

mandarin_meaning: （粗俗俚語）對年老、被視為失去吸引力或曾做過妓女的女性的貶稱，含侮辱意味
english_meaning: Derogatory Cantonese slang for a woman considered 'damaged', past her prime, or formerly a prostitute; literally 'broken/ruined chicken' (insult)
explanation_mandarin: 「殘鷄」是廣東話粗俗的貶稱，通常用來形容被視為年老、失去吸引力或有被孤立/受辱經歷的女性，常帶侮辱意味，有時特指曾從事性交易的女性。屬粗俗用語，應避免在禮貌語境中使用。
explanation_english: “Caan gai” is coarse Cantonese slang used as a disparaging term for women regarded as damaged, past their prime, or perceived to have been prostitutes. It is insulting and vulgar; avoid using it in polite contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以前做過雞，依家年紀大咗，啲人就話佢係殘鷄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 cin4 zou6 gwo3 gai1, ji1 gaa1 nin4 gei2 daai6 zo2, di1 jan4 zau6 waa6 keoi5 hai6 caan4 gai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她以前做過妓女，現在年紀大了，人們就說她是「殘鷄」。
examples.english_sentence: She used to work as a prostitute; now that she's older, people call her a 'caan gai' (derogatory).

mandarin_meaning: 死亡；（詩文）陨落、消亡
english_meaning: to die; to perish; (literary) to fall (of a star)
explanation_mandarin: 指死亡或消失，常見於書面語或詩詞中；亦可用來形容天體墜落。
explanation_english: Refers to death or disappearance, often used in literary or poetic contexts; can also describe the falling of celestial bodies (e.g., meteors).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰位英雄喺戰場上殞命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 wai6 jing1 hung4 hai2 zin3 coeng4 soeng6 wan5 ming6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那位英雄在戰場上殞命。
examples.english_sentence: That hero perished on the battlefield.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 流星喺夜空中殞落，好壯觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lau4 sing1 hai2 je6 hung1 zung1 wan5 lok6, hou2 zong6 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 流星在夜空中殒落，很壯觀。
examples.english_sentence: A meteor fell in the night sky — it was spectacular.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺手術期間不幸殞命，真係令人惋惜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 sau2 seot6 kei4 gaan1 bat1 hang6 wan5 ming6, zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 wun2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在手術期間不幸殒命，真讓人惋惜。
examples.english_sentence: He unfortunately died during the surgery; it's truly regrettable.

mandarin_meaning: 殞（yǔn）：死亡、殞落
english_meaning: to perish; to fall; to die (archaic/literary)
explanation_mandarin: 殟為罕用古字，常與「殞」通用，表示失去生命、殞落或掉落，多見於文言或書面語，現代口語中很少使用。
explanation_english: A rare/archaic character equivalent to 殞 (yǔn). It means to perish, to fall, or to die. Mainly found in classical or literary texts and seldom used in modern spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺戰爭中殟咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 zin3 zeng1 zung1 wan6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在戰爭中殞命了。
examples.english_sentence: He perished in the war.

mandarin_meaning: 死於幼年；夭折；早逝
english_meaning: death at a young age; to die young; premature death
explanation_mandarin: 表示年幼夭折或早逝，也可作動詞表示早亡，常見於古文或書面語。
explanation_english: Refers to dying at a young age or premature death; can also be used as a verb meaning to die young. Typically found in literary or formal usage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講嗰位歌手年紀輕輕就殤咗，大家都好傷感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 gong2 go2 wai6 go1 sau2 nin4 gei3 hing1 hing1 zau6 soeng1 zo2, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 soeng1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说那位歌手年紀輕輕就早逝了，大家都很伤感。
examples.english_sentence: I heard that singer died young; everyone is very saddened.

mandarin_meaning: 僵（如僵硬、僵尸），表示僵硬、僵直；在「殭屍」一詞中指傳說中的僵尸（跳屍）
english_meaning: stiff, rigid; also appears in 'jiangshi' meaning a hopping corpse/zombie
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞 / 名詞（視語境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 表示身體僵硬、無法靈活活動；作詞素時常見於「殭屍」一詞，指中國民間傳說中的僵屍。
explanation_english: Indicates bodily stiffness or rigidity; as a morpheme it appears in 'jiangshi' (hopping corpse/zombie) from Chinese folklore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚電視有套殭屍片，嚇到我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 din6 si6 jau5 tou3 goeng1 si1 pin3, haak3 dou3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚電視有一部僵屍片，把我嚇到了。
examples.english_sentence: There's a zombie movie on TV tonight; it scared me.

mandarin_meaning: 僵屍／僵尸 (jiāngshī)：指中國民間傳說中會跳躍行走的屍體，也可泛指像殭屍般沒有生氣的人或事物
english_meaning: zombie; (Chinese) hopping corpse/hopping vampire; by extension, a person or thing that is lifeless or robotic
explanation_mandarin: 源自中國民間信仰與小說，殭屍為復活的屍體，常被描繪成手腳僵硬、以屈膝跳躍方式移動的形象。現代也常用來比喻行為呆滯或毫無生氣的人/群體。
explanation_english: Originating in Chinese folklore, a jiangshi is a reanimated corpse often depicted as hopping with outstretched arms. In modern usage it can also metaphorically describe people or groups who are lifeless, robotic, or devoid of energy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個驚殭屍，唔敢一個人行夜路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 geng1 goeng1 si1, m4 gam2 jat1 go3 jan4 haang4 je6 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小時候害怕殭屍，不敢一個人夜裡走路。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little I was afraid of zombies and didn't dare walk alone at night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套殭屍電影好恐怖，唔好一個人睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 goeng1 si1 din6 jing2 hou2 hung2 bou3, m4 hou2 jat1 go3 jan4 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部殭屍電影很恐怖，不要一個人看。
examples.english_sentence: This zombie movie is scary; don't watch it alone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最近返工返到好似殭屍咁，冇精神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 faan1 gung1 faan1 dou3 hou2 ci5 goeng1 si1 gam2, mou5 zing1 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近上班像殭屍一樣，沒有精神。
examples.english_sentence: Lately I've been going to work like a zombie, with no energy.

mandarin_meaning: 字面：僵尸茶包；引申（俚語）：指外形像殭屍的創意/玩趣茶包，亦可比喻像殭屍般無精打采的人。
english_meaning: Literal: 'zombie teabag' — a novelty teabag shaped like a zombie; slang: someone who looks or behaves like a zombie (lethargic, lifeless).
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞（俚語 / 產品名稱）
explanation_mandarin: 通常指外形或包裝做成殭屍樣式的創意茶包，倒入熱水後會呈現出『殭屍』造型。在口語中也可用來形容因疲倦或無精神而像殭屍一樣的人。
explanation_english: Refers mainly to novelty tea bags designed to look like zombies (they reveal a zombie shape when steeped). Colloquially, it can be used metaphorically to describe someone who is exhausted or appears zombie-like.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 商店賣緊一款殭屍茶包，浸落熱水會變成殭屍造型，好得意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng1 dim3 maai6 gan2 jat1 fun2 goeng1 si1 caa4 baau1, zam3 lok6 jit6 seoi2 wui5 bin3 sing4 goeng1 si1 zou6 jing4, hou2 dak1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 商店在賣一款殭屍茶包，放進熱水後會變成殭屍造型，很可愛。
examples.english_sentence: The shop is selling a zombie teabag — when you put it in hot water it becomes a zombie shape; it's cute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今朝瞓得唔夠，返工整日好似殭屍茶包咁，冇精神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 ziu1 fan3 dak1 m4 gau3, faan1 gung1 zing2 jat6 hou2 ci5 goeng1 si1 caa4 baau1 gam2, mou5 zing1 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天早上沒睡好，上班整天都像個殭屍茶包一樣，沒精神。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't sleep well this morning; at work I've been like a zombie teabag all day, no energy.

mandarin_meaning: 把遺體裝入棺材，為出殯或下葬做準備。
english_meaning: to encoffin; to lay a deceased person in a coffin; to prepare a body for burial.
explanation_mandarin: 指將遺體安置入棺材或對遺體進行處理的喪葬行為，常見用法有「入殮」。
explanation_english: Refers to placing a deceased person's body into a coffin or preparing the body as part of funerary rites; commonly used in compounds like "入殮".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺喪禮之前，家人會幫亡者殮身，為出殯做準備。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 song3 lai5 zi1 cin4, gaa1 jan4 wui5 bong1 mong4 ze2 lim6 san1, wai6 ceot1 ban3 zou6 zeon2 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在喪禮之前，家人會為亡者殮身，為出殯做準備。
examples.english_sentence: Before the funeral, family members will prepare the deceased for burial by laying the body in a coffin.

mandarin_meaning: 殮尸（liàn shī）：将遗体清洗、整容、穿衣并安置入棺，供瞻仰或下葬。
english_meaning: To prepare or lay out a corpse (wash, dress, restore appearance) and place it in a coffin for viewing or burial.
explanation_mandarin: 指為遺體進行清潔、整容、穿衣、放入棺木等處理，讓親友能瞻仰或為下葬作準備。
explanation_english: Refers to the preparation of a deceased body — cleaning, dressing, cosmetic restoration and placing into a coffin — so it can be viewed by relatives or prepared for burial.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爺過咗身，佢哋安排人嚟殮屍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 je4 gwo3 zo2 san1, keoi5 dei6 on1 paai4 jan4 lai4 lim6 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爷爷去世了，他们安排人来殮尸。
examples.english_sentence: Grandfather passed away; they arranged for someone to prepare (lay out) the body.

mandarin_meaning: 殮房 / 太平間（殮葬前處理遺體的房間）
english_meaning: mortuary; embalming room; morgue (room where a body is prepared for burial/viewing)
explanation_mandarin: 指殮葬前處理遺體的房間或設施，通常在醫院或殯儀館用來清洗、整理、化妝、保存或防腐處理遺體的場所。
explanation_english: A room or facility where a deceased person's body is prepared before burial or viewing. Commonly found in hospitals or funeral homes for washing, dressing, embalming, or storing bodies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢屋企人話要將遺體送去殮房處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 uk1 kei2 jan4 waa6 jiu3 zoeng1 wai4 tai2 sung3 heoi3 lim6 fong4 cyu3 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他家人說要把遺體送去殮房處理。
examples.english_sentence: His family said they would send the body to the mortuary for preparation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫院殮房今晚冇開，家屬要等到聽日先可以見遺體。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 jyun2 lim6 fong4 gam1 maan5 mou5 hoi1, gaa1 suk6 jiu3 dang2 dou3 ting1 jat6 sin1 ho2 ji5 gin3 wai4 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫院的殮房今晚沒有開，家屬要等到明天才能見到遺體。
examples.english_sentence: The hospital mortuary is closed tonight; the family will have to wait until tomorrow to see the body.

mandarin_meaning: 为死者入殓并下葬；办理葬礼相关事宜
english_meaning: to prepare the deceased (en-coffin) and bury; to conduct funeral and burial
explanation_mandarin: 指为逝者进行入殓、举行葬礼并下葬等一系列处理和仪式。
explanation_english: Refers to the process of preparing the deceased (placing into a coffin), holding funeral rites, and burying the body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 家屬已經安排好殮葬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa1 suk6 ji5 ging1 on1 paai4 hou2 lim6 zong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家属已经安排好殮葬。
examples.english_sentence: The family has already arranged the encoffining and burial.

mandarin_meaning: 殯（bìn）：與殯葬有關，指為遺體辦理入殮、停放或舉行殯葬儀式等。
english_meaning: To lay out/entomb the deceased; related to funeral rites (e.g. placing the body in a coffin, funeral procedures).
explanation_mandarin: 表示將遺體置於棺槨或在殯儀場所辦理喪葬事宜，常見於詞語如「殯儀館」、「入殮」、「出殯」。
explanation_english: Refers to placing the deceased in a coffin or carrying out funeral-related procedures; appears in compounds like "殯儀館" (funeral home), "入殮" (to lay the body in a coffin) and "出殯" (to carry the coffin out).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺殯儀館，佢哋幫遺體辦理入殯手續。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ban6 ji4 gun2, keoi5 dei6 bong1 wai4 tai2 baan6 lei5 jap6 ban6 sau2 zuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在殯儀館，他們為遺體辦理入殮手續。
examples.english_sentence: At the funeral home, they handled the procedures to lay the body in the coffin.

mandarin_meaning: 殡仪；殯葬儀式或提供殯葬服務的場所
english_meaning: funeral rites / funeral services; funeral home (mortuary)
explanation_mandarin: 指與喪葬相關的儀式、服務或場所，例如殯儀館、殯儀服務等。
explanation_english: Refers to funeral rites, services, or places that provide such services (e.g., a funeral home or mortuary).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽過咗身，我哋要安排殯儀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 gwo3 zo2 san1, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 on1 paai4 ban3 ji4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媽媽過世了，我們要安排殯儀。
examples.english_sentence: My mother passed away; we need to arrange the funeral.

mandarin_meaning: 殯儀館（bìn yí guǎn）
english_meaning: funeral home; funeral parlor; mortuary
explanation_mandarin: 殯儀館是處理喪禮、遺體安置、化妝、告別儀式等事務的場所，通常由殯葬服務機構經營。
explanation_english: A funeral home is a facility that handles funeral services, care and temporary storage of the deceased, embalming/makeup, and memorial or farewell ceremonies; typically operated by a funeral service provider.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下晝要去殯儀館，幫阿伯送最後一程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 zau3 jiu3 heoi3 ban3 ji4 gun2, bong1 aa3 baak3 sung3 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們下午要去殯儀館，幫伯父送最後一程。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to the funeral home this afternoon to see Uncle off for the last time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 殯儀館外擺滿花圈，氣氛好嚴肅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ban3 ji4 gun2 ngoi6 baai2 mun5 faa1 hyun1, hei3 fan1 hou2 jim4 suk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 殯儀館外擺滿花圈，氣氛很嚴肅。
examples.english_sentence: The funeral home was lined with wreaths outside; the atmosphere was very solemn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 殯儀館通常會提供遺體安置、化妝同悼念場地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ban3 ji4 gun2 tung1 soeng4 wui5 tai4 gung1 wai4 tai2 on1 zi3, faa3 zong1 tung4 dou6 nim6 coeng4 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 殯儀館通常會提供遺體安置、化妝和悼念場所。
examples.english_sentence: A funeral home typically provides facilities for storing the deceased, preparing them (makeup/embalming), and spaces for memorial services.

jyutping: ban6 ji4 gun2 daai6 gaam2 gaa3
mandarin_meaning: 字面上指殯儀館大幅打折；俚語上用來幽默或諷刺地形容死亡、死傷或死亡率突然增加，像是殯儀館在特價一樣。
english_meaning: Literally 'funeral home big sale'; slang used humorously or sarcastically to say that many people are dying or that deaths have surged — as if funeral homes were having a massive discount. Can also be used literally.
explanation_mandarin: 常見於廣東話口語，帶有黑色幽默或諷刺意味，形容某段時間內死亡、嚴重事故或疫情導致的死亡/喪失現象變多。語境可為比喻或誇張，偶爾也可做字面意思使用。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang expression employing dark humor or sarcasm to describe a period with many deaths, serious accidents, or high mortality — as if funeral homes were offering big discounts. It is typically figurative and can sometimes be used literally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近車禍咁多，真係殯儀館大減價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 ce1 wo6 gam2 do1, zan1 hai6 ban6 ji4 gun2 daai6 gaam2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近車禍這麼多，真是殯儀館大減價。
examples.english_sentence: There have been so many car accidents lately — it's like funeral homes are having a huge sale.

mandarin_meaning: 殯殮（bìn liàn）：為死者處理入殮、洗殮、穿衣、安置棺柩等喪禮相關事務與儀式
english_meaning: To prepare the deceased for burial; funeral/mortuary rites such as washing, dressing, placing in a coffin, and related arrangements
explanation_mandarin: 殯殮指為亡者進行各項殯葬處理與儀式，包括入殮、洗殮、穿衣、安置棺木以及相關的辦理程序。
explanation_english: Refers to the mortuary procedures and funeral rites performed for a deceased person—such as washing and dressing the body, placing it in a coffin, and arranging funeral matters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿公啱啱過身，屋企而家搞緊殯殮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 gung1 aam1 aam1 gwo3 san1, uk1 kei5 ji4 gaa1 gaau2 gan2 ban3 lim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿公剛剛過世，家裡現在在辦理殯殮。
examples.english_sentence: My grandfather just passed away; the family is now arranging the funeral preparations.

mandarin_meaning: 殯葬（從事或處理喪葬、安葬、殯儀等事務）
english_meaning: funeral and burial; funeral services; mortuary services
explanation_mandarin: 指與喪葬、安葬、殯儀相關的事務或行業，包括辦理葬禮、遺體處理、安置等。
explanation_english: Refers to funerary practices and services related to death, including conducting funerals, burial arrangements, mortuary services, and the funeral industry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 殯葬期間，家屬需要聯絡殯儀館。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ban6 zong3 kei4 gaan1, gaa1 suk6 seoi1 jiu3 lyun4 lok3 ban6 ji4 gun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 殯葬期間，家屬需要聯絡殯儀館。
examples.english_sentence: During the funeral period, the family needs to contact the funeral parlor.

mandarin_meaning: 歼灭；消灭
english_meaning: to annihilate; to wipe out; to destroy completely
explanation_mandarin: 「殲」多用於合成詞「殲滅」，表示徹底消滅或消滅敵人，屬書面語，常見於軍事語境。
explanation_english: The character is mainly used in the compound '殲滅' meaning to annihilate or destroy completely. It is formal and commonly used in military contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 軍隊成功殲滅咗敵方基地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwan1 deoi6 sing4 gung1 zim1 mit6 zo2 dik6 fong1 gei1 dei6。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 军队成功歼灭了敌方基地。
examples.english_sentence: The army successfully annihilated the enemy base.

mandarin_meaning: 歼灭 (jiān miè)：消灭、彻底消除
english_meaning: annihilate; wipe out; destroy completely
explanation_mandarin: 表示把敵人、害蟲或其他事物完全消滅，常用於軍事或書面語境中，語氣較強烈。
explanation_english: Denotes completely destroying or eliminating something (e.g., enemy forces, pests). Often used in military or formal/written contexts; carries a strong sense of total eradication.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 軍隊最終成功殲滅敵軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwan1 deoi3 zeoi3 zung1 sing4 gung1 zim1 mit6 dik6 gwan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 军队最终成功歼灭了敌军。
examples.english_sentence: The army ultimately succeeded in annihilating the enemy forces.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要徹底殲滅害蟲，就要先搵到佢哋嘅窩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 cit3 dai2 zim1 mit6 hoi6 cung4, zau6 jiu3 sin1 wan2 dou3 keoi5 dei6 ge3 wo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要彻底歼灭害虫，就要先找到它们的巢穴。
examples.english_sentence: To completely eradicate the pests, you must first find their nests.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個病毒已經被徹底殲滅咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 beng6 duk6 ji5 ging1 bei6 cit3 dai2 zim1 mit6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个病毒已经被彻底歼灭了。
examples.english_sentence: The virus has already been completely eliminated.

mandarin_meaning: 歼灭战
english_meaning: annihilation battle; war/campaign aiming to destroy the enemy
explanation_mandarin: 指旨在徹底消滅或殲滅敵方軍隊或勢力的戰鬥或戰役，強調完全摧毀對方的作戰性質。
explanation_english: A battle or campaign aimed at annihilating the enemy; emphasizes completely destroying or eliminating opposing forces.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果今次真係打殲滅戰，目的就係徹底殲滅對方嘅軍隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 da2 zim1 mit6 zin3, muk6 dik1 zau6 hai6 cit3 dai2 zim1 mit6 deoi3 fong1 ge3 gwan1 deoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果这次真打的是歼灭战，目的就是彻底消灭对方的军队。
examples.english_sentence: If this really is an annihilation battle, the goal is to completely destroy the enemy's forces.

mandarin_meaning: 段（表示一段、片段、段落；也作量词，计量时间、路程、文字等）
english_meaning: section; segment; paragraph; a classifier/measure word for stretches, periods, or sections
explanation_mandarin: “段”可以作名词表示一段、一节或一片，也常作量词，用来计量时间（如一段时间）、路程（如一段路）、文字（如一段話）等。
explanation_english: “段” denotes a section or segment and is frequently used as a classifier to measure stretches of time, pieces of text, sections of road, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋行咗嗰段路就到啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haang4 zo2 go2 dyun6 lou6 zau6 dou3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们走那段路就到了。
examples.english_sentence: We'll arrive after walking that stretch of road.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要休息一段時間，唔好太辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 jau1 sik1 jat1 dyun6 si4 gaan3, m4 hou2 taai3 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要休息一段时间，不要太辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: You should rest for a while; don't push yourself too hard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢段對白好搞笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dyun6 deoi3 baak6 hou2 gaau2 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这段对白很搞笑。
examples.english_sentence: This bit of dialogue is very funny.

mandarin_meaning: 段落（文章的分段）；段、章节；也可指一段时间或一阶段
english_meaning: paragraph; section; a segment or phase
explanation_mandarin: 指文章中按內容劃分的段落，也可用來表示事件或時間的一段、階段。
explanation_english: Refers to a paragraph or section within a written text; can also denote a segment or phase of an event or period of time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇報告嘅段落要分清楚，咁先方便批改。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 bou3 gou3 ge3 dyun6 lok6 jiu3 fan1 cing1 co2, gam2 sin1 fong1 bin6 pai1 goi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这篇报告的段落要分清楚，这样才方便批改。
examples.english_sentence: The paragraphs in this report need to be clearly separated so it's easier to mark.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋講到故事入面一個重要嘅段落，令我好感動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gong2 dou3 gu3 si6 jap6 min6 jat1 go3 zung6 jiu3 ge3 dyun6 lok6, ling6 ngo5 hou2 gam2 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们提到故事里面一个重要的段落，让我很感动。
examples.english_sentence: They mentioned an important passage in the story that really moved me.

mandarin_meaning: 殷（yīn）：豐盛、殷勤、深厚，也作姓氏；殷商指商朝。
english_meaning: abundant; earnest/cordial; deep/profound; prosperous; a Chinese surname; (as in Yin/Shang dynasty)
explanation_mandarin: 「殷」常用於表示殷勤、殷切、殷實等，表示熱情、深厚或富足；亦為中文姓氏，並用於歷史名稱如殷商。
explanation_english: The character 殷 (jan1) is used to convey earnestness (e.g. 殷勤), profundity or abundance, and can mean prosperous or substantial. It is also a Chinese surname and appears in historical names like the Yin (Shang) dynasty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對客人好殷勤，成日幫手端茶倒水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Keoi5 deoi3 haak3 jan4 hou2 jan1 kan4, seng4 jat6 bong1 sau2 dyun1 caa4 dou2 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對客人很殷勤，經常幫忙端茶倒水。
examples.english_sentence: He is very attentive to guests, always helping to serve tea and pour water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 殷先生係我哋公司嘅創辦人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Jan1 sin1 saang1 hai6 ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 cong3 baan6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 殷先生是我們公司的創辦人。
examples.english_sentence: Mr. Yin is the founder of our company.

mandarin_meaning: 殷切（yīnqiè）：殷勤而迫切，形容期盼或關切的程度很深
english_meaning: eager; earnest; ardent; having a deep, urgent expectation or concern
explanation_mandarin: 表示熱切、殷切或迫切的期望與關心，常用於形容對某人或某事的深切期待或關注。
explanation_english: Expresses eager, earnest, or urgent expectation or concern. Often used to describe strong, heartfelt hopes or keen interest in someone or something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 家長對子女嘅前途抱有殷切嘅期望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa1 zoeng2 deoi3 zi2 neoi5 ge3 cin4 tou4 bou3 jau5 jan1 cit3 ge3 kei4 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家长对孩子的前途抱有殷切的期望。
examples.english_sentence: Parents have earnest expectations for their children's future.

mandarin_meaning: 殷勤：對人熱情、周到、殷勤地招待或照顧
english_meaning: attentive; solicitous; courteous and eager to please
explanation_mandarin: 表示對他人熱情周到、殷勤招待或關照，語氣可中性或帶有討好之意，視語境而定。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is warm, attentive, and solicitous in treating or looking after others; can be neutral or imply eagerness to please depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對客人好殷勤，成日招呼住我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 haak3 jan4 hou2 jan1 can4, sing4 jat6 ziu1 fu1 zyu6 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對客人很殷勤，總是招待我們。
examples.english_sentence: He is very solicitous toward guests and always attends to us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對我殷勤得有啲過份。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ngo5 jan1 can4 dak1 jau5 di1 gwo3 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對我殷勤得有點過分。
examples.english_sentence: He's being a bit too attentive toward me.

mandarin_meaning: 殷实（形容富裕、充实或家境稳定）
english_meaning: well-off; prosperous; substantial; financially secure
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容家庭、生活或經濟狀況比較寬裕、富足或穩定，亦可指事物內容充實。
explanation_english: Describes a family, lifestyle, or financial situation that is affluent, comfortable, or stable; can also mean that something is substantial or well-provided.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢屋企好殷實，平時無需為生計擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 uk1 kei2 hou2 jan1 sat6, ping4 si4 mou4 seoi1 wai6 saang1 gai3 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他家很殷实，平时不用为生计担心。
examples.english_sentence: His family is well-off; they don't usually have to worry about making a living.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢經濟穩定，生活殷實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging1 zai3 wan2 ding6, sang1 wut6 jan1 sat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经济稳定，生活殷实。
examples.english_sentence: His finances are stable and his life is comfortable.

mandarin_meaning: 杀 (shā) — 杀死、消灭；在口语中也可用于砍价、打发时间等用法（如“杀价”、“杀时间”）
english_meaning: to kill; to slaughter; to eliminate; (colloquial) to haggle/cut a price; to kill time
explanation_mandarin: 在廣東話中，「殺」(saat3) 主要作動詞，表示殺死或消滅。亦常見於合成詞與口語用法，如「殺價」（砍價、還價）、「殺時間」（打發時間）等。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '殺' (saat3) is primarily a verb meaning to kill or eliminate. It also appears in compounds and colloquial usages such as '殺價' (to haggle/cut a price) and '殺時間' (to kill time).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢被人殺咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei6 jan4 saat3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人杀了。
examples.english_sentence: He was killed by someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫可唔可以殺價？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 saat3 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服可以杀价吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you lower the price on this piece of clothing?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等巴士嘅時候，我用手機殺時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 baa1 si2 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 jung6 sau2 gei1 saat3 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等公交车的时候，我用手机打发时间。
examples.english_sentence: While waiting for the bus, I used my phone to kill time.

mandarin_meaning: 杀一儆百 (shā yī jǐng bǎi)
english_meaning: to punish one (person) as an example to warn many; to make an example of someone
explanation_mandarin: 指嚴懲一個人，以警戒或威懾其他人，達到震懾或警示作用。
explanation_english: Refers to severely punishing one person to warn or deter others; making an example of someone to achieve deterrence or admonition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方公開嚴懲嗰個貪污官，目的是殺一儆百，警告其他人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 gung1 hoi1 jim4 cing4 go2 go3 taam1 wu1 gun1, muk6 dik1 hai6 saat3 jat1 ging2 baak3, ging2 gou3 kei4 taa1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方公開嚴懲那名貪污官，目的是殺一儆百，警告其他人。
examples.english_sentence: The police publicly severely punished the corrupt official to make an example of him and warn others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司解僱咗嗰位經常遲到嘅職員，係想殺一儆百，督促其他同事準時返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 gaai2 gu3 zo2 go2 wai2 ging1 soeng4 ci4 dou3 ge3 zik1 jyun4, hai6 soeng2 saat3 jat1 ging2 baak3, duk1 cuk1 kei4 taa1 tung4 si6 zeon2 si4 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司解雇了那位經常遲到的職員，是想殺一儆百，督促其他同事準時上班。
examples.english_sentence: The company fired the employee who was often late to make an example of them and urge other colleagues to be punctual.

mandarin_meaning: 大量殺害（人）/ 大規模屠殺
english_meaning: to massacre; to slaughter people in large numbers; to kill mercilessly
explanation_mandarin: 「殺人如麻」原指像割麻一樣大量地殺人，現多用以形容大規模屠殺或造成大量死亡，有時也作誇張用法形容某事大量出現或造成大量損失。
explanation_english: Literally 'to kill people like hemp'; originally refers to slaughtering people in great numbers. Used to describe mass killings or events causing many deaths; can also be used hyperbolically to describe something occurring in great numbers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 戰爭期間，嗰啲軍隊殺人如麻，成條村都冇晒人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zin3 zang1 kei4 gaan1, go2 di1 gwan1 deoi2 saat3 jan4 jyu4 maa4, sing4 tiu4 cyun1 dou1 mou5 saai3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 戰爭期間，那些軍隊殺人如麻，整個村子都沒人了。
examples.english_sentence: During the war, those troops massacred people by the dozens; the whole village was emptied.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種病殺人如麻，醫院都爆滿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 beng6 saat3 jan4 jyu4 maa4, ji1 jyun2 dou1 baau3 mun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這種病殺人如麻，醫院都爆滿了。
examples.english_sentence: This disease is killing people by the dozens; the hospitals are all full.

mandarin_meaning: 殺人放火（字面為殺人和縱火），指極其惡劣的暴力犯罪；也可比喻嚴重、惡劣的行為
english_meaning: literally 'kill and set fire' (murder and arson); refers to extremely heinous violent crimes, or figuratively to very egregious/reckless actions
explanation_mandarin: 成語，原指實際的殺人和縱火等嚴重暴力犯罪，日常也用來比喻極端嚴重或惡劣的行為與行為人的無法無天。
explanation_english: An idiom literally meaning murder and arson. It denotes extremely serious crimes of violence and is also used figuratively to describe extremely egregious or lawless conduct.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲行為簡直係殺人放火，警方一定會嚴查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 hang4 wai6 gaan2 zik6 hai6 saat3 jan4 fong3 fo2, ging2 fong1 jat1 ding6 wui5 jim4 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些行為簡直是殺人放火，警方一定會嚴查。
examples.english_sentence: These actions are practically murder and arson; the police will definitely investigate thoroughly.

jyutping: saat3 jan4 fong3 fo2 gam1 jiu1 daai3
mandarin_meaning: 字面上是「殺人放火還戴着金腰帶」，比喻明明犯下嚴重或惡劣的行為，卻逍遙法外或反而被表彰、光鮮化，帶有諷刺和批評意味。
english_meaning: Literally 'kill people, set fires, golden waist belt'. A sarcastic phrase describing someone who commits serious wrongdoing yet remains unpunished or is paradoxically honored/celebrated — used to criticize hypocrisy or corruption.
explanation_mandarin: 常用來諷刺那些做了壞事卻不受懲罰、還得到獎賞或面子的人或組織；語氣多為批評或不滿。
explanation_english: Used sarcastically to ridicule people or institutions who do harmful or illegal things but avoid punishment or even receive honors; carries a critical, disapproving tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰位官員明明做咗犯法嘅事，仲獲獎，真係殺人放火金腰帶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 wai6 gun1 jyun4 ming4 ming4 zou6 zo2 faan6 fat6 ge3 si6, zung6 wok6 zoeng2, zan1 hai6 saat3 jan4 fong3 fo2 gam1 jiu1 daai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那位官員明明做了違法的事，還獲得獎項，真是殺人放火金腰帶。
examples.english_sentence: That official clearly committed illegal acts yet received an award — truly 'kill people, set fires, golden waist belt' (used sarcastically).

cantonese: 殺人放火金腰帶，修橋整路冇屍骸
jyutping: saat3 jan4 fong3 fo2 gam1 jiu1 daai3, sau1 kiu4 zing2 lou6 mou5 si1 hoi4
mandarin_meaning: 明目張膽作惡卻逍遙法外；有權有勢或被掩蓋而逃避責任
english_meaning: To brazenly commit serious wrongdoing and remain unpunished; to 'get away with murder' — enjoy impunity because of power, protection, or lack of evidence.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容有人犯下嚴重錯行或作惡，但因有權勢、包庇或證據被掩蓋而不受追究，帶有諷刺意味。
explanation_english: A Cantonese saying describing people who commit serious crimes openly yet evade punishment — often because of influence, protection, or absence of evidence. It is usually used sarcastically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔少貪官包庇，佢哋殺人放火金腰帶、修橋整路冇屍骸，點會被追究？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 siu2 taam1 gun1 baau1 bei6, keoi5 dei6 saat3 jan4 fong3 fo2 gam1 jiu1 daai3, sau1 kiu4 zing2 lou6 mou5 si1 hoi4, dim2 wui5 bei6 zeoi1 gau3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不少貪官包庇，他們明目張膽作惡卻逍遙法外，怎麼會被追究？
examples.english_sentence: Many corrupt officials shield them; they brazenly commit crimes and get away with it — how could they be held accountable?

mandarin_meaning: 杀人以灭口（为防止被揭发或泄密而杀害知情者）
english_meaning: to kill someone to silence them; murder to cover up or eliminate a witness
explanation_mandarin: 指為了防止被揭發、洩密或留下證據，而殺害知道內情或可能揭發的人，目的是封口滅跡。
explanation_english: Refers to killing someone to prevent them from revealing information or exposing a crime; to silence a witness by murder to cover up wrongdoing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗唔想俾人知真相，佢竟然殺人滅口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 m4 soeng2 bei2 jan4 zi1 zan1 soeng2, keoi5 ging2 jin4 saat3 jan4 mit6 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了不让别人知道真相，他竟然杀人灭口。
examples.english_sentence: To prevent others from learning the truth, he actually murdered to silence them.

mandarin_meaning: 殺人鯨（又稱虎鯨，學名逆戟鯨）
english_meaning: killer whale (orca)
explanation_mandarin: 一種大型齒鯨，俗稱殺人鯨或虎鯨，學名為逆戟鯨，是海洋中的頂級掠食者。名稱雖然聽起來兇猛，但牠們通常不會主動攻擊人類。
explanation_english: A large toothed whale commonly called the killer whale or orca (scientific name: Orcinus orca). It is an apex predator in the ocean. Despite the name, they generally do not attack humans unprovoked.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 海洋公園入面有隻殺人鯨表演，吸引咗唔少遊客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi2 joeng4 gung1 jyun4 jap6 min6 jau5 zek3 saat3 jan4 ging1 biu2 jin2, kap1 jan5 zo2 m4 siu2 jau4 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 海洋公園裡有一隻殺人鯨表演，吸引了不少遊客。
examples.english_sentence: There was a killer whale show at Ocean Park, which attracted many visitors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然叫殺人鯨，但係其實佢哋一般唔會主動攻擊人類。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 giu3 saat3 jan4 ging1, daan6 hai6 kei4 sat6 keoi5 dei6 jat1 baan1 m4 wui5 zyu2 dung6 gung1 gik1 jan4 leoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 雖然叫做殺人鯨，但其實牠們通常不會主動攻擊人類。
examples.english_sentence: Although they are called killer whales, they usually do not attack humans unprovoked.

mandarin_meaning: （口語/威脅）殺了你；（玩笑）我要殺了你（用作開玩笑或戲謔）
english_meaning: "I'll kill you" — can be a literal threat or a joking/teasing exclamation used among friends
explanation_mandarin: 「殺你」在廣東話中原指殺害對方，屬於嚴重的威脅語句；在口語和熟人之間亦常作戲謔或誇張式的抱怨（類似英語的 "I'll kill you!" 用於開玩笑）。視語境可為真實威脅或輕鬆玩笑，公開或正式場合不宜使用。
explanation_english: Literally means to kill someone. It can be used as a serious threat, but among friends it is often used jokingly or hyperbolically (similar to English "I'll kill you!"). Context determines whether it's playful or dangerous; avoid using it in formal or unfamiliar situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你食咗我個蛋糕？殺你呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sik6 zo2 ngo5 go3 daan6 gou1? saat3 nei5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你吃了我的蛋糕？我要殺了你！（這裡通常是開玩笑）
examples.english_sentence: You ate my cake? I'll kill you! (usually said jokingly)

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對住我講：「我要殺你！」，聽落好驚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 zyu6 ngo5 gong2: "ngo5 jiu3 saat3 nei5!", teng1 lok6 hou2 geng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對我說：「我要殺了你！」，聽起來很可怕。
examples.english_sentence: He said to me, "I'm going to kill you!" — it sounded scary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢句好嚴重，唔好隨便講「殺你」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ge3 hou2 jim4 zung6, m4 hou2 ceoi4 bin6 gong2 "saat3 nei5".
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這句話很嚴重，不要隨便說「殺你」。
examples.english_sentence: This phrase is serious — don't casually say "I'll kill you."

mandarin_meaning: 杀伤力 (shāshānglì)
english_meaning: lethality; killing power; destructive power; impact
explanation_mandarin: 表示武器、事件或因素造成伤害或破坏的能力；在比喻用法中也指某事物的冲击力或影响力。
explanation_english: Refers to the ability of a weapon, event, or factor to cause harm or destruction; figuratively, it can mean the impact or persuasive power of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢把槍嘅殺傷力好高，使用時要非常小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baa2 coeng1 ge3 saat3 soeng1 lik6 hou2 gou1, si6 jung6 si4 jiu3 fei1 soeng4 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这把枪的杀伤力很高，使用时要非常小心。
examples.english_sentence: This gun has high lethality; you must be very careful when using it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條廣告片嘅殺傷力好強，短時間內帶嚟好多訂單。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 gwong2 gou3 pin3 ge3 saat3 soeng1 lik6 hou2 koeng4, dyun2 si4 gaan1 noi6 daai3 lei4 hou2 do1 deng6 daan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条广告片的杀伤力很强，短时间内带来了很多订单。
examples.english_sentence: This advertisement is very impactful and quickly generated many orders.

mandarin_meaning: 砍價 / 討價還價
english_meaning: to bargain; to haggle (over price); to negotiate a lower price
explanation_mandarin: 指與商家討價還價，壓低價格或爭取折扣。
explanation_english: To negotiate with a seller to lower the price of goods or services, i.e., to haggle or get a discount.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺街市買魚時殺價，最後平咗十蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 gaai1 si5 maai5 jyu4 si4 saat3 gaa3, zeoi3 hau6 peng4 zo2 sap6 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在菜市場買魚時砍價，最後便宜了十塊。
examples.english_sentence: I haggled when buying fish at the market and ended up getting it ten dollars cheaper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買新電話嘅時候，你可以試下殺價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 san1 din6 waa2 ge3 si4 hau6, nei5 ho2 ji5 si3 haa5 saat3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 買新手機的時候，你可以試著砍價。
examples.english_sentence: When buying a new phone, you can try bargaining.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖頭唔鍾意畀人殺價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 m4 zung1 ji3 bei2 jan4 saat3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這家店不喜歡被人砍價。
examples.english_sentence: This shop doesn't like customers bargaining.

mandarin_meaning: 杀入 (shārù)：冲进、闯入；也指进入某个市场或领域
english_meaning: to rush into; to charge into; to break into (a place or market)
explanation_mandarin: 表示快速或强势地进入某个地方、场合或市场，既可指实际的冲进行为，也常用于比喻企业或个人迅速进入并占领某一领域或市场份额。
explanation_english: Indicates quickly or forcefully entering a place, scene, or market. Can describe a physical charge into a location or a company's aggressive entry into a market or field.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一聽到喊聲就即刻殺入間房救人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 teng1 dou3 haam3 sing1 zau6 zik1 hak1 saat3 jap6 gaan1 fong4 gau3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一听到哭声就立刻冲进房间救人。
examples.english_sentence: He rushed into the room immediately when he heard the crying to save someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間新公司短短幾個月已經殺入手機配件市場，搶咗唔少份額。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 san1 gung1 si1 dyun2 dyun2 gei2 go3 jyut6 ji5 ging1 saat3 jap6 sau2 gei1 pui3 gin6 si5 coeng4, coeng2 zo2 m4 siu2 fan6 ngok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家新公司短短几个月就已经杀入手机配件市场，抢占了不少份额。
examples.english_sentence: The new company rushed into the phone accessories market within a few months and grabbed a significant market share.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 音樂一開，大家就殺入舞池跳舞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jam1 ngok6 jat1 hoi1, daai6 gaa1 zau6 saat3 jap6 mou5 ci4 tiu3 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 音乐一开始，大家就冲入舞池跳舞。
examples.english_sentence: When the music started, everyone rushed onto the dance floor to dance.

jyutping: saat3 ceot1 go3 cing4 ngaau5 gam1
mandarin_meaning: （有人）突然出現並打亂局面／搗亂的人（源自歷史人物程咬金，泛指意外出現的麻煩或插入者）
english_meaning: someone who unexpectedly appears and disrupts things / an unanticipated interloper who complicates a situation
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語/口語 — 動詞片語（或名詞性用法，指突然出現的人）
partOfSpeech_english: idiom/slang — verb phrase (can be used nominally to refer to the unexpected person)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容某個人突如其來地出現，打斷或干擾原有計劃或討論，帶有意外插入、攪局的意思。
explanation_english: An idiom used to describe someone who unexpectedly appears and interrupts or complicates an ongoing plan or discussion — essentially an unanticipated troublemaker or interloper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋正討論緊點做，點知佢殺出個程咬金，提出一個完全唔同嘅方案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zing3 tou2 leon6 gan2 dim2 zou6, dim2 zi1 keoi5 saat3 ceot1 go3 cing4 ngaau5 gam1, tai4 ceot1 jat1 go3 jyun4 cyun4 m4 tung4 ge3 fong1 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们正在讨论要怎么做，没想到他突然杀出个程咬金，提出了一个完全不同的方案。
examples.english_sentence: We were discussing what to do when, unexpectedly, he showed up and proposed a completely different plan (i.e., he disrupted things).

mandarin_meaning: 冲过来 / 赶到 / 突然来到
english_meaning: to rush over; to arrive suddenly or in force; to descend upon
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，表示迅速赶到、冲过来或大量涌入某处，有时带有强烈、突如其来的意味。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase meaning to rush over, arrive suddenly, or descend upon a place (often with force or in numbers).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一聽到有折扣就即刻殺到嗰間舖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 teng1 dou3 jau5 zit3 hau3 zau6 zik1 hak1 saat3 dou3 go2 gaan1 pou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一听说有折扣就立刻冲到那间店。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as he heard about the discount, he rushed over to that store.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 暴雨殺到，快啲入屋！
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 jyu5 saat3 dou3, faai3 di1 jap6 uk1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 暴雨来了，快进屋！
examples.english_sentence: Heavy rain is coming — get inside quickly!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 派對啱啱開始，成班人已經殺到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: paai3 deoi6 ngaam1 ngaam1 hoi1 ci2, seng4 baan1 jan4 ji5 ging1 saat3 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 派对刚开始，一大群人已经赶来了。
examples.english_sentence: The party just started and a whole bunch of people have already shown up.

mandarin_meaning: 扑上来/凶猛逼近、靠近到身边（多指攻击、骚扰或强烈的接触/压力逼近）
english_meaning: to rush up to someone; to close in aggressively; to pounce on or press up against someone (figuratively: pressure closing in)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，形容人或事物迅速或猛烈地靠近到近身位置，常用來描述攻擊、騷擾、推銷或壓力迫近等情況。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese phrase meaning someone or something rushes up close aggressively. Often used to describe pouncing, harassing, pushy salespeople, or pressure/deadlines closing in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 推銷員不停殺到埋身，好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teoi1 siu1 jyun4 bat1 ting4 saat3 dou3 maai4 san1, hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 推销员不停地扑到我身边，真烦。
examples.english_sentence: The salesperson keeps pouncing on me — so annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 敵人殺到埋身，我哋要撤退。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dik6 jan4 saat3 dou3 maai4 san1, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 cit3 teoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 敌人冲到近身，我们要撤退。
examples.english_sentence: The enemy is closing in on us; we need to retreat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 截止日期殺到埋身，我仲未做完份報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gat1 zi2 jat6 kei4 saat3 dou3 maai4 san1, ngo5 zung6 mei6 zou6 jyun4 fan6 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 截止日期临近，我还没做完报告。
examples.english_sentence: The deadline is closing in and I haven't finished the report.

jyutping: saat3 gwan1 maa5 ze2 dou6 pong4 ji4
mandarin_meaning: 殺君馬者道旁兒（字面：在路旁殺君王的馬）——一個古語/諺語式的短語，用來形容犯下極大罪行、遭人唾棄、受公議的人（屬於罕見或已失傳的用法）
english_meaning: Literally “one who kills the ruler's horse by the roadside” — an archaic/obscure Cantonese phrase used figuratively to describe someone who commits an egregious offense and is publicly condemned.
explanation_mandarin: 此短語字面意為「在路邊殺君王的馬」，屬於古語或方言性表達，常用於比喻犯下大逆不道或罪大惡極之人，含貶義，現代粵語中少見，語感偏書面或古風。
explanation_english: The phrase literally says “to kill the ruler's horse at the roadside.” It is an archaic/obscure Cantonese expression used metaphorically for someone who has committed a grave, reprehensible act and is subject to public scorn. It carries a strongly negative connotation and is rarely used in modern Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做出嗰種背信棄義嘅事，喺我哋耳中根本就係殺君馬者道旁兒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 ceot1 go2 zung2 bui3 seon3 hei3 ji6 ge3 si6, hai2 ngo5 dei6 ji5 zung1 gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 saat3 gwan1 maa5 ze2 dou6 pong4 ji4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做出那種背信棄義的事，在我們耳裡根本就是殺君馬者道旁兒。
examples.english_sentence: What he did — such a treacherous act — to us he is basically a '殺君馬者道旁兒' (an egregious offender).

mandarin_meaning: 杀害，致人死亡（通常指故意或暴力行为）
english_meaning: to kill; to cause someone's death (often deliberately or violently)
explanation_mandarin: 表示使人或動物死亡，通常含有故意或暴力的意味，可用於法律或新聞語境中描述他殺行為。
explanation_english: Indicates causing the death of a person or animal, usually implying intentional or violent action; commonly used in legal or news contexts to describe homicide.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方懷疑死者係被人殺害。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 waai4 ji4 sei2 ze2 hai6 bei6 jan4 saat3 hoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方怀疑死者是被人杀害的。
examples.english_sentence: The police suspect the deceased was murdered.

mandarin_meaning: 杀戮（shālù）
english_meaning: slaughter; massacre; mass killing
explanation_mandarin: 常用於書面語，指大量或殘忍地殺害人或動物，強調暴力性與慘烈的結果。
explanation_english: A formal/literary term referring to killing on a large or brutal scale; emphasizes violence and the horrific nature of the acts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 戰爭只會帶來無盡嘅殺戮同痛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zin3 zeng1 zi2 wui5 daai3 loi4 mou4 zeon6 ge3 saat3 luk6 tung4 tung3 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 战争只会带来无尽的杀戮和痛苦。
examples.english_sentence: War only brings endless slaughter and suffering.

mandarin_meaning: 杀手（刺客、凶手）；在比喻用法中可指終結者或關鍵人物
english_meaning: assassin; killer; (figuratively) a finisher or decisive player/factor
explanation_mandarin: 「殺手」原指以殺人為職業的人（刺客、兇手），也常用作比喻，指在某領域具有決定性作用的人或招數，例如體育中的得分利器或商業中的致勝關鍵。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a person who kills for a living (an assassin or killer). It is also used figuratively to mean a decisive player or move (e.g., a team's finisher or a killer tactic).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係殺手，俾警方拘捕咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 saat3 sau2, bei2 ging2 fong1 kau1 bou6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是殺手，已被警方拘捕。
examples.english_sentence: He is an assassin; he has been arrested by the police.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個球員係球隊嘅殺手，入波好準。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 kau4 jyun4 hai6 kau4 deoi6 ge3 saat3 sau2, jap6 bo1 hou2 zeon2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這名球員是球隊的殺手，進球很準。
examples.english_sentence: This player is the team's killer (finisher); he's very accurate at scoring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電影入面嗰位反派係一個冷血殺手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 jing2 jap6 min6 go2 wai6 faan2 paai3 hai6 jat1 go3 laang5 hyut3 saat3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 電影裡面的反派是一個冷血的殺手。
examples.english_sentence: The villain in the movie is a cold-blooded assassin.

mandarin_meaning: 殺手锏；王牌；最後的制勝手段
english_meaning: a trump card; a secret weapon or decisive move used at a critical moment; last resort
explanation_mandarin: 指在關鍵時刻拿出來用以取勝或扭轉局勢的特殊手段或秘密武器，常用於比賽、談判或競爭的場景中。
explanation_english: Refers to a special tactic or secret weapon brought out at a crucial moment to win or turn the tide; commonly used in contexts like contests, negotiations, or competitions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺最後先出殺手鐧，結果贏咗場比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 zeoi3 hau6 sin1 ceot1 saat3 sau2 zin1, git3 gwo2 jing4 zo2 coeng4 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在最後才拿出殺手锏，結果贏了比賽。
examples.english_sentence: He only played his trump card at the end and ended up winning the match.

mandarin_meaning: 杀掉 (shā diào)：杀死、除掉；也可指终止、删除（如进程或檔案）
english_meaning: to kill; to eliminate; to get rid of; to terminate (e.g., a process or file)
explanation_mandarin: 表示把人或事物殺死或除去。在非字面語境也可指結束、終止或移除（例如殺掉一個進程、刪掉檔案）。口語與書面皆可使用。
explanation_english: Indicates killing or removing a person or thing. In non-literal contexts it can mean terminating or deleting (e.g., killing a process, removing a file). Usable in both spoken and written contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想殺掉嗰條蟲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 saat3 diu6 go2 tiu4 cung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想把那條蟲殺掉。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to kill that worm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個電腦程式我已經殺掉咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 din6 nou5 cing4 sik1 ngo5 ji5 ging1 saat3 diu6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個電腦程式我已經終止/刪除了。
examples.english_sentence: I've already killed/terminated that computer program.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電影入面嗰個壞人被人殺掉咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 jing2 jap6 min6 go2 go3 waai6 jan4 bei6 jan4 saat3 diu6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 電影裡面的壞人被人殺掉了。
examples.english_sentence: The villain in the movie was killed.

mandarin_meaning: 收攤／結束營業、提前停止（擺攤、擺賣）
english_meaning: to close up a stall; to stop selling/pack up (can also mean to call off or end an activity)
explanation_mandarin: 「殺攤」是香港粵語俗語，字面指把擺檔的攤子收起來，實際上常用來表示結束營業、提前收檔或取消某個活動、把一個安排提前終止。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang term literally meaning to take down a stall. It commonly means to close up a stall or stop trading early; figuratively it can mean to cancel or call off an event or end an activity early.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚街市生意太差，老闆決定殺攤，早啲收檔返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 gaai1 si5 saang1 ji3 taai3 caa1, lou5 baan2 kyut3 ding6 saat3 taan1, zou2 di1 sau1 dong2 faan1 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚菜市場生意太差，老闆決定收攤，早點收檔回家。
examples.english_sentence: Business at the market was terrible tonight; the boss decided to close the stall early and go home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為落雨，擺街頭嘅小販全部殺攤走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 lok6 jyu5, baai2 gaai1 tau4 ge3 siu2 faan6 cyun4 bou6 saat3 taan1 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因為下雨，擺在街頭的小販都收攤走了。
examples.english_sentence: Because of the rain, the street vendors all took down their stalls and left.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次個活動冇人嚟，唯有殺攤取消。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 go3 wut6 dung6 mou5 jan4 lai4, wai4 jau5 saat3 taan1 ceoi2 siu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次活動沒有人來，只好取消。
examples.english_sentence: No one showed up for the event, so we had to cancel it.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）關閉、裁撤或合併學校
english_meaning: Colloquial term meaning to close, shut down, or merge schools (often due to declining enrollment or resource reallocation).
explanation_mandarin: 「殺校」為香港粵語的口語用法，通常指因生源減少或資源調配而關閉、裁撤或將學校合併，亦可泛指學校停止辦學。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression referring to the closure, shutdown, or merger of schools, typically due to falling student numbers or resource reallocation; can also broadly mean discontinuing a school's operations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近因為少子化，好多學校都要被迫殺校或者合併。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 jan1 wai6 siu2 zi2 faa3, hou2 do1 hok6 haau6 dou1 jiu3 bei6 pok3 saat3 haau6 waak6 ze2 hap6 bing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近因為少子化，很多學校都被迫關閉或合併。
examples.english_sentence: Recently, because of declining birth rates, many schools have been forced to close or merge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰區有幾間小學話要被殺校，家長好擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 keoi1 jau5 gei2 gaan1 siu2 hok6 waa6 jiu3 bei6 saat3 haau6, gaa1 zoeng2 hou2 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那區有幾所小學說要被關閉，家長很擔心。
examples.english_sentence: Several primary schools in that district are said to be slated for closure; parents are very worried.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府推出新措施，目的係唔想再有殺校潮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 teoi1 ceot1 san1 co3 si3, muk6 dik1 hai6 m4 soeng2 zoi3 jau5 saat3 haau6 ciu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府推出新措施，目的是不希望再出現殺校潮。
examples.english_sentence: The government has launched new measures aimed at preventing another wave of school closures.

mandarin_meaning: 杀机 / 杀气，凶险或杀意
english_meaning: murderous intent; lethal threat; an atmosphere of imminent danger
explanation_mandarin: 指顯現出想殺人或有致命危險的氛圍或意圖，也可指有機會造成致命後果的情形。常見於形容人神情、環境或局勢的危險性。
explanation_english: Refers to a murderous intent or a lethal threat — an atmosphere suggesting imminent danger or a person's intent to kill. Often used to describe a person's look, an environment, or a dangerous situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢眼入面有殺機，望住佢我都覺得驚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaan5 jap6 min6 jau5 saat3 gei1, mong6 zyu6 keoi5 ngo5 dou1 gok3 dak1 geng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他眼神中帶著殺氣，看著他我都覺得害怕。
examples.english_sentence: There was murderous intent in his eyes; looking at him made me feel scared.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 對手身上散發住殺機，大家都提高警覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi3 sau2 san1 seong6 saan3 faat3 zyu6 saat3 gei1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 tai1 gou1 ging2 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 對手身上散發出殺氣，大家都提高警覺。
examples.english_sentence: The opponent gave off a murderous aura, so everyone tightened their guard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個地方殺機四伏，唔好單獨去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dei6 fong1 saat3 gei1 sei3 fuk1, m4 hou2 daan1 duk6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個地方殺機四伏，不要單獨前往。
examples.english_sentence: This place is full of deadly threats; don't go there alone.

mandarin_meaning: 杀死 (shāsǐ)
english_meaning: to kill; to cause someone or something to die
explanation_mandarin: 表示使生命終止，令某人或某生物死亡；在口語中亦可作誇張用法（如「熱到殺死人」表示非常熱）。
explanation_english: Means to cause someone or something to die. In colloquial usage it can also be used hyperbolically (e.g., "so hot it's killing people").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個兇手殺死咗佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 hung1 sau2 saat3 sei2 zo2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 兇手把他殺死了。
examples.english_sentence: The murderer killed him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人殺死咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 saat3 sei2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人殺死了。
examples.english_sentence: He was killed by someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今排熱到殺死人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 paai4 jit6 dou3 saat3 sei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近熱得要命。
examples.english_sentence: It's been so hot recently it's killing people.

mandarin_meaning: 杀气 (shāqì)：具有杀戮或威胁意味的气势、凶狠的样子
english_meaning: murderous aura; menacing/hostile vibe or aggressive intent
explanation_mandarin: 指一種讓人感到威脅、凶狠或想要傷人的氣勢，也可用來形容緊張、對抗性的氛圍或態度。
explanation_english: Refers to an intimidating, aggressive, or murderous-looking aura—used to describe a person's fierce appearance or a hostile, tense atmosphere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢面色好兇，好有殺氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 min6 sik1 hou2 hung1, hou2 jau5 saat3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他面色很凶，很有杀气。
examples.english_sentence: His face looks fierce; he gives off a murderous aura.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰班人講嘢好有殺氣，氣氛好緊張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 baan1 jan4 gong2 je5 hou2 jau5 saat3 hei3, hei3 fan1 hou2 gan2 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那群人說話很有殺氣，氣氛很緊張。
examples.english_sentence: Those people sounded menacing; the atmosphere was tense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢上場之後變得好有殺氣，對手好難頂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng5 coeng4 zi1 hau6 bin3 dak1 hou2 jau5 saat3 hei3, deoi3 sau2 hou2 naan4 deng2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他上場之後變得很有殺氣，對手很難應付他。
examples.english_sentence: He became very aggressive after entering the game; opponents found him hard to handle.

mandarin_meaning: （形容）充滿殺氣、兇狠的氣勢或樣子
english_meaning: filled with murderous intent; menacing; having a fierce or hostile air
explanation_mandarin: 「殺氣騰騰」用來形容人或場面帶有強烈的敵意、兇相或威脅性的氣勢，常表示對方看起來很可怕或很有攻擊性。
explanation_english: Used to describe a person or scene that gives off a strong sense of hostility or threat—appearing fierce, menacing, or full of murderous intent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日對住同事擺出一副殺氣騰騰嘅樣，搞到大家都唔敢靠近。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 deoi3 zyu6 tung4 si6 baai2 ceot1 jat1 fu3 saat3 hei3 tang4 tang4 ge3 joeng6, gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 gam2 kaau3 gan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常對著同事擺出一副殺氣騰騰的樣子，把大家都嚇得不敢靠近。
examples.english_sentence: He often puts on a menacing, murderous expression towards his colleagues, making everyone too afraid to approach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 球賽入面，對手殺氣騰騰，踢得又急又狠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kau4 coi3 jap6 min6, deoi3 sau2 saat3 hei3 tang4 tang4, tek3 dak1 jau6 gap1 jau6 han2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 比賽中，對手殺氣騰騰，踢得又急又狠。
examples.english_sentence: During the match, the opponents were full of murderous intent, playing intensely and ruthlessly.

mandarin_meaning: 搭訕 / 調情
english_meaning: to hit on someone; to pick up (romantically) — slang
explanation_mandarin: 香港廣東話俗語，指在公共場合（例如酒吧、夜店）以輕佻或主動的方式搭訕異性，帶有調情或嘗試勾搭的意思。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang term meaning to hit on or pick up someone (usually in places like bars or clubs), implying flirting or trying to seduce.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你又去殺波啦？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau6 heoi3 saat3 bo1 laa1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你又去搭訕了嗎？
examples.english_sentence: You went to hit on people again?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日去酒吧殺波，搵唔到正經嘅女朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 heoi3 zau2 baa1 saat3 bo1, wan2 m4 dou2 zeng3 ging1 ge3 neoi5 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是在酒吧搭訕，找不到正經的女朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He always hits on girls at bars and can't find a proper girlfriend.

mandarin_meaning: 杀生
english_meaning: to kill living beings; to take life; to slaughter
explanation_mandarin: 指杀害生命，尤指杀动物或伤害众生；在佛教语境中属于不善、违戒的行为。
explanation_english: Refers to killing living creatures, especially animals; in a Buddhist context it is considered an unwholesome or sinful act (taking life).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔食肉，話係因為唔想殺生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 sik6 juk6, waa6 hai6 jan1wai6 m4 soeng2 saat3 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不吃肉，说是因为不想杀生。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't eat meat, saying it's because he doesn't want to kill living beings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺佛教度，殺生係大罪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 fat6 gaau3 dou6, saat3 saang1 hai6 daai6 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在佛教里，杀生是大罪。
examples.english_sentence: In Buddhism, killing is a grave sin.

mandarin_meaning: 除草劑；用來殺死雜草的藥水
english_meaning: weedkiller; herbicide (liquid)
explanation_mandarin: 指用來殺死雜草的化學藥水或液劑，通常有一定毒性，使用時要小心，避免污染環境或直接接觸皮膚、吸入。
explanation_english: A chemical liquid used to kill weeds (a weedkiller/herbicide). It is often toxic and should be handled carefully to avoid environmental contamination or direct skin contact and inhalation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢樽殺草水係咪好毒㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung1 saat3 cou2 seoi2 hai6 mai6 hou2 duk6 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這瓶殺草水是不是很毒？
examples.english_sentence: Is this bottle of weedkiller very toxic?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 用殺草水要戴手套同口罩，唔好畀佢接觸到皮膚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jung6 saat3 cou2 seoi2 jiu3 daai3 sau2 tou3 tung4 hau2 zaau3, m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 zip3 zuk1 dou3 pei4 fu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 使用殺草水要戴手套和口罩，不要讓它接觸皮膚。
examples.english_sentence: When using weedkiller, wear gloves and a mask; don't let it touch your skin.

mandarin_meaning: 杀菌 (shājūn)
english_meaning: to sterilize; to kill bacteria/germs
explanation_mandarin: 指用熱、化學或其他方法殺死或去除細菌、微生物，以保持衛生或防止感染。
explanation_english: To kill or remove bacteria/microorganisms using heat, chemicals, or other methods to maintain hygiene or prevent infection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 沖奶之後要用熱水殺菌奶樽，先至可以安心畀BB飲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cung1 naai5 zi1 hau6 jiu3 jung6 jit6 seoi2 saat3 gwan1 naai5 zyun1, sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 on1 sam1 bei2 BB jam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 冲奶之后要用热水给奶瓶杀菌，这样才能放心让宝宝喝。
examples.english_sentence: After preparing formula, you should sterilize the baby bottle with hot water so you can safely let the baby drink.

mandarin_meaning: 殺蟲劑
english_meaning: insecticide (pesticide used to kill or repel insects)
explanation_mandarin: 殺蟲劑是用來殺滅或驅除害蟲的化學物質或配方，常用於農業、家庭或公共衛生，但使用時需注意安全與環境影響。
explanation_english: An insecticide: a chemical substance or formulation used to kill or repel insects. Commonly used in agriculture, households, and public health; requires careful handling due to safety and environmental concerns.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天蚊多，記得用殺蟲劑噴下屋企四圍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 man1 do1, gei3 dak1 jung6 saat3 cung4 zai1 pan3 haa6 uk1 kei2 sei3 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天蚊子多，記得在家裡四處噴撒殺蟲劑。
examples.english_sentence: There are many mosquitoes in summer; remember to spray insecticide around the house.

mandarin_meaning: 杀虫剂；杀虫水（用于杀灭昆虫的液体或喷雾）
english_meaning: insecticide; bug spray (a liquid or spray used to kill insects)
explanation_mandarin: 指用来杀死或驱除昆虫的液体或喷雾，常用于家庭或室内除虫。
explanation_english: Refers to a liquid or spray used to kill or repel insects, commonly used for household pest control.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企有支殺蟲水，幫我噴吓啲蚊得唔得？
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei5 jau5 zi1 saat3 cung4 seoi2, bong1 ngo5 pan3 haa5 di1 man1 dak1 m4 dak1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家裡有一罐殺蟲水，可以幫我噴一下那些蚊子嗎？
examples.english_sentence: There's a can of bug spray at home — can you spray those mosquitoes for me?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隔離間房有好多蟲，我買咗支殺蟲水嚟噴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaak3 lei4 gaan1 fong2 jau5 hou2 do1 cung4, ngo5 maai5 zo2 zi1 saat3 cung4 seoi2 lei4 pan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 隔壁房間有很多蟲，我買了一罐殺蟲水來噴。
examples.english_sentence: The next room has a lot of insects, so I bought a bottle of insecticide to spray.

mandarin_meaning: 取消預訂
english_meaning: to cancel a reservation/booking (usually colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語，指取消已經預約或訂位／訂貨，常用於餐廳、訂位或訂貨情況，有時暗含臨時爽約或放人鴿子的意思。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial verb meaning to cancel an existing reservation or order (e.g., a table booking or an order). Often used in hospitality contexts and can imply a last-minute cancellation or standing someone up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好殺訂喇，我已經幫你安排咗位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 saat3 ding6 laa3, ngo5 ji5 ging1 bong1 nei5 on1 paai4 zo2 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要取消預訂了，我已經替你安排了座位。
examples.english_sentence: Don't cancel the reservation — I've already arranged the seats for you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日無故殺訂，搞到餐廳好頭痕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 mou4 gu3 saat3 ding6, gaau2 dou3 caan1 teng1 hou2 tau4 han4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們經常無故取消預訂，弄得餐廳很頭疼。
examples.english_sentence: They often cancel reservations for no reason, causing the restaurant a lot of trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你殺訂，老闆可能會收你罰款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 saat3 ding6, lou5 baan2 ho2 nang4 wui5 sau1 nei5 fat6 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你取消預訂，老闆可能會收你罰款。
examples.english_sentence: If you cancel the booking, the owner might charge you a penalty.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）挑起爭端、激起情緒、開始激烈競爭或爭吵
english_meaning: colloquial/slang: to get fired up — to pick a fight, start an argument, become provoked, or become intensely competitive/aggressive
explanation_mandarin: 「殺起」為廣東話口語/俚語，常用來形容某人被激怒或被挑釁而開始爭吵、鬥氣或反擊；亦可指因情緒高漲而投入激烈競爭或行動。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang verb meaning to get worked up or fired up — typically to start an argument, pick a fight, react angrily when provoked, or to become intensely competitive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋為咗啲細事殺起嚟鬥嘴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 wai6 zo2 di1 sai3 si6 saat3 hei2 lai4 dau3 zeoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们為了些小事吵起來/吵架。
examples.english_sentence: They started arguing over those small things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好殺起我喇，我真係唔想理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 saat3 hei2 ngo5 laa3, ngo5 zan1 hai6 m4 soeng2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別惹我了，我真的不想理會。
examples.english_sentence: Don't provoke me — I really don't want to deal with it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 比賽一開始，佢就殺起嚟拼命追分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 coi3 jat1 hoi1 ci2, keoi5 zau6 saat3 hei2 lai4 ping3 ming6 zeoi1 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 比賽一開始，他就開始拼命搶分/追分。
examples.english_sentence: Once the match started, he got fired up and desperately chased points.

mandarin_meaning: 杀身之祸 (拼音：shā shēn zhī huò) — 指导致自己丧命或招致致命灾祸
english_meaning: A calamity that brings death upon oneself; a life‑threatening disaster
explanation_mandarin: 常用的成語，表示會使人喪命或招來極為嚴重的災禍。多見於書面語或古文用法。
explanation_english: An idiomatic expression referring to a disaster or misfortune that could cause one's death; often used in literary or formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔小心捲入黑幫恩怨，最後惹到殺身之禍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 siu2 sam1 gyun2 jap6 hak1 bong1 jan1 jyun3, zeoi6 hau6 je5 dou3 saat3 san1 zi1 wo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不小心捲入黑幫恩怨，最後惹上了殺身之禍。
examples.english_sentence: He accidentally got involved in gang feuds and ultimately incurred a calamity that could cost him his life.

mandarin_meaning: 為了正義或崇高理想而犧牲自己，甘願捨身
english_meaning: to sacrifice one's life for a righteous cause; to die for one's principles
explanation_mandarin: 指為了正義、道義或崇高理想，願意犧牲自己的生命或利益，成全大義。
explanation_english: Refers to willingly sacrificing one's life or interests for justice, morality, or a noble ideal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗保護村民，甘願殺身成仁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai4 zo2 bou2 wu6 cyun1 man4, gam1 jyun6 saat3 san1 sing4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為了保護村民，甘願殺身成仁。
examples.english_sentence: He was willing to sacrifice his life to protect the villagers.

mandarin_meaning: 殺錯良民 / 誤殺無辜、誤傷或錯誤懲罰無辜的人
english_meaning: to kill or punish the wrong innocent person; to mistakenly harm or blame an innocent party
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指誤殺或誤傷本為良民的人。常用於描述誤判、誤傷無辜或錯誤牽連他人的情況；在粵語口語與網絡語境亦可作比喻用法，表示冤枉或錯誤懲罰無辜者。
explanation_english: Literally 'kill the wrong good citizen'. Used to describe mistakenly killing, injuring, or punishing an innocent person. In Cantonese speech and online usage it can also be used metaphorically to mean wrongfully blaming or scapegoating an innocent party.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新聞報道話有警察誤殺咗一個無辜市民，真係殺錯良民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 man4 bou3 dou6 waa6 jau5 ging2 caat3 ng6 saat3 zo2 jat1 go3 mou4 gu1 si5 man4, zan1 hai6 saat3 co3 loeng4 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新闻报道说有警察误杀了一名无辜市民，真是殺錯良民。
examples.english_sentence: The news reports that police mistakenly killed an innocent civilian — that's really killing the wrong innocent person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司唔好為咗掩飾過失而殺錯良民，應該先查清楚再決定責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 m4 hou2 wai6 zo2 jim2 sik1 gwo3 sat1 ji4 saat3 co3 loeng4 man4, jing1 goi1 sin1 caa4 ceng1 co2 zoi3 kyut3 ding6 zaak3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司不要为了掩饰过失而冤枉好人，應該先查清楚再決定責任。
examples.english_sentence: The company shouldn't punish an innocent person to cover up mistakes — they should investigate thoroughly before assigning blame.

mandarin_meaning: 杀鸡儆猴
english_meaning: to punish someone as an example to warn others; to make an example of
explanation_mandarin: 比喻以處罰一個人來警告其他人，達到威懾或震懾的效果。
explanation_english: A metaphor for punishing one person as an example to warn others, intended to deter or intimidate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆公開炒咗阿強，係想殺雞儆猴，嚇怕其他員工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 gung1 hoi1 caau2 zo2 aa3 koeng4, hai6 soeng2 saat3 gai1 ging2 hau4, haak3 paa3 kei4 taa1 jyun4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板公开炒掉阿强，是想杀鸡儆猴，吓唬其他员工。
examples.english_sentence: The boss publicly fired Ah Keung to make an example of him — to scare the other employees.

mandarin_meaning: 杀鸡取卵（为了眼前利益而牺牲长远利益）
english_meaning: To sacrifice long-term benefits for short-term gain; a short-sighted, self-defeating action.
explanation_mandarin: 形容為了眼前或短期利益，採取損害根本或長遠利益的做法，短視且往往得不償失。
explanation_english: An idiom describing behavior that harms fundamental or long-term interests in pursuit of immediate or short-term gains; short-sighted and often counterproductive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗賺短期嘅錢，公司裁員減少研發，真係殺雞取卵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 zaan6 dyun2 kei4 ge3 cin2, gung1 si1 coi4 jyun4 gaam2 siu2 jin4 faat3, zan1 hai6 saat3 gai1 ceoi2 lyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了赚短期的钱，公司裁员减少研发，真是杀鸡取卵。
examples.english_sentence: To make short-term money, the company laid off staff and cut R&D — it's really killing the chicken to get the eggs.

jyutping: saat3 gai1 jin1 jung6 ngau4 dou1
mandarin_meaning: 杀鸡焉用牛刀（shā jī yān yòng niú dāo）：用大材来办小事，比喻不必用过大的力量或复杂的方法来处理小事；小题大做。
english_meaning: Literally 'why use a butcher's knife to kill a chicken' — to use excessive means or resources for a trivial task; overkill, making a mountain out of a molehill.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻處理簡單或小事時，不需要用過於龐大、複雜或昂貴的手段，意指小題大做或大材小用。
explanation_english: An idiom advising against using excessive force, resources, or complicated methods for a simple matter — essentially 'don't overdo it' or 'don't use a sledgehammer to crack a nut.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件小事，殺雞焉用牛刀啦，唔使搞到咁複雜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 siu2 si6, saat3 gai1 jin1 jung6 ngau4 dou1 laa1, m4 sai2 gaau2 dou3 gam2 fuk1 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件小事，殺雞焉用牛刀啦，沒必要搞得那麼複雜。
examples.english_sentence: This is a minor matter — no need to use a sledgehammer to crack a nut; don't make it so complicated.

mandarin_meaning: （1）电影或电视剧拍摄完成，杀青（收工、封镜）；（2）制茶工序中使茶叶停止发酵的“杀青”步骤。
english_meaning: (1) (Slang) to wrap up filming / finish shooting (a movie/TV show); (2) (Tea processing) the fixation step that stops tea fermentation.
explanation_mandarin: 在香港粵語中，『殺青』常作俗語，表示電影或劇集完成拍攝（相當於『封棚』『收工』）。另外在茶葉製作中，『殺青』指用高溫使茶葉中的酵素失去活性以停止發酵的處理步驟。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '殺青' is commonly used as slang in the film/TV industry to mean 'wrap up filming' (similar to '封棚' or 'finish work'). Separately, in tea production '殺青' (kill-green/fixation) refers to the step of applying heat to stop enzymatic oxidation of tea leaves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電影終於殺青啦，今晚要慶祝！
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 jing2 zung1 jyu1 saat3 cing1 laa1, gam1 maan5 jiu3 hing3 zuk1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 電影終於殺青了，今晚要慶祝！
examples.english_sentence: The movie finally wrapped; we should celebrate tonight!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 綠茶要經過殺青呢個步驟，先至可以停止發酵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: luk6 caa4 jiu3 ging1 gwo3 saat3 cing1 ni1 go3 bou6 zou6, sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 ting4 zi2 faat3 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 绿茶要经过杀青这个步骤，才能停止发酵。
examples.english_sentence: Green tea must go through the 'kill-green' (fixation) step to stop fermentation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個月加埋兩日班應該就可以殺青喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 jyut6 gaa1 maai4 loeng5 jat6 baan1 jing1 goi1 zau6 ho2 ji5 saat3 cing1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個月多加兩天班應該就能殺青了。
examples.english_sentence: If we add two more days of work this month, we should be able to wrap (filming).

mandarin_meaning: 杀头；处以死刑（斩首）
english_meaning: to behead; to execute by beheading; (colloquial) to face severe punishment or used hyperbolically to mean 'even if it kills me'
explanation_mandarin: 「殺頭」原指斬首或以死刑處決。口語中也可作誇張用法，表示會遭受嚴重懲罰或強調決心（如「就算殺頭我都要…」）。
explanation_english: Literally means to be beheaded or executed. In colloquial use it can mean to suffer severe punishment or be used hyperbolically to emphasize determination (e.g. "even if it kills me").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢犯咗重罪，可能會被殺頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faan6 zo2 cung4 zeoi6, ho2 nang4 wui5 bei6 saat3 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他犯了重罪，可能會被處以死刑（斬首）。
examples.english_sentence: He committed a serious crime and might be executed (beheaded).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 就算殺頭，我都要幫你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zau6 syun3 saat3 tau4, ngo5 dou1 jiu3 bong1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 就算被處死，我也要幫你。
examples.english_sentence: Even if it means I'm executed, I'll still help you.

mandarin_meaning: 搶食；搶先吃或霸佔他人的食物/機會
english_meaning: to snatch or hog food; to take someone else's portion or opportunity (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俗語，指搶奪別人的食物或搶先佔有機會，含有霸佔／搶吃的意思。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang verb meaning to snatch or hog food, or more generally to take someone else's portion or preempt their opportunity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好殺我啲蛋糕呀，我仲未食！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 saat3 ngo5 dik1 daan6 gou1 aa3, ngo5 zung6 mei6 sik6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把我的蛋糕搶走，我還沒吃！
examples.english_sentence: Don't take my cake — I haven't eaten yet!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺公司殺食，食晒大家啲零食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 gung1 si1 saat3 sik6, sik6 saai3 daai6 gaa1 dik1 ling4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常在公司搶食，把大家的零食吃光了。
examples.english_sentence: He always hogs the snacks at the office and eats everyone's treats.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去自助餐要有秩序，唔好亂咁殺食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 zi6 zo6 caan1 jiu3 jau5 zat6 seoi6, m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 saat3 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去自助餐要有秩序，不要亂搶食。
examples.english_sentence: At a buffet be orderly — don't just grab food crazily.

mandarin_meaning: 殺死馬；（比喻）終止、取消（計畫、活動等）
english_meaning: to put a horse to death; (figurative) to kill/terminate or cancel something (e.g., a plan or project)
explanation_mandarin: 原意為把馬殺死（如出於人道安樂死或處理病馬），引申用法可指突然終止或取消某事（如計劃、案子）。
explanation_english: Literally to kill a horse (e.g., euthanize a sick horse). Figuratively used to mean abruptly terminating or cancelling something, such as a project or plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢匹馬病得好嚴重，獸醫話要殺馬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pik1 maa5 beng6 dak1 hou2 jim4 zung6, sou3 ji1 waa6 jiu3 saat3 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這匹馬病得很嚴重，獸醫說要安樂死。
examples.english_sentence: The horse was very ill; the vet said it had to be put down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個計劃畀老闆殺馬咗，唔使再做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 gai3 waak6 bei6 lou5 baan2 saat3 maa5 zo2, m4 sai2 zoi6 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個計畫被老闆取消了，不用再做。
examples.english_sentence: The project was killed by the boss; there's no need to continue.

mandarin_meaning: 殺雞儆猴（比喻懲罰少數人以警告或震懾其他人）
english_meaning: To punish one as a warning to others; 'kill the chicken to scare the monkey' (punish an individual to deter others).
partOfSpeech_english: idiom (can function as a verb phrase)
explanation_mandarin: 用懲罰一個人或處罰個別事件來警示或震懾其他人，達到威懾效果。
explanation_english: To punish or make an example of someone in order to warn or deter others; using one person's punishment as a warning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司為咗嚇住其他員工，公開炒走咗嗰個人，真係殺鷄儆猴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 wai6 zo2 haak3 zyu6 kei4 taa1 jyun4 gung1, gung1 hoi1 caau2 zau2 zo2 go2 go3 jan4, zan1 hai6 saat3 gai1 ging2 hau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司為了震懾其他員工，公開開除了那個人，真是殺雞儆猴。
examples.english_sentence: The company publicly fired that employee to scare the others — it was really 'killing the chicken to warn the monkey.'

mandarin_meaning: 殺雞取卵（比喻為了眼前小利，犧牲長遠或根本的利益）
english_meaning: To kill the chicken to get the eggs — to sacrifice long-term benefits for short-term gain; short-sighted and self-defeating
explanation_mandarin: 比喻為了眼前的一點好處而採取會損害長遠利益或根本利益的做法，短視、得不償失。
explanation_english: A metaphor meaning to pursue immediate, small gains at the expense of long-term or fundamental benefits — a short-sighted, self-defeating action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋為咗即刻賺啲錢而削減研發預算，真係殺雞取卵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 wai6 zo2 zik1 haak1 zaan6 di1 cin2 ji4 zoek3 gam2 jin4 faat3 jyu6 syun3 , zan1 hai6 saat3 gai1 ceoi2 lyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們為了眼前的利益削減研發預算，真是殺雞取卵。
examples.english_sentence: They cut R&D budgets to make quick money — that's really killing the chicken to get the eggs (short-sighted and self-defeating).

jyutping: saat3 gai1 jin1 jung6 ngau4 dou1
mandarin_meaning: 殺雞焉用牛刀（不必用大的力量或方法去處理小事）
english_meaning: Don't use a sledgehammer to crack a nut; don't use excessive means or resources for a trivial task.
explanation_mandarin: 此成語出自古文，比喻用不相稱的手段或過大的力量去處理小事，表示浪費或不必要。
explanation_english: This idiom metaphorically advises against employing disproportionate methods or excessive force for minor matters — it implies wastefulness or unnecessary effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事好簡單，殺鷄焉用牛刀嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 hou2 gaan2 daan1, saat3 gai1 jin1 jung6 ngau4 dou1 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事很簡單，殺雞焉用牛刀嘛。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is very simple — no need to use a big tool to kill a chicken (i.e., don't go overboard).

mandarin_meaning: 壳（外壳、皮、外层）
english_meaning: shell; husk; outer covering; (figuratively) empty shell
explanation_mandarin: 表示物體的外殼或外層，可指蛋殼、蝦殼、殼狀保護層；也可作比喻，指空洞無內容的外表或組織。
explanation_english: Refers to the outer covering of an object (e.g., egg shell, shrimp shell, protective casing); can also be used figuratively to mean an empty shell or hollow exterior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻蛋個殻好薄，要細心啲，唔好打爛佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 daan6 go3 hok3 hou2 bok6, jiu3 sai3 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 daa2 laan6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个蛋的壳很薄，要小心点，不要把它打破。
examples.english_sentence: The shell of this egg is thin; be careful not to break it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔鍾意食蝦殼，食之前會先剝咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 sik6 haa1 hok3, sik6 zi1 cin4 wui5 sin1 baau1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不喜欢吃虾壳，吃之前会先剥掉。
examples.english_sentence: I don't like eating shrimp shells; I peel them off before eating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司換咗管理層，呢間公司而家淨係得個殻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 wun6 zo2 gun2 lei5 cang4, ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ji4 gaa1 zing6 hai6 dak1 go3 hok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司换了管理层，这家公司现在只剩下一个空壳。
examples.english_sentence: After changing management, the company is now just an empty shell.

mandarin_meaning: 壳 (ké)：指物体的外层或硬壳，如蛋壳、贝壳等。
english_meaning: Shell; the hard outer covering or casing of an object (e.g., eggshell, nutshell, seashell).
explanation_mandarin: 指覆盖在物体表面的硬质或半硬质保护层，可以指蛋壳、果壳、贝壳等，也可引申为外壳、外层或包装。
explanation_english: Refers to a hard or semi-hard protective outer layer of an object (such as an eggshell, nutshell, or seashell). It can also be used figuratively for an outer casing or covering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻蝸牛有個硬殼，可以保護佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 wo1 ngau4 jau5 go3 ngaang6 hok3, ho2 ji5 bou2 wu6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 蜗牛有一个硬壳，可以保护它。
examples.english_sentence: The snail has a hard shell that can protect it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個蛋殼好薄，小心啲唔好打爛咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 daan6 hok3 hou2 bok6, siu2 sam1 di1 m4 hou2 daa2 laan6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 蛋壳很薄，小心别弄碎了。
examples.english_sentence: The eggshell is thin; be careful not to break it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電話個外殼已經裂咗，要換殼啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 waa2 go3 ngoi6 hok3 ji5 ging1 lit3 zo2, jiu3 wun6 hok3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 手机的外壳已经裂了，要换壳了。
examples.english_sentence: The phone's outer shell is already cracked; it needs a new case.

mandarin_meaning: 殼公司（沒有實質業務或資產的上市公司）的股票；空殼股
english_meaning: shell stock — shares of a shell company (a listed company with little or no real business or assets)
explanation_mandarin: 指那些名存實亡或主要用作借殼、投機的上市公司所發行的股票，通常缺乏實際業務或資產。
explanation_english: Refers to shares of listed companies that have little or no real business or assets; often used for backdoor listings, speculation, or as takeover targets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間公司都係殼股，冇實際業務，只係俾人用嚟借殼或炒作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 gung1 si1 dou1 hai6 hok3 gu2, mou5 sat6 zai3 jip6 mou6, zi2 hai6 bei2 jan4 jung6 lai4 ze3 hok3 wo6 caau2 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那間公司只是殼公司，沒有實際業務，只是被人用來借殼或炒作。
examples.english_sentence: That company is just a shell stock — it has no real business and is only used by others for backdoor listings or speculation.

mandarin_meaning: （文言）混杂、混合、紊乱（罕用）
english_meaning: archaic verb meaning to mix together; to be in disorder or confused
explanation_mandarin: 殽為一個較為罕見的漢字，古書中可見，常用以表示混雜、混合或紊亂的狀態，現代漢語中很少單獨使用。
explanation_english: 殽 is a rare, archaic Chinese character found in classical texts, typically used to denote mixing, mingling, or a state of disorder. It is seldom used in modern speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個字「殽」好少用，意思係混雜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi6 'jiu4' hou2 siu2 jung6, ji3 si1 hai6 wan6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个字“殽”很少用，意思是混杂。
examples.english_sentence: The character "殽" is rarely used; it means mixed or chaotic.

mandarin_meaning: 弄得一團糟；混亂
english_meaning: a complete mess; to make a mess; chaotic
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語詞，表示把事情弄得很亂或處於混亂狀態，也可形容現場或狀況很混亂。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term meaning to make a mess or to be in a chaotic, muddled state. Can describe an action (to mess something up) or the resulting condition (a mess).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝個辦公室殽框晒，啲文件搵唔返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 go3 baan6 gung1 sat1 haau4 kwaang1 saai3, di1 man4 gin2 wan2 m4 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上辦公室一團糟，文件找不到了。
examples.english_sentence: This morning the office was a complete mess; we couldn't find the documents.

mandarin_meaning: 殿；殿堂，寺庙或宫殿的主厅
english_meaning: hall; palace hall; main hall of a temple or palace
explanation_mandarin: 指寺庙、宫殿等建築物中的主要大廳或殿堂，常用於描述具有宗教或祭祀、正式用途的場所。
explanation_english: Refers to the main hall in a temple or palace; a large, formal hall often used for worship, ceremonies, or official purposes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間古廟嘅正殿好有歷史。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gu2 miu6 ge3 zing3 din6 hou2 jau5 lik6 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这座古庙的正殿很有历史。
examples.english_sentence: The main hall of this old temple is very historic.

mandarin_meaning: 殿下（对皇室、贵族等的尊称）
english_meaning: Your Highness (honorific for royalty/nobility)
explanation_mandarin: 用來稱呼皇室、貴族或具有崇高地位的人，表示尊敬的稱呼。在口語中有時也會用作諷刺或戲稱，形容某人擺架子或自以為高人一等。
explanation_english: A respectful title used to address royalty or nobility (e.g., princes). In colloquial use it can also be used sarcastically to mock someone acting superior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 殿下，請入座。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 haa6, ceng2 jap6 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 殿下，請入座。
examples.english_sentence: Your Highness, please take a seat.

mandarin_meaning: 殿堂（大殿、宮殿；比喻崇高或權威的場所或級別）
english_meaning: hall; palace; (figuratively) a revered place or a 'hall-of-fame' level/status
explanation_mandarin: 指大型建築中的正殿或宮殿；也可比喻權威、崇高的場所或地位（如「殿堂級」）。
explanation_english: Refers to the main hall of a large building or palace; can also be used figuratively to denote a place or status of authority and reverence (e.g. "hall-of-fame level").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間寺嘅殿堂好宏偉，值得一睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 zi6 ge3 din6 tong4 hou2 wang4 wai5, zik1 dak1 jat1 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間寺廟的殿堂很宏偉，值得一看。
examples.english_sentence: The hall in this temple is magnificent and worth seeing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺音樂界已經係殿堂級嘅歌手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jam1 ngok6 gaai3 ji5 ging1 hai6 din6 tong4 kap1 ge3 go1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在音樂界已經是殿堂級的歌手。
